Crammed in one corner amidst the jumbled containers is an intricate wooden table, its surface covered in various contraptions.  Tucked just underneath it is a copper-framed box, its lid open wide.  The stuffy air sometimes stirs, sending the beads of the exit curtain to clattering.

title: [House Aspis, Roundhouse]
description: The most striking object in this circular room is the solid glaes column that rises from the center of the room to the ceiling.  It is apparent that this supports some great weight.  Floor-to-ceiling windows allow the light to stream in on the pool that surrounds the column.  Small benches and chairs line the tiled flooring, and a service bar circles the great column.

The most striking object in this circular room is the solid glaes column that rises from the center of the room to the ceiling.  It is apparent that this supports some great weight.  Floor-to-ceiling windows are awash from the shadowy reflections off the pool that surrounds the column.  Small benches and chairs line the tiled flooring, and a service bar circles the great column.

title: [House Aspis, Observatory]
description: The ceiling of this mystical chamber is a huge open dome of paneled glass.  The walls, also of glass, are covered in leafy vines of climbing ivy.  Centered in the room is a magnificent silver dragon, head held high, with eyes containing unimaginable knowledge.  A closer look shows the beast actually to be a large telescope, aimed directly into the sky.  Nearby is an old wooden table, heaped with astrological charts, scrolls, and other instruments of discovery.

The ceiling of this mystical chamber is a huge open dome of paneled glass.  The walls, also of glass, are covered in leafy vines of climbing ivy.  Centered in the room is a magnificent silver dragon, head held high, with eyes containing unimaginable knowledge.  A closer look shows the beast actually to be a large telescope, aimed directly into the night sky.  Nearby is an old wooden table, heaped with astrological charts, scrolls, and other instruments of discovery.

title: [House Aspis, Dragon's Back]
description: Moonbeams and starlight cast the entire observatory in a mystical glow, especially here, high atop the back of the dragon.  A comfortable-looking, cushioned bench fills most of this small area, but the centerpiece of the dragon is the large silver and brass telescope affixed near the dragon's neck and pointed toward the heavens.  Steps along the tail lead back down to the main floor of the observatory.

title: [House Aspis, Dragon's Lair]
description: The walls of this room are filled with books, old and new.  A large, centered, modwir table gated with six chairs has several scrolls scattered on its scarred surface.  Two overstuffed chairs flank the fireplace to form a sitting area.  Atop the mantle, intricately carved silverwood dragon bookends brace several well-worn books.  A smaller version of the original painting found in the foyer of the House hangs above the fireplace.

title: [House Aspis, Pool]
description: Around the glaes column, the cool, refreshing water is deep enough for swimming.  A benched area for the poolside bar rests near the tiled steps for lounging or exiting.

title: [House Aspis, Hallway]
description: A honey oak door, an oak door, a modwir door, and a heavy red oak door line either side of the thickly carpeted hallway.  Flickering lanterns provide lighting for visitors and to draw attention to the walls where portaits of the leaders of Aspis through the ages hang, each framed in elegantly carved silverwood.

title: [House Aspis, Hallway]
description: This hallway provides access to an oak door and a carved door.  Flickering lanterns cast warm light upon the thickly carpeted area and draw attention to the walls where portraits of the leaders of Aspis through the ages hang, each framed in elegantly carved silverwood.

title: [House Aspis, The Hive]
description: The glowing warmth of the honey-colored, oak-paneled walls and ceiling envelop all who enter.  The floor is softly covered in a deep piled moss green carpet.  Illuminated by flickering wall lamps is a large quilter's ring with an unfinished quilt stretched taut within the frame.  Alongside a cozy, overstuffed chair sits a hand-woven basket overflowing with needlework supplies and yarn.

title: [House Aspis, Sea Thrak Room]
description: This elegantly furnished bedroom casts a quiet spell of calm.  Time has aged its wide modwir plank floors to a warm brown, softened by simple hand-woven rugs.  A matching quilt is pulled back from the pure white linens of the four-poster bed, where plump pillows lie invitingly.  On the side table rests a lit oil lamp and a crystal vase filled with freshly plucked sea lavender.  Billowing sea-cotton curtains frame a distorted reflection of the room in the leaded glass windows along the far wall.

title: [House Aspis, Sun Room]
description: The two outside corner walls of this room are glass doors granting access to a small, private garden.  Moonlight gives the red oak flooring a blue shading.  Chimes of all sorts drop down from the ceiling, their music casting a hypnotic sensation on every breeze.  A large red oak tub, built into the floor, is filled to brimming with steamy water.  Fluffy, absorbent towels are stored in a rack within easy reach.

title: [House Aspis, Dragon Hideaway]
description: The thick oak walls that make up this split-level hideaway are adorned in mystical elven patterns.  The bed, on the upper level, is enormously oversized and drowned in fresh silks.  Two steps down, windows of etched glass line the outer wall, while cushions at their base provide a spot for rest.  At the base of the steps are large bookcases, home to volumes of novels and books of history.  An old overstuffed chair sits in the corner.

title: [House Aspis, Sun Room Tub]
description: Warm to the touch, the water seems a perfect temperature for relaxing.  The heat source is revealed from the pressure of several valves jetting hot water into the tub.  The canted sides on each end of the tub provide an inviting place to lean back and relax.

title: [House Aspis, Sun Room Garden]
description: Secluded from view from other areas of the House by a tall stone wall covered in leafy vines, this garden opens to the west to overlook the river.  Two cushioned lounge chairs with matching table between them face the water offering a shadowy view of the night sky reflecting off the surface of the water.

title: [House Aspis, Guest Room]
description: A comfortable-looking canopied bed covered in thick fleece blankets stands at the far end of this room.  To one side, a cozy fireplace is flush with the wall, the logs within waiting to crackle with a warm blaze.  On the mahogany bureau is a delicate porcelain vase containing a tiny bunch of fragrant, freshly-picked violets from the garden.  Two beautiful hand-crafted chairs lined with silk nestle by the wall.

title: [House Aspis, Griffin Room]
description: This is a comfortable, simple bedroom.  The dominating feature is the large puffy bed set upon a carved and polished base made of modwir.  There are no other notable features except for a simple oak bookcase and a thin wool floor cover.  Tapestries adorning the walls are visible to those entering the room.

title: [At a Glance, Showroom]
description: White silk walls surround this small room, made cozy by the soft glow of crystal lanterns from above.  An elegant display of velvet-draped trays show off a variety of mirrors that sparkle in the light.  A sapphire curtain leads to another room, the thick material rippling with the small breezes that enter through the tent's opening.

title: [Crown Confections]
description: Swathes of pastel-colored chiffon are draped across the linden-framed walls of the tent, the airy fabric bound with clouds of pale cloth-of-vaalin.  A glass-covered ebonwood stand sits in the middle of the rug-covered room, flanked on either side by displays of iridescent-lacquered linden.

title: [Crown and Kettle, Provisions]
description: Pewter-framed portraits cover the teal-colored walls of the shop, the canvases flanking a ceiling-high wrought faenor cabinet positioned beside tall marbled vases of half-unfurled ivory peonies.  A neatly piled stack of flannel-lined dark fel crates stand between gleaming suits of gilded armor, each container decorated in silver-inked calligraphy.

title: [Crown and Kettle, Trinkets]
description: An oversized frame of copper-lacquered wood encircles a wrought pewter rack across the back wall, the display presented before a brushed grey velvet-padded chaise in the center of the room.  A crown-shaped teal iron stove and accompanying plum wicker basket are set upon a rounded haon table, flanked by numerous sketchings of charcoal and ink.

title: [Wyvern's Hearth, Leaf Room]
description: Numerous jars of tea leaves cover the shelves of the curtain-draped shop, the colorful glass containers flanking a ceiling-high rich mahogany cabinet kept far from the bustle of the entrance.  Laurel-encircled wicker bins are artfully arranged between murals of forestry and fortresses, the artwork framed in gilded bronze.

title: [Wyvern's Hearth, Bean Room]
description: The robust scent of coffee beans fills the room, the heavy canvas-stitched sacks obscuring the vibrantly inked murals lining the walls of the shop.  A wyvern-carved mahogany display stands beneath a hammered fortress-etched shield, flanked by a pair of feather-filled crates, the containers guarded by crossed spears angled upward towards the brass-framed lanterns above.

title: [Elven Lure]
description: High walls of crimson spidersilk rise in a spherical shape to encompass the wide area of the pavilion.  The flames from ornate brushed metal candelabras cast a dancing glow throughout, while the sweet aroma of jasmine incense has infused the air.  Piles of soft throw pillows cling to the corners of the tent, and a curved redwood counter is nestled between two ebony racks on the back wall.

title: [Soled Out]
description: Beneath lengths of honey-hued gossamer, smooth white sand covers the floor of a timber-framed pavilion.  Some woven reed baskets dyed vivid scarlet are scattered along the perimeter between oversize pots containing local flora and fauna.  In front of a parchment screen, a display table draped with tonal silks offers an assortment of ornaments and trimmings.

title: [Soled Out, Storage]
description: Creamy white parchment screens separate this space from the main pavilion.  Trunks and boxes laden with wares are piled high in the corners, waiting to be sorted and set out for sale.  Wedged between woven reed bins, a dye-splattered bin, filled with vivid, liquid-filled vials, creates a colorful centerpiece.

title: [Soled Out, Workroom]
description: Behind a wall of parchment screens, the gossamer panels draped over the pavilion have been drawn back, affording a spectacular view of the meadow.  A shoe form rests upon a sturdy worktable littered with tools, inked designs, and measuring cords.  Beneath the table, neatly labeled boxes containing a variety of footwear await delivery to their new owners.

title: [A Great Cover Up]
description: Pale mistwood poles stand in each corner of the tent, holding the silk canopy high overheard.  The ground is covered by a plush pewter-hued velvet rug, with a circular cottonwood rack standing atop it in the center.  A delicate faenor chain curtain partitions off the rear of the tent and also provides access.

title: [A Great Cover Up, Work Area]
description: Soft purple silk rugs have been layered atop the velvet rug of the tent and strewn with some plush silver velvet cushions to provide a comfortable place to rest.  A small cottonwood table and a padded three-legged stool stand along the rear wall of the tent.

title: [Garden Of Light, Flower Beds]
description: Light moss-hued silk is draped over a sturdy mistwood frame, creating the walls of this spacious tent.  The ceiling is left open, allowing sunlight to stream through to bathe rows of temporary flower beds in a blanket of warmth.  A carved stone bench sits in the center of the area, its surface covered with a display of beads and gems.

title: [Garden Of Light, Fountain]
description: Centered in the room is a golden marble water garden that surrounds a beautifully carved mermaid, water spouting from a blossom in her cupped hands.  A wide assortment of plants grow in the warm pool, their vibrant blossoms a kaleidoscope of color.  A small stone table is set to the side, its surface covered with a variety of metal wires and lengths of ribbon.

title: [Polished Up]
description: Gilded vines burgeoning with sharp-tipped thorns wend through the burgundy damask rose pattern of the silk-paneled walls.  Luxurious walkways lined with wildflower tapestries cut paths throughout the spacious wagon, stopping only before a spade-footed vaalin and onyx carousel and a two-tiered woven linden branch rack.  The gleaming lacewood floors extend up the back wall in the form of a luminous, wide-framed bay window.

title: [Once and Floral]
description: Glowing orbs hang from each tent pole, casting a warm light throughout the area, with one particularly bright orb illuminating a calligraphed sign at the center of the shop.  Carefully arranged racks and stands house a lovely array of color-coordinated blooms and blossoms for sale.  A slender crystalline vase sits upon a marble pedestal in the rear of the tent.

title: [Devices of Destiny, Sanctuary]
description: Pale blue rays of light trace the edges between the dark interior walls and the low flat ceiling of this solemn chamber.  At the center of the calm space, a sylphlike figure of light poses atop a small circular plinth, its body arced in graceful poise.  Its slender arms extend to cradle a spherical crystal in cupped hands, gaze angled towards the heavens.  While appearing dark and solid, the floor feels a bit spongy.  Two shimmering light blue portals stand on opposite walls.

title: [Snowy Mountain Track]
description: Pale moonlight illuminates fluffy snowflakes that drift down slowly from the starry heavens and collect along snow banks that hug this secluded track in the mountains.  To the north, the trail ends at an ancient-looking arch at the base of a towering mountain wall.  A light blue portal stands at the other end of the path.  Despite the visible surroundings, the atmosphere is quite comfortable.

title: [Abandoned Cave Shrine]
description: Numerous candles inhabit the nooks and crannies of this dark yet spacious cave.  Pale yellow light illuminates the immediate area inside an ancient-looking arch but leaves the ceiling and corners invisible in the darkness.  Breezes pass through, yet all the candle flames remain undisturbed.

title: [The Amethyst Firefly]
description: Silver-threaded ivory carpets line polished birch floors, wending through the pavilion's lushly lined interior of amethyst silk and ivory velvet.  A padded crystal case rests near the end of one carpet, while a rich mahogany chest is thrown open near the center of the area, a silver-framed parchment discreetly placed to one side.

title: [The Amethyst Firefly, Imports]
description: This small circular area is draped with lush silks and velvets in forest greens and golds, with a silvery violet silk curtain leading into the back.  Clustered together at the center are a silver-edged crystal display and a mahogany case, a silver-framed parchment betwixt the two.

title: [Firefly's Flight]
description: Various bits and bobs from glassworking are scattered across the floor, and tools of the trade clutter one corner.  Dozens of plump, soft velvet cushions provide comfortable places to rest.  A silvery violet silk curtain leads back to the main pavilion, and dozens of arathiel fireflies in a variety of colors dangle from the ceiling, reflecting ambient light in a polychromatic glow.

title: [At a Glance, Backroom]
description: Velvet-lined boxes are stacked against the silken walls of the large tent.  A wide variety of colorful silk pillows are scattered about the area.  Set within a cloth divider is a thick sapphire curtain leading out to the main room.

title: [Thresk's Outfitting]
description: Blue-speckled sea glass walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A plain wooden table and a plain wooden table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Thresk's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the smooth mistwood walls.  A plain wooden table and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Thresk's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by gold-veined marble walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a plain wooden table and a plain wooden table.

title: [Asylum, Common Room]
description: This massive room is outlined by some small tables conjoined with battered metal chairs, leaving the center of the room open for roaming.  Neighboring the arched entry doors are some barred round-top windows that cast faint stripes of sunlight diagonally across the stone floor.  The only decorations on the walls are a few modwir-framed some warning signs.

title: [Asylum, Solitary Wing]
description: A foul odor and crazed screams fill the air of this entire corridor.  Strands of cobwebs hang from the ceiling and brush against exposed skin.  At the base of a rusty metal barred door lies a dead mouse next to a mousetrap that has not been used.   Some pieces of bloodstained padding are stuck to the bottom of the other barred door.

title: [Asylum, Caretaker's Office]
description: Gloomy and dank, the office is barely better than a cell.  One stone wall is lined with some filing cabinets containing the inmates' files that have been organized alphabetically.  A plain desk with a metal chair stands near the back wall.  Upon the desk is a lantern, quill, and a large stamp.

title: [Asylum, Administrator's Office]
description: This large office is tidy and well-decorated unlike the rest of the asylum.  A stone wall is decorated with a prestigious framed award above a wide glass case containing jars that display various-sized brains.  The back wall is completely shielded by floor-to-ceiling bookshelves that serves as a backdrop to an elaborate ironwood desk settled in front of it.

title: [Asylum, West Wing]
description: The austere appearance of this corridor lends to the rigid atmosphere of the entire asylum.  The hallway is mostly empty except for the occasional rat or stone-faced guard that passes through on watch.  A few benches have been firmly secured to the floor along the perimeter.

title: [Asylum, Living Quarters]
description: The only thing neat about this room is the precision of beds being arranged in straight rows.  Blankets are strewn about with some on the beds and some on the floor.  Ripped pieces of paper, covered in bizarre drawings and maps, lay in pieces on the ground near a scratched wooden door.  A tall pile of dirty clothes clutters up one corner of the room.

title: [Asylum, West Wing]
description: The austere appearance of this corridor lends to the rigid atmosphere of the entire asylum.  This section of the hallway has a bit more activity with inmates who occasionally run by.  A few benches are firmly secured to the floor along the perimeter.  The wall at the end of the hall has a chalky door outline with bits of cracked and crumbling stone in the center.

title: [Asylum, Lecture Hall]
description: The cobblestone walls stretch up and up, nearly vanishing into the shadows.  The walls are lined with hammered iron sconces, their light flickering off the damp stone walls.  Several rows of tall-backed settees are fixed towards an imposing podium with an obsidian top.

title: [Asylum, Visitation Room]
description: In the center of the room is a long wooden table with chairs on each side, though only one side has chained cuffs bolted to the floor.  A large window is sheltered by criss-crossing metal bars, allowing only a dreary amount of light to enter the room.   stands next to the solid steel door.

title: [Asylum, East Wing]
description: The austere appearance of this corridor lends to the rigid atmosphere of the entire asylum.  The hallway is mostly empty except for the occasional stone-faced guard that passes through on watch.  A few benches have been firmly secured to the floor along the perimeter.  Some massive double doors lead to a shared sleeping quarter for the inmates.

title: [Asylum, Living Quarters]
description: The only thing neat about this room is the precision of the beds being arranged in straight rows.  Blankets are strewn about with some on the bed and some on the floor.  Ripped pieces of paper, covered in bizarre drawings, lay in scattered pieces on the ground.  A pile of dirty clothes surrounds an empty wicker laundry basket in the corner.

title: [Asylum, Dining Room]
description: The vaulted stone ceiling is decorated with hanging iron chandeliers that cast a soft glow across the room.  A massive dining table covered with a dark cloth dominates the heart of the room with seemingly countless chairs surrounding it.  Uniformed workers come and go from a winding metal staircase that leads down to the kitchen.

title: [Asylum, Kitchen]
description: The large room seems to be in some sort of organized chaos.  Disheveled cooks with dirty aprons bustle about, some putting and some taking things off the wooden island counter in the center of the room.  A service table designated for ready-to-go trays of food sits next to a winding metal staircase that leads upstairs.

title: [Asylum, Solitary Wing]
description: The repulsive odor here almost distracts from the excruciating cries that echo through the corridor.  The recently painted stone walls are already peeling and cracking from the damp air.  A filthy tray rests just outside a tiny wooden door at the bottom of the wall.  There is a metal barred door leading to an inmate's cell and a solid steel door that yields no clues to what lies beyond.

title: [Asylum, Padded Cell]
description: Every wall in this room is covered in a plush, thick white padding.  This place seems to rob the senses, with every sound being absorbed by the room.  The room is extremely dark with only a faint presence of light coming from a narrow slit in the steel door.

Every wall in this room is covered in a plush, thick white padding.  This place seems to rob the senses, with every sound being absorbed by the room.  The room is extremely dark with only a faint presence of light coming from a narrow slit in the solid steel door.

title: [Asylum, Solitary Wing]
description: Dust and haze fill the air, making it difficult to see either the thick steel door or the adjacent metal barred door.  Draperies of cobwebs hang from the low ceiling and brush against anything that moves through the hall.  A slimy puddle lies in the center of the hall, giving off a tangy stink.

title: [Asylum, East Wing]
description: The austere appearance of this corridor lends to the rigid atmosphere of the entire asylum.  The hallway is mostly empty except for the occasional rat or guard that passes through on watch.  Benches have been firmly secured to the floor along the perimeter.

title: [Asylum, Treatment Center]
description: The walls are decorated with iron sconces and strange-looking symbols.  Medical instruments and cabinets secured with iron padlocks surround a large steel table that carries evidence of past examinations.  A large black cylindrical helmet sits above a restraining chair in the corner with a tray of needles neighboring it.

title: [Asylum, Experimental Therapy]
description: This cold room is filled with strange-looking equipment and furniture.  Against the wall furthest from the door is a massive wooden wheel with adjustable straps for securing legs and arms.  Two iron tubs sit against one of the side walls with buckets labeled "Ice Water" lined up in front of them.  On the opposing wall is a flat wooden bed and a wooden chair, both affixed with countless straps and buckles, with a tall metal cabinet separating them.

title: [Ostwicke Hall, Dressing Room]
description: Several wooden tables stand along the southern wall.  Before each table are several chairs, with a mirror hanging above the table before each seat.  Luminescent orbs glow brightly around each mirror.  One corner of the room is crowded with a desk topped by all manner of gaudy jewelry, painted masks, and colorful wigs.

title: [Jungle Path]
description: The humid air hangs heavy over the pathway, and the heavy tree boughs come together overhead to cast the area in permanent shadow.  Here and there, dappled light infiltrates the area, providing enough illumination to light the path and some details of the dense jungle to either side.

title: [Jungle Path]
description: Winding deep into the jungle, the path underfoot is well-trodden and clear of any typical jungle floor debris.  The air is filled with the raucous cacophony of birds, insects, and animals that dwell in the trees.  As the trail continues to the northwest, the foliage around you grows notably denser, though the path remains clear.

title: [Jungle Path]
description: Various low-growing flowers bloom in a vivid array of colors, here at the edge of a clearing.  The path ends subtly by fading gradually into the surrounding flora.  A natural gap in the blossoms leads to a wide expanse of grass.

title: [Iyo Glade, Clearing]
description: To the west, several grave markers are visible beyond a gnarled wooden gate.  The area is nearly silent, as a reverent air hangs over the space.  Beside a natural gap in the flowers, the jungle blooms fade to a wide clearing to the east, showcasing long grass and wildflowers.

title: [Iyo Glade, Graveyard]
description: Low-hanging boughs serve to muffle any ambient noise that might reach this space, making the very air around you peaceful and still.  Springy moss underfoot muffles any footfalls, and despite the omnipresent jungle at the perimeter of the graveyard, no untoward sounds reach this solemn area.  Rows of carved tombstones stretch away from the path in neat symmetry, some bearing colorful flowers and other offerings.

title: [Iyo Glade, Meadow]
description: A wide path leads through the meadow, its edges marked with fresh-cut timber.  Wildflowers intermingle with long grass on either side of the path, swaying gently in the breeze.  Here and there, definite sounds of small creatures moving through the grass can be heard, and a plump honeybee lazily makes its way from blossom to blossom.

title: [Ship It, Salesfloor]
description: Drab beige canvas encloses the sparsely furnished space, lit by the silvery moonlight streaming through the open tent flap.  Against the back wall, some tall standing shelves display neatly organized shipping supplies.  A worn sailcloth bin, tucked beneath a long oak table, frays along the rim where heavy use has loosened the threads stitching the fabric around a wiry metal frame.

title: [Ship It, Outgoing]
description: Stuffed to the brim with parcels, large canvas baskets crowd this half of the tent, aided by stacked, envelope-filled bins.  A simple lantern hangs from the pole supporting the roof, casting innumerable shadows in the crammed space.  Contrasting the chaos piled behind them, a linen-draped table and a stamped wood crate hold goods arranged in an orderly fashion.

title: [Iyo Glade, Clearing]
description: A large wooden totem stands in the middle of the path here, with whimsically carved creatures hanging from it in various directions, each peering intently in different directions.  The path itself splits into the four cardinal directions, with a steady trickle of shoppers and sightseers making their way through.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Iyo Glade, Market]
description: Tall grasses to the east give way to a congested tree line to the west, the path narrowing as it yields to the dense vegetation.  Uneven patches of the jungle floor have been cleared away to make room for small shops and travel between, a splintered haft of an axe or hatchet all that remains of the endeavor.  The blinking of fireflies reveals other nocturnal visitors in the canopy above, who quickly scamper away upon being sighted.

title: [Iyo Glade, Market]
description: Painted wooden totems line the uneven path, carved into representations of meditating humanoids with colorful birdlike heads.  Each one is decorated with gemstones and feathers, and faces a matching counterpart between a row of shops on the opposite side.  An elderly Iyo woman dips her hand into a tiny wooden bowl before tracing her fingertips along one of the figures.

title: [Conservation of Glass, Entrance]
description: Layers of tonal red linen panels compose the airy canopy and walls of this pavilion while a simple cotton rug covers most of the dirt floor.  Next to the entrance, a small incense holder releases a mixture of cinnamon and clove, giving the room a subtle, warm scent.  Above, lit glass lanterns are suspended from the rosewood crossbeams and provide a soft, steady glow over a glass display case, its contents displayed on a delicate glass shelf.

title: [Conservation of Glass, Lounge]
description: The tonal red linen panels have been pulled shut tightly to keep the warmth of the day and light from a pair of glass lanterns trapped inside.  Several comfortable cushions line the perimeter of this area, offering shoppers a brief respite.

title: [Flights of Fancy, Showroom]
description: The sharp tang of freshly honed metal and oil fills the air of this utilitarian wagon.  A simple cotton rug sits along the floor, its color long worn away by heavy traffic.  Overhead, a pair of lit sconces that have been lashed to the bows illuminate the room while a woven wicker basket dangles between them.  Against the wall, a wooden display has been arrayed with a variety of wares that have been neatly organized into rows.

title: [Iyo Glade, Market]
description: Gnarled roots and brambles cluster to the south, home to a vast array of insects and other tiny fauna that flit about the various types of flora here.  Built atop the overgrown path, a platform supports one larger shop while others make do with what support they are afforded.  Narrow pathways wind between the shops and a gap in the tree line leads north into a dense, wooded thicket.

title: [Iyo Glade, Market]
description: Massive roots jut from the ground, only to burrow once again and vanish as they find purchase in the jungle floor between a semi-circle of tents and stalls.  Thicker than most trees and arching higher than a full-grown giantman, the roots converge near a dense wall of brambles and hanging mosses.  The blinking yellow-green lights of fireflies illuminate the area, revealing the boughs of a gigantic redwood beyond the tree line to the west.

title: [Crystalline Creations]
description: Tapered green branches, many with their leaves still attached, are woven together with vines to form a rustic arbor. The structure is tucked between two giant roots of an ancient redwood, narrowing as it stretches back toward a curtain of hanging moss that obscures the secrets of the tree's deeper embrace.  In front of the living drape stands a naturally finish oiled zebrawood tray.  Two more displays are closer to the front and equally offset to either side, a single piece cocobolo log pedestal and cocobolo log stand completing a triangle with a pyrographed cedar sign at the center.

The structure is tucked between two giant roots of an ancient redwood, narrowing as it stretches back toward a curtain of hanging moss that obscures the secrets the tree's deeper embrace.  In front of the living drape stands a naturally finish oiled zebrawood tray.  Two more displays are closer to the front and equally offset to either side, a single piece cocobolo log pedestal and cocobolo log stand completing a triangle with a pyrographed cedar sign at the center.

title: [Iyo Glade, Clearing]
description: A wide path cuts its way through the grass on either side, making its way towards a copse of trees of various types and sizes.  To one side of the path is a large wooden sign, cleverly carved to appear as if it is being held by a small pile of grinning Iyo children.  Overhead, fireflies flare to life in random patterns, forming incidental constellations that fade nearly immediately.

title: [Step By Step, Entrance]
description: A polished brass lantern brightens the wagon, directly above a large sign that greets customers upon entry.  A small glass case, secured with iron fittings, casts prismatic light across the makeshift ironwood shelving.  Nestled above an oak table, the contents of a glass-topped ruic cabinet glisten softly in the ambient light beside a latticework divider.

title: [Step By Step, Workroom]
description: Bolted against the far wall a small workbench, with an ironwood chair secured behind it by iron latches, sits beneath a row of pegs that hold assorted cobbling tools.  Some small crates line the edges of the workshop, with markings that indicate the contents as assortments of cobbling supplies stored for future need.  Beneath a small brass lantern, a latticework divider leads out to the rear of the wagon.

title: [Spin Me A Yarn]
description: A woven paeline overhang, dyed with circular, kaleidoscopic pastels, rests atop the makeshift ironwood frame of the small stand.  Resting beneath the overhang, a villswood table is tucked away from the elements to ensure the quality of its wares.  Small flyrsilk-lined baskets are mounted on the rear wall, piled precariously high with a selection of yarns for sale.

title: [Iyo Glade, Clearing]
description: A raised wooden dais stands in the middle of the clearing, with a circular path all around it.  The platform itself is painted a deep forest green, the hue almost a perfect match for the surrounding grasses.  A number of paths lead away from the clearing, each one framed by split logs, while to the north a wooden archway is guarded by a pair of stern-faced Iyo.

title: [Iyo Glade, Shrouded Respite]
description: A half-sphere of underbrush serves as the entrance to a heavily wooded area, with towering trees reaching towards the sky, their branches intertwining in an impressively dense canopy.  A curved trail defined by split logs to either side leads directly to a large gap in the underbrush, with a colorfully painted totem standing to one side.

title: [Head To Toe, Showroom]
description: This open-air stall is made from long cocobolo limbs lashed together with sinew.  A thatched roof of jungle ferns keeps the elements at bay.  Centered in the space are two straw mannequins decked out in handmade finery.  The female mannequin is facing the male mannequin, while between them a small table holds several more items for sale.  A reed curtain leads to another room.

title: [Head To Toe, Backroom]
description: The open air is blocked slightly by swathes of woven palm fronds that drape from the thatched roof to cover two of the walls.  A small firepit warms the area in the center of the room.  Several small hooks on the cocobolo support poles dangle random objects that swing in the breeze.  A reed curtain leads to the front room.

title: [Iyo Glade, Shrouded Respite]
description: A large bonfire has been set up in this area, and is strategically located underneath a breach in the overhead canopy.  A series of wooden tables and benches has been arranged around the bonfire, and a flop-eared puppy works its way around from table to table on an endlessly hopeful circuit.  A stack of cut firewood stands off to one side, ready to keep the bonfire stoked should it start to flag.

title: [Iyo Glade, Shrouded Respite]
description: The canopy overhead is thick in this area with massive tree trunks dotting the space but not much in the way of underbrush.  Straw has been laid out across the ground to prevent mud from forming in the humid conditions, and a series of elaborately carved wooden benches are interspersed in no discernible pattern.  It is quiet here, with a distinctly settled, peaceful ambience amongst the towering trees.

title: [Iyo Glade, Bazaar]
description: The trees here are spaced far enough apart that the grass has grown long to either side of the path, and pockets of it have encroached into the trail itself, where it has been trampled flat by pedestrians.  A steady trickle of shoppers wend their way through, stopping occasionally to peruse the wares of one shop or another, or to greet an acquaintance.  The low hum of conversation is pleasant and mixes in with the occasional twitter of birds from the treetops above.

title: [Iyo Glade, Bazaar]
description: The trees in this area are widely spaced, allowing for plenty of free movement amongst them.  There is a path running east to west, lined with felled trees to give it a rough sense of order.  Here and there, various stalls have been set up amongst the trees to either side of the path, and a quiet buzz of muted conversation drifts by on a slight breeze.

title: [Iyo Glade, Meadow]
description: A small congregation of ducks lies sleeping just off the path in this area, nestled amongst the deeper recesses of the grassy meadow.  The pathway branches here, allowing for passage around the pond while also winding towards a small copse of trees to the north.  A neatly tended garden of bright wildflowers sits across the trail from the sleeping ducks, suffusing the air with a light, delicate aroma.

title: [Dolgin's Den, Entrance]
description: Hanging mirrors are positioned around the perimeter of the entrance, reflecting light from a lantern to the southwest.  Ash and soot mingles with the earthy dirt on the ground to the northwest, the blending of their natural hues staining the bottom of a hanging doorway that leads out.  Roughly hewn beams of ironwood support thick, patchwork walls and a ceiling decorated with dark silks that hang from taut ropes overhead.

title: [Dark Pit]
description: Dim light spills through a tiny gap above, barely illuminating the bottom of this freshly dug pit.  A nose-turning blend of caustic smells mingles abhorrently with rotting vegetation and charred flesh, the slime and sludge staining the bottom of a knotted hemp rope that leads up and out.

title: [Pelted Protection, Front]
description: A dazzling array of crystal beads decorate the inside of this tent, arranged horizontally and spaced evenly from the bottom edge to the apex of the arched ceiling.  Each row of crystals shifts to a different hue of the rainbow, refracting the small amount of starlight making its way through the tent's entryway.  Pelts and hides form the walls of the tent, supported by slender lengths of faewood.

title: [Sticks and Stones, Hollow]
description: Buzzing fills the hollow interior of this massive mistwood tree.  The occasional bee flits past you, gone in an instant as it heads up from a rabble of the tiny creatures defensively swarming the entrance from intrusion.  Gnarled growths along the walls form a series of narrow ledges that ascend into a massive honeycomb hive covered in busy worker drones.

title: [Iyo Glade, Meadow]
description: The grassy trail is slicked down from heavy foot traffic, but despite the humid conditions there is no mud to speak of.  A spongy layer of moss cushions every footfall while also reducing the ambient noise in the area.  The trail splits here, encircling a large pond fed from a small stream trickling in from the jungle.  Cattails dot the banks of the pond, and a large oak tree stands on the far bank, offering a bit of shade in this otherwise open expanse.

title: [G.E.M. Co., Main Floor]
description: Stacks of crates are stamped all over with the label "G.E.M. Co."  A single crate has been pried open and reveals numerous uncut gems of all different colors and sizes.  Leaning up against a large boulder are sets of miner's tools: pickaxes, lanterns, helmets, and large satchels that are all covered in stone dust and mud.  Settled up against a worktable is a dark red, velvet-lined display filled with rough, uncut gems.

title: [Sew Bustled, Gallery]
description: The heady scent of champagne and strawberries assault your senses as shades of purple and pink blend together in a mass array of silks that line the room.  Feathered boas dangle from hooks, their ends holding up rose-gold chandeliers with dark red candles.  Lined against the eastern wall is a display of six mannequins, each dressed in a different gown.

title: [Iyo Glade, Meadow]
description: A low, wide bridge spans the modest creek feeding a pond, and the air is suffused with the burbling of clear water as it tumbles its way through the shallow creek bed.  At the edge of the jungle, where the creek first becomes visible, a small herd of deer can be glimpsed through the trees, alternating taking careful drinks of water and eyeing the clearing warily.

title: [Refuse Reclaimed]
description: Strung around the planked walls on rusty chains, repurposed wine bottles softly illuminate the cozy space with a flickering glow.  A splintered padauk door with broken hinges lies across a stack of wooden crates and displays a hodgepodge of wares.  Smooth river rocks weigh down a painted terracotta pot that houses a charred tree limb tilted precariously to one side.  Its blackened, jewelry-draped branches brush against a patchwork curtain, fringed in cowrie shells, bissecting the wagon.

title: [Refuse Reclaimed, Workshop]
description: Organized chaos reigns over the well-stocked workspace.  Old hardware, bones, and other assorted odds and ends fill the various containers on a series of battered steel shelves.  One wall is covered in iron hooks used to store a diverse array of crafting materials.  Haphazardly stacked in one corner, a pile of reclaimed wood is fraught with exposed, rusty nails.  Across from a patchwork curtain, tools and half-finished projects litter the surface of a paint-splashed workbench.

title: [Tropically Tailored]
description: Spiraling up teak columns, vibrant, multihued organza opens into layers of draping, diaphanous curtains.  Elaborate sprays of vivid tropical flowers and verdant ferns blossom in the porcelain vases, swept with gold leaf, set on either side of a lacquered teak rack.  Punched with a floral pattern, a trio of hanging coconut shell lanterns cast light upon a vellum-paneled divider painted with blue macaws and a gilt-hooked rosewood display.

title: [Tropically Tailored, Sanctum]
description: Gossamer swathes enclose the teak pavilion with an ethereal rainbow of sheer fabrics that gently flutter under the coercion of a delicate breeze.  Cushioned by flyrsilk pillows with a bold hibiscus motif, a collection of rattan chairs is cozily nestled in one corner.  Alexandrite vines twine around the wiry legs of an aureate teacart set before the backdrop of a vellum-paneled divider painted with blue macaws.

title: [Iyo Glade, Meadow]
description: A large oak tree overhangs the well-trodden path in this area, with its boughs stretching out over a large pond as well.  A near-constant chirping can be heard from the bowels of the mighty tree, occasionally accompanied by the flutter of wings against leaves.  At the base of the tree, a few wary squirrels hunt for food while remaining alert and ready to dash away at any sign of trouble.

title: [House of Hatters]
description: Tall foliage-covered walls form the perimeter of the shop, each partition decorated with vibrant flowers crafted of vellum and silk.  The filigree-painted center of the room is covered by a tiered display of enamel teacups, the tiny ceramic containers posed in haphazard positions and held aloft by thin strands of ribbon-wrapped wires.  Several butterfly-shaped lanterns hang from the crosshatched ceiling, forged from blown glass, the diminutive figures casting rays of colorful light across the room.

title: [Garden Gatherings]
description: Fluffy white clouds cover the bright cerulean canvas lining the walls of the pavilion, the cotton-stuffed masses floating by a sun-shaped golden lantern hung above a curtain of silk and velvet-petaled roses.  An oversized bright clay planter stands at the forefront of the shop, flanked on either side by a display and rack woven from lacquered wicker, the containers surrounded by silk-petaled tulips dyed in a medley of colors.

title: [Garden Gatherings, Tea Party]
description: A series of spoon-strung ropes and teacups are draped high above a lacquered teak table encircled by colorful velvet chairs, the vibrant glass cups tinting the flora-strewn surfaces in a medley of bright tones.  The latticed walls of the garden are dotted with verdant green topiaries, their concealed branches creating a foundation for thin wooden shelves filled with glass bottles.  A curtain of silk and velvet-petaled roses leads back into the pavilion, the entrance decorated with tiny wire-framed bees.

title: [Inner Glow, Fountain]
description: Sheer curtains of white gauze cut across the room, hanging from alum-linked chains and splitting the pavilion into three sections.  The floor is freshly trimmed grass, thick and dark green, interrupted by pots of exotic lily flowers.  There is a metal arbor trellis covered in passion flowers arched over a marble fountain, flower petals raining down into the fountain's bowls below.

title: [Iyo Glade, Bazaar]
description: The trees here are older than elsewhere in the grove, their trunks wide and knotted.  A layer of pine needles lays atop the path, muffling footfalls from the shoppers making their way to and from the various stalls and booths.  A great tortoise sits motionless to one side of the trail, slumbering peacefully.

title: [Dreamfire Illusions, Entryway]
description: Thick plush rugs cushion the footfall of shoppers in this cozy canvas pavilion.  A multicolored assortment of stained glass lanterns illuminate the shop's wares with a warm welcoming glow.  Cyan-orange ombre banners decorate the ceiling and walls, their gradient artfully mimicking an early evening sunset.  In one corner, a simple arch is roped off.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, out

title: [Dreamfire Illusions, Backroom]
description: A multicolored assortment of stained glass lanterns provide warm light in this spacious gathering room.  Multiple lotus silk sitting pillows have been arranged in a semicircle with a break to allow for an unobstructed walkway.  On the far side of the room are a variety of tools and storage cabinets, hinting at the room's function as a multipurpose space.

title: [Iyo Glade, Bazaar]
description: Just beyond this last small clearing, the jungle becomes impenetrable on all sides.  The trail ends in a small circle, with various shops clustered around its perimeter.  In the center of the circle is a wide sandbox filled with half-dashed structures and hand-dug craters.

title: [Craft and Create]
description: Warm shades and cool ones, printed and solid, metallic and matte, the patchwork fabric sashes forming this shabby tent create a cacophony of color.  A triplet of matching end tables, one missing a handle and all of them scuffed and worn, define the space.  One table with a deep gouge and its back to the central pole supports a silver-veined white marble stand with a small chip.  The one with a missing handle stands against the outer wall and bounds the space on the west, just as the third well-worn end table resting near a pair of painted silk privacy screens draped with ribbons and lace bounds it to the east.

title: [Craft and Create, Cozy Corner]
description: Repurposed crates are stacked around the wall like shelves, each cubby filled with small boxes, piles of folded fabric, tarnished statuary, and broken jewelry.  Wildly mismatched, overstuffed pillows surround the eclectic space and create an inviting ring of comfort.  Towards the northwest, in front of a wall of heavy curtains and just opposite a pair of painted silk privacy screens draped with ribbons and lace, an ornate brass tray with a fractured mirror top offers a mix of refreshments.

title: [Dreamfire Illusions, Nook]
description: Nestled into this corner of the pavilion is a small sales nook lined with plush rugs.  A multicolored assortment of stained glass lanterns illuminate the shop's wares with a warm welcoming glow.  Decorative plants in glazed pots line the walls and hang from the ceiling, creating a verdant oasis in this nook.

title: [Dreamfire Illusions, Alcove]
description: Antique wooden benches rest atop thick plush rugs in this alcove of the pavilion.  A multicolored assortment of stained glass lanterns illuminate the shop's wares with a warm welcoming glow.

title: [Dreamfire, Stock Display]
description: Multiple fabric murals decorate the three canvas walls of this side room, each showcasing a scenic view of a different terrain, while an assortment of stained glass lanterns provide illumination to view the artwork.  The center of the room prominently features a large six-sided stock panel display with hundreds of designs.  An erithi attendant lingers nearby, awaiting customer orders.

title: [Craft and Create, Cut Corner]
description: Strings of quartz crystals weigh down the chaotically colorful fabric ceiling, their facets scattering light that glints off precious stones in a rich mahogany jewelry display lined with worn blue velvet.  To the northeast, a pair of potted pale sage lace ferns frame a glossy ebony buffet with a missing door that backs against a wall of heavy curtains.  On its black granite top with a spiderweb of cracks are jars of broken jewelry, boxes of mismatched beads, and a partially polished copper tin.

title: [Dolgin's Den, Drake Room]
description: The walls are discolored and blistered in this cramped showroom and a handful of cloaks are folded and stitched into layers to patch a hole in the ceiling.  Dim light makes its way here, reflecting off a series of hanging mirrors to the southeast.

title: [Dolgin's Den, Workshop]
description: Scraps of zorchar and fragments of scorched wood are scattered between crates, cases, and racks repurposed to create this makeshift workspace.  Some of the merchandise offered here looks drastically incomplete by comparison to those next to it.  A lantern brightly illuminates the corner furthest from the pavilion's entryway to the northeast.

title: [Pelted Protection, Back]
description: Slowly rotating one way then the other, a large crystal prism hangs over the center of the floorspace in the back of this large tent.  Multihued motes dance across the walls and wares here, refracting light from the entryway to the west, and are a constant source of entertainment for passing patrons who partake in the visual display.

title: [Pelted Protection, Pile]
description: Splintered crates and overturned chests litter a pile of discarded vegetation and debris.  Dim motes of light dance across a massive mithril footlocker atop the pile, reflecting off a large prism to the south.  The footlocker has been flipped on its side, revealing its contents.

title: [Sticks and Stones, Hive]
description: Inside the hive you see thick, overlapping layers of honeycomb laden with nectar and encapsulated with beeswax.  The thick amber liquid produced by the inhabitants here oozes and drips slowly around a dark crack, towards a shallow hole where a large knot has fallen free from the adjoining bough.  Thousands upon thousands of worker drones buzz around you, seemingly docile and undisturbed by your presence.

title: [G.E.M. Co., Dig Site]
description: Sheets of burlap have been wrapped around large chunks of stone and bound in place against the support beams of this makeshift hut.  Crates half-filled with stone surround a large hole in the ground to the east side of the building.  A crane system with pulleys and wheels has been built near the crater and currently has a wooden pallet hooked to the end of it.

title: [G.E.M. Co., Supply Room]
description: Large panes of colored glass line the eastern wall framed with mithril.  Swirled hues of amber, verdant, and crimson stain the otherwise clear walls.  Piles of grime-covered mining clothes dot the room, making the air pungent with the scent of sweat and minerals.  Set centrally in the room is a mesh metal wire basket filled with raw stones.  Several have tumbled over the rim and lay scattered about the surrounding area.

title: [Sew Bustled, Dressing Room]
description: Gold-leafed dressers line the east and west walls and carry upon them rose-gold trays filled with morsels to snack upon.  Teardrop crystals dangle from stringed pearls that are draped across the walls, while a large round mirror is placed above the line of gemmed streamers.  A honey-colored teak ladder breaks up the space between rooms, opening to a loft above.

title: [Sew Bustled, Loft]
description: Swathes of fabric are strewn across the room, creating a dizzying meld of colors and patterns.  Tightly wound bolts line the wall behind a worktable and a worn leather armchair.  Short, silk-covered settees are pressed against the chiffon tapestry-covered walls of this workspace, while mannequins representing the sizes of various races are dressed in half-stitched garments on the other side.  There is a square opening in the floor with a honey-colored teak ladder set against it.

title: [Inner Glow, Jungle]
description: Large fern plants and draped vines with fan-like leaves spread across this section of the pavilion.  The thick foliage creates a dense curtain of humidity, the pressure weighing heavily with each breath.  Mist burbles outwards from within this man-made jungle, creating a dense haze across the ground.  Cutting through the dark plant coverage, the form of a white to grey peahen can be seen, the avian poised protectively by a large nest.

title: [Inner Glow, Pond]
description: Stone steps lead up into this section of the pavilion and up to a pool of water.  Brightly colored fish of pale orange and silver dash beneath the watery surface when spotted.  Lily pads decorate the pool, some bearing large lilies ranging from pure white to dark shades of pink while others are made of stone and hold up widowwood lanterns.  Near the water's edge is a gnarled tree sprouting up from the lagoon, looming overhead like a contorted figure.

title: [Iyo Glade, Graveyard]
description: A large boulder sits directly in the middle of the path here, its surface worn slick by thousands of idle touches as visitors to the graveyard have passed by.  A mournful bird can be heard calling from somewhere in the distance, though it's impossible to tell from which direction the sound is coming.  The tombstones in this area seem slightly older than the ones nearer the gate, and their surfaces bear the telltale marks of weathering.

title: [Iyo Glade, Graveyard]
description: From here, the eye is drawn to a particularly ornate tombstone in the second row from the path.  It is nearly twice the size of the others surrounding it, and its surface is carved with dozens of evenly spaced sigils.  This tombstone is the only one with offerings laid before it, and amongst them is a wide, flickering candle with a large glass shield to protect it from the elements.

title: [Iyo Glade, Graveyard]
description: A massive blackened stump squats at the end of the path, its roots partially exposed as if the sheer force generated by the felling of its tree had forcibly yanked a portion of it from the soil below.  The tombstones are fewer here, when compared with the rest of the graveyard, and much older.  Some of the symbols on the stones themselves are nearly illegible, and here and there the stones have been broken or begun to crumble with the weight of years.

title: [Iyo Glade, Lowlands]
description: The path gradually slopes down towards a gentle depression in the forest floor that is populated by massive flowering trees, their branches hanging low and shrouding the entire area in heavy shadows.  Nestled amongst the tree trunks, a series of wooden tubs have been built, and a smiling young Iyo woman stands to one side of them, casually poking a stick at the brightly painted wooden ducks within.

title: [Iyo Glade, Lowlands]
description: A massive fallen tree dominates most of this space, its trunk a dozen feet or more across has been painted with colorful rings surrounding a tiny silver mushroom.  From the visible decay and large collection of moss and fungi around its base, the tree fell quite some time ago, and the path has simply evolved over time to wind around it.  A cheerful Iyo warrior lounges against a nearby stump where a dull mithril hatchet is deeply embedded in the wood.

title: [Iyo Glade, Lowlands]
description: A large wooden retaining wall holds back the jungle at this point, with massive treetops soaring high above.  A chubby red-bearded dwarf leans casually against an oak-framed sign near an elaborate runestaff lathe and a wrought iron staff rack beneath the sheltering canopy.  Underfoot, the ground is marshy and moist despite a liberal application of straw to assist with footing.  A series of oddly shaped benches sits at the foot of the wall, and the air is heavy with the scent of wet, loamy soil.

title: [Jewel of the Isle]
description: Mistwood racks hug the northern and eastern walls of this capacious square tent, their crossbars burdened with garments for sale.  At their junction, a multitiered mistwood jewelry coffret stands open, its clinquant offerings spilling from tier to tier.  The corner opposite them provides a small seating area, the cozy nook partitioned from the rest of the shop by a plushly cushioned L-shaped wooden bench.

title: [Concealed Conifer Close]
description: Nestled within the spacious triangle formed by two massive roots and a curtain of hanging moss, this cloistered corner is still and quiet, the protective vegetation guarding against wind and dampening sounds.  Along each side runs a parallel blackened cedar bench, providing a comfortable place to relax in the flickering light cast by several torches illuminating this hideaway under the ancient and majestic tree.  A live edge sliced teak table supported by three slender legs is at the center of it all, resting on a bed of plush moss that covers the ground.

title: [Firewheel Grove, Pathway]
description: This grove is exclusively populated by massive firewheel trees, their branches intermingling into an impressive canopy shot through with brilliantly colored flowers.  A pathway encircles the grove, stretching out to the northwest and northeast, while a wooden archway leads back towards the main festival grounds.

title: [Firewheel Grove, Pathway]
description: Firewheel trees flank the pathway, their resplendent blooms thick amongst the emerald green of their wide leaves.  The area is quiet and the air heavy with the sweet scent of the omnipresent flowers.  The path continues in a wide arc, stretching away to the north and southwest.

title: [Firewheel Grove, Pathway]
description: The grove comes to an end in this area, a dense wall of underbrush coming up to one side of the path, preventing passage.  Despite the proximity however, the firewheel trees remain to the opposite side of the path, completely separate from the rest of the forest.

title: [Firewheel Grove, Pathway]
description: The path defines a boundary between the dense underbrush of the jungle to one side, and the brilliantly flowering firewheel trees to the other.  The sounds of movement can be heard from the underbrush, as some jungle creature dashes away, crashing through the branches in its haste.

title: [Firewheel Grove, Pathway]
description: Underbrush rises up into a dense wall to the north, forcing the path to cut a sharp corner.  The firewheel trees remain on the opposite side of the path with no hint of invading underbrush amongst their wide trunks.  A pair of squirrels dart amongst the firewheel tree branches, chittering madly as they chase each other around at breakneck speed before disappearing from sight.

title: [Firewheel Grove, Pathway]
description: The path here curves to the north, following the edge of the grove.  Brambles form a dense wall just to the west, though it stops well short of causing any danger to those who remain on the path.  The branches of the trees are heavy with aromatic blooms, and the humid air is suffused with their sweet scent.

title: [Sunset Cabin, Foyer]
description: This room is alive with the near-constant happy warbling emanating from a large polished brass gilded cage containing a pair of bluebirds.  Formed from unfinished logs, the walls of the cabin are crafted and fitted so perfectly that none of the frigid air from outside can be felt.  A series of polished silver hooks are imbedded in the wood at eye height directly adjacent to the oak door, and a small stool sits just beneath them.

title: [Sunset Cabin, Sitting Room]
description: Overhead, a skylight floods the entire room in clear, natural light, illuminating a large wooden table surrounded by a series of mismatched comfortable-looking chairs that runs the gamut of bright colors.  In one corner is a wide rhimar chest, and across the room from it is a large flagstone fireplace.  A low, wide sofa festooned with multicolored pillows is situated in front of the fireplace.

title: [Sunset Cabin, Bedroom]
description: The most prominent feature of this room is the four-poster bed against the wall opposite the door.  Each of its posts reaches almost to the ceiling before joining a rectangular frame that surrounds the bed, from which is draped a series of diaphonous curtains.  A small table is set near the bed, and a large iron-latticed lantern stands in one corner of the room.

title: [Sunset Cabin, Rooftop]
description: Somewhat shielded from the elements on three sides by the roof of the cabin, this cleverly constructed perch looks out across an expanse of undisturbed snow.  The night sky is brilliantly lit with an innumerable number of bright stars, and a pair of padded wooden chairs are situated to allow both comfortable relaxation and easy access to a small rhimar chest strategically placed between them.

title: [Sunset Cabin, Workshop]
description: This room is rather cozy, but well-organized despite the lack of floor space.  A sturdy desk sits in the middle of the room, its surface covered with trinkets and baubles, and a large cabinet stands against one wall.  Interspersed around the walls are various paintings, each one rather abstract and seeming to be more focused on colors than shapes.  A small window provides enough light to see by, and a small fireplace is nestled against one wall in case more light or heat is required.

title: [Sunset Cabin, Kitchen]
description: Large portrait windows on three sides of this room allow for plenty of natural light, which illuminates an oval wooden table with padded chairs, a long counter with a white ivory basin at one end, and a tall white cupboard.  The faint scents of cinnamon and sugar hang in the air, remnants of previous culinary experiences.

title: [Garden Sanctuary, Approach]
description: Soft, thick moss carpets the floor of this small, circular chamber.  The delicate sound of a bubbling spring reflects off the smooth stone walls and fills the area with a sense of peace and serenity.  Heady aromas of mimosa blossoms and water plants waft through a shimmering portal filled with opaque green mist, complementing the underlying earthy scent of native grasses.

title: [Garden Sanctuary, Retreat]
description: Naturally flowing water spills down and around an extensive tumbling of sandstone rocks.  A single mimosa tree reaches an impressive height, bending its heavily laden boughs over a delicate mistwood bridge.  Elegantly arching over the spring, the bridge has a soft blonde color that stands out distinctly against a background of tall, slender grasses.

title: [Garden Sanctuary, Reception]
description: Precisely pruned trees of varying heights give a secluded feeling to the otherwise open expanse of short, pale emerald grass.  A simplistic stairway forms a fanning crescent down the side of a modest hill, adjacent to a sculptural stonework buffet and a bronze patina pedestal.  Warm, twinkling lights float amongst the limbs of back-set red maples that provide a fiery accent to the understated landscape.

title: [Garden Sanctuary, Altar]
description: Neutral sand-hued stones pave the earthy ground and are punctuated by a mix of smaller blue-grey and ivory pebbles.  A series of decorative stone lanterns line a wide, silk-spread aisle, leading to a lush koi pond in front of an ornate mistwood altar.  Minimal flowerage exists within the verdure flourishing around the area, dotted only by sprays of woody indigo blossoms and nearly transparent white buds.

title: [Garden Sanctuary, Conservatory]
description: A set of curving stairs trails off at a statuesque pavilion with a peaked crown covered in slate shingling.  Three dewy glass walls seclude a silk-cushioned trestle seat, while still allowing a sweeping view of the profuse irises and fruit trees.  Sunken into the ground, a silvery stone water basin faintly glimmers under shifting beams of sunlight.

title: [Shanty Town, The Garden]
description: Faded gravel pathways create a series of meandering trails that stretch throughout an expansive and verdant green garden bordered by raspberry bushes.  Thick vegetation grows at the edges of the plot, while a rickety scarecrow stands guard over a wide field of pale flax.  Several varieties of squash are clustered around tidy rows of carrots, tomatoes, pea pods, strawberries, lettuce and cabbage.  A sturdy workbench rests beneath a tool rack holding a number of burlap sacks and stained shovels.

title: [Shanty Town, Bread Booths]
description: Tucked away just beyond the garden's edge is a stretch of gravel and dirt that has been cleared away for a semi-circle of several wooden booths and an old firepit.  Dozens of Shantytown residents mill about, enjoying some hot meals and relaxing beneath the canopy of a thicket of trees. Some sit upon heavy logs spread about.  A sweet, yet faint, mixed aroma of bread and flora permeates the area.

title: [Illithien Aerie, Courtyard]
description: Starlight glimmers off windows set into an arched stone gatehouse fitted with several hitching rings.  Branching from the archway is an elevated stone aqueduct encircling the grassy courtyard.  Carved into the mountainside in graceful bas-relief is an intricate facade set with paned windows that terminates at the top of a high ridge.  Two slender marble columns flank a tall engraved copper doorway.  A small platform encased in a scrollworked vertical truss is set to one side of the facade.

title: [Illithien Aerie, Snowcap Atrium]
description: An arching, engraved copper entryway stands watch over the immense atrium, whose pale marble floor is inlaid with rings of concentric copper and jade to form a complex mandala.  Starlight speckles the floor as it filters through rose-hued window panes, while lit copper braziers keep the shadows at bay.  Twin staircases curve invitingly upward to meet in a broad balcony.  Tapestries provide a discreet screen to the hallway beyond.

title: [Illithien Aerie, Crystal Baths]
description: A deep mineral scent pervades the warm cavern cut into the limestone heart of the mountain by natural and artisanal means.  An expansive crystalline hot spring, captured behind a low mortared flagstone wall, is fed by a pair of elegant, carved aqueducts circumscribing the rough stone walls, with two inlaid stone stairways completing their frame around the pool.  A filamentous network of rose quartz veins twists throughout the limestone walls, conveying a warm, ethereal light from the surface into the cavern.

title: [Illithien Aerie, Petrel Parlor]
description: Open and airy, the large chamber is brightly lit by refracted light from a chandelier above, though faint starlight can be glimpsed through high windows.  An immense carved marble fireplace dominates one pale wall, while the rest are adorned in paintings and tapestries.  Scattered chairs and settees are arranged in small clusters around low tables, while a lacquered tanik sideboard rests discreetly below a curving staircase leading upward.

title: [Illithien Aerie, Astrapia Hall]
description: Marble pilasters bearing bas-reliefs of elven figures rise toward the arching ceiling.  A banquet table oversees the cleared space of the dance floor from a raised dais, while opposite stands a low gilded imflass sideboard full of refreshments beneath a long mirror wrought in imflass filigree.  Cushioned chairs, both around the table and along the far wall, offer ample seating.  Pale starlight streams in over the railing of an open balcony onto the dance floor, the encroaching shadows kept at bay by gilded candelabra.

title: [Illithien Aerie, Plateau]
description: Broad and naturally level, the plateau affords a breathtaking panoramic view of the shadowed valley beyond.  A chill wind whips across the expanse of granite, which is offset by the rising spires of the estate's roofline as it ascends the mountainside from below.  A scrollworked copper gate provides entry to a formal garden placed just opposite of the conservatory, while a crystal walkway curls around low stone terraces outside the structure before descending along the cliffside.

title: [Illithien Aerie, Conservatory]
description: Warm, moisture-laden air fills this large conservatory.  Countless panes of copper-hued glass framed with white metal arch high overhead, warding off the alpine night.  Night birds silently flit to and fro after prey.  Marble tile pathways lead between raised planter beds, each filled with lush flora and dotted with blooms in gradient hues.  A densely canopied dwarf haon is the focal point, its translucent leaves casting a luminescent halo magnified by a reflection pool beneath its elliptical foliage.

title: [Illithien Aerie, Garden]
description: Fragrant wisteria envelops the encircling wall, its perimeter broken at opposite ends by a scrollworked copper gate and a circular platform.  Towering over a wrought imflass bench, an ancient thanot stands watch over rows of cultivated flowerbeds.  Starlight bathes the garden in an ethereal glow, and dew glimmers on a ring of toadstools emerging from lush moss underfoot.  The mountain continues its ascent from the plateau along one side, where a rosy glass door is set within the exposed cliff face.

title: [Illithien Aerie, Woodstar Salon]
description: Starlight drifts through large paned windows on either side of the entryway, illuminating the circular salon in a silvered glow.  Hooded copper lanterns are suspended along the marble pilasters flanking several bookcases, each stacked floor to ceiling with a variety of tomes and manuscripts.  Several armchairs are arranged around a low table at the center, and a desk stands beneath one of the windows.  A shallow copper brazier emitting wafts of incense rests near the entry.

title: [Illithien Aerie, Workshop]
description: Hanging lanterns illuminate disparate work areas in their flickering glow, and glint off of mica-flecked walls.  Easily half of the chamber is taken up by tool-strewn worktables and sturdy desks, a low bookcase sandwiched between them.  In one corner, inlaid mithril runes encircle a massive granite slab that rests where the shadows are deepest.  A peculiar copper clockwork dragon stands guard near the passageway, a lone sentinel watching over the half circle of chairs clustered at the workshop's heart.

title: [Gallardshold, Northern Field]
description: Huge stone walls and ramparts stretch along the area, comprising the northern fortifications of Gallardshold.  Armored imperial soldiers march the length of the stone battlements, their eyes always trained to the distance.  To the south and east, the fortress city expands, while a narrow trail bends north into an expanse of trees.

title: [Northern Woodlands, Small Trail]
description: A narrow trail leads away from the great stone walls of Gallardshold and bends through thick patches of dark modwir trees.  A huge menacing forest rises up to the north.

title: [Northern Woodlands, Trail's End]
description: The trail gradually comes to an end, the dirt path eventually giving way to thick foliage and thorny brambles.  Rising up like a great foreboding force, the outer edge of the Wyrdeep Forest stretches as far as the eye can see.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest, Edge]
description: The outer edge of the dense forest is blanketed in a welcoming array of lush green grass and colorful wildflowers.  Wide rows of ancient yew trees fashion a pronounced boundary as they sway to and fro, their twisted limbs stretching and beckoning, inviting passerbys into the forest's depths.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest, Opening]
description: Wildlife is curiously absent at the entrance, and there is an unsettling calm that hangs in the air like a thick fog blanketing the encircling forest.  Faint bursts of sunlight bleed through modest breaks in the foliage overhead, affording barely enough light to illuminate the path.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest, Clearing]
description: The meandering path that leads farther into the forest grows increasingly difficult to navigate, dead leaves and broken twigs forming a protective cover over the almost concealed pathway.  Crisp snaps and crackles burst noisily from the surrounding woods in an unsettling cacophony.  Toward the east, a small clearing draws attention, a visual distraction from the hypnotic calls of the forest.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Wyrdeep, Treetop]
description: The giant wyrwood tree rises above a number of trees surrounding it, providing ample viewing on the forest below.  Vines run along the tree's numerous thick branches, twisting and coiling like thin snakes.  Periodically, the sound of leaves rustling or twigs snapping can be heard somewhere within the woods.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: Surrounded by pebbles and rocks meticulously placed, a wooden sign tilts on a splintered stake.  A solitary wyrwood tree looms above you, its twisted branches hanging uncomfortably still.  Adjacent to the circle of stones is a makeshift shrine covered with clumps of animal fur, bloodied claws and teeth, and what appears to be cracked feystones.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest, Briar Bed]
description: Thick growth has reluctantly given way to a small clearing, prickly vines and sharply barbed briars threatening entanglement to any who attempt passage.  Broken clay pots and scorched slats of faewood are strewn across the ground, a faint smell of smoke hanging heavily in the air.

title: [Wyrdeep, Golden Glade]
description: Great wyrwood trees enclose this glade on all sides, their trunks as light as amber, their branches a pale green tinged with gold, looking almost unreal.  The air is peaceful, infused with wild scents from the surrounding forest and alive with the song of birds in the distance.  The grass covering the glade is lush and full, like a bed of viridian silk spread throughout the area.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: Moss-covered stones slick with strange chartreuse-hued algae border a small stream, its wavering voice gurgling like a victim of strangulation.  The pathway is hidden beneath a deep layer of flourishing vegetation that leads travelers along its green trail.  Guttural moans seep from the maze of trees that obstructs the view in all directions.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest, Twisting Path]
description: Clouds of fog swirl along the ground, spawning tiny whirlpools of green mist that consume any dead vegetation that exists on the forest floor.  A deafening screech pierces the air, but is quickly muffled by echoing footsteps.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: The air is stagnant despite the fact that the dark green leaves on the imposing villswood trees rustle like a silent alarm.  A faint trickling of water can be heard in the distance.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest, Twisting Path]
description: Hundreds of footprints litter the forest floor and point in every direction, indicative of to and fro travel.  Heavy fog laden with a viridian tinge hangs in the air, the diffused light casting a green glow along the ground.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: A small brook heads off through the trees to the west, but the thick vegetation blocks movement in that direction.  Clusters of exotic-looking mushrooms, ranging from very small to a width of nearly a foot, blanket the ground in a muted array of color.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: Thorn-covered vines wind their way across the ground and up each tree, strangling the forest in an unforgiving grasp.  Complex cobwebs decorate each branch, their skilled weavers veiled in dark shadows.  A smidge of light sneaks through an opening overhead, but is quickly snuffed by the shifting forest, leaving the area in near darkness.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: The lack of ambient light in the suffocating darkness makes it impossible to discern the time of day.  Eerie howls and muffled scampering confirms the presence of unseen beings, but offers little solace as the approaching sound resonates through the trees.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: A long slender branch hangs from an overhead limb, coiled and twisted into a natural noose.  A bed of crushed leaves and broken branches lies on the ground beneath the bark-covered appendage, a faint outline of footprints imbedded in the brush.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: The stream widens as it makes a sharp southwestern turn at an unexpected opening in the forest.  While the undergrowth remains unforgiving, a diminutive breach offers a rare glimpse deeper into the shrouded woodland; a small village lies in ruins.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest, Twisting Path]
description: A partially concealed trail forks in numerous directions, and there seems to be a slight familiarity to the area.  The viridian-tinged fog thickens, leaving a stench in the air that burns with every breath.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: Tufts of blood-covered fur, some with remaining chunks of rotten skin, are scattered across the ground in an obvious display of recent bestial combat.  Nefarious shadows slither in and out of the trees, their silent movement detected only when the sounds of crackling underbrush echo through the area.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: Fractured and low-hanging limbs are draped in fine, hair-like moss, and form a natural cage around the branching walkway.  Hushed moans perforate the quiet and haunting cries linger in the air.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: Surrounded by a seemingly endless chamber of enclosing growth, the forest threatens to suffocate trespassers and keep its secrets cloaked in mystery.  Wild vines with a snake-like girth and thorns as sharp as daggers slither across the ground making the journey rather treacherous.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest, Twisting Path]
description: Clouds of fog swirl along the ground, spawning tiny whirlpools of green mist that consume any dead vegetation that exists on the forest floor.  A deafening screech pierces the air, but is quickly muffled by echoing footsteps.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest, Twisting Path]
description: Hundreds of footprints litter the forest floor and point in every direction, indicative of to and fro travel.  Heavy fog laden with a viridian tinge hangs in the air, the diffused light casting a green glow along the ground.
