title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: Flowing with urgency, the stream empties into a dark, ominous cavity.  The water's roar is deafening, drowning all sounds from the enveloping forest.  Sharp and jagged rocks along the water's edge create a protective barrier from a fatal plunge into the cavern's depths.  The heavy growth to the south has become impenetrable.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest, Twisting Path]
description: A partially concealed trail leads through a cluster of wide trees, ending at the edge of a small outcropping.  Below the ledge, a narrow stream can be seen winding through the forest, its waters a deep silver-blue.  A few faint footprints can be seen leading right up to the edge, then seem to disappear over the side.

title: [Wyrdeep, Silver Stream]
description: A narrow stream bends through the forest here, its smooth waters a deep silver-blue hue.  Small flashes of red and gold can be seen in the depths of the waters, as the occasional fish comes near the glass like surface.  Periodically, a warm wind stirs through the trees, rustling the dark leaves and creating a cacophony of disembodied whispers.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest, Twisting Path]
description: Clouds of fog swirl along the ground, spawning tiny whirlpools of green mist that consume any dead vegetation that exists on the forest floor.  A deafening screech pierces the air, but is quickly muffled by echoing footsteps.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: Dark and menacing, the suffocating density of the forest has seized all natural light, save a small breach in the underbrush to the southwest.  An occasional caw ruptures the ominous silence as avian shadows fly overhead, trapped beneath the towering crowns.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: Tufts of grey fur hang on a nearby branch, and an iridescent wing shimmers on the forest floor beneath a sliver of light.  Loud snaps echo around the path and resemble random pebbles thrown in distraction attempts.  Whispers in a unfamiliar tongue are heard, but have no discernable origin.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: A formidable cluster of yew trees shares the confined space with thorn-covered bushes and blocks farther travel into the forest.  An oppressive mist has formed along the ground and swirls hauntingly at the base of the trees.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: From light deficiency or curse backlash, the deformed trees resemble freaks of nature with their buckled trunks and twisted limbs.  Shifting shadows play tricks with the darkness, but the absence of noise prevents tracking.

title: [Wyrdeep Forest]
description: A great horned owl swoops down in an aggressive ambush, catching its victims off guard, but returns to the dark sky and an unseen haven.  The darkness is foreboding and inhospitable, and with every step, distorted faces appear in the bark of the trees.

title: [Monkey Fist, Northeast Kitchen]
description: Neatly organized dishes rest upon steel-reinforced shelves, which stretch the length of the narrow, galley-style kitchen.  Copper lanterns provide ample illumination throughout the windowless space and a clever pulley-system attached to the ceiling rotates several palm fronds in slow circles.  One segment of the counter has been turned into a polished wood chopping block that has a pile of fresh garlic cloves and a large stoneware basin on it, while opposite stands an iron stove supporting a steaming pot.

title: [Secretive Sips, Sales]
description: Despite the fact the walls are nothing more than layered scraps of wood nailed together, this structure somehow manages to stay upright.  A scuffed wooden bar stretches across the back wall with a line of crooked hooks hanging above it, both displaying wares for sale.  A dingy wooden crate is shoved into a corner, its lid open wide.  The air is still with the sharp aroma of alcohol permeating the cramped confines.

title: [Diskovery, Opening]
description: Excavated from the ground is a massive pit with no visible side supports to prevent a cave-in.  The surface is nearly fifteen feet above the bottom, and the only exit is back up the ladder.  Considering the absense of display tables, inventory containers, or seating accommodations, the floating objects do little to unclutter the confined cavity.

title: [Eonak Arms, Showroom]
description: Sooty brick walls and a hard-packed dirt floor contain this improvised showroom below a domed ceiling.  Smoky haze hangs in the air around a display table with items for sale.  Facing the wall, a crowded workbench piled with unfinished parts stands next to a grinding wheel.  Shelves organize finished pieces awaiting assembly.  Heat and an orange glow emanate from a forge to the south.  At the center of it all, a diminutive figure with spider-like arms conducts multiple operations at once.

title: [Eonak Arms, Foundry]
description: An orange glow illuminates the area despite the lingering smoky haze that hangs in the air.  Occupying the southern wall is the source of that glow: a small forge under a large black vent that funnels smoke out through the domed ceiling's apex.  Sooty tables face the wall in a row, each with bins full of dirty sand underneath.  The sound of heavy footsteps accompanies a steel golem as it moves about performing menial tasks.

title: [Good In-Tent-ions]
description: The room is paneled in rough-hewn wooden planks, punctuated by long dark wood shelves stocked with multicolored folded tents.  Below the shelves is a row of evenly spaced bright silver hooks that boast a series of lanterns and torches above a red cedar trunk.  A low plank riser is covered with assorted containers.  A wooden pamphlet rack stands beside the entrance, offering a selection of tent upgrades.

title: [The Bloody Lotus, Paper]
description: Piles of origami paper are crammed about a slightly dusty wood desk, several splattered with an indeterminate crimson substance.  Dangling from the ceiling are numerous origami figures arranged in combat, and a tiny origami replica of Duskruin Arena sits between a small silver-bound chest and a stained parchment notice.

title: [The Bloody Lotus, Patterns]
description: Hanging from the scuffed rafters of the bungalow are numerous, battle-themed origami figures, and origami paper is stacked along all the walls and under a sturdy cedar table.  A chipped iris agate case perches precariously along a blood red stack of paper, a dusty piece of parchment propped nearby.

title: [A Twist of Briars, Betrayed]
description: Lifelike vines painted along the walls seem to writhe in an artistic display of optical illusion, their sinuous, briar-laden shapes twisting about a series of blued steel racks hanging above a dusty mahogany counter.  In one dusty corner, a vine-wrapped cherrywood box has been shoved under a scratched ebonwood shelf, a wild rose bush fighting to escape its terracotta confines sitting next to it.  Several actual vines creep in from cracks in the ceiling and dangle overhead in an almost menacing array of verdure.

title: [A Twist of Briars, Thorned]
description: Myriad painted vines along the walls are covered by actual rose vines that wend their way through chinks in the ceiling to writhe across the interior, dripping lush, overpoweringly scented roses and covered in vicious thorns.  A makeshift arch pushes the voracious verdancy away from a battered and scratched wardrobe and a widowwood-set cabinet, but a rose-painted birch shelf is thronged by a persistent cluster that rains rose petals into a crimson-stained box below.  A few enterprising offshoots are making their way across the floor in a vegetative attempt at dominance.

title: [Twinkling Twilight, Alcove]
description: A stone rail accented with brilliant topazes leads back upward to the well-lit entry of the shop.  Scattered into a dark corner is a heap of weapons accented with dark jewels.  Painted overhead is a silver crescent moon outlined with black sapphires of assorted shapes and sizes.  A decaying rope hooked into the wall offers guidance deeper into the darkness.

title: [Twinkling Twilight, Dungeon]
description: Iron bars encase a pair of small rectangular cells, each outfitted with a cot and a rickety bucket.  An unnatural light filters in through a crescent-shaped glass moon on the ceiling.  A small flight of steps lead downward into the darkness.

title: [Twinkling Twilight, Crypt]
description: The floor slopes down into an iron drain positioned in the middle of the room.  Water trickles from small holes in the wall, following the rough cobblestone to the drain in the center.  An iron grate hanging from rusted hinges lays open next to the small flight of steps leading back up.

title: [The Peashirmen]
description: Little more than a fishing boat, the skiff is painted bright orange and edged in glossy black.  Low seats are attached to the gunwale, three in total, at the center of the vessel, while a canvas tarp is draped across the triangular stern and bound in place by rope lashings.  A single pine mast, lateen-rigged, rises out of the boat, its bright purple and yellow sail safely furled and lashed in place.

title: [Deep Within Darkness]
description: Aside from a single, flickering grey orb floating near the center of the convex dirt ceiling, this room is completely dark.  Smells of overturned earth and the putrid stench of death attack your senses within this cramped space, while a thick, pitch black fog billows and roils about unpredictably, at times completely obscuring the merchandise for sale.  A tight dirt passageway is scarcely visible, barely arching out of the packed dirt ground.

title: [Heady Spirits, Shrine]
description: Dark and squat, a makeshift alcove has been gouged into the wall of the shed to create this tiny nook.  While there is little space to move, enough room has been made to house a low ivory shrine against one wall.  The air is stuffy and humid, the overpowering smell of mildew pervasive in the cramped quarters.

title: [Moot Hall, Council Chamber]
description: A rich merlot carpet stretches from end to end of this large, spacious chamber, which is aglow from the moonlight shining in through several arched windows along an entire wall.  Large, verdant green plants rest in terra cotta vases in each corner of the room, and the walls are decorated with detailed paintings of nearby historical landmarks.  A circular table sits in the center of the room, surrounded by several wooden chairs.

A rich merlot carpet stretches from end to end of this large, spacious chamber, which is aglow from the sunlight shining in through several arched windows along an entire wall.  Large, verdant green plants rest in terra cotta vases in each corner of the room, and the walls are decorated with detailed paintings of nearby historical landmarks.  A circular table sits in the center of the room, surrounded by several wooden chairs.

title: [Hailscatter Atelier, Workroom]
description: The spacious work chamber is lit by a number of candles in festive colors, each encompassed by a faceted crystal globe.  The dancing light gleams off of the edges of hay-lined crates full of various materials and pools on the surfaces of silky cushions scattered in a rough semicircle across the floor.  Bright tapestries soften the cold stone of the walls, featuring artistic cavalry scenes and forested splendor.

title: [Shivergale, Landing]
description: Climbing out of the shop below, the airy steel of a spiraling staircase rises to the second story of the structure.  It opens onto a spacious landing shielded from the frigid wind by a sheltering wall that holds boxes of hardy iceblossoms and beds of wintersbite.  Standing guard before an arched double door of darkly stained Ossian pine is an ice crystal statue painstakingly carved to resemble a wide-bodied dog frozen in a vigilant posture.
location: Shivergale, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

wayto.31428: ;e if GameObj.inv.find {|obj| obj.noun =~ /^key(?:ring)?$/};fput "go pine door";else;empty_hand;multifput "get my key from my #{UserVars.key_sack}","go pine door","put my key in my #{UserVars.key_sack}";fill_hand;end

title: [Shivergale, Antechamber]
description: Cool light lazes down through clouded panels of bluish crystal set into the high ceiling of the antechamber.  The source of the radiance is obscured, but it dances and ripples like sunlight warped by the surface of a windblown pond.  Near to the door sits an umbrella stand stand worked of modwir and heavy bronze and a wall-anchored ice crystal chime.  Underfoot, a carpet runner depicts puckish frostlings engaged in a riot of mischievous activities from trickery to theft.
location: Shivergale, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

wayto.31427: ;e if GameObj.inv.find {|obj| obj.noun =~ /^key(?:ring)?$/};fput "go pine door";else;empty_hand;multifput "get my key from my #{UserVars.key_sack}","go pine door","put my key in my #{UserVars.key_sack}";fill_hand;end

title: [Shivergale, Common Room]
description: Framed by cloudy panels of bluish crystal, a wide fireplace dominates the rough-hewn western wall.  The scent of oiled leather rises from a singularly expansive couch positioned to benefit from the fire's heat.  Before it sits a low, wide refreshment table atop a snowy white warg pelt that contrasts brightly with the stone-tile floor below.  A northern archway proceeds into a cozy pantry, while a lacquered hoarbeam door breaks the carved granite of the eastern wall.
location: Shivergale, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Shivergale, Pantry]
description: Framed by walls lined with shelves bearing a plenitude of spices and sundries, the welcoming pantry is gently lit by frosted glass windows.  At the center, a spacious granite island boasts a spread of delectables and beverages spaced around an ice sculpture carved to resemble a thriving wolf pack.  Just inside the spruce archway, a shallow porcelain wash basin rimmed in hand-painted winterberries stands at the ready.
location: Shivergale, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Shivergale, Bedchamber]
description: A tremendous four-poster bed with a lush teal comforter occupies the bedchamber, positioned beneath an illuminated crystalline dome etched with flurries of snowflakes.  Nearby, a frosted glass door opens onto a second-story patio that looks out over the rooftops and burrows of the town.  Silver threads glint from a tapestry of glacial blues and greens hanging on the opposing wall beside a lacquered hoarbeam door.
location: Shivergale, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Shivergale, Balcony]
description: Wrought iron fencing mounted with flower boxes of hardy snowdrops and vibrant purple crocuses encloses a spacious patio outside a frosted glass door leading into the home.  Sunlight awakens strange colors in the glacier encroaching from the north and the carved walls of ice holding the small town's burrows within their embrace.  Smoke trickles from the chimneys of several dozen buildings in an effort to hold the indefatigable cold at bay.
location: Shivergale, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Fatal Afflares, Rupture]
description: The lack of natural light and an abundance of moisture has fostered an unexpected home for maidenhair ferns and elderberry bushes.  Dirt and debris, transported from a steady trickle of water from the upper floor, has settled along the moss-covered ground and provides ample nutrients for the botanic migrants to thrive.  Wrapped in petrified roots, a partially buried chest rests in the corner, taunting all who enter.

title: [Solhaven, Dungeon]
description: The narrow corridor is dim and mildewed, occasionally lit with torches set between intervals of heavy iron cell doors.  Each cell has been constructed to hold even the most ardent criminals of Solhaven.  A small set of stairs wind their way up to the sturdy door that leads to the main guardhouse.

title: [Solhaven, Dungeon]
description: Throughout the length of the corridor, mold and mildew encrust the granite stone walls of each cell.  Dim torchlight offers little visibility to the area.  The air is cold and damp providing little comfort to the denizens of these cells nor any other in this forsaken place.

title: [Solhaven, Gaol]
description: A pair of rotted planks balanced upon two mold encrusted mason blocks are the only furnishing of this damp spartan quarter.  The ground is soft and sticky from the effluent of prior occupants.  The air is humid and reeks of foul smelling leftovers of partially decomposing fish remnants and other things that you do not care to identify.  A barred window set high above one wall allow what little fresh air and light to barely pierce the repugnance of this holding cell.

title: [Solhaven, Death Row]
description: In this deepest portion of the dungeon, the air is stale and barely breathable.  Huge iron doors of steel lined with krodera bars are set solidly in the stone to prevent any chance of escape from the final confinement.

title: [Crested Glory, Helms]
description: Arena flags and banners in a variety of hues and materials adorn the cabin walls, proudly advertising various venues and gladiators in boldly painted vignettes.  Several sets of wooden helm stands are stationed along the perimeter of the space, while a tiered wooden helm display is situated in the center and lavishly decorated for its place of honor.  A black-inked parchment sign is perched on the top of the display alongside a square enameled tray.

title: [Crested Glory, Materials]
description: The scent of earthen pigments and dyes hangs heavy in the air of this part of the cabin, and a thin gold-threaded curtain blocks further depths of the space from view.  Counters hug the walls, and atop them are a rope-handled wooden crate, an oversized silver vase, and a woven rectangular basket.  On the wall above the basket, a black-inked parchment sign is securely mounted.

title: [Griffin's Roost]
description: Surrounded by railings and high walls of protective glass, the enclosure provides a view of a veritable of a small forest with a faux cliff.  In the distance, a mammoth nest is visible upon an outcropping and is built within the crux of two flat stones that are braced against each other.  Adult griffins fly back and forth from the spot, attending to the structure itself and occasionally disappearing within.  Near at hand, a set of winding steps surrounded by smaston bushes lead into a tall stone tower.

In the distance, beyond the trail, a mammoth nest can be seen, built in the crux of two flat stones that are braced to lean against each other.  A pair of adult griffins fly back and forth to the spot, attending to the structure itself and occasionally disappearing within.

title: [Penguin Workshop]
description: The walls of the room are covered in wool cut-outs of fuzzy penguins, flippers held high as they appear to descend down their parchment slide.  The workshop is situated with a glowing brazier, providing warmth to the room, alongside the thick peppered pelts lining the floor.  Across from the brazier is an ora-banded barrel set next to some work tables, the working area complete with a long tool rack hung above for easy access.  Wood paneling frames the doorway, accenting the overall design of the room.

title: [Butterfly Workshop]
description: The walls of the room are covered in a collection of parchment-winged butterflies, the insects dyed in various shades of lavender and mint.  The workshop is situated with a glowing brazier, providing warmth to the room, alongside the thick snowy pelts lining the floor.  Across from the brazier is an ora-banded barrel set next to a sturdy oak worktable, the working area complete with tool rack hung above for easy access.  Wood paneling frames the doorway, accenting the overall design of the room.

title: [Neartofar Road]
description: Drifts of debris line the road as it follows a straight path through columns of oaks and larches.  Gravel mixes with the rubble, creating an uneven path.  Bits of broken cobbles peek out from the piles covering the surface.

title: [Neartofar Road]
description: Tufts of pale dandelions, light pink alyssum, and deep purple cornflowers dot the edges of the road.  One or two bold plants push themselves between the cobbles, reaching toward the sunlight.  Oaks and beeches intertwine to make a natural rooftop arch high above the ground.  Their brethren stretch back from the road, creating a dense forest.

Tufts of pale dandelions, light pink alyssum, and deep purple cornflowers dot the edges of the road.  One or two bold plants push themselves between the cobbles, reaching toward the moonlight.  Oaks and beeches intertwine to make a natural rooftop arch high above the ground.  Their brethren stretch back from the road, creating a dense forest.

title: [Neartofar Road]
description: Tree cover spreads out above the road, the gravel dappled by spots of sunlight shining through the leaves.  Partially cleared, large branches of deadfall remain at the sides.  Small holes and paths give evidence that various small creatures have found passage through.

Tree cover spreads out above the road, the gravel dappled by spots of moonlight shining through the leaves.  Partially cleared, large branches of deadfall remain at the sides.  Small holes and paths give evidence that various small creatures have found passage through.

title: [Neartofar Road]
description: Burry chestnuts fill the gaps where cobbles have come loose in the old road.  In a particularly large rut, a puddle has formed, its moisture an attractant to various insects, from mayflies to gnats.  Massive chestnut trees with smooth grey trunks stand sentinel along the edge of the road.

title: [Neartofar Road]
description: Stately oaks and beeches with full crowns line the sides of the cobbled road, their branches meeting over it in a perfect barrel vault.  Tendrils of thick, verdant ivy weave their way around and drape from the branches, creating dense walls of greenery.  A few scrawny blackberry bushes cluster about one of the trees.

title: [Neartofar Road, Dam]
description: Dotted with low-branching pear trees, a sunny meadow flanks the cobbled road, its grass teasing at the stone edges with wild overgrowth.  The southern edge of the grassy field highlights a bright thread of silvery stream held back into a small pond by a wide earthen dam that serves as a pathway across.

Dotted with low-branching pear trees, a shadowed meadow flanks the cobbled road, its grass teasing at the stone edges with wild overgrowth.  The southern edge of the grassy field highlights a bright thread of silvery stream held back into a small pond by a wide earthen dam that serves as a pathway across.

title: [Neartofar Road, Dam]
description: Wide enough to allow a wagon to pass, the dam's mounded dirt has been packed flat.  Old cobblestones peek from between weeds that have grown over the path.  Grass grows over the downstream side, while fuzzy cattails and golden water lilies crowd the upstream bank.  Water trickles out from the bottom edge of the dam through a cylindrical, dark clay culvert.

title: [Neartofar Road, Dam]
description: Serving as a path across the stream, a wide earthen dam is partially lined with old cobblestones.  Fragrant, twisted olive trees line the meadow on this side of the water, their branches laden with ripening fruit.  Scattered stones show through the dirt and weeds that cover the road.

title: [Neartofar Road]
description: Piles of leaves and other natural debris drift over the earthen road.  Bits of ancient cobblestone peek from underneath layers of dirt and greenery.  Arching overhead, a row of white oak trees shelter the road with their verdant canopy.  Thin rays of sunlight stream through small gaps in the thick, intertwined branches.

Piles of leaves and other natural debris drift over the earthen road.  Bits of ancient cobblestone peek from underneath layers of dirt and greenery.  Arching overhead, a row of white oak trees shelter the road with their verdant canopy.  Thin rays of moonlight stream through small gaps in the thick, intertwined branches.

title: [Neartofar Road]
description: Lanky moss drapes on the branches of tall modwir trees growing in a thick stand.  A few broken cobblestones peek from beneath a layer of dirt and moss.  Dense greenery cover the forest floor with its thick, verdant clusters.

title: [Neartofar Road]
description: Cobbles stand like miniature formations in what has become nothing more than a muddy, wide, corrugated pathway.  Fallen trees in various stages of decay are scattered about the side of the road.  Piles of moss-covered debris drift against the natural barriers.

title: [Neartofar Road]
description: Rugged and coarse, the road meanders through the thick forest, the surrounding terrain undulating with gentle rises and dips.  Thick patches of brambles grow under dense stands of trees.  A thick canopy of branches and leaves weave together, blocking almost all natural light.

title: [Neartofar Road]
description: Snaking through the dense woodland, the coarse roadway is protected by a naturally woven arch of leaf-covered branches.  Thick bushes and greenery flourish in the moist ground around the bases of the tall sentinels.  Here and there, bright rays of sunlight penetrate the canopy, illuminating clusters of cinnamon ferns and some stalks of snakeroot.

Snaking through the dense woodland, the coarse roadway is protected by a naturally woven arch of leaf-covered branches.  Thick bushes and greenery flourish in the moist ground around the bases of the tall sentinels.  Here and there, pale rays of moonlight penetrate the canopy, illuminating clusters of cinnamon ferns and some stalks of snakeroot.

title: [Neartofar Road, Grassy Field]
description: Leaving the dense forest, the road meanders through a secluded meadow.  A wide creek winds about the green pasture before disappearing into the thick brush that lines the boundaries of the woods.  Patches of colorful wildflowers brighten the lush, grassy plain with their vibrant hues.

title: [Shadowed Forest, Trail]
description: Twisted together in a huge tangle, long deadfalls line the sides of the broken trail.  The trees above close in, enveloping the cleared area in shadows.  Leaves, moss, and bark in various stages of decomposition litter the ground.  Clusters of fungi grow from small nooks in the decaying foliage.

title: [Shadowed Forest, Trail]
description: The thick cover of maple and oak trees trees block out almost all light, creating a humid and damp environment below.  Piles of dead leaves outline the path alongside colorful clusters of fungi thriving in the moist conditions.  Small tracks indicate the considerable traffic of woodland creatures.

title: [Shadowed Forest, Trail]
description: Cover from the entwined branches of the massive trees that fill the forest allows very little light to pass down to the moist leaves that blanket the ground below.  Thick brush lines the narrow road, while a wide array of debris hides thick roots that make travel treacherous.  Rustling leaves high above blend with the sounds of creaking branches.

title: [Shadowed Forest, Trail]
description: Casting darkened shadows over the woods, the tops of a wide variety of towering, umbrageous trees hinder the light trying to filter down from above.  Thick shrubbery marks the roadway; the tangled barriers show signs of recent cutting with chopped lengths thrown on top of the live plants.  A discord of noises from small, rummaging creatures echoes throughout the gloomy forest.

title: [Shadowed Forest, Trail]
description: Bits of stone and rubble scattered about make travel difficult.  Throughout the dense forest, thick climbing plants grasp the bark of the trees, their surfaces damp from the humid climate.  Pale green moss dotted with fungal growth clusters about the trunks.

title: [Shadowed Forest, Trail]
description: Leaves still attached to twigs and branches dot the path, creating shadowed obstacles for the unwary.  Clusters of mayapples peek out of tangles of brush that grow thick on the side of the road.  Patches of smooth cobblestones are visible beneath the dirt and dust that has accumulated.

title: [Shadowed Forest, Trail]
description: Far-reaching and dense, the forest spans out in all directions, quickly lost in the darkness.  Curving branches create an enclosed natural archway blocking all but the thinnest rays of light.  Ruts and bumps mar the debris-covered cobblestone road, the way outlined by thick walls of entwined brush on either side.

title: [Shadowed Forest, Trail]
description: Light breaks through the thick, twisted canopy above, sending narrow rays of diffused illumination to the ground below.  Brush has been uprooted and trampled alongside the barely visible road.  In the disturbed soil, tangled dewberry brambles have taken over, choking out any other vegetation.

title: [Ironwood Tree, Clearing]
description: Standing sentinel over the bordering dark forest is a lone ironwood tree, its magnificent crown filled with copper red leaves.  Tangled honeyberry bushes surround the clearing, creating a natural fence around the towering form.  A ring of cobblestones is partially visible under the dirt of the road.

title: [Shadowed Forest, Trail]
description: Dense stands of hawthorn trees straddle the ditches along the side of the road, threatening to scratch with their sharp thorns.  Very little light filters through the leafy branches above, which creates dark shadows about the area.  The buzzing of various insects fills the air as they flit around, enjoying the warm, humid air.

title: [Shadowed Forest, Trail]
description: Sending dark shadows over the forest, the entwined tops of a wide variety of imposing trees obstruct the light attempting to filter through.  Thin slivers of light peek between small gaps in the coverage, descending upon a thick coating of dried leaves below.  Rich, earthy scents float from the still, humid air that barely catches the faint sounds of woodland creatures.

title: [Shadowed Forest, Trail]
description: Murky and ancient, the forest seems to go on far into the distant, veiled shadows.  Closely spaced branches wave ever slightly in the slow-moving air, the disharmony of their sounds echoing as they rub together in the dense foliage.  The wild noises of foraging creatures resonate through the area, adding more chaos to the music of the wilds.

title: [Shadowed Forest, Trail]
description: Fallen trees litter the side of the road, their rotting trunks teeming with life as insects and small creatures drift in and out of their wasting forms.  A thin mist hangs in the air, creating a hazy view.  The stale scent of decomposing wood mixes with that of decaying leaves as it floats in the forest air.

title: [Shadowed Forest, Trail]
description: Dipping down a small embankment, the road turns into a stagnant pool of filmy water.  Tiny water bugs flit across the surface, managing to move about the layer of grime gracefully.  Damp leaves cushion the roadway, giving some traction over an underlayer of mud.

title: [Shadowed Forest, Trail]
description: Thin rays of cascading light filled with swirling motes filter down to the ground, dancing between bits of dead leaves and a patchwork of ground cover.  Thick creepers dangle from the branches of a few trees, their blossoms contrasting with the dark shadows that frame the roadway.  A rustling in the foliage is evidence of the tiny creatures scurrying about.

title: [Shadowed Forest, Trail]
description: Thin vines droop from a few of the gigantic and archaic trees that comprise the old forest.  Saplings peek out from piles of moss and other greenery that rule the moist ground.  Curved branches create an arcing canopy above, the thick leaves blanketing the crowns.

title: [Oceanside Forest, Clearing]
description: Few trees grow in the small clearing, allowing the warm sunlight to shine down on the plants below.  Clumps of golden curry plants and dark blue cornflowers climb above the greenery on the side of the road.  Bits of cobblestone give way to a pebbled surface, the loose pale stones marbled with grey.

Few trees grow in the small clearing, allowing the warm moonlight to shine down on the plants below.  Clumps of golden curry plants and dark blue cornflowers climb above the greenery on the side of the road.  Bits of cobblestone give way to a pebbled surface, the loose pale stones marbled with grey.

title: [Oceanside Forest, Trail]
description: Sea rosemary shrubs close in on the narrow road, creating a beautiful border for the rugged terrain.  Pale, sandy pebbles cover the partially cleared trail.  The sounds of small creatures moving about the forest fill the air, occasionally drowned out by the variety of birds singing in the trees.

title: [Oceanside Forest, Trail]]
description: Broad trees with crowns overflowing with leaves shelter the ground below.  Large spaces between branches allow the bright sunlight to stream down, covering the lower plant life in its warm glow.  Dense shrubs edge the pale stone road, while stray bits of lush, darkly colored greenery try to invade.

Dense shrubs edge the pale stone road, while stray bits of lush, darkly colored greenery try to invade.

title: [Oceanside Forest, Trail]
description: Filtering through the forest, the air is filled with the faint tang of salt and sea.  Climbing hydrangeas hold onto the occasional tree, their white flowers adding a pale beauty and light scent to the dark, thick greenery.  Dried leaves, branches, and tree bark litter the road, causing difficult travel conditions.

title: [Oceanside Forest, Trail]
description: Shimmering down through breaks in the canopy above, the warm sunlight nourishes the ground below, giving life to a wide variety of wildflowers.  The gentle buzzing of honey bees echoes through the air as they flit about from blossom to blossom.  Weaving through the forest, the stone and shell road disappears around a curve.

Shimmering down through breaks in the canopy above, the pale moonlight illuminates the ground below, covering a wide variety of wildflowers in its gentle glow.  Tiny starflies flicker in and out as they glide through the evening air.  Weaving through the forest, the stone and shell road disappears around a curve.

title: [Oceanside Forest, Trail]
description: Spreading out across the sky, thick branches filled with leaves sway above.  Small saplings stretch up from the rich foliage in imitation of their larger brethren.  The songs of wild birds fill the highest limbs as the colorful avians fly about.

title: [Oceanside Forest, Trail]
description: Meandering through the stands of trees, the pebbled road guides the way.  The magnificent sentinels tower from above with their leaf-covered crowns.  Small creatures skitter about in the dry brush before scampering into hiding.

title: [Oceanside Forest, Trail]
description: Propped upon a small tangle of brush, a fallen oak mars the otherwise verdant forest floor.  The broken trunk has suckers of new growth ringing it, while its discarded branches bend, dry and withered.  Blanketing the rotting wood is a layer of dark green tree moss.

title: [Oceanside Forest, Trail]
description: Dark, thick moss encircles a large boulder jutting out of the ground by the roadside.  The massive object fractures the tangled barrier of shrubs and plants growing along the stony trail.  Stands of gigantic trees give way to the landmark, their towering presence sheltering from high above.

title: [Oceanside Forest, Trail]
description: Winding through the woodland, the road's surface is cushioned with crushed shells and sand.  Sharp and tangy, the scent of sea and salt fills the air, while the sounds of crashing waves carry throughout the area.  Shrubs and bushes are more prominent than the taller trees that grow more abundant towards the interior of the forest.

title: [Oceanside Forest, Clearing]
description: Sounds of the sea fill the clearing with the crashing tones of ocean waves.  As the trail winds around a tall stone circle, the way is covered with small pebbles, shells, and sand.  Caught behind the enclosing ring of granite, a towering lasimor tree spreads its branches upwards, its crimson leaves a beacon in the sky.

title: [Mistwatch, Walkway]
description: Thick planks of oak create a walkway that parallels the ocean.  Floating tigerwood docks are secured to the east along the shoreline.  Wandering off to the west, a narrow trail disappears into the forest.  Laughter flows out of an iron and mahogany building built across the path, away from the water.  A small stone shop is tucked between a pair of spindly trees with warped bark that has been damaged by the sea air.

title: [Airmen's Rest, Gathering]
description: Several leather-covered chairs are placed around a thick, woven reed carpet that is centered in front of a large grey stone fireplace.  Rich, spicy aromas from cooking food drift about the tavern, mixing with the scent of fresh ale.  Dark walls of lacquered wood glisten as the light from several black iron chandeliers illuminate the tavern.  A row of padded stools are lined up in front of a polished driftwood and glaes counter.  A narrow wooden staircase in the back leads up to an open hallway above.

title: [Airmen's Rest, Hallway]
description: Dark wooden paneling lines the walls of the small hallway.  Intricately carved molding lines the ceiling, while the floor is cushioned with a thick, crimson wool carpet that travels from a narrow wooden staircase to a tall oval window.  A small bronze lantern is hung on either side of each door, the pale glow softly illuminating the narrow space.

title: [Mistwatch, Harbor Entry]
description: Carefully cut planks of decorative tigerwood create a bridge from land to a series of five floating piers.  Dark chains of wrought iron line either side of the shifting walkway.  A sturdy bronze lantern hangs under a wyvern-carved wooden sign, its flickering light illuminating the wooden surface.

title: [Mistwatch, Walkway]
description: Nestled in a circular clearing at the end of the walkway are a rough oak building and a dark modwir shop.  Uneven stacks of boards and other shipbuilding supplies are piled up between the two structures.  Colorful patches of wildflowers sprout up between the materials.  Several twisted trees grow about the area, their full canopies providing shade from the hot sun above.

Nestled in a circular clearing at the end of the walkway are a rough oak building and a dark modwir shop.  Uneven stacks of boards and other shipbuilding supplies are piled up between the two structures.  Colorful patches of wildflowers sprout up between the materials.  Several twisted trees grow about the area, their full canopies allow bits of moonlight to filter through.

title: [Wyvern Elite Coastal Crafts]
description: Sketches and plans detailing a wide variety of ships hang from the walls of the well lit shop.  The bright candles set in a series of iron lanterns flicker as a cool sea breeze blows through several open windows.  Carved from polished driftwood, a long counter is set against the back wall, its surface covered with ship models.

title: [Shipshape Overhaul]
description: Coils of rope are piled in the corners of the spacious room.  Several bundles of sailcloth are draped over stacks of sealed wood.  Rectangular windows line the upper walls allowing beams of sunlight to fill the store.  A worn driftwood counter rests along the far wall under a brilliant crimson silk banner depicting the wyvern symbol of Ta'Vaalor.

Rectangular windows line the upper walls allowing beams of moonlight to fill the store.  A worn driftwood counter rests along the far wall under a brilliant crimson silk banner depicting the wyvern symbol of Ta'Vaalor.

title: [Airmen's Rest, Private Alcove]
description: Black iron chandeliers hang from thick chains suspended from the ceiling above, the wood covered with a dark stain and coated with a clear lacquer.  A trio of tables are placed about a large replica of an elven airship that is centered in the room.  Hung on the far wall is a pennant sewn from dark crimson silk and edged in golden fringe.

title: [Airmen's Rest, Chart Room]
description: Bronze lanterns hang to either side of a large hand-drawn chart that is placed above a massive carved mahogany bed.  A narrow writing desk topped with a variety of quills and partially drawn maps is tucked in a corner.  Flecks of warm colors are woven into the wool rug that lines the dark plank floor beneath an exposed beam ceiling.  A pair of cushioned wooden chairs is positioned about an ebon marble fireplace, with a basket of sticks placed nearby.

title: [Mistwatch]
description: Tucked away from the more traveled areas, this small part of the dock juts out over the water, perpendicular to a white-veined vaalorn gate leading to a private pier.  The sturdy pilings are stained with layers of white salt.  A few warped wooden benches are secured to the floor planks, several rolls of fishing net piled to the side.

title: [Mistwatch, Staring Wyvern Pier]
description: Worn tigerwood boards fitted carefully together form the walkway of the long pier.  Each spacious docking slip is padded with a series of canvas-covered cork bumpers.  A large cedar sign hangs from one of the thick pine supports that rise from the water and give stability to the structure.

title: [Mistwatch, Resting Wyvern Pier]
description: Tall pine supports rise up from the water, their lengths ringed with salt stains.  Wrought iron chains creak as the ocean breeze pushes a large cedar sign back and forth.  Bits of wood, plants, and other debris float about the structure, swirling under and around each post.  Chunks of canvas-wrapped cork line each slip, adding protection for docking ships.

description: Thick pine supports draped with fishing net outline the pier that stretches out away from the main walkway.  Wide, padded slips are built along the wooden dock, with painted, crimson numbers marking each.  A large cedar sign, hanging from a sturdy post, sways in the ocean breeze.

title: [Mistwatch, Rampant Wyvern Pier]
description: Bits of seaweed and debris float about the study pylons that support the strong tigerwood pier.  A series of ebon chains swing a large cedar sign from their lengths.  Boards lined with cork and canvas rise and fall as the water ripples about them, each sectioning off a spacious slip.

description: Thick seaweed hued in varying shades of greens, browns, and greys swirls about the thick pine posts that support the tigerwood pier.  Long panels of cork line each slip, their canvas and sailcloth coverings stained with muck and saltwater.  Dark iron chains hang from a weathered post, supporting a large cedar sign that swings in the ocean breeze.

title: [Mistwatch, Soaring Wyvern Pier]
description: Thick seaweed hued in varying shades of greens, browns, and greys swirls about the thick pine posts that support the tigerwood pier.  Long panels of cork line each slip, their canvas and sailcloth coverings stained with muck and saltwater.  Dark iron chains hang from a weathered post, supporting a large cedar sign that swings in the ocean breeze.

title: [Lasimor Clearing]
description: Polished rose granite encloses a perfect circle centered on a still pond lined with riverstones.  Vibrant fish flash in its depths, the dark water barely revealing their antics as they dart back and forth under the colorful water lilies that drift across the surface.  A small gravel path edges the basin, and a cluster of violet irises reveal their soft blooms against the pink enclosure.  Tiny iridescent insects flit about the garden, their translucent wings glittering in the moonlight.

title: [Lasimor Circle]
description: Soft floral fragrances waft through the air as pink and lavender water lilies float on the pond, their large leaves holding up a handful of brightly colored amphibians.  Nestled among the greenery is an ivory stone bench carved in floral filigree.  Slight buzzing noises from the bees harvesting pollen from the irises are the only sounds to break the ambient silence.

title: [Lasimor Circle]
description: Fitted against the outer curve of the wall, an ivory stone bench carved in floral filigree provides a resting spot and a perfect view of the fish in the pond.  Flanking the seat, vines of clematis grow upward along the wall, providing a bit of privacy.  The scent of salt and sea hangs in the air.

title: [Lasimor Circle]
description: Water lilies encircle a tall lasimor tree that towers over the beautiful garden.  The murky water of the pond ripples around the roots while small fish dart about.  Lush greenery from ferns to colorful grasses surround the area and push up against the polished granite stones of the circle.

title: [Airmen's Rest, Airship Room]
description: Dark red oak lines the walls with irregular panels, the thick grain of the wood contrasting against a rich wool carpet lining the floor.  Centered against the far wall is a huge walnut sleighbed that is flanked by a pair of modwir tables.  Resting in front of a small riverstone fireplace is a pair of cushioned chairs, a brushed copper bin of sticks tucked to one side.  Hanging from the ceiling by a series of slender bronze chains is a beautiful replica of an airship fitted for battle.

title: [Airmen's Rest, Cellar]
description: Large stands, filled with barrels and casks, line the walls of the clean basement.  Each wooden lid is marked as ale, beer, mead, whiskey, and other types of alcohol.  A smaller rack rests against another wall, its shelves filled with bottles of all shapes, sizes, and colors.  Bins of glassware, and metal and wooden tankards are stacked in the far corner.  A single glaes lantern hangs from a copper hook in the ceiling, its pale light illuminating the cramped, dark area.

title: [Happy Hands Odds-n-Ends]
description: Short and squat, the dimly lit building has an air of antiquity about it that is enhanced by the smell of dust and pipe tobacco.  Floor-to-ceiling shelves filled with all manner of wares block the windows, causing the sunlight to peek from behind the wooden structures.  Despite the cramped walls, the center of the shop is bare except for a short glass-topped counter and a cormorant-inked ironwood door nestled in the farthest corner of the room.

title: [Cormorant's Roost, Office]
description: Wall-to-ceiling shelves of rich mahogany boast gold-framed glass cases, the containers intermingled with various relics and antiques angled across the darkly lacquered wood.  A map-covered driftwood desk dominates the back of the room, flanked on the left side by stacks of ledgers and volumes of aged leather, a horizontal glass bottle nestled atop the pile.  To the right, a tall ironwood-carved kraken engulfs a battle-marred galleon, the sculpture's tentacles wrapped around the rooted desk.
location: Cormorant's Roost, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Cormorant's Roost, Observatory]
description: A circular table carved from gilt-veined marble dominates the mahogany-planked room, its surface covered with a small scale model of Elanthia and its waterways.  Iron-framed windows flank an antiqued gold telescope, leaving a pair of tall leather-backed chairs to hold back the heavy curtains fashioned of faded pirate flags.  A collection of weaponry is displayed above an unadorned slate fireplace, the mantle stacked with nautical charts and volumes.
location: Cormorant's Roost, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Cormorant's Roost, War Room]
description: The lantern-lit walls are covered in parchment maps and sheafs of bamboo paper, the sheets pierced through the planks by sharp-bladed daggers, the weapons littering the perimeter of the dart board on the opposing wall.  Rope-bound salvage crates line the circumference of the room, the quantity almost burying a hay-lined chest of dried goods amongst the treasure.  A trio of repurposed oak barrels provide seating, the cylinders surrounding an iron-weighted ship's wheel.
location: Cormorant's Roost, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Cormorant's Roost, Armory]
description: Thick walls of square-riveted iron cover the large room from floor to ceiling, the wrought metal gate framed by chainmail scabbards and narrow racks affixed vertically next to cormorant-shaped lanterns.  Iron-ringed drawers encircle the perimeter, the half-opened containers filled with vials and pouches of unknown substances.  Sigils of red-stained paint cover the visible surface of the stone staircase, the layers of repainting creating splatters of dried flakes across the metal floor.
location: Cormorant's Roost, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Cormorant's Roost, Chamber]
description: The mosaic-tiled floor of the room creates a map of the western waterways, the various seaports highlighted in metallic ink and scrimshaw ivory, whilst nautical routes are traced in blue-green imflass.  Vellum-sailed boats are scattered across the ground, a few strategically lined to flank a merchant ship far from port, the fleet surrounding the tall mahogany bed that dominates the far wall.  A gilt-framed velvet armchair sits by a ceiling-high window, the seat draped in layers of plush fur.
location: Cormorant's Roost, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Treeva's Stall]
description: Supply-filled niches are carved into the stone of the open landscape, leaving additional well-stocked racks and crates resting in the tall grass nearby.  A wood-planked trough has been wrought into the shape of a large ship, set upon kraken-forged iron legs extending towards the iron gate leading back to the din of the town.  Ragged parchment maps cover the fence posts studding an iron-bound entry leading back inside, covered with various scribbles and partially obscuring several leaflets from distant lands.

title: [The Retreat, Entryway]
description: Deep cherrywood paneling lines the walls of this space, and a thick bearskin rug covers almost the entirety of the floor.  The combination serves to give the room a dark, comfortable ambience when joined to the sweet lingering scent of pipe tobacco ingrained into every surface.  Light pours from a large wrought iron chandelier overhead, sending interesting shadows flickering into the darker corners.  A large sturdy chest sits next to the front door with an oversized hook in the wall above it.
location: The Retreat, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [The Retreat, Lounge]
description: The ceiling in this room is pitched at a high angle, with the exposed rafters forming the barest framework of a conventional space.  Nestled amongst the shadowy eaves are a series of chandeliers, each one providing enough ambient light by which to see, but not enough to completely dispel the dimness.  The hardwood floors have been polished to a glossy finish, and a massive overstuffed leather chair sits in front of a stacked stone fireplace.
location: The Retreat, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [The Retreat, Bedchamber]
description: A huge four-poster bed dominates the center of this room, its sturdy rectangular posts reaching nearly to the ceiling.  A large circular wooden bath takes up the far corner of the room, and a squat mahogany armoire sits next to the doorway.  A huge ornamental vine stretches across the wall behind the bed, its hammered iron thorns polished until they shine.
location: The Retreat, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [The Retreat, Porch]
description: The salty air from the harbor has bleached the wooden supports for the roof white, and rendered the floorboards of the porch itself gritty and pockmarked.  A small semicircle of curved sofas surrounds a wrought iron brazier and faces generally outwards towards the harbor itself.  A rhimar chest has been strategically placed between two of the sofas, allowing for easy access to its contents.  Dangling from the roof overhead are a series of well-worn cargo nets, interspersed with small glowing globes.
location: The Retreat, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [The Retreat, Workroom]
description: A single stone slab forms the floor of this room, though it bears many telltale signs of heavy wear.  An oversized worktable stands against the far wall, scattered with debris of various sorts, and etched into the floor is a nearly perfect circle with faded runes painted around its edges.  Some wide shelves sit off to one side, the wood visibly pitted and charred but held together by large iron braces.
location: The Retreat, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Academy Nexus, Column Chamber]
description: Apparently a central hub, several passages lead away from this circular room.  A pale screen of light spans each of the chamber's exits bar one.  Devoid of any other adornment, the smooth alabaster stone walls seem to shimmer and move as the light from a column of energy twists and turns on itself.

A pale screen of light spans each of the chamber's exits bar one.  Devoid of any other adornment, the smooth alabaster stone walls seem to shimmer and move as the light from a column of energy twists and turns on itself.

title: [Academy Nexus, Antechamber]
description: Grand tapestries cover the walls of the chamber.  Their bright colors of the fabric create a sharp contrast to the pale stone.  A pair of cushioned benches flank some double mistwood doors whose silver hue is accented by wrought iron fixtures.

title: [Academy Nexus, Hallway]
description: Beautiful alabaster stone is fitted together almost perfectly with barely a seam showing.  Passageways break off leading in other directions.  A glowing portal hovers above the floor, a bright sandy area can be seen on the other side.  Several iron sconces are set into the walls and fitted with golden-hued candles.  A wide variety of weapons hang on either side of the corridor with several shields interspersed between them.

title: [Academy Nexus, Training Hall]
description: Weapons are displayed on racks and stands that line the wall of the training hall.  One corner has several dummies that stand at attention.  Another area is set up with various targets with arrows protruding out of their surfaces at odd angles.  Away from the center of the chamber are partitioned spaces that house several sparring rings.

title: [Academy Nexus, Viewing Box]
description: Rows of cushioned seats fill viewing boxes that are arranged all around a large arena.  Beautifully embroidered canopies are pulled back allowing the moonlight to bath the area in a pale glow.  A shimmering wall of magical energy protects each booth while still giving a clear view of the trial space.

title: [Academy Nexus, Council Room]
description: Large and capacious, the council room has a triangular shape.  Seven wedge-like areas are partitioned from each other by carved banisters and are filled with a variety of chairs and tables.  Each section tapers in size to a platform that holds a large marble podium.  Tapestries hang along the back wall of the chamber, positioned above one of the smaller spaces.

title: [Mahkra Academy, Entrance]
description: Skylights fitted with crystal panes allow the pale moonlight to fill the entryway of the academy.  A multi-hued carpet covers the floor, its dark patterned material creates a sharp contrast to the silvery white stone floor.  While this chamber is obviously a foyer, no exit door can be found, only a small hallway leads out into the rest of the building.

title: [Mahkra Academy, Antechamber]
description: Several pots of flowering cactus are scattered about the small chamber.  An iron sconce is fixed to the wall next to a thick mistwood door.  Windowless, the area is blanketed in shadow despite being crafted from silvery, alabaster stone.

title: [Mahkra Academy, Office]
description: Scrolls, tomes, and piles of parchment cover the large bookcases that line the walls of this spacious office.  A beautiful oriel window dominates the wall behind a large wooden desk.  Covered with a dark blue velvet, a pair of padded chairs flank a thick mistwood door.

title: [Mahkra Academy, Lower Landing]
description: Round and cylindrical in shape, the chamber is unadorned except for a glowing malachite-hued column rising high in the center.  The white walls and floor glitter as the pale green light reflects off silver flecks of the stone.  Shadows flicker about as a shimmering ray of energy shifts and moves upon itself.

title: [Mahkra Academy, Upper Landing]
description: Rising up to the ceiling, a glowing malachite-hued column shifts and turns, casting shadows about the room.  Light from a shaft of energy glitters as it is reflected off the silver-flecked stone.  The rounded and cylindrical chamber is otherwise lacking any embellishment.

title: [Mahkra Academy, Convocation]
description: Tiers formed in a semicircle funnel down to a single stone podium.  Each level is lined with pale grey carpeting that blankets most of a dark verdant marble floor.  Obsidian benches cushioned with ebon velvet stand in rows upon each echelon, their sides carved with a single triskele.

title: [Mahkra Academy, Atheneum]
description: Moonlight streams through a brilliant rose window casting radiant colors upon the obsidian stone floor of the chamber.  The expansive library rises three stories high, each tier lined with dark shelves filled with every size, shape, and color of book, scroll and folio.  A single, spiraling iron staircase connects each level.

title: [Academy Nexus, Palestra Arena]
description: Built in an outside area of the academy, the arena is surrounded by a wall of clear energy that rises into the air, joining at a central focal point and creating a shimmering dome.  Several passageways can be seen behind the magical barrier.  The ground of the area is covered in multi-hued cobblestones.  There are no adornments or obstacles that can be seen except random areas that are blackened or discolored.

title: [The Lighthouse, Stairwell]
description: Upon entering the stairwell you spy the massive spiral iron stairs that climb the lighthouse tower.  The terse sounds of footsteps and thunderous conversation echoes down the stairwell and out through an arched opening.

title: [The Lighthouse, Stairwell]
description: A platform fashioned from iron and timbers marks the halfway point of the stairwell.  Muffled sounds of conversation seem to come from behind a modwir door and echo around the stairwell chamber.  A small window opposite a brass-framed alcove provides a vantage point that overlooks the bay.

A platform fashioned from iron and timbers marks the halfway point of the stairwell.  Muffled sounds of conversation seem to come from behind a modwir door and echo around the stairwell chamber.  A small window provides a vantage point that overlooks the bay.

title: [The Lighthouse, Meeting Room]
description: Lining the walls of this meeting room are charts of the local sea and maps of the surrounding land areas.  A large weather-tight door slides open to allow fresh air to clear out all of the hot air coming from the long-winded debates of captains, merchants, and townsfolk.  Several chairs are located around a large invar and silver-etched table, and the Mist Harbor emblem is prominently displayed on the south wall.

title: [The Lighthouse, Tower]
description: Looking down the stairwell from this height can be dizzying.  The low drone of the gear-and-pulley lens from above sends a wave of vibrations down through the tower.  The stairs end at a hatch leading into the lighthouse's glass dome.

title: [The Lighthouse, Lens Room]
description: This cramped space only has room for a huge lens fashioned from clear glaes and brass.  The luminous filament that used to burn oil has been changed to a mage-enhanced blue crystal.  The crystal that was more than fifty times brighter than years past ensured the safety of the merchant ships that travel these waters but now is burned out and useless.  A rusted iron chain hangs from the ceiling of the light tower and below it is a dull red sign.

title: [A Twist of Roses, Artistry]
description: Dark amethyst marble floors are veined with black and silver that twist and turn to resemble roses entwining with harps.  In one corner, a silver bench sits next to a marble fountain, and along the other wall, twin shelves of ebon marble reside above a lavender-veined black marble counter.  An elaborate Loenthran tapestry covers the wall behind the fountain.

title: [A Twist of Roses, Salon]
description: Sunlight streams through a large triangular skylight directly over the center of the salon, bringing out the golden flecks in the stark white marble flooring.  Two mannequins in flamboyant poses stand on either side of an emerald-encrusted white gold rack.  Elaborately carved with gold-veined roses, an intentionally asymmetrical black marble counter with a small engraved silver sign sits against one wall.  A glimpse of a rose garden is visible beyond a glass door.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Inner Ring]
description: Glistening in the perpetual twilight, large cobblestone pavers stretch across the cramped streets from the edges of gabled buildings to the bowing bridge.  Lampposts wreathed in verdigris copper hold frosted globes aloft, the dim light spilling from them painting the area in a sheen of violet while doing nothing to dispel the shadows of a twining pathway.  Double doors provide entry to a thatch-roofed building, a wooden sign in wrought iron scrollwork above, that is connected to a smaller structure by a moss-covered lancet stone archway.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Inner Ring]
description: Overlooking the canal that separates an island-bound inn from the rest of the town square, cobblestones kissed by dew stretch across the ground to create an uneven lane illuminated by verdigris copper lampposts.  A cramped and narrow alley winds its way northward, the wrought iron arms of mounted shop signs casting shadows upon the walls and arches that decorate its edges.  Sitting solitary upon one corner, a windowed chalet with a dramatically pitched roof is marked by the crest of an alchemist.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Inner Ring]
description: Teeming with fragrant, herbaceous growth, an overgrown garden tumbles across a cobbled pathway that departs from the crooked street toward a barely visible, squat cottage.  Thin ribbons of smoke slip from the off-center chimney to disappear in the aura-tinted sky.  Its nearest neighbor, a small confections shop, is festooned with colorful lights and pennants that create a festive air.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Fallen Court]
description: Spilling into the courtyard from the inner ring, a well-trodden cobblestone pathway quickly becomes fractured and fragmented as it merges with circular pavers that grow further and further apart the closer they get to a scrollwork wrought iron gate.  Darkened windows gaze blankly upon the courtyard from shops and homes that face the inner ring, a moss-covered lancet stone archway offering passage between the two sections of the town.  A smattering of stone benches, some broken and cracked, rest in scattered clusters amid overgrown grass and copper-banded barrels.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Inner Ring]
description: Multiple lanes converge upon the dappled cobblestones of the avenue, though one such pathway transitions into a bowed cobblestone bridge that disappears in a shroud of mist as it crosses the canal.  Verdigris-topped lanterns with colored glass panes illuminate the arch they are mounted from in an orange sheen, while a departing pathway is left to violet-sheened shadows.  Four peaks, each topped with a gable, dominate the multistory manor that overlooks the street.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Outer Circle]
description: Facing the Fallen Court across a stretch of cobbled street, the constabulary hunches amid the encroaching brush and foliage of the Bittermere Woods to the southeast and the thick iron fencing that disappears to the northwest.  Partially dilapidated homes dot the lane, their vacant windows reflecting the violet sheen of the twilight-kissed sky.  Silvery blue pampas grass grows in thick masses between the northern buildings, its feather heads swaying and rustling despite the lack of breeze.

title: [Templeton Shor'toes' Sugars]
description: Filling the space from the high-raftered ceiling to the polished bird's eye maple floors, the sweet scent of sugared confections is mixed with vanilla, chocolate, and pumpkin.  Warmly glowing lanterns flood the space with light, making it impossible to see the street beyond through the store's front windows.  A short glass display cabinet occupies a space near the door, while a round table and high shelves fill the rest of the display area.

title: [Clove and Dandelion]
description: Bundles of fragrant phlox, winter savory, and tufted goosegrass hang from the exposed rafters of the cottage, the scent of dried flora mingling with the haze from a cobblestone chimney.  Baskets, gardening and hunting tools, and various trinkets hang from the rough pine walls, creating a cluttered yet cozy feel to the space.  Low chairs surround the fireplace and rest upon a faded rug of ebon and tangerine hues.

title: [Clove and Dandelion, Triage]
description: Shutters on the whorled glass windows keep exterior light from invading the small space, their sashes bound by wrought iron hooks fitted into tiny rings.  Covered in surgical implements, a low table rests at the head of a cushioned cotton and rush pallet filled with herbaceous grass.  A bloodstained cushion slid back against one wall is close enough to the pallet to observe anyone there but distant enough to offer a modicum of privacy.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Jester's Court]
description: Crescent-shaped cobblestone pavers form concentric bands around a cracked fountain, the contents of which spill across the ground, creating tiny rivulets that cascade down declining stone steps to the north.  Rising out of the broken fountain bowl is a verdigris copper jester statue that pirouettes within vaalin ribbons, the matching sculpted design echoed by those that wrap around the nearby stained glass gate.  Verdant rose vines create shadows upon a twining pathway at one corner of the courtyard, while a dull green moss-covered stone arch slips southeast into darkness.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Inner Ring]
description: Leaning like an aging uncle, a monstrous mansion rises above the cramped streets with slanted windows and crooked pillars that support a sprawling, if ill-repaired porch.  Burgundy, chocolate, and black cherry roses weave through long trellises that decorate the facade, their creeping vines spreading to eclipse a dull green moss-covered stone arch.  Looping over the canal, and opposite a pathway leading southwest, a cobbled bridge provides egress to the town's infamous inn.

title: [Evermore Hollow, The Hotel]
description: Surrounded by verdant foliage, cobbled pavers, and wrought iron railings, the small island sits within the inky waters of a becalmed canal.  Ferrymen in gondolas offer passage off the island to parts unknown, while looping bridges lined in lanterns provide terrestrial access to the inner ring of Evermore Hollow.  Rising high into the twilight sky, a grand ebon-hued hotel is the focus of all nearby.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Evermore Hotel, Foyer]
description: A brass bell gleams atop a polished ebony desk across from a set of paned-glass doors, the streaming sunlight illuminating the dust motes dancing above merlot-hued carpets running the length of the dark-stained wooden floors.  Behind the desk, numerous keys hang in a wooden rack labeled with numbered brass plates above slots filled with addressed envelopes.  An arrangement of velvet-tufted sofas in assorted jewel tones fill the space in front of a walk-in fireplace of grey riverstone.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Nature's Glade]
description: Framed by the shelter of viridian hedges, a well-trodden cobblestone pathway is interrupted by the sprawling presence of a cushioned blue-green lawn that spreads outward in a perfect circle.  Silver-white sheets hide the backs of the shops and houses that abut the space to create a buffer between the noise of the inner ring, though the expanse is interrupted briefly by an arching arbor.  Fragrant lilac trees dapple the space, their ornamental canopies carefully sculpted and laden with lacelike flowers.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Inner Ring]
description: Crowded by the densely packed shadows of nearby arboreal giants, a maroon and iron-gabled manse dominates the corner of the avenue and is positioned so that its shutter-flanked windows can keep an eye on the various lanes that intersect at this corner of town.  Slipping beyond the manicured lawns to the east and the cramped structures to the west, a narrow pathway disappears southward, while an arching arbor hosts a plethora of painted plant life as it offers entry to a small alley.

title: [Gavelsdown Hall, Parlor]
description: Twilight hues spill through the open windows, giving the dimly light room a bruised appearance that is vivid contrast to the plush carpeting and gold fixtures.  High-backed leather armchairs are arranged in social circles throughout the space, while an elaborately carved cabinet occupies a space along the back wall.  The thick scent of cherry tobacco fills the air.

title: [Gavelsdown Hall, Sitting Room]
description: Hunter green and ebon bourde fabric decorates the walls of the sitting room, the colorful fabric threaded with thin gold wire that reflects the lights of the nearby scones.  Several settees of polished dark walnut are arranged through the space and covered with lush velveteen in complimentary hues.  A dark carpet stretches across the floor, its surface dappled in sodden footprints that trail to and from a pair of glass-paned doors.

title: [Gavelsdown Hall, Hallway]
description: Carved of alabaster and onyx, a pair of elegant statues flanks a flight of broad mahogany stairs, their arms raised above their head as they hold frosted orbs aloft.  Ochre fleur-de-lis patterns decorate the burgundy rug that covered the floorboards, while matching velvet swatches cover the walls.  Standing opposite the stairs are a set of polished double doors.

title: [Gavelsdown Hall, Parlor East]
description: Twilight hues spill through the open windows, giving the dimly light room a bruised appearance that is vivid contrast to the plush carpeting and gold fixtures.  High-backed leather armchairs are arranged in social circles throughout the space, while an elaborately carved cabinet occupies a space along the back wall.  The thick scent of cherry tobacco fills the air.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Outer Circle]
description: Built into the high stone wall that steadily declines to the north and south, an ebony basalt-framed portal whorled with crimson mists creates hazy shadows and flickering lights upon the dew-kissed cobblestones of the road.  A steady thrumming sound issues from the portal, causing a rhythmic tremor in the ground.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Outer Circle]
description: Stacked stones and wrought iron fencing rises in a slow incline from the south to the north along this curve of the cobblestone road.  Enormous scrollwork gates offer passage down a well-trod dirt path that leads into the mist-laced graveyard, while cobbled steps lead to decorative brownstones with shutter-flanked windows.  Decorative urns filled with lilies hold the enormous gates open.

title: [Graveyard Temporalis, Entrance]
description: An iron-bracketed torch is stationed aloft on the corner pillar of the graveyard's stone wall, which marks entry into the hallowed grounds to the north.  Fog has gathered here in a thick eddy, rising and swirling, a mass with coiling fingers that reach out and just as quickly retreat again, too insubstantial to grasp anything but the chilly air.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Inner Ring]
description: A squat slate-shingled building with a silver coin-emblazoned sign over the entrance sits at precise angles to the cobblestone road, its face decidedly lacking windows which causes it to give off an air of sterility.  Even the manicured lawn is unremarkable and dull.  Unassuming spires hoist lackluster bulbs aloft as they line a simple path that connects the street to the structure.  Opposite, descending steps lead to a view of the canal while cooing blackbirds hover nearby.

title: [Otherworldy Wealth, Entry]
description: Customers, both corporeal and ethereal, pass through the high-arched witchwood doors framing the grey stone building, the sounds of coin-handling muffled by the embroidered tapestries suspended from floor to ceiling.  The vine-engulfed counters are separated by tall dividers formed from lacquered scraps of parchment, their surfaces scrawled in a variety of languages.  An avian skeleton gazes from atop a stack of books, mimicking the motions of preening itself as it attempts to stretch its bone-set wings.

title: [Innocent's End, The Carefree]
description: Bright candy-colored buildings dot the landscape of verdant green grass and flowers, each shop surrounded by topiaries of whimsical creatures clad in outlandish clothing and accessories, the animals posed in various forms of cartwheels.  The cobblestone road leading from the stained glass gate is covered in doodles scrawled in thick chalk, the rainbow of childish calligraphy stretching outwards towards other areas of the neighborhood.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Outer Circle]
description: Hunkering in the shadows at the edge of the city, a gated neighborhood sprawls within the confines of a wrought iron fence topped with warding sigils.  Painted symbols dapple the cobblestones closest to its entry, while brightly burning lanterns struggle to stave off the shadows that seem to push outward from the neighborhood.  A lone shop braves the miasmic air of the area, its windows filled with brightly burning lights.

title: [In The Bag, Entry]
description: Littered with thousands of unwanted wrappers, the floor of this shop is concealed beneath a swirling, colorful sea of trash that shifts with each introduction of a new customer.  Bright and bold candies are painted across the walls and ceiling, and cotton candy-like streamers dangle from each candle-filled sconce that fills the room with dancing shadows.  An oversized sofa strewn with lozenge-shaped cushions is a vessel of respite in the otherwise choppy shop.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Outer Circle]
description: Parted slightly, the enormous wrought iron gates that provide entry to the graveyard via a well-trod dirt path cast long shadows on the cobblestone street.  A short wall built partly of wrought iron and partly of stone rises to the north while curving to the northwest on the opposite side.

title: [Graveyard Temporalis, Entrance]
description: An iron-bracketed torch is stationed aloft on the corner pillar of the graveyard's stone wall, which marks entry into the hallowed grounds to the north.  Fog has gathered here in a thick eddy, rising and swirling, a mass with coiling fingers that reach out and just as quickly retreat again, too insubstantial to grasp anything but the chilly air.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Outer Circle]
description: Perched on the edge of Nature's Glade, the cobblestone road is awash with verdant hues.  High viridian hedges block the view of Winterbriar Orchard to the north, while dense growth hides the view of the Gleyminn Anni River to the south where a flora-edged spindled pathway descends.  Though both places are not visible, their presence is evident by the sound of rushing waters and the scent of fragrant lilac.

title: [Evermore Hollow, River Entry]
description: Willow and alder trees rise in varying heights along the tumbling river's edge, their looping and spindled boughs laden with skeletal leaves of silver, ebon, and white.  Clattering and clacking in tune with the water's ambling chorus, tall reeds rise out of the muddy bank, resembling stick figures that are quietly watching the landing.  Clustered together, their lanterns creating pools of white illumination, a bunch of dark oak gondolas lie in wait for passengers to fill their interiors.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: The river bends sharply here between steep, tree-lined banks, the roots of the willow and alder sentinels bursting out of the damp earth and reaching towards the dark waters.  Visibility is low as a somber mist shrouds the bend making it almost impossible to see what lies ahead, though the sound of lapping water denotes that the shore is nearby.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Outer Circle]
description: Small jars filled with flickering light are strung across the road, anchored to trees along the southern curve and to the tightly crowded stone and thatch houses along the northern.  A small wooden dais appears to be a part-time gathering place and is ringed by scrollwork wooden benches.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Fate's Fire]
description: Buildings grow sparse as a well-trodden cobblestone pathway wends through the area on its way around a hillock covered in knee-high grasses whose entrance is blocked by a spear-topped black iron gate.  Saturated in crimson, orange, and yellow hues, the small courtyard is filled with a perpetually burning bonfire surrounded by dried-out ancient logs amid singed baskets of firewood.  Near the northeast, the faint outline of a dull green moss-covered stone arch supported by slanted buildings can be seen.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Inner Ring]
description: Surrounded by bright lanterns, a sprawling manor gazes upon the open canal and bridges with dark windows and shadowed gables.  Blue-green grasses decorate the lawn, growing duskier the further they are from the violet-sheened light, while bushes dabbled with blossoms form a corridor leading to the manor's entry.  A well-trodden cobblestone pathway cuts through the streets to the east of the structure, while a dull green moss-covered stone arch connects the manor to its nearest neighbor.

title: [Fate's Holding, Entry]
description: Blotting out the twilight-hued sky with its overlapping canopy, a dense forest of deciduous and coniferous trees surrounds a twining pathway that departs from a spear-topped black iron gate and disappears into the darkness.  Flickering lights dance through the dense undergrowth, their colors ranging in hue from amber to chartreuse and violet to corral.  A wooden sign sits at an angle to the ground, its face turned to ribbons of light that bleed through the bars of the gate.

title: [Quinton Manse, Vestibule]
description: Suspended from a golden chain, an enormous crystal and votive-filled chandelier hangs over a central hug and table, providing ample illumination for the circular vestibule.  Golden linden planks mix with ebonwood to create a striped paneling along the lower half of the surrounding walls, while the tops are covered in painted silk to create a colorful mural.  A flight of mahogany stairs leads to the level above, while a heavy golden linden door is open in the eastern wall and a narrow hallway provides access to a sprawling kitchen.

title: [Quinton Manse, Kitchen]
description: Floor-to-ceiling windows decorate the western and eastern sides of the kitchen, which stretches from one end of the manse to the other to create a large eating and culinary space.  Counters and cabinets decorate the southern walls, leaving only enough room for the exit to the vestibule, while the open golden linden door offers access to the garden.
