A large and round table rests at the heart of the room, surrounded by spindle-backed chairs.

Floor-to-ceiling windows decorate the western and eastern sides of the kitchen, which stretches from one end of the manse to the other to create a large eating and culinary space.  Counters and cabinets decorate the southern walls, leaving only enough room for the exit to the vestibule, while the closed golden linden door offers access to the garden.  A large and round table rests at the heart of the room and surrounded by spindle-backed chairs.

title: [Quinton Manse, Parlor]
description: Lush verdant green carpeting creates a muffling effect to the parlor, causing the sounds in the rest of the house to fade away.  Frosted hurricane lanterns are evenly spaced upon the cloth-covered walls and are held aloft by miniature shepherd's hooks anchored to the burgundy chainsil walls.  Armchairs are scattered about the room amid low tables and decorative cases.

title: [Quinton Manse, Study]
description: Occupying the entire upper level of the manse, the study is both expansively lit by candles and surrounded in scarf-wrapped polished glass windows that offer ample natural lighting.  Ebonwood bookcases line every bit of the walls that aren't occupied by a window, while dark walnut tables are arranged in the center and surrounded by oiled leather armchairs.  Smaller, more private nooks can be seen to the east and west of a flight of mahogany stairs that lead to the lower level.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Inner Ring]
description: Occupying the center of the boulevard, a two-story ebonwood building with a silver gypsum-inlaid door faces the canal where a lantern-lined cobblestone bridge spans the water, providing egress to and from a towering inn.  Narrow streets glittering with the perpetual dew and limned in violet hues from the everlasting twilight twist deeper into the sprawling town.  Trees dot the street within small expanses of grass, their limbs dappled with blue-green leaves and laden with fruit.

title: [The Greedy Ghost, Entry]
description: A duo of cats prowl along the lacquered mahogany counter running the length of the shop, nonchalantly tipping small piles of jewelry and gemstones to the wood-planked floor behind them.  An ethereal jewel-laden spectre mutters to itself as it attempts to reorganize the treasures, gently chastising its feline companions in half-hearted fashion.  The faint clatter of chains and bangles echo through the shop as the spirit moves about, gesturing as a small quill and parchment records its haul.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Outer Circle]
description: Wrought iron fencing surrounds a neighborhood built around a hillock to the north, the rustle of its high grasses and haunting melodies echoing across the cobblestone road.  To the south, wild brambles and tangled vines hide the bulk of Gleyminn Anni River as it snakes its way around the town and, though the foliage keeps it from sight, the sound of its rushing waters can still be heard.  Firelight from the perpetually burning fire at Fate's Courtyard paints the dew-slick cobbles in orange and red hues.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Outer Circle]
description: Large and small pavers decorate the cobblestone street along the western section of the road, while the eastern section is comprised of a curving boardwalk that allows for passage through a tangled bog towards homes and stores built on stilts.  Slipping towards the Gleyminn Anni river, an uneven luminescent azure stone path disappears into the dense foliage that hides the water from sight.

title: [Evermore Hollow, River Entry]
description: Towering trees form a canopy of dark shadows over the small landing, their gentle rustling creating avenues of illumination where the twilight-kissed sky can filter through.  Pulled back from the reach of the frolicking waters, a bunch of lantern-lit gondolas rest in cleaved lines that part the grass.  Tiny lanterns filled with will-o'-wisps flicker wildly, their dancing lights illuminating an uneven luminescent azure stone path.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Noble Guardian]
description: Transitioning from a well-trodden cobblestone pathway to a boardwalk that culminates in an elaborate iron gate, the small courtyard is part stone and part roughly hewn wood.  At its center is an ancient leafless tree strung with thousands of frosted glass bottles that sway and clink against one another, offering a counterpoint to its protesting groans as a gentle breeze moves through its limbs.  Encircling the arboreal colossus are worn circular benches connected by copper bands.

title: [Moorlyn, River's End]
description: Disconnected from the commotion of town by an elaborate iron gate, a thick veil of fog rises from the warm, marshy ground and lingers heavily in the air.  Marigolds, their vibrant yellow still visible through the heavy mist, are nestled in crowded patches of cordgrass and decorate a dry riverbed as it winds aimlessly through the marshland.

title: [Antiquarian Manor, Entry]
description: Stretching both to the east and west, the wide entry has a museum-like feel to it.  Cold marble glimmers in the light of dozens of candles housed in polished scones along the walls, while grey marble pillars veined with ebon and gold hold the distant ceiling aloft.  Several display cases line the walls, each offering a view of a different treasure.  Opposite the entry, and across the broad expanse of glisten tiles, a set of glass-paned double doors leads to a garden.

title: [Antiquarian Manor, Garden]
description: Concentric bands of onyx and white tiles encircle an enruned shadowglass obelisk that sits in the center of the garden.  Tufted and manicured blue-green grasses form a small lawn around the tiles before giving way to large and small urns filled with flowering bushes and ornamental shrubs.  Smooth marble benches are arranged at various points throughout the small garden, each flanked by pebble-filled glossy ebonwood planters housing a variety of orchids.  A small patio rests before the manor, offering firm footing before a set of glass-paned doors.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Inner Ring]
description: Illuminated stained glass windows splatter the glistening cobblestones of the lane in a variety of hues as light spills forth from an eclectic curios shop that sits perched upon one corner.  Other shops with amber-lit windows gaze upon the cobbled streets, their shutters canted at angles to their whorled panes.  A railing of wrought iron lines the quiet canal, a banded wooden bench perched at its edge with a tumble of knotted vines decorating its backing.

title: [Bones and Baubles, Entry]
description: The well-dressed form of a greenish grey zombie stands before a bejeweled counter, the proprietor attempting to wipe away clumps of dirt and flesh from the glass, despite being the origin of the detritus.  Every corner of the shop is filled with antiques and weaponry, the stacked crates sorted by a small family of raccoons grasping each item curiously between their claws.  The tiniest of the cubs waves about a single finger bone as it attempts to add it to the treasure pile.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Entry]
description: Gilded leaf and vine motifs engulf vivid emerald-colored walls, highlighting the tome-filled cases of lacquered lasimor framing the curved archway from floor to ceiling.  A myriad of framed portraits cover the remaining spaces, briefly illuminated by the blackened iron sconces flickering foxfire green flames before a set of elegant glass doors, the sparks scattering into the air.  An ebony velvet runner leads upward from the jet marble floor toward a set of wide stairs, the railing of metal arabesques flanked by a duo of onyx wrens.

title: [Second Floor, Landing]
description: A wrought iron chandelier hangs from the ceiling above, the half-melted tapers surrounded by a variety of metal cages enclosing stuffed birds glancing down through glass eyes.  Sculptures of chiseled green marble are displayed across from the blackened railing adorned in faenor roses, each decoration veiled in a thin layer of greyish dust.  A square-framed mahogany door stands a short distance from a set of wide stairs, decorated with a burnt velvet runner fringed in silken tassels.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Sitting Room]
description: Heavily draped curtains of stygian velvet frame a trio of glass windows patterned in geometrical designs, the streaming light casting distorted shadows over the half-crescent of riveted jacquard chaises perched on ebonwood legs.  A velvet-curtained corner of the room houses a tri-tiered wire birdcage, the central frames bent open, leaving the doors grasping at the hinges.  A circular rug woven of wren-patterned pashmina partially covers the floor, the scorched planks roughly gouged with reddish sigils.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Parlor]
description: A fan-screened fireplace of blackened iron stands across from a group of chairs padded in ebony velvet, the furniture adorned with a wren motif repeating across the emerald-papered archway of the parlor.  Gilt-armed lanterns hang above a glazed lasimor writing desk, casting wayward shadows across the ink-stained ledgers spread across its surface, the well smashed into shards of glass.  A tall portrait oversees the room, the painting framed between curtain-veiled windows covered in threads of silvery webbing.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Outer Circle]
description: Encapsulated on all sides by clotted and tangled brush, a passage slips into Bittermere Wood along the southeastern curve of the boardwalk that passes for a road in this section of town.  Faded planks stretch from sporadic grasses on one side to boggy muck on the other, while a twisted labyrinth of walkways and ramps shoots off into the congested homes built upon stilts to the northwest.  Spindled torches dot the boardwalk, their orange and green flames caged in twisted wire.

title: [Moorlyn]
description: Like a tangled web, strips of dry land snake around water-filled depressions and connect with other sections only to deliver the traveler to a dead-end.  Tall clumps of cordgrass shroud the pathway as it meanders in opposite directions from the parched riverbed, but an occasional breeze forces the grass to yield and exposes the ground enough that travelers can safely navigate through the neighborhood.

title: [Moorlyn]
description: Sodden terrain slurps and sloshes with every step, and it releases putrid puffs of air that hang as heavily as a guilt-filled memory.  Partially concealed by a concoction of thick mud and dense clusters of bulrush, a silver locket catches the moonlight and projects fractured rays of shimmering argent light upward.

title: [Moorlyn]
description: Ankle-deep water pervades this portion of the neighborhood, rendering it unsuitable for residences but well-suited for the moisture-tolerant perennials.  Far-off shrieks and growls grow in both proximity and intensity and, like an intruder's warning, evolves to a disorienting cacophony.  Debris resembling fish skeletons joins in the alarm and churns within the shallow, murky water, but subsides when the community outburst concludes.

title: [Moorlyn, Loyal Point]
description: Faint lights dot the landscape on a northwestern ridge, and a thick, forested wall obscures visibility far to the east.  The spent riverbed winds aimlessly around large clusters of maiden grass before a sharp turn to the south leads it out of view through the thick grasses.  Raised on stout pillars, a cypress shelter displays a variety of heraldry secured above numerous booths and kiosks.

title: [Moorlyn]
description: Dark shadows move silently through the area, their pitch-black forms seeping into the darkness until their existence has departed.  Muffled clinks and clanks of metal-on-metal, indicative of a distant battle, linger in the nighttime air and taunt any willing to take notice.  Tiny droplets of red-tinged liquid seep from the leaves of a cluster of crimson-veined caladium.

title: [Moorlyn, Hope Village]
description: Closely nestled homes shadowed by acutely overgrown flora create a dark and staggered backdrop to an abundant amount of glistening spikes of metal that protrude from the moist ground.  Patches of deep crimson sibirica surrender a blood-like tinge to droplets of dew that cling to the metallic protrusions, and in intermittent moments of sunlight, cast a similar hue along the ground.  A white cedar sign secured to a tall rod iron post marks the entrance to a small village.

Closely nestled homes shadowed by acutely overgrown flora create a dark and staggered backdrop to an abundant amount of glistening spikes of metal that jut out from the moist ground.  Patches of deep crimson sibirica surrender a blood-like tinge to droplets of dew that cling to the metallic protrusions, and in intermittent moments of moonlight, cast a similar hue along the ground.  A white cedar sign secured to a tall rod iron post marks the entrance to a small village.

title: [Moorlyn, Honor's Row]
description: Evenly cut cedar planks covered with hundreds of mismatched muddy bootprints form a stable walkway across the red glasswort-blanketed terrain.  Makeshift railings formed of thick double-braided ropes are secured to twisted trees on both ends of the walkway.  Statues carved from pristine white stone stand ceremoniously side-by-side in the center of a once flourishing but now parched pond.

title: [Moorlyn]
description: Winding as aimlessly as the river once did, paths overgrown with tall verdant marshgrass split off from the main artery toward multiple residences, each decorated with iron lanterns that creak noisily in the warm, light breeze.  Large patches of soggy ground begin to cluster together, some forming shallow pools along the wandering trail.

title: [Moorlyn, Faith's Juncture]
description: Placed at the intersection of two paths, one from the west and one from the northwest, a cluster of moss-laden stone benches are arranged around a smoldering fire, whose glowing and fiery embers never die out.  Crimson sparks drift lazily through the air like fireflies on a summer's eve, flitting from one spot to the next with reckless abandon.

title: [Moorlyn, Tree of Justice]
description: Bright orange-red embers drift in from the east behind clouds of smoky mist, illuminating the marshy ground in a deep amber hue.  Wrapped securely around the formidable trunk of a rotting tree is a rusty iron chain, its loose end swinging incessantly and clanking against the decaying timber.

title: [Moorlyn]
description: Floating lazily from the east, dying embers fall to the ground and release an unsettling whisper of hisses that lingers in the air.  A wooden fleet lies in wait behind a row of monstrous golden curls willow trees, their coiled and lengthy appendages swaying relentlessly in search of unsuspecting prey but receding at the first sign of defeat.  Dangling from a low-hanging limb, a rusted placard creaks noisily with each bend.

title: [Moorlyn]
description: Sudden and cacophonous avian chatter pierces the atmosphere, drawing attention to an inhabitant perched attentively on a large corkscrew branch.  As if dispatching a warning, the repeated shrill caws seem to commence and conclude with the entry and exit of visitors.  A broken tombstone, resting peacefully on the ground beside the tree, is cracked horizontally through its epitaph, slaughtering all possibilities of translation.

title: [Moorlyn, Dignity Point]
description: Appearing somewhat populated, a cluster of modest residences is built upon a substantial but unusually shaped mass of land with raised walkways that lead from each home to a central point at the far tip of the pseudo-island.  Orderly rows of torches illuminate each path and bathe the weathered planks in dancing golden shadows from the flickers of the flames.

title: [Moorlyn]
description: Small footprints appear from the west along the muddy ground and continue across a low footbridge that provides safe and reliable access over a soggy landscape.  Isolated patches of fog transverse the variegated terrain like billowy clouds in the sky, with brief stretches of clarity over an otherwise murky scene.

title: [Moorlyn, Bravery's Plight]
description: Extending in all directions from a shallow channel are hundreds of considerably smaller arteries that wend and twist around one another, vying for dominance in a race to the heart of the neighborhood.  To the north, a row of charred stakes rises over smoldering piles of half-burned ropes and blistering wood.  Footprints of varying sizes lead away from the martyrdom stage, though it's difficult to tell if they belong to the rejecter or rejected.

title: [The Haunting Sphere, Entry]
description: Creeping vines of blackened ivy engulf the walls of the small shop, the tendrils wrapped tightly along the exposed wooden crossbeams, spilling foliage across the velvet-draped glass counter in the center of the room.  Vellum-cut lanterns of glazed parchment cast uneven shadows across the rune-etched floor, exposing the circular patterns inscribed in faded ebon chalk.  Various sealed glass jars line the back wall, filled with macabre oddities that float suspended in the luminescent liquid.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Outer Circle]
description: Silvery ghost eryngiums mingle with dusky bluish grey globe thistles as they spill out of Bittermere Woods, framing a tangled amber grass-lined trail.  Enormous wrought iron lanterns molded into toadstools house luminous blue spheres on their underside to create decorative pools of light on the cobblestones that have been disturbed by the encroaching flora.  Slanted at angles, stone buildings share load-bearing walls amid curving arches and dark alleyways that lead towards the inner ring of the town.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: A path trodden through the amber grasses leading into the wood widens into a full-fledged trail further along, with the verdure shoved off and tangled at the edges.  Set back amidst the undergrowth and below the towering trees studded with luminescent viridian flat-capped mushrooms and yellow scale lichen is a thatch-roofed rough wooden shack flanked by a flora-choked picket fence.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Outer Circle]
description: Cramped and crowded, cottages and shops squat upon both sides of the thoroughfare beneath thatched roofs of pampas, straw, and haulm.  Stray bits of dried roofing collect against the drainage slots and grates, while ropy vines invade from Bittermere Woods and snake under the cobblestones, lifting them from their footings to generate an uneven terrain.  Enormous trees loom over the northeastern buildings, their thick canopies flickering with lights that do little to dispel the heavy shadows they throw.

title: [Constabulary, Entry]
description: Large cobbled stones plastered with stucco form the walls of this windowless room, while thick iron bars create a barrier between the common area and that of the detention area.  Rough wooden benches form a loose waiting area in front of a baluster-surrounded counter where moldy and dust-covered papers are stacked in orderly piles.  Stretching along the eastern wall, a set of stairs rises to towards the second floor but sharply turns towards the north as it disappears around a corner.

title: [Constabulary, Upstairs]
description: Folded back to emit the twilight-hued light of the sky beyond, grey shutters are swung away from wide windows and anchored to walls on all four sides of the well-kept room.  Resting upon a tangerine and slate grey braided rug at the center of the room is a broad oak desk.  A cushioned high-back chair rests behind it, while a smoky lantern sits in one corner.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Outer Circle]
description: Inclining slightly to the northwest as it narrows towards a bridge, the cobbled street is lined with uneven pavers to create a cramped thoroughfare.  Stores clustered together along the southern side of the road rise and fall at varying heights, their windowed faces turned to the wrought iron fence that overlooks the Gleyminn Anni River.  Perched in a row in descending dimensions, winged wrought iron serpents stretch their mouths wide to hold glowing orbs aloft.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Outer Circle]
description: Flanked by railings, the cobbled road arcs across a vast orchard that sprawls along the northern edge of town, while on the south of the bridge a more manicured and refined orchard fills the village's interior, surrounded by high walls.  Benches butt against the edge, providing resting space to enjoy the scenery of the area beneath.  A lantern-flanked arbor to the north has winding stairs beyond its verdant arc, offering entry to the grounds below.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard, Entrance]
description: Trees border the path beyond the lantern-flanked arbor thickly and with brilliant crowns of leaves in jewel tones of ruby, amber, and orange spessartine garnet.  A split rail fence borders the path northward, hemming in the lush groves and serving as backdrop for the swags of autumnal ribbons that adorn their lengths.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Outer Circle]
description: Holding court amid carefully arranged moss-covered stones, an enormous twisted beech grows along the western curve of the road.  Ropy roots disturb the cobblestones, creating a textured pathway that can be treacherous if not carefully trod upon.  As the road transitions to the smoother footing to the north, it inclines slightly to become part of an arching bridge.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Hallway]
description: Faded sketches of charcoal-drawn avians cover the peeling walls, the strips of emerald exposing a bare framework of stone and wood stained in ichor.  A faint haze of ghostly white smoke trickles from beneath a narrow door, intermingling with the scent of roasting meat wafting on the other side of the hall through a doublewide archway.  Curtains of black devore velvet frame either side of a lasimor-framed doorway, the fabric restrained by circular wreaths of dried florals, the withered petals scattered across the floor.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Dining Room]
description: A herd of wrought iron wrens form the chain-suspended chandelier hanging high above the checkered ebonwood and lasimor dining table, the small avians cradling half-melted tapers between their outstretched wings.  Carved wooden chairs padded in devore velvet sit scattered in disarray sit upon a bloodstained pashmina rug, the fabric shredded in thin uneven ribbons.  A wide ebonwood cabinet leans against the back wall, filled with a variety of instruments covered in ash and dust.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Kitchen]
description: The walls are tiled in cracked pieces of porcelain, the sharp pieces painted with tiny wrens, their broken bodies scattered across the wooden floor.  Small clay pots with bell-shaped purple and white flowers hang above sets of bent cutlery set on a cutting block, with a trail of berries smashed between the handles.  A set of shelves diagonally drop above a grime-covered porcelain wash basin beside a small glass-paned door, the shattered glass jars seeping their liquid down to a woolen rug.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Garden]
description: A small glass-paned door faces an elongated row of unkempt hedges, their broken twigs bent at abnormal upward angles toward the weeping willow trees obscuring the sky above.  The uneven sound of water gurgles out of a statue-flanked fountain, the liquid barely reaching the rotted wood planter perched above the irrigation, filled with a variety of sickly white and green flowers.  A variety of hempen ropes hang from the wood-planked awning, their knotted lengths suspending doll-like figures made from rose stems.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Smoking Room]
description: Lifeless glass eyes stare down from beam-bound wires set across the ceiling, the stuffed avians posed in mid-flight, their dusty wings draped in lacy webbing.  Anatomical sketchings of both man and beast are displayed in yellowed bone frames above the ichor-splattered fireplace, the drawings overshadowed by the fractured glass display case set upon the mantel.  Worn leather chairs are gathered around several rune-carved tables, their surfaces littered with scorch marks.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Study]
description: A black-lacquered desk dominates the center of the room, its legs carved in skeletal forms of avians both large and small.  An armor-clad warrior portrait looms behind the leather-backed chair, a trail of brittle cobwebs connecting the two in a drape of dust and bits of feathers.  Flanking the stained bureau are wooden racks filled with bottles of viscous fluid, their slender vellum labels faded from exposure to the curtainless windows, leaving the contents to congeal in oddly shaped forms.

title: [Second Floor, Ascent]
description: A gold-framed painting adorns the top of a decorative golden linden entry, the cityscape painted in muted tones and obscured by thin cobwebs draped along the ceiling and railings of blackened iron like macabre lacework.  To the right of the entry stands a suit of wren-engraved armor forged from pale steel, its arm held aloft, longsword angled at a set of wide stairs covered in dark velvet.  Heavy gouges litter the geometrical floor, the scuff marks distinguished by curls of steel and scorched wood.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Landing]
description: Tall shelves are adorned in preserved blooms of rich burgundy flora, the ribbon-tied bouquets interspersed with small trinkets and knickknacks covered in a pale coat of dust.  A myriad of leaf-framed animals and aquatic life are depicted across a pair of carved double doors, the fauna covered in lacerations extending from floor to ceiling, stained with splatters of an unknown black substance.  Twin newels of iron twist to form spherical cages on either side of the wide stairs, each pillar entrapping a glass-eyed wren.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Library]
description: A rectangular table of ebonwood has been carved with an elaborate map, the geographical points of interest covered in numerous tomes and aged scrolls veiled in pale dust.  Floor-to-ceiling bookcases enclose the wide room, each filled beyond capacity with volumes streaked in rust-colored flakes, the containers threatening to topple over upon a pair of velvet chaises.  Half-hidden beneath a heavy curtain is a spherical orb of crystal, the ball occasionally flickering in motes of crimson.

title: [Second Floor, West Hallway]
description: A duo of portraits flank the sides of a feather-carved door, the paintings choked by a tangle of ivy vines creeping from tall pewter urns set beneath each rectangular frame.  An ebonwood cabinet stands flush against the emerald-colored wall, filled with a variety of curiosities contained beneath the thick panes of cloudy glass, their surfaces covered in vein-like fractures.  Perched upon the container is a tiny stuffed wren, its lifeless eyes angled down at the torn pashmina rug.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Bedroom]
description: A myriad of yellowed wax candles encircle the steps to the ebonwood-framed bed, the extinguished tapers forming a pathway to the ceiling-high portrait draped in thin emerald chiffon, the fabric riddled with holes from contact with the open flames.  A flora-adorned mirror sits beside a tall dressing cabinet, the center cracked, leaving web-like fractures radiating toward the beveled edges.  A rusted steel dagger pierces through the black-lacquered door, its hilt wrapped in strips of desiccated flesh.

title: [Second Floor, East Hallway]
description: A floor-to-ceiling mirror framed in black-lacquered wings has been affixed to the vert-colored walls opposite of the wrought iron railing, the looking glass half-concealed by a curtain of tatted dark lace.  Graduated clay pots of tangled ivy obscure an ebonwood-framed door, the tapered ends withering beneath a vertical birdcage nestled in the far corner.  Wisps of brittle webs float on ethereal currents across the wainscotted paneling affixed above the geometric design adorning the floor below.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Guest Room]
description: Twisted poles of aged pewter form the silk-curtained frame of the bed, the richly embroidered comforter spilling down upon the wood-planked floor.  Sunlight pours in through the tall stained glass window, highlighting the pillow-filled nook and intricate dollhouse displayed on a scorched wooden side table, the panes staining the area in vibrant crimson.  An etched mirror sits above a porcelain basin on the opposite side of the room, the bowl flanked by twin vases filled with dark-petaled flora.

title: [Evermore Hollow, Outer Circle]
description: Transitioning from cobbled stones to rough-slatted wooden boardwalks, the road becomes a wide bridgelike structure that traverses the boggy ground in this section of the town.   Perched at the junction of stone and wood, a glittering golden stone-strewn footpath darts between thick bushes and staghorn sumacs.  Hovels and huts rise above the muddy road on stilts, their entrances accessible via twisting ramps.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: A tremendous tree spirals upward in the middle of the main path, which forks to either side, and its crooked trunk is as gnarled and curved as the spine of an old man contorted by age.  Thick, heavy vines that seem more wood than verdure climb into its dense canopy and knot themselves amidst the limbs, though the entirety of the tree is so massive that the effort seems entirely futile.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: Low amber ferns with curled and flanged heads are interspersed with the spiked grasses and mushroom towers, their glowing lamella shedding luminescent spores that light the path they edge.  Tiny motes, as delicate and weightless as dandelion seeds proliferate the air, pinpricks of blue-green illumination that dance on the air currents.  The soft chime of bells tickles the air, the source a bright harlequin pavilion whose colorful ribbons sway in the air.

Low amber ferns with curled and flanged heads are interspersed with the spiked grasses and mushroom towers with their glowing lamella shedding luminescent spores that light the path they edge.  Tiny motes, as delicate and weightless as dandelion seeds proliferate the air, pinpricks of blue-green illumination that dance on the air currents.

title: [Bittermere Woods, River's Edge]
description: The wide bases of pumpkin ash trees line the river's edge, limbs laden with seeds, while beneath grow mushrooms of such unusual size that their presence strains the limits of rational existence.   Nevertheless, there they stand, stems too wide for a giantman to wrap his arms around and caps more than spacious enough to shelter several people from any rainstorm.  Several stems stand bereft of their heads, while several stacks of inverted caps rest near the river's edge.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Pool]
description: Formed by an ancient landslide, the river waters flow into a substantial pool before tumbling down over a natural dam in a crooked line of rocks.  High on an illuminated ridge, an extensive orchard filled with apple and nut trees glows like a smoldering ember against the darkened hills.  A small fleet of boats are left unattended near the shore.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: Prickly, spiked amber grasses give way to soft tufts of green shoots, low-growing shrubs, and fanciful ferns along the path as the trees above stretch out their branches and interlace.  The ground is dappled with a sort of half-light, little making its way through the tree limbs of the auroral shifts of color in the sky and more originating with the motes of foxfire-hued illumination dancing between.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: With trunks that broaden as they spread into roots in the marshy ground, the trees are covered in a fine down of blue-hazed teal pincushion moss and ringed with spore-filled tangerine mushrooms.  Here and there amid the living fleece are clustered shelves of bear bread mushrooms, their bands of saffron, russet, and scarlet increasing their visibility against the nearly monochrome landscape.  Along the northeastern edge, a hyrrad rises, its frame blending seamlessly with the surrounding growth.

With trunks that broaden as they spread into roots in the increasingly marshy ground, the trees are covered in a fine down of blue-hazed teal pincushion moss and ringed with spore-filled tangerine mushrooms.  Here and there amid the living fleece are clustered shelves of bear bread mushrooms, their bands of saffron, russet, and scarlet increasing their visibility against the nearly monochrome background.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: Warm, tawny light cast from scattered toadstools washes the undersides of the thinning tree bowers in gold and gilds the tufts of verdant grasses, bestowing on the otherwise murky surroundings something closer to an inviting countenance.  Each step finds the ground underfoot less soggy and more firm, though in the distance, the soft whisper of flowing water can still be heard.

title: [Bittermere Woods, Convergence]
description: Paths converge on this solid, dry patch of ground from each of the four corners, bringing with them green and indigo grasses, amber weeds, and lavender underbrush that climb the shallow hill to meet an ancient stone well bathed in the shifting hues shed by the inconstant sky above.  It has no roof nor bucket for pulling water, but stones at each of the cardinal points in its construction bear sigils of spiraled lines and curling branches accented, rather than hidden, by a veneer of multihued mosses.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: Few trees border the path, but those that do are caked in tangles of rust scorpidium moss, obscuring most of the underlying bark.  Half-rotted tree trunks, their branches long devoured by the environs lie scattered deeper in the wood, becoming little more than shadowy forms lurking in the darkness.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: Mushrooms dot the landscape between the fallen trees that have succumbed to the choking grip of pervasive pearly green vines, their stems lofting them above the carnage below, while their glowing amber caps highlight the massacre.  Patches of yellow scale lichen and tangles of rust scorpidium moss cover the decaying wooden forms, making a buffet of the toppled towers.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: In the trek from north to south, the size and breadth of the trees have grown, with smaller, weaker specimens having been overtaken by vines and fungus, while the remainder have grown seemingly unfettered by the nuisances that have felled others.  Their enormity nearly defies belief, and in their higher reaches, well beneath the shelter of the bowers, what appear to be small porches can be seen stretching out from doors or warmly lit archways.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: With heavily leafed branches encircling their trunks, the massive trees dwelling in this part of the wood are less densely spaced, giving their canopies the room to spread.  The ground below is only dappled with light, mostly shed from the various bioluminescent fungi found at the edges of the narrowing path.  In contrast to the consuming mosses and lichen, a few specimens of gold-cored ruby starflower stand against the bases of the towering trees, as if mere proximity will lend them strength.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: The path terminates at a barrier of dying trees, their once vibrant orange canopies growing grey and brittle, while their bark flakes away in sheaves like scorched and crumbled pieces of parchment.  Inky scorpidium moss obscures the bare wood, tufts of old man's beard lichen drape from the branches, and the majority of the color comes not just from the crimson glow that can be glimpsed beyond the treeline, but the sparse clusters of satiny red pincushion moss found in patches among the other moss.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: At the base of the slope, a thin stream of violet-sparked ultramarine water springs forth, creating a narrow brook that twists along between patches of misty pink dreamphlox and beneath fallen tree limbs that serve as cover for clusters of wisp-drawn dark cyan mistblooms.  The air has a haze to it, tiny spores from various mushrooms drifting along that capture the ambient cotton candy-hued light and hold it for as far as the eye can see.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: Sprouting like daisies from a green meadow, blue-violet crystals in thin pillars dot the open spaces on each side of the pathway, occasionally pulsing brightly and creating haloes of illumination on the carpet of violet-tipped starflowers around them.  The flashes of light occasionally catch upon pairs of eyes hidden away in the tree foliage and dense underbrush that reflect a vivid shade of sapphire before disappearing.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: The flow of water widens as the slope of the land pitches ever downward, growing from a trickling brook to a full and widening stream of glittering ultramarine water.  Sprigs of cerulean starflowers grow near the edge, and beneath the water's surface, shadows of movement draw the eye as they slither downstream.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: The path alongside the ultramarine stream is lit by spectral violet dreamphlox blossoms tucked within sprays of velvet-soft azure grasses and tiny motes of shimmering light that dance beneath the trees.  With bark the hue of huckleberries and foliage of magenta and pale lavender, the trees hide within their canopies creatures that can be heard chittering, chirping, and whistling in unfamiliar tones.  At the edge of the stream, an oversized azure calla lily dips and bows its head toward the water with any breeze.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: Curling sharply northward, the stream disappears beneath a rocky outcropping topped by an elaborate effigy constructed of deep plum-hued woods and inlays of cobalt-laced deep magenta everine.  The formation's topping lintel is crescent-shaped, points upturned, while the cross beams and vertical supports are spiral-carved and engraved with sigils.  One branch of the path follows the disappearing stream northeast, while the other continues southeast.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: Ending in a glade enclosed by will-o'-wisp-lit tree growth, the path opens into field carpeted with cobalt and lavender-hued grasses dotted with rings of spiraled rainbow-striped mushrooms.  In betwixt and in between are clusters of tiny auroral starflowers and glittering fairy's skirt mushrooms, and at the edge of the treeline, stalks of mistbloom and dreamphlox are backlit by a vibrant magenta glow that filters through the undergrowth.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: Terminating in a rock and root-wrought pool, the stream emerges from the ground to bubble up and flow out of the hollowed interior of an ancient tree.  The ultramarine waters tumble in mini cascades over the wild undergrowth to reach the still waters below, which emit a soft radiance.  Sparks of light cavort in the air above the pool and within the loose twining of branches, winking in and out of existence with every other heartbeat.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: Periwinkle will-o'-wisps flare into existence beneath the shelter of the trees, cavorting amidst the leaves or trailing along the path a while, before disappearing into nothingness with a short, lyrical hum, almost like the distant giggling of a child.  Essence-topped trail markers eke out the general course of the path, despite the overgrowth of the undergrowth threatening to take over their defined boundaries.  Spiral-capped pink and violet mushrooms peek shyly from amidst the groundcover.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: Roughly hewn stakes trail along the edge of the path, alternating from side to side at measured distances, and support above them glimmering orbs of pure blue essence that brighten the underside of the surrounding trees' foliage.  Curtains of moss drape from the edges of the bowers, lit with their own periwinkle glow, to create living but motionless cascades akin to waterfalls frozen mid-course.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: A growth of crystals, the tallest of which is about the height of the average elf, are clustered aside the path, azure-hued and lit from within, making the path visible despite the pervasive deep twilight of the wood.  Sprigs of cerulean starflowers drape against fallen tree trunks that are otherwise obscured beneath nodule-ridden turquoise vines, ruffled lavender lichen, and fans of banded mushrooms.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: A thin run of sparkling violet water flows in from the south, puddling here in a shallow pool that shimmers like a jewel touched by moonlight.  All around its borders and within its shallows grow exotic florals of wondrous size and colors:  lilies in shades of magenta and cerulean, lotuses of indigo with sunset orange hearts, and clusters of blush pink rose mallow.  Grasses create a fringe between the blossoms, velvety sprays in hues of blue and purple.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: Dark, indigo-leafed trees tower over the open glade at the heart of the grove, the sky hidden behind the foliage though the view is no less for it.  Shimmering silver strands drape the limbs and branches, forming sparse curtains of luminescence, and tiny orbs of light tip each thin thread.  The glow suffuses the grove, making of the gloomy tree trunks looming guardians of the effulgence cast by the rings of glittering fairy's skirt mushrooms throughout the glade.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard]
description: A massive bower of woven vines and branches arches over the path leading north, its towering height laden with sweeping ribbons draped in scallops along its limbs to the peak, where they are held in place by an elaborate arrangement of autumn foliage and accents of walnuts, pecans, and apples.  Just beneath and strung from lengths of handwoven hemp rope is a rustic sign that reads, "Welcome to Ember Ridge Orchard."

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard]
description: Heavy ribbons of velvet and silk in autumnal hues are artfully woven through the lower tree limbs here, hung in wide, sweeping swags, while metal-framed glass lanterns dangle from the branches above.  The light cast across the area is golden, both because of the brilliant flames glowing within the lanterns and as a result of how the light they shed shines through the surrounding foliage like sunlight through a stained glass window.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard]
description: A rotund little shop nestled at the end of the rows of trees is strung with strands of diamond-shaped paper lanterns, each tiny flame within illuminating the dyed vellum to cast off shades of crimson, russet, and yellow-gold.  A few scattered wooden chairs sit around small tables beneath the lanterns, with a coppery spigotted urn on a stand arranged with clear glass mugs near the shop's door.  There's a paper note affixed to the urn.

title: [Ember Ridge Candy Apple Shoppe]
description: Polished wooden floors meet the convex walls that rise to a ceiling that gently flattens at the top to form a rotund little shop with old-fashioned charm.  Aged parchment posters line the walls, curling at the corners, while clear jars of sweets adorn the shelves between.  In the rear is a lengthy table set with a trio of deep slat wood baskets and a dark ivory parchment sign.  In the middle of the shop are a glass-topped counter and a long canopy-covered cart, standing back to back, immediately identifiable as the source of the sugary sweet scents in the air.

title: [Candy Apple Shoppe, Backroom]
description: This exceptionally small room is stacked high with small, wooden slat-walled baskets, some stained and others pristine, obviously meant to be used for picking apples and other bounties found within the orchard.  A small sign hangs above a narrow opening on the wall between two stacks.

This exceptionally small room is stacked high with small, wooden slat-walled baskets, some stained and others pristine, obviously meant to be used for picking apples and other bounties found within the orchard.  A small sign hangs a narrow opening on the wall between two stacks.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard]
description: Stacked along an out-of-the-way bench are a plethora of wooden fruit baskets, one nestled inside the other, some stained from extensive use while others are pristine, and running parallel to the bench is row after row of trees.  Apple trees, walnut trees, and pecan trees stretch in neat lines to the crest of the ridge, where the golden red light from beyond spills over and down the trunk-bordered lanes.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard]
description: The landscape climbs in a general westwardly direction here, with a split rail fence guarding the cliff-side edge as it rises.  Trees border the path, creating a natural archway of foliage that adorns the bare ground with hues ranging from ruby to gold, making each step a journey through a kaleidoscope of color.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard, Overlook]
description: From this elevation, the whole of Evermore Hollow unfolds below like a map unfurled, offering an unfettered view of the town and all of its surroundings.  The sky behind the dark buildings shifts unceasingly through an array of colors, the twilight background merely a canvas for strokes of paint orchestrated by an unseen hand.  Overhead, a light breeze rustles through the trees, and an intricate wooden bench invites visitors to take a rest and enjoy the view.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard]
description: Over the cliff side of the rise, red-gold light sweeps up into the underside of the trees, setting the leaves with their already vibrant fall colors aflame with illumination.  It makes the path ahead well lit and rather like strolling through a hall of stained glass windows lit by sunlight.  Off to one side of the path is a great heaping pile of fall leaves.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard]
description: Propped more against the split rail fence than supported by its own stake is a rather handsome scarecrow as scarecrows go.  Its sackcloth face appears freshly painted, its flannel shirt stuffed with fresh straw, and its hat rakishly tilted so that one black eye peers out from beneath the floppy leather brim.  Leaves have fallen to rest on its shoulders, with some stuck in the longer stems of its straw stuffing.

title: [Ember Ridge Ochard, Overlook]
description: Sprawled out beyond the overlook is the edge of the town below and the whole of its accompanying graveyard.  Its dim and dark countenance seems a distant and curious reality from this point of view amid the brightly colored trees bedecked in their autumnal finery.  Back in the direction of the main path, the enigmatic but warm, gilded crimson illumination from the far side of the ridge beckons, while everything below remains shrouded in heavy mists and set against a twilight sky.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard]
description: The steep rise of the trail begins to level as the peak nears, and the trees begin to thin to smaller growth shrubs, still full of the same vibrant hues as their larger cousins.  Somewhere along the path, the golden red glow backing the orchard ridge has begun to give way to the twilight of the land beneath it, and the sky becomes a melange of blues and indigos colliding with tendrils of gilded crimson.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard, Gazebo]
description: At the crest of the ridge stands a dome-roofed cedar gazebo festooned with garlands of russet and amber ribbons and a posy of fall leaves at the peak of each shallow scallop.  Some cedar benches line the circumference of the interior, and diamond-shaped paper lanterns are artfully draped from the ceiling, their crimson, auburn, and saffron shades offering warm light and a welcoming atmosphere.  Beyond the railing of the gazebo, the sky is dark and the view expansive, but no less striking for its tenebrous countenance.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard]
description: The ruts of a wagon track lead eastward, and rows of shadeless candles burn with bright amber-red flames to either side, lighting the way forward.  Dancing fitfully with the passing of even the slightest breeze, the candle flames offer something of a darker countenance to this part of the orchard, with the shadows beneath the fruit-laden tree limbs deeper and more animated as the ambient light flickers.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard]
description: The crowns of every tree are arrayed in crowns of autumnal color -- ember reds, fiery oranges, and gilded yellows -- so vibrant that they nearly glow in the tonal light that spills over the crest of the ridge.  Set within the cradle the niche of trees creates is a sizable wooden cabin, with barrel upon barrel of apples lined in an orderly fashion against one side, while the opposite end of the structure is occupied by a tall metal still that occasionally releases puffs of steam from its chimney.

title: [Ember Ridge, Cider House]
description: Rough timber walls form the interior of this simple A-frame cabin.  Aromatic cedar competes with the sweet scents of simmering apples and spices in the enclosed space.  A plank counter holds baskets of apples in dozens of varieties.  Dry leaves crunch underfoot, mingling with a smattering of spilled spices across the otherwise smooth wooden floorboards and congregating around the base of a gnomish clockwork cider press.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard]
description: Towering stacks of crates near the rear door of a porch-fronted wooden cabin are more or less neatly arranged, as are a small collection of empty fruit barrels that sit off to one side.  The scent of apples, both fresh and fermenting, is heavy in the air, lending a not entirely unpleasant scent to the area.  Off to the southeast, the land begins to slope gently downward and is marked by a well-trod footpath.

title: [Ember Ridge, Eastern Slope]
description: A split rail fence guards the cliff-shorn side of the path, and its wooden beams are darkened with age and use, though appear sturdy enough.  Vines twist along its length, emerald green and dotted with trumpet-shaped coral-hued flowers clustered atop fans of heart-shaped leaves.  The perfume in the air is less fruit and more floral here, sweet with the slightest hint of bitterness beneath.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard, Cliff]
description: Rising sharply, the land climbs to a narrow peak, with a few trees rooted close to the sheer cliff that leads straight down into the golden red glow that limns the long crest of the orchard itself.  Directly below, no details are discernable aside from the curious illumination, but a glance up and outward offers an ideal view of the Bittermere Woods and the curl of river that snakes between them and the orchard ridge.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard]
description: The whisper of running water can be heard somewhere further along the path, though the origins of the sound are hidden by a thickening layer of mist that has begun to blanket the ground.  Tendrils of it twist up the posts of the split rail fence and tease at the wan light cast by the metal-framed pendant lanterns mounted at intervals along the barrier.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard]
description: Underfoot, the ground grows softer with every step and leads deeper into the mists that obscure visibility at any point further than an arm's length.  Shed by the pendant lanterns set along the fence posts, their amber light is transformed into warm but hazy clouds that lend some manner of comfort if not any aid to sight at all.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard, Overlook]
description: From this vantage point, the view is unobscured above the bank of fog that has collected in the valley below, providing both an impeccable view of the illuminated tree tops of Bittermere Woods as well as the lazily pulsing flares of color within the mist.  Washed out by the grey-white, shades of pale blue, dusty green, and watery peach flash with a cadence like that of a heartbeat slowing to a stop.

title: [Ember Ridge Orchard]
description: The split rail fence bordering the path extends straight to the river's edge, thus far hidden by the mists, then levels off to transition into the railing of a shallow but wide dock.  A pair of coils of heavy rope rest near the railing, while the far opposite end of the dock is occupied by a bunch of halved cider barrels.  Twin pendant lanterns dangle from mooring posts on opposite sides of the platform, with a small space to directly access the river left in the middle.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: Rooftops appear behind high green reeds scattered along the gently sloping riverfront, the muddy strand trampled with myriad footprints.  Luminous white pebbles litter the shoreline creating a rough path away from the water's edge, through the reeds and disappearing over a grassy bank.  An assortment of abandoned luggage is piled high in a small white boat run aground on the eastern riverbank.

title: [Graveyard Temporalis, Outer Rim]
description: The stone retaining wall is mounted atop with iron fencing, each post topped with an arrow-shaped tip.  Red-veined vines entangle the bars and creep down the wall to crawl along its edge, never straying too far into the grass.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Still standing tall against the ravages of time and mysteries of this place, the stately iron fence that separates the graveyard from the town beyond is fit and hale.  Just off the path, several time-worn headstones stand, somewhat less stately than when originally placed, their names and dates worn down to odd bits of curves and lines etched into their stones.

title: [Graveyard Temporalis, Outer Rim]
description: Trickles of fog seep down from the graveyard, which sits at a higher elevation than the ground nearer the river.  From here, the sounds of flowing water are apparent, accented by the occasional large splash as if some massive creature disturbed the river's otherwise peaceful progression.

title: [Graveyard Temporalis, Outer Rim]
description: The muckiness of the dirt here impedes any further progress toward the river, though the thin line of moving water is well in sight.  Whether a trick of the eye or a reflection of the inconstant sky above, streaks of wan illumination seem to run occasionally just beneath the water's surface in long, lithe tendrils that glide past at some speed, then disappear entirely.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Doing little to disperse the ground covering fog, a single lamp post stands near the path, doing all it can with its soot-stained glass panels to dispel the obscurity and light the path.  The intemperate sky, with its bright, shifting colors at least aids in this endeavor, with its occasional flares of brilliant light making travel more manageable.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: A gravel path is barely visible beneath the foggy ground cover, its course well trodden and straight as it guides the way.  Vines with red-black flowers twine in and out of the iron bars of the fence that guards the barrier of the graveyard, their scent hauntingly sweet in this somber place.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Excepting a pair of trees growing tall against the fence, this plot of the graveyard is largely empty, just a stretch of grass, weeds, and wind-tumbled leaves that have gathered in the corners between iron bars and tree roots.  The accommodations seem fine enough for one creature, a massive orb spider that has made its web in the crook created by limb and tree trunk.  Its anchors span the distance to the fence and ground, silver-white and shimmering, and the web's tremendous size gives a hint to its age.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: A small, worn-down shack sits as far back off the path as it can go, backing right up to the iron fence separating town from graveyard.  It looks more like a storage shed than anything else, with chained and locked double doors in the front, a window on either side, and a single round window in what must be a mighty small attic.  Vines have clamored over and around it, but all simply cling there, dead and grey.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Glowing wisps of virulent mist swirl into the low-lying fog of the area, casting a spectral green glow onto the faces of the large grave monuments scattered here and higher into the tree limbs above that shelter them.  The effect is unnerving at the very least, as the slightest movement of the limbs creates monstrous shapes against the stoic marble, and with the density of ground cover, a person is only ever one step away from tumbling into an unseen grave.  Literally.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Heavy mists gather in this corner of the graveyard, eerily colored from within by a virulent virid glow, leaving only the tops of gravestones and headstones visible above the swirling fog.  There's a scent that comes with the obscuring vapors; it is noxious and caustic, burning the eyes and the nostrils with an unfamiliar concoction.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: In the space between several broken headstones, the ground has been cleared of grass and granite, all marble and vines swept away to make room for a pitched wood fire and a massive cast iron cauldron.  The legs of the cauldron loft the receptacle well above the flames, which are balefire green, and its contents glow with a sickly celadon hue, with gouts of mists creeping over the rim to spill out onto the ground.  Behind it are several vaults arranged in sets.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Gnarled roots have broken ground and upset headstones, gravestones, and monuments, leaving them toppled, set off-kilter, or broken beneath the tree to which the roots belong.  Without foliage, the limbs above offer little impediment in seeing the various poppets, fetishes, and cloth-shrouded dolls dangling from them by short lengths of hemp twine.  Some of the miniature effigies are obviously older than the others, but they hang all the same, stark and still even when a breeze whistles through the limbs.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: A grotesquely twisted tree dominates this section of the graveyard, with bare, knotted limbs reaching upward, while unnatural nodule-ridden roots have broken the ground from beneath.  The roots have ensnared grave markers, encircling them near the bases, twining higher as if with the intention of dragging them beneath the earth.  A stone statue dwells under the tree, its visage lost to the wild roots entangling it.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Despite the air being eerily quiet, utterly silent but for the guttering of torches, there is a vibration that can be felt in the soles of the feet.  It is not a gentle thrumming nor a rough quaking, but rather a rhythmic pulse that pounds like a heartbeat or the cadence of steps deep below the ground's surface.  An imposing black marble mausoleum with crimson-flamed torches flanking the doors stands looming off the side of the pathway.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: A modest faenor statue of a drake stands at the head of the singular grave alongside the path, its natural green hue darkened with the stains of mildew growth that are obviously occasionally cleaned away.  It has left the metal mottled, but quality lends character, and there is a small matching plaque set near the bottom, while the marble pedestal it is perched upon is flanked by iron benches.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Though this stretch of grass is left largely unoccupied, it is well kept, devoid of weeds and dead leaves.  Though subtle and hard to see beneath the ever-swirling mists that serve as consistent groundcover, small black-flagged stakes have been laid out to frame a trio of rectangles, side-by-side and separated by only a foot or so of space.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: A few black-shod trees line the fence separating the graveyard from the town to the east, obscuring the view from either side with an abundance of onyx-leafed coverage.  There is a single mausoleum centered on this plot, which is framed by a miniature black iron palisade that is in turn ensnared by vines bearing picture-perfect violet roses.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Black of bark and foliage, tall trees scatter this section of the graveyard, their species unidentifiable though it is obvious that their coloring is not a result of having endured the ravages of flames.  In harmony with the maleficence of the setting, a discordant whistle drifts through the air, its origins impossible to decipher, while faint, blink-and-you-miss-it blood red orbs of mist appear and disappear with random regularity.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: A copse of trees stands still and silent, each one gnarled and twisted, laden with black leaves and blacker bark, reaching skyward with rictus limbs.  The subtle, inward curve of the mass of trunks, branches, and dark bowers serves as a stark background to a few mausoleums in a uniform arrangement, with the grass that is visible beneath the swirling mists well manicured despite its sallow appearance.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: A wood-enclosed plot of graves set off the path seems far older than the stone monuments that surround it.  Its borders are consumed by rot, having once been something like a foot-high fence, but now is no more than four corner posts and the adjoining beams fallen to the ground to succumb to the ravages of time and lichens.  The graves themselves are sunken, their stones awkwardly tilted, creating a picture of neglect as haunting as the surrounding.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: The land rises as the path moves eastward, and in the distance, the vague outline of buildings stand as silent black sentinels against the ever-changing horizon.  Despite the proximity to town, there are no sounds typical of inhabitance.  No voices, no movement of wagons, no music, or merriment.  There is only the silence of the graveyard, the soft wind that rustles its tree limbs and whistles past monuments and the occasional whisper that brushes by, indistinct and indecipherable, as it passes.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Debris of broken tree limbs and crumbling monuments litter the ground, with the heavy and low-lying mist trickling between the stones and over the branches in thin tendrils that swirl and collect in eddies before flowing onward.  On one haphazardly leaning gravestone, a single raven is perched, though it barely seems to move, only wavers as if the shifting lights of the colorful undulating sky are playing tricks on the eye.  Nearby is an old stone chapel, its white-painted face a pale beacon in the gloom.

Debris of broken tree limbs and crumbling monuments litter the ground, with the heavy and low-lying mist trickling between the stones and over the branches in thin tendrils that swirl and collect in eddies before flowing onward.  On one haphazardly leaning gravestone, a single raven is perched, though it barely seems to move, only wavers as if the shifting lights of the colorful undulating sky are playing tricks on the eye.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: The iron fence that encloses the graveyard is caved inward under the weight of a fallen tree.  Its distinct species is no longer identifiable as it has been stripped of all leaves and bark, and the wood is entirely obscured by growth colonies of lichen, motley green and amber-tipped, and mushrooms of all manner and description.  A few tombstones were casualties of the falling, and one grave at the foot of a broken stone has been breached from below, with only a hand-clawed chasm left as evidence.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: A stonework gazebo, with stately pillars and a filigreed wrought iron dome, lurks off to the north of the path, accompanied by a couple of towering oaks.  The long moss-laden branches offer a certain amount of coverage to the structure, which is otherwise open to the sky, but the tangle of dark green, crimson-veined vines laced into its iron work offers far more.  Gravestones set at awkward angles, half-sunk into the soft ground, encircle the gazebo.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: A few, small dead trees line the eastern edge of the path, bark blackened and limbs missing or barely hanging on by the merest splinter of wood.  Beyond those, deeper into a plot of land dotted with tombstones and grave markers, stands a modestly sized statue of a robed figure.  The figure's head is bowed, hands clasped with fingers laced just beneath her chin.  At her feet, a hodgepodge array of candles burn fitfully.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: The path curves slightly westward here around a both ancient and very dead tree.  Its leafless limbs stretch up and out, over the path toward the sky, as if searching for something unknowable like a penitent at prayer.  Though dead, the tree is sturdy and hale, with black bark and crevices between the clusters of branches and within the trunk itself that invite investigation.  Beneath the tree's menacing guard are several crypts in a row, spaced out on either side of its looming countenance.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Several freshly dug graves lie in a straight line parallel to the path, though none have markers except for one carelessly abandoned shovel shoved blade-first into the ground at the head of the last vacant hole.  The dense mist covering the ground largely avoids the empty graves, save for one in the middle, and there, tendrils of mist spill over the edge like long, distended fingers reaching in to dig something out.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Stretching from the nearby chapel and ending some several yards away, a wrought iron fence encloses a single crypt, menacing in its appearance with the overarching edifice adorned with an exquisitely rendered but contorted face at the peak of the lintel.  Each corner of the granite is clasped by a monstrously clawed hand, as if the face and hands are but a prelude to a hideous monster clamoring over the crypt's shelter.  A bent and twisted opening between two bars of the fence teases possible access to the crypt.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: The wrought iron fence runs right up to the side of a decrepit three-steepled ebonwood chapel with hazy grey windows, whose steps though warped and cracked in places, appear stable enough to invite an attempt to venture inside.  A pair of torches have been mounted on either side of the chapel's double doors, and while the fire burning within them seems normal enough to the naked eye, a closer look reveals no source or fuel for the flames.

title: [The Wayward Soul Chapel]
description: It is apparent upon first glance that it has been many a year since this chapel saw regular use.  Dust adorns every flat surface, from the seats of the many pews to the floor itself and everything in between.  Hymn books are tucked into wooden slots built into the backs of the pews, and while no one resides within the building, the sconces along the walls are lit, topped with fresh candles.  A velvet-draped ebonwood altar sits atop the dais at the head of the aisle with a stained glass window in the background.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: A small courtyard has been partitioned off by a mostly intact wrought iron fence that stretches along the path to the northeast and as far eastward as the eye can see before it disappears into darkness.  Behind the vine and rust-encrusted bars of the fence is a collection of uniform grave stones, all in neat rows and all of approximate size and shape.  At the center of the arrangement is a statue encircled by a round bench that traverses the circumference of its base.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Mounted on low-profile iron stakes, miniature lanterns line each side of the path, casting a ruddy orange light into the foggy ground cover.  The effect is nearly the opposite of the assumed intention, turning the mist into a layer of diffuse pumpkin-hued obfuscation that leaves the path more or less hidden from view.  In the distance, a trio of dark steeples rise against the ever-changing sky.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: This section of the graveyard is devoid of stone markers or tombs, but houses instead a round pool with black marble walls, and a single statue standing at its center.  The flowers once neatly planted around its circumference have been allowed to run wild and are tangled with gnarled vines that have begun to reach over the edge and into the water within the pool.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Unkempt and apparently left unattended for a great while, a modest white marble mausoleum stands, the once pristine stone stained by mildew and moss.  Chips and chunks are missing from its four corner pillars, and the remains of the loss lie crumbled in the grass at the base.  One door hangs slightly off-kilter, leaving a narrow opening to the monument's interior.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Clumps of long, grey moss litter the ground and hang draped from the tombstones and errant brush alike, adorning the stones and plants like somber veils.  There is a simple granite tombstone that stands at the head of a freshly dug grave, the empty chasm waiting as silently as the mound of earth ready to fill it.

title: [Graveyard Temporalis, Outer Rim]
description: While the red-veined vines tangle and twist around the iron fence topping the stone wall, small clusters of greenery with multi-blossomed sprigs of skeleton flowers peek from the low-lying ground fog.  Tendrils of mist meander along the wall, with the occasional thin finger reaching to trail along the mortar between the stones in the wall.  A wan, frail flicker of light burns to the east.

title: [Graveyard Temporalis, Outer Rim]
description: A short, stone-worked retaining wall emerges from the ground to the west, growing taller and more stable as it stretches eastward.  The crowning wrought iron fence is mostly intact, with only a few tines bent and twisted out of alignment with the rest.  Along the ground at the base of the barrier, a thin veil of fog has begun to gather, and it makes its way along in sinuous lines that sway and waver with even the slightest stirring.

title: [Graveyard Temporalis, Outer Rim]
description: The remnants of a once stately wrought iron fence rise from the ground as the trail rises eastward, with just the arrow-tipped tines still visible.  The accompanying crumbled stone wall has nearly been reclaimed, sinking into the soft bank of the river to the west.  Vines with glossy, dark green leaves creep along the remains of stone and iron, red-veined and twisting, coiled through the ruins as if trying to drag them from oblivion.  Up against the wall's remains are a stack of sturdy wooden coffins.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: A massive stone monolith peeks above a dense fog bank on the western shore, the rock topped with an empty nest like a small, shabby hat.  The turbid river bubbles here and there as it winds away gently to the southwest.  Hazy shapes along the eastern bank resemble a veritable army of treekin druids, the thickening patches of fog serving as their beards.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: A tall and stately wrought iron fence marks the border between the graveyard and the land beyond, with most segments still standing upright, while others have been ravaged by time, choking vines, or things better left unmentioned as they lay twisted and cast aside.  A cluster of small, ancient gravestones are housed within a disappearing brick border, the ground and grass and weeds threatening to entirely reclaim the plot.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: A lamp post stands sentinel by the gravel path underfoot, and the shade of the lantern it holds aloft is so stained with soot that the barest modicum of light escapes its glass panels.  Even so, the procession of the path remains visible and the nearest gravestones just can be read with the assistance of the constant ambient light that dances along the horizon.  Flares of crimson curl against the indigo sky, while pulses of cyan and magenta flare with the cadence of a heartbeat.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: The gravel path begins to turn westward at this juncture, while to the north, the dark silhouettes of statuary and a dilapidated chapel are voids against the color of the skyline.  A gentle breath of stirring air is constant here, and beneath the whistling of it through trees is the most subtle of whispers, indecipherable but unmistakably there.

The gravel path begins to turn westward at this juncture, while to the north, the dark silhouettes of statuary and a small chapel are voids against the color of the skyline.  A gentle breath of stirring air is constant here, and beneath the whistling of it through trees is the most subtle of whispers, indecipherable but unmistakably there.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: Several large monuments stand in neat rows off the side of the path amid the thick overgrowth of grass and moss.  Candles have been arranged on the lower lip of some of the larger grave markers, and it is evident by the amount of wax coldly clinging to the stone as it meets the ground that these luminaries are regularly replaced.  They flicker fitfully from time to time, doing little to banish the foggy groundcover, instead only brightening it from within in fits and starts.

title: [The Graveyard Temporalis]
description: A statuesque oak looms over the graves here, aged well beyond mortal reckoning as its trunk is so broad that six giantmen, standing arms outstretched and hand in hand, could not fully encircle it.  Its branches are low and inexplicably long, as if sagging beneath the great masses of long moss that drape from their lengths, and the gravestones sheltered beneath them are darkened by the lichen that has grown to overtake the names chiseled there.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Restaurant]
description: An impeccably dressed host stands alert behind a golden oak podium carved into a griffin, its wings spread wide, welcoming guests to the formal dining area.  Drink-laden trolley carts are pushed around by footmen waiting on patrons seated at various tables while additional kitchen staff quietly appear with silver serving trays piled high with smoked meats and assorted delicacies.  A bell dings repeatedly in the foyer just beyond a carved mahogany door.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Bar]
description: On both sides of an archway leading to the foyer, ornate sconces hang between paintings on emerald-papered walls above dark-stained wainscoting.  A line of padded stools covered in cognac-hued leather welcome patrons to a long ebony bar fitted with a brass kickplate in front.  Reflected in a wall-length mirror positioned behind the well-stocked bar, groupings of oversized leather chairs around low tables offer more intimate conversation.
