title: [Evermore Hotel, Hallway]
description: A series of dripping candle-laden chandeliers illuminate a variety of oil paintings lining a long walnut-paneled hallway.  Plush carpet runners in wine-dark hues muffle footsteps on the gleaming hardwood floors outside of closed doors, some with notices hanging on the burnished brass handles.   A brass trolley cart stacked with luggage waits in an alcove at the end of the hall.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Evermore Hotel, Platform]
[Evermore Hotel, Lift]
description: Behind a gilded scissor gate, a platform operator stands at the ready, one hand on a polished brass lever clearly marked with the floors of the hotel.  The walls are covered with burnished cherrywood and silvered glass which reflects a cushioned bench covered in plush crimson velvet at the rear of the clockwork platform.  A low thrum emanates from behind the paneling.

Behind a gilded scissor gate, a lift operator stands at the ready, one hand on a polished brass lever clearly marked with the floors of the hotel.  The walls are covered with burnished cherrywood and silvered glass which reflects a cushioned bench covered in plush crimson velvet at the rear of the lift.  A low thrum emanates from behind the paneling.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Sitting Room]
description: Beneath a pair of heavily gilded chandeliers, two fel-framed divans covered in rich citrine suede face each other across a low table of crimson-stained fel.  A thick bearskin rug has been stretched out in front of a tall, black stone fireplace in one corner of the room, a brass-framed oil painting hanging above a crowned hardwood mantle.  Panels of crimson velvet have been drawn over an expansive window, a writing desk at its centerpoint.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Dressing Room]
description: Ornately framed glass mirrors hang above a row of bourde-covered benches and walnut dressing tables laid out with a variety of brushes and grooming tools.  Behind a painted silk screen partition, washbasins filled with warm, scented water sit atop a low cupboard containing a neat stack of face cloths.  The scent of eucalyptus seeps through a tall marble arch, a glimpse of a steaming pool of water visible beyond its border.

title: [Haunting Sphere, Consignment]
description: Dusty wooden cabinets line the walls of the shop, overfilled with aged scrolls wedged between leather-spined codexes and trinkets of various shapes and sizes.  A bent wire cage sits in the back corner partially concealed beneath a heavy amethyst wool cloak, the occasional sound of rattling muffled by the fabric.  A faint balefire green glow emanates from beneath the unevenly raised floorboards, leaving the lingering scent of sulfur as it fades.

title: [Bones and Baubles, Salesroom]
description: Decaying forms draped in formal wear shuffle to and fro, carrying various wares to their appropriate tables, each zombie readjusting its limbs between hauls.  The stone-hewn walls are covered in poorly drawn maps of various cities, some of which appear to have been torn off with teeth or marked with gore by a nearby assistant.  Loose floorboards create a semi-hazardous shop, the occasional wandering hand reaching out before being slapped down by an irritated zombie.

title: [Antiquarian Manor, West Wing]
description: Covering the center of the marble floor, a crushed velvet runner of gold-filigree and red muffles the sound of passersby as they explore the wing.  Ebon veining traces its away across the white marble walls, which glistens in the light of several frosted globes that dangle from the ceiling.  Perched upon the tile floor and set back from the central runner, several glass-paned display cases and gold-inlaid linden curios showcase rare finds.

title: [Antiquarian Manor, Showroom]
[Antiquarian Manor, Show Room]
description: Frosted globes dangle over each of the glass display cases housed in the small show room, while plush carpets muffle the sound in the enclosed space.  Golden fleur-de-lis decorate the cloth-of-gold fabric that decorates the walls, the symbol echoed in the ornate feet of velveteen chairs arranged in the corners.  A heavy white door offers egress.

Frosted globes dangle over each of the glass display cases housed in the small show room, while plush carpets muffle the sound in the enclosed space.  Golden fleur-de-les decorate the cloth-of-gold fabric that decorates the walls, the symbol echoed in the ornate feet of velveteen chairs arranged in the corners.  A heavy white door offers egress.

title: [Antiquarian Manor, East Wing]
description: Covering the center of the marble floor, a crushed velvet runner of gold filigree and red muffles the sound of passersby as they explore the wing.  Ebon veining traces its way across the white marble walls, which glisten in the light of several frosted globes that dangle from the ceiling.  Perched upon the tile floor and set back from the central runner, several glass-paned display cases and gold-inlaid linden curio cabinets showcase rare finds.

title: [Antiquarian's Study]
description: Surrounded by floor-to-ceiling shelves, the thickly carpeted room has strategically placed frosted globes that illuminate a large black walnut desk.  A suit of antique armor rests in one corner, its breastplate reflecting the ambient light while its limbs remain in shadows.  Various collection jars, ancient manuscripts, and rawhide-wrapped bundles fill the shelves and give the air a slightly musty scent.

Surrounded by floor-to-ceiling shelves, the thickly carpeted room has strategically placed frosted globes that illuminate a large black walnut desk.  A suit of antique armor rests in one corner, its breastplate reflecting the ambient light while its limbs remain in shadows.  Various collection jars, ancient manuscripts, and raw hide-wrapped bundles fill the shelves and give the air a slightly musty scent.

title: [The Greedy Ghost, Wares]
description: Several brocade-draped tables are set before the glossy wooden floor, each one laden with a variety of trinkets and treasures cradled between a duo of stands.  Tufts of wispy fur gather upon the thick woolen rugs beneath each table, the occasional paw flashing by, swatting at loose threads dangling from the shelves above.  An ethereal form passes through the back wall, the sounds of metal clanging as the mist traverses between the shop rooms.

title: [Fate's Holding]
description: Torches lashed to spears dot the path as it ambles through a landscape blanketed by peat moss, dispelling the darkness brought on by the closed canopy of the forest's densely packed trees.  Here and there, openings in the blackberry shrubs reveal small huts surrounded by an agglomeration of pink-tufted piri-piri bur.  Luminous standing stones draped in curtains of moss lurk just beyond the outer edges of the torchlight.

title: [Fate's Holding, The Cell]
description: Twining close to a grass-covered wall, the path slips in and out of pools of twilight as it meanders through the dark forest.  Sprawling across the entire length of moss-covered ground on the western side of the path, a heavily corded hornbeam creates a yawning canopy with its curving branches, the shade of which keeps all other growth from sprouting within its shelter.  Opposite, an oil-soaked torch sits in an iron bracket bound to the wall and illuminates a wrought iron cell door.

title: [Fate's Holding, The Cauldron]
description: Curtains of grandpa's beard moss drape smaller tree species with their scraggly stems, slowly descending into pendant shapes that brush the rocky terrain with their curly ends.  Burning brightly in a small clearing off the edge of the path, a bonfire covered with a cauldron-strung dried oak tripod dispels the dark of the woods.  Nearly luminous in the firelight, peat moss blankets those trees untouched by its loftier cousin and is home to stepping stones that connect several huts lurking in the forest's miasma to the path.

title: [Fate's Holding, Wooded Arch]
description: Half in shadow and half in twilight, the packed dirt pathway transitions from dense forestry to a rolling grassland of mixed tufts of wood melick and ryegrass.  Towering spruces, one upon either side of the pathway, arc towards the sky, their upper reaches crossing at some point to create a natural archway.  A series of carved warding stones with faces stare into the wood, their amber eyes sporadically flashing.

title: [Fate's Holding]
description: Clustered shrubs cling to the steep, grassy walls of the hillock the twining path snakes around, their twisted limbs holding clusters of mustard yellow blossoms under the watchful gaze of tidy dwellings.  To the west, dark shadows play upon the grassy land as knotted trees threaten to choke passage into a small wood that stretches from the tower hillock to the neighborhood's encircling fence.  A small wooden sign post rests at the bend in the path, a small wicker basket of torches at its feet.

title: [Fate's Holding]
description: Sprawling down the southwestern slope, wavy grasslands provide home to small dwellings with thatched rooves that are sporadically spaced throughout the neighborhood.  Beyond the homes, high wrought iron fences are a reminder that this burrow resides within town -- though space seems to do odd things beneath the twilight-touched sky.  Fomorian chokeberry shrubs grow in russet clusters along the steep incline that supports the hill's summit barrow, the berry laden plants continuing southwest where the dense woods darken.

title: [Fate's Holding]
description: Standing stones, some monolithic giants, act as quiet sentinels to the entrance of a court cairn at the northernmost edge of the twining trail, the ground slowly transitioning from a rock-riddled landscape covered in moss to bristly grasses ranging in hue from yellow to pale green.  Wild gorse grows in clusters against the highwalls of the barrow along the western edge of the track, while fields of Asharikan lilies surround winding pathways to thatch-roofed dwellings.

title: [Fate's Holding, Fomorian Cairn]
description: Slipping between stacked stone entries, the twining path leaves the standing stones at either end to provide entry through the barrier walls of a court cairn.  Large and flat fieldstones covered in moss form sentinel pillars between long burial niches fitted into the walls that are made of a mingling of curbstones, quarry rocks, and chunks of blue shale.  Ancient and ravaged by wind, a series of wooden posts are topped with various pieces of tattered fabric that flutter in the breeze and cast moving shadows upon the walls.

title: [Fate's Holding]
description: Steeply inclined, the winding trail departs from the knee-high, yellowish green ryegrasses along the western edge to a barren stretch of land dimpled by moonlight white boulders.  Standing stones painted in splatters of verdigris-hued lichen cast fingers of shadows along the southeastern edge of the track, sentinels or heralds to the burial cairn beyond it.  Forgotten by its steward, a double handle of an ard, its plough-head buried in the earth, houses the tattered remains of cloak or shawl.

title: [Fate's Holding]
description: Rising like a sentinel over the high grasses beyond the curving track, the skeletal remains of a once towering tree hunkers to the north.  Though leafless and decrepit, the arboreal colossus still spreads a shadow upon the land, expanding and contracting like long fingers of inky blackness grabbing at the round wooden entrances to homes built directly into the barrow.  A series of smooth-featured stones carved in various forms of supplication encircle the tree.

title: [Fate's Holding]
description: Thinning and yellowing as it becomes sparser, knee-high ryegrass surrounds the simple track that follows the curving incline.  Tall cairns, sun-bleached and covered in moss, dot the landscape in small, flattened clearings within the high grass, each marking where smaller trails descend from the barrow and lead to small homes clustered on the western incline.  Supported by angular rocks and wedged deeply into the ground, a spindled branch is imbedded into the track, its thin limbs covered in hemp-strung talismans.

title: [Fate's Holding, Barrow Summit]
description: Providing a view of the spiraled pathway that encircles the barrow, a hillock top has a steep trail leading down its side to the distant gates of the neighborhood.  Clanking chimes decorate the tops of crooked sticks that rest within short barrier walls that connect shallow cairns to one another across the flat plain.  Disappearing into darkness, a spindled copper-bound ladder offers access to the interior of the barrow where the faint flicker of torchlight is visible.

title: [Fate's Barrow]
description: Dank and dark, the cavern smells of loam, dirt, and something unidentifiable but sweet.  Root tendrils dangle from above, their spidery fingers casting shadows on the ground due to the flickering of the three torches positioned around a spindled copper-bound ladder.  Framed in ebonwood, widowwood, and driftwood, an ancient story wall displays colorful painted panels of a time gone by.

title: [Quinton Manse, Sitting Room]
description: Twilight hues spill through scarf-wrapped polished glass windows that line the pale blue walls, casting the room in gradient shades of violet, cerulean, and coral.  Velveteen divans and an oversized oiled leather armchair surround a grate-covered brick fireplace that occupies an interior wall, while a bundle of wooden sticks rests near the entry.  Baubles and knickknacks decorate the towering bookcase that rests against the northern wall.

title: [Quinton Manse, Western Nook]
description: Wrapped in a towering ebonwood bookcases, the nook is a somewhat private booth covered in decorative rugs that compliment the floral-patterned walls.  Though no windows are present, lighting is not an issue as wall sconces housing frosted globes are prevalent in this area.  A small sign offers information for the curious.

title: [Quinton Manse, Eastern Nook]
description: Wrapped in a towering ebonwood bookcases, the nook is a somewhat private booth covered in decorative rugs that complement the floral-patterned walls.  Though no windows are present, lighting is not an issue as wall sconces housing frosted globes are prevalent in this area.  A small sign offers information for the curious.

title: [Otherworldly Wealth, Lobby]
description: A pair of skeletons, bedecked in faded smoking jackets and cravats, sit on elevated platforms before several rows of benches, the duo elbowing one another as they chuckle to themselves.  Gilt-framed paintings of towns and villages cover the scratched stone walls, the images appearing to move from picture to picture as they navigate the vertebral-carved edges.  A thick glass-paned tank is filled in the skeletal forms of several fish, bumping into one another as they swim about the greenish water.

A thick glass-paned rectangular tank is filled in the skeletal forms of several fish, bumping into one another as they swim about the greenish water

title: [Innocent's End, The Outdoorsman]
description: A circular pond splits the chalk-covered cobblestone road, the vibrant blue waters covered in emerald lilypads and toy boats folded from wax-sealed parchment.  The faint sounds of quacking emanate between the confectionary-covered hedges along the walkway, followed by rustling that causes the nearby swings to sway from their branch-hung perches.

title: [Innocent's End, The Zoophilist]
description: Colorful pavilions of silk and canvas line the grass-covered walkway, the greenery being slowly consumed by a variety of animals meandering by the otter-shaped fountain in the center of the neighborhood.  Wooden-framed easels are scattered amid the chaos of mammals, the canvases propped up next to several chalk-colored chairs.

title: [Innocent's End, The Enchanted]
description: The walkway has been crafted of puffy clouds of bright white and silver, the ethereal forms leading up towards rainbow-encircled bungalows of sparkling glitter-sprinkled glass.  Bushes of colorful spun sugar are scattered along the pathway, the occasional unicorn helping itself before disappearing on feathered wings.

title: [Innocent's End, The Engulfed]
description: Thick tendrils of indigo-colored mist writhe across the ground, wrapping themselves across the bamboo-spiked lanterns in front of a row of stilted driftwood homes battered by waves of black water lapping at the foundations.  The sky above the homes has been blanketed by sinuous kites of silk, the eel-shaped toys rising and diving across the horizon, while others lay broken across the lapping waters.  A mechanical toy frigatebird perched on a log of driftwood, opens and closes its mouth soundlessly.

title: [Innocent's End, The Adventurers]
description: The cobblestones merge into the wood planking that forms the walkway, the sideless deck connected to several ship-shaped buildings by brightly painted gangplanks.  Cannons flank each windowed ship, occasionally firing a volley of confetti across the area, the parti-colored parchment dotting the crystalline blue waters below.

title: [Innocent's End, The Explorers]
description: Leafy vines of bright green crawl across the rocky ground, their lengths entwining with the tall wooden treehouses flanking the dense foliage-covered road.  Iridescent-winged avians flit across the walkway, landing safely in the branches shading the path from the elements, the occasional call echoing from above.  The sweet scent of tropical fruits permeates the air, the sap-covered trees dotting the horizon.

title: [Innocent's End, The Brave]
description: Tall fortifications flank the dirt-covered walkway, the stone-set castle walls covered in splatters of paint and lengths of hempen rope.  Horses crafted from metal and wood are dispersed across the battlefield, their ribbon-knotted reins draped across pillow-shaped saddles.  The faint thumping of drums echoes against the walls, the off-beat rhythm occasionally broken by loud neighing.

title: [Innocent's End, The Destroyed]
description: The broken hulls of wooden toy boats litter the sandy walkway, their skeletal remains occupied by a scant number of elven-crafted tents huddling by a dwindling fire.  A viscous black liquid forms a near-perfect circle at the center of the neighborhood, the edges smeared by the tentacles of a giant mechanical kraken lashing out from beyond the shoreline.  Flashes of jagged teeth and massive incarnadine wings dart from behind the tents, disappearing quickly in blurry waves.

title: [Innocent's End, The Desolated]
description: The cavernous hollows of moss-covered stone enclose the area from the rest of the neighborhood, casting shadows that pierce through the mists hovering above the ground.  Bearded toy marionettes lay scattered and broken against the rocks, covered in grey-colored boils, their mouths stained with flakes of rust.  A tall glass-eyed doll sits in an alcove high above, its curved fangs peeking out from a painted mouth of red.

title: [Innocent's End, The Felled]
description: A massive toy bear of hollowed metal dominates the middle of the area, covered in sickly green vines that constrict its body, the tendrils wrapping around a single deteriorated cabin set upon a small hill.  Tiny pin-covered dolls dangle from gnarled tree branches across the square, their cloth limbs dangling lifelessly alongside their broken button eyes.  The flattened grass across the walkway is littered with small toy soldiers, their wooden torsos and heads smashed into the dirt.

title: [Innocent's End, The Ruined]
description: The walkway fades into hard-packed sand as you step into the area, the coastline engulfed by larger-than-life toy frigates forming a monstrous wall looming across the horizon.  Churning greyish black waters lap against the dilapidated pier, continously slapping faded flags against the wooden logs.  Blue-furred stuffed animals dart in and out of half-toppled huts of palm fronds, their veiny hands repeatedly gripping each doorway with a faint snarl.

title: [Innocent's End, The Entombed]
description: The loud boom of colorful fireworks echoes over the charred buildings surrounding the cobblestone walkway, the smoke hovering over an oversized toy box affixed with six faintly glowing locks.  The lid of the box has shifted slightly ajar, causing tiny turquoise crocodiles and crystalline crabs to spill out, skittering off into the dark corners.  A two-headed serpent toy mechanically hisses menacingly as it wends across the container, its bright purple scales etched with nine giant Xs in crimson paint.

title: [Innocent's End, The Ravaged]
description: An aged mechanical carousel creaks loudly as it turns, the small fabric ponies pierced through by thin poles carved into overlapping arrowheads.  Faded panels cover the center column of the device, the idyllic inked countryside punctured with leaf-scribed arrows, the broken shafts littering the grass-painted floor.  The stuffed ponies are covered in thick wool blankets, their heads and bodies entirely concealed by a curtain of black.

title: [Innocent's End, The Broken]
description: Jagged metal sheets form a broken pathway across the area, forming the vague shape of a sword buried beneath the rubble of the desolate buildings on the horizon.  A quartet of gear-jointed figurines erratically move along the four corners of the neighborhood, each one garbed in the frayed remains of wool robes.  Sharply pointed ears protrude from one figurine, another covered entirely in scales across its exposed body, while the remaining duo stand facing each other, scimitar and dagger in hand.

title: [Innocent's End, The Shattered]
description: Heavy stones form the walkway across a large fortress, the parapet stretching east and west leading down to the battlements and several small tents providing makeshift shelter.  Beyond the gates are untethered marionettes, their peeled and cracked visages gazing towards the entrance, shuffling forward as they drag their strings in the trampled grass.  Wooden toy swords lay buried within the muddied puddles, splattered with bright crimson paint that bleeds into the soil.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Lounge]
description: A haze of cigar smoke lingers above tuft-backed leather sofas that invite lounging in front of a stone fireplace with a silver-framed oil painting hanging above its blackened mantel.  Scattered along the dark wood-paneled walls, panes of stained glass separate tables into cozy booths.  A nacre-tiled clockface mosaic set into the polished floor seems to indicate that the time is perpetually midnight.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Hallway]
description: A ticking longcase clock sits between a pair of closed doors in the middle of a short corridor leading northeast to a grand staircase.  Opposite the doors, a bronze-framed oil painting hangs above a heavy mahogany desk, a thick leather-bound tome lying open on it.  A rolling cart supplied with fresh towels and folded blankets is parked to one side of the hallway, while a maidservant pauses to dust a marble gargoyle sculpture.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Basement]
description: At the bottom of a steep staircase, wall-mounted lanterns cast shadows onto floor-to-ceiling shelves overflowing with unclaimed luggage, the moldering leather cases spilling their contents onto hard packed dirt underfoot.  The dark corners of the substructure are piled with a menagerie of forgotten possessions, a saddle trimmed with tarnished silver on top of one heap.  A path has been cleared through the jumbled maze, but only wide enough to sidle through.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Stairs]
description: Sinuous winged viper statues wrap around marble posts at the foot of a sweeping staircase leading up to a chandelier-lit landing.  The landing splits to the east and west, the carpeted steps climbing up and vanishing from sight.  From a high vantage point mid-flight, a young lady peers out from an oak-framed oil painting, her emerald eyes seeming to follow the retreating footsteps of the hotel guests.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Wine Cellar]
description: A barrel-vaulted wine cellar is dimly lit by glass-paned lanterns, the walls lined with wooden racks filled with dusty glass bottles, most of which are empty.  A cache of steel-banded hickory casks flank an aged oak press.  To one side of a curtained archway, a board of cheeses, breads, and fresh fruit have been left on a three-legged table, a trail of crumbs leading away from the fare to a small mouse hole in the corner.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Mud Baths]
description: A thick, gurgling sound echoes throughout a torch-lit undercroft littered with bubbling, mud-filled pools in a series of crescent shapes.  Thermal water flows from a natural spring into a fluted fountain in the center of the room, the cascade capable of showering away all traces of black mud.  A trail of muddy footprints lead through an archway.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Grand Hall]
description: Highly polished floors reflect tiered chandeliers suspended on lengthy chains overhead, the flickering candles catching specks of gold in the black marble underfoot.  On all sides, carpeted staircases climb up and out of sight to the floor above, the walls presenting a gallery of artwork to be discovered on each flight.  Richly appointed settees clustered around evenly spaced columns marching down the center of the hall encourage casual discourse between guests.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Solarium]
description: Moonlight pours through the glass roof onto lush greenery in terra-cotta pots, the petals of the scarlet hibiscus tightly closed for the night.  High-backed wicker chairs flank glass-topped sideboards set with cocktails, while green felted tables host lively card games and rolling dice.  A pair of ebonwood doors with hazy window panes opens out onto a lantern-lit patio overlooking the hotel grounds and expansive gardens.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Nursery]
description: A wire-bound mobile tilts above a green-lacquered crib of sturdy wood, the device suspending decapitated wool avians and mammals above a flora-stitched pillow stained in ichor.  Nestled between twin beds curtained in fine linen is a faded dollhouse, the ebonwood table below it strewn with minute pieces of broken furniture and porcelain body parts, some crushed into the wood.  Various toys are scattered across the sigil-woven rug, some emanating a dull red glow which changes in the ambient light.

title: [Third Floor, West]
description: Rope-strung mirrors lay in graduated lengths on either side of the curving archway, casting distorted images by the faint glow of an avian-shaped iron lantern, its flame-lit eyes flickering in the ambient breeze.  A silk-woven partition partially conceals a narrow wooden door and ladder, the screen hung with a variety of household tools left in disarray.  Small wire-formed cages encircle the spiraled wrought iron staircase, the enclosures piled with dusty feathers that spill across the rug-covered floor.

title: [Gable of the Finch]
description: The slanted ceiling of the chamber is covered with a variety of drawings, the image of a wren transcribed over and over in different mediums and styles, its diminutive body violently slashed by a sharp object.  An unadorned desk and matching bed sit untouched by the wrought iron staircase, both surfaces covered in sheets of parchment with the same wren, obscured by dust and grime.  A coil of frayed rope lays beneath a wobbly wooden chair, the ends entangled between the marred legs.

title: [Gable of the Grackle]
description: A dark-painted plague of grackles covers the slanted ceiling of the narrow room, their shadowed bodies illuminated by a small caged lantern hanging above a simple blanket-adorned bed.  The weathered floor boards are partially concealed by scattered pieces of clothing, the tattered shreds slipping beneath the loose planks like an open maw, its edges stained rust red.  A cotton-stuffed grackle sits perched above a wrought iron ladder, appearing to gaze over the bed with its glass eyes.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Staff Rooms]
description: Neatly arranged rows of quilt-covered beds sit flush against the peeling emerald walls, the sleeping arrangements densely enveloped by a shroud of yellowed dust.  Heavy wooden chests lay opened at the foot of each bed, filled with wrinkled pieces of bloodied clothing between the illuminated grimoires, ritual daggers, and vials of dried herbs.  A faded yellow and red box rests upon a single bloodwood stool, the seating encircled by stubs of melted wax dripped across the rune-carved wooden floor.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Wash Room]
description: A rectangular wren-etched mirror stands behind a deep basin of ashen porcelain, the circular bowl filled with opaque black water, with the contents threatening to spill across an ebonwood table against the wall.  A claw-footed tub is nestled by a curtained window, its shattered lip stained in rusty crimson rivulets splayed across the surface.  Web-like cracks have formed in the upper corners of the room, covering the emerald-colored walls in dark fractures.

title: [Third Floor, East]
description: The emerald-colored walls peel across the scratch marks on either side of a pine-framed curving archway, the haphazard slashes continuing along the narrow wooden door blending into the lasimor framework of the enclosure.  Stone-hewn nests adorn the railings of the wrought iron staircase, the marble cradles filled with ivoried bones fused with dark cloisonne.  A spiral wrought iron ladder leans across a parchment-filled wall, the anatomical sketchings highlighted in vivid scarlet ink.

title: [Gable of the Rook]
description: Tiny origami rooks seemingly float across the low ceiling of the room, their onyx paper wings pierced by thin iron hooks hung on brittle wire, and the paper avians are linked by cobwebs and dust.  An ebonwood-framed bed sits beside a wrought iron ladder, the bare mattress devoid of sheets and ornamentation and the narrow headboard snapped in half.  Flush against the high side wall is a marred writing desk, its surface penetrated by tapered blades bent at unnatural angles.

title: [Gable of the Wren]
description: Gilt-foiled wrens soar across the shredded emerald-colored ceiling, their diminutive bodies visible between the dozens of wind chimes strung from the iron staircase to the back wall, with the hollow tones of metal and wood echoing in the small chamber.  A pillow-covered bed sits nestled below a long ebonwood shelf, the ledge perched with a single hollow-eyed doll, its arms broken off and sitting upon the woolen blanket.  A faint glow of crimson emanates from beneath the wooden bed, pulsating slightly.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Water Closet]
description: The air in the cramped room is stale, with motes of dust seemingly suspended before a large and square wash basin, the sides of which are stained in shades of rust and crimson.  A mirror has been affixed above the basin, its clouded surface framed by a wren-carved border of ebonwood, where the avian wings are broken off and crushed upon the tiled floor.  Piles of rags lay abandoned in the darkest corner of the room, the torn strips shifting slightly in erratic patterns.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Storage Nook]
description: Wrought iron hooks hang heavy wool cloaks and robes from the vert-colored back wall, the fabrics concealing the pentagram-painted floor boards, the loosened chips flaking across the circular border.  A blackened lasimor chest sits buried beneath piles of aged parchment, its broken lock discarded beneath a shelf of cloudy liquid-filled jars and torn bags spilling a fine powder across the floor.  A series of footsteps lay untouched across the white powder-covered planks, alongside a duo of cloven hooves.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: Monstrous, deformed trees grow out of the grey-green river, their twisted limbs acting as route markers pointing in the directions of the diverging currents.  A fallen bough floats on the surface of the deep water beneath the vine-draped branches.  To the southeast, a small waterfall carries a handful of skeletal leaves on a sluggish current towards a heavily wooded terrain.

title: [Town Hall, Entry]
description: Surrounded by tarnished silver, oval, rectangular, and square mirrors dominate the faded green-on-silver wallpaper that lines the walls of the entry.  Wooden benches arranged upon the inner walls wobble at random intervals, as if something is sitting or rising from them though no one is present.  To either side of the entry, wrought iron hooks house cloaks and capes in various colors, though the number seems to shift and change without warning.

Wooden benches arranged upon the inner walls wobble at random intervals, as if something is siting or rising from them though no one is present.  To either side of the entry, wrought iron hooks house cloaks and capes in various colors, though the number seems to shift and change without warning.

title: [Town Hall, Hallway]
description: Shadows pool upon the landing, causing the eastern and western passages to be shrouded in darkness.  Doorways fashioned of clotted spiderwebs make it impossible to progress further in any direction that isn't down a balustered ebonwood staircase.

title: [Town Hall, Spookorium]
description: Curtains of straggly spiderwebbing flutter in an unseen wind as air moves through the room, drawn down the chimney by the fire recessed in a brick-lined alcove.  Forgotten sconces line the walls which are covered in peeling greyish paper, their tallows long since lost to the ravages of time.  Skittering sounds occasionally punctuate the crackling grumble of the fire.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: A heavy fog hangs above the dusky river quieting the incessant babbling of shallow waters along the stone-ridden shoreline.  Here and there, the parting mists unveil natural rock formations as works of art on display for passers-by.  One particularly large boulder resembles a horned gargoyle, its bat-like wings spread upward, disappearing into a cloud of grey mist.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: Curiously absent of birdsong, the thickening woods on either side of the somber river echo the sound of dry branches scraping against each other as an errant breeze sweeps through.  Heavy mists obscure the treetops along the banks with sullen clouds constantly changing shape.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: A series of tiny eyots capped with tufts of silvery, hair-like grass rise from the dappled river in a haphazard fashion.  Magnificent, knotted trees lean out over the water from either bank, their contorted grey branches reaching towards each other through the thick fog.  The sweet smell of wet earth and rotten wood pervades the air.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: Along this stretch of the river, the once-smooth waters swirl and froth, while shadowy shapes circle like sharks beneath the leaden surface.  A thin shroud of hazy mist envelopes the watercourse to the southwest.  Along the bank, the trees stand silent guard and an owl hoots in the distance.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Shrine]
description: The flow of the river is splintered by a small islet camouflaged in a dense thicket of white alders.  To the southwest, the current runs swift, forming muddy swirls and foaming eddies before disappearing into a thick brume.  A small shrine at the water's edge is marked with illegible runes.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Dam]
description: Now abandoned, a partially constructed dam of logs and mud narrows the water passage considerably.  A great swathe of trees have been felled on the eastern bank, most left to rot in soft, wet dirt.  To the south, a massive, purplish cloud bank appears to hover over the river.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Temple]
description: An eerie pall of silence settles over the area, the burbling of the slow-moving waters nearly muted.  Beyond the confines of the river embankments, the trees have given way to rocky ground covered in tall grasses.  The remains of an ancient stone temple lay in ruins on the eastern shore.  To the south, a dark cloud bank swallows up the landscape.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Cliff Face]
description: The river runs straight into a wall of grey stone piled up into lofty cliffs, which from upstream may have appeared as a dark mass of clouds, before vanishing into a subterranean passageway.  Lianas blanket most of the cliff face, covering the rough fissures and deep crevices.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Cavern]
description: A curtain of vines partially conceals a yawning cave mouth along the northwestern edge of a tenebrous cavity.  Labyrinthine tunnels branch off in various directions, the watery chambers unlit by golden sunshine or silvery moonbeam.  Lanterns placed into rocky recesses light the way through a navigable passage via watercraft.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Cavern]
description: The cavern ceiling dips quite low, the icicle-like stalactites overhead almost skimming the surface of the river in some sections.  The air seems stale with no discernable breeze from any direction.  Spiders skitter to and fro on the rocky walls, their intricate webs glistening in the lackluster glow from the scattered lanterns.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Cavern]
description: Stalagmites burst up from the murky waters making navigation in this section of the cave more difficult.  Overhead, bats cling to the rock ceiling seemingly unperturbed by the sputtering lanterns poorly lighting the immense subterranean area.  Fresh water pours in from an unseen opening high above, the sounds of the waterfall almost deafening.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Cavern]
description: The subterraneous water passage narrows considerably without warning in this tunnel.  Lit only by a single lantern, details of the numerous rock formations are lost in vast shadows.  The wreckage of a small boat, its bow splintered against a large whale-shaped rock, bobs on the surface of the grim river.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Cavern]
description: The low ceiling of the cavern has partially caved in, obstructing further exploration of a narrow, water-filled tunnel to the south.  A cache of branded oak barrels and a tangle of discarded fishing nets are caught amid the rubble that bumps up against the muddy shore.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Cavern]
description: A faint light to the east illuminates a craggy cave mouth filled by the dark waters of a slow-moving river.  Lanterns have been tucked into niches around the grotto, their flickering flames creating dancing shadows on the limestone.  Water drips slowly from the stalactites overhead, each drop into the river reverberating around the cavern.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: The river disappears underground at the foot of a rock formation to the west.  A makeshift dock of rotten logs lashed together with vines floats at the wooded water's edge.  The ground cover on the shore is thick, but a rough-hewn path can be made out, winding its way up from the dock and disappearing past the tree line.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Rock Face]
description: To the southwest, an expansive rock face camouflaged with an elaborate draping of vine comes into view.  Mist crawls across the surface of the dark waters at the base of the imposing cliffs, obscuring the course of the river in that direction.  A faint buzzing sound can be heard somewhere in the distance.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: The languid river flows between steep banks, its steel grey waters offering no reflection of the skies overhead.  A dented helm has been discarded in the mud along the shore and nearby a hatchet is sunk into a fallen timber.  Smoke can be seen in the distance drifting upwards in random patterns.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Ford]
description: Well worn paths deep with ruts lead down to the river on either side of the bank.  Posts are sunk deep into the soft ground on either side, each wound with heavy ropes which lay in large coils nearby.  While the current is not fast-moving, its difficult to judge the depth of the water to ford safely.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: Flowing at a leisurely pace, the river courses through a somber landscape featuring steep, rocky hillsides and stubby trees.  The air is still, no breeze rustling the tree branches or sending ripples across the water.  A collection of lily pads float along, their burgundy blooms a stark contrast to the otherwise grey surroundings.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Lake]
description: The meandering river waters flow into a miniature lake, a silvery grey gem embedded in the surrounding hills.  In the mists over the dead calm surface, a small island appears, home to a tiny hut constructed from mud, sticks, and stones.  The hut is overshadowed by an immense snag, its cracked trunk filled with empty nests and its parched branches clawing over the ground toward the water's edge.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Island]
description: Deserted nests cling to remnants of a tree's fallen branches, the post of a cracked wooden sign half buried in mud splintered and angled towards a fungus-laden rotted fishing dock behind a tiny hut crafted from mud, sticks, and stone.  Beyond the dock, a slow-moving stream traverses the small island, feeding from the river into a small lake on the other side.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Ferry]
description: Sinuous and dark, the water flows in a serpentine fashion as it winds along its unceasing course.  A deserted ferry next to a dilapidated wooden dock is situated on the western shore.  Nearby, a haphazard pile of wooden poles lie forgotten on the strand.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: The placid river seems to be barely moving along this stretch, the drab, tree-lined scenery unchanging.  Tall reeds poke up out of the water along the riverbanks, the aquatic grasses normally home to any number of mammals, but this bed is devoid of life.  Two relatively large boulders have been rolled close to the water's edge, one painted with an illegible rune.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: The river flows on peacefully, a few bubbles breaking the darksome surface along the shoreline.  The trees become taller, their trunks more sizable and their limbs more widespread.  Spikes of sharp-tipped rushes edge the hazy waters beneath a small spring on the bank pouring down into the river.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: A snake slithers out of the dark underbrush, down the muddy embankment and disappears into the murky waters of the river.  A fallen hardwood featuring a hollow trunk teems with insects across its cracked grey bark, an infernal buzzing filling the air.  The trees close in on either side as the channel narrows and bends.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: Grassy mounds appear in the middle of the river, the lead-colored water moving silently around the obstructions without even a burbled objection to their presence.  The river bend widens considerably as a fork appears to the northeast.  Along the banks, nightshade sprouts from the undergrowth.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Cottage]
description: Tendrils of mist creep across the slate-colored waters and wrap around the trunk of an immense willow affording a leafy bower on the western embankment.  The mild river washes across a vast slab of rock poking up from the depths, the current eroding a swirl-like pattern on its face.  A grey stone cottage with a thatched roof can be glimpsed, nestled far back in a copse of trees.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Reed Beds]
description: The sullen waters flow through the exposed roots of massive trees towering above the river on either side.  Faces have been carved into the smaller trees, their eerie, lopsided grins and slanted eyes seemingly watching the traffic on the river.  From its perch on a rotting stump surrounded by a greenish brown reed bed, a turtle pokes its head from its shell in a slow, monotonous manner.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Bridge]
description: A crumbling, moss-covered stone bridge spans a quarter of the distance across the river, the missing sections lost beneath the stirless, inky grey waters.  Flowering vines strung with an assortment of lanterns dangle from the ruins overhead, the flickering flames sending long shadows dancing over the languorous current.  A thrush nightingale atop the viaduct peers curiously down on transit below.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Pillars]
description: A smattering of bright purple loosestrife blooms beneath a magnificent canopy of darkened verdure.  Visible beyond the eastern shore, a ring of stone pillars, some leaning, others fallen, submit to the ravages of time.  A network of platforms and ladders have been built around the trunks of soaring trees, spiraling up and away out of sight.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: The silent woodland beyond the channel is covered with a thick carpet of blackish green moss covering nearly every visible inch of ground.  Magnificent trees, their branches uniting to form a dense canopy of foliage, shut out the sky above.  As the slate-colored river winds through the timbered landscape, a mist settles over the water obscuring the course ahead.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Dock]
description: Shapes emerge from the unraveling mists as a dim light begins to creep through the overhanging trees, their branches weighted with thick, heavy moss.  In the distance, a crumbling mausoleum comes into view behind a tall, wrought iron fence.  A rocky path leads away from a wooden dock at the water's edge.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Rocky Path]
description: Smooth algae-covered river rocks line a short, winding path from one dock to another beyond a gap in the ichor-covered foliage.  The trees here are wilted and withered, succumbing to whatever terrible malignancy has afflicted them.  A dilapidated rickety fishing dock barely clings to the end of a gangway beyond a battered wooden sign stained with dried blood, disappearing and reappearing in an undulating wall of hanging white mist.  Humanoid forms shift within the mist, their nature unclear.

title: [Adorned Endearment, The Point]
description: Forged metal candelabra adorn the ebonwood-planked walls of the shop, the dancing flames illuminating a vase-adorned glass display framed in dried florals and bundles of herbs.  A velvet-lined blackthorn box sits nestled between rich lengths of jewel-toned velvet, the fabric wrapping around the marble pedestal before spilling to the wooden floor.  The faint lingering scent of incense pervades between the walls, the thin tendrils of smoke dissipating across the framed sketches interspersed between the candles.

title: [Adorned Endearment, The Flesh]
description: Tall leaf-framed mirrors stand on either side of a wall-to-ceiling rack wrought into climbing ivy vines, the display set against the back wall alongside a duo of vase-set pedestals.  A lone faenor wire mannequin stands at the opposite end of the room, its base weighed down by heavy bolts of fabric dyed in deep jewel tones.  A rose-draped chandelier hovers from above, the onyx-petaled flora engulfed in long tangled vines extending across the ceiling and through the varying components of the shop.

title: [Adorned Endearment, The Curve]
description: Unfurled scrolls of pale vellum adorn the walls from floor to ceiling, the semi-translucent parchment highlighted in vibrant inks depicting various seaports of Elanthia.  A velvet-lined silvery haon box sits alongside an ebony cloisonne vase, the containers weighing down an aged map spread across a nearby ebonwood table, its surface covered in charcoal-drawn notes set within the margins.  At the far corner sits a glass-paned display, the stand encircled by fragrant bits of dried petals, the wooden frame carved in entwined ivy vines.

title: [The Art of the Drapery]
description: Metal-framed sketchings are artfully arranged along the haon-planked walls of the shop, each depicting a silhouette draped in a hand-drawn gown of charcoal and watercolors.  A velvet-padded rack wrought into a trellis of metal roses stands opposite of a vase-framed ebonwood counter, the displays both wrapped in tendrils of faenor-forged ivy.  A trio of wire-framed mannequins stand posed alongside each wall, each figure grasping a bouquet of dried flora.

title: [The Art of the Drapery, Study]
description: A glazed burgundy-black vase sits upon an ebonwood table, framed by ring-bound swatches of fabric and tiny glass vials of dye.  Various wire forms have been arranged around a velvet-padded rack, the mannequins adorned with several ribbons and affixed with tiny metal blooms.  The faint sound of a music box echoes across the room, abruptly starting and stopping at its own leisure.

title: [The Art of the Drapery, Parlor]
description: Circular glass lanterns hang from the haon-beamed ceiling, the globes engulfed by dark-toned bouquets of dried flora.  A velvet-padded rack stands against the back wall of the room, flanked by a set of vase-topped marble pedestals casting long shadows across the finely grained wood floor.  The long planks comprising the floor are speckled in black and rust-colored inks, adding dimension to the deep gouge marks across the edges.

title: [All Dogs Go To Naidem, Cottage]
description: The sharp smell of the sea permeates the air here, the scents of acrid smoke, rotten eggs, and burnt hair adding extra notes to the aroma.  Nestled into a hearth at one end of the room is a huge cauldron, the ceiling above stained black with soot.  Pushed into one corner is a water-stained wooden work table, a warped stool sitting askew in front of it, while a barnacle-covered wooden shelf is mounted above.  A discolored wooden door, its surface covered in a plethora of pinned papers covered in smudged handwriting, leads to a yard.  Much of the cottage is water-damaged, as though it has recently flooded.

title: [Both Sides Now, Central Room]
description: Divided in half symmetrically, the main room of the cottage is decorated in dark somber tones on one side and light cheerful hues on the other.  Display racks match in height and size, only their composition is different, creating a kind of opposing mirror visual.  The center has been left clear for customers to pause as they consider which half of the cottage to peruse first.  Stark torches flicker from their brackets on the shadow wall, opposed by clear, half-circle sconces glimmering parallel.

title: [Both Sides Now, Studio]
description: Disturbingly, this small alcove is a complete disparity from the main part of the cottage.  Skilled trompe-l'oeil has been applied to the walls, the rendering of clouds all around creating the despairing illusion of floating.  Fanciful designs of feathers drift here and there in hues of fuchsia, cerulean, and twilight.  Atop several clouds are playful circus scenes featuring striped tents and ferris wheels, flying pennants and strung with lanterns, but they are devoid of any customers.

title: [The Blood Red Hand]
description: Tendrils of smoky incense rise from a hammered copper bowl recessed into the ground at the heart of the shop, the cloying vapor at times sweetly scented and at others thick and noxious.  Melted candle wax drips from the rafters where hundreds of spent votives create a small graveyard that is faintly illuminated by the surviving tallows.  Midway down the wall, a rough oak shelf wraps around the room beneath a plethora of painted handprints in black, white, and blood-red hues.

title: [Buckle Up]
description: Moonlight breaks through a single, small round window, casting a gentle beam upon an awkwardly placed splintered oak bureau containing the remnants of a large rat's nest.  Several shelves line a shroud-draped wall, most of which are broken and covered with dust.  From beyond a garland-framed arch, the sounds of creaking floorboards echo throughout the area with no hint to their source.

Daylight breaks through a single, small round window, landing upon an awkwardly placed splintered oak bureau containing the remnants of a large rat's nest.  Several shelves line a shroud-draped wall, most of which are broken and covered with dust.  From beyond a garland-framed arch, the sounds of creaking floorboards echo throughout the area with no hint to their source.

title: [Cooktop Conundrums]
description: Wide windows let heat escape the small store, allowing the twilight hues of the sky to paint the whitewashed walls in ribbons of aquamarine, cerulean, coral, indigo, and violet.  Storage crates line the back wall, each with indiscernible shipping labels that curl back slightly from the rough wood.  Large display cabinets house various stoves for sale, while a plain basket on the store's only counter whispers as a slight breeze rustles the parchments within.

title: [Winterbriar Orchard]
description: Dark green hedges with rime-touched briars grow tall and thick, separating the area from the town beyond, and dozens of fruit trees grow in perfectly neat rows along one side of a wide cobblestone path.  Across the path, several cozy homes are scattered across a tree-strewn meadow and tucked amidst the edge of the hedges.  Several smaller walkways lead off the main path to more distant structures, and the main path forks widely, offering a choice between southeasterly and southwesterly.

title: [Winterbriar Grove]
description: Unnaturally dark fruit trees reach crooked branches to the sky, forming the outer rim of a dense grove of spiky, ice-covered trees that crowds the rough cobblestone pathway cutting through it.  Several riverstone structures fight for space between the grasping, twisting trees, and moonlight casts sinister shadows across the stone walls.  A light dusting of snow covers the southernmost trees.

Unnaturally dark fruit trees reach crooked branches to the sky, forming the outer rim of a dense grove of spiky, ice-covered trees that crowds the rough cobblestone pathway cutting through it.  Several riverstone structures fight for space between the grasping, twisting trees, and a few rays of sunlight push their way through to cast sickly shadows that writhe on the ground.  A light dusting of snow covers the southernmost trees.

title: [Icebriar Lake, Oblivion Lane]
description: Snow blankets the ground, almost obscuring the cobblestone path wending its way through the area.  Several almost identical houses overlook a large lake, and crimson-tipped spikes of ice bristle en masse to block all access to its frozen expanse.  Set farther back, dark vines drape over numerous smaller structures and wind around snowmen looming in the shadows.

title: [Icebriar Lake, Snowmere Way]
description: Clusters of trees thin out as they approach the lake, leaving drifts of snow surrounding numerous icy buildings.  A cobblestone pathway wends east to west, and steep banks of snow block access to the glittering frozen lake.  Dozens of ice-melded penguins swarm across a giant mound of snow, many sporting unnatural, serrated beaks holding tiny bits of flesh.

title: [Icebriar Lake, Lake's Edge]
description: Several lake houses cluster near the snow-covered banks of Icebriar Lake, while others nestle between clusters of trees set to the other side of the cobblestone path that winds along the length of the lake.  Several snowmen loom atop large drifts of snow, many wielding weapons where stick hands would normally be found.  While most of the lake's shore is inaccessible, a single icy bank appears relatively safe, albeit guarded by a squat snowman with a claidhmore.

title: [Icebriar Lake]
description: The frozen expanse of the lake stretches far and wide, the banks littered with broken remnants of docks, small boats, and other debris.  Large drifts of snow, often peppered with vicious thorns, block most access points to the lake, a sole icy bank navigable.  A small variety of structures dot the glittering surface of the lake, and a few holes are cut into the ice, revealing green-black depths.

title: [Icebriar Lake, Lodge]
description: Dark briar hedges loom behind a riverstone lodge, dozens of tiny, candelit gourds impaled on their thorns casting eerie shadows across the grounds.  In front of the lodge, a frozen lake sparkles in the starlight, and large drifts of snow block access to everything except the lodge entrances and the pathway.

Dark briar hedges loom behind a riverstone lodge, dozens of tiny, bright orange gourds impaled on their thorns.  In front of the lodge, a frozen lake glitters in the daylight, and large drifts of snow block access to everything except the lodge entrances and the pathway.

title: [Icebriar Lake, Icewild Hall]
description: A dark stone hall sits back from the frozen lake, a crescent of matching stone cottages almost buried in the snow banks along the shore.  The south shore of the lake is engulfed by a dark forest of cedars and briars, the cobblestone path ending at a dark briar arch leading deeper within.  Several hedge animals cover the snow-blanketed ground between the dark forest and the hall.

title: [Darkbriar Woods, Umbral Path]
description: Dark roots shatter a cobblestone pathway running through a dark briar arch, and thick ice coats everything except a shadowed, windy path running east to west surrounded by dense trees and briars that arch overhead, nearly blocking the sky.  Tucked between vine-wrapped oak, ash, and rowan are several smaller buildings, and narrow trails wander off the main path, disappearing in snow drifts, looming trees, and thorny bushes.

title: [Icebriar Lake, Winter's Edge]
description: Barely visible behind large drifts of cold-hardened snow, a frozen lake glitters in the ambient light.  A large riverstone manor sits on a small rise, surrounded by several outbuildings, and the cobblestone path ends abruptly at a foreboding thicket of trees and briars.  Several twisting trails lead behind the manor to additional buildings.

title: [Darkbriar Woods, Shadowed Copse]
description: Snowladen trees arch high above, casting shadows across the copse.  Several stone structures dot the depths of the woods, and several icy trails lead to additional buildings.  Icicle-fraught briars and brambles cluster together beneath the trees, the occasional frozen wild rose blossom adding a splash of color.

title: [Darkbriar Woods, Shadowed Path]
description: Dense thickets of black briars and stands of hawthorn, cedar, and birch obscure several buildings, deep snow further hindering access.  An icy cobweb spreads its lacy pattern between two winterberry bushes, something rodent-sized trapped in a glittering array of ice and webbing at its center.  Tree branches arch over the pathway, creating a canopy blocking the skies above.

title: [Darkbriar Woods, Shadowed Wilds]
description: Almost swallowed by the dark, briar-filled woods, many wooden edifices fight for life against the ice-hardened snow drifts blanketing the area.  Strings of jacinthe-hued baubles glow against the dark green cedar boughs to light up the path cutting through the woods.  Off to one side of the path, a giant ice sculpture sits, carved into the likeness of a jack-o'-lantern on a manticore's body.

Almost swallowed by the dark, briar-filled woods, many wooden edifices fight for life against the ice-hardened snow drifts blanketing the area.  Strings of jacinthe-hued baubles glow against the dark green cedar boughs to light up the path cutting through the woods.  Off to one side of the path, a giant ice sculpture sits, carved into the likeness of a jack'o'lantern on a manticore's body.

title: [Garden of Shadows]
description: Several stone buildings are set within the cultivated grounds of a large garden with trails wending this way and that off the main pathway.  Tall trees entwined with brambles and vines outline the area, the canopy overhead dense enough to cast deep shadows while still allowing just enough light for the garden to thrive.  Blue-black rosebushes climb trellises amidst ivory moonflowers, while pale pink jasmine blossoms near evening primrose, all seemingly unaffected by the chill air and massive snow drifts all around.

title: [Iceblossom Glade]
description: A ring of fragrant, snow-covered cedars holds the rest of the woods at bay, forming a large glade with a path leading deep into the southerly woods.  Iceblossoms, vibrant winterberries, and bright yellow aconite brighten the area, and snow blankets a merry-go-round in the middle of the glade.  A few buildings can be reached through neatly cleared paths in the snow.

title: [Darkbriar Woods, Haunted Bridge]
description: Dark cedars, rowan, and ash crowd together and join branches over the main path, casting eerie shadows across the area, and trails lead through the snow and underbrush to a variety of buildings.  A stream meanders to and fro with a twisting bridge arching from steep mossy bank to steep mossy bank.

title: [Darkbriar Woods, Umbral Wilds]
description: Several structures lurk between towering trees, snowbanks, and dense thorny bushes.  Briared vines twist between the tree tops, helping pull them together in a wide arch over the pathway, virtually blocking the sky from view.  The faint burbling of water drifts in from the east, and tiny, magically lit baubles are strung along the main path and icy offshoots into the woods beyond.

title: [The Ghostly Lotus]
description: Dimly lit by dusty lanterns, the tiny room is split in twain by a bead and bone curtain, its floor littered with bits of straw and chicken feathers that drift down from the thatched roof.  A rickety apothecary cabinet perches on the uneven and warped wooden floor, a scuffed wattle chest crowding at its clawed feet.  In perhaps an effort to cheer up the room, a chipped vase of mournblooms sits next to a bright orange notice.

title: [The Ghostly Lotus, Storeroom]
description: Cramped and dusty, the storeroom is essentially just a corner of the tiny hovel separated from the rest by a bead and bone curtain.  It houses a black willow desk with a mud-dotted grey stone case shoved underneath, and a single twisted candestick in a tarnished silver sconce illuminates a scrap of rough vellum.  Mithril shavings, straw, and dozens of straggly chicken feathers pile together in clumps scattered across the area, a tiny errant bone or talisman visible here and there.

title: [Darkbriar Woods, Umbral Willow]
description: The winding path through the woods ends at a giant gnarled black willow, its unnaturally dark boughs dangling wide over the clearing.  Dense briar thickets leave little room for egress except the path winding back to the east.  Rowan and birch fighting for life under the umbral willow's boughs create a few gaps in the thicket, but most look unviable as a means of escape.  Ice covers most the woods here, and deep drifts of snow pile along the path, except around a circle of bright toadstools.

title: [Winterbriar Way]
description: Snow lightly dusts the cobblestone path winding between bare-branched fruit trees and a smattering of fragrant cedars.  Down a twisting pathway are several buildings, small icicles glittering off their eaves.  To the south rests a large lake surrounded by buildings, a trellis of ice-veiled roses arching over the southwesterly path leading to it.

title: [The Witching Flower]
description: Thick, rope-like vines climb the walls of the cabin, obscuring them from view.  Large crystal vases full of flowers are gripped tight by the vegetation, covering the greenery with their colorful blossoms.  Dark green, leafy creepers cover the floor, almost engulfing a worn ivory carpet.  Pale beams of moonlight trickle through the verdant tangle growing over several opaque skylights.

Thick, rope-like vines climb the walls of the cabin, obscuring them from view.  Large crystal vases full of flowers are gripped tight by the vegetation, covering the greenery with their colorful blossoms.  Dark green, leafy creepers cover the floor, almost engulfing a worn ivory carpet.  Thin beams of sunlight trickle through the verdant tangle growing over several opaque skylights.

title: [The Witching Flower]
description: Thick tangles of leafy vines twist about, covering the walls of the small cabin.  Several tendrils creep across the ceiling, their wide lengths curling about the rough wooden beams.  A dense labyrinth of vegetation encircles a tile-inlaid wooden table that rests in the center of the room.

title: [The Witching Flower]
description: Creeping along the ceiling and walls of the room, a thick labyrinth of leafy vines creates a verdant enclosure, allowing only a series of wooden hooks to peek through.  Tendrils of greenery weave in and out, blanketing the floor and surrounding a tall oak hutch.  The foliage travels around a glass-inlaid ironwood door, a small copper handle barely visible through the massive tangle.

title: [The Cloaked Eclipse]
description: Heavily curtained glaesineth doors lead out to a rimed veranda, and swathes of silver-shot ebon velvet are draped across the walls and ceiling.  Myriad moths of arathiel and aragless hang from moonlight-hued ribbons of lotus silk, framing a series of copper cloak pegs.  Dangling from a veniom wire, a moth-embossed parchment floats above a star-carved amethyst case.

title: [Cloaked Eclipse, Kaleidoscope]
description: Cheerfully painted forest and meadow scenes cover the walls, each image lush with florals and greenery and tiny fawns cavorting with butterflies.  Numerous kaleidoscopes of lyshaelyn butterflies on sunshine yellow ribbons twine about a series of copper hooks, and an ebon marble mannequin sits in a jadewood-carved corner bower.  Glittering in the ambient light, a prismatic velvet curtain leads deeper within the shop.

title: [Collectors' Calamity]
description: Whitewashed walls reflect the twilight-hues of the Naidem sky as it bleeds into the small cottage through dirt-stained windows devoid of curtains.  Rough oak floorboards creak at regular intervals, though no one can be seen moving through the space as a cool draft sets trinkets dangling from the ceiling to swaying.  Tidy shelves line the eastern wall from floor to ceiling, while the western wall houses a glass-fronted display case that sparkles with violet hues.

title: [Conjured Couture]
description: A floor-to-ceiling chandelier of leaf-framed flora casts illuminated silhouettes against the blade-haloed rack set along the back wall, the display caught between twin tapestries of devore velvet, the heavy fabric pooling across the haon-planked floor.  In the center of the shop sits a rectangular glass tray nestled across the palm of a tall hand-carved display of bleached driftwood, the appendage covered in pyrographed sigils.  A yellow-eyed grey cat sits before several branch-framed mirrors to the left of the room, its reflection warped across the smooth surface.

title: [The Witch's Garden]
description: Lattices of dried liana vines cover the stone walls of the cottage, the entangled tendrils clinging to the corners of the apothecary table, which is covered in dried bundles of herbs and various gardening tools.  A duo of black cats lounge beneath the vine-draped table, kneading slowly across a fringed tartan blanket, then disappearing amongst a series of clay pots scattered across the ground.  Several leafy florals grow in a soil-filled cauldron  sits upon a low-set stool by an open window, the faint sounds of buzzing emanating between the blossoms.

title: [The Witch's Garden, Adorn]
description: Wood-framed sketches of local fauna decorate the vine-covered walls of the room, the drawings framing several vividly colored flowers in a soil-filled wide clay jar resting on a small wooden stool.  A pyrographed black willow chest sits open before a leaf-etched mirror, the celestial-decorated container filled with various pieces of clothing and small knickknacks cradled within the quilted interior.  A pudgy grey dormouse darts in and out of each component of the shop, gazing in curiosity before disappearing back behind a vellum-paneled partition.

title: [Tippy Toes, Entry]
description: A richly carved mahogany carriage loaded with wooden trunks and wicker baskets is parked in the middle of the high-ceilinged foyer.  To the north, an archway separates the tack and equipment storage area from the living quarters beyond.  The fragrant scent of hay mingled with oiled leather hovers in the chill air.

title: [Tippy Toes, Living Quarters]
description: A pair of high-backed chairs separated by a low table huddle in front of a dark stone fireplace, the dying embers of a fire glowing within.  Along one grey-striped, papered wall sits a sturdy oaken sideboard with open drawers, its contents neat and orderly.  Tucked away beneath a narrow stairway, wooden bins full of colorful bits of fabric are nearly hidden from view.

title: [Icewild Hall, Night Garden]
description: Nestled behind a stone wall between Icewild Hall and its carriage house, the unusually warm garden overflows with greenery, flourishing in the moonlight.  A cobblestone path surrounded by several ghost ferns leads to a small stone cottage, and a wild array of fragrant night phlox wraps about overflowing herb beds.   Vines of ivy, moonflower, and star jasmine wind across the surrounding stonework, edges icing over as they encroach upon the colder climes away from the garden.

A cobblestone path surrounded by several ghost ferns leads to a small stone cottage, and a wild array of fragrant night phlox wraps about overflowing herb beds.   Vines of ivy, moonflower, and star jasmine wind across the surrounding stonework, edges icing over as they encroach upon the colder climes away from the garden.

title: [Covert Creatures]
description: Numerous glass-encased bug displays hang from the polished stone walls of the cottage, interspersed with fishing nets holding aquatic specimens.  Arathiel-inset lanterns cast bright light across a silver rack and a copper and velvet mannequin, and a pair of quartz moth statues flank a fuzzy yellow-striped black velvet curtain.  Hiding in the shadows of one corner, a jade butterfly-inset case perches on a tentacle-legged stone table next to a silver-framed parchment.

title: [Derelict Abbey, Nave]
description: The long epoch of neglect that ensued after the majority of the Sisters of Perpetual Abeyance moved on to other pursuits has not been kind to the interior of the abbey.  Surrounded by an arch-roofed cloister, the drafty nave welcomes curious visitors eager for souvenirs of the order's heyday with offerings neatly exhibited atop a crowded catafalque and in a rectangular willow basket stacked with fastidiously penned documents.  To the south, a windchime fashioned of mismatched keys jingles tinnily from its home above an ivy-besieged transept leading to the refectory.

title: [Filigree and Whorls]
description: Paint splatters the walls, ceiling, and floors of the small shop, though surprisingly leaves the furnishings untouched.  Picture frames decorate the splattered walls, each supporting blank canvases that are almost too bright for the space.  Lanterns hang over a long wooden counter where wrought iron hooks keep various masks on display.

title: [Illusory Dreams, Entryway]
description: A variety of twilight and celestial-themed knickknacks adorn the walls and decorate the fabrics chosen for this shop.  A narrow window with drawn moon and stars curtains adorns the eastern wall.  Empty doorframes leading into other rooms hint at this building's previous function as a house, although it is unclear how long ago the conversion took place.

title: [Illusory Dreams, West]
description: Old wooden floors creak underfoot in this small room.  An assortment of toadstool lanterns adorn the room's walls, each providing a steady celestial blue glow that illuminates its surroundings.  A large locked armoire rests forgotten in one corner.

title: [Illusory Dreams, South]
description: A massive glass cabinet filled with pottery and porcelain cookware occupies one wall, too large to remove through the small doorways and also too nice to destroy.  A large oak heirloom table occupies the center of the room, and a glass vase filled with flowers in various shades of blue rests atop it.  These remaining pieces of furniture hint at the room's former purpose as a dining hall.

title: [Illusory Dreams, Southwest]
description: Bundles of dried herbs hang from a wall next to patinated copper pots and above a soot-covered fire stove.  The musky aroma of dried rosemary and day-old baked bread lingers in the air.

title: [Flasked with a Purpose]
description: A thick curtain of star jasmine blankets the crypt's cobbled stone walls, offering a touch of color to an otherwise gloomy area.  Empty bottles repurposed into candle holders line the floors amidst large globs of melted wax and beetle carapaces.  Centered in the room is a nondescript stone platform supporting a large iron urn decorated in carved grape clusters.

title: [Flightless Dragonfly]
description: Dark glaes windows, their surfaces carved into a dimensional diamond relief, shield the room from the much of the external light, as well as curiosity from passersby.  Empty cobwebs drape across faded black fel walls, their lengths nearly concealing several deep recesses framed in mildewed plaster.  Centered upon an ornate rug covered in layers of soot and dust, is an ebon sarcophagus surrounded by large white pillar candles lofted on wrought iron stands.

title: [The Four Humours, Entry]
description: Cozy but elegant, the polished wooden walls of this room are partially covered by two tapestries, one water-stained and one moldy, hanging from the ceiling.  A glass-fronted display cabinet is a focal point of the space, its clawed feet resting upon a tasseled throw rug beneath it.  Set in an open corner is a wide silver tray, the instruments scattered across its surface well within reach of a hard wooden stool and the black leather chair in front of it.  The faint scent of blood lingers in the air.

title: [Glisten and Gleam]
description: A pair of windows at the front of the store offers a view of the street outside and the tiny auroral starflowers blooming in the window boxes.  A worn wooden counter topped with a fraying silk-lined tray stretches nearly the full back wall of the cottage, while a moth-eaten velvet-cushioned glass gem case is stationed on one side of the shop and a unicorn-embossed shiny gold plate atop a slender stand is on the other.  A scrap paper note scrawled in childish handwritting is tacked to the front of the counter.

title: [Within Harm's Reach]
description: A glimmering green glow courses through large, densely intertwined roots overhead, revealing a circular, hard-packed dirt floor edged with fiery red-yellow toadstools.  Dirt walls glisten from above-ground snowmelt, and the warm, humid air in this half-sphere hollow carries hints of acrid mud.  Beneath some severed hook-ended roots, a gnarled knife block and a lacquered live-edge root bowl sit atop a flat-topped petrified toadstool.

title: [Beyond the Graver]
description: Carved jack-o'-lanterns flicker with an eerie yellow-green light in a semicircle along the circumference of the short, battered wooden interior walls of this tiny hut.  Shadows dance across the remnants of a stained wooden workbench and a gouged patchwork table in the center of the space, clearly abandoned long ago.  Indiscernible whispers echo throughout the hut, or maybe it is just a passing wind forcing its way through the gaps in its thatched roof.
