title: [Goblin King Dolls, Foyer]
description: Chipped, pale pink, raised panels enclose this entrance hall with sliding doors closing off the two side rooms to the east and west.  Sideboards have been pressed up against the mold-coated walls around a round center table, each surface holding various dolls.  A wide set of stairs leads up to a small landing where a single door sits.  Broken, unadorned dolls hang from miniature nooses from the railings.

title: [Goblin King Dolls, Landing]
description: Shattered porcelain litters the floor, and the wood frame, walls, and flooring around the door are blackened with a mix of soot and mold.  The layout of this upstairs landing has been mostly walled off.  There are no windows, hallways, or other doors here.  Shelves staggered, hung across the eastern wall, are home to more dolls.

title: [Smoldereye Lodge]
description: The ground floor of the tower is paneled in roughly hewn dark hardwoods and smooth, exposed riverstone.  Thousands of tiny facets of glimmering saewehna gems stud the ceiling overhead, arranged in patterns of constellations.  A thick engraved modwir shelf full of books runs along a section of the wall.  Arranged atop a massive tanik dresser are a mithril necklace stand and an engraved mistwood jewelry box.  A small curio cabinet displays a gold-banded keepsake chest.

title: [The Gnome Depot, Entry]
description: Framed and hung from the dirt-packed walls are several elaborately drawn illustrations of various contraptions, their faded and smudged water-damaged lines reinforced with newer blue ink.  The wooden floor creaks with the slightest movement, tainting the hypnotic sound of the gears moving in perfect cadence within the large haon clock against the back wall.  Directly across from an elaborate system of roots stands a neatly stocked spacious cabinet.

title: [The Gnome Depot, Cognition]
description: The large, gear-shaped chandelier bounces light off of the bronze door, bathing the room in a dark golden hue.  A dark-stained rowan armoire looms in the far end of the room, casting a shadow in the corner.  Covering the eastern wall is a tapestry depicting a Burghal gnome holding a small trinket.

title: [The Gouged Heart, Entrance]
description: Small flecks of sawdust float in the air, catching in the ambient light of the smithy.  Cobbled walls, lined with small iron bins full of forging glyphs, form a domed lid atop the cramped space.  Next to an umber velvet curtain, a scarred wooden table hold a small set of woodworking tools, with a small set of discarded wooden blocks piled to one side.

Small flecks of sawdust float in the air, catching in the ambient light of the smithy.  Cobbled walls, lined with small iron bins full of forging gylphs, form a domed lid atop the cramped space.  Next to an umber velvet curtain, a scarred wooden table hold a small set of woodworking tools, with a small set of discarded wooden blocks piled to one side.

title: [The Gouged Heart, Workroom]
description: An umber velvet curtain opens into a small workroom; a set of workbenches pushed to one side for ease of use.  A latticework chair sits before a small desk, its thin legs marking lines in the wooden shavings that cover the floor.  Tucked beside the desk, an assortment of papers has haphazardly stuffed into a haon box.

title: [House of Twilight]
description: Curls of once decadent wallpaper are abandoning the wall in several places, leaving bare wood beneath, and cobwebs span every corner.  An archway, staircase, and door at the rear of the foyer are roped off, but a lintel-capped mistwood door stands open off to the side, framed on one side by a repurposed coat rack laden with harnesses and an old nail barrel with a plank top on the other.  A hastily written note is attached to the barrel, a small sign is attached to the rack, and a very large parchment notice hangs directly above a massive hole in the floor.

title: [A Neatly Dug Rectangular Grave]
description: Apparently, this is a relatively deep hole, six feet deep and seven feet long by reckoning, seemingly rectangular in shape rather like...a grave.  It's a grave.  The size and dimensions, hard pack of the dirt, the precise cut of the walls, vertical and slightly intimidating from this angle, give it away.  Yep.  This is a grave.

title: [The Witching House, Foyer]
description: Glossy ebonwood floors stretch out from the door and across the room, with matching furniture that sits against walls with forest green, satin-sheened paper with an upper edging of onyx vines near the crown molding.  Ahead and slightly to the right is a satin cord-barred staircase, while a heavy ebonwood door has been placed beneath the railing on the side of the staircase.  To the left of the entrance is a wide ebonwood arch adorned with silver-drawn violet silk curtains that leads into a study, and another archway at the rear of the foyer offers a view of what must be a formal dining room.

title: [The Witching House, Laboratory]
description: A shallow set of steps lead down into the laboratory, its surroundings less bland than one might expect of an underground room.  The walls are lined with ebonwood panels, with an embroidered silk tapestry decorating one large area, while an ebonwood apothecary cabinet dominates nearly the entirety of the back wall.  Opposite the cabinet is a sturdy glass-topped worktable and a long silver-wrought shelf hung high enough above to accommodate all of the alchemical tools beneath.  Between the end of the worktable and the steps that lead out is a round side table with a a black parchment note scribed in silver ink propped atop it.

title: [Icewild Hall, Foyer]
description: The long, dark length of the Hall is punctuated here and there with floating globes of blue-lit glass.  A white carpet, its edges bound in silver wire, runs the length of the room, filling the space between a pair of large wooden doors and a glassy marble-keystoned arch.  Between the two portals, there is little furniture, though the bubbles of blue light do illuminate several pieces of statuary.

title: [Icewild Hall, Solarium]
description: A fine drift of snow freezes the flags underfoot, their stony faces rimed with frost.  High above, the glass panes of a silvery iron-framed dome are half broken and half missing.  Powder collects on the furniture below, including a table and desk, both of which are covered in heavy folds of concealing green velvet.  A glass globe, floating and lit up with a bluish light, hangs in the middle of the chamber.  A marble arch is set into one wall, and a gilded door into another.

title: [Luck of the Draw, Tricks]
description: The shop's interior is plastered with loud and garish wallpaper in alternating stripes of banana yellow and pumpkin orange, blessedly hidden for the most part behind large posters boasting feats of wonder, both hilarious and grotesque.  Along the back wall is a short counter topped with candy jars and flower vases, while a brightly painted shelf hangs above it.  A fanned card rack sits front and center on a white-clothed table in the middle of the area.

title: [Luck of the Draw, Chance]
description: With decor that could be deemed visually offensive to anyone with eyes, an oval chartreuse takes center stage at the heart of the room, and a wooden table with four mismatched legs, each of a different color, sits directly in the middle.  An old fruit crate painted over with obnoxiously bright colors that appear to have dried clumps sits beneath the table, and at the rear of the room is an arched door.

title: [The Familiar Phantom]
description: Stained glass globes illuminate the curtain-covered shop, the tiny votives dancing within the spheres as they cast shadows across a fine-grained haon display nestled between twin cages of pewter wire.  Leather-bound volumes lay open across a circular table in the center of the room, the bestiaries' illustrations replicated in sketchings pinned to the vertical planks comprising the walls.  Faint howls and chirps seem to emanate from a group of talismans hung on the far wall, fading into the din of the shop.

title: [Masqued Intentions, Entry]
description: Pallets made of wood are arranged in an orderly fashion against an opposite wall, illuminated by the dim light coming in through a window that has been fogged over.  Barren walls and broken furniture show signs of wear and neglect, with several pieces in multiple stages of disrepair.  Several porcelain masks are strung from some luxurious black silk ribbon affixed to an oak beam erected into the ceiling, while a small stone stairwell leads down to a basement below.

title: [Masqued Intentions, West Room]
description: The creme-colored walls stained with water damage stand in stark contrast to the dark wood of the rafters overhead.  A lamp rests in the corner casting an ambient light across the room, while tufts of vegetation can occasionally be seen through a makeshift floor.  Several chairs covered in white sheets have been pushed around, creating a small maze leading to a series of makeshift tables lined up against the walls dressed in faded purple and mauve linens.

title: [Moorlyn Cottage, Entryway]
description: The narrow hallway is paneled in dark wood, and the ceiling and upper walls are painted a rich, dark green, so dark as to be almost black.  Long thick carpets, red and blue and cream co-mingled, run along the wooden floors.  From above, a single stained glass shade casts a warm and colorful light.  A staircase leads up to a higher floor, and a doorway and an archway branch off of the entryway, leading deeper into the cottage.

title: [Moorlyn Cottage, Dining Room]
description: The bright white light of a low-hanging chandelier is muted some by its etched and frosted globes, the whole assemblage hanging low over a squared oak dining table.  While the glass-fronted cupboards that line the room display a collection of fine silver and porcelain, the table itself is unset, and is covered with a pile of papers and ledgers.  A swinging door leads elsewhere, a pair of glass double doors lead outside into a courtyard, and a narrow archway leads into the entryway of the cottage.

title: [Moorlyn Cottage, Den]
description: A well-used fireplace, several comfortable leather armchairs, and a wide carpet of geometrically patterned silk are the only signs this room serves, in the off-hours, as part of a home.  It is otherwise laden with wares, which are draped over racks and displayed on mannequins, folded into baskets, and overflowing out of boxes and shelves.  A single wide doorway is almost lost amongst the excess.

title: [The Other Daughter, Ingress]
description: Candles lit with flickering light overwhelm the majority of the floor space and sit in sconces and niches set along the wall, often with nary a scrap of space between each taper.  The flames regularly splutter out, victims of an ever-present chilly draft, but quickly spring back to life, as if the mausoleum's four stately coffins are unable to bear lingering for too long in darkness.  Barely visible in the warm illumination, hints of a violet glow suffuse thin fissures along the walls.

title: [The Other Daughter, Entry Vault]
description: Dark stone walls are infested along multitudinous cracks with a bright violet luminescence, its glow so vibrant as to faintly illuminate the majority of the dank, damp space.  Dripping down from the decrepit ceiling and oozing across the floor, viscous fluids and goo intermingle with scattered, nondescript bones, broken glass, and, in one corner, a collection of oversized rat's nests.  In the midst of it all, four candle-topped coffins offer a neatly laid out selection of curious oddities.

title: [Shadowplay]
description: Gleaming dark silk woven with climbing roses is draped over the ashen stone walls of the cool, tapered chamber.  The cobblestone flooring widens into a half-moon toward the back, highlighting an austere pale monir ambry lit by gently curled ironworked sconces filled with ivory candles.  Nestled into a removed corner, a carved heart of ebony cabinet sits on a lush burgundy carpet with satin tassels.  The delicate scents of petrichor and incense smoke elusively linger in the air.

title: [Preserving Breads]
description: Warm and dimly lit, the small store smells of fresh baked breads, fragrant herbs, and a hint of firewood.  The cobblestone walls support a series of floor-to-ceiling shelves along the windowless eastern side, the well-made structures spanning the entire space, while a stucco and brick corner fireplace is opposite.  Mosaic tiles surround the fireplace in an expanding ring that invades the hardwood floors.  Occupying the center of the space, a broad brick red barn door table is laden with the shop's offerings.

title: [Wild Flailings]
description: Hand-crafted forms of vivid paper and parchment hang from mahogany beams above, both festooned man and mammal suspended by hooks of spiraled metal.  An arboreal display of stained glass branches stands in the center of the shop, the splayed ends decorated with silken leaves dyed metallic jade and emerald.  Nestled in the back corner of the room is a carved driftwood octopus, its arms raised upwards at the ceiling, each curled around a colorful wooden stick.

An arboreal display of stained glass branches stands in the center of the shop, the splayed ends decorated with silken leaves dyed metallic jade and emerald.  Nestled in the back corner of the room is a carved driftwood octopus, its arms raised upwards at the ceiling, each curled around a colorful wooden stick.

title: [Vigil's End, Tranquil Point]
description: Grey tones wash the neighborhood with a persistent dreariness and dull the pastels of burgeoning blossoms adorning every home.  Like a fluffy, ashen pink cloud floating at the base of the hill, flowering cherry trees separate the houses from tiered rows of buildings rising to a distant peak.  Glowing pale orange windows break the gloom of their cinereous facades.  A half-timbered stucco shop with a steeply pitched roof sits at an angle at the corner of the bifurcated, cobblestone street.

title: [The Final Iteration]
description: The once luxurious furnishings of the store have been overtaken by a massive assortment of spare parts, bent pieces of metal, and clusters of junk.  Dozens of pots and planters house the remains of dead vegetation in various states of decay; not a single leaf bears even a hint of greenery.  A rune-carved dark ironwood door leads to the work room in the back of the shop.

title: [Vigil's End, Tulip Fields]
description: Wide, rotating stripes of homochromous tulips, desaturated by dim ambient light, horizontally stretch across the steeply inclined earth.  A slender, cobbled trail zigzags through the muted, efflorescent rainbow, cutting past the smattering of quaint cottages staggered along its path.  Halfway up the hillside, whimsical glaesine windchimes dangle from the rafters of a latticed pergola extending off the side of a haon-shingled bungalow.

title: [Nether and Void]
description: Lacquered planks of pitch black ebonwood cover the walls of the cottage, the wood carved in stylized calligraphy around a series of sigils filled with gilded ink.  A pentagram of dark-colored flora hovers over a cluster of wood-carved forms, the metal frame suspended by thick rings of blackened iron wrapped in dark emerald ivy, each tendril snaking across a melted candle set at each point.  A faint reddish black haze rises from beneath the haon floor, seeping through the boards before dissipating into a fine mist.

title: [Vigil's End, Armistice Avenue]
description: Perpendicular to the stone road, a narrow shiplap building spans the back edge of an archery range.  Round targets form an orderly line at the far end, their faces deeply pierced by arrows and spilling straw from old wounds.  Enclosing the grassy yard, a low wattle fence offers an unobstructed view of a sprawling ruin within the trees to the north, the dilapidated state a stark contrast to the neighboring picturesque streets.

title: [Rack 'Em Up, Lounge]
description: Layers of tanned animal hide cover all the walls and windows of this building.  The rooms are sectioned off by elk horn arches held up by whitewashed wooden beams that are covered with bloodstains.  At the center peak of the room dangles a chandelier of skulls that are decorated with a mix of horns and candles, the wax coating everything and dripping down onto a table below.

title: [Vigil's End, Ruins]
description: Toppled, vine-choked columns, crumbling ogee arches, and shattered limestone tiles serve as the last vestiges of an expansive, derelict structure.  Stone steps, pulverized to resemble a ribbed ramp, descend off the northern edge to a shallowly flooded path.  The glassy surface reflects the image of bare-boned trees hazed green with emerging buds, their gnarled roots obstacles to the waterlogged door tucked into the cracked base of the ruins.

title: [Kreapy's Krawliez]
description: Pumpkin orange and sickly green light bathes the musty space in a lurid glow.  Stuffed with grotesque specimens, illumed preservative jars line the mildewed shelves spanning the back wall.  Water stagnates in the deep lines of a summoning circle gouged into the limestone floor before a swollen mangrove altar.  Fractured under the weight of the low, faulty ceiling, an ogee arch frames a dark opening, wispy cobwebs clinging to the corners.

title: [Vigil's End, Flooded Path]
description: Thick perse vines meanderingly creep up a tilted sandstone watchtower, the image evocative of grasping tentacles dragging it deeper into the sodden earth.  A stained and tattered white banner, emblazoned with a faded aquamarine wave crest, drapes limply from the fractured parapet.  Overflow from the nearby stream drowns the surrounding grass and spills rust-hued water onto the winding cobblestone road.

title: [Rub-a-dub-dub, Entry]
description: Water seeps from sandstone block walls creating murky pools on a packed dirt floor, while a variety of basins and tubs collect water dripping from the high ceiling.  Draped from a thick beam overhead, a canvas tarpaulin shields a grey driftwood cabinet, keeping the linens within dry.  A clothesline is strung from an aged oak mantel, a pair of socks dangling just beyond the reach of the flames from a modest fire.

title: [Rub-a-dub-dub, Stairway]
description: Warped and rotting from constant water damage, the spiraling stairway winds up and up to a trapdoor in the ceiling overhead.  A collection of glass jars and clay pots are stacked on narrow shelves that line the sandstone walls, while myriad tubs, basins, and buckets hang from some rusty hooks.  Torches lighting the stairway splutter and sizzle as water droplets threaten to cast the treacherous flight into darkness.

title: [Vigil's End, Rocky Hillside]
description: Organically terraced by jagged, layered shale protrusions, the earth climbs northerly in a steep acclivity.  Brightly flowered groundcover blankets the treacherous terrain, their roots forcefully emerging from between the sheets of sedimentary rock.  Trimmed in an invar-braced marble arch, a fissure rends one of the short cliffs.  Under the meager shade offered by sparsely leaved trees, the asperous road, fraught with gaping cracks, picks a strategic path through the multitudinous hazards.

title: [Don't Bug Me!, Showroom]
description: Beyond the irregularly edged fissure that marks the entrance to this torch-lit space, the striated rock walls open up to reveal a modestly sized cave lined with iron shelving.  Moisture glistens off the walls and floor, dancing with scintillating sparkles as the reflected torchlight moves sinuously with the fluctuating passage of incoming air.

title: [The Final Iteration, Stamped]
description: Abutting the main room of the shop, this small side parlor is paneled with pale white oak planks.  A scorched dark modwir counter divides the room in half.  Threadbare cobalt rugs barely cover the scorch marks on portions of the flooring.

title: [Vigil's End, Armistice Avenue]
description: Soot streaks down the exterior of a a compact brick smithy attached to an open, wood-framed workspace cluttered with racks of unfinished weaponry, unrefined armor, and countless rafter-hung tools.  Dark smoke billows from the chimney jutting out of the angled roof, fed by a smoldering forge.  On the opposite side of the street, surrounded by tricolor hydrangea, a modestly sized riverstone barracks stands beside a packed dirt training yard.

title: [Ironmonger's Smithy, Salon]
[Ironmonger's Smith, Salon]
description: Walnut bookshelves fill every wall making this narrow shop with a low ceiling a bit claustrophobic.  Though carpeted, the floor creaks and groans with every step.  Between two of the bookcases, a side door opens out to an open-air scrapyard.  A little more exploration reveals an almost hidden set of stairs that leads up to another space above.  A large casement window offers a view of the street outside next to the salon's threshold.

title: [Ironmonger's Smithy, Office]
[Ironmonger's Smith, Office]
description: This windowless office is cloaked in shadow except for a bright candle on a chest-high desk in the center of the room.  Illuminated by the golden flame, a nearby stand lays bare the interior of a thick tome.  Barely discernible cabinets stand around the desk, their presence hinted at by the flicker of the candle's flame.  A shadow of the desk wavers on the carpeted floor from the dancing candlelight.  Almost invisible in the darkness, a set of stairs offers a way down.

title: [Ironmonger's Smithy, Scrapyard]
[Ironmonger's Smith, Scrapyard]
description: Several giantman-tall piles of discarded weapons and armor construct a hazardous maze within this open-air scrapyard.  A forge smolders away along the edge of the soot-stained red bricks of the adjoined smithy within arm's reach of an anvil accompanied by a tempering trough and grinder.  Assorted tools hang from a rafter set above the anvil.  A side door leads into the towering two-story building on the yard's eastern side.

title: [Vigil's End, Armistice Avenue]
description: Multihued banners embellished with various crests are proudly displayed beneath the eaves on the architectural hodgepodge of houses.  Adding to the pops of color that enliven the grey-cast street, planter boxes teem with muted blue vinca, sweet alyssum, and sanguine-stained coleus.  Wooden crates, washed blue and stamped with a silver oak, sit stacked beside the smeared, many-paned window of a squat shop set between prickly, leafless hawthorn trees.

title: [Any Way You Wand It]
description: A thin haze of yellow-green smoke drifts lazily through the area, originating from the brims of several open beakers stacked upon a high shelf that runs along the back wall.  A tall ironwood rack is home to several belts and harnesses, while resting near a small black velvet-lined case.

title: [Vigil's End, Armistice Avenue]
description: Hanging ivy drapes like a veil from the terraces of the numerous homes populating the street, dripping crimson-throated flowers down their plaster exteriors.  Iron-caged lanterns hang from posts scattered along a path that cleaves its way through trees in varying stages of rebirth, leading up the hillside to an austere, circular limestone keep.  From the summit, the lofty structure looms forebodingly over the grey-tinted neighborhood.

Hanging ivy drapes like a veil from the terraces of the numerous homes populating the street, dripping crimson-throated flowers down their plaster exteriors.  Iron-caged lanterns hang from posts scattered along a path that cleaves its way through trees in varying stages of rebirth, leading up the hillside to an austere, rectangular limestone keep.  From the summit, the lofty structure looms forebodingly over the grey-tinted neighborhood.

title: [Vigil's End, Armistice Avenue]
description: Towering over the broad pathway, an umbrageous oak sunders the cobblestones with eruptions of knotted roots.  A slatted ramp winds around the tree, its handrails ensnared in curling, wayward tendrils of spined vines strangling the enormous trunk.  Trimmed to boxy shapes, blossomed azalea bushes edge the residences lining the road.  Vibrantly painted wood shields trim the wraparound porch of a turreted brick house overlooking the blushed, floriated canopy to the south.

title: [Fiendish Phantomes, Athenaeum]
description: Massive open space has been hollowed out into the core of this tree, creating an interior pavilion with multiple arched outlets that peer deeper, through the tree's branches.  Carved into the oak walls of this dome are floor-to-ceiling bookshelves trimmed with faenor metalwork, each one depicting different vegetation.  The worn floor is covered in omnifarious parchments and half-torn books that are blanketed with dust and webbing.

title: [Fiendish Phantomes, Study]
description: Stacks of thick books tower thirteen feet up and surround an armless, high back wing chair that has been placed perfectly centered within a blood-drawn pentagram.  High above, draped across the tome peaks, are tattered flyrsilk curtains that envelop the area in sheer waves of fabric.

title: [Vigil's End, Briar Patch]
description: Leafy, overhanging boughs cast shadows upon the countless brambles arching over one another to form perilously thorned domes.  Almost hidden by the natural camouflage, a stygian opening creates a break in the tangles of sharp-toothed briars.  A precarious, cobbled path dives southerly toward a stacked stone archway, the unattached portal framing a golden scene that brightens in comparison to the oppressive darkness enclosing the world before it.

title: [Vigil's End, Encampment]
description: Skeletal remains of sizeable domed tents, some collapsed into haphazard piles of dry-rotted wood, are arranged in clusters across the roadside field.  Decaying furs and splintered kegs litter the exposed interiors.  Parched, sand-hued grasses obscure deserted, rusty weapons and reveal the occasional glint of a glaes armband.  Only a timeworn leather tent and a crooked hide-wrapped shelter stand intact, set on opposite sides of a burned-out firepit.

title: [Vigil's End, Legion Lane]
description: Weatherbeaten fences section off pastures in the sage green fields, patchy with amorphous pockets of sanguine flowers slicked wet by dew.  A decaying, beaded pony harness hangs from a hitching post adjacent to the double doors leading into a dark red stable with low windows.  White beams cross the gapped facade, the paint chipped enough to reveal the natural wood grain.  Finely ground gravel, bursting with prickly weeds, lays a path to the small stone lodge set back from the road.

title: [Vigil's End, Legion Lane]
description: Gnarled, fruitless orchards stretch behind the moldering frames of ruinous houses, shrouded by smoke curling from the orange embers tucked within the wreckage.  A blackened cottage, a stalwart survivor observing the still smoldering scene, stands defiantly beside a ramshackle stand with a slashed canvas canopy.  Facedown in the churned mud between widely spaced cobblestones, a wooden doll in tattered clothing lies abandoned before a gouge-riddled storefront.

title: [Vigil's End, Legion Lane]
description: Shadowed silhouettes of vultures roost within the knotty branches of an immense elm, a suit of lichen-encrusted armor slumped against the trunk.  Glass shards glitter in the weeds beneath the jagged-edged windows of a thatched roof bakery.  Nestled in brick and shingle rubble, a blackened boulder takes up residence within the adjacent destroyed shop.  Arrowheads and discarded weaponry sprinkle the muddied road with corroded debris.

title: [Vigil's End, Legion Lane]
description: Evenly spaced along the eerily quiet road, lampposts with cracked glass panes fail to provide any warm illumination.  The only vibrancy in this dark place comes from the burnt orange oxidization enveloping the iron bars in the sparse windows of a sturdy grime-smeared jail.  A bearded axe is buried deep in a stained execution block atop the platform of a wooden gallows.  From the weathered wood crossbeam, a trio of nooses hangs over the open trap door.

title: [Vigil's End, Legion Lane]
description: Smoke lingers in the air, thinly veiling clusters of charred homes with a grey haze.  Splintered wood boards up the windows, pale yellow light escaping from the cracks.  Threadbare banners adorn the eaves of a long slate-roofed house with a stone facade peaked by stepped gables.  Laden with decomposing burlap sacks, a toppled rickety cart sprawls before the porch, scattering rotten apricots across the mud-swept cobblestones.

title: [Vigil's End, Legion Lane]
description: Almost nothing man-made has survived here, the buildings merely empty, broken shells of their former selves.  Virid moss patches and blooming ivy climb over the scorched stones of the crumbling homes as nature reclaims its territory.  The stench of decaying flesh suffocates any delicate notes from the surrounding verdure, emanating from an enormous, blood red corpse flower blossoming in the half-shattered carapace of a bisected two-story house.

title: [Vigil's End, Legion Lane]
description: Behind a verdant veil of untamed cattails, a slender, gently babbling streamlet wends alongside the path.  Tawny silt runoff bleeds into the gaps between stepping stones and dapples the pitted rock with clay-infused puddles.  The wild grasses have been hacked away, clearing a sopping track to a circular bark-shingled hut with a thatched river reed dome.  Twin torches burn on either side of the gashed sailcloth curtain covering the doorway.

title: [Rack 'Em Up, Drying Room]
description: Long-forgotten carcasses are left to hang from hooks across a large beam of wood.  Fragile fragments of dried muscle and tendons keep the whole of the skeletal forms.  A musty and blackened bear hide rug covers the floor, its thick fur badly matted and flea-infested.

title: [Rack 'Em Up, Slaughter Room]
description: Two wooden tables create an "L" shape in the northeastern corner of the room.  The surfaces seeped in a viscous, black ichor that emits a putrid stench in the air.  Half-taxidermied animals are strewn across the room, their pelts molding away in patches that expose the skeletal frame beneath.  A large statue of a grizzly bear standing on its hind legs stands eight feet tall near the table with a claw holding onto a basket.

title: [The Witching Family Vault]
description: Within the hallowed walls of the massive vault lie a pair of black marble tombs nestled into two shallow depressions in the floor, both carved into elven figures lying in repose.  Silver sconces set high on the walls flank the tombs, while a black iron candelabra stands lit between them.

title: [A. B. Witching, Tinkering]
description: Though subterranean, the chamber has been decorated to conceal that fact, with two walls lined with floor-to-ceiling witchwood bookcases, while the others are covered with a deep forest green wallpaper lined with thin stripes of metallic bronze.  Sconces are mounted meticulously at regular intervals between the lines, set with ivory candles that glow with viridian-sparked golden flames.  A narrow glass-shelved rack, with a witchwood humidor on the top shelf, stands beside a set of steep stairs leading downward.

title: [All Fingers And No Crumbs]
description: Cozy and tiny, the structure appears to be part shop and part workshop.  Brightly lit copper lanterns line the northern wall providing illumination for a long workbench covered in hand drills, screwdrivers, planers, and sandpaper, the telltale signs of a wood carver littering the floor in the form of curls of wood and sawdust.  Conversely, there seems to be an invisible line where the wood shop ends and a pristine shop begins.  A cloth-covered low display table and a wide wicker hamper of wares rest upon a small rug.

title: [Rodnir's Bait and Tackle]
description: Patchwork walls form an irregularly shaped interior of rotted wooden planks and warped beams, the floor equally buckled and uneven around a battered wooden rack held in place by moss that has grown through in thick patches.  Thatched vines and brambles glisten with streaks of ichor and damp blood, their jagged thorns and hardened spines jutting downward from the ceiling.  Sagging dangerously low in the center of the room, a rotting ichor-covered crate dangles from a series of knotted cables.

title: [A Burning Desire, Storefront]
description: A variety of scents waft throughout the room, a mixture of jasmine, lavender, and vanilla incense burning in brass sconces scattered throughout the space.  A polished cabinet made of maoral stands adjacent to a three-legged granite table that has several lamps atop it.  Flickering in the lantern light, small wisps of ecru smoke tease the dried herbs that hang from the rafters.

title: [A Burning Desire, Office]
description: Atop a small desk, several boxes filled with various powders leave a strong, indescribable combinations of scents in the small, cramped office.  On a small silver cart, a set of mithril measuring tools and glass vials for mixing await further blending sessions.  Small flyrsilk pillows line the sides of the office, leaving the lone chair next to the desk the only suitable seating for work.

title: [Shadowplay, Hall]
description: Rows of ecru beeswax candles haunt the narrow chamber with ghostly light, accentuating the intricate bas-relief roses snaking over the stone surface of the walls.  A silver-chased mistwood trunk displays its innards enticingly in the dim, flickering glow.

title: [Stay Tuned]
description: A soft, somber refrain drifts throughout the edifice, originating from a trio of faceless minstrels in the corner of the room.  A lone arrachd figure sits near a high shelf, plucking the strings of his mandolin while resting upon a giant burgundy pillow.  A crystalline red glass display case stands near a warped wooden door.

title: [The Two-Headed Dog]
description: Violet, teal, coral, and aquamarine light leaks through the cornsilk yellow straw that covers the hovel's peaked roof, casting its upper reaches in rainbow-whorled colors before diffusing to the yellowish orange hues of the sconces that line the walls.  Broad shelves, evenly hung and level, cast shadows upon several tidy worktables, while metal splinters, leather fragments, and pencil shavings are scattered about the uneven floor.   A long bench rests near the exit, its surface worn smooth with use.

title: [The Uncouth Wallflower]
description: Light seeps through the thin cracks between the rough pine walls of the hovel, some filled with bits of bog moss and others with fragrant rushes.  Uneven floors creak and groan as if the tiny structure were moaning under the weight of an enormous burden, though the sparse furnishings consist of little more than a few baskets and a wooden dress rack.  A small fire, banked but still quite luminous, offers a modicum of light to those nearby.

title: [The Vamped Vault]
description: Dusky, autumnal shades of carnelian, gold, and foxfire green pour through stained glass window panes encircling the elongated vault, the blanched stone flooring dappled in the warm tones.  A raised beveled ledge solidly frames the bare walls, adjacent to a finely woven rowan case and a massive cast iron cauldron resting at the center of the space.

title: [The Vamped Vault, Arch]
description: The serene nook of smooth, uncolored stone surrounds a rune-etched shelf of the same material.  Delicately leaded windows lend their brilliant colorations to the otherwise unadorned area.  Dried herbs and blossoms litter the corners of the floor, scenting the area with their memories.

title: [The Garden Shack]
description: A dirt-strewn workbench lines one entire wall of this shack, with gardening implements neatly arranged on a pegboard mounted just above.  Clay pots in mostly neat stacks sit over in one corner, while a worn leather-covered stool is posted by a gated entry to an utterly uncurated garden behind the shack.  Across from the workbench is a neatly kept rack of small bottles and vials filled with a variety of substances, from dried herbs and lichen to luminous liquids of unknown origin.

title: [The Garden Shack]
description: Dried herbs, tied in tidy bundles, hang from the rafters and hooks on the walls, their fragrance a mixture of medicinal and floral scents.  Long worktables are covered in the half-finished remains of herbal sachets, woven baskets, and braided rings.  Twilight hues filter through the area as light from the many windows illuminates the space.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Neighborhood]
description: Trapped behind a high wrought iron fence is a sprawling neighborhood of abandoned dwellings, dark trees, and winding roadways.  Shadows dance around flickering lights within the depths of the area, their soft glow creating an eerie atmosphere and doing little to dispel the general gloom.  A large gated entry, its face decorated with a shattered coat-of-arms, bars entry.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Entry]
description: Spindly branches of blackened wood extend across the sanguine-splattered ground, casting macabre shadows over the small abandoned dwellings within the neighborhood proper.  A single tapered branch pierces through a nearby window, the wood covered in wispy cobwebs extending in a fan-like shape.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Brass Lane]
description: A tall dented brass lantern casts warped images across the crumbling cottages scattered along the hillside, the green-black flame sputtering and hissing as wax bleeds down the pole to pool above the dirt.  Vibrant fireflies blink in and out of viewing as they dart through the broken window panes, exposing a large silhouette looming closer as the insects grow in number.

title: [Endeltime Estates, The Crossing]
description: Twin rows of skeletal trees line each side of the crossroads, their gnarled branches perched with dozens of crows, each one gazing down at the sigil-covered ground.  The faint cry high above reveals a duo of vultures, the predators circling lower with each flap of their wings above a circle of empty buildings.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Endeltime Estates, Brass Lane]
description: Wrinkled vines of blackened foliage snake through the fence encircling a group of empty homes, consuming the spaces as they cling to the crumbling walls.  The vein-like appendages creep up through the holes in the thatch roofing, grasping upwards into the empty air, the vines casting undulating shadows into the dwellings below.

title: [Endeltime Estates, The Midian]
description: A quartet of veined marble pedestals hold dented bronze statues, each facing a cardinal direction, their faces gouged through in deep furrows from temple to throat.  The dirt beneath each column rises above the edges, the uneven earth tilting each one forward in a slow descent towards a row of empty homes.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Endeltime Estates, Brass Lane]
description: Twin rows of overgrown topiaries frame the roadway before each dwelling, the former knight-shaped bodies left in a disarray of creepers and decaying foliage.  Each topiary grasps at an iron-tipped spear, the tips snapped off cleanly and scattered amongst the debris gathered beneath the sculptures.

title: [Endeltime Estates, The Passing]
description: A rusted iron gate dominates the open, dirt-packed road, its bars bent and broken beneath the wrought metal raven adorning the top, its gilt-pronged eye sockets gouged by heavy vines piercing through the available space.  The crumbling facades surrounding the gate cast ominous shadows through the broken windows, each one marked by a faded blood red sigil.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Endeltime Estates, Brass Lane]
description: Tall hedges form a small maze beyond the house-lined roadway, the untended briars closing in the entry in a thick wall of thorns.  A shattered circle of pale grey benches sits before the maze, the stones covered in rust-colored stains, the markings following the cobblestone trail towards the main path.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Brass Lane]
description: Trellises of pale wood lay buried in the crumbling stone of several abandoned cottages, the latticed pieces snapped in half, leaving the dried flora to spill across the muck.  Smashed garden ornaments litter the ground before the road, the shards of glass embedded in the black-colored mud.

title: [Endeltime Estates, The Junction]
description: Crumbling marble arches encircle the quartet of pathways, the carved columns consumed by ichor-stained vines climbing along the lengths of stylized fauna, stretching out before several ruined structures.  Dented braziers of rusted brass flank each arch, peeled apart as though made from fragile parchment.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Endeltime Estates, Brass Lane]
description: The mud-covered road is flanked by twin plank-affixed structures built high upon the winding hill, the small boxes left unkempt as dozens of bats swoop in and out of the torn wire enclosures.  A third house lays horizontally in the tall grasses beside a large home, the broken gaps allowing small rodents to slip and out in search of food.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Brass Lane]
description: A scatter of overturned tables and chairs covers the dead grass across the small rolling hill, the shattered plates and cutlery buried beneath mounds of upturned earth.  A blackened pyre stands behind a half-circle of homes, stacked high with cloth-covered shapes left to smolder between the layers of foliage.

title: [Endeltime Estates, The Branch]
description: An awning spreads from an empty chateau toward a wood-framed patio, the canvas ripped asunder, exposing the overturned chairs and cushions littered along the floor.  Several broken instruments lay against the blackened walls of the dwelling, their bodies gutted and left beside a bent music stand.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
description: A small yarn-haired doll lays buried in the muck along the road, its button eyes barely hanging from fragile thread.  A trail of discarded toys and various household sundries leads up to an abandoned three-story house, the facade covered in a macabre veil of blackened smoke marks.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
description: An enormous grey-stained web expands between two worn-down homes, the sticky tendrils clinging to the shattered window frames extending further into the residence.  Web-spun forms can be viewed through the doorways, the engulfed bodies seeping a dark rust-colored liquid into the floorboards below.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
description: A desolated garden has been spread out before a quintet of small cottages, the flora and fauna torn from the ground and strewn across the thatched rooftops.  Droplets of rust-colored liquid have dried within the root beds, intermingled with decayed piles of unidentified mammals.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
description: Untidy rows of gravestones stand before a group of empty wooden cottages, the markers shattered between the waves of asymmetric grass.  The sites lay open, the piles of dirt and bodies overturned, exposing worn down coffins pillaged of valuables.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
description: The gravel scattered across the ground has been stained in globules of sticky black ichor, the liquid streaked across the battered doorways of several structures along the path.  Broken planks and various debris litter the grass between the homes, the wood branded with undecipherable runes.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
description: Decaying garlands of ichor-covered flora drape from each of the four houses sitting at the foot of the hill, the strands dangling at intermittent lengths before drooping into the puddles of brackish water filling the holes dipping in the dry grass.  Flashes of fur dart between the homes, skittering off into the shadowed recesses through the open doors.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Endeltime Estates, Jejune End]
description: A scorched sign creakily hangs from a lampost before a two-story dwelling, the walls of the empty home smashed into rubble that litters the street below.  A wending path of overgrown hedges frames the entrance, the sound of rustling emanating between the leaves.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Dread End]
description: A large villa stands at the top of the hill, the cobblestones leading towards the structure splattered in bits of flesh and ichor.  The shattered glass windows spill out billowing curtains riddled in moth-consumed holes, the fabric weeping down the blackened walls.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Joydrop End]
description: A heavily branched copse of witchwood trees hover above a duo of ruined stone buildings, their spindly limbs dripping a noxious black liquid onto the cobblestones below.  Occasional flashes of bright yellow eyes appear between the broken window panes, swiftly disappearing back into the darkness.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
description: An algae-curtained pond curves around a tall, pewter-spired dwelling, the brackish water dotted by the carcasses of former inhabitants floating in the wake.  The corvid-topped spire lays at a sharp angle, scraping against the hole-hidden rooftop loosened from the framework.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
description: Sparks of lit ash float from within a circle of dwellings, the motes stark against the charred walls and smoldering rooftops.  The front doors lay broken across the blackened dirt, covered in deep scratch marks from corner to corner.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
description: A gnarled ebonwood tree lays slanted against a stone-forged cottage, its bark emitting an orange-red glow from within the trunk, the branches warping with the heat of the fire.  The occasional sound of crumbling rock echoes from within the home, followed by the crackle of consuming flame.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
description: Some crumbled sculptures lie ruined before a pair of chateaus, their marble arms reaching out from beneath the piles of stone, palms facing up at the sky.  Rivulets of dark liquid spill forth from the shattered windows, staining the grass in circles of black.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
description: A small house sits at the bottom of the curved hill, the walls covered in thick layers of blackened webs, the surface decorated by desiccated insects and bits of bone.  Broken windows reveal eggs stuck to the inner frame of the home, covering the tiny enclosure from floor to ceiling.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
description: A faint greenish black glow emanates from the stained glass windows of a nearby residence, the shattered glass forming teeth-like protrusions across the home's log-stacked walls.  The wheels of an upturned wagon lay by the roadway, the various parts of the vehicle scattered across the area.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
description: Oddly bent poles of blackened iron hang limp silk pennants, the frayed fabric wrapped around the metal supports by thin stands of webbing.  The crooked display stands before a long stone villa, the pristine exterior a stark contrast to the scorched interior viewable from the outside.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Tilly Ending]
description: A broken latticed pathway leads towards a slate-colored villa, the high walls choked by dead ivy vines creating a webwork across the sigil-stained doors.  Rows of decapitated rose bushes flank either side of the structure, the petals staining the cobblestones in faded red streaks.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Filly Ending]
description: A desolate house of wood and stone has been broken in half, exposing the blackened trail of destruction from the pathway to the treehouse built behind the structure.  Deep grooves across the ground are filled with mud and carrion, the troughs tempting a group of vultures observing from a nearby tree.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Banal Court]
description: A two-storied home sits upon the desolated hill, the blackened silhouettes of flames encompassing the stone walls.  The faint glinting of broken glass litters the dried grass beneath the house, the metal window frames warped into contorted curls of melted iron, the claw-like bars extending into the dwelling.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Banal Court]
description: A quartet of thatch-roofed dwellings litter the small blackened hillside, the cobbled pathway traced by a dry streambed, the shallow sands exposing the gnarled roots of a nearby witchwood tree.  Sickly grey vines snake across the banks of the stream, splaying across the grasses like thin veins of ash.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Banal Court]
description: A hole-covered bridge connects a group of dwellings, the gaps between the planks revealing a dried up streambed littered with fish skeletons tangled in strips of decaying weeds.  Several runes are unevenly carved across the railings, the symbols scratched out by oversized claw marks.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Banal Court]
description: A crooked house of blackened stone leans precariously over a black algae-covered pond, the water's surface littered with scorched pieces of thatch bobbing between the dark patches of aquatic plants.  The long-tailed form of an unknown mammal stalks between the dense reeds edging the waters, causing the grasses to rustle subtly before going still.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Stone Drive]
description: A vine-choked stone villa stands beneath the imposing silhouettes of twin trees, the bower beneath littered with small skeletons semi-buried beneath the rising weeds.  A carved marble pedestal displayed before the home is filled with a thick black liquid, the ichor spilling down onto the cobbled ground.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Stone Drive]
description: Long ribbons barely hang from the tall pole at the center of the house-filled area, their faded colors sprinkled with flecks of rust and splatters of dark mud.  Molding floral garlands adorn the contorted iron gate encircling the plaza, the blossoms collapsing above shallow puddles of brackish water.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Mawk Street]
description: A murder of jet-eyed crows gaze down from a skeletal branch, the arboreal form rotting from within, its exposed trunk covered in greyish green fungi.  Overshadowed by the large tree is a pair of grass-engulfed houses, the wood planks consumed by the familiar pungent mold.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Mawk Street]
description: The iron-fenced clearing is covered in a blanket of dead grass, the field littered with broken wooden tables strewn onto the ground before the hollowed-out dwellings.  Wicker picnic baskets lay smashed amongst the wreckage, the spilled meals consumed by swarms of buzzing flies.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Mawk Street]
description: An off-center carousel sits half-buried in the blackened mud, consumed alongside several wooden benches bordering the broken ride, separating it from the houses encircling the area.  The painted horses have been ripped off their poles, torn limb from limb, then discarded in a pile of ichor-stained detritus.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Mawk Street]
description: A small aviary sits beneath the bower of skeletal trees, the brass cage crushed beneath the weight of a fallen branch, leaving the barred door buried in the dirt.  The faint shrieks of avians echo throughout the area, hidden behind the series of villas enshrouded behind the thick hoarbeam trunks.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Mawk Street]
description: An imposing tree stands to the side of the home-littered path, the haon's gnarled branches providing a perch for a pair of grey-ruffed vultures searching for carrion.  The trunk has been littered with piles of small bones and beaks, the remains of a small carcass buried amongst the leaves and cartilage.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Mawk Street]
description: Tall briar patches block the view of several rundown homes, the wickedly curved thorns creating a curtain of claw-like appendages across the path.  Fresh splatters of inky black ichor drip from the shrubs, the prickly ends dangling scraps of cloth and bits of unidentifiable flesh.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Maudel Lane]
description: A tiered marble fountain sits cradled between skeletal hedges, the cracked structure filled with murky black waters dotted with decaying plant matter.  The feminine form of the adorning statue has been shattered into asymmetric pieces, the laurel-adorned head resting amongst the sea of weeds before the empty chateau set behind the decorations.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Maudel Lane]
description: A gnarled copse of witchwood trees crowd the dust-covered walkway, their branches choked by red-stained vines hovering just above a set of ruined houses.  Thin curtains of brittle cobwebs extend from limb to limb, decorated in silk-wrapped shells of insects long extinguished.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Maudel Lane]
description: A weed-riddled patch of grass is littered with decrepit gravestones, the cracks along the marble filled with green-black moss that obscures the already illegible carvings across the flat surfaces.  A blackened dwelling stands behind the cemetary, its tall bell tower collapsed across the roof and onto the dusty pathway.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Maudel Lane]
description: A trio of blackened wooden cottages dominate the barren grasses along the walkway, their rooftops canted across the log-bound framework, the windows crushed beneath the charred weight.  A broken wagon lays splintered in the dirt, its canopy splattered in ichor and patches of hide.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Maudel Lane]
description: A single plank swing sways from a bare branch of a towering oak, the splayed appendages extending over the remains of a forgotten pair of residences.  Black and rust-colored ichor has been splashed across the weed-covered cobblestones, the grasses concealing slivers of bone and metal.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Maudel Lane]
description: An arch of twisted black vines extends across the stone wall edging the road, the labryrinth of dried creepers barely concealing several empty houses further back within the plot.  The trailing plants swallow the vegetation across the front of the yard, the waves of black drowning the once colorful display.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Rusted Ends]
description: A dense patch of brambles separates a row of abandoned cottages from the dusty road, the gnarled shrubs entangled through the broken window panes.  The occasional glint of red and yellow eyes peek from the shadowed corners of the structures, quickly disappearing behind the rotted plank doors.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Rusted Ends]
description: A single thatch-roofed cottage stands amongst the rubble of its neighbors, the other homes left in piles of stone and mortar.  The shattered windows house ceiling-high weeds, their rotting tops spilling down into the mud-covered ground.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Rusted Ends]
description: A solitary tree stands before a row of houses left in shambles, the naked branch hanging a frayed rope swing stained in blackish ichor.  Piles of musty leaves litter the trunk of the tree, the remains of a broken toy solider peeking out beneath the decaying foliage.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Rusted Ends]
description: Deserted cottages form a half-crescent around a crumbling stone well, the wooden planks lining the roof dangling precariously from rusted nails, creaking loudly in the ambient wind.  Thin coils of fraying rope lay buried beneath dirt and broken armor, splattered in iron-colored ichor, the patterns echoed across the rim of the structure.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Rusted Ends]
description: The muddy road is stained in patches of black ichor, the trail of fluid following the walkway to a trio of crumbling dwellings.  All three doors barely hang from their rusted hinges, the brief view of their interiors exposing torn fabrics and broken pieces of furniture.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Rusted Ends]
description: The last vestiges of a dwindling fire sits between a pair of tall crumbling buildings, the dying coals giving off the occasional spark that is instantly drowned out by the encroaching darkness.  The faint cries of an unknown mammal echo off the stone walls, drowned out by the hissing of the subsiding fire.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Rusted Ends]
description: Faded paint covers the demolished walls framing a larger dwelling, the trellis-covered walkway veiled in ghostly white cobwebs dangling silk-wrapped exoskeletons.  The double doors of the chateau peek through the thick layers of webbing, the skeins caked in hair and bits of flesh.

title: [Endeltime Estates, Rusted Ends]
description: A fenced-in garden sits before a section of ruined cottages, the thin stakes snapped forward, buried within the jungle of dead grass.  A straw-filled scarecrow slumps over the distended vegetables, its eyes gouged out, leaving the occasional bean to spill out from the empty socket.

title: [A Run-Down Desolate Cottage]
description: Cobwebs span every corner betwixt the walls and ceiling, some so laden with dust that they sag like worn out party banners, while others are still occupied by their creators and their mumified and cocooned prey.  The hearth is cold, but full of ashes, its outer masonry stained with soot, and a broken wooden chair lies discarded before it.  A single threadbare rug and one small table are the cottage's only other furnishings.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Mushrooms soar to unnatural heights on either side of the rocky trail, an ethereal blue luminescence emanating from the gills of their colossal caps.  In unison, the glowing lamellae slowly pulse, occasionally blanketing the area in a darkness that heightens the treacherous nature of the terrain.  Oversized white lichen fans, cast with deep shadows, cling to the fungal stalks.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Narrow and meandering, a stream slips through the profusely floriated landscape, its surface obscured by a faintly glowing haze.  Tangled flowering ivy clings to a deteriorating bridge arched over the water, burrowing deep into the cracks of the worn stone.  Strangled by errant vines, verdigris lanterns adorn the crumbling end posts, lightless and long forgotten by time.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Massive dandelion puffs float against the twilit sky, swaying in a persistent breeze atop long stalks stemming from rosettes of lobed, lanceolate leaves.  Sent aloft by sporadic gusts, fuzzy seeds whip through the air until the wind settles, allowing them to drift to the earth.  Radiant orbs hover among the tufts as they fall like whiskery snowflakes, bathing the fluff-blanketed ground in honey-hued light.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Twisting through the floral forest, the trail picks a path around the enormous, conical blooms blossoming in every direction.  Rainbow ombre petals mirror the colors of the aurora-streaked sky, layered to form the giant inflorescences.  Whiskered with drooping tendrils, soaring black bat flowers interrupt the pastel hues like stygian ink splattered on a watercolor painting.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Evocative of wispy parasols, towering flowers shelter the narrow trail, globules of dew gracing their cerulean-limned, emerald ray florets.  Overgrown lilies thrive in the dappled shade, their sprawling, jewel-toned blooms bespeckling the landscape with saturated coloration.  Adding hints of vibrant foliage, heart-shaped wild ginger peeks out from around the blossoms.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Virid vegetation covers the rolling earth, ripe with fanning ferns and leafy laurels.  Unusually immense, green ball dianthus speckle the abundant verdure with shaggy, lime-hued domes.  The lush greenery is shot with sprigs of chartreuse orchids, their labella blushed a rich cerise shade.  Emitting a pale inner glow, tiny spheres dart through gaps in the flora.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Colossal jet black rocks, sharp-cornered and irregular, protrude at varying angles from a sanguine sea of poppies.  Shallowly incised runes cover the entirety of the formations, the symbols too worn to be decipherable.  Nigh intoxicating, a heady floral aroma pervades the air, caught between the arboreal silhouettes bordering the eastern and western edges of the efflorescent field.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Auroral lights paint the twilight-kissed sky, a vibrant backdrop for the beheaded obsidian obelisk standing sentinel over a tranquil pond ringed in horsetail reeds.  Visible beneath the surface, the severed point glistens in the soft illumination emanating from multitudes of floating, ghostly white lotuses.  Polychromatic orbs spin in a whirling dance above the crystal clear water.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Gossamer webs, strung with shimmering dew beads, stretch between the luminous stalks of lofty, flat-capped mushrooms that look as though they were carved from jade.  Growing in irregular, petal-like clusters, apricot jelly fungi patch the damp soil with their illumed, gelatinous forms.  Foliose lichen encrusts the rocks that force the path to pick a winding way through the area.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Narrow and straight, the trail cuts through the center of a monumental fairy ring created by fly agaric.  Pleated parasol mushrooms spread across the clearing like blanched grass, dwarfed by the sky-high circle and surrounding forest.  The fungal field luminesces in rippling waves, the rhythmic ebb and flow reminiscent of moonlit waves rolling through a vast ocean.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Basket fungus branches into massive round and oval balls, giant sculptures handcrafted by nature.  Tinting the bone white frames with delicate hues, pastel orbs of light weave in and out of the geometrical latticework.  Whisper-thin mycelium threads split into countless forks as they spread across the moisture-laden path, redolent of pulled cotton.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Bulging, magenta pustules dot the rounded purple caps of tree-sized toadstools draped with sickly green, tentacular vines.  Their cores have a faint, deep amber glow, adding to the garishness of the multicolored scenery.  Large enough to devour a halfling, carnivorous plants stand with their cilia-fringed mouths agape, waiting to snap shut around unsuspecting prey.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Rampant briars crisscross in arcs over the shrinking creek as it winds to the south, blocking the trail in that direction and suffocating the other plant life.  The lifeless remains of snapdragons sprout between the thorns in a failed attempt to escape their tangled prisons.  Dried conical inflorescences adorn the long stems, the clustered flowers redolent of miniature, dead-eyed skulls.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Bright purple hues from the auroral twilight sky lend a diffuse luminosity to the dense mists hanging in the air.  Cushioned with an overgrown mass of vivid yellow and magenta flowers, a crescentic islet cuts through the curving stream, splitting it in two.  The heavy haze blurs the intense colors of the flourishing blossoms and viridescent foliage to a painterly effect.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Wildflowers grow in abundance, blossoming to the water's edge in shocks of intense pink and fuchsia contrasted against dark greenery.  Straggly saplings frame the fog-hazed scene, their leaf-bare branches caught with petite white blooms.  Agitation clouding its churning surface, the brook tumbles over the rapids, jutting rocks and sodden deadfall diverting its course.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Sprouted with crimson-capped toadstools and blanketed in verdant mosses, a fallen tree bridges the breadth of the creek, powdery decay spilling onto the path from one jagged end.  A low mist hangs above the steadily flowing water and creeps over the root-threaded banks.  Slowly, it twines around the scattered, multicolored inflorescences flourishing within the adjacent verdure.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Dense curls of fog unfurl over the stream, suffused with a pale, prismatic glow reflected from the light limning the rippled water.  Alongside the banks, hundreds of golden eyes stare blankly up from the slender, pointed petals of dwarf crested irises.  Translucent sage green leaves branch from glittering wood moss, feathering the edges of the scraggly, roughly blazed trail.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Foliated tendrils drape from the tree boughs, creating a natural corridor for the hazy creek to wind through.  The leafy veils softly radiate an aqua phosphorescence that tints the muddy path and the wispy, spindly spider lilies sprouted along it.  Spangling the verdant curtains with points of white light, bright orbs drift aimlessly through the threadlike vines.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Dappled with glistening beads of dew, feathery painted ferns thrive beside the streambanks.  A luminous cloak of greenery droops from the trees on either side, casting a blue-green glow over the fringe-winged white egret orchids interspersed amongst the fronds.  Lichen-encrusted roots burst from the damp trail as it follows the gentle curve of the brook.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Many-petaled falls of purple wisteria overtake the gnarled, leafless trees looming over the small, lambent pool feeding the creek.  Trickling from hollows in the trunks, rivulets cascade over moss and roots to the water's surface.  The floral-enswathed scene is set aglow by globular, celestial blue crystals caught in coiled branches, deepening the shadows of the forest beyond the veil.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Marigolds and mums encroach upon the path as it slips past explosions of forsythia, shrouding the way beneath their sunny pom-poms.  Crushed to a brownish mush, countless petals litter the dirt track, only the ghosts of cheery yellow coloration remaining.  Sunflowers shoot up from the golden field, their round visages tilted downward under the weight of plump seeds.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: As orange as a burning sunset, zinnias and dahlias overtake the unrestrained gardens, popping into oversized globes of vivid petals.  Radiant light condenses into the forms of ethereal butterflies, resplendent and multihued, that flutter over the elaborate, inflorescent orbs.  Luminous motes trail off the tips of their intangible, wispy wings as they flit from bloom to bloom.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Flames of the forest trees bow over the sloping path, appearing ablaze from the clusters of brilliant scarlet flowers wrapping their sprawling limbs.  Below the fiery canopy, gnarled roots crawl out from eroded banks, fusing into contorted, natural steps caught between the crumbling faces of earth as they descend to the south.  Mosses creep across the organic stairs like a thin, verdant carpet.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Hungry flytraps bide their time, spread open to reveal their cerise mouths, while others have tightly clamped jaws as they digest a recent meal.  Damp and mossy, the trail passes through a menagerie of exotic plants with creeping tendrils, curvy shapes, and glaring colors.  The occasional butterwort with its pastel hues appears deceptively innocuous in comparison to its gaudy surroundings.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Multitudinous vasiform plants, in varying shades of putrid greens and deep maroons, pack the naturally terraced earth with a miniature forest that grows more vast with each consecutive tier.  Hanging from long stems, burnt orange pitcher plants dangle over the edges, their curled lips dripping with tacky liquid.  Radiant pink spheres, darker at the core, aimlessly float through the jungle-like terrain.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Sanguine mosses, sodden and squishy, cushion the alien landscape in a lurid display of color.  Shaped like gargantuan disks, chartreuse sundews tilt at diverse angles and decorate the terrain in a random, spotty pattern.  Dense roseate hairs sprout from the flat surfaces, tipped with viscous globules of mucilage.  The sticky orbs slowly consume hapless insects hopelessly trapped within.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Skirted by a blood red spathe, a single titan arum with a cylindrical inflorescence dominates the flora with its massive presence and overwhelming malodor of rotting corpses.  The surrounding crimson-blushed plant life tilts away from the fetid flower, the tubular lime green pitchers shrinking back in curved curls to leave a clear circle around the tapered base.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Stellate blooms match the tint of the cerulean haze enveloping their aculeate, royal blue stems, which branch into fuzzy curls tipped with burgeoning buds.  Curving around exposed chunks of slate, the trail travels past the prickly plants.  Love-in-a-mist grows rampantly in a cloud of fractal foliage, their cobalt blooms centered with tentacle-like stamen clusters.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Dainty vines laden with cream-throated lapis blossoms twist down slender tree trunks and tumble over the ground, tangling hazardously over the path as it meanders through the unbridled garden.  Casting a somber illumination over the tall flower spikes, deep blue-violet orbs drift through the profusion of wild indigo flourishing within their verdant leaves.

title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
description: Aswirl with blooms tinted dusky violet in the muted lighting of twilight, flowering jacaranda trees spread their contorted limbs over the petal-strewn path.  Royal purple plants provide intensely colored, shimmery foliage traced with viridescent veins and rachis.  Stalks of larkspur pepper the vegetation, their blossoms opened in bold displays of rich plum hues.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: The slow-moving waters of the river pick up a hint of speed as they splash down over an inconsequential rock formation, before smoothing out once more into a steady, purposeful current.  A gloomy and boundless forest spreads away to the south, its densely wooded thickets closing in the river on either side.  An extremely narrow road runs along the bank for some distance before disappearing into the dark underbrush.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: In the midst of a primeval forest, the river plods on beneath a tangled canopy of vines and leaf-laden branches.  Shadowy forms seem to move across the solemn waters, while a heavy silence settles like a wet blanket over the wildwood.  Giant arboraceous ferns cover the ground alongside the river.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: The river washes up on a muddy shore beneath a pair of colossal banyan trees, their vine-draped branches creating a thick canopy overhead.  A lone firefly flits along the treeline, its rhythmic blinking illuminating the gnarled limbs and casting eerie shadows.  A deep, black moss carpets the soft ground beyond the river.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Shore]
description: Thick black moss carpets the ground between massive banyan trees, vines hanging low along the shoreline.  Weaving between the flora, a firefly blinks in synchrony with the sounds of the river's arduously slow current gently breaking around a fallen tree.  A stained wooden sign smeared with ichor leans towards the remains of a moss-covered sunken fishing dock beyond the banyans.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Shore]
description: Thick mud of varied earthen hues comprise a narrow shore at the end of a cavernous, mold-ridden passage.  Boulders and rubble block the way south, opposite a narrow passage that opens up beyond an old wooden sign splattered with mud.  A patchwork moldy fishing dock is barely visible beyond the passage as it widens to reveal a colorful marshland.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Herb Baths]
description: Steam rises from a large pool in the center of the vaulted chamber, its crystal clear water sparkling beneath glass skylights overhead.  Long hardwood benches separated by potted palm plants are pushed up against glossy, marble-tiled walls.  Glass jars filled with various herbs, flowers, and oils line glass shelves behind an ebonwood table stacked with rolled white towels.

title: [Quinton Manse, Hedged Garden]
description: Raspberry, carmine, and scarlet grow in profusion from the purple beech hedges the small garden, the red hues mingling with the nearly black purple leaves and dominating their hunter green cousins.  Tiled pavers arranged in odd angles create an elegant patio of alternating angles and dark hues.  Open for the moment, a glass-paned golden linden door offers access to the manse.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River, Bridge]
description: The collapse of an ancient black willow provides a makeshift bridge across the narrow, dark water for the wildlife inhabiting the riverbanks.  The boughs of the great tree stretch out lazily in the direction of the current, its branches netting a collection of fallen leaves and broken twigs that have floated downstream.  Beneath the fallen tree, a lantern hangs from a rusty nail as a warning of the low clearance.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: Thick moss clings to the trees along the riverbanks, the gnarled trunks and twisted branches obscuring visibility to what lies beyond.  A crude stick figure dressed in burlap swings from a low-hanging willow branch, a black raven perched on its wooden shoulder.  The soothing sounds of flowing water fill the quiet air above the wooded lowland.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: Deep and sluggish, the water plods along its course, the riverbed overhung with a thick canopy of leaves from the enormous trees along the banks.  A stoppered glass bottle is carried downstream by the current, narrowly missing a jumble of roots and rocks protruding from the eastern hillside.  An unmarked tombstone rests in the shadow of an ancient weeping willow.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: The murky waters of the river reflect no ambient light as they flow along smoothly, the exact depth unknown.  On the eastern bank, a wooden boat bobs forgotten, tethered by rotting ropes to a dead tree trunk.  On the opposite shore, a fairy ring of reddish brown mushrooms springs up from the verdant ground.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: Patches of mist and dense fog linger in the still air, hovering above the smooth surface of the river.  There's no movement on the riverbanks to either side, each bounded with a thick copse of tall weeping willow trees leaning heavily inward over the waterway.  A lengthy watersnake glides past, disappearing into a fog bank.

title: [Gleyminn Anni River]
description: A darkening gloom settles over the area, the air thick with grey mist which muffles surrounding sounds except for the slow-moving current of the river.  A chill seeps in, followed by the caw of a raven, piercing through the duskiness.

title: [The Witching House, Undercroft]
description: Beyond the shelter of the black marble arch, a long corridor of stone blocks forms a passage that leads into utter darkness to the far west.  All sounds are muted, though the sounds of steps reverberate in a disconcerting, cyclical echo.

title: [A. B. Witching, Undercroft]
description: Muted by the massive stone blocks of the walls, miniature explosions seem to be occurring somewhere nearby, sending minute tremors through the floor underfoot.  The scents of loam and smoke grow stronger as the passage continues on, and soot stains the stone above a stately black marble arch.

title: [A. B. Witching, Workshop]
description: An immense crescent worktable sits centered on the back wall, with a swiveling cushioned barstool nestled in its cradle, allowing access to the full span of the work surface.  Almost an entire wall is covered by a large parchment illustration of a variety of plants, herbs, and fruits.  Hand-scribbled notes line its surface, some faded with age, others so fresh that the wet ink glimmers in the lamp light.  A few wine red damask-cushioned wingback chairs are arranged about in the remaining space.

title: [The Witching House, Regrets]
description: Cobwebs adorn the corners of the room between floor and ceiling and wall and floor, and it generally looks to have been untouched in an age.  Every surface appears in need of a good cleaning, including a dust-covered ebonwood cabinet with glass doors that rests against the far wall.  An age-darkened parchment sign on the side of the cabinet clings in place, looking ready to fall at any moment.

title: [The Witching House, Memories]
description: Neat and tidy, with stacks of sealed crates and locked and latched boxes, this room is immaculate, well arranged and well kept.  A glass-shelved bloodwood cabinet sits against the far wall, with an age-darkened parchment sign on the side of the cabinet that stands out against the vibrant hue of the wood.

title: [The Witching House, Study]
description: Centered at the rear of the study is a massive black marble fireplace with a basket of sticks sitting on the edge of the hearth, while the space to either side is occupied with wall-to-wall bookcases.  The remainder of the wall space is covered with dark crimson wallpaper embossed with a tone-on-tone floral pattern and a street-facing window heavily curtained with black velvet.  Opposite the arch out is a thin scarlet-striped black velvet couch with an attached chaise, with a few wing-backed black velvet chairs spread out before it.  Amid the seating is stationed a tiered silver-framed refreshment cart with a variety of glasses on the lower shelf.

title: [All Dogs Go To Naidem, Yard]
description: Red cedar boards have been neatly nailed together into a fence that encloses this space into a private backyard and garden.  Whatever ground isn't covered by bushes, grass, and plants is scattered with overlapping tiny pawprints, chewed bones, and dug holes.  A tiny replica of the cottage is set in one corner, its surface covered in clinging ivy, the front door open to allow entrance for any puppy-sized animals.  A round steel bowl is set in the opposite corner, a similar bowl full of water resting beside it.

title: [Covert Creatures, Laboratory]
description: Looking like an alchemy lab gone awry, the area is filled with tables cluttered with vials, chemicals, snippets of poisonous plants, and copper bowls.  A few rugs have been thrown about as if an afterthought for decor, and framed specimens of insects and aquatic life hang from the walls.  A fuzzy yellow-striped black velvet curtain leads back to the main room.

title: [Derelict Abbey, Refectory]
description: The faint, resinous scent of balsam hangs in the air, intermittently overpowering the aroma of rustic loaves of bread baking.  Opposite an ivy-besieged transept, a stout brick cooking hearth holds court, serving double duty as the sole source of warmth in the otherwise chilly refectory.
