A lone tanik bench spans the length of one wall, providing the only seating in the slate-tiled assembly room.

title: [Don't Bug Me!, Workroom]
description: Though the seepage running down the striated rock walls glistens enticingly in the flickering light of an iron-framed torch, the accumulated puddles on the uneven floor make the footing quite hazardous.  A series of flat stone blocks provide seating around a small worktable covered with tools and metal shavings.

title: [The Final Iteration, Workshop]
description: Chests, boxes, and piles full of scrap metal and spare parts cover most of the floor.  The back wall of the room is singed in various locations above a massive mithril workbench.  An almost artistic display of scorched flooring, pock marks, gouges, metal shavings, and other assorted bits of material have piled up beneath the bench.

title: [Flightless Dragonfly]
description: Streams of moonlight break through a canopy of moss overhead draping from the top of a red mulberry tree.  Scattered leaves in autumnal hues cover the ground, with giant white puffballs peeking through.  Surrounding the tree in concentric circles are several stumps of once great evergreens, the remnants cut down to provide ample seating.  A moss-draped door offers entrance to a medium-sized home at the edge of the clearing.

A canopy of moss, skillfully arranged to drape from the top of a red mulberry tree, creates shelter from the sun's harsh rays.  Scattered leaves in autumnal hues cover the ground, with giant white puffballs peeking through.  Surrounding the tree in concentric circles are several stumps f once great evergreens, the remnants cut down to provide ample seating.  A moss-draped door offers entrance to a medium-sized home at the edge of the clearing.

title: [The Four Humours, Office]
description: A barnacle-covered tapestry stretches across the back wall of this cramped office, partially covering the polished wooden wall underneath.  A wide claw-footed desk takes up most of the space, while an elaborately embroidered rug spreads across the floor.  The subtle scent of medicinal herbs wars with the sharp, metallic tang of blood in the still air.

title: [The Gnome Depot, Workshop]
description: Hanging from the walls and strewn across the floor are various sketches of elaborately drawn widgets and simple machines.  A small lamp casts light that dances off the metal gears and sprockets piled on the large work table in the center of the room.  Some mismatched couches and cushions are squeezed into the small space.

title: [Goblin King Dolls, The Room]
description: Void of any color other than black, it is hard to tell how big or small this room is as the walls blend with the floor and ceiling, blurring the edges of where one ends and the other begins.  There is only a white rocking chair placed against the back of the room and the door you entered through.  The chair looks large enough to seat two people and has a one-eyed stuffed bear sitting in it.

title: [House of Twilight, Workroom]
description: The disrepair of the walls is mostly hidden behind an array of large squares of parchment pinned in place by silver tacks.  Everything from architecture to clothing designs are accounted for, with the latter being mostly centered over the makeshift worktable at the rear of the room, where samples of cloth -- damask, satin, and jacquard -- litter the top.  An adjustable dress form stands bare in one corner, while a square pedestal table stands beside it.

title: [Illusory Dreams, Backroom]
description: Hand drawn, ink-splotched star charts line the walls, and a large, thick area rug covers the floor, deafening footsteps.  Prominently placed against one wall is a finely crafted, solid oak writing desk, complete with blank parchment and all manner of writing accessories.  A variety of mismatched antiquated stools, chairs, and benches have been arranged to provide seating for visitors.

title: [Kreapy's Krawliez, Backroom]
description: Acrid and nostril-burning, the overpowering aroma of preservative suffuses the stale air in the cramped room.  Condensation drips down the limestone walls, guided by cracks and streaks of black mold.  Old chairs are heaped into the corners, wood frames splintered and askew, though a few have been pulled out of the piles.  Laden with bug-pinned boards and open jars, a work table stands against the wall opposite a fractured ogee arch.

title: [Luck of the Draw, Lounge]
description: Tables littered with spare parts, marked cards, and random bits of miscellany line two of the four walls in this small backroom, while several mismatched stools and chairs sit scattered about.  A partially clean worktable is tucked into one corner, and a multihued glass bowl of hard candies rests on its edge.

title: [Materials Maketh Man]
description: Dominating a large portion of the cottage is an enormous loom that uses the main support beam as head roller.  Curtainless windows provide illumination from the perpetual twilight outside, while carefully shielded lanterns dispel even the most tenacious shadows.  At the forefront of the space are carefully arranged baskets and receptacles, each laden with bolts of fabric, with shelves above them that house stacks of paper.

title: [Moorlyn Cottage, Courtyard]
description: The small courtyard is ringed with a stone wall, and is flagged with large slabs of silvery grey.  A metal latticework pergola is thickly covered with winter roses, within whose sweet-smelling, thorny embrace are placed a half-circle of high-backed wooden chairs.  A hearth and stack is built into the surrounding wall, and the blazing bonfire within warms the courtyard.  A pair of glass double doors lead into the cottage.

title: [Moorlyn Cottage, Kitchen]
description: The kitchen is clearly a room meant to serve a purpose, not to be beautiful.  Yet, there are gentle touches still.  The iron stove is polished.  The butcher's block is unstained.  A marble slab is set with labeled canisters of flours.  Someone has taken the time to paint a frieze high up where the walls meet the ceiling.  A single window overlooks the courtyard to the back of the cottage, its glass panes clean and clear.  Even the swinging door is a bit more colorful than is purely necessary.

title: [The Other Daughter, East Crypt]
description: The air is moist, its scent so strongly laden with loam and decay that it practically tastes of it.  Formed from the halves of two broken altars, four stone benches are angled in toward each other to face a rocking chair that sits at the dead center of the octagonal chamber.  Beneath it, the makings of a ritual circle and its associated runes sprawl outward in imperfect symmetry before abruptly terminating just shy of the violet phosphorescence-riddled walls, each of which houses a tomb in its earthen embrace.

title: [Rub-a-dub-dub, Lookout]
description: A view of the verdant, water-soaked landscape is interrupted by thick perse vines creeping over the exterior sandstone blocks and translucent glaes windows set at regular intervals around the entire room.  A small oaken table surrounded by mismatched chairs offers meager provisions, the bread loaves stale and the water jug nearly empty.  Stacked along the wall, a pile of torches and kindling stand ready to signal any signs of distress.

title: [Shadowplay, Niche]
description: The stony alcove is mostly barren, save for a broad shelf that is set into the entire lower length of the surrounding walls.  Serving as the only other adornment, a vaalin-barred glass lantern looms above the space, its flickering interior casting a pale, silvered glow over the whole room.

title: [Tippy Toes, Upstairs]
description: A long worktable complete with a pair of shoe forms takes up most of the space in the loft.  An open footlocker containing a variety of tools and cobbling supplies sits at the end of a neatly made, narrow bed.  A small, round window lined with frost overlooks the courtyard below.

title: [The Vamped Vault, Recess]
description: The archway extends into an uncomplicated room occupied by a blocky pale stone worktable.  Silver-bracketed curios line the walls, many of them cluttered with bits of dried flora, small-sized iron instruments, and a prolific collection of colored glass vials.

title: [The Witching Flower, Workroom]
description: Oak beams support the riverstone walls and ceiling of the small workroom.  The walls are clear of any greenery, although several small creepers peek through a hole in a glass-inlaid ironwood door.  Several dark stone benches are scattered about a thick rolton wool carpet that is strewn with bits of discarded plants.  Various tools and materials are scattered over the surface of a carved wooden table.

title: [The Sorrowwood Crypt, Entry]
description: A few guttering candles valiantly battle the subterranean gloom, their wan illumination casting peculiar shadows on the walls that appear to lurch drunkenly at the slightest hint of a draft.  Flanking a darkened passageway, a tatterdemalion statue of a one-winged fairy presents an outstretched tray for perusal, and a cracked marble sculpture of a kneeling sea nymph offers a peek into a lidless coffret on her lap.

title: [The Sorrowwood Crypt, Tombs]
description: Cobweb-curtained niches honeycomb the eastern and western walls of this sepulchre, their only occupants spindly, wax-mantled candelabras that illumine the tomb with a warm glow hardly befitting the surroundings.  An imposing limestone sarcophagus rests beside an ithaenil-set runed mistwood cabinet, partially obscuring a series of damaged frescoes.  A very important RULES sign sits just inside the entrance to a darkened passageway.

title: [Whiskey Table]
description: Hushed conversations fill the pauses between tinny notes spilling from a music box in the bar, the strained melody unrecognizable.  At the center of a spindly ebonwood table, a tiny green flame flickers in a brass lantern casting an eldritch glow on the scene.  A detailed portrait hangs on the papered wall, the subject's gaze seeming to shift from time to time.

title: [Witch Table]
description: Spaced far enough away from the main dining hall to offer a portion of privacy, a blocky ebonwood table is draped with a crisp white cloth and set with a cut glass vase brimming with fragrant mournblooms.  A thick parchment menu lies open atop the table drawing attention to the chef's specialties and gourmet fare.  Flickering votive candles cast a soft glow on a silver-framed portrait hung on the wall, its subject gaunt and in need of a good meal.

title: [Sapphire Table]
description: Situated along the wall, a polished ebonwood table is nestled between a pair of blood red leather benches, the padded seats a little worse for wear.  The cozy booth is separated from the one in front and behind by brass-set stained glass panels of eerie forest scenes.  A large bowl of popped corn partially conceals a lightning bolt-shaped scorch mark on the table.

title: [Stream of Reflections]
description: A fungus-laden rotted fishing dock extends into the slow moving stream, a thick patch of luminescent crimson algae bobbing on the surface near each deteriorated piling.  Barely discerned through a tightly grown, entangled leafless canopy overhead is a sky of dull, featureless grey.  A patch of oily black water gently ebbs between the algae growing around the dock, a flickering shadowy reflection across its surface distorted and jagged.

title: [Stream of Reflections]
description: Twisted mangroves clog the muddy banks on either side of a fungus-laden rotted fishing dock, their clumped masses saturated with faintly glowing viridian moss that dimly illuminates the area.  Branching towards the entangled apex of an uncanny, leafless canopy above, the boughs of ancient and gnarled petrified trees extend high over the dock underfoot.  The waters of the stream move laboriously slow, a flickering shadowy reflection across its surface distorted and jagged.  A rotted wooden gangway leads away from the dock.

title: [Stream of Reflections]
description: An ancient, petrified tree extends high over the dilapidated end of a fungus-laden rotted fishing dock underfoot.  Massive and towering, the tree stands guard above an amassed collection of sedimentary sludge where the waters of the stream are forced through compacted brambles and mangroves.  Oily patches near the dock shift on their own accord, a flickering shadowy reflection momentarily appearing at each glance.

title: [Rodnir's Folly]
description: The north and south walls here are formed from the cracked and splintered section of a ship's hold, buried underground and packed with mud where the bow and aft would join if it were still a seaworthy craft.  A length of mossy rigging dangles from the edges of a vine-covered hole above a massive flat red-spotted mushroom, and a scattering of overturned crates litter the angular, convex wooden floor.

title: [Mold Marsh]
description: Two slick granite boulders force a slow-moving stream to divert away from a patchwork moldy fishing dock, zigzagging until it double backs on the southern side.  Nearly destroyed, the dock is now infested with the dimly glowing, multihued mold that pervades the area and intensifies to the southwest.  Gnarled, petrified trees twist upwards, covered in patches of blues, red, greens, and yellows.  A tumbledown moldy gangway leads away from the dock.

title: [Mold Marsh]
description: Molds of varied luminescent hues grow in large clumps and patches, consuming the majority of the dock underfoot.  A slow marshland stream is clogged with large rocks and fallen, petrified trees that have uprooted on the opposite side.  One of the trees is mostly intact, bridging a gap between two sections of the moldy fishing dock.  The stream carves its way through the colorful growths that have overtaken the area, zigzagging towards a larger body of water to the northeast.

title: [Mold Marsh]
description: Alongside the dimly glowing moldy fishing dock underfoot, a slow-moving stream empties into a deep pond in the middle of the mold-infested grove that surrounds it.  Mangroves cling around the water's edge, dwarfed by towering trees, all covered in thick patches of vivid, multihued mold.  Striated patterns of the luminescent growths have overtaken the leafless, entangled canopy above, providing their own unique skyscape.

title: [Moss Pond]
description: Tilting at a precarious angle, a sunken fishing dock manages to stay intact only because of the thick clumps of moss growing throughout its waterlogged frame.  Ankle deep, the motionless water covering the dock is murky with sediment and detritus while the center of the pond clearly reflects the colorful hanging mosses in the canopy above.  A moss-shrouded wooden gangway leads away from the dock.

title: [Moss Pond]
description: A moss-covered sunken fishing dock barely serves as a way to traverse along this side of the pond, its warped surface tipping and tilting with each shift or step.  Violet-flecked viridian moss hangs from countless dead, petrified trees, their dull grey boughs entangled to the point where it isn't clear where one begins or ends.  Dark ichor oozes down long, tangled vines hanging from the surrounding banyans like rivulets of sap, thick and gooey as it pools near the water's edge.

title: [Moss Pond]
description: Clear of debris, the central waters of the pond are still, while its edges are murky and brown with sediment from a slow tributary stream beyond a row of clustered mangroves.  A moss-covered sunken fishing dock creeks softly underfoot, connecting at an angle to another section of planks by a natural bridge of tangled vegetation leading east.  Occasional splashes near the dock's pilings confirm any suspicions of inhabitants beneath the surface.

title: [Misty Waters]
description: Floating detritus collects along the bank as the water ebbs towards a dilapidated rickety fishing dock.  Dimly glowing viridian moss and umber-hued clumps of algae cling to the endmost pillars of the dock, now bare of plank and nail.  Visibility to the northwest is blocked by a thick curtain of hanging mist.  A mist-shrouded ramshackle gangway leads away from the dock.

title: [Misty Waters]
description: Clinging mist hangs low in the air, slowly shifting with any movement in the water beneath it.  A dilapidated rickety fishing dock bends sharply underfoot with each step across its remaining rust-stained wooden planks.  Tightly packed mangroves on the opposite side are overshadowed by massive petrified trees, their branches entangled against a dull grey, lifeless sky.

title: [Misty Waters]
description: Shrouded in thick white mist, a dimly glowing violet webwork of tendrils extends across the water here and blocks passage beyond.  A dilapidated rickety fishing dock has been irreparably damaged, the end nearest to the tendrils rotted away and blackened with ichor, the other end of the dock disappearing into mist to the northeast.  Mangroves slowly rise and fall along the bank on the opposite side, dimly glowing as they reach the apex of each belabored cycle.

description: The melody from the front room can still be faintly heard, its tune both beautiful and serene.  Several gilded birdcages are suspended above a black velvet-draped table.  An old stool occupies a far corner, with a smattering of wood chips scattered all around it.

title: [Pierced Veil, First Floor]
description: Acicular crystal formations pierce through the mahogany planks of the repurposed house, their facets glinting from the pulsing glow emanating from a dusty, orb-capped chandelier.  A barbed wrought iron stand casts spiked shadows softened by the gentle, rhythmic illumination.  Barely concealing a narrow staircase, devore velvet curtains patterned in monochromatic florals echo the profusion of black star calla lilies framing the glass display case set to one side.

title: [Pierced Veil, Second Floor]
description: The stairs lead up to a spacious room with a pair of splintered doors on the western wall.  Tattered shreds of gossamer drape from the edges of the ceiling, brokenly veiling tilted paintings and a full-length mirror tucked into one corner.  In the center of the room, open manacles hang from the armrests and footrest of a reclined leather chair.  Scattered around a mahogany console table, piles of dusty velvet cushions provide an alternative to the questionable seating.

title: [Buckle Up, Backroom]
description: Silver hoops of varying sizes, within which stretch multitonal floral doilies, hang from overhead beams by twisted hemp cord.  Scattered across warped, and somewhat rotted, floorboards are overstuffed crocheted cushions dyed a dark mulberry red and sewn with intricate beadwork along the edge.  Beside a garland-framed arch, an unsteady pillar displays a large fishbowl filled with murky green water.

title: [Masqued Intentions, Basement]
description: Blackened stone walls slick with moisture line the area, while a precariously hung lantern casts shadows throughout.  Broken bits of furniture and decorations lay strewn like obstacles as water drips steadily in one corner of the room.  A thick onyx table stands near the back wall with a silver-handled obsidian dagger resting on it while a single post of scorched ironwood stands upright alongside it.

title: [Ember Ridge, Picnic Tables]
description: In a quiet hollow created by a ring of tall, colorfully arrayed autumn trees sit several wooden picnic tables, their tops covered with ivory, russet, and gold plaid cloths.  Beneath a small shelter adorned with copper and saffron ribbons, which is set off to one side, is a modestly sized banquet buffet, decorated for the season with miniature pumpkins and gourds, leaves and clusters of acorns.  Behind it are a line of simple wooden chairs, each with a cluster of leaves tied to the upper rung of the back.

title: [The Minaret, Ground Floor]
description: The ground floor of the minaret is packed earth, nearly frozen solid even within the thick walls.  A dusty cushion sits half askew at the base of a stone spiral staircase, the steep curve of which disappears upwards into a distant darkness.  Someone has left a bulky ceramic jug and a few lumpy pottery cups to lie in a dusty pile.

title: [The Minaret, Up the Spire]
description: Only a bit of light seeps in from above and below to illuminate the sharp curve of the spiral staircase.  It wends its way upwards and downwards in the minaret, its risers and treads carved from the tower's stone itself.  There is no handrail.

title: [The Minaret, Midspire]
description: The simple, round chamber is little more than a landing, with a carved stone spiral staircase continuing both up and down.  A small bit of floor has been stolen from the center of the ring, upon which is a wooden plinth.  An arrowslit lets in a bit of starlight.

title: [The Minaret, Up the Spire]
description: The tight coil of treads and risers continues.  Along the wall, a thin eburnation smoothes a second spiral to complement the larger curve, as years upon years of bracing hands have worn the rough stone to a polished finish.  A single arrowslit lets in a bit of light, enough to see the outline of well-fitted trapdoor in the ceiling just above the top of the stairs.

title: [The Minaret, Rooftop]
description: In the center of the minaret, a decorative stone spire has been rudely truncated and the carved block left to sit alongside its former place.  An enormous telescope of aged brass and shining glass sits atop the makeshift dais, sturdy and steady as if it had always been there.  Around the instrument are boxes of papers and crates of ornaments.  A trapdoor, or a long fall, are the only ways off of the rooftop.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Hidden Room]
description: Thick cobwebs with a cache of moths, flies, and beetles wrapped in their silky strands stretch across a tightly spiraled staircase.  At the foot of the stairs, a curtain has been pulled partway across a darkly stained mahogany panel, its edges illuminated with warm, glowing light from behind.  A spider dangles from a wax-covered candelabra set atop a high-wrought walnut newel post.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Widow's Walk]
description: A spiraled staircase is visible beneath a trapdoor that opens onto a wooden rooftop platform enclosed by a black iron balustrade.  Offering a bird's-eye view of the grounds below, the lookout surrounds a massive stone chimney, a line of sand-filled buckets, and scum-topped rain barrels nearby.  A sleek ebony raven perches on a railing-mounted brass telescope.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Widow's Walk]
description: Covered with slick, green moss, many of the grey floor planks in this section of the walkway are warped, the footing treacherous.  Empty earthenware flower pots are pushed up against the black iron balustrade, one post tied with once colorful ribbons that are now faded and fraying.  The view below is of a maze of gardens behind the hotel.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Widow's Walk]
description: Overturned wooden crates have been fashioned into makeshift patio furniture, and a water-stained parasol harpooned in the middle of an empty wine barrel branded with strange markings.  Open-mouthed stone gargoyles which have been dislodged from their posts on the steep roof block off a small corner section of the walkway that has begun to sag.  Initials have been crudely carved into the side of the chimney and then partially covered over by blood red paint.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Widow's Walk]
description: A faded crimson banner bearing the hotel crest hangs limply from a decorative iron railing enclosing the narrow walkway.  Visible through the black bars, a downspout sculpted into a birdlike gargoyle claws its way out of the surrounding grey stone.  Several lichen-encrusted wood shingles have slipped from the steep gable roof and lay scattered in the courtyard far below.

title: [Armaments of the Destroyer]
description: Cold radiates from the stone floor, leaving the air of the keep damp and uninviting.  Spiraling stairs hug the outer wall, offering passage to the floor above, while a pair of heavy wooden double doors provides egress to the street beyond.  Several armor stands are arranged along the curve of the room, faded pennants and tapestries hanging above them and fluttering in an unfelt breeze.

title: [Armaments, Second Floor]
description: Arrow-slit windows allow the twilight colors of the sky to paint the southern stones in shades of amber, violet, and cerulean, while a large cobblestone fireplace brands the room in orange, red, and yellow hues.  Despite the warmth of the fire, the air is still damp and laced with a pervading chill.  Positioned between the spiraling stairs and a copper and oak ladder, several armaments are arranged upon statuesque stands, each depicting warriors in combat poses.

title: [Armaments, Third Floor]
description: Overlapping square rugs of durable, if utilitarian, wool cover most of the wooden floor, while ensconced torches dominate the walls and stain the ceiling with soot.  Thick iron hooks, sturdy wooden pegs, and heavy wrought iron racks rest beneath the light sources, each laden with armor and armaments.  Descending to the floor below, a copper and oak ladder disappears through a small hatch along the western wall.

title: [Innocent's End, Winding Trail]
description: Traversing the meandering trail proves tricky, trailing creepers and cat's-claw snatching at the clothing of passers-through as if to draw them into the verdant morass of vegetation.  A boscage of plant life girds the small road, constantly at odds with the foot traffic as it attempts to consume the ashlar paving stones disrupting its quest for hegemony.

title: [The Gallivant, Clearing]
description: The overgrowth stops abruptly, opening into a wide grassy clearing that is still verdant but obviously manicured.  Centrally positioned, an immense marquee striped in teal and saffron flies a pennant decorated with a pair of toy bears playing pat-a-cake.  At haphazard intervals, the marquee's borders shift and blur uncannily, but the small signpost planted near the entrance proclaiming this "The Gallivant" remains steadfast.  A mossy cobblestone path skirts the edges of the clearing and disappears into some thick overgrowth to the northeast.

title: [The Gallivant, Marquee]
description: Wide vertical stripes of alternating teal and saffron climb the canvas walls of the tent to the roof, sharply ascending to the apexes of the two king poles raising it to lofty heights.  A rectangular platform painted in gilt occupies a place of prominence opposite the entrance, elevated slightly above the packed earth floor to give an audience seated on the magpie collection of chairs and benches an excellent view of the entertainment.  The scent of buttered popcorn emanates from a bear-painted gnomish contraption standing just inside a tent flap framed in multihued bunches of fruit-shaped glass lamps.

title: [Quinton Manse, Corridor]
description: Heavy drapes, thick and voluminous, trail from polished brass poles in blended shades of dark green and black, each drawn back to provide a view of the street below through whorled glass-paned windows.  Thin-striped grey-on-plum bourde fabric dominates the walls where decorative glass sconces are supported by polished faceplates.  Glass-fronted trophy cases decorate the southern walls of the corridor, their spindled legs resting upon a thick carpet of woven ebon and scarlet wool.

title: [Quinton Manse, Corridor]
description: Windows encased in heavy drapery line the eastern wall of the corridor, while the west is covered in trophy cases and decorated in grey-on-plum bourde fabric.  Frosted globes perch upon brass lanterns, offering a crisp white light that dispels the twilight hues that spill in from the windows.  A pair of ebonwood bookcases flank either side of the corridor.

title: [Town Hall, Registry]
description: Heavy curtains frame the murky windows that dominate the western wall, the ancient drapery threadbare and covered in skeins of cobwebbing.  Anchored to the ceiling and suspended over a long ebonwood counter, an antique and tarnished chandelier appears to be the playground of dozens of spiders as evidenced by the long strands of spiderwebbing that drift down from it.

title: [Gavelsdown Hall, Parlor West]
description: Twilight hues spill through the open windows, giving the dimly light room a bruised appearance that is vivid contrast to the plush carpeting and gold fixtures.  High-backed leather armchairs are arranged in social circles throughout the space, while an elaborately carved cabinet occupies a space along the back wall.  The thick scent of cherry tobacco fills the air.

title: [Cozy Little Friends]
description: Glittering in the light of dozens of votives, delicate sea glass and mirror fragment charms hang from the exposed rafters of the wagon and fill it with dancing lights.  Daffodil yellow shutters are closed tightly against the damp air of the neighborhood, while heavy blankets are piled high upon a bed built into three walls.  Lacquered pegs and wrought iron hooks hold various charms, their long ends dangling over wicker basket filled with yarn balls.

title: [Icewild Hall, Receiving Room]
description: Whilst the rest of the Hall seems to have fallen into disrepair, this small chamber remains pristine.  A figured green silk rug covers much of the flagstone floor, and mirrors, their surfaces clear and unfoxed, cover the walls.  The greedy position of a heavily cushioned chair nearly conceals a petite fireplace, with its surround of gilded wood.  Lesser benches, with less comfortable cushions and less access to the heat, are placed in a half-circle.  A single gilded door provides the only egress.

title: [Farain's Shack]
description: The walls are painted orange with splashes of black.  A series of knives are stuck into the shape of a heart on the wall, each with a heart-shaped pommel.  A large mauve rug is stretched out across the floor, its surface covered in red stains.

title: [Farain's Shack]
description: Alternating sheets of violet accented with lace frill are strung across the ceiling inconsistently against the walls.  A large black rock with a series of rocks stacked on top of it sits in the center of the room.  The overwhelming scent of sandalwood and lavender invades your senses.

title: [Farain's Shack, Alcove]
description: Dark wooden planks are bound together with twine to form a makeshift wall that surrounds the room.  Shafts of light are filtered through the thick, rotting oak beams precariously balanced overhead.  A mauve rug stretches out across the uneven floor.

title: [It's To Pie For, Bakery]
description: Their frightful faces flickering with fiery light, carved ghost pumpkins decorate the splintered shelves and dusty corners in festively arranged trios.  A display case stretches out from the maple counter, its glass front shattered over the petrified pies within.  Beside a rusty potbelly stove, taxidermy carrion birds perch on the mantel over a caved-in brick hearth, eternally caught in mid-flight.

title: [It's To Pie For, Dining]
description: Ragged glass shards trim the expansive window that affords an open, uninterrupted view of the street.  A cool breeze blows through the suspiciously lifelike bats dangling from the rafters, causing them to pendulate over the wrought iron tables and matching chairs.  Nearly cocooned in cobwebs, a copper cart is tucked into one corner, its silken shroud ripped open to reveal the bite-sized desserts on top.

title: [It's To Pie For, Library]
description: Cozy ebon brocade chairs, draped with acid green knit throws, occupy the spaces between the mismatched bookcases lining the stone walls.  Half-melted candles cast a warm, orangey glow over the webwork silver recipe boxes set beside them on assorted end tables.  Seated on wooden stool, a straw-stuffed scarecrow dons a tilted chef's hat and a black cat-print apron.

title: [Ghastly Groceries]
description: Pristine white-washed walls are illuminated by evenly spaced sconces that create a warm, pale yellow light that spreads throughout the shop.  Bright white curtains embroidered with cows and roltons decorate the windows, while a long service counter is skirted with brick red linen and decorated with black and white chickens.  Standing across from one another, a tall storage shelf offers dry goods and an insulated ice chest houses dairy items.

title: [Nana's Notes]
description: Warped and slightly waterlogged, an uneven floor causes the northern end of the shop to be higher than the southern end.  Thick, heavy rugs drape across the ground to keep out the damp of the wetlands beyond, while a cozy fire helps to keep the space comfortable and warm.  Scribbled notecards hang above a small stove, the writing utterly illegible, while a small oak bookcase housing dozens of cookbooks dominates an opposing wall.

title: [The Timeless Hollow]
description: Sturdy branches of slate grey interweave in an arching lattice to form the living walls of the area, the leaf-adorned limbs highlighted by tiny motes of light.  Unraveling bolts of fabric float along the perimeter of the room, occasionally brushing past a trio of mannequins draped in bespoke gowns of swirling smoke.  Exceedingly tall bookshelves climb upwards toward the glass-domed ceiling, revealing a constellation-filled sky illuminating the watercolored panes.

title: [Sonreeva, Mausoleum]
description: Fleshy vines pour in from the entrance of the mausoleum and creep across the surface of the granite structure.  From just outside, the faint glow of the crimson flames barely illuminates the interior, causing shadows to flicker across the far wall.  Several coffins, each in front of a chute, used to store cadavers line the eastern and western walls, while the northern wall houses a belt and pulley system for coffin returns.

title: [Sonreeva, Crypt]
description: Six torches, each lit with a dark violet flame, are affixed upon the granite walls.  Empty coffins lay at the end of the chutes, which connect to the mausoleum above, while a crude pulley system consisting of ropes, wheels, gears, cranks, and a leather band is used to return the coffins.  A bladed pendulum swings back and forth with a large blackened skull stuck at the end, making the death trap useless in its current state.  The musty smell of desiccated bodies wafts throughout the tomb.

title: [Sonreeva, Crypt]
description: Piles of torn flesh and shattered bones are scattered across the floor of the crypt, the stench overwhelming.  Corroded steel shackles dangle from the walls, some encrusted with bits of gore and sinew.  The sound of metal grating against stone comes from somewhere near.

title: [Sonreeva, Crypt]
description: Piles of torn flesh and shattered bones are scattered across the floor of the crypt, the stench overwhelming.  Corroded steel shackles dangle from the walls, some encrusted with bits of gore and sinew.  The sound of metal grating against stone comes from somewhere near.

title: [Sonreeva, Dead End]
description: The circular room is a dead end, and the only exits are to the southeast and southwest.  Foreign symbols are arranged on the northern wall haphazardly.  Carved into the floor are a trio of short red lines pointing toward a black circle that is crossed out.

title: [Sonreeva, Crypt]
description: Piles of torn flesh and shattered bones are scattered across the floor of the crypt, the stench overwhelming.  Corroded steel shackles dangle from the walls, some encrusted with bits of gore and sinew.  The sound of metal grating against stone comes from somewhere near.

title: [Sonreeva, Hall of the Dead]
description: Upon the moss-covered limestone walls, shallow niches house a number of urns.  Iron sconces give off a pale green illumination, giving the hall an eerie presence.  Smeared trails of blood and gore lead in every direction.  Lengths of tattered cloth are scattered across the floor.

paths: Obvious exits: south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Sonreeva, Dias]
description: Five large stone sarcophagi form a makeshift semicircle around the circumference of the dais in the center of the hall.  The life-sized image of a paladin, dragoon, summoner, healer, and duelist in full armor has been painstakingly chiseled into the lid of each sarcophagus.  The tattered, moldy remains of five banners stand in the center of the circle, the faded cloth waving gently in the slightest breeze.  At the north end of the dias, an arched stone door is flanked by two torches.

title: [Sonreeva, Hall of the Dead]
description: Upon the moss-covered limestone walls, shallow niches house a number of urns.  Iron sconces give off a pale green illumination, giving the hall an eerie presence.  Smeared trails of blood and gore lead in every direction.  Lengths of tattered cloth are scattered across the floor.

paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Sonreeva, Vertical Shaft]
description: A single smoky torch is set above an arched stone door to light the stairwell leading into the depths of this foul place.  Several bones have been wedged into cracks in the walls, perhaps as an attempt to reinforce them for a bit longer.

title: [Sonreeva, Vertical Shaft]
description: The stairwell wraps around the walls, with the occasional torch giving just enough light to not plummet downward.  Ghoulish screams echo from above and below the void in the center of this area.

title: [Sonreeva, Subterrane]
description: Smoke from burning torches lingers in the air, mixing with dust and causing the narrowing passage to feel more constricting.  Long curtains of cobwebs hang from the ceiling and walls, stirring slightly.

title: [Sonreeva, Dark Passageway]
description: Smoke from burning torches lingers in the air, mixing with dust and causing the narrowing passage to feel more constricting.  Long curtains of cobwebs hang from the ceiling and walls, stirring slightly.

title: [Sonreeva, Dark Passageway]
description: The deeply shadowed corridor leads off to the north and south, with little distinction between the two.  A multitude of scuff marks on the dusty ground bear witness to recent travel through this area.

title: [Sonreeva, Dark Passageway]
description: Wet, mashed bits of entrails glisten in the torchlight along the passageway's stone floor.  Congealing trails of blood lead southward, while deeply grooved scratch marks lead north.

title: [Sonreeva, Dark Passageway]
description: The air is musty and stale, combining with close quarters and low light to give a claustrophobic feel.  Faint scratching noises come from all around, accompanied by the nearly imperceptible sound of unidentifiable breathing.

title: [Sonreeva, Dead End]
description: Twin sputtering torches provide just enough illumination to make out a humanoid figure chained from the low ceiling.  Hanging by its manacled hands is the decomposing body of a horned imp.  Beyond the corpse lies a vast abyss that abruptly ends the passageway, swallowing it into a sea of darkness.

title: [Sonreeva, The Void]
description: The area is soaked in pure darkness.  Barely anything makes a sound, and there is a chill in the air.  The nothingness surrounding the location seems hopeless.  The void is the only egress from this place.

title: [Sonreeva, Collapsed Tunnel]
description: The unstable walls have buckled in several places, depositing large chunks of stone along the tunnel and nearly blocking the way ahead.  Mounds of dirt and rubble cause the route through the tunnel to be more circuitous in order to avoid possibly creating a cave in.

title: [Sonreeva, Collapsed Tunnel]
description: Large chunks of rock lay strewn about the tunnel, making the way precarious.  A lone torch, sputtering in its iron sconce, provides just enough light to traverse the rubble.  A cracked bone the size of a whole gnome sticks out of the exposed earthen wall that appears to have served as an archway to the passageway.

title: [Sonreeva, Collapsed Tunnel]
description: Thick layers of webbing encase a massively winged effigy, which lies against one wall.  One wing is fully outstretched, while the other has broken off shattered on the ground.  Two empty depressions in the statue's face stare into the dark.

title: [Sonreeva, Collapsed Tunnel]
description: A section of the wall forms a natural alcove that has runic carvings worked into the surface.  The low ceiling and constricting space does not make the area easy to pass through.  The vertical incline also becomes steeper heading downward.

title: [Sonreeva, Collapsed Tunnel]
description: Large insects cling to the earthen walls, emitting a low buzzing sound in the dim tunnel.  The ground is littered with husks and carcasses of dead vermin, though the occasional giant centipede skitters through in and out of smaller openings.

title: [Sonreeva, Collapsed Tunnel]
description: Several small niches have been randomly cut into the walls on both sides of the tunnel.  Staring out from the shadowy depths of each recess is a skull, with glowing red eyes and chattering teeth.

title: [Sonreeva, Collapsed Tunnel]
description: Bloody claw marks mar the earthen walls, and the ground is wet with some unknown liquid, deep enough to wade through.  Something slithers around in the fluid, causing large bubbles to form on the surface.

title: [Sonreeva, Cistern]
description: Dark liquid, now waist high to the average halfling, collects at the bottom of the tunnel.  Corpses float on the surface, while animated hands of the dead grasp at anything submerged in the pool.

title: [Sonreeva, Sunken Chamber]
description: A stone ramp leads up to a rusty iron hatch that seals off the cistern above.  A small puddle of dark liquid pools at the bottom of the ramp, but quickly seeps down a grate.  A bloated corpse of a grik rots in the center of the chamber.

title: [Sonreeva, Depths]
description: The scent of sulphur intoxicates the area, the fumes so thick they feel heavy on the air.  The cramped space is engulfed in darkness, and there is barely enough room to traverse back and forth through the area.

title: [Sonreeva, Depths]
description: The air is much drier and warmer here, with hotter updrafts coming from the depths below.  Cracked bones circle a tunnel leading further downward, with barely any way to easily manuever the broken steps that circle the route.

title: [Sonreeva, Depths]
description: Blasts of hot air shoot up from the deepest parts of the passageway.  A faint glow is now visible, the first time the darkness has been pierced throughout Sonreeva.

title: [Sonreeva, Depths]
description: The light upon the walls transcends its formerly nebulous coloring to take on a ruddy, crimson hue, making craggy shadows on the uneven cut of the stone walls.  Even for those acclimated to such climes, the heat is enough to raise a sheen of sweat.

title: [Sonreeva, Depths]
description: Positively choking with its heat and humidity, the air here chokes with every breath as might lava if possible to inhale.  The light from an inferno grows ever brighter.

title: [Sonreeva, Deepest Parts]
description: Unaffected in the least by the blistering heat of the passage, a pair of statues stand on either side of the narrow walkway.  One hunkers against the wall as if readying to climb, its stone talons biting into the blocks as it glares back over its shoulder with a visage so fearsome that it could curdle the guts of the strongest of adventurers.  The other statue looms large and gazes down with a loathsome stare, wings and arms outstretched as scraps of decaying flesh dangle from its talons.

title: [Sonreeva, Deepest Parts]
description: It is difficult to tell if the beads of liquid trailing down the stone wall from where a statue emerges from the structure of the passage itself is blood or water merely tinged sanguine by the ever-constant glare of crimson light from below.  The carved beast is frozen in the act of lunging across the walkway toward the figure that has been chiseled out of the wall itself, likewise arrested in a claw-splayed and snarling rage caught in the midst of realization.

title: [Sonreeva, Deepest Parts]
description: There is no question that the tacky substance on the stone floor was once a pool of blood, based purely on its coloring and the vile scent released when disturbed.  Across the breach, a pair of statues stare at each other -- one with heavily veined wings stretched wide and curled fists raised into the air, while the other is engaged in ripping an imp in half, entrails and viscera strung out in stone between the parts.

title: [Sonreeva, Palisade]
description: Rough-cut stakes as long as a human is tall are buried, blunt end, in the stone floor, stationed at an angle that directs attention northward.  Their sharpened tips are dark with aged blood and caked with dried flesh, and when attention manages to stray beyond their compelling points, deeply scored sigils can be found on the walls on either side of the passage.  It is obvious their origins are demonic in nature.

title: [Sonreeva, Demon Wall]
description: The passage ends in an obsidian wall, its facade carved with a countenance that is, in itself, ghastly visage, demonic in nature, with a yawning maw that reveals razor-sharp teeth and a forked tongue.  Horns crown the being's head, wings rise large and menacing over its shoulders, and a disturbing hybridization of clawed tentacles coil along the lower edge.

title: [Hollowlair, Dreadgrounds]
description: The surface of this barren place is extremely hot, with plumes of sulfur pouring out from vents in the ground.  The air is choked with smoke, and it feels dangerous to breathe.  The monolithic stone door standing guard over this area is sealed closed from this side.

The surface of this barren place is extremely hot, with plumes of sulfur pouring out from vents in the ground.  The air is choked with smoke, and it feels dangerous to breathe.  The monolithic stone door standing guard over this area is sealed open from this side.

title: [Hollowlair, Dreadgrounds]
description: A collapsed tower of stone and bone has succumbed to the flames, and banners fraught with demonic sigils burn amidst their crumbled walls.  Rumbling shakes the ground underfoot, the sound of it like a great roaring, though the only visible consequence is explosion after explosion of fire, dirt and rock spraying upward with the force of the flames.

title: [Hollowlair, Dreadgrounds]
description: A thunderous explosion makes the smaller stones on the ground rattle and skitter, while in the distance, the top of one of the heinous towers is obliterated by a flaming boulder propelled by a particularly powerful gout of flames.  Dust and bone shards rain down in an audible shower that can be heard from half a league away.

title: [Hollowlair, Dreadgrounds]
description: Every inch of the surroundings are incandescent with flames, with fire seeming to consume even those things that defy logic such as stone and the very ground itself.  In the cavernous chamber, horrific towers of stone and bone rise in the distance even as blades of granite split the ground to stab upward.  Gouts of flame flare from the floor nearly to the ceiling, consuming any wayward trees, and the hissing of ruptures can be heard igniting from all directions.

title: [Hollowlair, Dreadgrounds]
description: An unfathomably large skeleton that defies identification presents a formidable obstruction to avoid, as flames lick across its spine in blue-tipped waves and ripple within the long-empty cage of its skull.  Without warning, otherwise seemingly innocuous ground erupts with pillars of flame all along the path.

title: [Hollowlair, Dreadgrounds]
description: Amidst the spikes of granite that pierce the ground, there are massive shards of obsidian, and here and there, impaled skeletons cling only by the arrangement of their bones to the tips of the protrusions.  Ripples of heat roil into the air from the ground, and every trembling through the dirt threatens an eruption of flame.

title: [Hollowlair, Dreadgrounds]
description: Weapons long abandoned, rusted and bent, litter the ground as far as the eye can see, which is limited by the amount of smoke and distorting waves of heat in the air.  Smaller buildings topped with horned and spiked fortifications are occupied now only by the flames that can be glimpsed through the windows and doorless entries.

Inset torches flanking the door burn with crimson flames that hiss and whisper with the syllabant voices the damned.

title: [Hollowlair, Dark Sanctuary]
description: Free from the hellish landscape beyond the sealed door to the south, the chamber is more tranquil than it appears to be.  A towering sculpture in the likeness of Marlu dominates the center of the sanctuary -- crafted from glossy black marble, time has worn its way through the rock, causing severe damage.  Much of its left wing and shoulder lie strewn across the western side of the room.  An archway to the north serves as the only exit.

title: [Hollowlair, Dark Shrine]
description: Dominating the rear wall of the chamber is a carving striving to escape the unfathomable slab of black marble.  Marlu, features contorted into a countenance of rapturous furor, is caught mid-lunge, barbed tentacles grasping the edges of the wall as if it were possible to tear himself free of the carving.  Beneath his gaze is a gore-slathered altar, atop a rusted metal grate strung with ribbons of decaying flesh.  The smell is inescapable, except perhaps through an ebon gate beneath Marlu's demonic visage.

title: [Hollowlair, Den of the Fiend]
description: Channels burrowed into the walls, floor, and ceiling of the chamber house black marble tentacles, carved and barbed with razern.  The entire room appears caught within the Ur-Daemon's grasp, with Marlu's form looming over it.  Manacled and shackled chains line the walls, are mounted to the ceiling and floor, which is marked by a series of drains.  From the horrific stench, undoubtedly a result of the fetid and festering flesh on the restraints and clogging the drains, there seems to be no escape other than a barbed stone door.

title: [Innoscents Lost, Showroom]
description: Dim light filters in through the open shutters of a large glass window flanked by a pair of unlit sconces to illuminate the room in a dull, gray glow.  A large wool rug is laid out in the center of the room with a pair of over-stuffed couches set on it.  Next to the couches, a large river rock fireplace serves as the central focus of the room with a wood bin dutifully placed beside it.  Almost as an afterthought, a glass display case and a dark mahogany table have been placed against opposite walls with their wares illuminated in an amber light by a pair of candelabras.

Two lit sconces flanking a shuttered glass window illuminate the room in a dull, amber light.  A large wool rug is laid out in the center of the room with a pair of over-stuffed couches set on it.  Next to the couches, a large river rock fireplace serves as the central focus of the room with a wood bin dutifully placed beside it.  Almost as an afterthought, a glass display case and a dark mahogany table have been placed against opposite walls with their wares illuminated in an amber light by a pair of candelabras.

title: [Innoscents Lost, Workroom]
description: Bright and airy colors cover the walls of this room, their hues made dull and lifeless by the twilight light from a round glass window.  Beneath the window, a modest desk has been placed with a small bed sitting beside it.  Several chairs have been arranged against the wall for guests to take a respite.

title: [Gavelsdown Hall, Parlor]
description: Twilight hues spill through the open windows, giving the dimly light room a bruised appearance that is vivid contrast to the plush carpeting and gold fixtures.  High-backed leather armchairs are arranged in social circles throughout the space, while an elaborately carved cabinet occupies a space along the back wall.  The thick scent of cherry tobacco fills the air.

title: [The Roof Over]
description: Slanting at an absurd angle, the roof of the shop is attached on the eastern edge to a wall that is two fomorians high, while barely tall enough for a coblynau to the west.  Diagrams and building plans decorate the walls, each with a corresponding note or label stating "Dream Home" or "Wishes" in a bright green calligraphy.  Access to windows is blocked by the various towering bookcases that line the walls, though the floor is largely free of debris.
