The collapsed ceiling leaves the zenith of the tower open to the daylight, which blazes in cruelly.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Ward]
description: Hiding in the shadows of the high curtain wall, the kennels are dark and silent, the yips and cries of dogs a conspicuous absence.  Part of the flagstone path diverts toward the building, an open-air collection of grated cages with a veranda anchored to the interior wall.  There is a long trough before it to water the dogs, but the leftover water has a skim of black and green moss across it.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Kennels]
description: Wrought iron cages, eaten away by rust, are empty of the creatures that once called them home.  All that is left behind are beds of mouldering straw and the crumbling remains of a pottery water dish lying on its side in the shadows.  Even the smell of dog has abandoned the open-air kennel, leaving naught but the whispers of the breeze to occupy the place.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Ward]
description: A pair of heavy stone doors is set into the ground at a slight angle, guarding the entrance to a vault or storeroom beneath the castle.  Heavy beams hold the doors shut, secured by thick silver nails.  The path proceeds past the blockaded entrance, passing a spray of dried blood on the wall nearby.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Entrance]
description: Vaulting grey stone doors mark the entrance of the castle.  Panels on each depict a briar sprig and rising moon, though the images are difficult to pick out on the dark surfaces.  Two colossal grotesques stand on plinths to either side of the entryway, their horned heads bent as if in reverence and their wings folded.  One's mouth is carved in an unsavory smirk.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Antechamber]
description: Forbidding pillars of charcoal grey marble support a cathedral ceiling that is limned with an elaborate mural of a night sky alive with a fall of bright crimson petals.  From the support arches are strung banners bearing the rising moon and briar sprig of the house.  Two suits of full plate armor, far too tall and broad to be other than display pieces, stand guard over the grey stone doors leading out into the castle yard.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Pond]
description: A decorative pond stretches along the front of the castle, the water cold and murky.  Rising gently over the waters, a bridge of dark, rough-hewn stones arcs to the northeastern shore, where the flagstone path toward the castle entrance continues.  Around the shores of the pond, the grasses grow thick, competing with hardy reeds for space.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Grand Hall]
description: Candles gloriously illuminate the polished stone surfaces of the castle's grand hall, a cavernous chamber that proceeds to the east and west.  There are dozens adorning a singularly immense chandelier that hangs overhead, a three-tiered confection of gold and ruby.  Huge marble floor tiles reflect the honeyed light, save at the center of the room, where jeweled tesserae form a mosaic of the house's briar sprig and rising moon sigil.  Ahead, massive double doors open onto a stone passage.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Passage]
description: Walls rise high to either side of the passage, culminating in a graceful arch that is mostly lost to the shadows far above.  Torches burn in sconces flanking the walkway, throwing back the immediate darkness and filling the hall with acrid smoke.  More plentiful light, that of countless flickering candles, pours in via a pair of stone double doors leading out into an expansive chamber.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Grand Hall]
description: Galleries look down on the vastness of the grand hall.  Their gilded railings are brightly polished, glistening in the reflected light of dozens of candelabra on plinths near the room's edge.  Banners and silken flourishes spill lushly from beneath each balcony, softening the severity of the stone construction.  To the west, a black marble archway opens onto a hallway with dark crimson runners.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Vomitory]
description: The hallway is lined with dark crimson runners that mute the sound of footsteps.  They match the reds of the drapes that hang from the walls, softening the severity of the stone construction.  Portraits of finely dressed women, men, and children hang from the spaces in between the spills of fabric, baubles winking from their throats and hands an ostentatious display of aristocratic wealth.  The carpet leads through an arched opening to the west, passing by an unobtrusive steel door.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Dungeons]
description: Seated in a brass candleholder, a candle burns atop an elmwood desk positioned by the door leading out of the dungeons.  Feeble and flickering, the light just barely manages to hold back the oppressive weight of the gloom that roosts in the castle's dungeons.  The sweetness of its beeswax does little to hide the stench of death and rot wafting from the cells proceeding into the darkness.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Theater]
description: Red-upholstered seats fan out to either side of a wide aisle, down which flows a scarlet carpet with dark grey piping.  The walls are ornate murals of swirling petals adrift on a breeze and look as if they are flowing toward the stage.  Several candles burn in nooks along the walls, casting the house in a burnt orange glow like that of the sky at dusk.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Stage]
description: At the aisle's end, red-upholstered chairs fan out before the foot of a wide, crescent-shaped stage, providing ample but intimate seating.  Chandeliers of gold, diamond, and garnet hang from the high ceiling, their glittering adornments reflecting a constellation of colored lights on the walls.  Near to the steps leading up to the stage is a small door.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Backstage]
description: A vanity with an attached mirror, just one of several along the far wall, sits near the stage door.  Several candelabra light the small, immaculately clean space, which smells faintly of powder and greasepaints.  Near the back of the chamber, a rack holds several wigs made from real hair.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Sunroom]
description: A spacious sunroom is sequestered from the grand hall by lush silken curtains that are the color of fresh-spilled blood.  Opposite the draperies, a wide stained glass window allows in daylight, the grey and scarlet panels staining the radiance with jeweled colors.  Near to a velvet fainting couch, a semicircle of chairs sits facing away from the windows.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Grand Hall]
description: Starlight creeps through stained glass windows that dominate the eastern wall, the tenuous light reddened by the colored panes.  It illuminates a raised dais on which are set tables and seats that watch over the hall.  To the north, the high ceilings rise in parallel with a series of steps that climb toward an ostentatious chamber.  No less grand is a jeweled archway to the east.  Opposite the steps is a smaller, less impressive arch framing the entrance to the kitchens.

Daylight filters uncertainly through stained glass windows that dominate the eastern wall, stained fiercely red by the colored panes.  The windows illuminate a raised dais on which are set tables and seats that watch over the hall.  To the north, the high ceilings rise in parallel with a series of steps that climb toward an ostentatious chamber.  No less grand is a jeweled archway to the east.  Opposite the steps is a smaller, less impressive arch framing the entrance to the kitchens.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Chapel]
description: Twin candelabra to either side of the jeweled archway illuminate the chapel.  Ceiling murals display scenes of winter and snow-swept landscapes, broken into vignettes by an impressive array of high arches.  An alcove along the northern wall is given over to an immense organ whose brass pipes occupy the surrounding walls.  Between pews, a center aisle lushly carpeted in scarlet and charcoal proceeds eastward and up to a colossal statue of white marble.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Passage]
description: The smoky, torchlit passage splits to either side of a grand staircase of grey stone and deep crimson bloodwood that ascends grandiosely to the second story of the keep.  There, upper banisters fly banners in scarlet and grey.  A framed archway to the northwest reveals glimpses of long shelves crowded with old tomes, while a mirroring path to the northeast dovetails into a spectacular gallery hung with a dazzling selection of artworks.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Upper Hallway]
description: A stone and bloodwood staircase climbs to the second story of the keep, the natural beauty of its ruddy wooden inlay complemented by the grey-trimmed scarlet runners at its center.  Beeswax candles stand in arched nooks along the tenebrous stone walls, illuminating a trio of hallways leading to the castle's living spaces.  The shortest path, to the north, is softened by a dark red carpet with bright golden tassels.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Library]
description: Floor-to-ceiling bookshelves of dark-stained Ossian pine flank the arched entrance of the library, over which hangs a carved plaque.  Several tables sit in a clearing among the looming shelves, cluttered with open tomes and sheaves of paper.  The windows are imbued with swirls of carmine color that blunt the brilliance of the moonlight streaming in at the cost of staining it vividly red.

Several tables sit in a clearing among the looming shelves, cluttered with open tomes and sheaves of paper.  The windows are imbued with swirls of carmine color that blunt the brilliance of the daylight streaming in at the cost of staining it vividly red.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Library]
description: Positioned between two wide picture windows is an ancient Olbin spruce scroll rack.  The scrolls within give off a scent that is both acrid and dry, a strange commingling of sour preservative and dusty old parchment.  Sinuous patterns in scarlet swirl through the window panes, making the rack look as if it is at the center of an eruption of color.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Library]
description: Books and neatly stacked scroll tubes cram every crevice of the shelves above and to either side of a yawning fireplace of crimson-shot grey marble in the western wall.  Comical grotesques cavort before the hearth as if in celebration of its majesty, their features wildly varied but similar in that none stand more than a foot tall.  Encircling the fireplace is a ring of comfortably upholstered chairs in the same scarlet and grey hues as the window curtains.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Gallery]
description: Near the mouth of the gallery, a portrait in a brilliantly gilded frame looks down at the walkway with a bemused smile on her face.  The painting depicts a surpassingly beautiful woman framed against a quay tossed by storms.  Drapes have been drawn over the broad picture windows along the hallway, and the light of the torches on the opposite wall makes the eyes of the figure seem to dance with secret amusement.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Upper Hallway]
description: Comical grotesques cavort in every other arched nook along the walls, each holding a burning candle aloft.  Combined, the flames lend a honeyed, inconstant glow to the hallway, which comes to an end in a dark-stained pine door carved with falling sweetbriar petals and tangled thorns.  A trio of jagged gouges defaces one of the empty nooks and has dislodged a few of the stones used in their construction.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Quarters]
description: An oversized four-poster bed occupies the far wall of the room, which is appliqued with patterns of falling sweetbriar petals in dark paint.  Ghostly veils of lace hang from the bed's curtain rods, making it look as if swathed in pale mist.  Near to the door sits a heavily adorned chest with a gilded padlock, its wrought golvern frame taking the form of interlocking brambles.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Upper Hallway]
description: Heavy curtains block the starlight from streaming through vast windows along the eastern wall, necessitating the candles carried by grotesques in arched nooks along the walls.  The small, comical gargoyles bend as if to surveil a dark-stained pine door, which is etched with a spread-winged raven surrounded by falling feathers.  A grey-trimmed scarlet carpet runs up to the foot of the door to soften the cold stone of the walk.

Heavy curtains block the sunlight from streaming through vast windows along the eastern wall, necessitating the candles carried by grotesques in arched nooks along the walls.  The small, comical gargoyles bend as if to surveil a dark-stained pine door, which is etched with a spread-winged raven surrounded by falling feathers.  A grey-trimmed scarlet carpet runs up to the foot of the door to soften the cold stone of the walk.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Quarters]
description: A steaming bath, its waters likely piped from a water source below the castle, is set into the floor of the spacious chamber, ringed by a collection of lazing grotesques that are taller than a handspan.  The other half of the long room is dedicated to a sprawling bed heaped high with furs.  Separating the two, a long ash dresser is carved with bramble patterns.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Upper Hallway]
description: At the end of the hallway stands an imposing bloodwood door carved with a moon and bramble sprig that is heavy-laden with thorns and berries.  Blazing torches to either side cast the planes of the door in harsh, dancing light, making the shadows of its carvings stretch long and strange.  Along the walls, bas-reliefs of weeping women in tattered gowns lend a funereal cast to the walk.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Master Suite]
description: A high ceiling with raw timber rafters crowns the vast antechamber of the master suite.  Brilliantly illuminated by dozens of beeswax candles, the room's windows are smothered by heavy curtains of dark crimson velvet, the draperies marked with the same moon and bramble sigil as a heavy bloodwood door.  Along one wall, a luxuriant couch lazes, bright scarlet pillows vivid against its dark leather surface.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Atelier]
description: Waxen candle stubs cling to their sockets in a golden candelabrum like destitute lepers, providing the only stable source of light in the dim studio.  Covered canvases gather in the shadows of the room, most shrouded in velvet.  The burled maple paneling of the floor is coated in a layer of silvery dust.  In the room's center, a portrait is limned in shades of ash rose and dusky gold, the feminine figure within turned away from an ornate gilded steel door in the eastern wall.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Study]
description: Beneath heavily curtained windows, a writing desk is scattered with letters.  Atop it, a heavy brass stamp lies on its side, still caked with grey-swirled crimson wax.  Candles burn in nooks and in several clusters on the stone floor but not in sufficient numbers to raise the illumination beyond a wavering golden glow.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Gallery]
description: Among the various portraits and landscapes occupying the northern wall of the gallery, a tastefully framed artwork is given pride of place.  The hoarbeam-framed portrait depicts a man with raven locks charging into the fray on horseback, his sturdy mount bloodied from battle.  Candlelight makes the flames of warfare in the background seem to flicker and lick at the night sky beyond.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Gallery's End]
description: The gallery comes to an end beneath a gilded arch that is gratuitously decorated with bramble carvings.  Alone on the wall beneath it is an ebony-framed portrait that depicts a proud, pale man holding a goblet of wine aloft.  Censers of thick, sweet smoke hang from the ceiling near the picture on steel chains, making it look more of a shrine than an art display.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Dining Room]
description: Beneath the light of a tiered chandelier hung from the pine-paneled ceiling, a massive bloodwood table hosts an ostentatious banquet on trays of bone and porcelain.  Each place setting at the table has heavy golden utensils that are freshly polished and devoid of even a speck of dust.  A burled arch in the far wall frames a swinging door through which fleeting glimpses of an immaculate kitchen are visible.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Kitchens]
description: The fires of the kitchen hearths burn bright, filling the air with stifling warmth.  Roasting on spits are haunches and limbs of unidentifiable origin that give off a rich, savory scent.  Meticulously kept, counters of grey marble hold racks of fresh spices, cutting boards, and a wide variety of cooking utensils ranging from knives to copper pots.  A swinging door in the western wall leads to an extravagant dining chamber.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Throne Room]
description: Opulent chandeliers adorned with firedrops and duskjewels hang high overhead, casting sharp-edged shards of colored light on the lush velvet runners of the throne room.  They climb several sets of decorative steps toward a gilded throne that sits beneath a livid scarlet banner stitched with a briar sprig before a charcoal grey moon.  Smaller seats that are no less opulent sit in a crescent, with the elevated throne situated at the zenith.  Crossed swords on the wall gleam with fresh polish.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Chapel]
description: Jewels of multifarious hues encrust a sphere suspended from the ceiling, casting a prismatic storm of colors over the cold features of an aged bone statue.  The figure stands atop a raised dais draped in black velvet, the pooling spills of which look almost liquid in the radiance.  Behind her, a mural on the wall depicts a vast black gate with only shadows beyond.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Pantry]
description: Little separates the pantry from the kitchens beyond a stone half-wall that is lined with containers of dried spices and burlap bags full of salt and flour.  Wheels of cheese, the size of a small child, sit atop blocky tables, and cured legs of meat swing from the arched ceiling.  Several barrels of mead and wine sit in one corner, but they are dusty with disuse.  Behind one barrel, a stairwell descends into the floor.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Larder]
description: Intense cold embitters the air of the expansive larder, a basement dug into the earth beneath the castle and surrounded by imposing walls of black rock.  The carcasses hanging from the low ceiling are still but untouched by rot, the subterranean frigidity helping keep decay at bay.  One corpse looks to have been bipedal.  Several barrels of brined fish in one corner lend a salty aroma that keeps the air sharply fresh.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Wine Cellar]
description: Barrels of wine occupy wrought iron racks that travel from floor to ceiling in the frigid cellar.  A silvery layer of dust clings to even the newest barrel, a cask of syrah from Talador.  Shelves along the eastern wall are home to glinting bottles of rarer vintages, the glass's colors ranging from deep red to gentle green.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Service Door]
description: Crates and barrels of a variety of woods and makes crowd along the walls but leave an open aisle leading up to some reinforced double doors that open out onto the castle ward.  Though shut and sealed, the containers offer tantalizing hints of the goods within.  A ribbon of incarnadine silk peeks from a slat in one crate, while a distinctive barrel is redolent with odors of honey, vanilla, and cinnamon.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Service Door]
description: Guarded by an abandoned watch post, an unimpressive servant's entrance occupies a bend in the castle's walls.  Crates and barrels, some emitting powerful aromas of rot and fetor, sit by a pair of double doors that lead into the castle.  One barrel has begun to leak, exuding a sappy black substance that stinks intensely of death.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Dungeons]
description: Cell after cell flanks the wide corridor leading to the far end of the castle dungeons.  Other than the occasional splinter of hay on the stone ground, the walkway is clean, with no obvious source to the horrific odor of rot lingering in the cold air.  At the end of the hallway hang several pairs of shackles, the metal freshly polished.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Ward]
description: To the northwest, the flagstones grow scarcer before giving way entirely to a narrow dirt trail that proceeds under an arch of sweetbriar into the gardens.  The paved walkway continues eastward, bending closer to the castle.  A wagon nearby is unattended, its bed full of grey and decomposing vegetation, though whether the refuse began as weeds or flesh plants for the garden is unclear.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Gardens]
description: A babbling spring feeds a small, cold pool that is surrounded by an abundance of thriving greenery.  It looks like it has been some time since the hands of a gardener pruned a branch or plucked a weed.  Dwarf mountain ash trees have spread thickly gnarled roots through the earth and litter the ground with bright red berries.  The blossoms of sweetbrier and wolfsbane seem to be competing with one another for brilliance of color.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Ward]
description: Birds have nested in the horns of one of the grotesques overlooking the flagstone walk.  His mouth, a spigot for rainwater runoff from the castle walls, is choked with brambles, the eager greenery having grown down the piping in an unending quest for sunlight and sustenance.  Altogether, the monstrosity looks absurd, and the glower on his face makes it look as if he knows it.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Ward]
description: Briars cling to the walls of the castle, growing thickest at the base.  Ambitious branches, heavy-laden with red blossoms and vicious thorns, have climbed as far as the second story, finding ample purchase in the cut stones of the keep's facade.  The flagstone walk proceeds past the overgrowth, giving wide berth to the shadows of the deepest thickets.

title: [Barrow, Entrance]
description: Painted scenes adorn the walls of the barrow near the entrance, which allows gelid moonlight to filter into the stony surroundings.  The paintings are crude at first, depicting strange nautical settings and scenes of battle and death, but the artistry refines as the images proceed further into the cave.  A scattering of bones clogs the pathway.  Some still have flesh on them, and none have yellowed with age.

title: [Barrow, Corpse Walk]
description: Dried and dusty corpses litter the ground as if dumped from the hollows that honeycomb the walls.  Most look to have been half-krolvin, their dried skin possessing bluish or grey hues.  One niche holds a recently deceased body, the colors of its flesh not yet muted by death.

title: [Barrow, Corpse Walk]
description: The cold is intense as the burrow's tunnel proceeds deeper into the earth, flanked by niches full of corpses new and old.  Air whistles through the tunnels in low moans, knife-sharp, but its chill keeps the odor of death to a low sickly sweetness.  Bootprints disturb the loamy earth, the patterns too distinct to have been there for long.

title: [Barrow, Corpse Walk]
description: Hideous symbols in blood mar the honeycombed walls of the barrow, the sinister luminescence throbbing from the sigils less bright but steadier than the flicker of torchflames lighting the path.  Blazing in unnatural reds and violets, the torches proceed toward an arched opening to the southwest.  The fire almost manages to hold back the oppressive cold of the frozen earth.

title: [Barrow, Altar of the Tenth]
description: A large, circular chamber yawns at the barrow's end, lit by roaring violet and crimson flames roaring from torches in sconces around the room.  Crudely carved from porous black stone is a squat, misshapen figure with membranous bat-like wings.  He stands atop a defaced altar of crimson-stained stone.  Staring down at the scene is a three-faced etching in the wall that has been slashed and raked so badly as to be almost unrecognizable.

title: [Consortium, Lobby]
description: The entrance of the Darkstone Bay Consortium is grand, with an expansive lobby that stretches far and wide.  There is plentiful wall space in which rows of cushioned chairs rest, providing a comfortable option for those waiting to conduct business.  Huge arched windows and a rustic wrought iron chandelier bathe the area with an ample amount of light.  A thick deep blue carpet runs from a pair of iron-bound doors and ends near a high dark elm desk where a lithe blonde-haired elf sits.

title: [Consortium, Atrium]
description: The area opens into a large spherical chamber, which is topped with a high dome glass ceiling.  Dark oak trees stretch up from the center of the atrium, their thick branches piercing through the sunlight gleaming down from above.  Rows of verdant green hedges run a border beneath walls of high glass windows, and a pair of mahogany doors sits between two greystone fountains.

title: [Consortium, Exchange Hall]
description: Dark wooden posts support the high ceiling of the exchange hall, which houses several wooden tables and chairs, many arranged in circles to offer plenty of space to allow conversations and trade to occur.  Heavy brocade curtains are pulled back along each wall to provide just enough light to seep in through a collection of large glass windows.  The wooden floor has lost its polish and is now marred by countless scuff marks from boots.

title: [Consortium, Envoy Post]
description: Ornamental monir pillars line the room on each side, framing a spacious carved stone table surrounded by wrought iron chairs.  Partitioned from the main meeting space, nooks of opulent ivory leather booths face an immense pane of glass that looks out on the exchange hall below.  Tall ferns and potted greenery loom over blue cushioned couches, their foliage providing a secluded place to relax.  Positioned against a statement wall of brushed muted copper is a tessellated mistwood credenza.

title: [Consortium, West Hall]
description: Dark-paneled walls encompass the length of this hallway, with its floor a stretch of burnished grey wood.  Modwir-framed portraits are staggered along one wall, each one depicting the face of several founders.  A polished statue of a red marble lion is perched at the side of a wide staircase leading up.

title: [Consortium, Founder's Hall]
description: Wide-paneled windows provide an expansive view of West Ring Road and the palisade walls of Wehnimer's Landing, with the trees of the Dragonsclaw forest rising in the distance.  Plush deep blue carpet runs the length of the floor and ends before a small step that leads to a tall modwir door.

title: [Consortium, Lounge]
description: A tall modwir door is nestled between two wide bookcases, which house hundreds of tomes.  Opposite of it rests a half-circle of plush sofas, each one centered around a low gnarled oak table.  The sweet aroma of vanilla emits from several candles behind a polished slate-topped bar.

title: [Consortium, Garden]
description: Cherry blossom trees provide a canopy of airy pink blooms over stone benches that line the pebbled paths intertwining around vibrant wildflowers.  Keeping guard over the garden, a patinated bronze fountain, boasting two carved lions, pours off into a water lily covered pond below it.  Multi-hued flora dot the landscape, adding pops of color to the lush grass and shrubbery.  In a quiet corner, an ivy-wrapped mistwood pergola suspends glass jars at varied lengths that house assorted flowers.

title: [Consortium, Trophy Room]
description: Scissor trusses made of dark monir run parallel along the ceiling, creating a vaulted roof to this vast room.   An annular chandelier composed of various antlers dangles from the center of the space and competes for the focal point of the area against a cobblestone fireplace.  Trophies of hunts from the past decorate the paneled blue walls, their lifeless expressions still holding their ferocity.  A petrified tree stump sideboard runs along the back of cognac leather couches that occupy the floor.

title: [Consortium, East Hall]
description: Dark-paneled walls rise up along a smooth floor of burnished grey wood.  Light from the atrium shines in through a row of high arched windows, which cast a warm glow along several fel-framed paintings along one wall.  A polished statue of a red marble lion stands to the side of a wide staircase leading up.

title: [Consortium, Silver Gallery]
description: Plush deep blue carpet runs along the floor of the hallway, and several potted plants rest along the width.  Ornate silver sconces are set into the dark-paneled walls, their light mixed with the sunlight from wide window and brightening the area.  An oversized painting of Darkstone Bay hangs near a wide mahogany archway, from which the sound of revelry and clanking glasses echoes.

title: [Consortium, Baystone Parlor]
description: A circular bar counter dominates the center of the parlor, its slate-topped surface polished to a high sheen.  Racks of wine bottles and empty glasses hangs above it, and a purple-haired elven barmaid offers an almost genuine half-smile to nearby patrons as she converses with them.  Several miniature pewter lions are positioned along a dark blue baystone mantle that stretches over a blackened stone fireplace.  Round tables and chairs provide seating throughout the edges of the room.

title: [Consortium, Firefly Lounge]
description: Deeply cushioned cobalt-hued couches draped with lush snowcat pelts flank a tidy desk topped with petrified modwir.  A baystone-punctuated chandelier candelabra hangs directly above the workspace.  Densely planted vegetation in a variety of colorful pots draw attention toward a trio of arched windows set into the darkly paneled walls.  Several colorful cloaks hang on hooks beside the entry.

title: [Consortium, Souvenir Shop]
description: Outcurved around the room, emblazoned cobalt mistwood counters gilded in copper are topped by cream slate.  Monir walls decorated with cutout trestles contain shelves and cubbies nearly overflowing with a myriad of trinkets and knickknacks.  Glass display cases and wooden racks line the opposite walls against arched floor-to-ceiling windows. Spanning the counter space, a dark-hued vaalin ladder sits on a track, allowing access to harder-to-reach goods.

title: [Consortium, Chance Room]
description: Lacquered paneled walls encapsulate the room where heavy brocade curtains hang to the sides of several bay windows, which look out towards the western gate of town.  Curls of smoke drift lazily near some green felt-topped tables, where several visiting patrons are raucously engaged in games of dice and tiles.

title: [Consortium, Office]
description: Heavy brocade curtains partially cover a row of thick glass windows that overlook the atrium down below.  A curved maoral desk and chair sit in one corner, bordered by two oversized rune-etched armoires.  A plush red bear skin rug dominates the center of the floor and stretches beneath a massive lion's head mounted on the wall.

title: [Consortium, Assembly Hall]
description: The walls of the assembly hall are paneled with dark wood, and several thick blue rugs are spread about the sturdy wooden floor.  A stage rises up against the far wall, where several armchairs and a high podium stand.  The center of the chamber houses rows of cushioned chairs, and behind them hangs a crisp banner with the crest of a red lion before a crossed hammer and pick on a field of silver.

title: [Consortium, Black Hand Trading]
description: Arabesque-patterned copper tiles sweep across the ceiling complementing the sumptuous mazarine rug covering the floor.  Dominating the eastern wall is a colorful etched-glass map that sits opposite a series of bay windows.  Hushed whispers echo across the open floor plan as various business negotiations take place at modwir desks and plush chairs clustered together.  A cobalt velvet couch wraps around a corner, enclosed by a free-standing latticework iron bar.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Gardens]
description: The shadow of a lone yew tree stretches long and dark over the resplendence of the overrun garden's flowers, its boughs still white with trapped snowfall.  Old and wide-bodied, the tree has an immense trunk that is thick and ungainly, gnarled from long years of growth.  A thin path proceeds underneath the conifer's drooping, scratching branches, winding northeastward.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Gardens]
description: In a silent copse at the garden's edge, sheltered by the bend of the castle wall, there sits a single grave.  The briar roses heaped onto the mound of earth are fresh, dew frozen onto their dazzlingly red petals like a dusting of diamonds.  A single spent candle sits before the headstone, the sweetness of its beeswax almost lost in the perfume of the neighboring verdure.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Training Yard]
description: Stuffed opponents are driven onto stakes in the training yard.  Mildew spots the burlap figures, and the hay stuffing them has grown damp and fetid, lending them an ugly lumpiness.  A veranda extends out from the castle walls, lending cover to racks of weapons, armor, and shields, but from the deteriorating state of the arms, the effort to keep the elements at bay appears to have been in vain.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Training Yard]
description: A line of archery targets stands near to the castle walls, the painted bullseyes pocked with holes from past successes.  Lying abandoned in the high grasses, a bow with a broken bowstring sits as a remnant of a time before the yard fell into disuse.  Its wood is silvered and splintered from exposure and neglect.

title: [Xorus' Weaponry]
description: Varnished ebonwood walls rise from a speckled black marble floor.  Just above an open-mawed greater vruul statue hangs a portrait of Darkstone Castle, and a vaulted ceiling completes the picture.  A iron-bound ebonwood chest and a gold-veined black marble counter stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Xorus' Weaponry]
description: An old elven war banner hangs on one of the ribbed black willow walls, and a vaulted ceiling rises overhead.  An oily black kraken statue sits in one corner of a speckled black marble floor.  There is an elegantly carved oak armoire on one side of the shop and a twisted dark metal rack on the other.

title: [Xorus' Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an ebonwood beam ceiling, a framed lighthouse painting hangs on one of the ribbed black willow walls.  A carved mahogany box and an intricately carved ebonwood stand sit in opposite corners while a sphere-topped black marble fountain rests on a speckled black marble floor.

title: [Dantevian's General Store]
description: Beneath an ebonwood beam ceiling, a ruby-eyed grinning skull hangs on one of the varnished ebonwood walls.  A gilded maple table and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sit in opposite corners while a pile of striped throw pillows rests on a speckled black marble floor.

title: [Dantevian's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An engraved copper bin and a bamboo rack sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Dantevian's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An engraved copper bin and a flexible willow woven basket sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Arkati Aided, Sheru's Strike]
description: Enclosed by glossy mistwood walls, the shop features a bronzed drake sculpture in the center of its plank floor.  A midnight blue rising phoenix tapestry hangs under the beam ceiling.  Right near the front is a glass-topped mistwood counter and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet.

title: [Arkati Aided, Oleani's Orbs]
description: A huge fanciful mural of two entwined figures hangs on one of the pink-tinged creamy silk walls, and a soaring sunrise-painted ceiling rises overhead.  A magnificent Oleani statue cradling gemstone orbs sits in one corner of a lustrous ivory marble floor.  There is a stepped gold hexagonal display on one side of the shop and a candle-lit draped shrine on the other.

title: [Arkati Aided, Lorminstra's Love]
description: An Arkati pantheon painting hangs on one of the varnished ebonwood walls, and a vaulted ceiling rises overhead.  A tiered alabaster fountain sits in one corner of an enameled hardwood floor.  There is a gold-veined black marble counter on one side of the shop and a silk-lined display case on the other.

title: [Dara's Outfitting]
description: The broad sweep of the strewn pine floor is interrupted by a braided seagrass rug.  Halfway to the beam ceiling, a portrait of Darkstone Castle hangs on one of the knotty pine walls.  A gilded maple cabinet and an oval-shaped speckled marble counter are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Dara's Combat Gear]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on one side of the shop and a gilded maple table on the other.

title: [Dara's Magic Shoppe]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a vine-carved mahogany table on one side of the shop and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on the other.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Solarium]
description: Splendid organic lines of vaalin frame bulbous, misted glass panes that rise high overhead, culminating in an ogee formation, with many-rayed starburst chandeliers dangling at the peak.  Mistydeep riverstones encircle a shallow pool filled with lily pads, while a central seating area with blued wrought iron tables and chairs filters out into mossy, slate paths curving around the clumping lasimor specimen.  Whorl-spindled balustrades line a short series of steps toward the stained glass doors inset with a pair of pavonated peacocks leading back inside the keep.

title: [Ebonstone Manor, House Pub]
description: Lightly stained and heavily lacquered, an enormous tree stump surrounded by high-backed ebonwood chairs dominates the center of this gathering area.  Hand-painted and framed in solid gold, an elaborate map of Elanith rests above a large fireplace of pristine white granite blocks, and a dart board hangs on the wall off to the side.  Across from a well-used bar, a wide mantle serves as a prominent display for more than a dozen small crystal figurines, each carved into a different house crest.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: Stumps pepper the spacious clearing, as stacked logs leave evidence of their recent removal.  A grove of trees surrounds the area, leaving a natural palisade to add some security to the campsite.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: A line of silk pavilions casts a colorful array of numerous Imperial flags representing the different territories of the Empire.  Craftsmen work diligently outside their shops, the aroma of hops, meat, and freshly cut lumber consuming this division.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: Rugged canvas tents stand near the opening of the glade, as uniformed soldiers guard the entrance.  Knights wearing various Imperial crests heavily patrol the area, their clanging armor echoing throughout the Lower Dragonsclaw.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: A messenger holding a letter pauses a moment as they contemplate which direction to head before sprinting off down a worn path heading into the centralized camp.  Two soldiers rest near stacks of iron-banded barrels, helms tucked beneath their arms and flagons clenched in their hands, as they banter and laugh.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: A few children sit still, in a half-circle, before an elderly man who is perched upon a wide modwir stump, waving his hands about as he weaves a long tale to the enraptured audience.  Dappled moonlight leaks through the canopy of trees, illuminating the forest floor in a radiant glow.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: A roaring bonfire demands attention from the center of this temporary town, its coppery gold flames mesmerizing as they dance.  Rows of tents bordering the fire create purposeful pathways to other areas of the camp.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: Open wagons display weapons, clothing, and various goods for sale, allowing browsers to easily peruse the merchandise.  Shopkeepers tend to their wares and busy themselves creating a bustling atmosphere in this makeshift town.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: A thicket near the living quarters secures countless ropes as freshly laundered clothing hangs from them.  The bright scent of lemon soap lingers, but intermixes with smoke from the nearby fires.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: Burlap dummies on wooden stakes hang in an open field as soldiers fearlessly charge at them.  Shouts and hollers mimic the sounds of war as they reverberate throughout the meadow.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: A corral wraps around a clearing enclosing horses within its walls.  Stable hands escort the animals in and out of their pen, as the smell of hay is present on the breeze.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: At the end of the valley, trees creating an orchard take on a different hue and appearance.  Apples and pears ripe for the taking hang from their branches, providing an additional food source for the area.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: A squire rests next to a cooking fire, a sword half his size resting awkwardly against a log as he roasts a small squirrel in the nearby flames.  Wisps of charcoal-hued smoke curl and rise upwards, sending the alluring aroma of cooked meat and burning coals into the air.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: The sound of a woodpecker echoes throughout the forest and competes against the rhythmic noise of an axe against a tree.  Several giantmen, sweat darkening their tabards, grunt as they haul sharpened logs from the center of the field to pile near a series of wooden towers at the edge of the forest.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: Two elderly women huddle over a row of basins, taking turns as they dip clothes into the water, gossiping amongst themselves as they drag the garb against rugged washing boards.  A group of children engaged in a wooden sword fight frolic through the area, causing the women to pause and look on, before they run off.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: Numerous fire pits sit unattended outside faded canvas tents, their embers still faintly glowing despite the lack of flames.  The glimmer of metal flickers beyond the edge of the forest, accompanied by the clanking of armor as several Imperial soldiers continue their patrols.

title: [Post Haste]
description: The wood-planked walls of the wagon are covered in hand-penned parchments and sheets of vellum, interspersed with colorful sketchings and watercolor renderings framed in bamboo.  Several blanket-cradled containers are nestled between curios filled with knickknacks, each piece of furniture adorned with a variety of faded stamps.

title: [Presently]
description: The low-roofed wagon's walls are painted in a dizzying array of gold and purple harlequin patterns, the diamonds curving and wending about the walls to create a disorienting optical illusion that makes them appear warped and skewed.  Bright brass shelves climb from floor to ceiling on the far wall, stacked neatly with gaily colored wrapping papers and gift boxes, while a hammered brass bucket piled high with ribbons in a dazzling assortment of hues sits just inside the door.

title: [The Boo-Wery]
description: The narrow wagon has been decorated with tall curtains of green-on-ebon tartan, the excess fabric neatly folded upon the wood-planked floor below.  A lacquered mahogany tray encircled by sprigs of holly sits at the center of the room, displayed upon an overturned barrel branded with the name "Fryzel".  A display of carefully stacked ceramic steins flanks either side of the barrel, each unique drinking vessel painted with a variety of landscapes.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Crypt]
description: Recessed shelves of dust-laden stone stretch along the walls.  Skulls beyond count, of a variety of shapes and sizes, rest amid the dust, their empty black sockets staring sightlessly out at the crypt.  Spiderwebs form a funeral veil over the lifeless bones, wispy, tattered, and dangling detritus.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Crypt]
description: Standing guard over squared niches in the walls, the tall bronze statue of a bearded old man raises his rod over the passageway.  Behind him, the wall is etched with an ornate gate with flourishes like wings spreading from it to either side.  One niche near the mural once held bones, but they have mostly collapsed into chalky grit.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Crypt]
description: The stresses of the surrounding earth have left the wall of the crypt spiderwebbed with deep cracks.  Cold earth has pressed through and spilled onto the ground.  It litters shelves full of crumbling skulls and obscures the base of the wall, but the stone construction has managed to hold back the assault for now.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Crypt]
description: The shadows of the square-cut niches are nearly impenetrable, their oppressive darkness concealing all but the faintest hints of the remains within.  One skull has its fleshless features turned toward the aisle.  Scratch marks around one of its eyes indicate that a creature has made a nest within.  Cut into the stone of the floor, steps proceed northward, rising in a slow climb toward a raised dais at the center of the crypt.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Smith's Tomb]
description: A shallow series of steps mounts a raised dais at the center of the crypt.  Atop it is a carved coffin of old, stained marble, its sides etched with hammer and anvil devices.  Driven into the coffin at an angle is a rusted sword of once-fine make.  A flaking mural on the wall depicts four hands straining for a blade wreathed in a nimbus of light.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Crypt]
description: Gilt on an ancient painting gleams from the walls, though time has made the thin metallic layer peel at the edges.  Flanked by graves carved into the walls, the mural depicts golden, winged figures soaring above a gate that is blacker than the surrounding shadows.  A displaced skull lies on the ground, its empty eye sockets fixed on the artwork.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Crypt]
description: Empty niches stand behind a podium of black stone hoisting a hide-bound tome aloft.  The pale, mottled binding of the book is secured by chains that dangle a variety of heavy veil iron padlocks.  Footprints mar the dust caking the floor leading up to the podium.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Crypt]
description: Fingers of rime spread like a growth of moss along the wall, glistening like a dusting of diamond.  It clings to the edges of shelves full of disembodied skulls and glistens from the surfaces of coffins marching down the passageway.  The biting chill presses in from all around, amplified by the frozen earth surrounding the underground chamber.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Crypt]
description: An intense, burning chill suffuses the darkness of the crypt.  Braziers of ancient and corroded bronze stand on plinths before recessed niches in the walls, in which the bones of the long dead slumber.  Brittle, yellowed, and collapsing into dust from age, the remains are interred in once-fine armor that has similarly succumbed to the ravages of time.

title: [Baker's Shop, Sitting Room]
description: Generously padded chairs surround small glass-topped tables covered in silk tablecloths, and ceramic tiles continue along the walls from the front room, adding a complementary decor to the area.  A dimly-lit corner offers a more secluded gathering spot, away from the constant flurry of bakery visitors.

title: [Baker's Shop, Corner]
description: Elaborately illustrated depictions of historical events hang on a freshly painted wall, low enough to be viewed while seated at one of the padded chairs around the small table.  A pie-shaped candle flickers lazily, casting dancing shadows across the floor and infusing a sweet apple pie fragrance into the air.

title: [Baker's Shop, Tea Room]
description: A long table surrounded by upholstered stools separates two sides of this tea room, with one side serving as a place to visit and drink, and the other side specially designed to brew teas and coffee.  Situated adjacent to a sideboard is a small stove with a cast iron kettle placed on the top, and a pitcher of fresh water has been conveniently positioned on the sideboard next to a variety of condiments.

title: [Harbor Hideaway, Courtyard]
description: Star filled skies open above this square courtyard buttressed on either side by the colorful walls of neighboring structures.  Cobblestones circle outward from a central fountain, providing a paved surface between a beaded curtain and a wrought iron gate.  Dense foliage thrives in the corners of this secluded sanctuary.
location: Harbor Hideaway, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Trader Bjarnn's Yarn Barn]
description: Painted a deep red hue, the facade of a miniature barn obscures most of the cart it's nailed to, save for the hint of wooden wheels visible along the bottom edge.  Immovable doors, crossed with pristine white boards, flank a wide opening occupied by a yarn-stuffed metal trough festooned with a garland of mismatched knit socks.

title: [Darkstone Bay]
description: The jagged spires of the coastal cliffs rise up overhead as the Darkstone Bay floods in to eternally brush across the Black Sands beach. Nearby rocks glisten with the spray from the ocean, and the crashing of waves resounds nearby.

title: [Darkstone Bay]
description: The waters of Darkstone Bay are cold, made worse by the winds pushing against you.  The rocky walls of the coastal cliffs rise up to the west, as the murky waters continue endlessly to the north, connecting to the horizon.

title: [Darkstone Bay]
description: The waters of Darkstone Bay are cold, made worse by the winds pushing against you.  The rocky walls of the coastal cliffs rise up to the west, as the murky waters continue endlessly to the north, connecting to the horizon.

title: [Darkstone Bay]
description: A cold wind races across the surface of the bay, sending moisture and salt swirling about.  Beneath the waters, a large bed of kelp can be seen.

title: [Darkstone Bay]

title: [Darkstone Bay]

title: [Darkstone Bay]
description: The ocean swells rise up high, crashing down in loud splashes of water and foam.  Small bits of kelp float along the surface of the dark waters.

title: [Darkstone Bay]

title: [Darkstone Bay]

title: [Darkstone Bay]
description: In every direction the murky blue waters of Darkstone Bay spread out all around you.  Small waves rise and fall, sending ripples of foam and bits of kelp floating along the surface.  The silver glow of the moon cascades down, causing patches of the sea to almost gleam like metal.

title: [Darkstone Bay]
description: The ocean swells rise up high, crashing down in loud splashes of water and foam.  Small bits of kelp float along the surface of the dark waters.

title: [Trident's Voyage]
description: Thin lengths of fishing wire drape from one corner of the shop to the other, the nearly invisible threads suspending bamboo-framed lanterns shaped like colorful schools of fish, their dyed vellum scales covered in silver lacquer.  Overlapping scrolls of aged parchment cover the walls, inked with a nautical map of the continent's seaways, the teal waters dotted with various ships and sea creatures.  The faint scent of toasted spices wafts in from the northern area of the shop, followed by joyous singing.

title: [Trident's Voyage, Cafe]
description: Origami clouds and sea birds meander above a linen-draped natural blonde oak table, the sideboard encircled by several rope-strung chairs crafted from faded fishing nets.  Sea kale-encircled planters of fresh flora are scattered along the perimeter of the shop, each container flanked by a capybara-shaped watering can situated below rain chains of hammered copper.  The bamboo-set walls of the room display dozens of sketches, the drawings depicting life from Caligos Isle and beyond.

title: [The Mist and Shore Bakery]
description: Light and airy, the shop's interior features polished birch floors with matching shelves, cupboards, and counters, all filled with various baking and cooking goods.  A display case highlights numerous pastries and other delectables, and behind the main counter stands a diminutive baker.  One wall is covered in a detailed mural of an isle surrounded by turquoise seas, a haze of indigo mist lingering amidst the tiny village on its shores.

title: [Illuminate and Celebrate]
description: A trio of carved wooden trees decorates the far wall of the stall, crafted from planks of ivory-washed jadewood and wrapped in colorful velvet ribbons.  A two-tiered white pine stand sits above a soft bearskin rug, the second shelf containing a frosted lapis glass bowl wrapped in a knitted ivory paeline scarf, the floor below it scattered with glinting bits of confetti.

title: [Vornavis, Great Hall]
description: On a low dais, spanning the southern end of the hall, three regal chairs of state rest before an embroidered tapestry of the Rising Swan of Vornavis that covers the wall behind them.  Banners bearing the coats-of-arms of knights in service to the barony hang from the railing of the second floor gallery that lines the other three sides of the Great Hall.  Opposite the dais a pair of large fel doors, inlaid with gold scrolling, are set in the north wall.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: Smoke coils up from some nearby fire pits as dozens of settlers converge upon a boiling stew pot bordered by several logs.  Each passerby helps themselves to the ladle, filling their tin bowl before heading off elsewhere into the camp.  Stretching wide in a field across the way is a huge dusty brown canvas pavilion.

title: [Sablo's Pavilion]
description: Dark brown walls of canvas are pulled taut along several wooden posts, providing a wide center floor for the command pavilion.  A large cot occupies one corner, a heavy ermine blanket tossed haphazardly upon it.  Dominating the middle of the tent is a huge modwir table littered with dozens of maps, carved wooden miniatures, empty scroll tubes, and a shrunken skull paperweight.

title: [Imperial Campsite]
description: The area of the grounds here has been freshly cleared of trees, with rows of modwir trunks forming makeshift seating that surrounds a pristine white marble altar.   Aromatic incense oil burns within some faceted glaes-paneled lamps nearby, infusing the area with a mix of lavender and cedar.

title: [Commodore Hall]
description: This large room opens up to a generous view of the bay through a trio of floor to ceiling windows.  Dominating the room is a circular raised-map carved table surrounded by high-backed velvet upholstered chairs.  Above, the beams of the vaulted oak ceiling display a large, split-color flag, while off to the western corner a roped-off staircase leads to the floors above.  Standing opposite the stair is a detailed diorama, beside which sits a stack of tea crates branded with an onyx rose.

title: [Sea's Crossing]
description: Flanked by folded shutters, wide-open windows devoid of glass allow the tropical air to filter through the small storefront that is illuminated by the warm starlight.  Smooth oak floors support a wide glass-fronted counter, while dark pine and teak planks cover the walls where a series of shelves are anchored by wrought iron supports.  The keel of a small sailing vessel has been cleaved in twain to form the exiting archway.

title: [Logging Colony, Tig's Barn]
description: Patches of mud, dried and cracked on the edges, dominate the entry to high-ceilinged stables, while sash windows tilted open allow the coastal air to slip through the humid confines.  Tidy bales of hay, straw, and rushes surround support posts that are evenly spaced down the various lanes.  The whiny and nickering of stalled animals fills the air.

title: [Tig's Barn, Eastern Flank]
description: Sash windows propped open with sticks and wedges line the southern, while a hardpacked threshing floor smoothly transitions from the muddy edges of the barn's entrance to the west.  Oak support posts keep the slanted ceiling aloft and are surrounded by barrels of rainwater and oats.  The soft sound of rustling and snorting is a reminder that animals are housed nearby.

title: [Tig's Barn, Western Flank]
description: Sash windows propped open with sticks and wedges line the southern, while a hardpacked threshing floor smoothly transitions from the muddy edges of the barn's entrance to the east.  Oak support posts keep the slanted ceiling aloft and are surrounded by barrels of rainwater and oats.  The soft sound of rustling and snorting is a reminder that animals are housed nearby.

title: [Sailcloth Findings]
description: The cramped quarters of this small shop are made to seem even smaller by the inclusion of several half-body mannequins modeling wares and mounted to the upper walls above various shelves and display tables.  Armless and legless, the torsos pitch just a bit forward, looming and held in place with rope and rigging that looks suspiciously like a sailor is responsible for the knots.  At the rear of the shop is a short counter, scarred and discolored with age, scattered with knickknacks.

title: [Kraken's Fall, River]
description: Cozied up along the riverside in a picturesque scene is a small cobblestone cottage with a steadily spinning oak waterwheel and barn.  Large oak and pine trees stand tall beyond the cottage, scattered within their depths is a large herd of cattle grazing upon the lush green grass.  A cacophony of cattle, pig, chicken, and goat calls echoes throughout the tree line, though it becomes drowned out near the burbling river.

title: [Riverside Grocer, Storefront]
description: Coarse, unstained planks of oak with pine trim line the four walls of this tiny, single-storied storefront.  Badly frayed fishing nets dangle from the ceiling rafters, scattered with cracked oyster and scallop shells tangled within the fibers.  A smooth, honey-hued oak counter with various bagged and boxed goods rests against the back of the room below a cherrywood-framed mural of Caligos Isle.

title: [Absolute Scentsibility]
description: From rustic riverstone walls hang several paintings of lushly forested landscapes, and handwoven rugs are scattered about the wood floor, their brightness adding splashes of color to the shop.  Behind the counter, out of reach of wandering hands, are shelves filled with vials and bottles and work tables covered with plants in various stages of preparation.  A leaf-painted piece of parchment hangs near the counter, and with each gentle stir of air, a new fragrance drifts across the shop.

title: [Forge and Hearth]
description: The mahogany planks comprising the shop walls are covered in copper-framed drawings of dense tree-covered woodland areas, the depictions varying through mediums of charcoal and paint.  Between the artwork are vertical diagrams of flatware and crockery, each piece carefully detailed in flowing calligraphy, the illustrations set alongside their matching counterparts across a glass-filled display.  A bare countertop of wood-framed stone sits at the back of the shop, unadorned save for an aged brass lamp.

title: [Onoir, Brother Sartarius Chapel]
description: Moonlight streams in through the clear crystal ceiling, casting long shadows across the rosewood floor towards the pulpit centered at the front of the room, the platform set before several pews.  Silver sconces frame tapestries across the chapel walls, the light sparkling across them like stars in the evening sky.  Soft murmurs of prayer and singing echo throughout the chamber, the sounds reverberating against a rosewood table by the onyx staircase, the table half-cast in shadow.

title: [Solhaven Grocer]
description: The narrow door gives way to the interior of the small shop.  Shelves line both of the side walls from floor to ceiling, each replete with jars, boxes, and containers of every sort to hold goods and staples.  Several lanterns hang overhead, providing soft warm light over the low tables that cover the floor.  A wide oak counter runs along the back of the store, with a ladder in one corner to provide access to hard to reach items.

title: [Landing Bazaar, Lawn]
description: The center of the bazaar opens into a wide grassy range, free of clutter and booths, the lush verdant meadow warmed by the moonlight above.  Townspeople gather nearby, some quiet and others boisterous as they travel between nearby shops and booths.  A cobblestone boulevard stretches to the north, bordered by several other roads and merchant structures.  Three large ironwood trees ascend at the edge of the yard, blanketing half of the area in darkness.

title: [Landing Bazaar, Boulevard]
description: A broad circle of russet cobblestones creates a wide courtyard, the space decorated with clusters of iron-wrought benches and tall leafy green trees.  Numerous roads lead off in every direction, each one eventually reconnecting to encircle the graveled expanse.  The brazen voices of hawkers reverberate from all corners, carried in from merchant booths and shops in the distance.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Landing Bazaar, Modwir Lane]
description: The bustling atmosphere of the market intermixes with the relaxing sound of water bubbling from a lion-carved stone fountain.  Vendors push carts up and down the cobblestone road, stopping occasionally to demonstrate their goods or to make a sale.  The intoxicating aroma of coffee permeates the area, originating from the direction of one of the establishments.

title: [Landing Bazaar, Baystone Byway]
description: A slender wooden post rises amidst some flowerbeds, hoisting a banner depicting an emblem of a red lion, its cloth crisp and wrinkle free.  Multi-colored canopies decorate the edges of the road, each boutique boasting different goods to sell.  Inside each tent, merchants peddle their wares, a mixture of boisterous exchanges echoing throughout the street.  The mixed aroma of smoked meats drifts out from the open window of a nearby brick-lined shop.

title: [Landing Bazaar, Baystone Byway]
description: Barrels of spices bearing brightly hued pigments line the outside of a bay window belonging to one of the shops.  Along the pathway, crates of fresh produce and exotic flora are displayed to lure shoppers further inside.  Children play nearby, the feeble clacking of their wooden swords muffled by the clanking metal of two red-armored guards patrolling the area.  A small dusty kitten mews at the base of a tall oak tree, its bright eyes falling upon a tiny nest tucked among its branches.

title: [Landing Bazaar, Modwir Lane]
description: A thicket of modwir trees surges along one edge of the road, creating a blanket of darkness to envelope the exteriors of a handful of shops.  Children run playfully along the store fronts, peeking into each colorful window display before moving on to the next one.  A muted tune hangs in the distance, originating from an elven minstrel perched upon the edge of a wrought-iron bench, politely thanking shoppers that toss coins into a jar at his feet.

title: [Landing Bazaar, Walkar Avenue]
description: Merchants busy themselves outside their pavilions, drawing large crowds to observe them work on their crafts.  Textiles of vibrant prismatic colors hang from a few posts of the outdoor shops, the fabrics eerily waving in the winds.  The constant clang of a hammer on metal reverberates from behind a large thatch-roofed building, a plume of dark smoke billowing upwards.  Several thin hounds dart about the street, scratching at barrels and pressing noses to the ground, fast on the trail of their next meal.

title: [Landing Bazaar, Walkar Avenue]
description: Each side of the lane is fringed with several sturdy shops, their smooth slate roofs capturing some of the glint from the moonlight above.  A pennant stitched with the image of a waraxe flaps about, tethered to a long wooden post that stretches above a carved sandstone statue.  A cluster of wrought-iron chairs and tables litter the outside, allowing customers a place to rest and watch the crowds.

title: [The Rhimar Rink, Entrance]
description: Modwir walls enclose the well-sized shop, their surfaces colored with a whorled pattern of deep and light blues.  Small child-sized handprints of white paint are scattered along the walls, each one containing a scribbled name, and shaped to resemble a falling snowflake.  A large window opens near the entrance, where a burly giantman greets visitors.  A crowd of onlookers stand on the outside of a half-walled arena, watching as several people skate along a stretch of ice.

title: [The Quick Prick]
description: Several glass display cases are staggered into three rows, each one spaced apart strategically to allow a wide berth for customers to pursue the gleaming inventory within.  Heavy black brocade curtains are pulled back from a large front window, making way for an abundance of moonlight to brighten the entire shop.  Wispy tendrils of flowery scented smoke drift across the vermillion-hued walls, as patrons move about after being greeted by a smiling curly-haired shopkeeper.

title: [Blended Brew, Front Room]
description: Aisles of tall, cognac mistwood shelves are stocked with a plethora of jars holding a colorful array of herbs, each labeled with the tea blend it contains.  Cutout trestles with shelves of ivory ash sit behind a sales counter, exhibiting tea kettles, cups, and saucers, the items varying in material and brightly painted colors.  Across from the carved white ash door, a moss and flora mural hangs from the back wall of the shop, its plant life lending an earthy smell to the floorspace.

title: [Blended Brew, Sitting Room]
description: Cushioned loveseats and decorative chairs in a color spectrum of green hues litter the open, airy floor plan.  Hand-painted silk walls depict abstract herbs and flowers cascading from ceiling to floor in a repetitive pattern.  Beams of moonlight stream through an arched window, the gossamer curtains lightly moving with the slightest hint of air as patrons walk by.  A white ash sideboard curves around an antique pewter stove topped with a gilt-foiled white ceramic kettle.

title: [The Blue Orchid]
description: Glass-paned lanterns hang from wooden beams along the ceiling casting a glow throughout the area.  The walls are decorated with several framed paintings of blue orchids, and a low counter is cluttered with an abundance of ink bottles and an assortment of needles.  Silk onyx curtains border a wide window, the display showcasing multi-hued stock tattoo drawings.  In the back, a muscular tattoo artist leans over a writing desk, an inked-hand diligently sketching a design on a piece of vellum.

title: [Relocated Reverence]
description: The walls of this simple shop are decorated with talismans and symbols of worship displayed on rows of small iron hooks.  Joined modwir counters block access to the walls, leaving just enough space behind them for a solemn green-robed pilgrim to wander between and attend to patrons who wish to make a purchase.  Hanging from the ceiling, a flickering lantern dangles from a rather ordinary iron chain.

title: [Patty's Cakes]
description: The small, white-walled shop holds the sweet mixed aroma of cinnamon, flour, and honey.  A trio of aproned halfling maids move hurriedly about the room, restocking the shelves between taking orders.  Several patrons shuffle about the store, perusing the variety of frosted pastries and other delicacies a freckle-nosed halfling baker sets upon a counter.

title: [The Rhimar Rink, Ice Arena]
description: A smooth landscape of hard ice stretches across the entire length of the circular arena.  Half-walls border the rink, providing both protection and a view for onlookers.  A crisp chill hovers in the air.

title: [Blended Brew, Smoke Lounge]
description: A cloud of clove-scented haze lingers over the top of corbeau leather armchairs that are clustered in dimly lit corners.  Wrapping around the lounge, an ornately carved modwir bar topped in a gilded viridian marble is attended to by a sharply dressed bartender.  Rows of velvet-padded stools line the counter, offering a view of the ledge housing bottles of liquid ranging from amber to honey-hued.  Backlit shelves angle downward to display cigar boxes and their contents behind walls of thin glass.

title: [Cavern Home, Junction]
description: A northwest/southeast corridor crosses a northeast/southwest corridor.  The gelatinous trails along the ceiling also cross, and bursts of energy coming from different directions sometimes pass without colliding.  At other times they arrive at the junction point simultaneously, doubling their illumination power for just a moment before continuing along the ceiling once more.  The rippled walls and ceiling cast no shadows, nor do they reflect the light in any great quantity.

title: [Cavern Home, Exhaust]
description: Bursts of cool air surge into the room from all four directions.  The gelatinous trail on the ceiling splits to move around a wide circular grating, and the passage of air gives the impression that it is sucked up through the grating to a place unknown.  Each puff of wind causes whatever is behind the grating to moan and whistle.  Aside from the grating and the gelatinous trail, the room is totally empty.

The electric blue lighting sparkles off the highly polished metallic sides, increasing the illumination in the room and intensifying the strobe effect.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Museum]
description: The roughly hewn obsidian walls and floor are a stark contrast to the polished finish of the rest of the tower.  Ornate sconces, lit from within by tall beeswax candles, adorn the walls at even intervals, their orange and red light flickering and dancing across the walls beneath the shadowed ceiling.  Two gnarled ebonwood trees flank a blackened display case and a crude shelf formed from rock jutting from the wall, while a pair of mannequins stand at attention on either side of the room.

title: [Marshal's Office]
description: This small, tidy room is sparsely furnished, with only a large desk in one corner, lit by a wall sconce and covered with various papers, letters, and maps.  A small footlocker sits in the corner of the room, and the walls are adorned with displays of different arms.  In the corner, a stand displays a gleaming suit of field plate armor.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Meeting Hall]
description: Several rows of oak casks line one side of this room, stacked from floor to ceiling.  Running down the other side of the space is a lacquered ebonwood bar at the perfect height for a dwarf.  At the far end of the room, a large fire pit is tended by a stout Khanshael pitmaster who is diligently attending to multiple spits of aromatic meat roasting over dancing flames.  A wide and well used table spans the length of the room's center, affording various Khanshael the chance to share tales, food, and drink.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Elder's Chamber]
description: The center of this room is filled by a large slab of intricately carved stone that serves as a desk.  Smooth rolaren and invar runes have been meticulously inlaid upon its surface detailing the history of past campaigns.  Behind the desk, three towering ebonwood chairs rest on a slightly elevated base, commanding the chamber.  The wall behind the desk presents a striking display of weapons and armors that have been carefully maintained in battle-ready condition.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Marroc's Lair]
description: A low arch opens into a spacious cave hewn from the obsidian foundation of the tower above.  Gauzy, sanguine bolts of silk are draped from the cave's high ceiling, lending a ruddy hue to the dim light.  Mounted on the wall opposite the entry is a large scaled hide, secured in position by small mithril spikes.  Along another wall is a raised obsidian dais above which is a small niche.  A thick pile of furs of various sorts overlays the platform, and a plush snow cat fur rug covers a portion of the floor.

title: [Garden Cottage]
description: The walls of the cottage seem to be a welcoming shade of green at first glance.  Then, curiously, as if the sunlight streaming into the expansive windows has changed at the whim of a drifting cloud, the walls shift in tone and appear more of a rich shade of blue than green.  A hand-painted mural covers the entire back wall.  Against a wall sits a teak credenza, framed by windows which offer a view of the gardens and trees outside.

title: [Garden Cottage, Bedroom]
description: The bedroom is furnished with a comfortable-sized bed crafted of bleached wood.  A soft patchwork quilt covers the bed, woven of soft lambswool.  White linen curtains billow gracefully at the open windows in the pleasant breeze, carrying in the clean smell of a stand of pines outside the sunlit room.  A bronze-accented trunk sits at the bed's foot, placed so that it doesn't obstruct the idyllic woodland scene woven into a wool rug covering the plank floor.

title: [Woodland Market]
description: Various bins, counters, and shelves overflowing with grocery staples line the white oak walls and pale blue tiled floors of the bright and airy market.  A sizable ceramic-topped cupboard is centered along the back, its shelves bursting with fresh baked goods.  Large glaesineth orbs hanging from the raftered ceiling fill the spacious room with warm light.

title: [Garrison, Lieutenant's Quarters]
description: This may have been a nice place to hang one's hat at one time, but now all the furnishings are gone.  Faintly, beneath some rust-colored stains, you can see parts of a crest on the wall.

title: [Garrison, Sergeant's Quarters]
description: A smashed weapon case and insect-ridden mattress are the focal points in the sergeant's sleeping quarters.  A looted display case probably once held the sergeant's medals and battle trophies.

title: [Garrison, Barracks]
description: Long and narrow, this barracks room once housed about two dozen soldiers in relative comfort.  All the bedding and furniture has long since been destroyed.  The remains of the soldiers do not seem to mind the mess in their once polished room.

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Being]
description: The Hall of Being stretches endlessly onward with no end in sight, impossibly long for a building of the library's size.  The endless maoral panelled walls are unembellished save amber glaesine wall sconces, which are evenly spaced down the corridor, providing dim illumination.

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Queens]
description: Deep black granite tiles are cornered with cabochons of pure blue lapis, and a detailed mosaic of a peacock with fully spread fan dominates the center of the floor.  Dozens of gilt-framed portraits of past Illistim rulers decorate the dark panelled walls, a testament to the longevity of the House.

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Being]
description: The Hall of Being stretches endlessly onward with no end in sight, impossibly long for a building of the library's size.  The endless maoral panelled walls are unembellished save amber glaesine wall sconces, which are evenly spaced down the corridor, providing dim illumination.

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Flora]
description: Deep green veined marble tiles spread across the expansive floor.  Thanot wall panelling is heavily carved with plants and flowers of all types.  Various semi-precious jewels, forming shimmering petals and leaves, have been inset into the floral carvings to great effect.  A low shelf lines the walls beneath the panelling, containing carefully preserved volumes.

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Being]

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Fauna]
description: Dark amber granite flooring reflects a dull sheen where light from the hanging glaesine globes overhead touches its surface.  Pale golden maoral bookcases exquisitely carved into the shapes of various beasts are set against the chamber's stone walls, each nearly touching the high ceiling of the chamber.

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Being]

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Glory]
description: Dark grey granite flecked with deep sapphire blue covers the floor, unembellished save a single silver diamond inlaid in the center of the room.  Silvery haon bookcases line the walls, their edges trimmed in thin hammered silver strips.  A carved haon longbow is mounted on one wall, a silver plaque beneath it.

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Being]
description: The Hall of Being stretches endlessly onward with no end in sight, impossibly long for a building of the library's size.  The endless maoral panelled walls are unembellished save amber glaesine wall sconces, which are evenly spaced down the corridor, providing dim illumination.

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Lore]
description: Deep green marble flooring is interrupted only by a lone black granite diamond pattern in the chamber's center.  Tall cases of books fill almost every inch of wall space along three walls.  The fourth is hung with a massive tapestry depicting the great hunt, detailing the scene of a long-ago king and his retinue triumphant over a vanquished foe.

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Being]
description: The Hall of Being stretches endlessly onward with no end in sight, impossibly long for a building of the library's size.  The endless maoral panelled walls are unembellished save amber glaesine wall sconces, which are evenly spaced down the corridor, providing dim illumination.

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Time]
description: The black granite floor tiles are speckled with tiny golden flecks that glimmer gently in the light from several amber glaesine sconces mounted on the silk-draped walls.  Circular shelves rest in the center of the room, carved of finely grained thanot and edged in gilded dahcres.

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Being]
