title: [The Drowned Boar, Patio]
description: A horrible bloated boar statue stands guard over the entrance of the crowded patio, which stinks of sweat, cigar smoke, and the heady sweetness of burning herbs.  Clouds of smoke puff from censers hanging from the low driftwood eaves straining toward the street.  A nearby table, one of the few not crowded with grizzled tradesmen with bloodshot eyes, has a mosaic top patterned with bright bits of colored glass.

title: [The Drowned Boar, Bar]
description: Smooth-worn floorboards spread throughout the crowded bar, cut from the same warped oak as the long wooden bartop sitting off to the side near the door.  A stool or three sit in front of the bar, their cushions tattered and water-stained but otherwise serviceable.  Underneath a huge bronze boar's head sprouting from the wall above the bar, a faded sign lists the establishment's offerings.

title: [The Drowned Boar, Nook]
description: The low eaves of the ceiling press down from overhead, each driftwood bar carved with random designs and scrawled obscenities.  A nigh-omnipresent haze of smoke lingers in the air, at turns heady and choking.  Hanging on the eastern wall is a colorful dart board that has seen better days.

title: [Featherfall Sanctuary]
description: Embraced by a viridian wall patterned with a whirlwind of snowy feathers, the chamber houses a circular depression ringed by a rise of concentric steps.  Only an illuminated panel breaks the white storm.  Standing at the heart of the sanctuary is a slender winged statue lathed by silver moonlight pouring through a skylight high above.  A low curved stone stands before the statue, spotted with candle wax and the ashy leavings of old incense.

title: [F2P Limbo]
description: You are in a F2P limbo area.  For more information, type HELP.

title: [Gathering Dahcre Chamber]
description: Starlight from alabaster skylights gently illuminates this comfortable room, casting a soft light on the many exotic plants growing here.  A profusion of heat-loving tropical vines twine about a white-veined green marble fireplace, their flower-laden tips nearly covering a silver looking-glass set above the mantel.  Pots of bright crimson and gold dragonstalks nearly obscure a pinewood bar flanked by a pair of white, green, and silver banners.  A brilliant green faenor medallion caps the painted trellis archway leading into the room.

description: Lustrous woods, ranging from blackest ebony to palest box, are joined to make the sinuous marquetry floor of this comforable room.  Rattan chairs with cushions upholstered in autumnal-hued tapestry are drawn up alongside an oak-framed fireplace, above which hangs a silver looking-glass in an oak-leaf patterned frame.  An ornately carved bar of inlaid fel runs along one wall, flanked by twin silver and black banners.  Almost obscured by the vines wrapped around the entry arch, a carmiln medallion reflects the firelight from its polished surface.

title: [Wine Cellar, Assembly Room]
description: Plush, navy blue wall-to-wall carpeting muffles the steps of any who enter the room.  Overhead, a softly swaying crystal chandelier emits soft chimes.  Numerous low-backed cushioned chairs fill the floor space and standing between each chair is a small table.  Resting in the center of each table are delicate vases, each holding a yellow rose.  At the head of the room, a podium stands on a slightly raised dais with an even number of seats on each side.

title: [Zul Logoth, Secret Cavern]
description: Rivulets of dank water drip down the walls, adding an eerie trickling sound to the ever-present *plink* of droplets smashing onto the cavern's stone floor at regular intervals.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Hallway]
description: Crafted entirely of silvery grey stone, the blocks fit together seamlessly creating the smooth passage walls.  Set into a shallow recess is a narrow archway covered with a peacock blue silk curtain.

title: [Moonglae Inn, Upper Cloister]
description: A covered walkway paved with dark blue slate circles a skylit atrium in the center of the building.  A low greystone wall bolstered by a row of graceful black marble pillars ensures that inattentive guests will not step out into the empty space.  A large pane of stained glass framed in dark oak hangs between the pillars across from a heavy, black ash door on the opposite wall.

title: [The Unicorn Room]
description: This room is decorated in stark wintery hues.  A deep black carpet patterned with spiralling silver horns covers the floor, while pure white curtains frame silvery-grey walls.  The large four-post bed features oversized silver pillows above an elaborately embroidered comforter.  An elegant crystal vase on each night table holds a small bouquet of white narcissus.

title: [The Trident Room]
description: This room is tastefully decorated in muted autumnal colors.  A rust-colored carpet patterned with golden sailing ships covers the floor, accentuating the golden curtains and soft brown walls.  The large four-post bed features oversized golden pillows above an elaborately embroidered comforter.  An elegant crystal vase on each night table holds a small bouquet of chrysanthemums.

title: [The Sun God Room]
description: This room is brightly decorated with summery primary colors.  A bright yellow carpet patterned with green ivy covers the floor, accentuating the dark green curtains and bright yellow walls.  The large four-post bed features oversized yellow pillows above an elaborately embroidered comforter.  An elegant crystal vase on each night table holds a small bouquet of yellow roses.

title: [The Spire Suite]
description: This double room contains a sitting area with two cozy easy chairs and a cushioned window seat as well as a spacious bedroom decorated in wintery hues.  A thick white carpet covers the floor, and white cotton curtains almost disappear against the pure white walls.  Four pillows patterned with silver snowflakes rest atop the elaborately embroidered comforter draped over the oversized bed.  An elegant crystal vase on each night table holds a small bouquet of white narcissus.

title: [The First Room]
description: This room is brightly decorated with summery primary colors.  A plush red carpet with a dark blue border covers the floor, coordinating the blue and white striped curtains and deep red walls.  The large four-post bed features oversized yellow pillows above an elaborately embroidered comforter.  An elegant crystal vase on each night table holds a small bouquet of red roses.

title: [The Huntress Room]
description: This room is brightly decorated with summery primary colors.  A deep green carpet covers the floor, accentuated by green and white striped curtains and plain white walls.  The large four-post bed features oversized green pillows above an elaborately embroidered comforter.  An elegant crystal vase on each night table holds a small bouquet of yellow roses.

title: [Queen of Enlightenment Suite]
description: This double room contains a sitting area complete with an easy chair and a cushioned window seat as well as a spacious bedroom decorated in muted autumnal colors.  A chocolaty brown carpet covers the floor, and rust-colored curtains accent the pale yellow walls.  Four pillows patterned with red, yellow, and brown leaves rest atop the elaborately embroidered comforter draped over the oversized bed.  An elegant crystal vase on each night table holds a small bouquet of chrysanthemums.

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Hall]
description: You are in a darkly lit hallway which travels east-west.  To the east you can see an intersection leading to more lockers, and a curtained opening on the north wall.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Locker Room]
description: Carefully arranged across the floor are plush, powder blue carpets patterned with multicolored interlocking bubbles.  The rear wall of the chamber is comprised of numerous small, locked compartments.  For your convenience, your personal locker is placed on a low granite-topped counter.  On the wall opposite the counter hangs an oil painting rendered in vivid colors.

title: [Public Lockers]
description: Carved out of the limestone, the small room has an array of sealed locker units that stretches from floor to ceiling on one side, while the opposite wall has a curtained opening that exits into a hallway.  A long oak counter rests in the center of the room and has a single locker resting on its smooth surface.

title: [Asylum, Padded Cell]
description: Every wall in this room is covered in a plush, thick white padding.  This place seems to rob the senses, with every sound being absorbed by the room.  The room is extremely dark with only a faint presence of light coming from a narrow slit in the solid steel door.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: The openings of small pipes are visible through the muck on the walls.  To judge from the smell, they used to deliver raw sewage into this main tunnel.  The tunnel continues to descend, as the darkness and humidity seem to close in around you.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: A faint light trickles in through the cracks in the ceiling, as the tunnel continues to drop.  In the distance, you can hear the faint scratching sounds of vermin being about their business.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: Large blobs of some sort of slime occasionally drip from the ceiling here.  They collect on the floor, making the footing a bit more treacherous than normal.  Keeping one eye on the descending blobs, and one eye on your path, you gingerly pick your way through.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: You carefully pick your way around the bits and pieces of debris.  Just thinking about the nature of this debris makes you a bit nauseous.  The smell of the place is revolting, making matters even worse.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: There is a small bit of sludgy water pouring out of one of the many small pipes.  It has collected into a dark slimy looking pool here, with a small trickle of filth oozing on down the tunnel.  There is just enough room to pick your way around it as you continue on deeper into the earth.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: The trickle of sludge begins to move a bit faster, as the slope steepens.  The small pipes in the walls grow fewer, but no less filthy.  You can feel a touch of moving air, perhaps a bit fresher than that which you've grown used to breathing.

title: [Mistsheen, Solhaven Annex]
description: Mist-hued cascades of luxuriant spidersilk drip from the walls and ceiling of the spacious shop, pooling around shelves of silvery wood holding scores of small, brightly colored bottles.  The shelves even line the broad bay windows flanking the shop entrance, displaying dozens of the crystal containers to passersby.

title: [Mistsheen, Oils]
description: Tiered shelves of silvery wood sprout organically from the varnished maoral walls, the crystalline bottles of oil arranged atop them gleaming only slightly brighter than the smooth maoral.  The air is heavy with a melange of spice and sweetness, although silk-draped windows let in the fresh sea breeze to leaven the scents.

title: [Mistsheen, Crystals]
description: Hanging swathes of pale grey gauze cordon off the alcove from the rest of the shop's spacious interior.  Backlit by glowing candles, the cloth shimmers with hints of strange color and hue.  A sculpted bronze brazier in the shape of a winged boar casts the cloying scent of burning herbs into the perfumed air.

title: [Lavandula Terrace]
description: Carved from the hillside, the small landing blends into the terrain with tiles of flint and slate.  Colorful wildflowers cling to the steep and rocky ground, contrasting with the darker greys and browns of their surroundings.  Tucked close to the craggy wall is a small pine cottage surrounded by hardy greenery that grows in thick clusters.

title: [Ravelin Harvest]
description: Smooth pine boards varnished to a golden shine line the floor and walls of the small, yet airy market.  A trio of bronze lanterns hang from the ceiling, their glaesineth orbs etched in detail with a series of wildflowers.  Canisters, crockery, and jars fill deep shelves set up about the room, while painted bins filled with sacks and bags are stacked neatly underneath.  Detailed watercolors illustrating a wide variety of local herbs are hung between the goods on display.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Ice Tub]
description: Circling about, the thick ceramic sides of the tub are filled to the brim with ice water.  The wooden walls of the room keep the warmth of the jungle air at bay.  Cold enough to see your breath floating by, the room is chilled by the freezing water you are in.

title: [Warrior Guild Ice Tub]
description: The tub is filled just enough to cover a prone giantman with icy water.  You hope you don't have to linger here much longer.

title: [Warrior Guild, Ice Hole]
description: A large break in the frozen lagoon provides access to the shallow, frigid water.

title: [Warrior Guild Ice Tub]
description: The tub is filled just enough to cover a prone giantman with icy water.  You hope you don't have to linger here much longer.

title: [Warrior Guild, Ice Tub]
description: Frigid water filled with crushed ice has been further chilled to the point of indecency by the addition of chunks of salt.  The cold is practically unbearable.

title: [Warrior Guild, Ice Tub]
description: The smooth stone tub is filled almost to its rim with freezing water.  Hopefully no one needs to stay submerged within its icy grasp too long.

title: [Ice Tub]
description: The tub is filled with icy water.  This is clearly not a health spa nor a resort, no normal person would set foot into anything that cold.

title: [Guild Hall, Frigidarium Bath]
description: This room contains a crescent shaped bath built into the ground with tiled steps leading down to the frigid water.  Large slabs of ice ring the edges of the bath maintaining the temperature of the water just above the freezing point.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Hallway]
description: Crafted entirely of silvery grey stone, the blocks fit together seamlessly creating the smooth passage walls.  Set into a shallow recess is a narrow archway covered with a peacock blue silk curtain.

title: [Timor's Storage, Hallway]
description: You are in a dimly lit hallway.  The torches on the walls flicker and fade casting all manner of shadows about the hallway.

title: [Bathhouse, Sauna]
description: Braziers filled with hot coals sit in three corners of this small, irregularly-shaped, wooden room, filling it with wet, oppressive heat while droplets trickle down the walls.  Opposite the plain door leading out, an uncomfortable-looking square stone bench provides a place to sit.  Alongside, a clay ewer is filled full of water with a wide-bellied ladle hanging from the rim.

title: [Warrior Guild, Sauna]
description: Except for the occasional moan or scream of agony from an adjacent sauna, few sounds pierce the silence in what could, at best, be called a large coffin.  Towering black wooden walls seem to push in from four sides, leaving barely enough room to turn around without hinderance.  The mild Elanith weather somehow feels much harsher here, with not even a hint of a breeze to help evaporate the sweat puddling on the floor.  Not surpisingly, the stench rivals that of a troll king in mid-summer.

title: [Warrior Guild, Sauna]
description: Except for the occasional moan or scream of agony from an adjacent sauna, few sounds pierce the silence in what could, at best, be called a large coffin.  Towering black wooden walls seem to push in from four sides, leaving barely enough room to turn around without hinderance.  The basement air fails to supply even a hint of a breeze to help evaporate the sweat puddling on the floor.  Not surpisingly, the stench rivals that of a troll king in mid-summer.

title: [Warrior Guild, Sauna]
description: As a result of the expansion of the metal encasing this box, scalding steam rises up from the floor through minute cracks.  Red hot lava is visible through the slivered openings in the walls, but does little to distract from the intense, agonizing heat radiating throughout the sauna.  The ripe odor of previous inhabitants assaults the senses, infused in every crevice and cranny of the cramped surroundings.

title: [Warrior Guild, Steam Room]
description: Moist and almost unbearably hot air surrounds you, making it hard to even breathe in the soothing fragrances that permeate the small room.  Barely large enough to accomodate the slatted bench and copper brazier, the steam room is artfully decorated with tiled mosaic walls.  The relaxing combination of warmth and scents help work out the aches and pains acquired during the day.

title: [Guild Hall, Balnea]
description: Like a small ceramic closet, the balnea is elegantly decorated with a tiled mosaic floor and walls.  Soothing fragrances waft from the golden brazier that sits atop a tripod in one corner.  The heat and scents relaxes you, inviting you to lie on the benches and let the warmth work out the aches and pains of the day.

title: [The Circle Stone]
description: Crafted from thick lengths of heavy black leather, the tent's edges sway slightly.  A varnished wooden desk is set near the back, with evenly stacked sheets of vellum organized neatly upon it.  A rune-etched circular stone table dominates the center of the pavilion, bordered by several wooden stools.  Wisps of yellow, green, and cyan smoke curl up from crystal beakers that continuously bubble within a rhimar-lined rack.

title: [Beyond the Glass]
description: A massive domed chamber of thick, crystalline shards stretches outward, while several etched arcane sigils form a pattern across the glass-like floor.  A huge obsidian obelisk floats, suspended in mid-air, its surface crawling with wisps of glowing energy.  Ribbons of ethereal light swim along the chamber, lazily coiling and twisting about.

title: [Solhaven, Pier's End]
description: The pier comes to an end over the crashing waters of Solhaven Bay, flanked by two high wooden pilings.  The din of North Market to the southeast is all but quelled by the winds of the night sea, and the crisp scent of saltwater swirls in eddies on the chill air.  A vast, dark expanse of water lies in near-pitch darkness as far as the eye can see, broken only by the white crests of waves and the glittering motes of reflected celestial bodies.

title: [BayVigil Houseboat, Dock]
description: A private dock edges a small houseboat, which is securely moored to large pilings sunk deeply into the floor of the bay.  Seagulls wheel and call raucously overhead, and one large fellow stands domineeringly on top of one of the pilings, obviously quite used to interlopers of the non-winged sort.  Nets and cane poles lean against the side of the houseboat, providing a maritime motif.
location: the BayVigil Houseboat, inside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [Dragonstalk Landing, Gardens ]
description: Tall curved arches of verdant foliage enclose the open air garden, the structures entwined with lanterns of gilded glass draped at various intervals across the soft grass.  A square of mahogany planks sits in the middle of the garden, inlaid with a stylized eahnor wyvern framed in enamel dragonstalks.  Placed behind a gilt-clawed table is a fortress-painted screen, the vellum revealing faint silhouettes of the band as they organize their instruments.

title: [Dragonstalk Landing, Patio]
description: Several crimson-draped tables are scattered across the wooden floor, surrounded by velvet-cushioned chairs perched upon wyvern-carved legs.  A gilded chandelier of gently curved dragonstalks curls across the pole-centered ceiling radiating bolts of silk, its crystalline leaves casting glinting motes of light over the area as the fixture sways in the ambient breeze.  Lattices of vine-worked greenery frame part of the open-air patio, decorated with hand-drawn sketchings of the fortress.

title: [Dragonstalk Landing, Reception]
description: Gilt-threaded banners of crimson velvet decorate the walls of the pavilion, the stylized wyverns standing rampant above a fortress adorned in a row of rounded shields.  A circular table of carved mahogany splits the center of the room, surrounded by high-backed chairs padded in leather, each one given equal space across the wood-planked floor.  Spherical lanterns are scattered along braided ropes strapped across the ceiling, each piece caged in brilliant eahnor.

title: [Encampment, Prime Tower]
description: The top of the imperial watchtower is spacious and ringed by a reinforced wooden railing that provides an ample view of both the camp and the Lower Dragonsclaw forest beyond.  A small weapons rack houses several spears, bows and arrows, and a wide cabinet safely secures some preserved rations and herb kits.

title: [Encampment, Weaver Tower]
description: The top of the imperial watchtower is spacious and ringed by a reinforced wooden railing that provides an ample view of both the camp and the Lower Dragonsclaw forest beyond.  A small weapons rack houses several spears, bows and arrows, and a wide cabinet safely secures some preserved rations and herb kits.

title: [Encampment, Drake Tower]
description: The top of the imperial watchtower is spacious and ringed by a reinforced wooden railing that provides an ample view of both the camp and the Lower Dragonsclaw forest beyond.  A small weapons rack houses several spears, bows and arrows, and a wide cabinet safely secures some preserved rations and herb kits.

title: [Encampment, Griffin Tower]
description: The top of the imperial watchtower is spacious and ringed by a reinforced wooden railing that provides an ample view of both the camp and the Lower Dragonsclaw forest beyond.  A small weapons rack houses several spears, bows and arrows, and a wide cabinet safely secures some preserved rations and herb kits.

title: [Zul Logoth, House Clerk]
description: Affixed to the stone wall beside a smooth blue granite desk are polished brass plaques with a bizarre array of yellow feathers.  The opposite wall features an intricate, built-in cubby system neatly housing documents and papers in order of content and priority.  Dangling from a pole in the corner of the office is a wrought iron bird cage emitting a strong luminescence.

title: [Municipal Building, Rooftop]
description: Sturdy wooden planks extend out to cover the rectangular roof of the Municipal Building below.  The cavern ceiling overhead is close enough to touch, while down below dwarves are seen coming and going, some entering and exiting the building on official business.  A strong ironwood beam structure suspends a large invar bell next to a long invar horn cradled in a similar supporting frame.  A ladder leads through a trapdoor back down into the building below.

title: [Short Tunnel]
description: This short tunnel is cramped and dark save for light illuminating the shapes of arched openings that appear at the northern and southern ends.  A hint of fungus mingles with the mineral scents of the cool, yet mildly humid, air.  Footsteps echo through the tunnel as the darkened silhouettes of dwarves pass from arch to arch.

title: [Hall of Clans, Entry]
description: Row upon row of rune-carved columns march northward into the depths of this spacious hall.  White marble arches crisscross from column to column, creating a rib-vaulted ceiling overhead.  Polished hexagonal tiles fit neatly together spanning the floor throughout the solemn space.  Along the marble-finished southern wall, heavy iron sconces hold aloft lit torches that emit a soft golden light above a cobblestone arch that provides an exit back to Zul Logoth.  Visitors shuffle through with quiet reverence, pausing to inspect each column

title: [Hall of Clans]
description: Row after row of rune-carved columns stand north to south along a polished marble floor.  Iron torch-filled sconces mounted on the west marble wall illuminate the columns with a soft golden light.  A clear area to the northwest can be seen through the stone pillars that support a white marble, rib-vaulted ceiling overhead.

title: [Hall of Clans]
description: Columns repeat to the south and west supporting a white marble, rib-vaulted ceiling above.  Light from iron sconces mounted on the marble wall to the northeast cast soft golden light reflected by the polished hexagonal tile floor that spreads throughout the hall.  The shadows of an alcove in the eastern corner obscure the view of a modest wooden door mounted on iron hinges.

title: [Hall of Clans, Maintenance]
description: This simple room contains a stone workbench covered with tools.  Some long wooden handles stand upright in a reused ale cask next to a rack of wooden torch bases awaiting construction.  Shelves containing buckets of sand, paraffin chips, and bundles of burlap stand to either side of a simple ironwood door leading out.  A squat potbelly stove radiates heat from the corner, casting off a warm orange glow from its grated door.

title: [Hall of Clans]
description: The ranks of rune-carved columns from the south ends at the northern side of the grand hallway.  A golden light beckons from the south where a looming obelisk stands at the chamber's center.  On the northern marble wall flanked by torch-filled iron sconces, a pointed arch opening provides access to a chamber beyond.

title: [Hall of Clans, Center]
description: The rib-vaulted ceiling is higher here to accommodate a tall granite obelisk that stands on a slightly raised circular dais at the precise center of the hall.  Soft golden light brings a glow to the area from lit torch-filled iron sconces mounted to the rune-carved columns that stand in a protective circle around the monument, along with smooth marble benches that allow visitors a place to rest as they consume the runes inscribed upon it.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Encampment, Pylon Tower]
description: The top of the imperial watchtower is spacious and ringed by a reinforced wooden railing that provides an ample view of both the camp and the Lower Dragonsclaw forest beyond.  A small weapons rack houses several spears, bows and arrows, and a wide cabinet safely secures some preserved rations and herb kits.

title: [Hall of Clans, Council Room]
description: This large circular room is filled with a stone conference table carved from the granite of the floor.  Heavy iron sconces are mounted to the marble walls, casting a soft gold light across a map of Elanthia that has been intricately carved into the table's surface.  Twenty-four padded chairs surround the engraved slab, behind which are some recessed shelves displaying expertly carved likenesses of famous dwarves past.  A pointed arch opening to the south leads back to the hall.

title: [Secret Chamber]
description: Stale air fills this dark, cubic chamber of unadorned granite with a dust covered floor.  A tunnel offers some progress south, though no light comes from the opposite end, making it impossible to determine how long it may be.  At floor level, a crawlspace leading out has been blocked on the other side to prevent passage.

title: [Dead End]
description: It is so dark the immediate surroundings are impossible to see.  The walls are rough with the sharp jagged protrusions one would find in the beginning stages of a tunnel being dug.  However cobwebs and dust belie the age of the crude passage.  Feeling around the unfinished tunnel walls reveals no obvious exits.

title: [Hall of Clans]
description: Column after column continue in all directions of this vast chamber.  An illuminated area marking the center of the hall can be seen through the columns to the northeast.  Soft golden light radiates forth from torch-filled iron sconces mounted high on the marble-finished western wall to illuminate the intricate dwarven runes carved into each of the stone columns that fill the quiet gallery.

title: [Hall of Clans]
description: The march of columns turns northeast along a marble wall lined with lit iron sconces.  A shadowed alcove in the west wall partially conceals a modest ironwood door mounted on iron hinges.  Spying through the forest of stone, a large obelisk can be seen at the center of a golden torch-lit clearing to the southeast.  The faint scent of soot lingers in the still atmosphere.

title: [Hall of Clans, Administration]
description: This simple room is a cube carved from the granite surrounding the hall deep below ground.  While the room's interior surfaces are smooth, they lack the marble finish of the hall outside.  Across from a modest wooden door, an ironwood desk resides under an insignia of a crossed silver pick-and-shovel flanked by some heavy iron sconces that emit golden light on the room below.  Some bookcases and barrels full of reading material line the walls.

title: [Ilynov Manor, Patio]
description: A small branch of the Mistydeep river has undercut the city wall near a tall lasimor tree and forms a serene pool amidst the lush flora of the garden.  Large flagstones form a meandering path between fragrant roses and flowering cherry trees leading from the brick patio to a small fishing dock on the edge of the tranquil pool.  A large brick hearth fills the center of the patio, several rattan chairs surrounding it.  Dark crimson pots filled with trailing, bright white-laced yellow plumeria flank a set of glass double doors leading back into the manor.
location: Ilynov Manor, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Hallway]
description: Woven with strands of muted golds and greens, a beautiful ramie silk carpet leads down the hallway from a carved tanik archway.  A bright, potted geranium rests next to a gold-banded lapis velvet curtain that hangs opposite a green and silver chevron-patterned curtain.  A small, stained glass skylight showers the room with patterns in brilliant hues as sunlight shines through the colored panes.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Hallway]
description: Shades of golds and greens create beautiful patterns in the rich ramie silk carpet that blankets the polished tanik floor.  A flyrsilk ivory curtain and a sun-faded sailcloth curtain are draped on either side of the hallway with a marble hummingbird statue resting to the side of each.  Frosted crystal globes hang from the ceiling illuminating the area with a pale, flickering light.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Hallway]
description: Ivory walls, paired with the pale gold and green carpeting, create a beautiful contrast in color and design.  A silver flyrsilk curtain weighted with a quartet of silver moon medallions hangs across from a midnight black velvet curtain adorned with an image of a swaying willow tree.  Suspended between the portals is a trio of crystal globes.  Fanciful shadows dance along the walls created by the flickering flames housed inside the lamps.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Hallway]
description: Bright crimson crimson roses, climbing from glass-inlaid pots, line the pale ivory walls of the hallway.  The polished tanik floor is cushioned with a thick ramie silk carpet patterned in pale hues of golds and greens.  Hanging between the flowers are an ornate brocade curtain and a silvery velvet curtain embroidered with a blossoming sovyn clove.

title: [Rhyaesdid Pantry]
description: Polished tanik inlaid with bits of colorful sea glass covers the countertops and a large island workspace centered in the room.  A pale stone fireplace fills one wall, with several smaller ovens built into the side for baking.  A large area covered in shelving is stacked with jars and bottles labeled with ingredients and spices.  Resting to one side is a wooden dry sink piled with a wide variety of foods.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Hallway]
description: Sounds of trickling water dance out from a carved stone waterfall placed between a golden velvet curtain embroidered with a crimson phoenix and a jade-inlaid ebonwood arch.  Light from a trio of frosted crystal globes casts a pale blanket over the rich ramie silk carpet that runs the length of the hallway.  The lamps send bits of luminous motes across the walls as their pale beams dance upon the water.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Hallway]
description: Running the length of the hall is a woven carpet of ramie silk patterned in shades of pale gold and green.  A redwood door is set into one wall while a dark purple velvet curtain edged in silver and a pale jade ramie silk curtain embroidered with the Silvergate Inn crest face each other on opposite sides of the hallway.  Several paintings hang about the portals, their subjects varying from country scenes to baskets of flowers.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Hallway]
description: Hanging from a platinum chain, a pair of crystal lamps sway above, the faceted panes sending motes of fragmented light over the gold and green carpeting.  Set into the wall is a silver door adorned with the Sylvanfair coat-of-arms, opposite an ice blue snowflake lace curtain.  A mosaic crafted from sea glass hangs from the wall; light shimmers off of each piece as it illuminates the work of art.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Hallway]
description: Ramie silk carpeting extends down the hallway, patterned in shades of pale gold and green.  A cushioned white oak bench rests against the wall between a mistwood arch and a rune-embroidered ash grey curtain.  Climbing up a miniature trellis is a rosebush, its pale pink blossoms contrast and complement the pale ivory walls.

title: [House of Paupers Annex]
description: A circular polished rosewood bar dominates the center of the room, flanked by low-backed leather and rosewood stools.  Opposite a gold-banded lapis velvet curtain leading out is a back-lit stained glass panel depicting the town of Cysaegir, and a steel-bound bristle dart board set with silver rings hangs on the wall to the right.  A recessed alcove to the left of the panel is covered by a gold-threaded white flyrsilk curtain.

title: [House of Paupers Lockers]
description: Carefully arranged across the floor are plush, powder blue carpets patterned with multicolored interlocking bubbles.  The rear wall of the chamber is comprised of numerous small, locked compartments.  For your convenience, your personal locker is placed on a low granite-topped counter.  On the wall opposite the counter hangs an oil painting rendered in vivid colors.

title: [Paupers, Locker]
description: With the curtain closed behind you, all sound from outside the locker area has been hushed.  The counter is topped with deep green baize which shows little wear.

title: [Paupers, Locker]
description: A small swarm of fireflies flit about in a cylindrical cage hung from the granite ceiling.  Their blinking green and yellow glows softly illuminate this small room.  Though the marble walls are unadorned and the granite floor is uncarpeted, the room still provides a quiet place for contemplating the contents of your locker.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: Ivory drapes hang upon the walls, their overly long lower edges pooling upon the soft rug that stretches from wall to wall.  The drape's silken lengths are unfettered except where they are parted to provide egress through a blue-edged silver silk curtain.  A polished blue modwir counter sits in the center of the circular chamber, beneath the light of an enormous seaglass orb that is held aloft by a woven hemp basket.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove facing a wall of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and placed on a marble counter.

title: [Singing Traveler Table]
description: Half-full wooden ale tankards lie scattered over the table.  The soft melody of a mandolin, reminiscent of Kai's triumph song, can be heard in the distance.

title: [Elemental Fire Table]
description: The table is formed from cooled lava which has been polished till it gleams.  In the center of the table is an opening from which a flame rises, illuminating the table with a ruddy glow.  The chairs which surround the table are also carved from cooled lava and covered with plush red cushions.

title: [Minor Water Table]
description: Water fills the table's pedestal which is made of a large square of clear crystal.  Pebbles, sand, and plants fill the bottom, and a variety of fish and marine life can be seen through the table's clear top.

title: [Tangleweed Table]
description: Warm light floods through the skylight over the table.  Blooming plants hang from the ceiling and long vines fall down to the floor, providing a natural curtain.

title: [Mana Table]
description: An aura of security surrounds this polished modwir table on which you see some fresh mana bread.  The sweet aroma of the bread makes you wonder if someone rushed out and left it behind, or if it is a gift from the gods.

title: [Silvergate Annex]
description: Silvery moonlight floods through glass doors adorned by pale green sheers.  A tri-fold crystal mirror rests beside a rose-carved pearwood archway opposite an Inn News chalkboard.  Silver flyrsilk covers the sofa and armchairs grouped upon a floral-patterned paeline rug.  Dominating the far wall is a large oil painting above a marble-topped long pearwood sideboard holding a pair of glowing brass candle lanterns.  A polished brass bin sits beside a pale jade ramie silk curtain embroidered with the Silvergate Inn crest.

Pale green sheers billow in the breeze from open glass doors guarded by a wrought iron step balcony.  A tri-fold crystal mirror rests beside a rose-carved pearwood archway opposite an Inn News chalkboard.  Silver flyrsilk covers the sofa and armchairs grouped upon a floral-patterned paeline rug.  Dominating the far wall is a large oil painting above a marble-topped long pearwood sideboard.  A polished brass bin sits beside a pale jade ramie silk curtain embroidered with the Silvergate Inn crest.

title: [Silvergate Lockers]
description: Carefully arranged across the floor are plush, powder blue carpets patterned with multicolored interlocking bubbles.  The rear wall of the chamber is comprised of numerous small, locked compartments.  For your convenience, your personal locker is placed on a low granite-topped counter.  On the wall opposite the counter hangs an oil painting rendered in vivid colors.

title: [Silvergate Annex]
description: Two huge toadstools in large stone pots illuminate a large, comfortable room.  Dusky brown granite benches line two of the marble walls, facing each other across the sapphire carpet.  Mounted above one bench is a stuffed tusked boar head and above the other hangs a huge silver lion head with a gaping maw and savage looking fangs.  On one wall, a silver arch allows exit to the corridor outside, while on the other wall a curtain provides entrance to the locker area.

title: [SilverGate Lockers]
description: A small swarm of fireflies flit about in a cylindrical cage hung from the granite ceiling.  Their blinking green and yellow glows softly illuminate this small room.  Though the marble walls are unadorned and the granite floor is uncarpeted, the room still provides a quiet place for contemplating the contents of your locker.

title: [Mana Sword Dahcre Chamber]
description: Framed by walls of polished basalt, this room's cool elegance is softened by silvery wool carpets woven with a deep blue geometric design.  Comfortable wing chairs upholstered with deep blue leather are drawn up around a silver-veined marble hearth, above which is set a silver-framed beveled glaes mirror.  Flanked by twin green banners, a silver-veined marble bar fills one corner.  Above the silver arch leading into this lounge, a blue quartz medallion gleams softly in the light.

title: [Darkened Chamber]
description: A single glaesine sconce attached to the wall illuminates the small chamber, casting a fitfully flickering light across the room's few features.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Dangling from a chain at one side of the room is a small mithglin ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Private Locker]
description: Jade green marble veined with cream covers the small amount of floor space, while pale oak paneling forms a modest wainscoting.  A white-on-cream figured silk covers the upper portion of the walls.

title: [A Stone Chamber]
description: A single oil lamp hanging from the high vaulted ceiling illuminates the small oval chamber.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Firmly bolted to the wall at one side of the room is a small, cast-iron ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple opening.

title: [Lounge Lockers]
description: Warm light filters through the curtained opening, faintly illuminating the simple cell.

title: [Kishnar's Hearth, Shop]
description: Raw hoarbeam timbers, glinting with cold veins of glacial blue and shining silver, line the lower half of the shop's dark stone walls.  They curve to frame a wide stone hearth, within which a roaring fire crackles invitingly.  Opposite the hearth, a burled pine countertop with scrimshawed ivory inlay separates a cozy nook from the rest of the shop.  Shelves line the walls behind the counter, holding various staples in neat glass jars.

title: [Communitea House, Entry]
description: Beautiful rugs, worn thin in spots but still largely intact, and colorful tapestries soften the cold, exposed stone of the large entryway.  A long hall extends north from a heavy wooden door with panes of leaded glass, its walls lined with painted landscapes, and leads to a wrought iron and glass arch at its end.  A cordoned-off flight of stairs leads to the upper chambers of this once great home, and to the west a wide doorway draped with heavy velvet curtains opens into a modest sitting room.

title: [Communitea House, Sitting Room]
description: Cracks in the granite-tiled floor, some small and some not, have been mostly hidden by the careful arrangement of a tufted emerald velvet divan with several missing buttons and matching wide, scallop back chairs with scuffed, dark walnut end tables in between.  Bookcases and curio cabinets backed with blackened mirrors line one wall, the faint scent of old books clinging to them still.  Gold and bronze damask curtains, fraying a little at the edges, are partially drawn over a large window on the far side of the room from a pair of paneled sliding doors.

title: [Communitea House, Drawing Room]
description: Dark finishes and plush fabrics lend to a cozy atmosphere despite their obvious age and wear.  Directly across from a pair of paneled sliding doors, a large framed Talador map hangs in a place of honor above a small fireplace.  On the west wall, a tall back overstuffed armchair with cracked chocolate leather and large desk face a small sofa and floor-to-ceiling bookcases across the room.

title: [Communitea House, Orangery]
description: Large panes of thick, cloudy glass enclose this space on three sides and rise above to form a lantern roof.  Within the fourth wall, a wrought iron and glass arch is set directly across from a stained glass door leading out to the garden.  The lush foliage of highly cultivated trees in oversized weathered stone planters forms a thick canopy, their green leaves shading small groupings of white wicker chairs and tables arranged around a cast iron potbelly stove.

title: [Communitea House, Garden]
description: Dark ivy climbs the walls surrounding this private garden, the broad and waxy leaves covering lifeless stone with lush green.  Opposite a stained glass door, nestled against the verdant vines, a four-tiered white marble fountain with a cracked acanthus finial stands between a pair of oversized planters ravaged by time.  In the center of it all, resting on slate paving stones with moss growing between their cracks, low stone benches surround a ring of blackened limestone set with a steel grate.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Courtyard]
description: The grey-hewn walls of stone are covered in flecks of precious metal and gemstones, the surface glinting with the ambient light cast by several silver-forged lanterns leading towards the manor.  Dried tufts of cave moss frame the pathway to a carved haon door, the wood decorated with a lively scene of several dwarves in a bustling market, the intaglio encircling a gilded plaque.  Nestled into the corner of the door and walls is a mine cart-shaped donation bin.

title: [Tempest River, Cliff's Edge]
description: The overgrown clearing is framed by a series of vine-covered statues.  A forest of old-growth trees with dense underbrush presses into the clearing, leaving very little room between it and the cliff's edge.  A hedge of overgrown roses provides a natural block from the wind and draws attention to the panoramic view.  A trail breaks through at the western edge, leading steeply down to the water below.  Barely visible within the trees is a broken moss-covered pathway, unusually thick masses of undulating vines and moss winding about the branches above.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Comyner's Gates]
description: Sprawling along the coastline, the three wards of Brisker's Cove are surrounded by walls, with each ward having its own entry.  The gates to Comyner's Ward are monstrous, double-wide doors fashioned of ironwood and reinforced with bronze and steel.  Several pathways encircle the city, while others stretch out into the yawning desert.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Comyner's Gates]
description: Converging to a point in the north, the New Ward Wall and Old Ward Wall meet at the wide stone entry of the Comyner's Gates.  Large double-wide doors of reinforced ironwood, heavily scarred and positively ancient, stand open, their heavy bronze and steel hinges dappled with tarnish and rust.  Large wrought iron brackets hold torches aloft, their flickering fires illuminating the area.

title: [Drayhyme and Erstwhile Meeting]
description: Perched upon the intersection of two streets, a triangular building of white stucco with a terracotta-shingled roof fills the southern section of the block.  To the east, a large thoroughfare follows the patchwork sandstone blocks of the Old Ward Wall, while to the west, a narrower road slips through the town along the edges of the New Ward Wall.  Bustling with both foot and mount travelers, a steady stream of traffic moves through the northern gates.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Erstwhile Lane]
description: Bright white and navy blue bricks dominate the straight street, which is sheltered by the bulk of the New Ward Walls on the west.  Small shops and a cozy inn, each with pristine white stucco faces and wide paneless windows, face the street, their entries illuminated against the dark of night.  A series of potted urns of well-tended desert species rest near stone benches under flickering torches.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Erstwhile Lane]
description: Departing from the business district to the north, the small homes of Comyner's Ward huddle against southern sections of the New Ward Wall.  Here and there, large date trees spring to life in the surrounding sandy dirt of the small domiciles, their striped trunks surrounded by tufted clusters of bright pink muhly grass and white-tipped feather grass.  Dormant torches line the stucco-faced wall, each burning with small flames that collectively illuminate the area.

title: [Erstwhile and Trisister Divide]
description: Curving to accommodate the lay of the New Ward Wall, the paved road transitions from the navy blue and white sandstone of the northern section to wider, cobbled stones.  Torches continue along the smooth, white faces of the stucco wall, their bright glow illuminating a a cooper's warehouse that occupies a lot on the eastern corner.

title: [Trisister and Billinggate Cross]
description: Customs houses, blacksmith forges, and storage warehouses form several clusters along the southern sections of the crowded street that follows along the New Ward Wall.  Foot traffic passes back and forth between a pair of open wickets in the ironwood gates.  Due to the proximity of docks, soldiers stand at the gates watching for any mischief-makers that may try to infiltrate the more refined ward.

Customs houses, blacksmith forges, and storage warehouses form several clusters along the southern sections of the crowded street that follows along the New Ward Wall.  A single wicked in the tall ironwood gates stands open to the nighttime traffic, a single guardsman monitoring those that move in and out.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Billinggate Row]
description: Uplifted cobblestones, stacks of burnt pilings, and mangled bits of metal create a barricade to the southwest where the ragged gates and skeletal remains of Winter Manor rest lifeless and vacant.  Beyond the sloping hill, where once manicured lawns whither into yellow tufts, are the bones of the once bustling Iron Dock.  Citizens bustle along the street, averting their eyes from the historic destruction and ignoring a nearby jailhouse.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Trisister Road]
description: Dusky rose gaura pays court to a spray of sunset-hued lantana as they chase each other around the homes that rest upon the northern side of the cobblestone road.  Warehouses keep their back to the small domestic-heavy road, their white stucco surfaces covered in creeping fig vines that flourish in both the heat and the shade the area provides.  An incredibly narrow alley skirts through structures to the north, providing a direct route to Comyner's Court.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Comyner Court]
description: Cracked white tiles form a radiated, wavy-rayed sun around a circular sandstone fountain that dominates the quiet courtyard.  Torches illuminate the faces of many a shop and home that surround the small gathering place, and though many are closed for the evening a stucco and oak store remains open to customers.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Brisker's Cove, Drayhyme Way]
description: Canting to one side, a nondescript wooden shop is huddled amongst the backs of buildings at the western edge of a wide, cobblestoned thoroughfare while opposite green-grey ocotillo rise like dead sticks from the runnels near Old Ward Wall, their thin forms pale green and riddled with thorns.  The lights of Comyner's Market spill across the street, illuminating the dark section of road.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Inne Alley]
description: Creating a claustrophobic air, the narrow alley connects Comyner's Court to Trisister Road.  Tightly huddled buildings, narrow shops, and small homes show their backs to the dirt track, leaving the cut-through unwelcoming in the silent and darkness of night.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Trisister Road]
description: Clotheslines crisscross the air above the cobblestone street, the laden rope swaying in the dry air that sporadically touches upon the area.  Two-story homes, each with wide-opened windows and second-floor balconies, gaze down upon the road from beneath the shelter of their terracotta roofs.  Surrounded by curly-topped squid agave, a small open-air pavilion on the north side of the road is sheltered by an enormous arching dolphin statue of pieced-together coral and sea glass.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Ginnel Alley]
description: Squeezed between tightly crowded homes, shops, and anonymous buildings, the narrow track connects Comyner's Court to Drayhyme Way.  Shadows lay heavy upon the alley, whispers lingering in the air despite no visible citizens wandering nearby.  The chittering of rats, coming from somewhere down a side passage between buildings, echoes on the cobblestones.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Drayhyme Way]
description: Lurking in the dark, buildings rise upon the western edge of the cobbled street in crowded groupings, while to the east the off-white walls of Old Ward Wall rise skyward.  Runnels upon either side of the cobbled thoroughfare are filled with sand, which has blown in from the city's gates to the north.  The air shimmers to the south and north where the heat of the day causes refraction.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Drayhyme Way]
description: Homes of the Fisherman's Ward nestle close to the Old Ward Wall, though some enterprising individual has chipped the stone away between houses to allow for easy access to Drayhyme Way.  To the west, shop buildings in various stages of repair or remodeling are surrounded by discarded debris.  Old signs of a fire mar and darken the cobblestones near many of the structures.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Drayhyme Way]
description: Crumbled bits of the Old Ward Wall scatter across the cobblestoned thoroughfare as its body was obliterated in the past due to a downed palm tree.  The wide body still rests across the rent in the barrier, though its trunk has been largely sawed and sections of it removed.  Curving between the backs of shop buildings, a narrow alley slips deeper into the town, while a nearly pristine road tracks westward.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Brisker's Cove, Trisister Road]
description: Flapping like pennants, clothing hanging from crisscrossing lines sways in the ocean-borne breeze that slips through the tightly packed warehouse to the south.  Modest homes huddle together in the shadows of the larger structures across the street, their bright orange-red roofs dark under the cover of night.  Squatting amid the domiciles, a small shop sits open to customers.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Trisister Road]
description: Surrounded by homes on its left and right, a small shrine rests within a stone garden decorated with gopher plants and succulents.  Nearby homes have small pathways leading from their awning-covered porches to the cobblestone road, while warehouses decorated with bright white stucco show their windowless and doorless backs to the domestic setting.  Pin-tailed sandgrouse amble between the homes, their plumage quiescent as they wander.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Billinggate Row]
description: Abutting the Old Ward Wall to the east, a wide cobblestoned thoroughfare departs from the warehouse district towards the various markets of Brisker's Cove.  Tufted hairgrass, largely in shades of yellowish-white with clusters of bright green in the center, rise around desert willows planted along a narrow runnel that separates the street from the wall.  The edges of a sprawling shipyard spill from the south, their distant edges stretching towards the Fisherman's Docks on the eastern shores.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Billinggate Row]
description: Stretching from the southern edge of the street towards the ocean, a sprawling shipyard surrounded by a high fence and sporting large pulley-operated cranes is quiet though well-illuminated to discourage thieves.  Clustered storehouses and warehouses fill the opposite section of the street, their doors barred and chained for the night.  Thin curls of shaved wood litter the cobblestones.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Billinggate Row]
description: Bright pink muhly grass spreads its feathery stalks around several palm trees along the southern edges of the street, the bristles all but hiding a winding path that leads to a small promontory.  The northwestern section of the road is clotted with warehouse and custom buildings, their terracotta roofs a bright contrast to their whitewashed faces, while to the northeast a sprawling shipyard with heavy pulley systems and high fences dominates the road.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Billinggate Row]
description: Warehouses and customs buildings cluster along the western side of the curving road, their dark roofs and white stucco walls a contrast to the cobbled street.  Nestled amid the structures is a long two-story tavern that has bawdy music spilling from its doors and windows.  The southernmost edge of the street grows sparser as grasses are reintroduced into the environment along with a smattering of palm trees.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Comyner's Docks]
description: One of three visible dock systems, the Commoner's Pier is situated between the Fisherman's Pier to the west and the Pier of the Desert Eagle to the east.  Steeply inclined to depart from the cobblestone streets, the ramp drops almost two stories before connecting to a wide pier surrounded by thick pilings.  A thin curl of smoke departs from the chimney of the Harbormaster's office, the tenebrous substance barely visible.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Comyner's Docks]
description: Supported by thick posts in the ground, a small square building is built against the very edge of the dock.  Tacked to its walls are billboards and posters advertising various vessels looking for day laborers as well as the most current customs regulations.  A pair of large arrows are painted upon the damp planks, one pointing east to Pier 1 and the other pointing south to Piers 2 through 5.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Comyner's Docks]
description: Painted in deep, navy blue upon the golden, refurbished planks of the dock, a trio of arrows directs traffic either south to Piers 3 through 5, north towards Pier 1, or east towards Pier 2.  Guardrails fashioned of rope threaded through holes in thick pilings separate the western edge of the long dock, where there is a clear view of the bright ships owned by the wealthy and military of Seareach.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Comyner's Docks]
description: Arching over the pier, a dark, navy blue awning ripples in the light seaborne breeze that dances across the surrounding ocean waters.  A series of steps, guarded by local militia, descends to a private dock along the western edge opposite the arm of Pier 3, while painted arrows upon the golden planks point to the north and south for Piers 1-2 and 4-5 respectively.  Piteous and plentiful, the cry of gulls fills the air.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Comyner's Docks]
description: Dockworkers diligently maneuver along the pier, their backs bowed as they haul crates by utilizing a series of straps across their backs.  Foremen sporadically call out orders, causing this section of the pier to have bursts of activity.  Pier 4 is noted to be to the west based on the simple arrow painted into the dock's planks, while a decorative sign nailed to one of the nearby pilings points further south to Pier 5.

title: [Brisker's Cove, Comyner's Docks]
description: Stretching towards the city of Brisker's Cove, a long dock with fingerlike extensions shows signs of recent refurbishing.  Braided hemp rope is wound through holes within multiple pilings along the western edge, while the east holds the entrance to Pier 5.  Planted at the edge of the dock, a several stories high flagpole thrusts its snapping pennants skyward.

title: [Comyner's Docks, Pier 5]
description: Pier 5 is boldly labeled in deep blue and gold paint upon the golden planks of the dock as it stretches eastward into the waters of the harbor.  Tidy coils of rope allow dockhands to cast lines to incoming boats beneath the watchful eye of piteously crying gulls.

title: [Comyner's Docks, Pier 4]
description: Pier 4 is boldly labeled in deep blue and gold paint upon the golden planks of the dock as it stretches eastward into the waters of the harbor.  Tidy coils of rope allow dockhands to cast lines to incoming boats beneath the watchful eye of piteously crying gulls.

title: [Comyner's Docks, Pier 3]
description: Pier 3 is boldly labeled in deep blue and gold paint upon the golden planks of the dock as it stretches eastward into the waters of the harbor.  Tidy coils of rope allow dockhands to cast lines to incoming boats beneath the watchful eye of piteously crying gulls.

title: [Comyner's Docks, Pier 2]
description: Pier 2 is boldly labeled in deep blue and gold paint upon the golden planks of the dock as it stretches eastward into the waters of the harbor.  Tidy coils of rope allow dockhands to cast lines to incoming boats beneath the watchful eye of piteously crying gulls.

title: [Comyner's Docks, Pier 1]
description: Pier 1 is boldly labeled in deep blue and gold paint upon the golden planks of the dock as it stretches eastward into the waters of the harbor.  Tidy coils of rope allow dockhands to cast lines to incoming boats beneath the watchful eye of piteously crying gulls.

title: [Comyner's Docks, Pier 1]
description: Knotted hemp is fed through a series of thick pilings to create a functional railing that is interrupted by wide spaces where hitch cleats are arranged for vessels to tie up to.  A large metal lockbox marked as a safety chest rests in the center of the pier, its metal surface cool and smooth.

title: [Comyner's Docks, Pier 1]
description: Crates and barrels occupy one section of the pier; the piles are tidily stacked and bound together by small-weave hempen fishing nets and tied to the nearest piling.  Signs of a fire mar the posts, though only a few show signs of heavy damage along their tops.  Copper-hitching cleats glisten in the starlight light from along the edges of the decking.

title: [Comyner's Docks, Pier 1]
description: Coils of rope lay in tidy bundles upon the decking of the pier, their weight, lengths, and hues varying from thick to thin, short to long, and dusky grey to sun-bleached white.  Polished copper and bronze cleats, tarnished with verdigris due to the salt water, are wrapped with hitching leads that dangle in the water.

title: [Comyner's Docks, Pier 1]
description: Rounded instead of squared, the end of the dock has five slips that allow ships to dock in a circle around its refurbished decking.  A crisp, freshly painted number five in navy blue dominates the central planks, which show recent signs of scrubbing.  Bronze and brass-hitching cleats stand at the ready to serve those that seek portage.

title: [Comyner's Docks, Pier 2]
description: Knotted hemp is fed through a series of thick pilings to create a functional railing that is interrupted by wide spaces where hitch cleats are arranged for vessels to tie up to.  A large metal lockbox marked as a safety chest rests in the center of the pier, its metal surface cool and smooth.

title: [Billinggate Tavern, Taproom]
description: Bawdy music, raucous laughter, and discordant singing fills the air of the room, mingling with the scent of stale ale, unwashed bodies, and ocean air.  Stretching left to right along the back, south-facing wall, a long bar surrounded by long-legged oak stools gathers a crowd of workers and sailors, each thirsty and insistent on receiving attention.  The atmosphere within the tavern is stifling and hot.

title: [Billinggate Tavern, Dining Room]
description: Short oak walls divide the dining room into five sections, creating booths that have access to one of the tavern's many open windows.  Inviting tables surrounded by benches sit within the rectangular closures, allowing customers a place to rest and enjoy their meal with a modicum of privacy.  Laughter from the nearby taproom fills the air, while bawdy music played by an unseen bard creates an entertaining atmosphere.

title: [Silly Sheep Table]
description: Surrounded by benches and chairs, a long wooden table is covered in chipped paint and scarred with age.  Plastered across the low, privacy walls are multiple pictures depicting a comical sheep with a supercilious grin.

title: [Merry Meerkat Table]
description: Surrounded by benches and chairs, a long wooden table is covered in chipped paint and scarred with age.  Plastered across the low, privacy walls are multiple pictures depicting a comical meerkat dancing merrily amid sand dunes.

title: [Guzzling Goose Table]
description: Surrounded by benches and chairs, a long wooden table is covered in chipped paint and scarred with age.  Plastered across the low, privacy walls are multiple pictures depicting the comical image of an inebriated gooose guzzling down tankards of ale.

title: [Rollicking Rolton Table]
description: Surrounded by benches and chairs, a long wooden table is covered in chipped paint and scarred with age.  Plastered across the low, privacy walls are multiple pictures depicting the comical image of a trio of roltons laughing and drinking at a bar.

title: [Tipsy Tamarin Table]
description: Surrounded by benches and chairs, a long wooden table is covered in chipped paint and scarred with age.  Plastered across the low, privacy walls are multiple pictures depicting the comical image of a tipsy tamarin with a long, curled mustache.

title: [Imperial Post]
description: Roughly triangular in shape, the Imperial Post widens at the back, providing ample room behind the counter for the storing of mail and letters awaiting sorting.  A polished lebbek wood sign hangs on one terracotta-accented wall, next to an elaborate mural of Brisker's Cove.  Pots of bright pink muhly grass cluster around a vase of fresh-cut flowers, adding splashes of brightness to the otherwise pristine white-and-terracotta decor.

title: [Cooperage, Workroom]
description: Stacks of curing wood line the southern walls, each arranged in racks by type and labeled with concisely worded phrases etched into copper plates.  Upon the northern wall, tools of the coopering craft are carefully fitted into displays amid glass-faced bins holding quarter hoops, head hoops, and rivets.  Several worktables house barrels in various stages of creation, though no attendants are visibly working on them at this time.  A small door leads to the backyard.

title: [Cooperage, Courtyard]
description: Backed by a stockade fence, the small, packed-dirt yard is devoid of any kind of growth.  Barrels with copper, iron, or bronze hoops are stacked in three of the space's four corners, while the fourth holds an old trough of discarded materials.  The sound of hammering filters through the air, issuing from within the connecting warehouse.

title: [Harborside Haberdashery]
description: Neatly arranged rows of boxes stacked upon each other against the walls display an assortment of styled hats, along with tiny plaques etched with prices in silvers.  An order counter at the back of the shop is shrouded in a haze of tobacco smoke, where a petite woman with a gem-adorned headband shrewdly gazes at everyone who enters.

title: [Unfinished Fashion]
description: Heavy boards are hammered over the support beams of the shop's haphazardly furbished walls, nearly unsuitable to support the weight of the unlit, ornate copper sconces affixed to them.  Cloaks, capes, and jackets hang from pegs jutting from a pair of freestanding wooden poles to either side of an ironwood order counter.  Standing attentive behind the counter is a balding human man wearing lavish crimson silks and dark leathers.

title: [Niima's Embrace]
description: A jovial woman patiently assists patrons in this freestanding pavilion, hawking wares strewn over makeshift tables and counters.  From the eastern corner of the roped-off displays and arching overhead to the west is a massive, artfully crafted coral and sea glass dolphin of enormous proportions.  The fins of the dolphin extend outward and provide a sheltered area beneath them.

title: [The Tailor's Sister]
description: Rough wooden timbers form the walls of this small shop, lengths of braided cord tethered from one side to another.  Dangling from the cords, a selection of colorful kaftans, pantaloons, and burnooses sway gently as a coastal breeze pushes its way through the entrance.  A tall copper-framed mirror is affixed to the wall adjacent to a small pedestal near a wooden order counter, where a young rosy-cheeked woman stands attentively.

title: [Shrine of Fate, Garden]
description: Pin-tailed sandgrouse warble to one another as they wander within and out of the shade provided by yellow-flowered gopher plants that grow in scattered profusion amid the bright white stones of the garden.  A singular path trails between the cobblestones of Trisister Road and a small shrine of white marble.  Lining the ambling way, small succulents of coral-edged green, crimson, and russet hues provide a splash of interest against the smooth stones.

title: [Shrine of Fate, Oratory]
description: Cool marble slabs stretch across the circular floor of the shrine, the alabaster hue fairly luminous in the sunlight that slips through the surrounding pillars.  At the heart of the structure is a decorative altar, long and wide; its smooth surface is rather plain while its sides are carved with basrelief images.  A trinity of statues, each a different female Artkati, stands between the pillars.

title: [Shrine of Fate, Altar]
description: Surrounded by carved columns, an altar rests at the center of a small shrine with a domed ceiling.  Cold air radiates from the smooth surface of the altar, veins of gold, cobalt blue, and sea green spiderwebbing across it only to disappear beyond the edges.  A quiet hum fills the air.

title: [Promontory of the Shield, Path]
description: Winding its way through thick pink muhly grasses that transition to clusters of fountain grass, a winding path connects the cobbled streets of Brisker's Cove to the cliff's edge of the promontory.  Distant sounds of lapping waves fill the air, while a subtle coastal breeze sets the surrounding grasses to waving.

title: [Harbormaster's Office]
description: A sizeable wooden wheel is displayed against the wall of the office, the helm's surface carved in elaborate nautical imagery and coated in dark lacquer.  Several gold-framed maps line the planked walls, each one depicting various trade routes through the surrounding waters of the Great Western Sea and beyond.  A worn leather-backed chair sits behind a kraken-carved desk of driftwood, the surface cluttered with various bottles glinting as the moonlight peeks through the tall windows.

title: [Promontory of the Shield, Bluff]
description: Waves crash upon the lower cliffs of the promontory, flooding porous rock and creating an echoing sound reminiscent of a flute being placed underwater.  Fountain grass frames the bare granite and creates a natural barrier that prevents access to the cliff's edge.  A stoic sentinel, a towering alabaster statue representing a warrior with his hands resting on a shield planted at his feet, gazes eastward.

title: [Merchant Complex, Nexus]
description: Smooth granite walls encompass this generous octagonal room, the ceiling and floor meeting at expertly chiseled corners.  A wide ramp carved from the surrounding rock winds down from above, terminating at the solid granite floor.  Blazing torches set betwixt stone arches standing on each wall provide ample light and passage for the bustling traffic that moves between them.  Some serious looking dwarves stand guard, their keen eyes scanning for foolhardy thieves in the throng.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, up

title: [Merchant Complex, Roramnoak]
description: Below a series of torches that cast their golden light on this area, some sturdy shelves of walnut display all kinds of cloth and leather baggage.  Stacked along the wall below are larger storage containers for customers who want to move more goods.  A worn stool next to a cupboard off to the side provides the owner of this shop a place to rest their butt and beverages.

title: [Merchant Complex, Krenlumtrek]
description: Torches mounted to the walls flare above a tall maple counter built on a wooden platform that covers the floor.  Upright racks line the wall behind the counter, organizing some finished planks.  Neat bundles of sticks lay next to stacks of logs nearby that are tagged and ready for sale.  A wood handle rises from the bit of an axe that's been hacked into a short upright standing log behind the counter.

title: [Merchant Complex, Smaelton]
description: Iron sconces along the wall grasp burning torches that radiate their light in this section of the complex.  Ingots of various metals have been stacked along the granite wall behind an ironwood table dominated by a large brass scale.  A simple iron anvil rests behind the table that looks more like a place to sit due to the lack of any scuff marks or tools nearby.

title: [Merchant Complex, Mordrakam]
description: Torches blaze above a polished maple rack displaying shiny edged weapons of varying sizes and designs sending glints of reflected light throughout the area.  Behind the display, a workbench can be seen covered with multiple whetstones, while pots wait patiently below presenting their contents to the craftsperson working the sharpening table.

title: [Merchant Complex, Oltregek]
description: Three brass oil lamps hang over the area casting a soft light on the surroundings.  Sparkling glassware vessels of differing colors and shapes have been spread out across a wide table along with other smaller leather containers.  A squat stool accompanies a workbench that has been mounted with a large magnifying glass on an articulated arm.

title: [Merchant Complex, Gotronek]
description: Chiseled into the wall between two lit torches is a detailed scene depicting the interior of a great hall.  Several polished marble pillars about waist high to a dwarf stand in a half circle atop which are intricately cut figurines that reflect the flickering torchlight.  Behind the display, dust covers the floor around a straight-backed chair and work table.

title: [Merchant Complex, Krethuum]
description: Gak hide rugs cover the floor in this area of the complex below an open wooden cart that displays small baskets exposing their goods for anyone to peruse.  Strung together with twine, bundles of hides have been stacked next to a scrap covered workbench.

title: [Merchant Complex, Toktrog]
description: Mounted on the wall behind a display table covered in small trinkets is a large parchment map showing the DragonSpine mountains with brightly glowing glaesine orbs on either side.  A small natural branch rack on the table displays curios suspended from cords and strings.  Two comfortable rocking chairs provide seating for the merchants when traffic in the complex is slow.

title: [Obsidian Keep, Great Hall]
description: Carved into the riverstone, this massive hall is large enough to serve as the center of activity.  Small groups gather in the various seating areas carved into the walls and rising from the floor.  The congregating Khanshael appear to be largely merchants, craftsmen, and traders of all sorts, some engaged in loud, boisterous conversation, some huddled quietly together.  Two large doors, one steel-banded and the other of reinforced silver, lead deeper into the keep, while a rectangular cast iron gate is flanked by a pair of stout Khanshael guardsmen.

title: [Obsidian Keep, War Room]
description: A large rectangular table dominates the center of the room, with an even larger map of Elanthia draped across its surface.  Small figurines of obsidian and wood sit atop the map, marking various locations across Elanith.  Faint etchings mark the known locations of major structures, cities, and terrain.  An ornate steel-banded silver door serves as the room's only exit.

title: [Obsidian Keep, Armory]
description: This spacious room features a series of weapon and armor racks.  Each rack boasts a specific type of weaponry or armor, all highly polished and obviously well cared for.  Ranging from viciously serrated claidhmores to traditional whip-blades, a wide array of weaponry fills the leftmost racks.  The right side of the room houses various sets of armor, equally as meticulously maintained as the weaponry.  The far corner hosts a counter with your locker on it.

title: [Obsidian Keep, Slaves Hold]
description: The area opens up into a large space of gated sections carved into the riverstone walls.  Down each aisle are rows of cells, each housing an unwashed Krolvin secured behind a dark iron gate.  The prisoners cower in the furthest corners of their cells and avoid all eye contact. title: [Thanot Table]

title: [Fel Table]

title: [Twisted Tentacle Overlook]
description: Serving as a bridge between the flotilla proper and the docking system, this large overlook is made of reclaimed ships' woods and thick ropes of rolled hemp.  Nestled against the side of the flotilla are two small shops, a rickety shack and a small battered tent, and a large sign covered in warnings is prominently displayed next to a broken anchor.

title: [Crooked Docks, Maelstrom Pier]
description: Five crooked piers float haphazardly along the outer edge of the flotilla, a series of ropes and pulleys hanging at the ready to collapse the docking system at a moment's notice for rapid travel.  The uneven decks are comprised of dozens of types of wood, most resembling salvage from ships' hulls, and some ragged bits of cork serve as minimal padding at each docking slip.  A battered sign reads, "Maelstrom Pier - Slips 1-5," and a whirlpool sucking a ship into its depths is carved into it.

description: Five crooked piers float haphazardly along the outer edge of the flotilla, a series of ropes and pulleys hanging at the ready to collapse the docking system at a moment's notice for rapid travel.  The uneven decks are comprised of dozens of types of wood, most resembling salvage from ships' hulls, and some ragged bits of cork serve as minimal padding at each docking slip.  A battered sign reads, "Maelstrom Pier - Slips 21-25," and a whirlpool sucking a ship into its depths is carved into it.
