title: [The Great Piratical Flotilla]
description: The main deck of the flotilla is expansive, its sturdy flooring intentionally scuffed to reduce falling accidents, and the outer edges are built up in a protective composite of ships, sails, metalwork, and weaponry.  A giant opening at the center of the flotilla drops into the ocean below, a rickety railing with a series of painted buoys serving as a very slight deterrent to taking a plunge.

title: [Flotilla, Kraken's Corner]
description: Elaborate systems of colorful sails and powerful weaponry line the outer edge of the flotilla's deck, making it hard to see the ocean from here.  The stern of an incongruous river boat has been permanently lashed to the flotilla, its once bright paint faded and chipped and its paddle wheel nailed solidly to the deck.

title: [Flotilla, The Stacks]
description: Several canvas awnings provide protection from the elements, while a few cannons affixed to the outer deck provide protection from more intelligent threats, their polished barrels glinting in the moonlight.  Almost blocking movement easterly, dozens of crates are stacked high and covered in thick hempen netting weighted with glaes spheres.  A narrow path between the stacks is made more treacherous by the addition of patches of seaweed, barnacles, and the occasional misplaced cannonball.

title: [Flotilla, Mermaid's Plunge]
description: Ocean water churns below, taking up a large portion of the flotilla's core.  A rope strung between two unsteady-looking poles is all that separates the denizens of the deck from a plunge, and a series of painted buoys has been wrapped around one pole for rescue purposes.  The deck here has deep score marks that look a bit too uneven to be from moving crates and are deepest right next to the edge of the pool.

title: [Flotilla, Sea Dragon Quay]
description: The outer edges of the flotilla are built up high here, with a reinforced archway leading to a dock system to the northwest and a small passage opening to the southwest between berthed ships and permanent protections.  The deck sprawls wide, leaving ample room for maneuvering, and a river boat is securely lashed across the south edge.  Intricately carved into the deck is a sea dragon wrapped about a small ship.

title: [Flotilla, Sea Kobold's Folly]
description: A kobold and squirrel statue rests next to an ironwood gangway leading to the bow of the Flying Squirrel, and several crates marked "Grog" are stacked on the other side.  Moonlight glints off the waves below.  Numerous ships crowd some of the docking berths while others are repurposed as defense bays, lined with cannons and large barrels stained with pitch.  The bow of a river boat is securely affixed to the flotilla.

title: [Flotilla, Tenebrous Walk]
description: Built up defenses along the outer edge of the flotilla cast twisting shadows across the wide expanse of moonlit deck.  Several empty bottles line up near the docking slip for a derelict carrack listing heavily to port, and a series of painted buoys dangles near the open waters at the flotilla's center.  At the center of the deck is a whimsical sea glass inlay depicting a drowned moose snuggling with a siren.

title: [Flotilla, Lazuli's Edge]
description: The external defenses are well-stocked here with ships flanked by cannons and stacks of ammunition, and the enormous deck is intentionally rough to provide firm footing.  The inner edge drops sharply off into a large expanse of ocean with a sturdy railing and gate system protecting against accidental plunges.  A series of painted buoys is wrapped around a few sturdy posts, and a rope ladder is coiled near another.  There are deep gouges at the railing's gate, as if someone or something fought hard before going over.

title: [Flotilla, Obsidian Walkway]
description: The expansive deck is stained obsidian here, painted with a bright red dagger-pierced heart and crossed viridian acantha leaves.  A polished modwir houseboat is secured to the outer edge of the flotilla and protected by several cannons, and a series of painted buoys is coiled near the interior edge.  Dozens of nets with crystalline blue fishing floats are piled neatly between racks of secured spears and tridents.

title: [Flotilla, Jareseth's Jump]
description: The ocean depths in the midst of the flotilla sparkle in the starlight, and the deck leading up to it is covered in deep scuff marks.  A handmade sign nailed to a pole is the only item between deck and depths.  Opposite sits a repurposed warehouse, with a seashell mosaic at its entrance depicting several pirates brandishing cutlasses.

title: [Flotilla, Behind the Stacks]
description: Large stacks of crates isolate this area of the flotilla, creating a narrow path west back to the main structure.  To the north, the way is blocked by an oversized building, its exterior covered in various bits of flotsam and jetsam, and a ramshackle ironwood man-of-war is thoroughly lashed to one outer edge.  Reinforced connections bridge this section to the outermost edge of the flotilla in a narrow but sturdy walkway, creating an easily defensible position.

title: [Flotilla, Viridian Deck]
description: A series of sails is permanently affixed to the flotilla's built-up outer edges, casting shadows across the immense deck, and the entire south edge is blocked by the external wall of the Jetsam Court, its smooth planking allowing no purchase for any boarding party.  Partially blocking the way east, thick hempen rope coils into stacks higher than the tallest giant, with various sizes of anchors propped beside them.

title: [Flotilla, Cobalt Passage]
description: The flotilla's main body ends here with a small pier jutting out to the north and a large crow's nest standing tall at the outermost edge of the deck.  Various caches of weaponry are lashed along the deck at strategic locations, and partially blocking the way west, thick hempen rope coils into stacks higher than the tallest giant.

title: [Flotilla, Kestral Pier]
description: Relatively unprotected, this small pier juts out from the main body of the flotilla with the ocean sparkling in the moonlight all around.  Dozens of canvas coverings provide shade and protection from the elements, and several chairs and fishing poles rest beneath.  At the farthest edge of the pier stands a tall modwir flagpole proudly displaying the flotilla's colors.

title: [Flotilla, Knivers' Pier]
description: Protected and isolated, the Knivers' Pier has both a dilapidated old sloop and an iron-reinforced modwir brigantine lashed to its outer edges, each able to cut away at a moment's notice.  A rotating deployment of guards wanders the decks, each member bristling with weaponry, and where no ship is docked, no railings exist to stop someone's fall into the depths below.  Starlight sparkles across the unobstructed view of the ocean's expanse.

title: [Twisted Tentacle, Sloops'n'More]
description: Displays of ships and ship accoutrements line the walls of the shop, and a simple salt-stained oak counter rests along the back wall with several dozen ship flags folded up on one end.

title: [Twisted Tentacle, Trinkets]
description: Several freestanding shelves line the canvas walls of this dank, humid tent, each holding items such as neatly folded and color coordinated canvas sails and meticulously coiled lengths of rope.  A carved teak mermaid statue stands behind a low counter along the back wall.

title: [Mariners' Market]
description: Jutting off from the main structure of the flotilla, this battered teak dock has several dubious-looking vessels in various stages of seaworthiness tied to a variety of posts and pillars.  Kelp is flung across the planks, creating a walking hazard, and unusual bright orange barnacles encrust the reinforced archway leading back to the main flotilla.  The clustered ships and structures of the flotilla proper tower above this offshoot dock, leaving it relatively unprotected.

title: [Seafarers' Shops]
description: Expansive in both width and length, the battered teak dock has several slips for visiting ships, each with several salt-stained buoys.  Several deep scratches mar the deck in unusual, circular patterns, as if a giant tentacle had smacked the deck multiple times in succession.

title: [Corsairs' Corner]
description: The battered teak dock makes an abrupt right angle turn, reducing the capacity for docking vessels somewhat.  A colorful sea glass kraken cuddled up with a bevy of merpeople has been inlaid into the center of the deck with the phrase, "Something for everyone at the Great Piratical Flotilla," carved beneath it.  Barnacle-encrusted posts and seaweed-covered bumpers mark off individual docking slips.

title: [Raiders' Resources]
description: The dock terminates in a series of crates supporting scaffolding and stocks, the wood marred with deep gouges and permanent bloodstains.  An incongruously bright banner reads, "Welcome!  Bring silver and shop to your heart's content!"  Fine print has been stitched beneath the welcome stating, "Goods, services, and attitude subject to change."  There is room for a handful of vessels at various docking berths on either side of the ominous stockade system.

title: [The Drowned Moose, Deck Entry]
description: Somewhat on the small side, this carrack looks to have once been a fine vessel, although now it is listing heavily to port.  Years of neglect and abuse have rendered this hulk of warped and broken boards ready for the salvage yard.  A crooked companionway leads further into the inky bowels of this floating ruin.

title: [The Drowned Moose, Cap's Taps]
description: A scavenged gangplank spans several barrels to create a bar, behind which stands a short, brawny dwarf glaring from above a matted beard.  Crates behind the bar contain spare glasses and dishes, all of which are either chipped, cracked, or dirty.  Strategically placed groups of crates have been arranged in the small area into some tables, and directly opposite the makeshift bar is a crooked companionway.  A large hole in one wall provides a glorious view of dark water.

title: [The Drowned Moose, Hold]
description: The hold would be spacious, if not for the piles of rotting sail, frayed hemp ropes, and leaking casks heaped toward the warped plank ceiling.  A large puddle of murky water spans the short distance between a red door and a blue door.  Toward the rear of the hold, an old ship's wheel dangles horizontally from a thick, iron chain and supports a few stubs of tallow candles.

title: [The Drowned Moose, Blowhole]
description: Pushed into a corner is a short bed, centered under a crooked oil painting.  A small puddle of water stands in the crack where the tilted floor meets the warped wall, giving the room a musty, briny smell.  Several broken oars lean against the wall next to an open red door.

title: [The Drowned Moose, Blue Cabin]
description: Large wooden spools are stacked in a corner, cracked and showing signs of rot.  A chalk drawing of a treasure chest decorates the wall above a slanted bed.  Leaning against the wall next to an open blue door is a splintered ship's wheel.

title: [The Jolly Chimera, Deck]
description: A large chimera statue stands sentinel over the houseboat, its cheerfully painted figure brightening the entire polished teak deck.  A twining leaf-painted door leads into the deck-level cabin, while a brushed steel ladder leads deeper into the interior.  Ocean droplets on leaves and petals glint in the sunlight washing over the numerous healing herbs and potted plants that ring the deck and cabin, and several different arkati icons are carved into the outer rail's posts.

A large chimera statue stands sentinel over the houseboat, its cheerfully painted figure looming over the night-shadowed deck.  A twining leaf-painted door leads into the deck-level cabin, while a brushed steel ladder leads deeper into the interior.  Ocean droplets on leaves and petals glint in the starlight shining upon the numerous healing herbs and potted plants that ring the deck and cabin, and several different arkati icons are carved into the outer rail's posts.

title: [The Jolly Chimera, Cleric]
description: Several cots line the room beneath detailed murals of various ship battles with body-strewn decks.  Each mural depicts a dwarven cleric walking cheerfully through the carnage.  The floors are scuffed and splattered with crimson stains, which are only partially obscured by various potted herbs.  A dusty cabinet is filled with chrism gems, white flasks, and obscure paraphernalia.

title: [The Jolly Chimera, Healer]
description: Lush greenery in terracotta pots fills the area with the overwhelming fragance of healing herbs and plants.  A few utilitarian cots are positioned within reach of the healer, and several shelves line the walls, overflowing with potions, elixirs, and salves.

title: [The Flying Squirrel, Bow]
description: Wide planks of pitch-covered larch stretch from a companionway to the ornately carved figurehead gracing the bowsprit.  A large coil of tarred hemp rope lies at the base of a thick mast that rises twenty feet in the air.  A crow's nest is perched at the very top of the mast and has a commanding view of the moon glinting off the waves.  An ironwood gangway is positioned between a gap in the low railing.

title: [The Drifting Depository]
description: Dank and humid, the brigantine's interior is dimly lit by flickering torches.  A ripped banner hangs along the back wall, reading "Bank of Kraken's Fall," and an incongruously pristine and gigantic iron vault sits in the corner behind a rickety counter.  Two guards flank the vault, each bristling with weaponry and bulging muscles.

title: [Good Fences]
description: Uneven flooring with a decided downward slant holds dozens of rickety shelves crammed with dust-covered trinkets from numerous ports of call.  A glass-fronted countertop may once have been designed to showcase wares, but its current smudged and saltstained existence reveals only shadowy outlines of items in its depths.  Sitting on top of the countertop is a small sign propped up by a rusty bell that reads, "Ring for Service."

title: [Good Fences, In the Hold]
description: The large hold of the ship is partitioned off with rickety shelves, tattered sailcloth curtains, and a rusty string of small cannons.  Four tables are set up closest to the stairs leading back up, one displaying armor, another with weapons, the third cluttered with magic items, and the final one overflowing with odd bits of miscellany.

title: [Captain's Quarters]
description: A trio of round, brass-encased portholes along the port side offer unfettered views of the seas, the moon shining on the crests of her waves.  A cushioned bench runs the length of the portholes, and a hammock hangs along the starboard side, swaying gently with the rocking movement of the ship.  Suspended from the center of the ceiling by a short chain is a half-shuddered iron lantern, oscillating to the ocean's rhythm.  Hanging from a nail next to a bow companionway is a small piece of mirror with desilvered edges, and tucked into a corner next to a stern companionway is a copper urn.

title: [The Flying Squirrel, Stern]
description: With one end supported by stacked crates and the other lashed to the taffrail, a salt-stained driftwood bar dominates the rear section of the deck.  Several three-legged wooden stools are arranged along the front of the bar, while a one-legged pirate stands behind it, ready to serve.  Lit torches are evenly spaced along the taffrail, between which can be seen the ocean waves on the starboard side and the busy flotilla on the port side.  A large coil of rope lays next to a companionway.

title: [Lower Deck, Bow]
description: Rope-coiled rungs driven into the port and starboard sides near their convergence form a ladder of sorts, allowing quick travel between decks.  A bucket with a mop in it sits in a corner, ready for use on the scuffed pine floor.  Hanging next to a port side door is a large starfish, and nailed next to starboard side door is a lobster claw.

title: [Lower Deck, Starboard Lounge]
description: A row of carefully stacked wooden crates lines one wall, and opposite is a metal basin on a large pine stand.  Nailed to the wall above the basin is a small piece of mirror, while a frayed linen cloth hangs from a nearby hook.  Covering the pine flooring is a worn, blue wool rug, and a large, crimson lobster claw is nailed next to a door.

title: [Lower Deck, Portside Lounge]
description: A row of precariously stacked wooden crates lines one wall, and opposite is a white ceramic basin on a large oak stand.  Nailed to the wall above the basin is a small piece of mirror, while a dirty linen cloth hangs from a nearby hook.  Covering the pine flooring is a worn, red wool rug, and a large starfish is nailed next to a door.

title: [Steerage, Bow]
description: Rope-coiled rungs driven into the port and starboard sides near their convergence form a ladder of sorts, allowing quick travel to the upper decks.  Large coils of hemp rope are stacked on a row of barrels, and a broom lies on the floor by an overturned bucket.  Yards of discolored canvas lean between a thick metal hatch and a brass-handled door.

title: [Forward Observation Cabin]
description: A multi-paned window takes up a majority of one wall and affords a view of the forward berthing compartment.  A row of cushion-topped crates are situated around the open window.  Several names are written in chalk on the wall next to a brass-handled door, and all of the names are crossed out except for one -- Capt'n Jingles.

title: [Lower Deck, Stern]
description: Rope-coiled rungs driven into the aft boards form a ladder of sorts, allowing quick travel between decks.  A bucket with a mop in it sits in a corner, ready for use on the scuffed pine floor.  Hanging next to a port side door is a strip of bloodied linen.

title: [The Flying Squirrel, Infirmary]
description: An unshuttered iron-caged lantern hangs from the ceiling by a short chain and sways above a pair of wood-framed cots.  A white metal cabinet is mounted on the wall, packed with an assortment of bandages, powders, colorful vials of liquids, and a large bottle of whiskey.  A wooden bucket in one corner is filled with soiled bandages, and a makeshift rack is nailed to the wall beside a door.  A peg-legged, ancient pirate serves as the crew's surgeon and main occupant of the infirmary.

title: [Steerage, Stern]
description: Rope-coiled rungs driven into the aft boards form a ladder of sorts, allowing quick travel to the upper decks.  Rows of casks line the walls, some clearly marked as alcohol, while others have more questionable symbols.  Bales of tobacco line the wall opposite a thick metal hatch, and large sacks of rice are piled up around a brass-handled door.

title: [Rear Observation Cabin]
description: A multi-paned window takes up a majority of one wall and affords a view of the rear berthing compartment.  A row of cushion-topped crates are situated around the open window.  Several names are written in chalk on the wall next to a brass-handled door, and all of the names are crossed out except for one -- Bo'sun Jones.

title: [Bloated Peacock Table]
description: Mismatched chairs ring a lopsided wooden table, which is nothing more than a large crate overturned atop a barrel.  Scratched into the table's surface are a myriad of designs, including a rather large peacock.  The bird seems overly large and has X's for eyes.  The floor under the table is covered in something that is both slimy and sticky.

title: [Grinning Shark Table]
description: Chairs are pushed around a squat wooden table, which is little more than a large crate on a stack of smaller crates.  Protruding through the top of the makeshift table is an imposingly large shark tooth.  The floor under the table is covered in something that is both slimy and sticky.

title: [White Feather Table]
description: Thick, bronze bars protect two small panes of glass that hang on the wall above a cracked wooden table.  Sandwiched between the grimy, protective plates is a pure white feather.  A small piece of paper is secured to the wall by a shiny dagger embedded nearly to the hilt.

title: [Barnacle Table]
description: A large, wooden spool lies on its side, the top surface now repurposed as a warped wooden table.  Rings of some unidentified, sticky substance are scattered across the table top, and the underside is covered in barnacles.  A small puddle of murky liquid glistens on the floor.

title: [Crooked Docks, Pirate Pier]
description: Five crooked piers float haphazardly along the outer edge of the flotilla, a series of ropes and pulleys hanging at the ready to collapse the docking system at a moment's notice for rapid travel.  The uneven decks are comprised of dozens of types of wood, most resembling salvage from ships' hulls, and some ragged bits of cork serve as minimal padding at each docking slip.  A battered sign carved with a skull and crossbones reads, "Pirate Pier - Slips 11-15."

title: [Crooked Docks, Pirate Pier]

The uneven decks are comprised of dozens of types of wood, most resembling salvage from ships' hulls, and some ragged bits of cork serve as minimal padding at each docking slip.  A battered sign carved with a skull and crossbones reads, "Pirate Pier - Slips 16-20."

title: [Crooked Docks, Pirate Pier]
description: Five crooked piers float haphazardly along the outer edge of the flotilla, a series of ropes and pulleys hanging at the ready to collapse the docking system at a moment's notice for rapid travel.  The uneven decks are comprised of dozens of types of wood, most resembling salvage from ships' hulls, and some ragged bits of cork serve as minimal padding at each docking slip.  A battered sign carved with a skull and crossbones reads, "Pirate Pier - Slips 21-25."

title: [Sylvan Beast Dahcre Chamber]
description: From the corners of this spacious hexagonal room rise pale granite pillars cleverly carved to mimic wide-boled willow trees.  Like branches, granite tracery overhead supports a transparent glaes ceiling, pierced in the center by the flue of a circular fieldstone hearth.  To one side stands a simple wooden pedestal, the ranger statue it holds reflected in the still pool nearby.  A polished malachite token is set above the willow withe arch piercing the southern wall.

title: [Darkened Chamber]
description: A single glaesine sconce attached to the wall illuminates the small chamber, casting a fitfully flickering light across the room's few features.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Dangling from a chain at one side of the room is a small mithglin ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Private Locker]
description: Jade green marble veined with cream covers the small amount of floor space, while pale oak paneling forms a modest wainscoting.  A white-on-cream figured silk covers the upper portion of the walls.

title: [Annex, Willow Hall's Veranda]
description: A gentle breeze filters through this rustic area with a mild scent of flora.  Two walls have been paneled with pine, while the floor is covered with a lush forest green carpet.  An overhead lantern illuminates a circular polished rosewood bar with matching leather and cherrywood stools.  Two walls have been framed with a trellis interwoven with blue roses, but left open to nature with only a hand carved railing expanding across the bottom, with potted strawberry plants nestling in the corners.  Several overstuffed couches are placed throughout the room, with small tables beside them.

title: [Willow Hall, Locker Alcove]
description: The alcove is intimate, with a plush forest green rug, and a green-shaded lantern that sheds a soft light.  A cedar counter protrudes from the back wall with a matching stool facing it.  Over the counter are numerous cedar lockers, each one's door polished to a high sheen.

title: [Willow Hall Annex]
description: Two huge toadstools in large stone pots illuminate a large, comfortable room.  Dusky brown granite benches line two of the marble walls, facing each other across the sapphire carpet.  On one wall, a brass arch allows exit to the corridor outside, while on the other wall a curtain provides entrance to the locker area.

title: [Willow Hall Lockers]
description: A small swarm of fireflies flit about in a cylindrical cage hung from the granite ceiling.  Their blinking green and yellow glows softly illuminate this small room.  Though the marble walls are unadorned and the granite floor is uncarpeted, the room still provides a quiet place for contemplating the contents of your locker.

title: [House Annex, Willow Hall]
description: Devoid of nearby furnishings, a black willow tree mural decorates the western wall under the light of several frosted glaesine globes that dangle from the ceiling.  Plush grass green carpeting dappled with straw yellow threads lends the otherwise austere space a coziness that is enhanced by the presence of a hunter green crushed velvet settee.  A lacquered white door leads to the hallway, while a green-edged ebon linen curtain provides access to the storage facilities.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: Ivory drapes hang upon the walls, their overly long lower edges pooling upon the soft rug that stretches from wall to wall.  The drape's silken lengths are unfettered except where they are parted to provide egress through a green-edged ebon linen curtain.  A lacquered ebonwood counter sits in the center of the circular chamber, beneath the light of an enormous seaglass orb that is held aloft by a woven hemp basket.

title: [Amber Lounge]
description: Abstract tapestries in autumn hues cover the walls of this cozy room, while a scattering of silken pillows provides a place to rest.  A modwir pedestal bearing a minature willow tree stands proudly by the entrance.

title: [Oteska's Den, Entry]
description: Wood made from repurposed ships' hulls lines the floors and walls of this small entryway, all polished to a rich sheen.  The variety of woods and hues is broken by an iron-worked rich maoral door leading back to the shop, and a spiral staircase winding up.  Hanging between a pair of crossed cutlasses is a brass plaque, and an unusually neat pile of netted glass floats is carefully arranged in one corner, each globe dimly lit from the inside to illuminate the area.
location: Oteska's Den, inside the island town of River's Rest

title: [Oteska's Den, Main Cabin]
description: Cozy and with a theme best described as pirate meets eccentric, the walls of the main living area are covered with a collection of maps and charts with a dart board positioned carefully between them and above a cupboard.  Several leather chairs arranged in a loose semi-circle around the fireplace rest on a rug woven to resemble a treasure map.  Sunlight streams through a large, bullseye window over a curtain-covered arch, brightening the area and bathing a spiral staircase in its warm rays.
location: Oteska's Den, inside the island town of River's Rest

title: [Oteska's Den, Galley]
description: Serving as a focal point for the galley, a picture window with a planter box of verdant occupants spans the length of the preparation counter and allows a pleasing view of the River's Rest environs.  Brightly polished, copper pots and pans hang on racks overhead, and several shelves house a plethora of dishes and flatware.  In one corner rests a large porcelain sink and opposite it sits a solid oak pantry.  Sunlight glints off the copper above, casting a cheerful glow about the galley.
location: Oteska's Den, inside the island town of River's Rest

title: [Oteska's Den, Sleeping Quarters]
description: Several bookcases line the walls and surround a bed with a battered leather sea chest resting at its foot and a glass-paned brass sconce hanging on the wall above it.  Narrow windows along the upper walls let in daylight, casting a shadow across a narrow maoral door.  A small stack of books next to the bed is topped by one entitled, "Secrets of the Tempest River."
location: Oteska's Den, inside the island town of River's Rest

title: [Oteska's Den, Navigation]
description: Every open surface of the study's walls is neatly covered in maps and charts, each bearing organized and color-coded, but incomprehensible, notes and markings.  An intricate brass sextant and astrolabe set hang over a case, and sunlight dapples the surface of a teak desk and matching chair.  Between a chart of the lunar cycles and several small constellation drawings sits a bookcase overflowing with additional research and information.
location: Oteska's Den, inside the island town of River's Rest

title: [Subterranean Hideaway]
description: Several bioluminescent fungi dotting the walls and ceiling provide light for the subterranean cavern, casting a soothing blue-green glow over everything.  Set into the moist rock wall, a ladder leads to a wooden panel in the ceiling.  A single strand of tiny glass baubles hangs over a partially buried sea chest, each glowing with a yellow-red light, and steam rises from a handcarved stone pool in the center of the cavern.  Some shelves hold several towels and a handful of refreshments.

title: [Hinterwilds Caravan, Sleigh]
description: The capacious sleigh is one of several traveling swiftly toward the Hinterwilds, driven by a polite northerner.  Drawn by a team of well-fed sled dogs, the sleigh is piled high with supplies.  There are also fur blankets that, if a bit musky, provide ample warmth to both driver and riders.

title: [Twilight Hall, Agaric's Room]
description: This room appears to be a cavern hewn from dark gray stone with white ora veins.  A rocking chair sits in front of a cleverly carved niche in the stone wall that serves as a fireplace.  The sparse furnishings include a neatly made bed covered with a grey and red blanket, and a large table holding various chemicals and potions neatly stored in jars and flasks.  A shelf on the wall holds scrolls, tomes and writing implements, including a grey tome and a black ledger labeled "Twilight Hall Accounts."

title: [Stout Street Armory, Courtyard]
description: White dryad hedges grow along the high iron fence enclosing the courtyard, which is paved with cobblestones.  Flying a silk pennant emblazoned with a charging mule, a low-roofed stone guard post stands toward the rear of the courtyard.  A lone training dummy of sackcloth, propped up by a spruce stake, stands near to the entrance.  It looks like it has endured more than a few beatings.

title: [Stout Street Armory, Foyer]
description: A charging mule seal is picked out in mosaic tiles on the floor of the armory, worn by time and the passage of many feet.  A short, blocky desk of carved modwir guards the area before a riveted heavy steel door, kept meticulously free of dust and debris.  Lanterns suspended from the ceiling are unlit, but the smell of lamp oil lends a sweetly tart fragrance to the air.

title: [Stout Street Armory, Map Room]
description: An ornate hoarbeam desk and accompanying leather chair sit in the corner of the spacious chamber, flanked by a stack of heavy wooden crates to one side.  Much of the room is given over to a large model of Icemule Trace occupying a tiered depression in the chamber's floor.  Despite the plain stone structure of the surrounding armory, no expense appears to have been spared in the construction of the wooden models or the bright-colored map on which they rest.

title: [Stout Street Armory, Infirmary]
description: An old mural adorns the far wall of the close infirmary, lending a splash of color to the dour surroundings.  The floor and walls are made of stone and only a single barred window allows in sunlight in wan beams alive with scarce motes of sparkling dust.  Acrid and herbal, a medicinal smell emanates from a large mirrored cabinet in the northern wall.  Cots line the floor, clean and ready for triage.

title: [Stout Street Armory, Arsenal]
description: Racks of good steel weapons march in neat, orderly rows down the walls of the arsenal.  Many, but not all, appear sized for smaller wielders.  The air is close and heavily scented with acrid grease and polish used to keep the stored weaponry ready for combat.

title: [Black Sands Isle, Cavern]
description: This tiny cavern is enclosed by craggy walls and a very low ceiling.  Against the opposite wall from the narrow entry is a small chest affixed with a bright brass lock.

title: [Bliss Island, Dock]
description: A short bollard has been painted green, standing out against the smooth, pale planks of a short pier jutting off the beach.  The dark waters glisten in the moonlight, and faint phosphorescence can be seen in the distance.  Further inland, a long cobbled pathway leads into lush tropical flora redolent of heady fragrances.

title: [Bliss Island, Garden]
description: Glossy leaves of indigenous flora shimmer in the moonlight, with closed blossoms punctuating the dark green foliage.  The slender trees and larger greenery rise out of moist loam, while smaller plants reside in neatly tended beds and painted pottery.  Despite the man-made nature of the garden, the area retains a distinctly natural feel to it.  A cobbled path lined with a thin border of jade sea glass bisects the tropical oasis.

title: [Bliss Island, Beach]
description: Lapping waters caress the peaceful beach, the surf creating a gentle rhythm like the heartbeat of the secluded island.  Scattered about are variegated seashells that have washed up onto shore over time.  Bathed in moonlight, a lone palm has been sent swaying in the tropical night, casting a dancing shadow against the pale sand.

title: [Bliss Island, Swimming Area]
description: Situated in a small cove, the dark blue waters of the swimming area bounce of the shore and ripple calmly through the secluded harbor.  A protective ring of rocks near the opening of the cove prevents larger sea denizens from entering the area and also keeps the tide from growing too strong.  Rhythmic and persistent, the surf crashes on the sands of the distant beach and creates undulating waves to float upon.

title: [Bliss Island, Path]
description: Secluded within a sizeable clearing encircled by a lush tropical garden is a quaint, green-shingled cottage.  A cobbled walkway leads up to the abode's front door painted deep viridian to match the shutters and trim.  Affixed to the top of a nearby signpost is a lifelike parrot statuette.

title: [Bliss Island, Dock]
description: A short bollard has been painted red, standing out against the smooth, pale planks of a short pier jutting off the beach.  The dark waters glisten in the moonlight, and faint phosphorescence can be seen in the distance.  Further inland, a long cobbled pathway leads into lush tropical flora redolent of heady fragrances.

title: [Bliss Island, Guest Bedroom]
description: Moonlight streams in through a window that affords a view of the beach and its glistening waters.  The soft white walls have been painted with stylized crimson vines that are repeated in the motif of the dresser and nightstand.  A large hope chest rests at the foot of the bed, and a full-length mirror stands in the corner.

title: [Bliss Island, Kitchen]
description: A massive stone hearth dominates the kitchen, its glowing embers radiating warmth along the floor.  The high ceiling has been fitted with vermilion rafters, while open windows let in the slightly salty sea air.  Laid out upon a sea glass-inlaid countertop are several trays of food and beverages.  Alternating red and white tiles have been inlaid into a square teakwood table, which has been surrounded by four matching chairs.

title: [Mist Harbor, Jail]
description: Whitewashed walls break up none of the monotony that is the inside of the jail.  A single candle burns on a stone slab which provides the only seating.

title: [Wehnimer's, Jail Cell]
description: Dirty walls surround you, and a metal-banded door blocks your only exit.  From somewhere in the darkness, you can hear the sound of a creature moving about.

title: [River's Rest, The Brig]
description: Surrounded by darkness, dampness and the smell of mildew, you find yourself cutoff from the light and life of the town somewhere above.  An occasional heavy footstep overhead breaks the silence but the muddy walls quickly dampen the sound.  It seems this is not meant to be a comfortable place and you are soon totally damp as the floor seems to be mostly muddy water.  There is nothing to do now but wait.

title: [Icemule Trace, Cell]
description: The low ceiling of this cell was obviously designed for the shorter races of Elanthia.  The floor is covered with straw, and a distasteful scent lingers in the air.  The only exit is a small steel door with a barred window in the center.

title: [The Cockroach Pit]
description: A rough hole ten feet square and fifteen feet deep has been excavated from the granite rock.  Cold, clammy moisture clings to the walls, and the stench of blood, decaying flesh and excrement hangs heavily in the air.  The ceiling is a heavy steel grate with only a couple of inches between the bars.  Rats peer down from between the bars, eyeing the occupants of the hole hungrily and hoping for the occupants' imminent demise.  What they don't eat, the cockroaches will finish off.

title: [Hall of Justice, Oubliette]
description: Silence.  Loneliness.  Despair.  Here you are lost, with no clear idea of when you will be found.  The oubliette is a round, featureless room, with no visible entryway or exit, save for a tiny grating some thirty or more feet above you.  Water drips down steadily from the metal grate, causing a faint rhythmic tapping noise to penetrate the ever present silence.

title: [Hall of Justice, Pit of Doom]
description: Vaguely circular in structure, the pit is only approximately ten feet wide.  What little light reaches the bottom of the fetid enclosure illuminates things better left unseen.  Brackish water fills the bottom few inches of the room, and the constant sound of trickling can be heard as more seeps in through cracks in the pit's stony walls.  The slick fungus on the walls makes them impossible to climb.

title: [Lockup]
description: The inside of the cell is rank...so rank it seems even the rats have found better accomodations.  Water drips from the ceiling, nurturing a foul-smelling mold on the walls and making the packed earth floor a sloppy mud.  On closer inspection, a pile of red dust becomes the remnants of shackles long ago rusted, and you hesitate to inspect the puddle in the corner.  You will certainly keep from breaking the law in this place, if only to never have to see this cell again.

title: [Jailhouse, Cell]
description: Stone steps, three in total, rise from the hardpacked dirt floor of the cell towards a solid door of scratched and dented metal.  Iron-wrapped oak benches are bolted to the three remaining granite walls, though space is left to allow guests to stand in the corners.  Dim, discolored light fills the space from a small rainbow glaes window that offers a warped view of the jailhouse entry.

title: [Reformatory, Detention Cell]
description: The only source of light in this cramped cell is from a small, oval window with bars.  Pushed against the wall, supporting an overstuffed feather mattress, sits an iron-framed cot.  Clearly visible from beneath the cot is the edge of a tattered manual that is missing its cover.  Locked tightly, a featureless metal door stands between this cubicle and freedom.

title: [Rogue Guild, Workshop Toolbench]
description: The worn weathered surface of the toolbench carries its history of generations of training craftsmen.  Small files and drills lay stacked neatly at one end, while blank scraps are piled at the other.  A small pattern of grooves and scratches leaves the evidence of its constant use.

title: [Workbench]
description: The workbench is crafted from hardened dark wood and looks sturdy enough for just about any job.  Raw materials are stacked neatly to the side awaiting your use.  Just above them are the tools needed for locksmithing and keymaking.

title: [Rogue Guild, Workbench]
description: A giant, luminescent toadstool rises from a rectangular ceramic pot in the corner, shedding a bright, bluish-white light over the workshop.  A variety of tools and materials are split neatly between a hanging rack and a polished steel workbench.

title: [The Rift]
description: A mass of pulsing and twitching tissue sits to the west.  At first, the booming that rolls through the air sounds like thunder, but a moment of listening proves it to be too regular and rhythmic to be a storm.  Thump-thump... thump-thump....  All at once the source comes to you, and as you gaze at the tissue you realize it is a giant heart.  Grey-green worms chew through the flesh, and listening to the beating it becomes obvious that they are killing the heart, and whatever creature it belongs to.

wayto.12208: out

title: [A Weathered Shack]
description: Long modwir shelves lined with various potions, tools, and the unidentifiable remains of plants dominate one side of this relatively large shack.  A simple counter sits near the rear of the room directly in front of a thick wooden door.

title: [Lyra-Flyr Stables]
description: Polished copper lanterns hang from several beams, their light shedding a pale warmth over the straw-covered wooden floor.  Several rows of stalls line the walls of the stable, each entry beautifully carved with a blooming flower.  Cleaned and polished tack hangs from pegs set into the walls, a stand of saddles placed underneath.

title: [Waste Not]
description: Intricate knots bind the colorful roofing to the tree's limbs, while grommets, rope, and brass anchors bind the breeze-rippled walls in matching shades of red and yellow to the smooth oak platform that serves as the shop's floor.  Woven baskets, lashed plank shelves, and dangling carryalls house various sundries, while a smooth counter offers a comfortable and well-illuminated space for ordering.

title: [Cleric Guild, Cauldron Room]
description: Small windows provide light and a view in this unrelievedly sterile room of white marble.  Within the room itself, the only color is a huge bright copper cauldron with clawed feet set in the center of the floor.

title: [The Elven Sole, Entry]
description: The lacquered floor has been fashioned from a mixture of parqueted light and dark wood.  A freestanding desk in the center of the room has a long-haired elven woman behind it.  Against the left wall is a stockpile of wooden crates stamped in black with a logo of crossed laces.  A colossal bronze sign hangs above the grand archway, which leads to an illuminated hallway.

title: [The Elven Sole, Alcove]
description: This small room is cut off from the hustle and bustle of the rest of the building.  The parqueted floors are left unadorned, but the walls are decorated with elegant oil portraits of fashionable men and women showing off their footwear.  A maple writing desk is tucked into a corner of the room with a narrow-back chair behind it.

title: [The Elven Sole, Store]
description: The parqueted floor is mostly covered by massive sanguine hand-knotted rug.  An impressive display of cobbling materials is stocked within the floor-to-ceiling shelves that line north wall, while a small glass display showcases some of the fancier adornments.

title: [The Elven Sole, Tannery]
description: The lacquered parquet flooring stops abruptly at the bottom of a carved oak counter.  Behind the counter, the flooring is a seamless sheet of polished white marble.  Along the east wall are numerous vats that have been sculpted from raised flooring and separated by etched dividers.  Each vat contains a different dye, while several large mixing pools are filled with skins in various states of coloring.  Along the north wall a carved stone workbench is covered with pelts and tools, while a large portcullis dominates the west wall.

title: [The Elven Sole, Hallway]
description: The rib-vaulted ceiling of this hallway has a suspended metal sphere chandelier in each section.  A warm apricot color paints the walls, interrupted only by an oval bronze sign that hangs between the workshop doors.  There is a a grand archway that opens to the entry.

title: [The Elven Sole, Hallway]
description: The rib-vaulted ceiling of this hallway has a suspended metal sphere chandelier in each section.  A warm apricot color paints the walls, interrupted only by an oval bronze sign that hangs between the workshop doors.

title: [Sandal Workshop]
description: The rich paneling of the room is fashioned from spalted maple, each cornered with a niche radius display of fancy chopines.  A sturdy U-shaped worktable meets against the back wall with an oversized steel-banded barrel tucked underneath.  Just above the table is an organized tool rack with countless pieces of cobbling equipment.  Hanging from the ceiling is modest iron chandelier cast with intricate beadwork.

title: [Daisy Workshop]
description: The rich paneling of the room is fashioned from spalted maple, each cornered with a niche radius display of fancy chopines.  A sturdy U-shaped worktable meets against the back wall with an oversized steel-banded barrel tucked underneath.  Just above the table is an organized tool rack with countless pieces of cobbling equipment.  Hanging from the ceiling is modest iron chandelier cast with tiny daisies.

title: [Lilac Workshop]
description: The rich paneling of the room is fashioned from spalted maple, each cornered with a niche radius display of fancy chopines.  A sturdy U-shaped worktable meets against the back wall with an oversized steel-banded barrel tucked underneath.  Just above the table is an organized tool rack with countless pieces of cobbling equipment.  Hanging from the ceiling is modest iron chandelier cast with lilac blooms.

title: [Vornavis, Vespertine Gate]
description: Shaggy cypress, planted in close proximity to one another, form a natural barrier that hides the view of a nearby tower, its wicket, and its grounds, while also providing a bright green contrast to the uniform grey and white of the lane.  Avenues branch off, each seeking the center of Vornavis and departing from the protective shelter of the Vornavis-Solhaven wall.  Shadows encircle the green copper gates, despite the orbs offering pulsating illumination, a guard just visible beyond its access point.

title: [Vornavis, Dondraek Lane]
description: Following the curvature of the city's walls, the cobblestone street travels in a gentle incline to the north.  Columnar lampposts glisten in the daylight, the large frosted orbs that crown them dormant for the moment and temporary perches for migratory avians.  Brownstone homes are surrounded by small patchwork yards of dusky green centipede grass and maoral-framed herb or flower beds throughout this section of the city.

Following the curvature of the city's walls, the cobblestone street travels in a gentle incline to the north.  Columnar lampposts glow with a steady, bright light that dispels the shadows of night that linger this close to the city's walls.  Brownstone homes rise in tidy rows down the lane, their faces illuminated by smaller globes that dot the pathways leading through their small yards to their doors.

title: [Vornavis, Gate of Shadows]
description: Dispelling shadows at every turn, frosted globes anchored to the arch above the Solhaven gates emit a steady white glow.  Wide sandstone slabs, worn smooth by travelers over years, are fitted between the city walls and the nearby buildings that fills the lane.  Heavily beamed rooves slant from the various structures, their tops hidden beyond the shadow-inducing lips.

title: [Vornavis, Dondraek Bridge]
description: Forming a large arch over the wide canal, blue limestone blocks are fitted with green pavers to create a wide bridge with verdigris copper railings.  To the west and slightly below, the canal waters are controlled by a series of sea gates that adjust the flow depending on the direction of the vessels trapped in its sections.  Dike revetments curve along the northern and southern banks, protecting the city in the event of stormy weather.

title: [Vornavis, Gate of Light]
description: Bordered on its south by the interlocking pavers of the canal-spanning bridge, the sprawling courtyard is comprised of rounded cobblestones painted bright white and laid in concentric bands around a marble fountain.  Flanking the gates that connect Vornavis to Solhaven are wrought iron loops that resemble shepherd's crooks, each dangling a glass-doored octagonal lantern dormant in the daylight.  Branching out from the courtyard like the rays of a stylized sun, five avenues head deeper into the city.

Bordered on its south by the interlocking pavers of the canal-spanning bridge, the sprawling courtyard is comprised of rounded cobblestones painted bright white and laid in concentric bands around a marble fountain.  Flanking the gates that connect Vornavis to Solhaven are wrought iron loops that resembed shepherd's crooks, each dangling a glass-doored octagonal lantern that bathes the area in bright light.  Branching out from the courtyard like the rays of a stylized sun, five avenues head deeper into the city.

title: [Vornavis, Dondraek Lane]
description: Western-facing homes line the ambling lane, each surrounded by decorative bushes and ample lawns.  Beyond the tidy rows, the illuminated city thrums with activity and life as denizens hurry about their busy day.  Narrowing perceptibly to the north, the small cobbles of the street transition to large slabs of worn sandstone as it slips between an imposing structure and the city walls.

Narrowing perceptibly to the north, the small cobbles of the street transition to large slabs of worn sandstone as it slips between an imposing structure and the city walls.

title: [Vornavis, Dondraek Lane]
description: Slowly transitioning from a residential area to the south, the northern section of the avenue that follows the line of the Vornavis-Solhaven wall becomes less densely populated.  Lampposts are more prevalent amid the tidy storehouses and customs houses, which are surrounded by wagons in various stages of being loaded or unloaded.  A set of cobbled stairs rises towards the gated entry into the sister city.

title: [Vornavis, Gate of the Tradesmen]
description: Known colloquially as the Tradesmen's Gates, a wide stone structure juts out from the copper-faced doors that interrupt the tall Vornavis-Solhaven wall.  Cobbled stairs to the south and north ascend to the bustling warehouse district of the imperial city, where refracted light bounces off of lanterns that are strung up on the avenue below.  Fuchsia-footed wandering sailor, a local ivy, climbs the walls, finding purchase in the ancient mortar between the stacked stone blocks.
