Cobbled stairs to the south and north ascend to the bustling warehouse district of the imperial city, where pinpoints of lantern light glow from where they are strung up on the avenue below.  Fuchsia-footed wandering sailor, a local ivy, climbs the walls, finding purchase in the ancient mortar between the stacked stone blocks.

title: [Vornavis, Outer Bailey Avenue]
description: Cobbled with white pavers and sporadically dotted with blue and green fieldstones, the avenue passes through the residential area of Vornavis between both the eastern and western curtain walls.  Growing less densely populated, the homes are in a chalet style and surrounded by cultivated hedges and manicured lawns.  Flower-festooned baskets hang from broad lampposts topped with frosted glass orbs, the lacquered wrought iron glittering in the lamplight.

title: [Vornavis, Outer Bailey Avenue]
description: Wide and spacious, the lane to the east is free of buildings to allow the guards on the parapets of the outer bailey walls an unobstructived view of the area, while below them, an iron-reinforced ironwood portcullis provides access to a built-in gatehouse.  The nearest building is a three-story orphanage with a gabled roof that is set back from the walls by a distance of thirty or forty paces, its nearest partners sitting across the street are much smaller buildings that are clustered along the edges of a crowded cobblestone avenue that darts deeper into the city.

title: [Nexus]
description: Golden bars of alternating heights are joined by cross-beams as a barrier on the edges of the square platform.  In the center, cobblestone pavers spiral outward from a tall iron lampost with a timeless statue in front of it.  The platform seemingly drifts along in a endless, soundless darkness.  In the corner on a raised pedestal is a large dark sign.

title: [Distorted Winding Road]
description: Cobblestone pavers lead up to a ripple of light spanning the center of the room.  Within the light, a distorted road winds its way up to a swan-embossed gate with a robust Vornavian guard standing next to it.

title: [Distorted Wharf]
description: Ripples of light distort the water of Darkstone Bay surrounding the South Wharf.  Several two-masted schooners are moored nearby.

title: [Distorted Campaign Tent]
description: Cobblestone pavers lead up to a ripple of light spanning the center of the room.  Within the light, you can see somewhere near upper trollfang and a sink hole.

title: [Schooner Docks, Bait Shop]
description: The smell of fish and salty sea air pervades the small building.  Several wooden crates of varying sizes are stacked haphazardly along the back wall near a long counter.  A large barrel holds some of the shop's wares, as well as the robust stench of worms and other bait.  Behind the counter, various goods are stacked upon some long shelves.

title: [Great Western Sea]
description: The icy, dark blue water of the Northern Waves stretches out around you in every direction.  Rippling waves, some topped with whitecaps, chop up the surface and make it difficult for you to tread water.  The triple masts of the krolvin warship tower over the much smaller schooner.  You notice that a ladder extends down from the schooner's deck to the east.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Great Western Sea]
description: The nearby schooner offers some protection from the choppy water of the Northern Waves.  The great hull of the nearby krolvin warship is dangerously close, threatening to crush you between the two ships.  A long rope ladder descends from the schooner above, allowing ease of access to the vessel for those overboard.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Tower Moat]
description: The foul stench of rot and decay hangs heavy in the air here like a hideous, retch causing blanket.  The thick black water, which is surprisingly shallow, bubbles and churns with incredible vigor.

title: [Vornavis, Guard House]
description: Arrow loops dominate the southern wall of the narrow corridor that provides egress through the thick inner bailey walls, the expanse culminating in an iron-reinforced ironwood portcullis to the west and a pair of iron-fortified gates in the east.  Frosted orbs in the ceiling illuminate the space, each generating arcs of magical energy that pass between them with small hisses of sound.  Ropes for the portcullis are protected by a metal shield before disappearing into housings on either side of the corridor's walls.

title: [Vornavis, Inner Bailey]
description: Crescent-shaped, the courtyard stretches from the iron-fortified gates towards several broad steps that lead to the keep's heavy ironwood doors.  Alures offer guards viewpoints of the city beyond as well as the courtyard, while access to these places are concealed within the four towers that dot the curtain walls.  Balconies and windows also overlook the cobbled expanse, their ledges draped in pennants of emerald green emblazoned with a single ivory swan.

title: [Vornavis, Vestibule]
description: Large and circular, the grand vestibule has a domed ceiling and an enormous crystal chandelier anchored to three points in the sandstone walls.  Wall-hugging stairs form an arch over a pair of large fel doors, a banded brown wicket discreetly tucked in the shadows of the eastern staircase, while a double-wide green feldspar archway on the northern wall offers a view of an enormous dining hall.  Emerald green and ivory tiles form a decorative tile mosaic in the circular floor.

title: [Vornavis, Gallery]
description: Surrounded by tapestry covered walls, the gallery's landing is comprised of a clean, polished wood floor and sparse furnishings.  Emerald green runners line the way, each spreading from the wall-hugging stairs and disappearing into the wings in the northeast and southeast.  An aerial view of the vestibule is beyond a set of fel railings, while ornate pillars and a short wall provide a stone-framed view of the Great Hall below.

title: [Vornavis, Gallery South]
description: Emerald green Vornavian silk tapestries hang from the walls, their edges decorated with the embroidered image of local flowers, while their centers are emblazoned with a single ivory swan.  Smooth benches are arranged upon a three-step riser, providing a clear and easy view of the Great Hall below.

title: [Vornavis, Gallery North]
description: Emerald green Vornavian silk tapestries hang from the walls, their edges decorated with the embroidered image of local flowers, while their centers are emblazoned with a single ivory swan.  Smooth benches are arranged upon a three-step riser, providing a clear and easy view of the Great Hall below.

title: [Vornavis, Armory]
description: Illuminated by frosted globes that rest upon wrought iron sconces, the armory has heavy tapestries on its walls and thick carpets that muffles all sound in the space.  Suits of armor, some incredibly archaic and stained with age or use, stand like silent sentinels around the small armory.  A smattering of short-backed crescent chairs resides in the four corners, while a large planning table occupies the center.

title: [Vornavis, Banquet Hall]
description: Art pieces decorate the western sandstone wall of the dining hall, each coming in a variety of shapes, sizes, frames, and mediums, while the opposite wall is filled with stained glass windows.  Frosted orbs dispel the shadows from every corner of the space, offering a bright white glow over the long table draped in emerald green and surrounded by high-backed velveteen chairs.  A double-wide green feldspar archway provides egress to the vestibule, while small doors in the northern wall lead into the kitchens and cooking yard.

title: [Vornavis, Dondraek Lane]
description: Arcing to follow the curve of the Vornavian cliffs, the granite wall becomes shorter as the distance between the two cities expands due to the natural formations.  Short terraces dot the cliff face, each incredibly narrow and overflowing with vibrant apple blossom clematis, the dark leaves and vines of which dangle down to touch the cobblestone lane.  Northward, the storehouses and customs buildings give way to a wide road and smaller buildings surrounded by paddocks.

title: [Vornavis, Dondraek Lane]
description: Sharply falling away, the buildings and warehouses of the western part of the city abruptly ends at a wide expanse of road that abuts the Vornavian cliffs.  Scaffolding, complex pulley systems, and anchored ropes ascend to the top of the cliff face and are utilized to lower various crated wares from the Solhaven streets to the ground below.  Two lines of goods, heavily guarded, await their final destination - either deeper into the city or up to the port town.

title: [Vornavis, Dondraek Lane]
description: Transitioning from a wide lane to the south, the path narrows perceptibly and curves through a grassy plateau that is surrounded by the bustling city, the Vornavian cliffs, and the slopping city walls.  All manner of equine, bovine, caprine, ovine, and porcine noises can be heard from the various paddocks, stables, and stalls that dot the area.  Though each structure and fenced enclosure appears well-kept and clean, the coastal winds still occasionally pull unpleasant odors from their vicinity.

title: [Vornavis, Gate of Tears]
description: Winding a sinuous path away from the walled grasslands of Vornavis, a cobblestone path descends to the city from the verdigris copper gates of the holdings beyond.  Evenly spaced lanterns, little more than sturdy shepherd's hooks dangling bowl-like lanterns, shift and click as an almost continuous breeze tugs at them.  Faint, yet insistent, the roar of the Cascade of Tears is a steady drone in the background.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The smell of rotting organics fills the air as you pick your way though the rotting straw that clutters up the road.  The road looks much the same off to the north and south.

title: [Bard Guild, Ladies' Salon]
description: Walls of ivory watered silk framed in gold-washed pearwood define this small, elegant salon.  A few settees are clustered in the center of the room, providing rest for feet weary from dancing.  A bird's-eye maple vanity covered with an assortment of small vials and canisters runs along one wall, lined with a row of oval-backed chairs facing mirrors lit by bright wall sconces.

title: [Mine]
description: The floor is covered with guano which makes footing unsure as you make your way between the stalagmites.  The sounds from the bats above you grow louder as you sense that they are disturbed by your presence.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Mine]
description: The floor is covered with guano which makes footing unsure as you make your way between the stalagmites.  The sounds from the bats above you grow louder as you sense that they are disturbed by your presence.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [The Broken Coin, Entry]
description: Thin planks of blackened wood line the walls of the small nook.  Faded and worn, once-decadent green and gold rugs adorn a narrow walkway, while an old worn desk rests in one corner.  Against the far wall, a tall bookcase stands with several items on its shelves.  Lying on a small crate, a barely lit lamp gives a dim golden-yellow illumination.

title: [The Broken Coin, East Room]
description: Once-beautiful scarlet and black scarves with gold accents suspended from the ceiling have begun to deteriorate and fall apart.  What was once a series of luxurious pillows now lay scattered along the floor, their bright coloring and intricate designs faded long ago.  Tiny shafts of light pour in from cracks throughout the walls as dust gathers in their wooden crevices.  Nearby, a long wooden shelf lines a moisture-stained wall, while a yellowed sheaf of paper is tacked next to it.

title: [Be Still My Hops, Sales]
description: Dingy and cramped, this building appears unkempt but serviceable.  A long wooden bar runs along one scuffed wall, while a set of stained wooden shelves have been nailed above it.  A swinging door leads to a backroom storage space.  The musty smell in the air battles with the sharp smells of alcohol and malted grain.

title: [Be Still My Hops, Storage]
description: Several crates, some open and some closed, are scattered across the scuffed floorboards of this tiny space.  It is difficult to see clearly, as the only light source is a grimy lantern hanging from a bracket on one wall.  The air is stuffy and mixed with the subtle sweetness of malt.

title: [The Preening Plover]
description: Gaps in the paneling of the drafty shop allow beams of sunlight to pierce the shadow-draped room.  Save for the space in front of the ebonwood door, the floor is covered by a shaggy, violet alpaca wool carpet, on which rests an open damask-lined valise housing a few knickknacks.  Centered prominently in the circular space, a heavy wrought iron garment rack towers, its spokelike arms extending to nearly touch the walls.

title: [The Herbal Huntsman]
description: Lashed to the beams on the slanted ceiling, fragrant herbs infuse the air with a medley of vegetal aromas, mingling with the earthy, woodsy scents of fur and leather from the varied hides draped over the sparse furniture.  An austere iron lantern casts foliated shadows over the bark-stripped rack fashioned from branches against the back wall.  Pulled halfway open, an undyed flax curtain splits the windowless space, a deer-carved oak chest sitting open beside the loosely gathered fabric.

title: [Best Foot Forward]
description: The interior of this spacious tent is heavily draped with luxurious red fabrics.  Red silk carpets inlaid with intricate gold patterns cover the floor.  Several full-length mirrors have been artistically placed between the low, chest-covered tables that line the walls.  Shining brass oil lamps hang from tent poles and reflect flickering light over each specular surface.  A large mahogany and gilt jewelry stand holds a place of pride in the direct center of the tent.

title: [Scoria and Dross]
description: Rivulets of wax drip down from the wrought iron chandelier in the center of the foundry, the colorful veins highlighting the pale stone of the floor below.  The ceiling-high forge stands against the furthest wall, its blue-white fire dancing before a curvilinear cast iron display of wares highlighted by the licking flames.  A series of stylized statues lay scattered amongst tomes of blackened leather, the forms affixed with parchments covered in charcoal sketches.

title: [Certifiable]
description: A glittering, crystal-crowded ceiling hums with an unsettling drone, the sole source of the exceedingly bright light spilling over every inch of this otherwise spartan room.  Sterile white paint coats the walls, amplifying the illumination, and a steel-topped table stands in front of a roped-off hallway.  Towering steel shelves stretch from floor to ceiling along the eastern wall, topped with numerous baskets, trays, bags, boxes, and folios.

A glittering, crystal-crowded ceiling hums with an unsettling drone, the sole source of the exceedingly bright light spilling over every inch of this otherwise spartan room.  Sterile white paint coats the walls, amplifying the illumination, and a steel-topped table stands in front of a roped-off hallway.  Towering steel shelves stretch from floor to ceiling along the eastern wall, topped with numerous baskets, trays, and folios.

title: [The Fairy Ring, Copse]
description: Needles cushion the earth beneath the acicular canopy provided by the copse of tanik and cedar trees, a fairy ring of luminous celestial blue toadstools pushing its way through the organic carpet.  In the center, a constellation-stitched lotus silk cloth covers a low table displaying an assortment of trinkets.  A ghostwood stand and a capybara-carved jadewood rack stand before shaggy trunks partially obscuring a deteriorating cobblestone wall.

Needles cushion the earth beneath the acicular canopy provided by the copse of tanik and cedar trees, a fairy ring of luminous celestial blue toadstools pushing its way through the organic carpet.  In the center, a constellation-stitched lotus silk cloth covers a low table displaying an assortment of trinkets.  A capybara-carved jadewood rack stands before shaggy trunks partially obscuring a deteriorating cobblestone wall.

title: [I See You, Showroom]
description: Pristine white marble floors, walls, and ceiling create a colorless atmosphere with fluted white marble podiums dotting the room.  The only offset to this white-washed room is a dark stone-slatted door and the colorful hair pieces decorating the busts placed upon the podiums.

title: [The Herbal Huntsman, Respite]
description: Bottles and apparati lie scattered around a bronze-caged lamp on the open lid of a pebbled leather trunk, its sisken-lined interior brimming with twine-tied scrolls.  Flicking orange light brings a warm shine to the plush bear hide rug softening the solid cedar floor.  Secured with two worn suede straps, a thin bedroll tilts against the back corner beside a scarred cordovan pack.  An undyed flax curtain, left partially open, evenly divides the lean-to and affords a modicum of privacy.

title: [Mind Your Manas]
description: The tent consists of large ridgeweaver silk walls, each one a colorful blend of soft yellow, orange, and white hues.  Sand-colored pillows occupy the corners, and rows of bronze metal racks stretch across the center of the room.  The fragrance of cinnamon and other spices drifts lazily through the area.

title: [The Firebird, Quarters]
description: Though not precisely spartan, none would deem the cramped quarters as lavish.  Opposite the entry hatch, a glass-windowed porthole allows a glimpse of the airship's surroundings.  Nearby hangs a gilt-framed oil painting depicting a vibrant seaside town, the bright, cool colors contrasting starkly with the pallor of the light cast by a flameless glaes lamp atop a nearby writing desk.  The bunk is neatly made but spare, clad in a green velvet blanket and with crisp white sheets and pillows.

title: [A Breath of Autumn, Clothes]
description: The air within the wagon's burnt orange walls is warmed by a long-piped wood stove tucked into a far corner, atop which sits a tiny, simmering pot filled with apple slices, cinnamon sticks, whole cloves, orange peels, and star anise that fragrance the steam as it rises.  Every breath is spiced and rich, like pumpkin pie and mulled cider, and a chill trickle of air seeping in from around the door teases the burgundy cotton curtains as it passes on its way deeper into the wagon.

title: [A Breath of Autumn, Perfumes]
description: Garlands of twine-strung leaves, acorns, and autumnal-hued scraps of cloth hang in a scalloped line high on the walls enclosing this section of the wagon, and a fan of woven straw accents each peak.  In the corners hang strands of alternating dried apple slices and cinnamon sticks, and an amber-beaded curtain shields the further reaches of the wagon from view.

title: [A Breath of Autumn, Workroom]
description: Golden oak shelves line the walls and are stocked with clear jars displaying a variety of dried fruits and spices, while bundles of herbs dangle from twine strung in a zigzag pattern between the support beams overhead.  Off to one side sits an overstuffed golden velvet couch, and a glass-shelved bronze cart is stationed at the far end.

title: [Moot Hall, Pookia's Office]
description: Messy pink handprints wrap around the walls, a series of smudges and dripping paint also adding decoration.  The floor is covered with a large white piece of canvas material which is littered with empty paint cans and splatters.   A lone broken chair occupies the center of the room, its seat offering a home to a few refreshments.  The pink oak door sits propped against the frame, removed from the hinges allowing open access into the space.

title: [Moot Hall, Kiyna's Office]
description: Paneled ivory silk walls are painted in warm-hues detailing a phoenix and stylized flame motifs, the design only stopping to give way to an arched window.  Lodged into a corner, a mahogany bookshelf claims residence, its shelves covered in a number of tomes.  A matte gold leather armchair sits behind a burnished red modwir desk, its surface haphazardly stacked high in paperwork.  A cozy chestnut brown leather couch faces the desk, flanked on either side by tiered end tables hosting refreshments.

title: [Moot Hall, Vaemyr's Office]
description: The plain white walls of the office appear almost out of place amongst the assortment of books, maps, documents, and alchemical instruments scattered about.  A large map stretches across one wall, with smaller maps of other continents pinned to the edges to expand it.  On the opposite wall a large window next to a big oak desk shines sunlight into the cluttered room.  A small tray at one edge of the desktop, the only clear space amid the tall piles of documents, holds refreshments.

title: [Moot Hall, Kayse's Office]
description: Ivy trickles over the top of an ecru-washed birch bookcase, its cluttered shelves illuminated by a broad bay window encapsulating a mint velvet bench.  Terminating to meet a geometric coffered ceiling, a blush silk wall sits behind a glass-topped birch desk outfitted with a plush ivory chair.  A duo of coral ceramic pots sprouting ferns flank a gilt-flecked leather couch while above a trellis-patterned sideboard and various shaped crystal vials holding trilliums decorate the wall.

title: [Barracks, Rest Hall]
description: Burnished wooden floors span the length of the room, broken up by a thick rolton wool rug that rests in the center of the chamber.  The expanse of a large red oak bed is tucked away along a far wall and bordered by two tall modwir armoires.  A small black mithril brazier is nestled beneath a high wooden shelf, while a pair of old boots leans up against an open closet.

title: [Talon Isle, Prayer Gate]
description: Age has defaced but not managed to weaken a towering blue stone arch that looms over the walkway just before its slope intensifies markedly.  Creepers cling to what limited purchase cracks in the stone can provide, but the ancient architecture's foundation appears to be mingled with the roots of the island itself, so sturdy does it seem.  Its bulk provides more than adequate shelter from the rain.

title: [Talon Isle, Trail of Hopes]
description: Ferns lean in close to either side of the path, spotted with raindrops that make them glitter like rainbowed jewels in the half-light.  Old, stout palms that are many times the height of a giant form bowers over the road of hard-packed dirt and stone, mimicking an immense structure further on up the trail.  The narrow walkway cleaves close to the uneven walls of the spire as it strives to ascend.

title: [Talon Isle, Shore]
description: Wildly contorted spires of igneous rock explode from the sands of the beach.  The stone and sand are a study in contrasts; the former is blood-dark and craggy, while the latter is bright as diamonds and blessed with a surpassingly fine consistency.  Inland, the beach makes a reluctant segue into green grasses and wild growth, their green hues enhanced by the stormy sky's odd glow.  Catching droplets of crystal clear water, flowers in a variety of riotous hues border a steep path up the island's central spire.

title: [Talon Isle, Rock Wall]
description: Just beyond the end of a towering blue stone arch, the stone and dirt path dead-ends into a blood-red stone wall.  Though the surface of the rocky rise is replete with crags, so too is it slicked with the downpour and the foliage of exotic plants that sprout from the multitudinous crannies.

title: [Talon Isle, Rock Wall]
description: A precarious ledge juts out from the middle of the rock wall, lending access to deep niches carved out of the stone.  Winks of gold and other metallic hues flash from the darkness of several of the holds.  A single such recess might be the work of nature, but the even procession of them suggests that they must be the work of skilled beings.  Above, the rock wall is smoother and lends little purchase for climbing.  In some places it appears smooth as blown glass.

title: [Altar of the Sea's Bargain]
description: Winds scream about the peak of the talon that gives the island its name, tossing the sparse grass scattered across the tiny plateau at the summit.  Sprouting from the grass as if it grew there, an ornate seaglass altar dominates the space.  Held aloft by a twist of seaglass is a clear glass orb.  Veils of swirling mist spin about the island as if it is the eye at the center of a hurricane.  They conceal all but the vaguest view of the storm-swept ocean and the mainland beyond.

title: [Talon Isle, Tidepools]
description: The stretch of diamond-white beach shines like a second sun.  Liquid light glistens off of several tidepools clinging to the cliffside, refracting onto the rocks in curtains of rainbowed color.  The scents of the sea and the isle's overgrown greenery commingle into a salty-sweet melange in the air.

title: [Talon Isle, Obelisk]
description: A grey stone obelisk lies on its side, the etchings on its face corroded by the ungentle touch of saltwater.  Swirls of prismatic light crawl over the tenebrous surface of the stone.  A sheer cliff face, blood-red and shot through with forking bits of blue stone like veins, hangs over the ruined carving, brooding and silent.

title: [Reticent Repose, Curtilage]
description: Dew glistens on the rose bushes that ring the garden, and the uneven cobblestone path meandering through their concentric rows is illuminated by the silver glow of starlight.  Tracing a circuitous route from a wrought iron gate to the fel-timbered chalet, the path is guarded by a lithe faerie statue hiding amid a lilac bower.  Within the garden's heart, roses and flowerbeds open up in a small clearing where marble benches ring a huge bonfire, while the soothing song of crickets rises softly all around.
location: Reticent Repose, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Reticent Repose, Sitting Room]
description: Subtle moonlight casts an eerie glow through some frosted windows surrounding wide alder doors, while golvern sconces illuminate a gold-framed portrait suspended above a marble fireplace.  Shadows waver over an elaborate rug centered upon dark mahogany floors between two plush couches.  Twisted silk ivy garlands woven with dried grapevines hang across ivory walls, their lengths strung with clusters of ceramic berries.  In a darkened corner of a bare wall, a beveled mirror hangs opposite a set of mahogany double doors inlaid with gilded eahnor wire.

title: [Reticent Repose, Laboratory]
description: Painted on the hard stone floor is an archaic symbol, its presence unmarred by fire damage originating from its edge.  Similarly, the stone walls bear scorch marks up to the ceiling, with a heavy concentration of soot in the corners.  A damaged tapestry hangs on one side, its length wavering slightly despite a lack of wind.  Suspended from the ceiling on a rusted iron chain is a rectangular oil lantern, its glass panes either severely cracked or missing altogether.

title: [Reticent Repose, Breakfast Nook]
description: Terra cotta-colored walls complement pale sandstone tile floors in variegated neutral tones.  Muted moonlight gently illuminates a rosewood table through a latched garden window adorned with drawn ivory and sunset orange linen curtains.  Twin sconces cast dancing shadows upon an enameled iron stove set against a far wall adjacent to an intimate maoral booth tucked into the corner.
location: Reticent Repose, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Reticent Repose, Bedchamber]
description: Scarlet and ebon ombre byssus curtains frame a broad bay window above a cushioned alabaster bench.  Moonlight reflects off parquet-patterned mistwood floors, simultaneously causing shimmered shadows along the artisanal pearlescent finish on the rose-hued walls.  Ceiling-draped swathes of soft black gossamer create a dark halo around a four poster bed facing a whitewashed stone fireplace nestled between a mahogany vanity and a large armoire.

title: [Reticent Repose, Bath]
description: The gentle plink of water drops echoes throughout the room, the air thick with steam.  Scattered along the black tile floor are opalescent pillar candles, their gentle flames highlighting silver flecks embedded in walls painted in twilight hues.  A path of polished river stones leads from a silk-draped arch towards a large travertine bath nestled within an enclosure of varnished maoral.  In each corner, tall obsidian vases hold gold-painted tree limbs, their lengths stripped of excess twigs.

title: [Tall Tower]
description: A rough angled ceiling of thin iron plates arcs overhead, supported by thick poles of iron that continue down to the ground that is far below.  Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a few small notches are cut into the dark metal walls.  The countryside expands out beneath you, its terrain easily visible from this high vantage point, the moonlight gently illuminating the interior of the tower.

title: [Celebration Barge, Willow]
description: An ornately carved oak bench circles the trunk of the willow, offering a place to rest and a sheltered refuge from the noise and activities farther aft.  Here one can enjoy the quietude provided by the protective branches and the gentle lapping of the waves just a few feet away.  Visible through the willow leaves, partygoers engaged in animated conversations and quiet pairs intent upon each other follow the flagstone path to and from the domed hall.

title: [Fireside Supplies]
description: Sleeping furs are tidily piled against the back wall of the domed tent, while a firepit at the center is surrounded by various cooking stones and baskets of food.  Whittling tools are carefully arranged upon racks lashed to the walls of the tent, their polished ends gleaming in the ambient light of both the nearby fire and the frosted globes that are attached to the support posts of the ceiling.  Near the exit, a low round table is stacked with wares.

title: [Bank of Bloodriven, Wine Cellar]
description: Elaborate wine racks of the finest metals hint that this room may once have been a true connoisseur's pride and joy.  The years, however, have not been kind, and disorder and disarray now permeate the space.  Wooden crates, some splintered and shattered, line the walls, and broken glass in colors from green to brown to clear glitters in tiny shards strewn across the dirt-covered floor.

title: [Marshtown, Abandoned Courtyard]
description: This abandoned courtyard appears to be used predominately for storage.  Stacks of crates and the ubiquitous Marshtown barrel are piled high in the open space.  Barely visible within the maze of wooden containers is a bricked-over white marble archway at the back of the courtyard.
location: Safe Harbor, inside the seaside town of Solhaven

wayto.33351: ;e if GameObj.inv.find {|obj| obj.noun == "key"};fput "go brick-covered door";else;empty_hand;multifput "get my #{UserVars.safe_harbor} from my #{UserVars.keysack}","go brick-covered door","put my key in my #{UserVars.keysack}";fill_hand;end

title: [Safe Harbor, Entryway]
description: Constructed from scavenged wood and cast off driftwood planks, the walls of the structure are a mixture of colors, textures, and types of wood.  Swathes of white, blue, and pale sea green Vornavian silk are hung along the walls, attempting to cover as much of the surface as possible.  A jagged driftwood plank hangs above the entryway door and a small barnacle-encrusted anchor rests in one corner.  Threadbare carpets lead off in every direction.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Safe Harbor, Kitchen]
description: Small ceramic herb jars and miniature plants line the back edge of the dark modwir counter, parting to make room for a dented enamel wash basin positioned beneath a circular brass porthole window.  A small cookstove is nestled in a fixture of smoothed river stones.  Three round wooden stools sit under the counter, available for seating as needed.  A trio of colorful crab shells are mounted on the walls, within the grasp of a huge shark jaw.

title: [Safe Harbor, Planning Room]
description: The room is dominated by a huge dark ironwood table which rests atop a massive bedraggled woven rug, surrounded by a set of high-backed brown leather chairs.  Haphazardly nestled beneath the table is an enruned black mithril lockbox, neatly polished and well maintained.  Maps of Vornavis, the freeport of Solhaven and its bay, and numerous other local landmarks are hung on every wall of the room.  At the back of the room stands a glass-topped modwir display case.

title: [Safe Harbor, Bunks]
description: A quartet of simple beds are set up along the walls of the sleeping area, each bed neatly made with green blankets and a single pillow.  A woven low-slung hammock hangs between a discolored wooden wardrobe and a large overhead beam.  Along the back of the room a pair of clothing racks frame an elaborate gold and brass mirror mounted on the wall.  A rusted iron rung ladder leads to a hatch in the roof.

title: [Safe Harbor, Rooftop Sanctuary]
description: The rooftop of the building is lined with a series of barrel planters, each sprouting a vibrant pink display of seaside daisies.  Residing under a waxed sailcloth awning is a mosaic glass Niima statue, her eyes looking out over Solhaven Bay.  A polished brass ship's lantern rests on the driftwood plinth beneath the statue, its surface polished and smoothed by the touch of countless hands.  A battered driftwood hatch leads back inside the building.

title: [Methais's Home, Hallway]
description: Matching the decor of the living room, cherrywood wainscoting below ivory plaster walls gives this narrow hallway an elegant look.  A polished haon door is set into the center of the hallway's south wall, while a felwood door stands opposite to the north.  The hallway ends well beyond these two at a multi-paned white door, where squares of sky are visible above the door's gathered curtain.

title: [Warcat Suite, Landing]
description: The wide stairwell leads up to a worn and flat landing, enclosed by burnished wood paneled walls.  The head of a stuffed warcat has been mounted above an arched modwir door, its face covered in striped black and grey fur and its mouth frozen into a feral snarl.  A small brindle fur rug rests just before the door, its material weathered and matted with dried mud.
location: Warcat Suite, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Warcat Suite, Living Room]
description: Wood paneled walls stretch in every direction of the living room, their surfaces burnished to a nice sheen that brightens slightly from the light of bronze lanterns nearby.  The center of the area is dominated by an oversized plush sofa, its rich burgundy hue matching the massive threaded tapestry hanging near a carved archway.  Nestled to the side of a modwir door stands a polished granite-topped bar.
location: Warcat Suite, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Warcat Suite, Den]
description: The carved archway opens into a cozy room that is permeated with the fragrance of sandalwood and lavender.  A heavy dark oak bookcase stands on each side of a black marble fireplace, while several trinkets adorn the mantle above.  On the opposite wall sits a sturdy oak desk with a glass top covering its surface and a high-backed leather chair rising behind it.
location: Warcat Suite, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Warcat Suite, Kitchen]
description: The smell of flour still hangs in the air, mixed slightly with the savory aroma of baked bread.  Wine racks occupy the wall directly above a blackened stove, and the center of the room is crowded by a heavy oak table generously stained by grease.  A small metal churn sits upon a rhimar-inset counter tucked away in one of the corners.
location: Warcat Suite, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Warcat Suite, Game Room]
description: A round felt-covered table sits in the center of the room, surrounded by several plush velvet-cushioned chairs.  Wisps of jasmine smoke drift through the air, infusing the area with a faint haze that lingers lazily.  A coral-inlaid dart board has been nailed into the wall near a tall, glass-paned, oak cabinet.
location: Warcat Suite, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Warcat Suite, Bedchamber]
description: Deep burgundy curtains drape across a huge bay window, uncovered just enough to allow a stream of moonlight to seep through the glass.  One entire wall is consumed by a huge four-poster oak bed, each wooden post carved with intricate etchings of prowling warcats.  An open archway leads to a wide closet where a brass-edged driftwood chest dwells within.  A tall gilt-hued mirror leans against a wall near a heavy wooden door.

title: [Scrip Shop, Meditation Room]
description: Quarantined from the chaos of the adjacent chamber, sizable throws of snow leopard fur line both the floor and walls, meticulously aligned to create a hypnotizing pattern of dark spots.  Stone pedestals inlaid with ur-barath sconces bear candles that release a gentle, soothing fragrance into the air, erasing all evidence of the musty scent in neighboring areas.  White fur rugs form a circle inside the pedestal boundary, each one spaced far enough from the next to allow for adequate distancing.

title: [Trapper's Shack]
description: The oak floor and walls of this efficiency-sized hunting cabin are timeworn, scratched, and pitted, but anyone can see this cabin was built to last.  Utilitarian in nature, the single room has been left unadorned but for a mounted tapir head on the wall directly across from the entrance, and an entire wall has been dedicated to a weapons display.  A stout stool rests next to a small, unlit cast iron stove to the left of the door.  To the right of the door hangs a bloodstained game bag on a wooden hook.

title: [Spindrift Sanctuary, Approach]
description: Pale golden yellow snow lilies sprout from around a wall of mottled grey stone, its overhang partially shadowing a slurry of ice and snow that trails down a shadowy stone-lined path.  Frost-swept clusters of ruffled clover blot the niveous surroundings with striking dollops of greenery.  A sturdy, nicely appointed cypress log cabin with a gabled roof is plunked among some blue-blushed winter roses and encircled by unruly crallisberry hedges.
location: Spindrift Sanctuary, inside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

wayto.33366: ;e if GameObj.inv.find {|obj| obj.noun == "key"};fput "go entryway";else;empty_hand;multifput "get my #{UserVars.spindrift} from my #{UserVars.keysack}","go entryway","put my key in my #{UserVars.keysack}";fill_hand;end

title: [Spindrift Sanctuary, Parlor]
description: Lofty vaulted ceilings above are inset with panels of crystal-clear glass revealing the arcing skyscape painting the heavens outside.  Adjacent to a beveled door and a narrow hallway, a motley crew of preserved beast heads hangs over a spacious rune-etched fireplace housed in an encasement of natural stonework.  Hunting-themed oil paintings in gold frames adorn the polished cypress walls with a rustic flair, yielding to a fauna-carved rowan arch on the eastern wall.  An overstuffed tartan couch is grouped with an oaken reading desk and a suede-lined wicker basket.
location: Spindrift Sanctuary, inside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Spindrift Sanctuary, Haven]
description: Rows of roughly hewn wooden slabs are pushed to the side of the square-shaped room, each one with its own set of wickedly sharp tools exhibited on hanging steel hooks behind it.  Ledges teeming with a multitude of supplies and other labeled toolboxes wrap around the upper half of the walls.  Prepped for longer periods of work, an aged vultite-chased lantern hovers above an elaborate fir sideboard.  Scads of untanned hides are stacked next to a fauna-carved rowan arch, opposite another meticulously sorted selection of variegated pelts.
location: Spindrift Sanctuary, inside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Spindrift Sanctuary, Bedroom]
description: Taking up a significant majority of the free space in the room, an enormous goosefeather sleighbed is mounded with oversized spruce green flannel pillows and draped with plushly layered furs.  Geometric beadwork traces the heavy suede curtains that frame a leaded glass picture window, opposite a red cedar dressing table cradling a fluted celadon wash basin.  The far wall holds a burled acacia doorway and displays an impressive collection of widely varied creature horns and antlers.
location: Spindrift Sanctuary, inside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Spindrift Sanctuary, Study]
description: Burnished cherrywood floors span the length of the entire study, ending just before a dark mahogany hearth that is surrounded by a half-moon of mosaic gold inlay.  Ancient novels and tomes litter the built-in bookcases that nearly reach the ceiling, the extensive library only interrupted by the presence of a burled acacia doorway.  A rounded black marble platform rises at the back and is domed by vast glass windows that are set up for viewing with a wide-lensed antiqued copper telescope.
location: Spindrift Sanctuary, inside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Spindrift Sanctuary, Kitchen]
description: Blue and white tiled floors and an elongated heart of pine dining table give the kitchen a welcoming, pastoral charm.  The aroma of freshly baked tarts infuses the air around a spotless, hammered bronze kettle perched upon a stout cast iron stove.  Innumerous copper pots and pans are suspended from staggered ceiling hooks, placed opposite some beveled silver beech cupboards and a steel-topped walnut serving cart.
location: Spindrift Sanctuary, inside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Hall of Justice, Hallway]
description: Ivory-weighted banners of pavonated silk are suspended high above the silver-gilt staircase, the muted fabric embroidered in peahens framed by arabesque-beaded plumage.  A duo of heavy-handled doors stand below the curved ascent, each haon-crafted panel flanked by an armored member of the Sapphire Guard standing still above the cool stone floor.  The sounds of footsteps echo throughout the hall, followed by the muffled sounds of whispers from behind the chamber beyond.

title: [Observation Room]
description: Haon-framed chairs of burnt plum velvet are arranged before the silver-washed railing, their brush-shaped legs resting against the marbled ivory floor.  Heavy curtains are draped across the ceiling-high windows, obscuring the light through layers of lilac-on-aubergine brocade, the fabric pooling below a lacquered heartwood table affixed in the far corner.  A spherical silver lantern emanates a soft glow across the table's surface, providing a faint modicum of light.

title: [Observation Room]
description: Ebony-framed chairs of burnt emerald velvet are arranged before the silver-washed railing, the vine-carved legs resting against the marbled ivory floor.  Heavy curtains are draped across the ceiling-high windows, obscuring the light through layers of jade-on-burgundy brocade, the fabric pooling below a lacquered ebonwood table affixed in the far corner.  A spherical kelyn lantern emanates a soft glow across the table's surface, providing a faint modicum of light.

title: [Observation Room]
description: Mahogany-framed chairs of burnt crimson velvet are arranged before the silver-washed railing, their wyvern-carved legs resting against the marbled ivory floor.  Heavy curtains are draped across the ceiling-high windows, obscuring the light through layers of ivory-on-gold brocade,  the fabric pooling below a lacquered lasimor table affixed in the far corner.  A spherical eahnor lantern emanates a soft glow across the table's surface, providing a faint modicum of light.

title: [Observation Room]
description: Oak-framed chairs of burnt sepia velvet are arranged before the silver-washed railing, the leaf-carved legs resting against the marbled ivory floor.  Heavy curtains are draped across the ceiling-high windows, obscuring the light through layers of sage-on-hunter green brocade, the fabric pooling below a lacquered mahogany table affixed in the far corner.  A spherical brass lantern emanates a soft glow across the table's surface, providing a faint modicum of light.

title: [Sweethen's Bakeshop, Patio]
description: Fluted limestone columns support a spacious pergola strung with strands of glowing glass spheres, the hawthorn slats overhead dividing the star-strewn sky into slivers.  Painted bright white, standing flower boxes frame the shelter on three sides, housing aromatic profusions of lavender and sage.  Amaranth-hued cire canvas cushions soften the stylized chairs arranged around a scattering of lattice-topped wrought iron tables.

title: [Vornavis, Castle Hallway]
description: Polished marble traverses the south-north expanse of the hallway, decorating the open space between stained glass windows and the portraits of nameless nobility staring blankly from the walls.  Twin doors, a plastered ivory door and an unmarked door, offer entry into other chambers, while a guarded staircase built between the pair leads to the Baronial Bower.

title: [Vornavis, Castle Hallway]
description: Culminating in a peak, floor-to-ceiling stained glass windows dominate the western walls, allowing sunlight to filter through and paint the cold cobblestones in splashes of bright colors.  Stretching across the fel and ironwood flooring is a long emerald green runner edged in golden knotwork.  Heavy tapestries fill the spaces between the various entries that decorate the eastern walls, their brass fixtures polished and gleaming.

title: [Vornavis, Tower Stairs]
description: Spiraling upward, a wall-to-wall staircase of grey cobblestones ascends the tower, leaving the polished oak floor behind.  Leading southward into the main keep, a long corridor lined with tapestries, doors, and windows has stone walls and an ironwood floor with chevron fel planks.  At the base of the tower, an ironbound door is open to the garden of the inner keep.

title: [Vornavis, Tower Stairs]
description: Bronze-banded torches rest within brackets upon either side of an ironbound door, which is open to the castle walls.  Darkened by exposure to the elements, the landing stones are pitted in places where the natural elements have worked at them over time.  Rising and falling upon either side, the unmarred steps transition to other parts of the tower.

title: [Vornavis, Tower Stairs]
description: Devoid of windows, but covered in ancient tapestries, the grey stones are cool to the touch in this dimly lit section of the tower.  Wide, sweeping stairs rise and fall upon either side of the landing, which is host to a door.

title: [Vornavis, Tower Stairs]
description: A small landing and a door to the tower room at this level interrupt the sweep of the stairs.

title: [Vornavis, Tower Landing]
description: Culminating in a thick ironwood ceiling with a trapdoor recessed into it, the tower is dimly lit by sunlight that comes through small, thin archer windows built into the cold stone.  Long, wide stairs stretch from wall to wall as they descend to the floor below.

title: [Vornavis, Inner Garden]
description: Incongruously, the eastern section of the garden is dappled in a thin layer of snow that allows blossoms to grow despite the subtropical climate.  Creating the illusion of a forest glade, pale yellow mosses reside beneath towering silver fir trees that elegantly hide the militaristic nature of the castle walls, while geometric hedges descend along the southern slope.  A narrow set of stairs ascends to the protective walls, while a small banded door leads into the keep and keeps company with a row of narrow whorled-glass windows.

title: [Vornavis, Castle Wall]
description: Protecting the inner courtyards of the baron's castle, the wall is crafted of sandstone and slate blocks.  Below the crenellations, a paved yard stretches to an outer wall, while to the inside lies a well-manicured garden subdivided by a snowblossom-bordered walkway.  A narrow set of stairs descends from the top of the wall to the garden, where a small door provides entry to the castle.

title: [Solace of the Seaborne, West]
description: Some layered walls of wavy glass cast colorful silhouettes across the pale sand, the etched surfaces projecting rays of calligraphy across the changing tides.  Garlands of anemones and sea buckthorn drape over a quartet of carved stone founts.  The water's surface alights with tiny votives floating between strips of parchment scrawled with long-forgotten names.  Carved into whimsical sea creatures, myriad charms adorn the driftwood benches sitting half-buried within the sand.

title: [Solace of the Seaborne, North]
description: Umbrageous trees watch over the glistening sands spread over the area, the rustling leaves echoing against the glass-forged hourglass set within a ring of muted sea glass.  A sturdy frame of driftwood holds the sculpture aloft while small clockwork gears slowly rotate as the fine grains fill the bottom chamber, the granules tinted the vivid colors of the sea.  Several narrow marble benches surround the hourglass, the names carved upon the seats faded by both time and nature.

title: [Solace of the Seaborne, East]
description: Dozens of windchimes hang from the splayed branches of the tall, foliage-bare trees, the murals upon their carved trunks faded by the elements.  Sporadic melodies rise from the hollowed lengths of bamboo, sea glass discs, and aged brass bells as the occasional breeze ripples the surface of the nearby pond.  Stitched with symbols of the Great Houses, silken banners hang from gnarled driftwood poles buried alongside thin benches offering places to rest and reminisce.

title: [Solace of the Seaborne, South]
description: A circle of sandstone benches surrounds an imposing sculpture of natural fulgurite, its base buried deep into the mottled dark sands beneath it.  Square-caged lanterns radiate from the fractal form towards tall posts of blackened iron, diminutive lightning bugs casting greenish gold sparks against the cloud-etched glass as they slip in and out of the receptacles. The faint scent of ozone and sea rosemary fills the air, followed by a tinge of earthiness.

title: [Solace of the Seaborne]
description: Pathways of crushed sea shells converge towards the alabaster-carved longboat raised within the center of the area, covered in dozens of muted sapphire candles flickering amongst dried white sea roses.  Natural driftwood benches sit beneath sunbleached linen canopies, the embroidered bolts of fabric tightly knotted to the silver-banded posts placed outside the circle.  Veiled in a layer of pale sand, small mementos and lush bouquets lean against the sandstone slab elevating the vessel.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Ready, Set, Auction!]
description: Two-person benches situated equidistant from each other to form half-circle rows begin at a long mahogany table and expand outward from one end of the hall to the other, leaving only a tiny standing area for late arrivals.  Gold-trimmed mahogany buckets hang from each bench's armrest, and overly stuffed cushions line each seat to provide substantial comfort during long sessions.  Standing behind a mahogany podium, an auctioneer keeps watch over the area with a keen eye.

title: [Royal Arboretum, Walkway]
description: Vert-colored ivy entwines down the white marble columns framing the cobblestone walkway, the pale pillars affixed with latticed archways draped in the five-pointed leaves.  Thin loops of vaalin wire hang high across the living ceiling, the opalescent hooks suspending colorful origami flora above several glowbark benches carved in whimsical fauna.  Beyond the path sits a number of canopy-covered displays, the artwork framed by tall vases set upon the well-manicured lawn.

title: [Royal Arboretum, Walkway]
description: The column-framed walkway leads up to the arched duo of doors, the faenor-framed dome inset in honeycomb-like panels of glass.  Ivy-draped partitions of blonde oak are angled between groupings of natural wicker chairs, the floral-framed portraits interspersed between slender moss-draped shelves.  Framing either side of the entrance are a duo of silver-veined marble pedestals, each angular base encircled by a profusion of verdant foliage climbing upwards across the base.

title: [Arboretum, Botanical Garden]
description: A colossal dome of faenor-framed glass encompasses the botanical garden, the hexagonal panels streaming moonlight across the quartet of approaches scattered across the cobblestones.  Tall groves of trees provide respite across the expansive lawn, shading groupings of chairs placed by the fountain, the crystalline water misting the nearby stall nestled between the fenced gardens.  A vine-arched corner of the square conceals a trio of potted topiaries, the plants encircled by pale benches.

title: [Parasitics Conservatory]
description: Reinforced shelves flank the entry, stocked with rolls of bandages and small, well-sharpened tools, the bundles of supplies placed close to the enclosures.  Various jars of raw chrysoprase are placed at the center of the table, the gemstones casting subtle green shades across the dark-inked parchment scattered across the surface.  An herb-embroidered curtain partially conceals the window-inset door at the back of the area, the fabric loosely draped over a blackboard angled in the corner.

title: [Parasitics Research]
description: The thick walls of riveted metal are affixed with mesh-caged glass containers, the carefully labeled enclosures each hung with a pair of thick leather gloves and a twine-tied bundle of dried herbs.  Less utilitarian tools and knickknacks cover the glass-topped table lofted on twin ebonwood trunks, the well-worn tomes weighed down by faceted lengths of crystals.  A diminutive sidetable sits nestled by the metal-riveted door, stacked with empty teacups and a single porcelain teapot.

title: [Fungi Conservatory]
description: The humid, sub-level facility is dimly lit by several mushroom-shaped lanterns affixed to the rock walls, casting a steady, subtle light across a window-inset door.  Thin-framed enclosures, filled with a variety of straw, dirt, and lichen, are displayed in tidy rows along the sides of the spacious facility, the center occupied by a long table of live-edged ebony.  Recesses serve as moss-draped bookshelves beside the faenor-latticed egress, perpendicular to a blackboard framed in stylized fungi.

title: [Fungi Research]
description: The cavelike research area is affixed with numerous wooden shelves riveted to the stone walls, the units filled with numerous jars, alembics, and flasks crafted from various glasses and metals.  A duo of lanterns sit at the center of an ebony table, its surface scattered with stacks of parchment alongside an apparatus set beneath a citrine heating element.  Nestled in the far corner is a rack-covered station, neatly organized with cast iron tools beside a moss-encircled basin.

title: [Arboreal Conservatory]
description: The woodland area is framed by a copse of trees in various stages of maturity, the leaf-scattered ground beneath the forms encircled by verdant undergrowth traversing toward the faenor gate.  A mahogany-planked cabin stands nestled between the arboreal sentinels, its elongated roof sheltering a blackboard set before a series of iron-legged stools.  Several makeshift workbenches are set beneath the towering branches, covered in a variety of well-worn tools.

title: [Arboreal Research]
description: A number of live-edged tables are scattered across the perimeter of the facility, the various cuts of wood covered in lacquer to preserve the fine grain.  Displayed at the center of the room are a small duo of potted gardenias, their intertwining branches grasping upwards toward the branch-like lantern hung above the crossbeams.  Clay and ceramic pots are stacked haphazardly between tall wrought iron stools, the seating weighed down by small canvas bags of soil.

title: [Ethnobotany Conservatory]
description: Rays of moonlight pierce through the ceiling-high windows of the conservatory, highlighting the orderly wooden bookshelves filled with colorful leather-bound tomes and folios.  Several embroidery-covered chairs are scattered beside the live-edged haon table, the arrangement facing the blackboard attached to the sketching-draped walls.  A tri-legged easel stands beside a staircase leading to the facility above, the narrow hallway displaying artifacts and small knickknacks on angular displays.

title: [Ethnobotany Research]
description: A circular display dominates the center of the window-framed room, the inner walls of the table reinforced by riveted plates of drakar radiating constant heat across the sand-filled pit.  Smaller versions of the rounded containers are scattered across the expansive facility, each one uniquely erected with varieties of glass, metal, and clockwork contraptions slowly clicking at random intervals.  The chair-lined wall displays hand-sketched studies of several species alongside stacks of scrolls.

title: [Mistwatch, Private Pier]
description: Undulating waves carry seaweed to the supports of the private pier, the tangled flora catching on the waterlogged wood.  A double-masted mistwood ship moors at the far end, a gangplank leading up to the sailless vessel.  To the north, ships of varying immensity line the public docks that stretch out to the misty, moonlit sea.

title: [Spirit of the Mists, Deck]
description: Twine-strung crystals wind around one sailless mast and then another, bathing the mistwood deck in a cool glow as they swoop down to catch on a brass-cast, segreant wyvern figurehead.  Painted a muted ocean blue hue, slatted chairs look out to the misted sea, arranged alongside a marlin-carved chest on the firepit-inset foredeck.  Twin stairs with curved, glimaergless-inlaid railings ascend on either side of a cabin featuring stained glass windows in a coastal motif.

title: [Spirit of the Mists, Bar]
description: Foggy quartz orbs caged in nautilus-cut vaalorn hang in a neat row over an expansive, mist grey lasimor bar lined with low-backed leather stools.  On the other side, the mirrored back wall reflects the framed technical ship plans occupying the space between brass-rimmed portholes, offering circular glimpses of the moonlit seascape.  Dark-stained planks enclose the spacious underdeck, the far end adorned with a tri-toned dart board beside a mistwood rack.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Market Tunnel]
description: Carved into the stone wall, an illuminated tunnel leaves the bustling shadow of the market behind as it heads in a slow decline through the towering cliff.  Pinpoints of light within the tunnel mark lanterns, while a subtle breeze cooled by the dark stone carries with it the stunningly sweet scent of scarlet milkweed.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Darkened Tunnel]
description: Cool and dark, the chiseled stone tunnel echoes with the distant sound of crashing waves and the hushed tones of visitors to the Wandering Eye Market.  Bronze lanterns are anchored to the wall above an acacia and copper bench that keeps company with a banded wooden barrel.  Twin urns, glossy and tangerine in hue, rest beneath a verdigris copper contraption that creates a gentle rain.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Nereid Tunnel]
description: Haloed in starlight, the northern end of the tunnel is wide and covered in pinned black basket wythe.  Conversely, the southern end of the tunnel follows the smooth, chiseled granite walls into the darkness where the sound of dripping water echoes in the air.  A small sign of parchment and bamboo is anchored to the opening amid the clustered vines.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Landing]
description: Surrounded by shaggy broom sedge and feathery nassella grass, a yawning portal cuts into the very bedrock of the cliff face and is surrounded by cultivated black basket wythe.  Several wide, grey stone slabs form steps that lead to the deep, turquoise-blue waters of a crescent-shaped beach of pristine white sands, while the sun-bleached planks of narrow boardwalks stretch east and west through the sheltering grass.  A copper-banded barrel is tucked against a sheer stone wall, with a sign reading "Keep Our Neighborhood Clean" tacked to it.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, East Boardwalk]
description: Nestled against the blue-grey slate of the southern wall, cultivated cordias rise from the feathery marram grass.  Soft grey planks, worn smooth from wind and age, form a curving boardwalk that spans the tall grass that grows at the edge of a mica-flecked white beach.  Shell and pebble-lined walkways connect a series of small domiciles to the boardwalk, while a sinuous sandy path cuts through the dunes towards the sound of crashing waves.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, East Boardwalk]
description: Cutting a path through the high grass of the surrounding dunes, a smooth boardwalk rests upon glittering white sands to create an even egress that follows the rapidly shortening granite wall to its southeast.  Brightly burning torches mark the ends of pebble and seashell walkways that depart from the boardwalk and end at the colorful doors of the small domiciles that are built between the nearby dunes and their sandy game trails.  Trailing over the granite cliff face, fuchsia and white blossom-laden bower vines perfume the air.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, East Boardwalk]
description: Elevated slightly, the greyish white boardwalk gently arcs over a small riverlet that is fed by a spring that spills down the distant cliff face in the southeast.  Cattails and reed canary grass grow in upon either side of the sun-bleached boards, sheltering small seashell pathways that lead to squat domiciles with colorful doors.  A smooth stone bench is placed in the center of the path, positioned to allow for a view of the lapping waters of the beach.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, East Boardwalk]
description: Leaving the cliffs of Kraken's Fall behind, the landscape transitions from tall grasses and beach vines to rolling dunes and is pockmarked with large greyish white boulders.  Small tidal pools along the western edges are fed directly from the lapping ocean, while nearer at hand a pale, sand-smoothed boardwalk connects pebble walkways to the area's small houses.  An incline of smooth steps provides access to a flat plain that overlooks the beach.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Sharing Garden]
description: Tidy bamboo scaffolding holds aloft matching pipes, carrying fresh water from the distant cliffs of Kraken's Fall down to the small sharing garden.  A white picket fence encircles the manicured grass of the plateau, which supports dozens of raised seagrass baskets and harvest box planters.  To the north, the waves of Tenebrous Cauldron crash against the shore, while southward the dunes create a verdant barrier between the cliffs and the mica-flecked beach.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Sharing Garden]
description: Encircled by a picket fence, the public garden is arranged in steppes that are irrigated by fresh water pumped into the area by a complicated bamboo system that disappears up the incline to the higher steps.  Box planters are teeming with vegetation upon each of the grassy layers and are surrounded by seagrass baskets of harvested fruit, free for the taking.  A series of stone slab steps descends to the beach through a break in the fencing.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, West Boardwalk]
description: Leached of color due to exposure to the sun, wind, and salty sea air, worn greyish-white planks create a small pathway through the tangled clusters of sedge and sea grass that sprout up along the sandy terrain.  Small homes perch upon sand dunes, their backs to the beach and their doors opening to pebbled walkways that connect with the boardwalk.  Winding its sinuous way between the domiciles, a thin trail provides access to the beach.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, West Boardwalk]
description: Cutting its way through the feathery heads of nassella grass, the smooth planks of the boardwalk seem almost pearlescent in the starlight.  Pockmarked with tiny holes, the southern cliff face is covered in sea oxeye daisy vines and hosts the nests of dozens of tropical birds.  A large wooden bench rests on one side of the boardwalk, while opposite a narrow game trail snakes between the huddled forms of domiciles that are nestled within the sheltering grass and dunes.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, West Boardwalk]
description: Swaying slightly in the gentle tug of a seashore breeze, a stand of thick-trunked jelly palms obscures the granite cliff face and is laden with bright orange fruits and feathery palm pinnate leaves.  Huddled in their shadows, a variety of thatch-roofed domiciles are built to either side of a boardwalk that cuts through the shaggy broom sedge and marram grass.  Bamboo-poled torches sprout up around the various pathways leading to the beach, their flame-filled bowls responding to the subtle currents of the seaside air.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, West Boardwalk]
description: Leaving the sheltering cliff walls behind, the boardwalk stretches in an incline towards an outcropping to the north, while pebbled walkways dart into the surrounding grasses to connect small homes to its smooth planks.  Glistening in the sunlight, mica-flecked white sands fill the expanse between the sheltering dunes and the turquoise water that laps at the beach.  A large, a smooth grey boulder interrupts the boardwalk, which splits around the monstrosity and reconnects on its opposite side.
