Glistening in the starlight, mica-flecked white sands fill the expanse between the sheltering dunes and the turquoise water that laps at the beach.  A large, a smooth grey boulder interrupts the boardwalk, which splits around the monstrosity and reconnects on its opposite side.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, West Bonfire]
description: Resembling a manicured lawn, the outcropping is sheltered by the cliffs of Kraken's Fall on the west and encircled by a white picket fence on the north and east.  An octagonal picnic table and a driftwood bench are scattered about the area, while an open-air kitchen is built directly against the cliff face.  A large blazing bonfire surrounded by stones and sand is the focal point of the plain, while a rickety sun-faded staircase leads to the beach below.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Beach]
description: Small and large tidepools decorate the western edge of the beach, where a rickety sun-faded staircase attaches to the cliff face and leads to a grassy plain.  Soft sands are covered with shallow water, the small inlet protected from the encroaching surf by large boulders that jut out of the turquoise waters.  To the east, the surf carries bits of seaweed and empty mermaid's purses across the mica-flecked sands, while a twisted grass-flanked pathway heads to a distant boardwalk.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Beach]
description: Creating a counterpoint to the heartbeat-like pounding of a surf, dune grasses rustle as the seaborne breeze sets them in motion.  Fine, glittering sand stretches from the blue-grey of the long fronds towards the water, a variety of tiny seashells littering the distance.  A narrow game trail disappears between the dunes.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Beach]
description: Set to a backdrop of blue-green grass with feathery beige tops, the white-sand beach is serene.  Starlight reflects off the flecks of mica within the fine white sands, causing it to sparkle and shimmer as gentle tidal breezes cool the air and carry the tang of salt to the area.  Flanked by thin trails and sandy paths that slip through the encircling dunes, a pair of stone slab steps departs from the beach and connects with a flat stone landing with a wythe-encircled entrance in the distant cliff face.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Beach]
description: Spilling into the beach, tumbled stones stand at the head of a game trail that disappears through dunes that are covered in feather-headed grass.  Rhythmic and persistent, the azure waves deposit a bright frothy, white surf upon the glittering sand before receding into the turquoise waters of the cove.  A long picnic table surrounded by sun-faded benches sits back from the tideline and is relatively dry.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Beach]
description: Sheltered from the rollicking surf by the curve of the land, the small inlet is bisected by a freshwater riverlet that slips out of the surrounding dunes on its voyage toward the ocean.  The soft sands of the shallows are pockmarked with tiny holes where hidden clams rest, the gently lapping waters filling them in with each passage.  A series of stone slab steps provides access to a public plateau garden that grows upon the flat surface of a small outcropping.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Beach]
description: Scattered across the white sands, tiny seashells tumble in and out of the lapping surf as hermit crabs scatter from the encroaching froth.  Enormous, colorful parasols with long bamboo handles are planted in soft sands at an angle, creating tiny little shelters upon the beach that are lined with heavy wool blankets.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Sand Beds]
description: Isolated from the beach, the soft sands are set back from the rollicking surf and sheltered by the curve of the land.  Ocean water glides into the air through breaks in the surrounding walks, which keeps the clam beds hydrated and fresh.  A large boulder, its base draped in seaweed and its sides splattered in seafoam, acts as a breakpoint between the soft sand and the tide.

title: [The Vengeance, Docking]
description: The glaesineth-enclosed deck has a small door leading into the shop and a brass-edged koa gangplank climbing up to a second-story door.  Small openings at the top of each wall let in the sea air, and their transparent nature allows an unfettered view of the dunes and ocean.  An anchor-topped coil of hempen rope sits neatly in one corner, the anchor polished to a high sheen.  Painted onto the artfully sea-weathered wood of the wall is "Welcome to the Dire Ebon Vengeance!" with a brass ship's bell hanging next to it.

title: [The Vengeance, Main Cabin]
description: Several small bull's-eye windows set at regular intervals line the outer walls, each outlined in gleaming brass.  The area resembles a ship's cabin, complete with an aperture leading to the west, and a silver and brass hatch with a discreet teak ladder in the ceiling.  Centered over a rattan couch is a narra-framed oil painting, and a sextant hangs next to a highly figured koa door.  Intricate marquetry in koa, teak, mahogany, and narra depicts a giant kraken in the middle of the floor.

title: [The Vengeance, Galley]
description: Bathed in sparkling moonlight, the cozy galley is comprised of light-hued, polished wood flooring with cheerful whitewashed walls featuring ocean blue accents.  A wave-etched white stone basin sits beneath a seaglass mosaic depicting the island, and a small kitchen table is positioned near an oversized brass and koa pantry.  A narrow-tipped balcony filled with greenery is visible through a koa-inlaid glass door.

title: [The Vengeance, Bow]
description: Partially covered by a canvas sailcloth, the bow-shaped balcony is overgrown with greenery.  Vines loop about brass railings and around flowering shrubs, and a carpet of brocade moss covers all but a small koa-and-seaglass pathway, its springy turf ranging from almost black where the shadows hang heavy to a lighter hue beneath the moonlight.  A few herbs cluster near a koa-inlaid glass door leading inside, but the focus is on flowers and lush, tropical vegetation.  Almost hidden beneath the vines is a small, nondescript statue of a mermaid.

title: [The Vengeance, Captain's Cabin]
description: This room encompasses the entire third story of the building, with bull's-eye windows perfectly aligned along the length and two large picture windows on either end looking down upon the second-story balconies.  One side comprises the sleeping area, with a carved narra bed and a koa wardrobe, and the other a sitting room of sorts with a nacre-inlaid teak desk and several chairs around a riverstone fireplace.  Scattered across the polished koa and teak floor are several lamps and a few handwoven carpets, with a silver and brass hatch by one wall.

title: [The Woodman's Chisel]
description: Tall shelves of fine-grained mahogany frame the curtain-draped windows of the small shop, the tone-on-tone brocade styled with local fauna highlighted in threads of gold.  A wide counter displays hand-sketched sheets of vellum beneath a pane of clear glass, the drawings bordered by an array of paint-dipped sticks showcasing available customizations.  Set above an antler-inked partition is an aged iron chisel, the tool displayed within a frame of lacquered lasimor.

title: [House Aspis, Hidden Landing]
description: You are standing on a small landing tucked underneath the grand staircase.  There is a dust bunny in one corner, and steep steps lead downwards.

title: [House Aspis, Lower Lounge]
description: Carved out of the sloping hilltop and facing east, this lounge appears three-sided at first.  Then you realize one entire wall is covered with a nearly invisible crystal window that overlooks a breathtaking view of nearby pine trees that sway their branches gratefully in rhythm to the cool breeze.  Two doors lead east and west.

title: [House Aspis, Workshop]
description: Roughly hewn stone walls rapidly dance silently in the flickering torchlight.  There's a constant sense of something felt yet not seen, of something important distantly whispered yet unheard.  Aspis' enchanting workshop is a place of dangerous magic, where tidy oak countertops and lockers can't conceal the raw power that its wizards attempt to harness.

title: [House Aspis, Spare Bedroom]
description: This simply furnished bedroom is for guests of the House.  It holds a plain but comfortable bed with softened linen sheets, a small dresser and a nightstand with a candle on it.

title: [House Aspis, Lower Storeroom]
description: Well-stocked racks and shelves fill this room.  It is cool and dry, the perfect environment for supplies destined to last a long time.  Inventory lists dating back several decades hang from the walls, and a narrow stair leads down in one corner.

title: [House Aspis, Hidden Nook]
description: There isn't much room in here and the air seems stale and none too fragrant.  You can barely feel a slight breeze that seems to be coming from near the floorboards, but it doesn't seem to be doing much to freshen the air.

title: [House Aspis, Under the Floor]
description: You can't see more than a few inches in front of your face, but you are pretty sure you remember how to find the small opening to get back into the building.  A cold shiver drips down your back and you think you hear footsteps.  Is it your imagination, or is there really someone else down here too?

title: [Underground, Narrow Tunnel]
description: Black shadows dance on the periphery of your vision, but you can never seem to focus on anything long enough to identify it.  The floor of the tunnel is slick from a constant trickle of water that runs down the walls and your footing doesn't seem very secure.

title: [House Aspis, Wine Cellar]
description: This is a long narrow space under the foundations of the house.  It is cooler than the rooms above and rather a bit damper.  Long rows of dust covered bottles sit on wooden racks along one wall.  Casks of ale, mead, brandy and other liquid delights squat along the other wall awaiting their call to duty in the lounges and rooms abovestairs. Beads of moisture collect along fissures in the walls and an occasional drip echoes faintly through the still air.

title: [House Aspis, Secret Vault]
description: This is the strong room of the House.  Treasure and important papers are kept here in a massive iron safe anchored to the floor.  A small wooden table sits in front of it for use in handling money and for storing important but less valuable items.

title: [House Aspis, Hallway]
description: You stand in front of the strong room where each member keeps his or her valuables.  A dark opening leads into the room.

title: [House Aspis, Hallway]
description: You stand in front of the strong room where each member keeps his or her valuables.  A dark opening leads into the room.

title: [Underground, Narrow Tunnel]
description: The water running down the walls seems to be increasing in volume, making you wonder about the sturdiness of the ceiling braces that you see every few feet.  The floor of the tunnel is thick with mud, but you can see some sort of light to the west.

title: [Underground, Narrow Tunnel]
description: The tunnel seems to continue to the west, but a large gap in the floor prevents you from travelling any further in that direction.  Mud and water flow rapidly around your legs and through the gap, sending a small brown waterfall cascading over the edge.

title: [Den of the Dragon, Stage Entry]
description: The smell of paint, both fresh and old, is almost overwhelming, and the scuffed hardwood floor creaks under each footfall.  Dim lighting reveals old paint cans stacked in one corner and highlights the nondescript, flat grey walls whose only feature is the myriad painted phrases scattered here and there.  One small door leads back out and another deeper into the performers' area.

title: [Den of the Dragon, Green Room]
description: A scuffed oak floor is enclosed by pastel green walls.  A long vanity with several mirrors lines one wall.  Stools have been provided at the vanities so performers can put last minute touches to their make-up.  Couches and chairs make cozy sitting areas around mismatched braided rugs.  A few green plants sit in clay pots, adding a bit of serenity to the room.  There is a small niche in the wall next to the door.

title: [Den of the Dragon, Backstage]
description: Dark curtains separate this backstage area from the main stage and allow actors to watch for entrance cues.  Pulleys and ropes overhead attach to flats and other equipment, and one long, coiling rope attaches to a pulley controlling the heavy dark green velvet curtains that front the stage, serving to block the entire stage from audience view when closed.  A sign hangs nearby that can be read even in this darkened area.  The occasional flash of light and sound emanates from beyond the flats.

title: [Den of the Dragon, Stage Right]
description: Through the heavy curtain, one has a clear view of the stage.  This darkened corner provides an ideal place to reflect.  There is a hushed silence as people move to perform various duties.

title: [Den of the Dragon, Stage Left]
description: From this vantage point, one can see all that happens on the stage just beyond the slightly open curtain.  From this room, it is quite possible that every whisper could be heard by an audience.  Above are pulleys through which braided ropes are drawn and left to drape down.  The rope ends are coiled neatly to avoid mishap.

title: [A Weathered Shack]
description: Long modwir shelves lined with various potions, tools, and the unidentifiable remains of plants dominate one side of this relatively large shack.  A simple counter sits near the rear of the room directly in front of a thick wooden door.

title: [Deck the Halls, Show Room]
description: Decorative items line the ecru walls on all sides, the pale hue serving as a warm backdrop.  Directly across from a rose-etched door is a low platform exhibiting larger items.

title: [All That Sparkles, Chamber]
description: Carved out of the surrounding cream-hued stone, this airy chamber features not a single straight line or sharp angle.  Instead, the pale walls curve out to meet a fanciful, undulate ceiling; their surfaces inlaid with sparkling gemstone chips in whimsical mosaic waves that spiral around the room.  A circular chandelier illuminates the shop, the wares displayed on racks and shelves sparkling in the ambient light.  Two rippled columns flank an azure ombre catenary archway, while a curved asymmetrical door stands at the opposite end.

title: [All That Sparkles, Alcove]
description: Recessed deeply from the main shop, the alcove walls have been completely tiled with gemstone shards into a mosaic of an undersea coral forest.  A tall glass-paned counter stands below a scallop-shaped window that offers a view of the exansive moonlit sea.

title: [And Sew It Goes]
description: Two hand-painted porcelain urns flank each side of the boutique's entrance and are filled with bright, blooming peonies that complement the room's simple but elegant decor.  Floor-to-ceiling glass walls give an unhindered view of the adjacent exterior grounds, and a floral curtain with cutwork lace edging hangs over the backroom entry behind a tiered display counter.

title: [And Sew It Goes, Alterations]
description: Armless chairs upholstered in spruce green distressed velvet are arranged in a semicircle around a white oak table brimming with sewing supplies.  Tiny pins with colored heads lay scattered about the floor, and thin strips of fraying material dangle along the edge of a nearly full wastebasket.  A full-length mirror sits next to a console table prepared with a modest selection of treats.

title: [Sweet Delights, Display]
description: White paneling covers the walls of the shop with twin windows draped with pink curtains making the atmosphere bright and airy.  A frosted glass-covered counter is centered on a thick alabaster carpet woven with sparkling threads of silver.  Several displays lined with thick paper doilies are set around the room. The scent of rich chocolate fills the air.

title: [Customary Procedures]
description: Alternating tiles of white, black, and light grey create intriguing floor patterns that have been mimicked with paint to a halfway point on the walls where they meet a solid travertine border of dark grey.  Woven baskets overflowing with white jasmine hang strategically throughout the shop and infuse their sweet fragrance into the ocean-scented air.  Working ardently behind a light grey travertine counter, a brown-haired designer pauses briefly to greet each customer that enters the shop.

title: [Furrier, Rooftop]
description: The rooftop holds a clear vantage of the northern palisade wall and the huge guard towers flanking the north gates.  Beyond the walls stretch the huge expanse of oak and modwir trees making up the Lower Dragonsclaw Forest.

title: [Wehnimer's Landing, Rooftop]
description: The tops of buildings stretch out across Wehnimer's Landing, dwarfed by the wooden palisade walls rising up to enclose the town.  Below the edge, a network of cobblestone roads winds between closely-spaced shops.

title: [Wehnimer's Landing, Rooftop]
description: The tops of buildings stretch out across Wehnimer's Landing, dwarfed by the wooden palisade walls rising up to enclose the town.  Below the edge, a network of cobblestone roads winds between closely-spaced shops.

title: [Barracks, Rooftop]
description: The cobbled roads of North Ring cross below, from east to west.  Wooden palisade walls rise up near the rooftop as the scent of leather and weapon oil wafts up from the barracks.

title: [Wehnimer's Landing, Rooftop]
description: The tops of buildings stretch out across Wehnimer's Landing, dwarfed by the wooden palisade walls rising up to enclose the town.  Below the edge, a network of cobblestone roads winds between closely-spaced shops.

title: [Wehnimer's Landing, Rooftop]
description: The tops of buildings stretch out across Wehnimer's Landing, dwarfed by the wooden palisade walls rising up to enclose the town.  Below the edge, a network of cobblestone roads winds between closely-spaced shops.

title: [Wehnimer's Landing, Rooftop]
description: The tops of buildings stretch out across Wehnimer's Landing, dwarfed by the wooden palisade walls rising up to enclose the town.  Below the edge, a network of cobblestone roads winds between closely-spaced shops.

title: [Bayview Manor, Courtyard]
description: Walls of stacked stone surround the courtyard, providing some solace from the constant bustle of the city on the other side.  At one end of the courtyard, a pair of aged mahogany doors leads into the manor while a wrought-iron gate at the opposite end leads back to the city.  Along the perimeter, an assortment of topiaries, bushes, and ivies has been planted, their blooms blanketing the area with a soft, floral scent.  In the center, several cushioned benches surround a large pear tree which provides shade from the sun, its canopy a riot of leaves wit

title: [Bayview Manor, Foyer]
description: The foyer is expansive and airy, with high ceilings and polished marble floors that gleam in the bright natural light streaming in through the floor-to-ceiling windows that flank a pair of aged mahogany doors.  An imposing chandelier hangs overhead above a pair of plush leather couches set on a large wool rug near a riverstone fireplace.  Opposite the entrance, a grand staircase leads up to the second floor while an ornate oak archway leads further into the manor.

title: [Bayview Manor, Library]
description: Sturdy floor-to-ceiling shelving filled with books and folios organized by subject matter line the walls of the room.  Atop a thick wool rug in the center of the room sits a dark byssine-lined chair and a grand mahogany desk covered in neatly organized papers and trays containing various alchemical apparatuses.  Above, a polished gold lantern hangs from a decorative canopy that has been inlaid with various gemstone constellations.

title: [Bayview Manor, Ruined Workshop]
description: The smell of burnt timber and cloth, which is relieved only by the large hole that has been blasted into the roof, permeates the remnants of this shattered workshop.  Large spiderweb cracks radiate outward from the central point of this large, round room.  Throughout, shattered bits of plinite have embedded themselves into the wall, their inner light casting a dull, ethereal glow. In the center, a makeshift platform has been erected and topped with a polished silver telescope.

title: [Bayview Manor, Kitchen]
description: Neat and efficient, the kitchen has been organized to provide a cook with ready access to all of the tools and serveware contained in its numerous white pine cabinets.  In the center, a large wood table serves as a convenient place for prepared food and drinks to be served.  Behind it, a polished copper stove sits flanked by additional work surfaces while a small rhimar chest sits near the entrance.

title: [Bayview Manor, Bedroom]
description: Some curtained floor-to-ceiling windows allow natural light to fill the space and provide a view of the courtyard outside and the city beyond.  A large ebonwood sleigh bed flanked by a pair of ebonwood nightstands and gold wall sconces serves as the focal point of the room, its plush mattress topped with thick blankets and soft pillows.  Across from the bed is a comfortable ebonwood chair and a large cedar wardrobe, its doors inlaid with geometric gold leafwork.

title: [Bayview Manor, Bath]
description: Polished marble floors surround an ornate freestanding bath embellished with elegant gold fixtures.  Curtained windows provide the space with natural light while a large crystal chandelier suspended from a silver chain hangs overhead.  A square silver-framed mirror hangs above a polished beechwood vanity topped with a polished stone sink while several storage bins are tucked away underneath.  In opposite corners of the bath sits a gold filigree bin and a small collection of incense on a small beechwood stand.

title: [The Trading Post]
description: Enclosed by whitewashed shiplap walls, the shop features a large brown bearskin rug in the center of its plank pine floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the post and beam ceiling.  Right near the front is a live edge oak table inlaid with a blue resin river and a glass display case framed in richly stained oak.

title: [The Trading Post, Alcove]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the whitewashed shiplap walls, and a rough-hewn post and beam ceiling rises overhead.  A plush white sheepskin rug sits in one corner of a wide plank pine floor.  There is an antique oak cabinet with frosted glass doors on one side of the shop and an ornate oak rack set with polished brass hooks on the other.

title: [The Outfitting]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the whitewashed shiplap walls, and a rough-hewn post and beam ceiling rises overhead.  An intricate cloth mosaic tile rug sits in one corner of a wide plank pine floor.  There is an open cast iron safe inlaid with intricate brass scrollwork  on one side of the shop and an oak slab shelf supported by solid brass brackets on the other.

title: [Irval's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, a midnight blue rising phoenix tapestry hangs on one of the smooth granite walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet and a glass-topped mistwood counter sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a dark-stained oak floor.

title: [Irval's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A warped treasure chest and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Irval's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A splintered cargo crate and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Neithan's General Store]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the polished oak walls, and a vaulted ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of a polished oak floor.  There is an oversized sea chest on one side of the shop and a gilded maple cabinet on the other.

title: [Neithan's Outfitting]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the ribbed black willow walls, and a vaulted ceiling rises overhead.  A bronze peg-legged cat statue sits in one corner of a dark-stained oak floor.  There is a narrow glass-topped table on one side of the shop and an elegant silver jewelry rack on the other.

title: [Neithan's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a glass-tiled vaulted ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A floral-etched ceramic case sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Daedeus's Magic Shoppe]
description: The broad sweep of the oak floor is interrupted by a sphere-topped black marble fountain.  Halfway to the golden oak ceiling, a detailed landscape painting hangs on one of the polished oak walls.  A white marble shelf is pushed to the back of the shop.

title: [Daedeus's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sits in one corner while a hanging suit of full plate armor rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Daedeus's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A set of carved felwood shelves sits in one corner while a hanging suit of full plate armor rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Harbored Anchors, Lounge]
description: Barely tall enough to fit a full-grown giantkin, the arched ceiling is lined with thick beams of varnished acacia.  Pinned, hammered, and haphazardly glued across the walls are flyers, jewelry, gems, and all manner of trinkets.  There is a small pathway between the wagon's front door and the back, and on either side of the pathway are bags full of fabrics, furs, and leathers.  Cleared of clutter, a checkered pull-out desk has a neat display of goods.

title: [Harbored Anchors, Backroom]
description: Stacks of books and loose papers clutter the area.  There is a small bed that is half-buried with pillows of every shape and color, with a single linen blanket tucked between.  Dangling above is a dusty iron lantern next to a tiny, single glass-paned window.

title: [Excessive Accessories]
description: Pulled taut against dark rosewood support beams are layers of creamy tan canvas.  There is a triangular peak at the top of the yurt that expands to form its bulbous, circular body.  Mats of woven bamboo line the floor, while stained glass-shelled lanterns dangle high above.  Opposite a slit opening in the canvas walls and pressed back against the room is a long rosewood worktable full of colorful merchandise.

title: [More Fantabulous]
description: Golden oak boards comprise the wagon's floor, with a deep blue rug running down the center.  A carved fel table runs along one wall, while a wide peachwood stand lines the opposite wall.

title: [More Fantabulous, Hatch]
description: Only the edges of the polished oak floor are visible, as most is covered by a bright blue rug.  Some invar hooks hang from one wall, while a thick cherrywood rack flanks the opposite.  A burnished steel hatch leads into the rear of the wagon.

title: [More Fantabulous, Storage]
description: Numerous wooden crates and boxes are stacked up throughout this storerom.  One area near the real wall is kept clear, save for a small padded cot and a cushioned tanik bench.  A polished silver lamp hangs low on the wall just above the cot.

title: [The Fiery Sonata, Salesroom]
description: Dimly lit, the interior is tightly packed with cluttered aisles, leaving little room to move around.  Multiple instruments rest on lacquered wooden shelves, while several others are displayed against the walls.  Small bronze placards are placed near each instrument, detailing its intended use.  Despite the confined space, the arrangement of the instruments is orderly and systematic.  Against the far wall, a large glass case exhibits several wares for sale.

title: [Rumor Woods, Rolton Glades]
description: Aspen-covered hills gently roll into a grassy meadow where the cackling call of a distant woodpecker harmonizes with the querulous tone of a red-breasted bluebird.  Wildflowers bloom in a riot of color, the purple coneflowers complementing the fiery red poppies and a swathe of violet-tinged blue irises add intensity to a patch of sunny buttercups.  A hollow log along the edge of a footpath hosts a growth of white-spotted red mushrooms.

title: [Rumor Woods, Rolton Glades]
description: Deep drifts of orange and violet flowers grow wild along the edge of a muddy path cutting through patches of high grass in a glade of aspen mixed with oak saplings.  Not far off of the path to the east under the shadow of a copse of trees, a spring bubbles into a small pool, the cool, clear water inviting a variety of wildlife to take a sip.  A thick patch of white clover blossoms inside of a lopsided ring of reddish brown mushrooms.

title: [Rumor Woods, Racing Entries]
description: Pennants placed every few feet along a widening muddy track provide a colorful escort to a pair of viewing stands on opposing sides of a sodded racing track.  Centrally located, a sky blue and white-striped pavilion buzzes with activity as jockeys prepare for upcoming races.  A supply cart pulled by a team of stout ponies is unloaded of its burden near the entrance.

title: [Rumor Woods, Tourney Booths]
description: On opposing sides of a dirt racing track, a set of vert-painted steps and a set of violet-painted steps lead to corresponding banner-draped viewing stands filled with raucous crowds.  The soft ground has been trampled by foot and hoof alike, a thrown silver horseshoe stuck in a water-lined mud puddle near a shorn tuft of sweet grass.  A thicket of beautyberry bushes provide a scenic background for a collection of booths.

On opposing sides of a dirt racing track, a set of crimson-painted steps and a set of green-painted steps lead to corresponding banner-draped viewing stands filled with raucous crowds.  The soft ground has been trampled by foot and hoof alike, a thrown silver horseshoe stuck in a water-lined mud puddle near a shorn tuft of sweet grass.  A thicket of beautyberry bushes provide a scenic background for a collection of booths.

title: [Rumor Woods, Viewing Stands]
description: Painted with splashes of beige and myrtle green, it is standing room only at this end of the race track viewing stands.  Covering the oak plank floor, a mixture of confetti and sawdust is used to soak up the spilled ale from which a constant sour odor rises.  An enormous stuffed scorpion pierced through the eyes with a white arrow hangs above a set of steps leading down from the stands.

Painted with splashes of gold and hunter green, it is standing room only at this end of the race track viewing stands.  Covering the oak plank floor, a mixture of confetti and sawdust is used to soak up the spilled ale from which a constant sour odor rises.  An enormous stuffed wolf head pierced through the eye with a golden arrow hangs above a set of steps leading down from the stands.

title: [Rumor Woods, Viewing Stands]
description: Reserved for special guests, front row seating overlooking a dirt racing track features wide fleece-padded benches with ample leg room between the rows.  An elaborate gold-threaded hunter green banner depicting a savage rivalry between a menancing horned rolton and a fierce ebon wolf hangs over the railing.  A serving wench balances a mug-laden tray on her shoulder as she weaves her way through the crowd offering refreshments.

title: [Rumor Woods, Viewing Stands]
description: Sheltered beneath a hunter-green striped canvas awning, rough-hewn oak benches are evenly spaced with hardly enough room to sidle between.  A spilled ale tankard and overturned basket of roasted peanuts lies forgotten beside a steel-banded cask branded with a sloppily painted rolton.  The wooden floor sags under the weight of the crowds in this area and is covered with a thin layer of gold-hued sawdust.

title: [Rumor Woods, Viewing Stands]
description: Constructed from hardy oak and stained a golden honey color, narrow benches set on risers run the length of an elevated stand overlooking a dirt racing track.  Padded fleece cushions are strewn about the seating area, offering slight comfort and minimal warmth.  Mounted along the front rails, hunter green pennants whip and snap wildly in the cool breeze.

title: [Rumor Woods, Viewing Stands]
description: Overlooking a dirt racing track, multitier plank benches painted bright beige are packed into an oak constructed stand raised above ground level.  Silken beige banners are draped at all corners, while myrtle green streamers featuring jerboas flutter from sturdy wooden railings.  The smell of roasting peanuts and freshly popped corn wafts through the seating area.

Overlooking a dirt racing track, multi-tier plank benches painted bright crimson are packed into an oak constructed stand raised above ground level.  Silken ebon banners are draped at all corners, while crimson streamers featuring various wolf silhouettes flutter from sturdy wooden railings.  The smell of roasting peanuts and freshly popped corn wafts through the seating area.

title: [Rumor Woods, Viewing Stands]
description: Cut from waxed canvas, an ebon-on-crimson striped awning offers race track viewers protection from the elements.  Jeers and cheers rise up from raised rows of crowded, rough-hewn oak benches positioned behind a more spacious seating area roped off for use only by honored guests.  A stern-faced attendant is positioned nearby, nodding at distinguished onlookers and offering entry to the reserved section.

title: [Rumor Woods, Viewing Stands]
description: An overwhelming number of spectators crowd closely together along ebon-painted benches, the lack of fresh air forcing those in the front row to hang over crimson banner-draped railings in order to catch a breeze.  Stacked in one corner, tapped barrels of cheap wine drip onto a sawdust-covered plank floor.  A rolton pinata covered with golden fleece hangs by a noosed rope overhead, a pile of sharpened sticks scattered below.

title: [Rumor Woods, Viewing Stands]
description: Raised several steps above the ground, the sturdily constructed stands overlook a deeply rutted racing track.  Several of the benches have collapsed under the collective weight of the crowds, the splintered oak boards now only fit for kindling.  Strands of embroidered black-on-crimson pennants line the steps leading down to the racing entries.

title: [Plum Tree Table]
description: Bathed in candlelight, a small round table of white birch rests within the shelter of painted screens.  Several stubby pillar candles encircle a white porcelain urn painted with wrens upon the smooth surface of the table, while a soft rug of lamb's wool provides a vibrant splash of verdant color to the area.

title: [Cocobolo Table]
description: Fitfully burning, a stone-filled glaesine bowl is nestled within the heart of a smooth cocobolo table.  Privacy screens of painted rice paper framed in bamboo encircle three-quarters of the space, while the final section provides an unobstructed view of the common area.

title: [Summit Table]
description: Earthy brown hues blend with dark purple within this small nook that is surrounded by paper screens painted with mountain scenery.  Knotted roots, lacquered to produce a glossy sheen, are twisted together to form the central support of a glass-topped table, while cushioned tree stumps on felt-bottomed legs form comfortable chairs.

title: [Wolf Table]
description: Encircled by some gilt vexilla, the bas relief table is illuminated by lanterns that dangle from the wrought iron rafters above.  Brightly painted, the table top displays a topographical map that is surrounded by tumbling water.

title: [Rolton Table]
description: Encircled by some gold and hunter green vexilla, the bright table is illuminated by lanterns that dangle from the wrought iron rafters above.  Boldly pyrographed into the top of the table is a the head of a rolton in profile.

title: [Moving on Up]
description: Colorful planks of wood create fencelike walls across the room, the posts hung with twine-tied origami folded into the shapes of several equines, tortoises, and roltons.  Layered green wool rugs cover the planked floor, the runners leading towards several tin buckets filled with assorted treats.  Hung above the crossbeams are blown glass lanterns forged into fluffy clouds, the pieces lit by tiny teardrop-shaped votives casting a faint light across the shop.

title: [The Brass Ring, Carousel]
description: An assortment of carousel horses mounted on gilded poles encircle a moving platform beneath shiny metal rings hanging from a mirrored ceiling, just out of reach.  A rearing stallion carved from black fel follows a winged, poplar-carved pegasus, while a prancing, helmet-clad centaur takes its place in line behind a spiral-horned unicorn pulling a chariot.  Between the moving menagerie, a small red door with a brass knob is visible in the center support housing which is covered in colorful scenery panels.

title: [The Brass Ring, Carousel Center]
description: A prime representation of gnomish artisanship, the inner workings of the carousel are laid bare behind the finely painted scenery panels in a jumble of gears, levers, and moving metal parts.  Amid bins overflowing with tools and barrels full of black grease, an old monir chariot has been repurposed into a bed for the operator.  A spiraling stairway winds around the enormous center pole supporting the roundabout, leading to a storage area above.

title: [The Brass Ring, Storage]
description: A small herd of carved wooden horses in various states of disrepair are crowded into a makeshift corral taking up most of the available storage space above the carousel.  Leather reins and tarnished bits hang on oak-paneled walls on both sides of a cedar cabinet filled with evenly spaced shelves.  Suspended from the low ceiling by lengths of faded velvet, myriad brass rings, each polished to a mirror shine, reflect the flickering light cast from a pair of lanterns mounted near the stairway.

title: [Lambs Among Wolves]
description: The dirt floor is nearly hidden by a carpet of rolton and wolf fur rugs, all in various states of wear and tear and in a variety of hues.  Much the same are the walls of the slapdash wooden shelter, each covered by and insulated with the furred hides of both predator and prey.  Small ramshackle curios sit here and there, filled with jars and bottles of odds and ends, solids and liquids, while a four-legged scrap wood table takes center stage in the space, illuminated by a black iron-framed lantern above.

title: [Tiu & Qaiteke]
description: A wide pathway cuts through the tent, which is composed of a patchwork of bleached hides stretched between a series of tiered support poles.  Colorful lapis and ruby-toned woven rugs are scattered across the ground near a flimsy yucca wood table, leaving the remainder of the ground uncovered.  Strung from double rows of thick ropes that hang at mid-chest level and directly in the midst of an incensed haze, finely crafted nakaten represent the majority of the shop's offerings.

title: [The Folded Lotus]
description: Crates of paper are stacked about the outer edges of the pavilion, several topped with origami unicorns and lizards.  Set upon a plum-colored carpet, an expansive cherrywood desk and a dark mahogany cabinet display several samples of fine origami paper, a small silver-bound chest tucked between them.  Prominently displayed near the entrance is a silver-framed notice.

title: [The Folded Lotus, Training]
description: Luxurious swaths of crimson and ebon silk cover the pavilion walls, while hundreds of origami figures litter the shelves and counters situated strategically across the area.  A polished dream agate case sits beneath a lotus-painted teak and bamboo table, and a silver-framed sign is placed prominently on the center pavilion support.

title: [Curio Minds, Entry]
description: Bright light gives the tiny shop an airy feel and almost washes out the pale green and pastel pink stripes running vertically down the walls.  Plain molding rings the perimeter where the raftered ceiling meets the octagonal configuration of the small building, and translucent white gossamer curtains flutter with the soft breeze from the open windows and ajar doorway.  A hodgepodge of ceramic pots in bright hues hold miniature rose bushes in splendid bloom that line every sill.

title: [Curio Minds, Alcove]
description: Pale decorations continue to underwhelm here, forcing the focus on a large pale maple display at the center of the room.  Odds and ends of old ephemera set within a mix of mismatched picture frames are arranged in clusters on various decorative tables set between a grouping of red velvet chairs and an arrangement of yellow velvet chairs.  Some of them contain faded paintings of people in all kinds of customed dress, while several are stylized drawings of various animals in poses.

title: [A Lofty Affair, Entry]
description: Bales of hay line the edges of the pavilion, their sides bound by heavy wire and their bottoms resting upon a canvas floor covering.  Tufts of grass stick up between the heavy tent stakes that bind the walls to the ground, as well as create lumps beneath the canvas tarps, though in most places they are worn smooth from foot traffic.  A series of copper lanterns attached to the central support post provides illumination for the available wares.

title: [A Lofty Affair, West Wing]
description: Sunlight slips through the sheets of canvas where the binding lacing on the pavilion walls has come undone, the rawhide bindings flapping with small snapping sounds in the arctic breezes that slip in and out of the area.  Bales of hay covered in sailcloth or checkered tablecloths are positioned in rows along the edges of the space, their wares held down by rocks to keep them from fluttering away.  Small tufts of blue-green grass peak out from beneath the overlapping floor coverings.

title: [A Lofty Affair, East Wing]
description: Rippling in the arctic breezes, the walls of the pavilion flutter and sway at sporadic moments.  Nearby, a central post keeps the ceiling aloft and allows for a view of the entire tent, though passage to its other areas is confined by the position of hay bales covered in fabric.  A low wooden table stretches across the alley between the bales.

title: [Bad Wolf Clothing, Entrance]
description: Lengths of twine are strung between oaken tent poles creating clotheslines, each hung with a variety of woolen garments.  Pushed up against the tent walls, several mismatched wooden trunks sit open with the contents in complete disarray.  Above a tattered tent flap, the severed head of a massive grey wolf is mounted, its sizable jaws propped open in a perpetually menacing growl.

title: [Bad Wolf Clothing, Backroom]
description: Metal brushes are scattered over a long oaken worktable next to rattan baskets of fleece stacked one on top of the other.  Taking pride of place, a golden yew spinning wheel draped with woolen yarn is arranged alongside a small rocking chair.  Pushed beneath the table is a line of dye-splattered tubs and water-filled basins.

title: [Ewe Vixen]
description: Canvas stretches across a sturdy oak frame, creating a small booth with an open front that faces the winding caravan trail.  Travel and loose shale cover the ground, crunching as guests come and go within the cramped shelter.  Long tables line the walls, while a series of copper hooks land in various ornaments hang from their affixed position along the oak beams.

title: [Legendairy]
description: Bright candy-striped walls enclose the pastel-colored shop, the long marble counters covered in tiered racks of gold and silver wire.  In the center of the room stands a monocle-adorned octopus statue, its curled arms displaying a multitude of blown glass bowls, the vessels cradled between polychromatic streamers of silk ribbon.  Chain-draped lanterns shaped like inverted ice cream cones are scattered throughout the shop, casting vivid flashes of light across the planked floor.

title: [Legendairy, Extras]
description: The colorful brocade walls are affixed with angular ice cream dishes piling toppings into open hollow hands crafted from bright ceramics.  A hat-wearing capybara of clay stands in the middle of wood-planked floor, the upright rodent grasping twin glass trays between its claws.  Garlands of vellum-crafted ice cream scoops are draped across the walls, linked by tiny wood-carved cones, the decorations swaying with the ambient breeze.

title: [Steaming Mugs]
description: Separating the working space from the customer space, a long oak table supported by blackened iron legs is covered with a bright yellow tablecloth and covered with various beverages.  Beyond the table are several tripods holding aloft kettles and cauldrons as they gently simmer over carefully banked fires built just beyond the edges of the stall's canvas awnings and walls.  The blended scent of cinnamon, coffee, and caramel fills the air.

title: [The Daily Dip]
description: Supported on four sides by durable oak walls, the booth is covered with a red and white-striped awning that hangs over its long counter.  Beyond the counter, the western walls are lined with shelves and laden with drakar-lined bowls and steaming baskets of food.  Upon the opposite wall is a bookcase that holds rhimar-lined containers and paper-lined urns beneath a protective, bug-resistant mesh.  A small sign rests on the counter.

title: [Milkin' It]
description: Wispy clouds of chiffon-wrapped glass are interspersed across the vibrant blue-painted ceiling, the semi-translucent lanterns encircling a gilded glass sphere at the center of the shop.  A red barn-shaped display sits nestled across rugs of grass-colored cotton, the neatly stacked wares cushioned in a bright gingham cloth.  Diminutive figurines of roltons, goats, and other farm animals are displayed on several wall-mounted shelves, the models crafted from a variety of artistic mediums.

title: [Milkin' It, Petting Zoo]
description: Tall beams of grass green wood create an open-air framework for a number of straw-filled pens, the spacious stalls echoing with various bleats from their occupants.  The iron-riveted posts are hung with buckets of feed, brush-filled pouches, and other provisions for the woolly animals, the string-tied gourds swaying across the fence with the ambient breeze.  A series of tree stumps are set within the enclosures, the various heights providing a number of perches for the playful creatures.

title: [The Starry Lotus, Starstruck]
description: Layers upon layers of lush inytela billow down from the ceiling, the sparkling, twilight blue silk panels creating a pathway that wends through the pavilion.  Each panel depicts a different constellation, and intricate embroidery along the edges highlights various flora of Atan Irith.  Under a trio of toadstool-embroidered banners sits a polished ekata rack and a carved nightwillow counter, while a series of apovta shelves is framed by panels edged with tiny mereviolets.

title: [The Starry Lotus, Sunstruck]
description: The night blue starsilk of the pavilion has been draped with artfully twisted rays of yellow, orange, and pink naraina radiating out from a shimmering ball of bright yellow silk at the ceiling's apex.  Several swathes have been hand-painted with scenes of Atan Irith life, including a detailed depiction of Inyexat riding capybaras through a valley.  A luck agate-inlaid table and a mereagate stand perch atop a thick captiql rug at the center of the room.

title: [Rolton Pens, Entrance]
description: Brightly colored awnings sway and flutter in the transient arctic breezes, the ropes that anchor them to nearby support posts creaking and groaning when they pull against their bindings.  White picket fences stretch along the east and west, forming an encircling pen in the thick blue-green grasses of a rolling glade.  Small mounds of stubborn snow cling to the footings at the entrance gates.

title: [Rolton Pens, Central Viewing ]
description: Stretching northward, a long column of white picket fences departs from the central viewing area of the pens towards the entrance gates where clumps of snow still cling to the blue-green grass.  Colorful awnings of bright yellow, red, and green provide shelter from the elements, though they still sway when the arctic breezes pass through.  Along the southern section are three pens filled with roltons, sheep, and goats.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Rolton Pens, Rare Grazing]
description: Overlapping one another, bright green triangles of canvas provide shelter to the wedge-shaped pen that is filled with blue-green grass and grazing roltons.  White picket fencing keeps the ovine denizens from wandering away, while baskets of sweet grass hold their attention.  Bells strung from red and yellow ribbons mark the entry gate, which leads back to the central viewing area of the glade.

title: [Rolton Pens, Uncommon Grazing]
description: Overlapping one another, bright red triangles of canvas provide shelter to the wedge-shaped pen that is filled with blue-green grass and grazing sheep and goats.  White picket fencing keeps the ovine denizens from wandering away, while baskets of sweet grass hold their attention.  Bells strung from green and yellow ribbons mark the entry gate, which leads back to the central viewing area of the glade.

title: [Rolton Pens, Common Grazing]
description: Overlapping one another, bright yellow triangles of canvas provide shelter to the wedge-shaped pen that is filled with blue-green grass and grazing sheep.  White picket fencing keeps the ovine denizens from wandering away, while baskets of sweet grass hold their attention.  Bells strung from green and red ribbons mark the entry gate, which leads back to the central viewing area of the glade.

title: [Gnomish Gnails]
description: Worn, dingy canvas walls, supported by a bronze-braced metal frame, trap the aroma of oil and rust in the compact tent.  Amongst tightly coiled springs and well-used tools, patinated gears and cogs litter the top of a worktable behind an oil-stained elm counter displaying gnomish gadgets.  A brass-caged lantern glows warmly from the low-peaked ceiling, the orangey light glinting off the rows of glass bottles lined up on a copper-riveted steel rack.

title: [Baaarnyard Bounty]
description: Colorful barn-shaped lanterns are suspended on high within the bright blue tent, highlighting the gingham-lined wicker baskets affixed to tables in the shape of fence posts.  Wooden shelves are scattered across the silken walls, displaying a variety of rolton artwork crafted from various mediums, the largest shelf balancing a depiction of an armor-clad rolton standing triumphantly above a defeated wolf.  The ground has been scattered with shaggy green cotton rugs, the fringe fraying across planks.

title: [The Silken Lotus, Irita]
description: A lavish golden silk divider separates this area from the rest of the pavilion.  Opulent wall hangings representing each Dai brush the polished mahogany flooring, and a birch counter rests opposite a birch sideboard.  Several lush ferns and potted chrysanthemums surround a tiny burbling fountain in the far corner.

title: [The Silken Lotus, Raiyatha]
description: Plush cushions and walls of forest-hued silks and satins combine to create a cozy and comfortable space behind a cedar and sapphire silk screen.  A stuffed silken mannequin sits in one corner atop a nautilus-patterned rug, and a cherrywood figure rests opposite, nestled between a long bamboo shelf and a tall dream agate pillar etched with lotus blossoms.

title: [The Silken Lotus, Ayra]
description: Separated from the main pavilion by a hand-painted crimson silk partition, this area is well-lit with several full-length mirrors.  A stylish cherrywood mannequin and a lifelike lotus wood figure draped with elegant clothing stand by themselves in the center, with a series of cedar racks displaying additional wares against the outer wall.

title: [Lizard Vivarium, White Walkway]
description: Light and airy colors dominate the walkway with brightly painted, white wooden beams and colorful, potted hydrangeas strewn about the area.  White jasmine has been wound around the beams of the pen's fence, while smooth white stones and brass lanterns define the path through the walkway.

title: [Lizard Vivarium, Green Walkway]
description: The oppressive heat and humidity are amplified by the lack of any portal to the outside, denying shoppers even a moment's respite.  Coiled around the mullions and trusses supporting the glass ceiling overhead are large vines soaking in the ample sunlight.  Below, succulent plants are displayed along the beams separating the pens from the walkway.

title: [Clodhoppers]
description: Near a metal rack filled with various tools for the creation of footwear, a sturdy shoe form is bolted to a heavy wooden platform.  Bolts of fabric are tightly packed into bins beneath a long oaken worktable littered with scraps of leather and broken bits of chalk.  An old wine barrel sits in front of a canvas tent flap.

title: [Tortoise Holdings, Enclosures]
description: The open air enclosure houses a quartet of similar, but smaller enclosures, each one heavily reinforced by iron pipes to prevent collapse.  Lengths of colorful linen have been draped between the areas, the fabric embroidered with elaborate stylizations of large-shelled reptiles.

title: [Tortoise Enclosure]
description: A makeshift pond has been dug within the center of the stall, the blue-green water surrounded by troughs of fresh fruits and vegetables.  Iron-caged glass lamps hang high above the rafters, casting asymmetric rays of light upon the muddy floor.

title: [Tortoise Enclosure]
description: Half a dozen cacti line the back wall of the stall, each succulent missing a variety of large chunks along their flat stems.  A fine layer of sand intermingles with the crushed greenery littered upon the ground, the massive indentations an indication of the stall's inhabitants.

title: [Whirl and Twirl, Showroom]
description: Trunks filled with colorful silks and low tables laden with vendibles are situated between pairs of mannequins, each positioned mid-step in various dances.  A formally-dressed mannequin sporting a luxurious blonde wig dances a waltz with a faceless partner near a tiered glass display case.  To the east, low hanging chandeliers illuminate a path through the sheer silk partitions leading to a polished hardwood dance floor.

title: [Whirl and Twirl, Dance Floor]
description: Softly lit by ornate gold candelabras at each corner, a flame maple dance floor has been polished to a mirror shine.  Off to one side, a small elevated platform is arranged for a musical ensemble, complete with chairs, music stands, and instruments.  A silk-draped table at the back of the tent has been laid out with refreshments.

title: [Off the Chain]
description: Swathes of ivory silk create the interior of this small, yet airy, tent.  A glass display case topped with a wooden tray is centered upon a large, colorful rug that covers most of the floorspace.  Several tall mannequins are stationed at the corners to display wares, while a silver-framed mirror is positioned near the flap serving as exit and entrance.

title: [The Tartan Cloth, East Wing]
description: Umber canvas falls in even lines from the conical ceiling to the overlapping rug floor, their long lengths weighted to prevent movement in the arctic winds.  Flickering braziers sway in their lofted position above as tendrils of chill air trickle through a small smoke hole in the ceiling to tug at them.  Several garments, hung from wooden pegs around the perimeter, flutter, their ends catching on the woven river reed baskets placed beneath them.

title: [The Tartan Cloth, West Wing]
description: Lofted braziers shed light throughout the umber tent, the warm glow illuminating the conical-shaped ceiling and the multicolored rugs that are scattered about the floor.  Stretched between the central support posts, several wrought iron hooks and river reed baskets are arranged at varying heights throughout the area, while a smooth wooden bench provides a resting place for weary customers.  A light arctic breeze tickles the air despite the warmth of the braziers above.

title: [The Tartan Cloth, North Wing]
description: Long tapestries of tartan fabric drape from hooks that are woven into the joints of the pavilion, where the umber ceiling meets the canvas walls.  Overlapping rugs of bright and dark hues are scattered about the space and provide a touch of insulation from the cold, hard ground.  River reed baskets are neatly tucked beneath long oak tables that display a wide variety of clothes for sale.

title: [The Tartan Cloth, Center]
description: Four support posts rise perfectly straight in the air to support the heavy canvas of pavilion, while the opposite ends are weighted with enormous wrought iron circles.  Hooks hammered into their lengths are fitted with bronze chains that hold large braziers aloft, the sturdy round bowls filled with coals that illuminate every corner of the space.  Long tables filled with wares are arranged to create alleys that lead to other sections of the pavilion, while river reed baskets are tidily tucked beneath them.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Lizard Vivarium, White Pen]
description: Large white sandstone rocks litter the area, serving as places for the denizens of this pen to lounge and soak up the sunlight streaming in through the glass roof above.  Along the perimeter, white jasmine has been strung around the fence, suffusing the area with a pleasant scent.  At the center, a small fire pit has been dug to provide further warmth for the animals present.  You also see a white wooden gate leading out of the pen.

title: [Lizard Vivarium, Blue Walkway]
description: The heat and humidity along this walkway are magnified by the ample amount of sunlight streaming in through the glass ceiling.  Under the wooden beams forming the perimeter of the fence, blue hyacinths and irises have been planted to provide a natural demarcation for the pen.

title: [Lizard Vivarium, Blue Pen]
description: Large flat rocks cover the packed dirt floor of this wood fence-enclosed pen.  A small watering hole has been placed at one end, while a small feeding trough has been placed at the other.  In the center, a fenced fire pit has been placed, its flames casting a dull glow upon the surrounding area.  Around it, several lizards lay with their bellies exposed to the flame, basking in the warmth it provides, with only an occasional break to groom or drink before returning to their resting spot.

title: [Lizard Vivarium, Green Pen]
description: The packed dirt floor and large flat rocks within this pen are dimly illuminated by several large lanterns that have been placed along the perimeter. Flames lick at a broad, thin stone suspended from short stone supports over the sunken fire pit in the center, set adjacent to a small watering hole dug at one end.   Arrayed around it, several lizards lounge with their bellies exposed to the warmth emanating from the fire, while the largest lizard asserts its dominance by lazing upon the rock platform itself

title: [Barn With It, Entry]
description: Hanging from a low beam, an iron lantern provides very little illumination to the room.  Oiled leather, straw, and grains scent the air.  Particles from the dried goods float throughout the area, creating a fine layer of dust upon all the surfaces.  The walls of this room are lined with wall-mounted saddle racks, each bearing the weight of its namesake, while just beneath are barrels full of numerous equine treats.

title: [Barn With It, Northwest]
description: Evenly spaced across the room, hoops of iron are hammered into the walls, each with a set of leather reins looped through them.  A large square bench rests near the northwestern wall, a small leather cushion placed upon it, with a set of boot brushes nearby.  Wooden crates filled with an assortment of nightmarish snacks are set upon counter-topped cupboards that line the eastern walls.

title: [Barn With It, South]
description: Cubby holes line this entire room, each one holding within them a different set of jousting gear.  Colorful ribbons dangle from the exposed trusses above.  Some of them look brand new, while others are tattered and faded from time.  Large, woven jute sacks hang from wooden pillars placed at the front and back of this room.

title: [Quit Stallin', Backroom]
description: Gold-hued canvas falls at an angle from ceiling to floor to create a narrow storage room at the back of the tent.  Mismatched fixtures, leftovers or extras from the displayers at the front of the tent, are discarded amid wooden chests and opened crates.  Resting near the entrance, a long wooden bench is covered in papers.

title: [Born to Adorn, Leg Up]
description: Trailing in from the west, a bright white lattice stretches to the ceiling and is held in place by ties to the central support of the tent.  Metallic hooks and rough oak pegs are affixed to the structure, which forms a sort of wall that separates the center of the space from this section.  Placed against the exterior canvas tent wall, a low round table topped with wares is illuminated by a lantern that sits in its center.

title: [Born to Adorn, Long Necked]
description: Canvas pools in loose folds amid yellowing grass along the edges of the small tent, which is supported by a single rough oak post.  Several small pine barrels are arranged in a neat row that stretches to the north, while several dusty wicker baskets are scattered about the dirt floor in seemingly random order.  A lantern rests upon a low round table in the center of the space, its bright white light providing ample illumination.

title: [The Kindred Plaid, West]
description: Laid out in layers, bright white rugs rest upon grass green ones to create diamond patterns upon the ground, while heavy wrought iron spheres rest upon the overly long cloth walls in an attempt to keep the arctic winds at bay.  A narrow wooden footlocker rests in the center of the room, its lid thrown back to reveal the trinkets and baubles stored within.  Not far behind, a long oak table has several river reed baskets stuffed under it, which helps to clear up the center for foot traffic.

title: [The Kindred Plaid, South]
description: Lamplight plays upon the rippled oilcloth of the tent's walls, lending them an oily appearance that is slightly rainbow-swirled.  Large posts keep the ceiling at bay for even the tallest of guests, while mismatched rugs scattered on the ground hide most of the surrounding mud and grass.  Sitting kitty-corner to one section of the tent, a copper-bound worn oak footlocker sits with its lid thrown wide to display the pressed and folded linens within.

title: [The Colorful Carapace]
description: Various shapes of testudinal glass dangle from twine suspended between the tent's central support and several of the side poles.  Light plays off the delicate ornaments, casting colorful shifting patterns upon the ground and walls.

title: [The Colorful Carapace]
description: Beautifully colored patterns have been painted on sheets of parchment and pinned in an orderly fashion along the nearest tent wall.  Small gauze pouches of dried herbs hang between the side poles, releasing their delicate fragrance into the air.

title: [The Colorful Carapace]
description: Several wooden planks line the back of the tent, serving as workstations for creating colorful pigments.  A particularly wide shelf has been neatly stocked with a multitude of glass jars holding raw materials: flowers, berries, vegetables, and an assortment of minerals.  Set off to the side, a few colorful cloths are neatly folded and displayed on a short wooden rack.

title: [The Flanked Bag]
description: The dark canvas of the marquee is lit with a warm glow by six globes of light suspended from spokes that radiate out from the king pole at its center.  The eastern and southern walls of the tent are lined with tall haon shelves, each neatly stacked with merchandise for sale, leaving the northwestern corner occupied by the tools of the tanner.  A large drying rack stands empty next to a crate piled with tree bark and an assortment of barrels filled with varicolored liquids.

title: [Woodn't Yew, Leaf]
description: Patches of raw linen in various shapes and sizes cover holes found throughout the tent's faded walls and canopy.  Along the walls are blackwood racks with iron gridwork containing a variety of unfinished wooden branches stripped of excess bark and twigs.  Set between two of the racks is a large terracotta urn painted with an irregular pattern of scorched horsehair.

title: [Woodn't Yew, Needle]
description: Stacks of blackwood crates surround the entirety of the area, with additional ones cluttering the ground.  Amongst the crates are remnants of tree branches, their sticks, twigs, and leaves now dry and brittle.  Along the tent's fur-covered walls hang moss-filled brown-tinged glass spheres strung on braided copper and bronze filiments showing signs of patination.

title: [Vintage Visions]
description: Rippling slightly in the sporadic arctic breezes, the canvas walls of the pavilion are decorated with burgundy, mustard yellow, and ecru stripes.  Rugs are scattered across the ground, though here and there tufts of grass are visible where the seams just barely overlap.  Carefully positioned lanterns illuminate the wares that are for sale on the low mahogany tables.

title: [Bloodriven Village - Urchin Hideout]
description: This is a fake room used to hold wayto/timeto for urchin guides.

title: [Tome Raiders]
description: Dust particles dance in the slivers of sunlight that filter through the aged windows, casting a subdued glow upon the room's contents.  A sprawling wooden table, worn with the marks of countless readers, dominates the center, its surface adorned with stacks of weathered tomes and delicate monocles.  Adjacent to it sits a glass display case, its contents illuminated by a single nightshade purple candle.

title: [Paranormal Pages]
description: Floating like clouds against an inky black sky, frosted orbs of magical light hover against the dark canvas of the pavilion and provide a soft glow that illuminates the tidy shop's wares.  Tables covered in pristine white cloths stretch across angled walls, while geometric-patterned carpets cover the ground with their warm colors and hypnotic designs.  Curtain ties hold the flaps of the pavilion open, providing a flow of air and a view of the streets of Bloodriven.

title: [Volatile Storage]
description: Large mounds of what can only be called junk are haphazardly strewn around the interior of this shop, and the areas of floor which remain visible are covered with multicolored stains of various hues.  A narrow window sits high up on one wall, though it is so heavily encrusted with greasy soot that it only provides meager illumination at best.  Pitted bronze hooks are strewn around the walls at irregular heights and intervals.

title: [Rhuik's Armory]
description: Beneath an oak-framed ceiling, a pair of wooden snowshoes hangs on one of the pale ivory plaster walls.  A lacquered wooden shelf and a low wrought iron table sit in opposite corners while a polar bear rug rests on a polished oak floor.

title: [Ouna's Weaponry]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of a plain tile floor.  There is a clawfooted cherrywood table on one side of the shop and a badly scarred oak counter on the other.

title: [Vornavis, Small Forest]
description: The road bends sharply around a small tree-covered hillock, pitching a gradual slope to accommodate the rise and fall of the landscape.  Thick underbrush along each side has been cut well back from the edges of the trail.  The sparse forest lining each side provides some lovely glimpses of the surrounding area, as travelers traverse through the woods.

title: [Vornavis, Small Forest]
description: Rising up over the top of a hill, this vantage point creates a slight clearing, affording a peek over the treetops.  To the northeast, a shadowy stone tower sits off in the distance, its crenellated design evident.  Wagon ruts are dug deep into the trail, commemorating the many travelers who have, at one time or another, stopped here to rest and catch the view.

title: [Vornavis, Winding Road]
description: The edge of the forest meets this winding road, wandering around several small hillocks, and a fresh breeze rustles leaves while gently caressing the countryside.  A dark stone keep sits high atop a rocky outcropping at the end of the road.

title: [Vornavis, Keep Bridgehead]
description: The soft sounds of a thin rushing river only hint at the power that must have cut the deep chasm that surrounds the walled keep sitting at this fork in the road.  Spanning the gap over the roiling water is a wooden drawbridge, supported by thick chains connecting it to a massive twin-turreted watchtower.  The grey stone walls of the keep stand in mute defense against any enemy from without.

title: [Vornavis, River Trail]
description: A foot trail travels alongside the gorge, surrounding an impressive keep standing on the far side of the river, its grey stone walls and brown thatched roofs faded from weather and time.

title: [Vornavis, River Trail]
description: Climbing a small rise, the trail ends in a tiny clearing, the sound of the river becoming slower as it widens.  Downstream, the water gradually splays outward, growing flat and sluggish, with the keep painting a picturesque sight standing tall alongside the reflective river.

title: [Vornavis, Small Beach]
description: Winding back and forth to avoid outcroppings of wet and slippery rocks from the splashing of the river, a tiny path leads down to a small cozy beach situated along a bend in the river.  Surrounded by three logs, the cold remains of a fire lie in a rough pit, and an unrecognizable charred bone rests upon the grey ashes mingled with bits of black charcoal.

title: [Turamzzyrian Academy, Keep]
description: Two heavy linked iron chains slip through a series of pulleys and wrap around a huge windlass, all covered in a heavy layer of grease and grime.  A number of curious dark small holes pierce the ceiling of the entry area.  Past a closed and rusted out black iron portcullis is an open central courtyard, while an old oak drawbridge leads back out towards the merchant road.

title: [Vornavis, Small Beach]
description: Hugging the river's edge, a slender path dips in and out of the nearby shrubbery as it lazily leads in a roughly northerly direction up the river.  Large stones, smoothed by the passage of water, rise along the banks and create a small barrier from the rapidly moving current as it dramatically dips to the south.  Lichen, moss, and ferns are prevalent here, their thick roots making the banks firm and durable.

title: [Vornavis, Sandy Dune]
description: Pale white sands glitter in the golden light of the day, their ultra fine grade causing them to sparkle ever so slightly when the sun's rays fall upon them.  Shrubs and underbrush fall away from a craggy slope, which leads up and away from the river to the south.  Conifers and oaks spread outward from the area, their leafy expanses making it difficult to see very far.

title: [Vornavis, Hill Top]
description: Nearly as tall as the upper branches of the surrounding forest, the hill top provides an excellent view of the surrounding area.  To the south, the river tumbles by at a stately pace through the berry-laden underbrush, while to the east the trees pay homage to a grassy plain where a dilapidated stone castle basks in the sun.  Though steep, the slope provides access to a game trail that heads back into the Cairnfang Forest.

title: [Vornavis, Grassy Plain]
description: Tall and unshorn, yellow and green blades of grass rise from the fertile soil and bend beneath the sporadic breezes that sweep across the plains.  Violets and baby's breath rise amid the verdant blades to add a spot of color to the largely molten expanse, while dark shadows along the edge of the plain hint at trees in the distance.  Narrow and winding, a game trail leads through the grass towards a hill to the south and a shadowy castle to the north.

title: [Vornavis, Grassy Plain]
description: Tall as a halfling, the yellow and green blades of grass rise in a perimeter around this small clearing, which is comprised of moss and packed dirt.  A tangled thicket of chokeberry briars occupies the western edge and stands as guardian over a large rabbit hole.  Dipping in and out of the clearing, a narrow track slowly ambles away from the area.

title: [Vornavis, Grassy Plain]
description: Verdant and earthy, the area is filled with dark green blades of grass that rise as tall as the average halfling.  Feathery tops slip from their protective sheaths within each bladed tendril and spill large quantities of seeds upon the moss-covered ground.  Long shadows stretch across the area from the incredibly high walls of the hedges that rise to the east.

title: [Academy, Topiary Entrance]
description: Overgrown and wild, the hedges that rise out of the ground to create an imposing wall seem oddly out of place in the middle of the plains.  Scraggly tendrils reach outward like the spectral hands of some long forgotten ancestor, while a wild profusion of green, orange, and yellow leaves dimples the expanse.  Nearly choked by the untamed mass of vegetation is a small iron gate, which provides entry to the grounds.

title: [Academy, Topiary Maze]
description: Bisecting the overgrown topiary neatly in half, a jagged fracture lined with rough limestone blocks provides egress from the maze.  Thick strands of clinging ivy hug the various pieces and fairly choke the space with their broad leaves.  Small and large evergreens extend their feathery fingers across the area creating a shadowed environment that keeps the ambient light from completely penetrating.

title: [Academy, Topiary Maze]
description: The tall hedges have been pruned back to form a smooth pathway within the maze.  Encroaching ivy has been trimmed away, leaving scattered gaps along the high herbaceous walls.  A finely carved marble fountain has been set in the middle of this path, the bright sun reflecting off the crystal clear water flowing from its peak.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south

title: [Academy, Topiary Maze]
description: Bright white mistletoe berries peek out from atop the tall hedges they have invaded.  Twisting ivy vines curl between the exposed roots, the foliage dusted with tiny clumps of moist soil from recent tending.  Large, broken seashells, firmly imbedded into the smooth dirt path, crunch underfoot as visitors pass through.

title: [Academy, Topiary Maze]
description: The row of hedges suddenly widens, exposing a fragrant rosemary topiary in the middle of the pathway.  A pair of canver trees planted to either side intertwine, forming an arch overhead and showering the ground with snowy white petals.  A fat bumblebee perches lazily among the foliage.  Sunlight glitters off something within the branches of the carefully clipped rosemary.

title: [Academy, Topiary Maze]
description: The boxwoods continue their enigmatic path, blocking any view of what lies ahead.  Somewhere within the foliage, a pair of squirrels chitter angrily, as though they too cannot decide which path to take.  Along the ground, sunlight touches the glossy leaves of a creeping periwinkle, its purple flowers adding color within the greenery.

title: [Academy, Topiary Maze]
description: Gaps have formed in the hedge where branches have been damaged from lost maze wanderers trying to push through the foliage.  Small holes through the bushes show the other side of the hedge leading down a different path.   A large spiderweb, the sunlight shimmering off its strands, has been woven within the foliage.

title: [Academy, Topiary Maze]
description: Towering boxwood plants stand over ten feet tall, twisting and turning along the path ahead.  Strands of ivy weave among the branches, climbing their way towards the top.  Sunlight shines off the evergreen leaves as small insects scurry upon them.
