paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest

title: [Academy, Lower Bailey]
description: Wide and uneven, the entryway to the keep arches high above and is covered in a yellowish-white, chalky substance that exudes a foul stench.  The once firmly packed ground of the courtyard is now pockmarked with small and large holes where pieces of stone and gravel have broken free.  Directly north is the courtyard and keep tower, and an old oak drawbridge is visible past a closed and rusted out black iron portcullis.  An east-west passage traverses the wall that surrounds the Academy.

title: [Academy, Lower Bailey]
description: Displaying visible signs of disrepair, a lofty tower of mottled grey stone rises from the roof of the keep in the center of the open courtyard.  Breached only by a riverstone ashlar arch, the keep's tower rises far above the walls that enclose it and has far fewer missing stones in its safe.  The surrounding grounds are filled with tumbleweeds, broken tree limbs, and a variety of chipped stones, which all lie amid large tufts of greasy feathers.

title: [Academy Keep, Great Hall]
description: Towering walls of fitted stone line this spacious hall, arcing inward near the top to form the vaulted ceiling above.  Shredded tapestries and faded wall-hangings of purple and gold hang in tattered streamers from the walls among long ribbons of dust-laden spider's webs.  Tables and chairs, splintered and unserviceable, are piled in a large heap near the arch, while a sideboard, still draped in old festival streams, leans precariously near a small passageway cut into the rear wall.

title: [Keep Tower, Library]
description: Clogged with the rotted remains of books, parchments, and scrolls, the solid monir bookcases that enclose the once great library are stained with mold and swollen with fetid water.  Broken tables and chairs lie in shambles about the space and are draped in blankets fashioned of cobwebs and dust.  Resting in the clear space at the center of the room is a polished silver tray laden with the remains of some long ago offering.

title: [Keep Tower, Sitting Room]
description: Despite the warm golden glow of sunlight that streams in through the ashlar-framed bow window the sitting room is chilly and the air is rank with the smell of stagnant water.  Once plush chairs, now shredded and devoid of their stuffing, stand skeletal around the room in a semicircle.  Using the wall as a support, a three-legged oak sideboard draped with a moldy covering teeters under a load of rotting food.

title: [Academy, Upper Bailey]
description: Several warped wooden barrels lean against the rear wall of the keep, their sides broken and their rotting contents spilling upon the uneven cobblestones of the courtyard.  Dark watermarks stain the walls around passage that has been cut into the wall of the keep tower.  The skeletal remains of a canine lie in a heap of rotted hides not far from the small entry.

title: [Academy, Northern Wall]
description: Weeping with moisture, the stone wall is heavy with moss and black mold due in part to the rotting remains of an old stone well sitting nearby.  The peaked wood roof of the structure has rotted away, and the dowel has broken from the crank, leaving no sign of the old rope and bucket.

title: [Academy, Northwest Corner]
description: The corner here is dark and damp, with much of this section of wall cracked and splitting, and the arch slightly misshapen yet still standing tall.  The carefully cut stones of the peaked opening are a light green in color, and carved on each are intricate patterns of small trees and flowers.

title: [Academy, Orchard Garden]
description: Overgrown huckleberry bushes create a wild border around a small orchard of dead fruit trees.  Climbing strawberry vines cling to an arched opening and threaten to choke the space with their reaching tendrils.  Rotted berries, oranges, apples, and pears linger on the ground where they have fallen due to being left too long on the limb.  The scent of their soft bodies rotting upon the ground fills the air with oddly sweet, bitter perfume.

title: [Academy, Western Wall]
description: Crenellated walls rise imposingly high above the unshorn lawn and create a bit of a windbreak from the gusty coastal breezes.  Holes in the wall are filled with straw, yarn, and other bits of organic material to create bird houses within the structure, though a great many of them have given over to fungus and molds due to the lingering moisture in the area.

title: [Academy, Western Wall]
description: Flat and remarkably smooth, the grounds near the wall are littered with broken limbs, brambles, and other debris that passing storms have thrown over the wall.  Covered in a blanket of moss, the remains of a small wooden lean-to rests to one side and defiantly stands against the test of time.  Bottomless buckets, some shattered and others missing their handles, lie in a jumbled heap amid wild patches of overgrown grasses and newly sprouted brambles.

title: [Academy, Southwest Corner]
description: Filled with mortar and loose stones, a jagged scar runs down the face of the wall where a previous repair has rotted away.  Large and small bits of the upper crenellation have fallen free and clog the walking space, though it manages to still be passable.  Green stone set into an arched opening has a sheen of yellowish moisture upon it, which enhances the intricately carved staff entwined by two roses that decorates the lintel.

title: [Academy, Rose Garden]
description: Cloyingly sweet, the scent of roses fills the air and occupies every single space within the garden.  Thick, cord-like vines choke the swing and benches to such a degree that they actually hold them several handspans above the ground and make them impossible to utilize.  Dark petals decorate the overgrown grass within the small garden and are thickest near an arched opening.

title: [Academy, Southern Wall]
description: Rotting piles of old hay lie in blackened heaps against the wall, their thick depths filling the air with the scents of mildew and decay.  A downed hitching post lies at the water-warped feet of several other posts, their ropes frayed and unusable.  Here and there, a stray stone has tumbled free from the wall and trampled the overgrown grasses.

title: [Academy, Southern Wall]
description: Thick blades of overgrown grass sway sporadically in the errant coastal breezes, their seed-laden heads filling the air with a wheaty scent that is a reprieve from the rot of most areas of the keep.  Faint trails, where once travelers roamed, still mark the area beneath the watchful gaze of the wall, though they are interrupted by the various stones that have tumbled free of their nesting places.

title: [Academy, Southeast Corner]
description: The cracks between each of the stones in the ashlar walls are carefully filled with a yellowish green chalky substance.  An arched opening is crowned by a single green stone which has a small carving of a man sitting on a log, his elbow resting on his knee and his chin resting on his hand.

title: [Academy, Meditation Garden]
description: Faded wildflowers and tufts of grass sprout from beneath a bed of pine needles carpeting the secluded garden.  In a circular hollow rests an old stone well, shaded by the overhanging branches of nearby oak and tanik trees.  Aged wooden benches near an arched opening provide weary travelers a spot to relax and meditate.

title: [Academy, Eastern Wall]
description: Small cages with wooden slats lie stacked along the walls of the keep, each with a bit of straw lining the bottom and a small slatted door.  The ground is also covered in a light sprinkle of straw, hiding the stray pieces of grass poking their way to daylight.

title: [Academy, Eastern Wall]
description: Surrounded by a precariously stacked pile of broken buckets, a long wooden tub filled with fetid water nestles against the lea of the wall.  Blackened grasses provide a blanket around the structure, while yellowish tufts stand out at odd angles on the opposite side of the path.

title: [Academy, Northeast Corner]
description: Here, a small section of wall has shifted slightly, as if pushed up from beneath.  While still complete, it leans outward noticeably.  A large greenish stone with a carving of a bear and a tiger standing side by side sits on the peaked arch of a small opening.

title: [Academy, Topiary Garden]
description: Clogged by overgrown topiaries, a jagged fracture in the outer wall provides egress from the academy's grounds, while an arched opening surrounded by wild bushes leads deeper inside.  Large bushes, vaguely resembling the shape of bear, monkey, tiger, and dolphin stand guardian over the grounds, their bushy heads and elongated limbs giving them a wild and crazed cast.  Lying upon the ground within a wire frame is the remains of a once regally sculpted ki-lin bush.

title: [Academy, Northern Wall]
description: Leaning against the wall are various sized iron bands and stacks of thin pieces of wood.  Nearby, a low and sturdy circular block sits surrounded by small piles of wood shavings.

title: [Keep Tower, Stairwell]
description: Slabs of carved grey granite set in a spiral traverse this stairwell, wide enough to carry whole groups of people up and down the generous steps.  Small slit windows allow for a glimpse of the countryside, as slender beams of pale light barely illuminate glittering mica in the stone.  A fine layer of dust hangs over the thick iron chain that has been bolted to the walls, lending the area an unkempt appearance that is at odds with the view from the windows.

title: [Keep Tower, Corridor]
description: Thin shafts of light slip through the arrow loops set into the outer walls, their metallic parts missing where some previous looter has tugged them free.  All around, the ashlar walls that line the corridor display the pock-marked appearance of a surface that have been given over to dust and grim.  Slanted arches rise above a light sun-faded oak door and a dark shadowed oak door, which flank the landing.

title: [Keep Tower, Corridor]
description: The passage looks much like the other corridors in the keep tower, the sense of strange familiarity reinforced by the identical doors and arrow loops present in the same exact locations on each level.

title: [Keep Tower, Corridor]
description: Any sense of climbing up or down is disoriented as this corridor appears to be a perfect match to the other floors above and below.  The sliver of a view out an arrow loop is the only way to tell in which direction you might be heading.

title: [Keep Tower, Corridor]
description: Though shorter in length as the tower rises, this corridor is much the same as the others.  A small arched open window is set into the wall where the arrow loop would normally go.

title: [Keep Tower, Corridor]
description: Light filters in from the arched opening at one end of the corridor, a surprising change from the previous levels.  The same two doors -- one hidden near the shadow of the stairs leading down, the other opposite an arrow loop -- are the only embellishment to the otherwise plain ashlar walls.

title: [Keep Tower, Rooftop]
description: Next to an arched opening stands a wooden guard post offering an astounding view of the surrounding area.  From the top of the narrow roof on the keep tower, you can see the rolling hills to the southwest as they gradually blend into a flatter, slowly wavering countryside at the outflow of the river basin.  Glancing north, the land rises, becoming majestic mountains that stand tall and mighty, rising high into the sky.

title: [Keep Tower, Vornavis Room]
description: Chipped and scratched, a panoramic fresco surrounds the room and depicts the cliffs of Vornavis as they lead downward towards the coast.  Cobwebbed strands drop from the center of the ceiling and attach to the lifelike protrusions of the illustrations, their diaphanous ends trailing into the open spaces.  Above each of the three niches set into the walls is a small enameled crest.

title: [Vornavis Room, East Niche]
description: Heavy curtains of cobwebs drape across the circular copper shield that is fitted into the worn stones of the wall, the tattered skeins dangling to dust-littered floor.  Empty sconces, blackened with the remains of burn-out torches, flank a glass and brass display case along another wall, while the remaining two display faded squares where portraits may once have been displayed.

title: [Vornavis Room, West Niche]
description: Faded cobalt blue paint decorates the walls, while a border of Solhaven Bay scallop shells rings the room near the dusty ceiling.  Faded pennants hang from the rafters amid brass-wrapped lanterns and a thick carpet of Vornavian silk covers the cobbled floor.  Leaning against a broken weapon stand is a glass and brass display case.

title: [Vornavis Room, North Niche]
description: Thick skeins of dust-laden webs slant across the rough stone walls of the corridor, their pallid tendrils swaying as the air beneath them is disturbed.  Tattered and faded, an ochre and pale green banner presides over a glass and brass display case.  Debris, comprised of discarded rodent bones and moldy papers, litters the floor, which is covered with a hole-riddled carpet of faded silk.

title: [Keep Tower, Hendor Room]
description: Cloudy crystals rise in shards from the cobblestone floor to form the image of a frozen witch of unsurpassed beauty.  Fragments of the the sculpture have broken free and tumbled into the dusty ground along a single line that divides the room in two distinct portions.  Affixed to the wall above the eastern niche is a small shield-shaped device, while a small tattered banner rests above the western niche.

title: [Hendor Room, East Niche]
description: Azure paint peels from the ceiling in long stripes, which are caught by the thick layers of cobwebs that cling to the corners of the room.  Splintered wood is collected in a thick pile on the northern wall opposite a blackened circle on the southern wall where someone tried to start a fire.  Pushed against the eastern wall, a glass and brass display case appears to be unscathed by the long ago blaze.

title: [Hendor Room, West Niche]
description: Blue and crimson enameled wings decorate the bronze body of an enormous phoenix, which is affixed to the eastern wall.  Though much of its magnificent plumage is missing, as well as the jewels that once rested in its eyes, the gaze of the fiery bird falls upon a glass and brass display case that is placed in the center of the room.  With no windows to aid in the circulation of air, the niche smells stagnant with dust.

title: [Keep Tower, Aldora Room]
description: Surrounded by washed out curtains of crushed velvet, a trio of cloudy windows of stained glass stand guard over niches recessed into the walls.  Pale outlines on the blocky stone walls have large nails in the center, evidence that artwork once was displayed there.  High over head, a cracked candelabra dangles from a frayed rope, its candles scattered and broken upon the floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Aldora Room, South Niche]
description: Pure white shields, slightly greyed with dust, hang from the tops of the walls to create a decorative metallic border and provide ample purchase for spiders to build their silken nests within.  Cracked orbs dangle from rusted chains above a glass and brass display case.

title: [Aldora Room, East Niche]
description: Fragments of broken glass litter the floor of the niche, their painted hues faded and cloudy with dust.  Sun-bleached walls hold darker squares where tapestries once hung and have been replaced with curtains of spider webs.  The focal point of the room is a glass and brass display case.

title: [Aldora Room, West Niche]
description: Shredded tapestries, the victim of some rodent, hang in long lengths from the walls, their once resplendent threads now dingy and mildewed.  Painted roses decorate the spaces between, though each bloom is chipped where the paint has peeled away.  Pushed against one wall, a glass and brass display case holds court over dust bunnies and bluebird feathers.

title: [Aldora Room, North Niche]
description: Shattered furniture, tattered tapestries, and fractured windows litter the niche with their broken and misshapen shapes.  Chains dangle from above to support candelabra that are devoid of votives and creak as the air moves through the space.  Heavy layers of dust cover the floor, though a set of footprints in the thick debris leads towards a glass and brass display case that has been pulled free of the litter.

title: [Keep Tower, Honneland Room]
description: Azure walls, painted with fluffy clouds, meet the dark green floors, which are littered with dust bunnies and bits of straw.  In the center of the room a replica of the famed silver well stands in disrepair, its sides missing several stones and its rope missing its bucket.  A small taxidermy doe lies on its side in the dust, its vacant eyes gazing at the eastern niche.

title: [Honneland Room, East Niche]
description: Perfumed with mildew and mold, the niche is layered with the remains of several decomposing scrolls, while nearby a rotted bookcase spills its warped shelves upon the floor.  Upon one wall, a tapestry depicting purple lances on a field of silver holds court over a glass and brass display case.

title: [Honneland Room, West Niche]
description: Devoid of glass, a nearby window allows the elements to spill into the room causing deep black mold to spring to life upon the squared rocks of the walls that surround it.  Here and there, painted fragments outlined in flattened pewter wire rise out of the dull carpeting, their murky depths difficult to discern.  Though tarnished, a glass and brass display case appears largely undamaged where it rests at the entry to the niche.

title: [Honneland Room, North Niche]
description: Devoid of all furnishings, save for a single brass display case, the niche is mostly free of debris and cobwebs.  Deep gouges in the floor display the clear sign that something large and heavy has been dragged from the area, though what it was remains a mystery.

title: [Keep Tower, Selantha Room]
description: Faded tapestries progress from one end of the room to the other, the worn stitching telling the tale of Gor'nustre's refusal of Selantha's emissaries, the subsequent caravan massacre, and ending with the war against the Kannalan Alliance.  Several niches have been built into the remaining walls, their arched entries draped with dust-filled webs.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Selantha Room, East Niche]
description: Dusty images decorate the cobblestone walls of the niche, the faded paint creating the image of a harbor filled with ships.  One ship stands out among the rest because of its black sails and the red flag that it flies.  A glass and brass display case sits in the center of the room and has several skeins of webbing that stretch from its brass edges to the nearby walls.

title: [Selantha Room, West Niche]
description: Filled with cobwebs and a fine layer of dirt, the niche bears the resemblance of an abandoned jeweler's shop.  Workbenches line the walls and are covered with forgotten tools of the trade.  A glass and brass display case rests at the heart of the room upon an oddly shaped sanguine stain.

title: [Selantha Room, North Niche]
description: Table and chair legs are scattered across the cobblestones of the floor and mingle with torn seat covers and shattered glass.  Blankets of dust and spider's webs attempt to hide the destroyed pieces but only add to the general gloom of the area.  Thick scratches upon the walls mingle with ribbons of color, while tiny chips of paint decorate the floor.

title: [Selantha Room, South Niche]
description: Glass fragments and shredded tapestries decorate the dark niche, which is covered in layers upon layers of heavy dust.  Skeins of grey and brown cobwebs dangle from the ceilings and create a gossamer halo above a glass and brass display case.

title: [Keep Tower, Bourth Room]
description: Pale sandstone has been carved into a model of the first Voln monastery, as first encountered outside of Kedshold, long before the fall of the city to Selantha's armies and its razing by fire.  Large cracks appear in the piece, many of which have tumbled onto the floor, but much of it is still whole.  A pair of niches flanks the occupied space.

title: [Bourth Room, East Niche]
description: Several totem poles encircle the niche, their carved faces depicting a variety of animals.  Though their paint has long since faded, and many of them are missing their upper pieces, the carvings are relatively preserved.  The most prominent figure amid the dusty collection is that of the bear.

title: [Bourth Room, West Niche]
description: Dark green walls give the dust-covered room a murky, overcast appearance despite the faint light that filters in from the main room to the east.  Empty bookcases and vacant chairs clutter the room with dark shadows, while a glass and brass display case rests beneath a curtain of cobwebs.

title: [Keep Tower, Riverwood Room]
description: Ripped velvet pads the six placards that decorate the walls of the room, though the bare display hooks give no hint at what might have been displayed.  Cryptic etchings, visible beneath the layer of dust, are written in a concise hand, but no evidence of who the creator was is available within the tiny room.  Twin niches flank the room.

title: [Riverwood Room, East Niche]
description: Splintered beyond repair, an ebonwood banister inlaid with golden filigree hangs precariously from its mounting bracket upon one end of a rotted staircase that lies in splinters around the room.  Narrow windows shed small amounts of moonlight upon a glass and brass display case, which is half hidden in inky darkness below.

title: [Riverwood Room, West Niche]
description: Decorated with antlers and covered with bowls of wax fruit, the crude altar is blanketed in a layer of dust and cobwebs.  Faded paintings depicting a forest in moonlight encircle the room, each with the image of a spirit haloed in a nimbus of azure.

title: [Keep Tower, Torre Room]
description: Deep blue walls, painted the color of the sea off the coast along River's Rest, have been carefully rendered to make it appear as though one is adrift.  On one side of the room, Fairport's wharf has been carefully rendered in mirror image, giving the illusion you are viewing the city's busy port reflected in the water.  A trio of niches has been built into the remaining walls.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Torre Room, South Niche]
description: Shadows play across the cobbled walls of the niche but only serve to enhance the gloom of the mostly lightless area.  Faint lines in the dust that lingers on the floor show where furniture once stood, while empty sconces gaze vacantly upon a glass and brass display case resting near the entry of the niche.

title: [Torre Room, West Niche]
description: Faint light flickers across the area from a single torch housed in the curving arch of the niche, though most of the room remains deeply entrenched in shadows.  Long strands of cobwebs attached to the ceiling stretch across a white stork-adorned banner, which is hung near a glass and brass display case.  Stagnant and cloying, the air tastes of dust and smells of decay.

title: [Torre Room, East Niche]
description: Faded with age, the sweeping mural that covers the western wall is missing several sections of imagery where the paint has separated from the stone.  Curls of paint and lacquer mingle upon the dusty floor amid the tattered ruins of a faded carpet of pale blue.  A copper-sided display case upon the eastern expanse rests beneath iron sconces that are devoid of glass and candle.

title: [Torre Room, North Niche]
description: Grafted to the wall with heavy iron brackets is an enormous whale bone that has been carved in the sailor's style of scrimshaw.  Heavy footlockers, mostly the type used by sailors, are arranged through the niche and though the padlocks are still in place, the sides have been chewed out by some kind of large rodent.

title: [Keep Tower, Seareach Room]
description: Swathes of dust-heavy cobwebs fall in lengths across the darkened room, which is surrounded by dozens of tapestries that depict similar scenes.  Several lacquered masts, each hung with a different flag, are arranged through the room and are labeled with the names of historical vessels.

title: [Seareach Room, East Niche]
description: Coarse, sand-covered stones lend the niche a windswept appearance that once might have been decorative, but is now filled with small skittering bugs and piles of waste.  Painted patterns in a strange blue hue are faded upon the wall, the long skeins of silky webs littered with bug-filled cocoons blocking any ability to discern their meaning.  Standing guard upon the path that leads to and from this section of the niche is a glass and brass display case.

title: [Seareach Room, West Niche]
description: Pale blue limestone blocks brighten the upper sections of the niche's walls, while the lower section is finished with a sand to create the image of beach dunes.  Though dust lingers on every surface, a fair amount of glittering gold sands is mingled with the debris.

title: [Keep Tower, Research]
description: Collapsed shelves draped in blankets of dust lean against their casings, the moldy remains of their once esteemed passengers lay in tattered shreds at their clawed feet.  Chair stuffing is scattered about the room in old clumps that resemble matted nests, while the splintered remains of a table has been pushed firmly against one wall.  Watermarks upon the southern wall glisten with new moisture and lend the small space a fetid, mildewed scent.

title: [Research, East Niche]
description: Devoid of all furnishings, save for a glass and brass display case pushed against the eastern wall, the small niche seems unscathed by the destruction displayed in other parts of the tower.  Dust bunnies have collected in the corners and a fine layer of soot has settled over the cobblestones causing the scene to resemble a meadow beneath new-fallen snow.

title: [Research, West Niche]
description: Dappled light leaks into the small niche from a strange crystal wedged into the arch that leads into the primary room.  Faint streaks of a greenish-yellow hue give the room a sickly cast, which is only enhanced by the foul smells that rise from a pile of decaying books along the western wall.

title: [Keep Tower, Imperial Halls]
description: Tattered banners hang from the rafters of the ceiling, their colors faded and their lengths so mutilated that it is difficult to discern what they may once have had emblazoned on their silky faces.  Dust and mold lay heavy upon the warped and broken furnishings of the room and the heavy, cloying aroma of ammonia fills the air.

title: [Imperial Halls, Trauntor Halls]
description: Tinged with layers of dust, the walls of the small hall still display their proud, dark green hues, while the slender towers that are built into the southeastern and northeastern corners also maintain a modicum of their black enamel.  Each tower has decorative crenellations at its peak, while their bases are fitted with iron-barred doors of slightly warped oak.

title: [Academy, Dragach Halls]
description: Dust-heavy spiderwebs cling to the burgundy walls of the hall, their laden tendrils falling in thick streamers that stick to every surface.  Painted in alternating patterns, bighorn rams and curled horns decorate the upper edges of each wall, though their hues and metallic spirals are faded and dull.  A large wooden plaque, dirty and bare of anything to exhibit, presides over a glass and brass display case along the western wall.

title: [Academy Prizes]
description: Eerily still, the darkness surrounding this platform shimmers in its infinite depths.  A large slate table sits in the center of the room surrounded by cobblestone pavers.  The golden fence surrounding the nexus is crested with elongated spikes, each painstakingly polished.

title: [Trader's Refuge, Storeroom]
description: Austere and cramped, the storeroom is lined on two sides with wooden shelving holding stock to be sold.  Through the middle of the room, a simple cotton rug provides some covering for the rough hewn wood floor as a silver-latticed lantern overhead provides lighting.  Against the back wall, a set of stairs leads up to a carved oak doorway, while a gilded ironwood chest rests upon a small platform in the open space beneath them.
location: Trader's Refuge, inside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [Trader's Refuge, Apartment]
description: Bright and airy colors in this room counterbalance the darkly stained oak floors and dim light filtering in through a white linen-curtained window flanked by a pair of sconces. On opposite walls, a carved white door and a carved light blue door lead to adjoining rooms while the center is devoted to entertaining guests.  A pair of soft leather couches and a whitewashed driftwood table serve as a comfortable seating area, while a large glass aquarium divides it from the entry area.
location: Trader's Refuge, inside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [Trader's Refuge, Bedroom]
description: The darkly stained, white oak flooring of this bedroom is relieved by the white shiplap walls and exposed beam ceiling of this inviting room.  Atop a tonal blue wool rug, which covers most of the floor, rests a large feather-stuffed bed and a footbench with a rope-hung brass chandelier suspended overhead.  On the opposite wall, a small antique dresser sits between two diamond-grid windows with a polished silver mirror hung above it.
location: Trader's Refuge, inside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [Trader's Refuge, Bath]
description: Atop a smooth marble floor rests a white claw-foot bath flanked on either side by a wash cloth basket and a small wood table to hold various sundries.  Behind the bath, a sea blue tile wall rises from floor to ceiling to accent the room's otherwise plain white walls.  In the corner, a pair of brass lanterns hanging next to a round glass washbowl provide a soft glow to the space, the oil releasing a sweet orange blossom aroma when it burns.
location: Trader's Refuge, inside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [Trader's Refuge, Kitchen]
description: White marble floors and cabinets serve as a backdrop for several colorful touches in the kitchen.  An island with a soft blue base and grey marble countertop provides a convenient place for prepared food and drinks to be served.  Behind it, a countertop with a white wash basin and enameled stove serves as a food preparation area while a silver filigree bin sits to the side.  Overhead, a delicate silver chandelier provides illumination over the workspace and island.
location: Trader's Refuge, inside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [Trader's Refuge, Study]
description: The darkly stained white oak flooring from the living quarters continues into this study where a carved mahogany desk and velvet-backed chair dominate the center of the room.  Behind the desk, a large city map has been hung on the bright blue wall between a pair of sconces.  The walls on either side of the desk are lined with white bookcases containing books dedicated to various historical and nautical pursuits.
location: Trader's Refuge, inside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [Maliku's Combat Gear]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Maliku's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Maliku's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Emberthorn Refuge, Glade]
description: Sunlight filters through upturned, twisting branches of ancient, moss-covered trees casting a diffused glow over the lush verdure of the glade.  Fragrant wildflowers mixed with a comforting earthy redolence permeates the air, while a waterfall sounds in the distance, the tinkling melody of rushing water adding to the tranquility.  A pathway of smooth stepping stones leads to a secluded woodland sanctuary constructed of airy canopies and sturdy platforms.

title: [Emberthorn Refuge, Threshold]
description: Connected by a series of raised, lantern-lit walkways, wooden platforms at varying heights are cloistered beneath native leafy canopies of liana-draped boughs.  Tubular, bronze-dipped wind chimes sway above a lacquered lacewood desk and matching chair, which are cleverly bowered amongst graceful branches.  An occasional butterfly drifts in and out, fluttering through patches of diffused sunlight.

title: [Emberthorn Refuge, Bowery]
description: Suspended from lofty, spreading branches overhead, great pendulous nests have been repurposed into comfortable seating, each lined with down-filled, silken pillows.  A firebowl carved from a half moon of rock is positioned in the center of the open air parlor.  Beyond the corner of the octagonal wooden platform, an arched passageway of intertwining lianas frames a picturesque waterfall fringed with bracken.

title: [Emberthorn Refuge, Nook]
description: Sheltered by a dense canopy of verdant umbrage, an elevated wooden platform affords an expansive view of the surrounding landscape, the western edge guarded by moss-covered trees resembling green giants with wrinkled bark faces.  A polished heartwood slab table flanked by a series of high-backed chairs is arranged atop floor mats woven from dried grasses, giving off a sweet aroma.  A seemingly floating staircase leads to a vine-enclosed platform farther above.

title: [Emberthorn Refuge, Platform]
description: Secluded behind drapes of interwoven vines, an oversized, downy feather bed nestled in a cradle of curving branches is situated in the center of a lofty platform overlooking a lush garden.  A near-perfect circular opening in the canopy overhead acts as a skylight, offering a glimpse beyond the verdurous sanctuary.  Thrown over a gnarled branch of a prodigious, hollow-trunk tree, a length of knotted rope dangles over the pooling water of a woodland waterfall below.

title: [Emberthorn Refuge, Garden]
description: Nestled between rhododendron and hemlock, a swift stream tumbles over a craggy ledge ten feet above the ground in a continuous waterfall, spilling into a rock-lined pool.  A knotted hemp rope dangles from a magnificent hollow-trunk tree hung with myriad glass orbs illuminating a pebbled path winding through creeping vines and overgrown roots.  Beneath a low-hanging limb, a roomy hammock of meshed twine fishing net offers needful repose amid the tuneful waters synchronized with buzzing insects and echoing birdsong.

title: [Elaienaran Haven, Garden]
description: Bordering one side of a small stone cottage, a stand of linden trees grows among a covering of painted ferns, their feathery foliage offering little shade from the sun above.  Along the other side, an ornate stone bird bath is placed by a thick hedgerow of honeyberry bushes.  Centered in the beautiful garden is a small grey stone pond flanked with twin wooden benches and surrounded by a light-pebbled walkway that branches off, leading up to a large glaesineth glasshouse.

title: [Elaienaran Haven, Glasshouse]
description: Rattan baskets filled with colorful blooms hang from the bronze frame of the large glasshouse.  Large panes of glaesineth create the ceiling, door, and walls of the structure, allowing warm sunlight to shine through the abundant greenery.  Raised beds, overflowing with a wide variety of flowering plants, line pebble walkways that wind throughout the building around a central counter strewn with various gardening tools.  Potted rose bushes are scattered about, adding to the kaleidoscope of color.

title: [Elaienaran Haven, Glasshouse]
description: Thick panes of glaesineth covered in moisture fit into sturdy bronze supports that form the structure of the glasshouse with a labyrinth of copper piping and wiring following the bracing.  A raised herb garden, filled with fragrant plants, lines the pebbled walkways, while narrow wooden counters of potted orchids dominate the outside of the space.  A large worktable rests against the back wall next to a mistwood and glaesineth door, while small braziers tucked into the corners keep the air heated.

title: [Elaienaran Haven, Salon]
description: Exposed beams of dark walnut support the lofted ceiling, their lengths reinforced with strips of dark bronze.  Thick ivory wool carpeting blankets the floor except for a small tiled area before a small ivory marble fireplace.  Centered in the room is a live-edge ash table surrounded by cushioned armchairs that face away from a mistwood and glaesineth door.  A ceramic bin of sticks rests to the side partially hidden by lengths of pale silk draped across a curtained archway.

title: [Elaienaran Haven, Chamber]
description: Vibrant pale ivory carpeting blankets the polished wooden floor of the private chamber.  Centered against one silk-covered wall opposite a silk curtained archway, a pair of small cherry tables set with dark beeswax candles flank a huge cherry estate bed piled high with rich azure pillows.  A dark pomegranate wardrobe rests next to a folding silk screen that partially conceals an elegant leaf-patterned faenor mirror hanging above an ivory marble basin.

title: [Elaienaran Haven, Study]
description: Centered in the far wall is a tall wooden bookshelf flanked by a pair of large arched windows.  A thick, ivory wool rug covers most of a dark walnut floor under a cherry-inlaid ash writing desk with a matching chair resting behind it.  Tucked into a corner on the far side of the room is a small cast iron stove with an etched top plate, a pair of azure velvet cushioned armchairs arranged around a carved table positioned in front.

title: [Ebonstone, Waterfront Suite]
description: Light streams in through a sweeping, curved window above a smooth driftwood seat tucked with colorful, palm-patterned silk pillows.  In the center, a large aquarium takes pride of place, its viewing enjoyed from several pale leather chairs and a low, sea glass-topped table arranged nearby.  A gauzy, ivory linen curtain is pulled to one side revealing a narrow opening in one wall, its surface washed in shades of pale blue and turquoise green.

title: [Ebonstone Manor, Lockers]
description: Behind a seashell-painted silk screen, woven rugs are scattered over a gleaming hardwood floor leading to a polished modwir counter.  An oval, sandstone-framed mirror hangs above a cushioned bench and small table topped with a painted terracotta planter.  Neatly stacked locker boxes take up one wall opposite an oil painting depicting a seaside town.

title: [Dewberry Room]
description: Thick ebon rolton wool covers the polished oak floor, its fibers woven into a geometric pattern.  A polished linden rocking chair rests to one side of a small round table.  A large bookcase dominates one wall while a granite blackboard covers another.  Fashioned from rough planks of wood is a small barrel that sits next to the arch leading to the hallway.

title: [Strawberry Room, Cubbyhole]
description: Small and cramped, this room ends with a dark curtain which is drawn shut.  Remants of old advertising slogans are painted onto the surface.  A small metal lever is imbedded into the wall.

title: [Dewberry Room, Lockers]
description: The grey stone walls are bare, except for brass wall sconces with candles burning cheerfully.  A woolly, rolton fur rug stretches out on the floor of this small room.

title: [The Seascape Lounge]
description: Gold veins in the polished white marble floor create a random pattern that is partially covered by a colorful woven sea grass carpet.  Several cushioned chairs are placed about a large riverstone fireplace, a small basket of sticks nearby.  Crafted from dark marble, a blackboard hangs above a small copper pot of leafy green ferns.  A pair of brass sconces is lit, their candles illuminate the room with a soft glow that reflects off the clear crystal walls of an aquarium.

title: [A Stone Chamber]
description: A single oil lamp hanging from the high vaulted ceiling illuminates the small oval chamber.  Smooth, gold-veined white marble walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Firmly bolted to the wall at one side of the room is a small, copper ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Lounge Lockers]
description: Warm light filters through the curtained opening, faintly illuminating the simple room.  Pink lines swirl over the surface of a smooth white marble counter that stands against one wall.

title: [Cairnfang Manor Lounge]
description: Sunlight floods into the room, gently diffusing through the numerous blown glass globes hanging in the expansive, wall-sized window, creating watery projections of blue light across the room.  A pillow-strewn window seat spans the width of the room, making a cozy place to rest with a far-reaching view of the treetops outside.  A peacock blue ceramic pot sits to one side, resting at the corner of a hand-painted canvas screen.

title: [Cairnfang Manor Lockers]
description: Carefully arranged across the floor are plush, powder blue carpets patterned with multicolored interlocking bubbles.  The rear wall of the chamber is comprised of numerous small, locked compartments.  For your convenience, your personal locker is placed on a low granite-topped counter.  On the wall opposite the counter hangs an oil painting rendered in vivid colors.

title: [Wave Dachre Chamber]
description: Several ivory couches are arranged atop woven sea green wool that covers the center of the smooth white marble floor.  A linden-framed oval mirror hangs above a large riverstone fireplace with a small basket of sticks stands ready next to the hearth.  Crafted with expert detailing, a beautiful dolphin statue seems to leap above a scrollworked pedestal.  A polished dark marble blackboard is positioned near the arch that leads into this room, a silver-edged driftwood medallion set at its apex.

title: [Darkened Chamber]
description: A single glaesine sconce attached to the wall illuminates the small chamber, casting a fitfully flickering light across the room's few features.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Dangling from a chain at one side of the room is a small mithglin ring.  At the far end of the chamber is an ivory curtain.

title: [Private Locker]
description: Jade green marble veined with cream covers the small amount of floor space, while pale oak paneling forms a modest wainscoting.  A white-on-cream figured silk covers the upper portion of the walls.

title: [Cairnfang Manor Annex]
description: Terracotta tiles of varying shades are set into the floor, their edges forming interwoven diagonal patterns, dark and light hues twinning.  A few potted ferns rest about the room between several benches, each cushioned with woven blue and green silk pillows.  Driftwood sculptures hang on either side of a small obsidian blackboard.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Nook]
description: Set back from the main room, the small nook is enclosed by panels of rough driftwood.  Terracotta tiles are set into the floor in a haphazard pattern with a tarnished brass lamp on the wall the only light source.  A runner of woven sea grass creates a cushioned walkway leading to a heavy beaded curtain.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Locker]
description: With the curtain closed behind you, all sound from outside the locker area has been hushed.  The driftwood counter is topped with deep green baize which shows little wear.

title: [Aquamarine Lounge]
description: Carved from granite, the floor is smooth and warm from underground heat currents.  A slate blackboard hangs from the wall opposite an arch that leads back to the hallway.  A large mistwood bookcase covers another wall, its shelves full of a variety of tomes and books.  Several iron sconces hang above an overstuffed couch.

title: [Aquamarine Lounge, Cubbyhole]
description: Dark grey stone lines the floor of this narrow, cramped space which ends abruptly at a curtain.  A small brass lever is set inside a small, recessed space in the wall.

title: [Aquamarine Lounge, Lockers]
description: Tiny and cramped, this small room is bare of decoration or comforts.  A small rock-carved counter covers one wall while a a rough leather curtain hangs on another.

title: [Cairnfang Manor Annex]
description: Two huge spotted pale green toadstools growing in a pair of stone pots illuminate the large, comfortable room with a pale tinted light.  A small granite table is centered on a woven sapphire blue carpet with several dark granite benches positioned about it.  Tucked behind one of the potted fungi is a wastebasket carved from solid rock.  On one wall a brass arch allows exit to the corridor outside, while on another a small blackboard hangs next to a wool curtain that leads to the locker area.

title: [Cairnfang Manor Annex, Locker]
description: A small swarm of fireflies flit about in a cylindrical cage hung from the granite ceiling.  Their blinking green and yellow glows softly illuminate this small room.  Though the marble walls are unadorned and the granite floor is uncarpeted, the room still provides a quiet place for contemplating the contents of your locker.

title: [House Annex, Cairnfang Manor]
description: Devoid of nearby furnishings, the western wall is painted royal blue and dominated by a mural depicting an open gem-infused hand, which is illuminated by the warm glow of several frosted glaesine globes anchored to the ceiling.  Plush royal blue carpeting dappled with white threads lends the otherwise austere space a coziness that is enhanced by the presence of an opalescent white organza settee.  A lacquered white door leads to the hallway, while a white-edged royal blue silk curtain provides access to the storage facilities.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: Ivory drapes hang upon the walls, their overly long lower edges pooling upon the soft rug that stretches from wall to wall.  The drape's silken lengths are unfettered except where they are parted to provide egress through a white-edged royal blue silk curtain.  A lacquered white linden counter sits in the center of the circular chamber, beneath the light of an enormous seaglass orb that is held aloft by a woven hemp basket.

title: [Erykk's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Melivn's Bountiful Booty]
description: Beneath an oak beam ceiling, a large Aenatumgana painting hangs on one of the pink plaster walls.  A narrow glass-topped table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the blonde oak floor.

title: [Melivn's Bountiful Booty]
description: Beneath an oak beam ceiling, a mounted fish skeleton hangs on one of the pink plaster walls.  A low wrought iron table sits in one corner while a bathing maiden statue rests on the blonde oak floor.

title: [Melivn's Bountiful Booty]
description: Beneath an oak beam ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the pink plaster walls.  A low wrought iron table sits in one corner while a suit of silver-chased armor rests on the blonde oak floor.

title: [Imperial Counting House, Entry]
description: Crowded but tidy, the customs house is home to many official services within the Comyner's Ward.  Stacks of crates and boxes waiting to be inspected have labels of lading attached to their faces, the inked markings nothing more than chicken scratch and patterns of repeating numbers.  A small accounting booth occupies one wall, a bored teller sitting behind its protective bars.

title: [Imperial County House, Exchange]
description: Dimly lit and cramped, the small hallway is stifling and warm.  Very little airflow makes its way through the passage as crates and boxes fill the eastern wall from floor to ceiling.  Illuminated from within, a small exchange booth houses a sleepy clerk.

title: [Imperial County House, Debts]
description: Smoking lanterns hang from hooks in the ceiling, their glass faces stained with soot and grim.  Separations in the clapboard walls allow the winds from the nearby coastline to sweep sand into the cramped hallway, creating a heavy patina of dust and grit that touches every surface.  Squinting through the bars of a small collections booth, a clerk decorated in spectacles watches the hallway with interest.

title: [Harbor's Harvest]
description: Multipaned circular windows dot the front wall, allowing fragmented beams of sunlight into the cozy but otherwise dimly lit shop.  Dozens of woven seagrass bee skeps dangle overhead, interspersed with ribbon-tied bundles of dried herbs.  Opposite the entrance, a high, slat-sided acacia counter blocks access into a rear doorway, but myriad rhimar-lined boxes and woven baskets can be glimpsed through the long, beaded strands curtaining it.

title: [Rylohk's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Granite Edge]
description: Wind-scarred walls of rugged granite form a high natural barrier around a deep valley nestled among the mountain range below.  Several rocks have been chiseled away into the shape of crude ramparts, giving the very peaks a castle-like appearance.

description: At the base of the slope is a narrow field that has been cluttered by hundreds of bones. The odor of death and blood emanate throughout the area, only stirred about by the wind from the passage above.

title: [The Ember Vale, Field of Tombs]
description: The valley opens wide, complete with swathes of verdant grass and low rocky platforms.  The dirt is stained black with blood in several spots, with faint trails leading away as if bodies were drug off by victorious predators.  The ground is littered with broken spearheads and arrows. title: [The Ember Vale, Worn Trail]
description: The granite trail here is weathered and trodden, but still uneven in many spots.  A broken-down cart has been abandoned to the side, its wheels splintered and unrepaired.

description: Carrots, turnips, and stalks of corn span the farms, growing up in neatly bordered beds of soil and dirt.  Rickety scarecrows stand watch like straw sentinels, their spindly arms stretched wide.

Tables and chairs are placed about, some of them more worn down than others.  The aromatic blend of spices and meat wafts through the area.

title: [The Ember Vale, Chapel]
description: Stained glass windows line the side walls of the large chapel, while the center of the church is filled with hand-carved wooden pews.  A large stage rests at the far back of the room with a tall wooden podium and a few sets of bagpipes resting in a corner.

title: [The Ember Vale, Garrison]
description: The stench of sweat and oiled metal has infused the area, and the ground holds crumpled piles of ruined armor plates.  Numerous cots fit along a wall, some even built into the wall with a connecting ladder to the floor.  A stained stew pot bubbles with the day's meal in the center of the room.

title: [The Ember Vale, Shaman Tent]
description: Thick canopies of black rolton hide are pulled tight to form the walls of the tent, with a singular curtain of bone beads leading out.  The ground is almost moist and black with old blood.  Piles of nibbled bones lie in a corner, flies buzzing around some gamey meat still clinging to greasy ligaments.  The air is heavy, almost suffocating.

title: [The Ember Vale, Inner Ring]
description: Bluish grey stone walls encompass the path, expanding in a ring that encapsulates the center of the settlement.  The faint aroma of smoked meats drifts in from nearby roads.

title: [The Ember Vale, Center Square]

title: [Magnificent Merchandise, Foyer ]
description: The foyer of this shop provides an illusion of standing in a great hall which is further enhanced by the gold-framed mirrors lining the walls between the ivory columns in the corners. The tall ceilings are framed by gold and blue draperies that pool onto the polished walnut floor.  Carved into the floor, and inlaid with pearl, is intricate scrollwork creating a neverending pattern of swirls.

title: [Magnificent Merchandise, Food]
description: Sitting prominently in the center of the room is a glass counter with each inner shelf lined in an intertwining of glaes and gold.  The aroma of bacon and other various meats, grease, and sweets fill the air.  Polished walnut flooring continues here and is shiny enough to reflect the gold silk-covered walls.

title: [Magnificent Merchandise, Music]
description: The polished black walnut flooring is offset by the gold-framed torches, whose flicker sets a somber, quiet tone.  The walls are covered in simple gold and blue splattered paint, as if the room is either not finished or it is a failed attempt at a more artistic approach.  Along the walls are glaes shelves, lined in pearls, allowing a simply elegant display for the musical instruments they hold.

title: [Wizard Guild, Library]
description: This long stretch of hall bears little more than three rows of towering bookshelves.  A number of staggered breaks in the expanse of book-laden shelves allows one the opportunity to move between rows, and occasionally a half-height bookshelf provides a potential place to rest some tomes.  Small globes of pale golden light hang from the ceiling at regular intervals, casting a soft but even glow throughout the hall.

title: [Cleric Guild, Shop]
description: Numerous candles are placed in small groupings along the walls, their warm glow lending an intimate light to the room.  A crystal-paned counter stands to the north, the wares within it gleaming softly as the flames waver.  Chests are positioned to either side of the counter, while several shelves line the walls above.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Acistira Pier]
description: Arched trellises of sable-washed wood ascend across the ebony-planked pier, the Nalfein ivy-entangled lattices engulfed in fragrant blooms of taerethil swept in hints of garnet.  A vine-framed haon sign hangs from the crossbeams, suspended from thin bronze chains alongside several spherical lanterns of merlot-colored glass.  Rectangular planters of blackened iron flank the edges of the pier, the stone and soil-filled containers covered in jewel-toned florals interspersed with vert foliage.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Acistira Pier]
description: A vine-framed haon sign is strung between the tall lattice-wrapped posts framing the ebony-planked pier, the pillars linked horizontally by a high-arcing ceiling of incarnadine roses veiled in curtains of dark green ivy.  Vertical racks of wrought copper flank each post, each filled with coils of rope, ledgers, and vial-filled crates contained behind panels of naefira-etched glass.  A bronze-caged lantern sits atop the racks, nestled between rolls of dark netting and a mahogany-slatted signal fan.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Acistira Pier]
description: Sculpted posts of marbled garnet stone flank the ebony-planked pier, each lantern-affixed column draped in coils of verdant ivy.  The vine-woven latticework arcs across the area, the flora-interspersed canopy suspending a vine-framed haon sign above the riveted dock, the rectangle swaying in the ambient breeze.  Acistira-branded footlockers of mahogany and leather are neatly stacked beside the posts, the containers draped in layers of netting skimming the floor below.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Acistira Pier]
description: Merlot-colored buoys crafted from mahogany casks frame the ebony pier, the hollow vessels bound with braided ropes leading up to the latticed arches canopying the dock in ivy-draped curtains.  A dual-wheeled wooden cart has been parked upright against the sable-trellised arch, the wood affixed to a framework of blackened iron.  Suspended from the lacquered crossbeams is a vine-framed haon sign, the placard chained to several lanterns of blown glass ensconced in bronze filigree.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Acistira Pier]

description: The tall lattice-curved arches frame the ends of the ebony-planked pier, the ivy-draped trellises suspending a vine-framed haon sign between the unfurling grey-washed roses.  A series of nautical maps sketched in vivid pigments are affixed to an ironwood board, protected by a panel of clear glass flanked by a duo of open signal fans.  A wrought silver-traced bench sits beside a stack of hemp-bound crates, the containers branded in a port-encircled cityscape.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Boardwalk]
description: The faint cries of seagulls echo through the boardwalk and towards the western and southern piers, their avian silhouettes resting upon ebony-crafted crates flanking the entryways.  Well-tended planters are scattered between tall faenor lamp posts, the unfurling blooms of naefira and sprigs of lavender alight with plump honeybees, the others resting in tiny cups filled with water droplets.  An ivy-framed sign stands in the center of the florals, the calligraphy highlighted by nautical watermarks.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Boardwalk]

Set beneath the archway is a ledger-filled ebonwood stand, its surface covered in quills and sheets of parchment.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Boardwalk]

Nestled between the crates are displays of wood-slatted signal fans, spyglasses, and map tubes, the well-maintained nautical tools kept beneath lock and key.

A faenor-framed board board of black slate sits beneath the reinforced canopy, nearly engulfed in corkscrews of heartleaf that wends down across its riveted legs and across the boardwalk.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Boardwalk]
description: A trio of cushioned ebonwood wagons line the sides of the boardwalk, their chain-bound cargo hidden beneath heavy layers of fur and pelts.  Ivy-draped niches, crafted from grey-stained ironwood, are affixed beneath an oiled leather canopy, its recesses filled with wax-sealed envelopes and rolled maps tied with silken ribbon.  Tall faenor-forged lamp posts stand at each corner of the boardwalk, the spherical lanterns loosely draped with garlands of dark naefira, filling the air with their heady fragrance.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Promenade]

Ink-painted terracotta pots encircle the base of the fountains, the rich soil revealing shoots of verdant foliage and budding flora.  The splayed branches of oleander and lemon trees drape over the paved road, perfuming the area in heady fragrance of sweet vanilla and citrus, the scents intermingling with the faint notes of saltwater.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Promenade]

A tall row of faenor lamp posts stand guard across the opposite side of the walkway, their spherical nielira-etched lanterns loosely entangled in heartleaf.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Promenade]
description: Heartleaf-draped pergolas of aged mahogany dot the perimeter of the paved walkway, the curling tendrils skimming the linen-cushioned chairs shaded beneath the leafy bower.  The echoes of the boardwalk reverberate across a stack of ebony crates, intermingling with the occasional cacophony of seagulls soaring over the port. title: [Nielira Harbor, Cliffside]
description: Triangular particolored flags of sailcloth and silk drape off gradual lengths of rope above a duo of stone-arched doors, the entryway curtained in veils of vert heartleaf.  Tall recesses carved into the stucco walls are filled with tiny nielira-shaped votives, the blush-colored wax painted with an ombre of pale blues and greens, each votive resting on a nacreous oyster shell.  Interspersed between the alcoves are fluted clay pots, the saffron-painted containers erupting with verdant ferns.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Cliffside]
description: Paper boats of colorful origami float across the surface of a wall-attached fountain, the vessels dipping slightly as they pass beneath the streams of blue-green water.  Foliage-veiled buildings stand across the sun-lightened cobblestones, their glass-paned displays showcasing fascinators and other millinery resting on cushions of burnt velvet.  The scent of saltwater and citrus drifts across the walkway, the fragrances intermingling with scent of paperwhites blooming from chain-hung baskets.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Cliffside]
description: A curved wall of sun-bleached limestone frames the cliffside of the walkway, the elongated ledge decorated with ship-carved planters filled with eryngium and sea lavender.  Several fine-grained telescopes of brass stand upon carved stone pedestals, the instruments tilted down towards the naefira-framed ports below the square.  Diminutive anchor wheels serve as circular tables between the pedestals, each one covered in stacks of parchment, then weighted by gear-affixed orrery.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Cliffside]
description: Several ebony silk umbrellas provide a modicum of shade above a quartet of lacquered haon tables, the chairs scattered before an ecru stucco shop displaying glazed teapots from faenor hooks.  Teacup-shaped pots dot the perimeter of the area, spilling fragrant blossoms across the cobblestones, tiny honeybees flitting to each in turn.  The indistinct sounds of an ayr and tambourine echo across the walls, the melody followed by a round of voices singing softly in unison.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Cliffside]
description: An arch-inset limestone wall stands before the aerial view of the harbor below, the pillars framing the partition and hung with lattice-woven flora entwined with filament-like faenor vines.  Set upon a pedestal of starburst-inset marble is a bronze-banded telescope, the oiled instrument set before a half-circle of ebonwood benches nestled between patches of wildflowers.  Rows of topiaries flank the slate steps ascending the walkway, highlighting the lantern-draped iron gates set above the square.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Cliffside]
description: Curtains of vert heartleaf drape across the sun-bleached limestone buildings, entwining across the wrought iron balconies as they brush against the cobblestones.  Naefira-framed doorways of shuttered wood are interspersed between the fern-planted clay pots, the vessels framing each shallow step across the walkway.  Entwined within a circular patch of rich earth is a pair of silvery-leafed olive trees, the dense branches draped over a narrow stone bench inset in tiles of sea glass.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Cliffside]
description: Ebony shelves are affixed to each side of an ash grey stucco building, the elongated planks lined with terracotta pots filled with fresh herbs scenting the wood-framed entry of the shop.  An iron-framed garden thrives between the buildings, the diminutive area well-watered by a maedat-carved fountain, the crystalline liquid flowing from the rock-shaped base and dispersed along the even rows.  Branchlike chairs create a half-crescent beneath a leaf-laden pergola, the mahogany beams draped in swathes of silk.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Cliffside]
description: Hemp-strung lanterns are draped across the sun-washed stucco buildings, the graduated vellum spheres suspended above the grey-toned cobblestones.  Whimsical displays of lacquered instruments and folios of sheet music stand behind the naefira-painted panes of glass, the individual shops decorating their entryways in fragrant garlands of florals.  The faint sounds of singing echo from the rooftop gardens above the road, the voices accompanied by both harp and lute.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Cliffside]
description: Gently curved lamp posts of dark faenor flank the slate-roofed pale limestone stables at the turn of the cobblestone walkway, the spherical lanterns draping tendrils of heartleaf in lacelike patterns.  A trio of leather-wrapped racks are affixed to the side of the narrow steps further into the harbor, the wooden lengths draped with reins and leather saddles embroidered in floral arabesques.  Set between a duo of iron-legged stools is a half-barrel trough, the vessel overflowing with wildflowers.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Cliffside]
description: Canopied carts and wide-walled wagons are parked close to an ebony-washed building affixed with jade-lacquered shutters, their reinforced beds filled with parcels and twine-bound envelopes.  An ivy-draped canopy of bleached driftwood stands opposite the bustling shop, the shaded area filled with cushioned chairs of dark wicker facing the blue-green waters below.  The paved path of cobblestones is painted in renditions of exotic stamps, the trail of labels scattered across the grove-encircled plaza.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Markets]
description: Lotus-shaped votives float across the vivid waters of the terraced marble fountain, the fixture attached to an ecru limestone building draped in crystalline droplets across the windows.  The sounds of string instruments pour out from the shuttered windows above the shop, the occupants' balcony decorated in blown glass wind chimes gently ringing with the ambient coastal breeze.  A sculpture of repurposed driftwood stands nestled in the cypress-shaded corner, variegated mushrooms peeking out from beneath the asymmetric lengths.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Gardens]

title: [Nielira Harbor, Gardens]

Subtly nestled between the arboreal forms is a diminutive pool, the moss-covered stones adorned with small tokens.

A diminutive flock of black-billed magpies flit to and from the iron-railed balcony above, disappearing into their twig-crafted nests.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Markets]

title: [Nielira Harbor Mail Office]

title: [The Aneia]

The natural formation of the rock creates an asymmetric roof over a quintet of tables, the archway partitioned by a curtain of Nalfein ivy, the ivory-edged leaves allowing glimpses of the crashing waves below.  A scattering of terracotta pots frame wrought iron benches set against the limestone walls, the backdrop engulfed in latticed jewel-toned roses.
