title: [The Tailor's Muse]
description: The faint glow of dozens of silk-strung faerthiel illuminates the frame-covered walls of the boutique, the tiny baubles radiating outwards from a tall mirror set above the marble counter.  Glazed glass vases are interspersed between silk-draped mannequins caught in various balletic poses, their arms raised towards the staircase leading upwards towards the melodic sounds of instruments echoing across the steps.  A rose-carved cabinet stands against the far wall, stacked with rolls of rich fabric.

title: [The Naefira Boutique]
description: Thin rays of sunlight seep through the alternating linden and mahogany slats framing the windows of the shop, the beams highlighting the wall-mounted rack of garments dyed in a variety of rich-colored tones.  Silk-stitched dress forms stand at the corners of the limestone room, the silhouettes bedecked in handwoven garlands of florals interspersed by verdant ferns.  The carved pine counter sits at the center of the pyrographed floor, its surface draped in leaf-framed naefira.

title: [The Vintner's Distillery]
description: Bronze-latticed curtains of heady florals frame the ceiling-high windows, the arcs of flora draping over the glass and casting shadowed silhouettes across the ebony-planked floor.  The shelf-covered limestone wall displays a kaleidoscope of glass bottles, the arrangements decorated with hand-drawn sketchings of vineyards, each parchment labeled in gilded ink.  A three-sided counter of sanded ebony crates encompasses the back of the shop, encircled by a variety of high-backed leather chairs.

title: [Cordwainer's Muse]
description: Jewel-toned swathes of fabric are draped across the jade-washed stucco walls of the shop, the brocades and laces entwined with chain-strung faerthiel in accompanying colors.  Wrought pewter brackets loft cases in vertical rows against the back wall, the footwear displayed behind panes of glass set before the ivy-curtained counter covered in dye swatches.  A lace-appliqued shoe form stands nestled in the far corner, its surface covered in silk-petaled naefira trailing down toward the planked floor.

title: [Fragile Service]
description: Alternating slats of ebony and haon frame the ceiling-high windows of the shop, the corners framed by rope-bound terracotta pots spilling verdant foliage across the limestone walls.  Twin marble pillars are overlaid by a sheet of naefira-carved glass, creating an elongated counter beside a tall faenor display showcasing several samples of wares.  A tiered chandelier of stained glass hangs above the shop, casting rays of polychromatic color across the woven wool rugs dispersed across the floor.

title: [Harbor's Bounty]
description: The tall open-air stall is framed in blackened iron, the greenhouse-like structure curtained in veils of ivy, the subtle shadows dancing across the narrow limestone building set alongside the shop.  An arched entrance is set at the side of the stall, the doors held open by ice-filled stacks of crates, the containers branded with various images of fish.  A long wooden counter divides the two structures, its perimeter bordered by wrought metal chairs cushioned in striped sailcloth.

title: [The Onyx-Petaled Taerethil]
description: Ceiling-high windows are draped in a fall of onyx-petaled taerethil, the blooms arcing over the curved lattices framing the faenor-chained chandelier at the center of the shop.  A gilded cabinet of ebony stands behind an elongated glass-paneled counter, the surface encasing rows of pastries labeled with vellum placards and placed upon leaf-framed platters.  Nestled in the back corner is a nacre velvet curtain, partially concealing a spiraled flora-wrought staircase entwined with thin vines.

title: [Onyx-Petaled Taerethil, Rooftop]
description: Trellises of latticed ebony provide the framework for a series of domed enclosures scattered across the pebbled garden, the stones creating a pale walkway through the lawn.  Lacquered lengths of rope suspend vivid faerthiel interspersed by sailor's knots, the tiny lanterns dancing like fireflies along with the ambient breezes off the nearby waters.  The faint echoes of music reverberate throughout the area, the instruments occasionally accompanied by a passing choir of impromptu performers.

title: [Jewel of the Harbor]
description: Ribbons of silk suspend ebony picture frames across the pale tea green walls, the glass-paned ovals portraying silhouettes adorned with various pieces of elaborate jewelry, the finery held in place by diminutive pewter pins.  The faenor-framed counter displays several lengths of chain and cushion-affixed pins, the mixed metals neatly labeled next to each vertical row.  A ceiling-high mirror of carved haon is flanked by arched windows, the trio veiled in graduated drapes of heart-shaped ivy.

title: [Root and Petal]
description: A fragrant veil of dried herbs and florals drifts across the curtain-draped shop, the sheaves arranged in various glass vases across the fine-grained haon counter along the back wall.  Charcoal-sketched drawings frame tall vertical drawers, the lined containers filled with wax-sealed vials and bottles, each vessel affixed with a tiny vellum tag.  Several bracketed shelves line the sides of the apothecary, filled with wide stone jars interspersed between wicker-woven canisters.

title: [The Lady's Interlude]
description: Lacquered cherrywood beams cross along the ceiling, entwined with leafy garlands of alabaster naefira caught in bloom, the flora encircling silk-wrapped faerthiel suspended above a marble counter.  Chiseled marble pillars frame the wall-affixed wooden shelves stained a hunter green, the planks displaying tall glass jars filled with dried leaves mixed with blossoms and herbs.  Ianthine travertine tiles are arranged in a checkerboard pattern across the floor, inset in dark ivory flourishes.

title: [Nielira Harbor Bank]
description: A wide mural of Nielira Harbor engulfs the back wall of the establishment, the watercolored parchment covered in strokes of ink indicating points of interest.  Heartleaf curtains a glass-encased booth nestled in the far corner of the area, the exchange carefully watched by a trio of guards standing by a ceiling-high cabinet of labeled drawers.  Charcoal-drawn sketches of tall-masted vessels encircle a lacquered haon door, the entry revealing a long corridor filled with the scent of aged vellum.

title: [Nielira Bank, Teller]
description: Ivy-draped bars of blackened iron frame the room-wide ebony counter, the wooden surface carved with an expansive map of the eastern seaboard, then covered in a thin sheet of glass.  Behind the counter reveals tall shelves filled with leather-bound ledgers interspersed with obscure trinkets, the treasures barely concealed beneath the lids of small, velvet-lined chests.  A nielira-carved plaque is affixed to the back wall, the creature's long arms serving as a makeshift rack for several faenor keyrings.

title: [Nielira Bank, Exchange Booth]
description: Graduated curtains of verdant heartleaf veil the glass-encased booth from view, the floral-engulfed back wall creating a brilliant contrast to the lacquered ebony counter standing within the center.  A raven-haired exchange clerk stands behind the counter, occasionally turning around to prune the blossoms behind her, her belt laden with a variety of small garden tools alongside a quill and tiny inkpot.  The sounds of commerce and seagulls intermingle from outside the booth, the heavy footfalls echoing across the room.

title: [Nielira Bank, Debt Collector]
description: A series of ship-carved wooden shelves frame the elongated haon counter set before the grey stucco back wall, a pink-haired elven clerk arranging a number of weathered ledgers beside her between sips from a glass teacup.  A brass-framed lantern of jade green glass sits beside the clerk, etched with a bloom of nielira between the bubbled surface, their tentacles dancing in the ambient flames.  The soft sound of feline snoring echoes from beneath the counter, the snuffling interrupted by the occasional purr.

title: [The Taerethil Pavilion]
description: The high-peaked ceiling of the pavilion stands tall against the framework of ebon-stained mahogany, the jade-colored silks complemented by leafy naefira garlands filling the area with a heady, floral fragrance.  A quartet of velvet-backed chairs face outwards toward a collection of cushioned benches, the maedatha carpet bisecting the floor, running upwards towards the dais.  A vase-framed table is set between the audience and the dais, the polished surface simply adorned with a jade-carved inkpot.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Stables]
description: The high-arching ceiling of the stables provides respite for several hay-filled nests, the avian occupants quietly chirping from the rafters above.  Fine-grained planks of ashen haon form the foundation of the stables, the framework reinforced by blackened iron and branded in elaborate insignias.  The wide sash windows allow the ambient ocean breeze to idle through, the gentle draft rustling the hemp-bound bales of straw stacked neatly beside each stall.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Stables]
description: Blankets of colorful maedatha are stacked in honeycomb-shaped shelves across from the fine-grained stalls, the recesses filled with worn toys and stiff-bristled brushes.  Steel buckets of water and oats hang from tall, leather-strapped posts; the containers sway gently with the ocean breeze flowing through the sash windows, the rustling threatening to topple a stack of apples set on the ledge.  Knotted lengths of hemp are affixed above the stalls, the ends suspending heartleaf-entangled glass spheres.

title: [Nielira Harbor, Stables]
description: Blankets of colorful maedatha are stacked in honeycomb-shaped shelves across from the fine-grained stalls, the recesses filled with worn toys and stiff-bristled brushes.  Steel buckets of water and oats hang from tall, leather-strapped posts; the containers sway gently with the ocean breeze flowing through the sash windows, the rustling threatening to topple a stack of apples set on the ledge.  Knotted lengths of hemp are affixed above the stalls, the ends suspending heartleaf-entangled glass spheres.

title: [Zul Logoth, Onyx Tunnel]
description: Potted toadstools offer a glow that lights up the striped walls in this section of tunnels.  Foot traffic passes through the arch in the north wall and deeper into the tunnels to the south.  Those who come and go through a rune-carved portal in the west wall typically bear solemn expressions.  On the opposite wall is a dark opening.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Ancient Stairwell]
description: A marvel of dwarven masonry, this ancient spiral staircase carved into the rock of the mountain is wide enough to accommodate simultaneous up and down traffic.  While they may have once been sharp-cornered, the steps have been rounded over time by the countless passersby that have traversed them.  An iron chain secured to the wall serves as a right-handed railing opposite the central column that is worn smooth from the contact of many hands seeking its support.

title: [Stonetomb, Sanctuary]
description: Large, rectangular stone blocks shore up this round room covered by a crystal-inlaid dome.  Reaching to the sky, the statue of a winged humanoid woman stands at its center.  Between clusters of glowing, potted toadstools, a wide invar gate cordons off a stone yard opposite an arched ironwood door in the southern wall.  Beyond the statue to the west, a wide plaque-lined hallway leads deeper into the tomb, while to the east, a simple portal leads back out to Zul Logoth.

title: [Zul Logoth, Long Tunnel]
description: A long tunnel with walls wide enough for three dwarves to walk side-by-side, and a ceiling tall enough for an average giant to stand upright, leads south into darkness.  The smooth stone of the floor has a polished, shallow depression along its central track, evidence of centuries of foot traffic.  To the north a stairwell descends deeper underground.

title: [Zul Logoth, Venerable Columns]
description: As you travel along this stretch of tunnel, the ceiling disappears and the walls fall away, replaced by elaborately carved, massive marble columns to either side.  At least ten dwarves around, their tops are lost in the darkness above.  Shadows obscure what lays beyond them to the east and west.  The air is cold and damp, and the darkness is oppressive in this vast and ancient place.

title: [Zul Logoth, Switchbacks]
description: The cavern ends here at a glistening rocky wall.  Carved into the dark stone, a series of wide switchback steps winds upwards, wet from water that trickles down from above.  Small patches of deep red algae can be seen on the surface of some of the surrounding rocks, but they do not quite thrive in the cool, mineral scented air.  Darkness obscures what lies to the north.

title: [Zul Logoth, Cavern Entry]
description: This cave is small, with air that is slightly musty.  Lichen clings to the walls to the southwest, a hint of what lies further in that direction.  Tiny streams flow north out of the cave and down a series of steps just outside an opening in the north wall.  Dark and quiet, save for the sound of the streams and the occasional drip of water, it smells of earth, mold, and slate.

title: [Stonetomb, Memorial]
description: A vaulted white marble ceiling rises above a pair of statues standing beside each other on a raised platform at the center of this square chamber.  The marble-finished walls that enclose this serene space are lined with rune-incised plaques that indicate the permanent residents of the crypts behind them.  Long ironwood boxes full of glowing toadstool clusters line the perimeter of the room, giving everything a bluish glow.  A wide hallway leads east, while dark corridors lead off in the other cardinal directions.

title: [Stonetomb, Office]
description: This small but cozy room is neat and tidy.  Dual candelabras spill warm, golden light across a modest desk facing an arched ironwood door in the north wall.  A pair of padded chairs faces the desk, all resting on a geometric-patterned, rust and gold carpet.  A low cabinet runs the length of the west wall across from a stone bust standing on the eastern side.  Behind the desk, barrels of rolled up papers flank a large bookcase.

title: [Stonetomb, Stone Yard]
description: This expansive, cave-like room is the workspace and storage for the mausoleum through the invar gate to the south.  In the northeastern quadrant, stacks of brass plates have been lined up beside a sturdy easel.  In the southeast, racks of glowing toadstools sit next to empty pots and a pile of mulch.  On the western side, dwarf-sized stone slabs are stacked next to a wheeled step ladder contraption.  Upright brooms fill a rack near a small steel door in the north wall.

title: [Stonetomb, West Vestibule]
description: The natural grey granite walls of this chamber are filled with one foot square, runed brass plates from floor to ceiling.  Troops of blue-tinted white toadstools fill low stone troughs around the edges of this cool chamber, subtly providing blue-white light.  Two benches occupy the corners of the eastern wall for any who wish to pause in the serenity of the environs.  Twin crypt-lined corridors lead to other rooms north and south.

title: [Stonetomb, Southwest Vestibule]
description: A grid of brass plates, each bearing a single dwarven rune, fills the granite walls and continue down dark corridors to the north and east.  Standing in the southwestern corner is the statue of a dwarven sculptor midway through a project.  Pots sprouting bioluminescent toadstools light the chamber from below with a cool, light blue glow.

title: [Stonetomb, South Vestibule]
description: The grey stone walls of this chilly chamber are full of rune-incised plaques denoting the remains of those who've left this mortal realm behind.  Standing over a stone anvil is the statue of a dwarf frozen mid-swing before the strike of the hammer.  Pale blue light rises from groups of potted toadstools all around the edges of the floor.

title: [Stonetomb, North Vestibule]
description: Standing before the northern wall, a statue of a dwarf holding a plumb bob surveys a stack of blocks incorporated into the sculpture.  Brass crypt markers line the wall behind it and continue down corridors leading west and south.  Potted toadstools around the edges of the chamber light the area with a pale blue glow.

title: [Stonetomb, Northwest Vestibule]
description: Having been carved from the very bedrock of the Dragonspine gives this chamber a cave-like ambience.  Numerous crypts marked by columns and rows of rune-etched plaques fill the walls and corridors that lead to the south and east.  Standing in the northwestern corner, the statue of a dwarf examining a piece of ore is lit from below by pots of glowing toadstools.

title: [Zul Logoth, Cave of Awakening]
description: Luminous yellow crystal blooms twinkle in the dark along this cave's ceiling and walls.  Assemblies of white puffball mushrooms huddle together in patches across a verdant carpet of dewey green moss that covers the floor.  Occasional zephyrs stir the pleasantly cool air, sometimes scattering orange-red clouds of spores that erupt from the odd mushroom cluster.

title: [Zul Logoth, Cave of Vitality]
description: This cave is hot and humid, the air heavy with the smell of fungus.  Crowds of glowing pale blue trumpet mushrooms release luminous motes that tumble through the darkness over tall golden parasols and creamy flathead toadstools that compete for space in the nutrient rich deep brown humus below your feet.  Heavy droplets fall from green moss tendrils that hang overhead.

title: [Zul Logoth, Cave of Wisdom]
description: Whispering winds can be heard coming from hidden vents in the dark, craggy ceiling, circulating crisp, cool air in this cave.  Rotten logs litter the floor, their soft flesh breaking underfoot, host to numerous orange oyster mushrooms and glowing purple toadstools that thrive on the decomposing wood.  The prevalent smell of decay is not entirely unpleasant.

title: [Zul Logoth, Cave of Transition]
description: The air in this icy cold cave leaves your breath hanging in the air.  Groups of glowing jewel tone toadstools in amethyst, sapphire, and ruby joyfully illuminate an otherwise desolate rocky landscape.  Crystal clear icicles hang from a rocky ceiling that's covered in stark white lichen.

title: [Zul Logoth, Cave of Convergence]
description: Ghostly mycelium tendrils spread out of a dark shaft in this sizable cave's ceiling, spiraling out and down the dark granite walls, weaving around puddles of water in the stone floor, eventually meeting again at the center of this grotto where they wind and twist themselves into the form of a lithe humanoid figure standing before a natural spring.  Golden clusters of bioluminescent mushrooms gather in patches along the web-like network to illuminate the surroundings in a tranquil light.

title: [Zul Logoth, Natural Spring]
description: Glowing motes float in the air over the gently burbling surface of this crystal clear natural spring.  Mason-cut stone blocks have been arranged around the edges of the pool to provide places to enjoy the tranquility of the surroundings in the refreshing water.  While slightly cool at first, acclimation to the spa's embrace takes little time.

title: [Beneath the Philtrum]
description: Exposed rafters are covered in frosted globes that shed their bright light upon the wares that fill the shelving units that line the walls of the small but quaint shop.  Thick carpets dampen the chill that rises from the floor, while a riverstone fireplace has a banked fire laid in it that keeps the dampness from the air.  Several storage baskets are scattered along the walls, though noticeably vacant from the path of a nearby door.

title: [Borrowed Plumes, Wares]
description: Housed in large glass globes, fireflies emit a yellow-green bioluminescence which reflects off of the polished hardwood walls and floorboards.  Swathes of colorful silks are draped from a collection of marble block pedastals supporting vases brimming with fans of iridescent peacock feathers.  A pair of glossy walnut armoires flank a lace-curtained opening near the rear of the wagon.

title: [The Discerning Stitch]
description: Tendrils of silver-cast ivy frame the ebony-planked walls of the shop, the hammered metal leaves curtaining the thorn-framed stand occupying the west wall.  Tall burgundy glass lanterns are affixed on either side of a faenor rack bedecked in garlands of leafy florals, the lavender and roses scenting the air.  A collection of parchment-labeled bottles are displayed on elongated shelves leading north, the colorful containers filled with various liquors arranged between wide glassware.

title: [The Discerning Stitch, Drapes]
description: Glass-encased lamps are scattered between the antler-framed rack and ebony stand, the containers casting shadows across the charcoal-drawn sketches displayed along the planked walls.  A velvet-draped birdcage stands in the back corner, its occupant occasionally rattling the gilded confines hidden beneath the thick curtains.  The faint scent of burnt wood and aged whiskey permeates the air, the haze swirling across the carpeted floor.

title: [Winning Shriek, Rest]
description: Intricate dark-hued stains embellish the inner walls of this hallowed alcove, where ample space encircles the central burial vault, allowing unhibited movement.  Smooth, white ceramic tiles, worn by countless visitors, enclose the deceased, radiating outward along the cardinal points, while the interstices between them are embraced by the native ground's natural covering.

title: [Sizzle and Spice]
description: Amidst a persistent scent of charred wood and a faint crackle of embers in the air, the vague resemblance of a cookery emerges, its culinary furnishings and equipment mostly covered in a thin layer of ash and soot.  Currently in a restoration phase, a solid maple block and a tall oak pantry possess a number of items seemingly spared from the blaze, and the tiniest whisper of a recently cooked meal lingers in the air, inviting a promise of future endeavors.

title: [Peace of Mind]
description: The curtain-draped walls of the dust-covered shop are engulfed in a myriad of shelves overflowing with knickknacks, the flat lengths of wood framing a tall ebony curio inset with panes of glass.  Dried bundles of herbs scent the air, the scattered leaves sprinkled across the mahogany-planked floor alongside tufts of cat hair.  The faint yowling of several felines echoes throughout the room, followed by the sounds of claws against wood.

title: [The Imprinter's Studio]
description: A vast array of portraits, paintings, and other artistic imagery occupy the vast majority of this entryway's four walls.  Arranged around the room for easy viewing are multiple display cases, each containing different decorated dreamfire panels to showcase the shop owner's artistic skill.

title: [The Imprinter's Studio, Den]
description: Haphazard boxes piled high in a corner lay forgotten and dusty in this sparsely decorated den.  An artist's easel and overflowing workstation stand prominently to the side of one half of the room opposite a chaise lounge occupying the other half.

title: [Market Makers]
description: Wall sconces housing hurricane lanterns line the walls of the hut, providing ample illumination for the crowded space and dispelling all shadows from the area.  Long shelving units are hung between the lanterns, their sides open ended, and their wall supports fashioned of heavy wrought iron.  A series of parchment advertisements decorate the spaces beneath the shelves, their painted faces cheery and bright.

title: [Tooth and Claw, Entry]
description: The crooked construction of the hide walls of this shelter makes this space closed and cramped.  A wide wooden work table carved with a plethora of wild animals on the legs, its surface covered in bits of paper and tools, takes up one entire wall.  Shoved into the opposite corner are a wood-framed chest paneled with various skins and a hide-sided box, their interiors full with wares.  A ragged curtain constructed from several squares of fur leads to a sectioned-off area in the back.

title: [Twisted Ways, Windy Storefront]
description: The walls of the store's entrance have been sundered and blackened, the larger holes patched with strips of metal and planks of wood.  Wisps of smoke and vapor spiral around a lazy little twisting dust devil slowly drifting across a patch of loose floorboards.  The shop continues beyond a long cracked display rack, narrowing sharply where the walls have almost entirely caved in.

title: [Twisted Ways, Smoldering Corner]
description: Intense heat emanates from a glowing red pile of twisted weapons in the back corner of the desolated interior of this shop.  Thick wooden beams are irreparably scorched, once supporting the remnants of wooden racks that displayed merchandise on the now rubble-littered floor.  Colorful glass fragments mark the walls, deformed where they have melted into the soot-stained stonework.  A splintered section of the ceiling hangs dangerously low, and all but the shortest visitors must duck to avoid its jagged edges.

title: [Twisted Ways, Frozen Corner]
description: Cooled vapor hovers in the air, and tendrils of hoarfrost pattern the walls and ceiling of this crowded space.  An icy blue frost-covered crate nearly fills the entire corner, the floor slick with ice around it.  Moist floorboards are riddled with mold, warped and swollen from exposure to constant gusts of dry heat from the eastern corner of the shop.

title: [The Glass House]
description: This vine-roofed hut serves as both a manufactory of glass as well as a shop offering its creations.  Beside a cold and ash-stained iron furnace, a sprawling workbench displays myriad metal tools of glassmaking, while along the riverstone walls, a painted tanik shelf and a smooth oak shelf flaunt a smattering of colorful glass trinkets for sale.  Beside a roughly hewn oak log pedestal, a neatly inked notice and a small placard call for the attention of all patrons.

title: [Elemental Embellishments]
description: The cozy interior of the small house is arranged in balanced quartets and quintets of objects, displaying matching elemental motifs throughout.  A large tapestry hangs on the back wall of the room and plush carpeting covers the floors.  A dark ironwood necklace stand and an engraved mithril ring display maintain pride of place as the everything in the room is designed to draw attention to them.

title: [Diabolically Chained]
description: Exposed rafters dominate the rough oak-plank ceiling, their broad expanses fitted with large, blackened iron hooks that keep amber-glassed lanterns aloft.  Dirty windows offer views of the street beyond, their smudged panes allow the aurora-kissed sky to paint wares displayed on nearby counters in violet hues.  Wicker baskets line the eastern wall, while the western one is fitted with a large, open ironwood door surrounded by heavy iron chains.

title: [Entranced]
description: Hovering below the ceiling, a miasma of smoke drifts through the small hut from a nearby window, choking the air and forming a haze that obscures the walls.  Faint light trickles in through an opening in the peaked, twig-covered roof, creating pools of light upon shelves that ring the space.  A low sleeping pallet filled with preserved furs is thrown against one wall, while several ancient food crocks are scattered about the dirt floor.

title: [Fancy Wishbones]
description: Cracked pale cobbled slabs of stone and packed dirt stretch up and curve at their peak to create a domed ceiling.  Dried vines creep across the walls, weaving in and out from openings that are either man-made or timeworn, invading the spaces.  Sickly green orbs of light cast shades of color between black and vivid absinthe green across the area.  Shadows form stick-like fingers that grasp at the engraved sarcophagus dominating this cave.

title: [Lacquered Ungues]
description: Though only a single room, the hut is deceptively large and incredibly tidy.  Smooth stucco covers the walls, which are only interrupted by round windows of decorative stained glass.  Frosted globes dangle from the ceiling, providing ample lighting for viewing the various vials and jars stored on a nearby bookcase.  Colorful floral designs decorate the quilt that covers a brass-knobbed bed along one wall, while a copper brazier in the heart of the space keeps the dampness of the surrounding forest at bay.

title: [Spider Johnn's Tin Smoke Box]
description: Perhaps once a cozy home, this abode boasts only scratched wooden floors where furniture might have stood and the sort of wear in which derelict buildings are so often clad.  The scent of smoke hangs heavy, and the peeling dark green-striped ivory wallpaper is stained with a notable soot line near the ceiling and various oddly pristine spaces on the walls where paintings likely hung.  Leaving a vast emptiness before it, a tall ebonwood-framed counter with glass inserts stands near the back of the room, and atop it rests a sectional filigreed case.

title: [Spider Johnn's Tin Smoke Box]
description: Though peeling, the wallpaper on the walls is without stain or blemish, and the floor is scuffed as if with the movement of furniture and bears, near the door, the wispy-fingered stains of soot left by flames.  A single window hangs in the side wall, its glass smoked grey.  An elevated ebonwood display sits beneath it, along with a sectional filigreed silver case, and both are lit by a cream-shaded oil lamp.

title: [Nightfire Brews, Kitchen]
description: Keeping the entire shop toasty and warm, an enormous fireplace occupies one entire wall of the kitchen and is filled with dozens of brick-lined baking alcoves.  Opposite, gleaming pot lids hang upon the wall amid various skillets, pots, and pans that are hung from simple iron hangers.  A long preparation counter, complete with a soapstone wash basin, rests near an archway leading into the shop, while a staircase topped with a niveous wool runner disappears into the owner's private quarters.

title: [Nightfire Brews]
description: Occupying most of the exterior wall, a large bay window rimed in hoarfrost at its corners offers an unobstructed view of the winter wonderland beyond its panes, while pendant lanterns dangling from the exposed-rafter ceiling create a soft glow throughout the space.  Tables and mahogany chairs are scattered throughout the area, their mahogany bodies arranged in social circles upon amber and niveous area rugs.  A long counter stands before an archway leading to the kitchen, its surface covered in enticing offerings.

title: [Sleightest Hand]
description: Large gashes are torn into the blackened, weather-soiled canvas tent walls.  Rusted iron poles struggle to keep what remains of the tent up.  At the back end is a rotten, black-stained bedroll with a lidless thanot footlocker half covered by the bedding.  Grass and molding moss have slowly begun to take over the rest of what remains here.

title: [The Dancing Death Dirge]
description: Cracked and charred logs set on top of each other line the walls, while the two stained glass windows are in perfect condition, like new.  Rays of colored moonlight stream in through the tinted panes of glass, dotting the charcoal surroundings with dim colors.  Most of the furniture in this small room is either ash or mostly destroyed by a fire.

title: [Drowned Dreams Curiosities]
description: Dirty shop windows allow the aurora-patterned sky to filter into the area, dusting the low shelves in mottled hues of violet and cerulean.  Dampness hangs heavy in the air, the scent of sea water and mold dominating the space, while a chill mist clings to the warped floorboards.  A series of display cases filled with dried seaweed are scattered throughout the space, each bearing a patina of verdigris on their damp copper fixtures.

title: [Drowned Dreams Curiosities]
description: Low ceilings and cramped aisle give the space a disorderly feeling, which is only enhanced by the improper lighting and the heavy scent of rot and mildew that lingers in the damp, musty air.  Bookcases and cabinet stretch towards the ceiling, their tops brushing against the dark beams, and enclosing each aisle with the clutter of the bric-a-brac stored on their shelves.  From somewhere at the back of the shop, the incessant sound of something dripping can be heard.

title: [Haunted Waters Artifacts]
description: Warped boards, dark with water stains and mottled with off-white acorn barnacles, form the walls of the small shop, which vaguely resembles a ship's bunk room.  Tangle clumps of seaweed, rotted and foul, dangle in long ribbons from the ceiling, while eerily glowing glass orbs rest within fishing net and provide illumination for the space.  Open chests and trunks are bolted to the uneven floor and are filled with reclaimed wares.

title: [Haunted Waters Artifacts]
description: Rotted hammocks sway from the exposed rafters of the room, the sodden rope and cloth structures dripping into stagnant pools upon the uneven ground.  Verdigris veins paint the copper portholes that gaze out into the streets beyond, their dirty windows limned in violet, cerulean, and coral hues as the perpetual twilight attempts to spill through the glass.  Footlockers, trunks, and barrels are scattered throughout the room, their warped faces mottled with bright white barnacles.

title: [A Vague Inkling, Showroom]
description: Walls of pale grey stone enclose the spacious building, while thick rafters of oak support the layers of a compact thatched roof.  Partially covering the polished wooden floor is an oval braided rug mixed with a wide range of green.  Centered in the room is a live-edge maple table draped with a forest green velvet runner.  Next to a curtain-draped archway is a series of bronze hooks fashioned in the shape of various skeletal creatures.

title: [Beneath the Philtrum, Workroom]
description: Scattered about the long workbench that takes up most of the space within the small workshop are various bars of wax, jars of paint, and small cauldrons that rest on short-legged pedestals heated by votives.  Large lists decorate the walls, the greying parchment smeared with pigmented wax and listing the various ingredients needed to create tinted wax.  A small wooden bench sits to one side.

title: [Borrowed Plumes, Storage]
description: A simple cot outfitted with a grey cotton bedroll and a plump goose feather pillow is pushed up against the wall beneath a circular window, the diffused light filtering through the colored glass slicing the room in two.  Across from a roseate tufted armchair with a matching footstool, a walnut worktable displays a porcelain mask project in process amid a scattering of jewels and feathers.  Velvet-cushioned boxes packed with elaborate disguises are stacked on narrow shelves covering the walls.

title: [Tooth and Claw, Backroom]
description: Several cured hides of varying quality have been strewn over the floor of this enclosed section, making the footing precarious in places.  Boxes are scattered everywhere, some open to display their contents of teeth and bones, while a guttering oil lamp hangs suspended from the roof to provide scant illumination.  The air is stuffy and smells of animals, both alive and dead.

title: [A Vague Inkling, Backroom]
description: Tucked into the corner of the small room is a scratched oak writing desk, the surface littered with parchment, writing utensils, and inkpots.  A thick, moss green carpet covers most of the polished wooden floor.  Several cushioned benches are scattered about the center of the space.

title: [The Roof Over, Cabinetry]
description: Dangling a variety of tools from small hooks secured around its frame, a wooden worktable displays a spread of blueprints, most containing various notes and markings.  Piles of sawdust swept into the corners are continuously stirred creating a blizzard of tiny particles that float through the air.  Recently completed, an elaborately carved cabinet exudes a mildly pungent odor of varnish.

title: [A Darkly Canopied Path]
description: A lushly green canopy casts dark shadows across the area, the trees and vines creating it crowding, but not yet obscuring, the cobblestone pathway.  Hints of an opening are visible through a vine-draped arch leading southwest, but to the northeast, the foliage looks denser.  Nevertheless, a brightly colored, arrow-shaped sign points in that direction, and all the vegetation gives the sign a wide berth.

title: [A Darkly Canopied Path]
description: Dense foliage crowds the cobblestone pathway, and overhead, the trees weave together in a dark green, light-blocking canopy.  Along the side of the path, leafy kudzu completely obscures several objects, and a few tendrils have hesitantly sent out feelers onto the moss-covered path.  Wavering back and forth at the slightest breeze and untouched by any voracious greenery, however, is an arrow-shaped sign pointing to the east.

title: [A Darkly Canopied Path]
description: Jungle greenery wages war with itself and with the cobblestone path upon which it threatens to encroach.  Meanwhile, the thick canopy overhead blocks all but the barest of ambient light, making the time of day virtually impossible to tell, and the surrounding jungle is also almost unnaturally silent except for the occasional rustle of leaves and vines.  Exempt from all verdant trespassing, an arrow-shaped sign points to the northeast.

title: [A Darkly Canopied Path]
description: Liana vines creep up the tall trees crowding the cobblestone pathway, their grasping tendrils interweaving with branches to create an arching canopy overhead.  Leading somewhat northerly, a vine-choked trail branches off from the main road.  A riot of blood red fungi scatter across decaying stumps, interspersed with virulent orange stalks of slime mold.  An arrow-shaped sign points east.

title: [A Darkly Canopied Path, Gates]
description: The cobblestone path leads through a pair of tall iron gates, and on the other side, the jungle seems to be successfully held at bay.  The overhead canopy of vines and verdant tree branches here is low, brushing the tops of the gate and its flanking stone wall.  Dark purple blossoms dangle just out of reach, and several thick clumps of ferns drape leafy fronds along the path.  All vegetation stays well away from an arrow-shaped sign pointing at the gates, except for a tiny, out of place, cobra lily sitting in a miniscule boggy spot.

title: [Abandoned Cemetery]
description: This small clearing has several haphazardly placed burial markers and sites, and while once upon a time there may have been an attempt to keep the area clear, the foliage threatens now to overwhelm it.  Spiderwebs of significant size drape from vines and headstones, roses rampage wildly across graves, and thick tufts of grass choke reliquaries.  Narrow trails and footpaths venture into the dark, vegetative depths beyond.

title: [Bonfire of the Gallivants]
description: This spacious glade has numerous benches set near stone circles with a prominent circle for a bonfire at the center.  Placed at strategic locations throughout are barrels of leaves, log-filled racks, and twig-stuffed crates.  Wild roses and blackberries grow along the clearing's outskirts, holding voracious vegetation at bay.  A shadowed vine-beset footpath disappears into the verdant darkness, while to the east, a manor is visible in the distance near what looks to be the remnants of a decepit ferris wheel.

title: [Gallivant Manor, Grounds]
description: Moss-covered steps lead up to the raised stone terrace and the doors leading into the manor, while overgrown grass, brambles, and rose bushes make moving across the lawn complicated.  Unkempt, tiny paths lead into a wild garden, whimsical statuary visible here and there, bordered on one side by a giant hedge wall broken only by a gated archway.  A small trail curves around the manor, and a half-circle of stone benches is visible to the west.

title: [Gallivant Manor, Approach]
description: Held mostly at bay by some unknown force, the jungle looms large upon the perimeter.  Rising out of the wild approach, a brick and ashlar manor dominates the area, dwarfing the metal skeletal remains of a ferris wheel and a carousel scattered on the overgrown lawn, wild clumps of grass and vines entangling themselves across the paint-faded rides.  A gated ashlar wall separates the eastern lawn from the rest, and the cobblestone path leading in from a pair of tall iron gates narrows to a small trail wrapping behind the property.

title: [Gavelsdown Hall, Entry]
description: Brightly illuminated by polished brass sconces that are evenly spaced upon the crimson and ebon bourde walls, the entry is carpeted with a deep burgundy rug that muffles all sound.  Flanked on the eastern wall by a lacquered ebonwood archway and the western by glass-paned doors, a flight of broad mahogany stairs ascends to the second floor and is decorated with carved balusters.

title: [Gavelsdown Hall, Library]
description: With the exception of the southern wall, the library is encircled by floor-to-ceiling bookcases laden with tomes, volumes, and manuals.  Chandeliers, evenly spaced throughout the ceiling, provide ample illuminations for those reclining on any of the many cushioned armchairs scattered about the space.  A lectern rests opposite the entry and is surrounded by storage chests and broad oak tables.

title: [Gavelsdown Hall, Parlor]
description: Golden linden frames surround floor-to-ceiling windows upon the southern and western walls, the glass within whorled and opaque, causing only a dim impression of the natural light to filter through.  Curios and cupboards are scattered about the parlor, their lacquered faces glinting in the light of the room's sconces, while an elaborately carved cabinet is deliberately placed beneath a spotlight.  Offering egress, a lacquered ebonwood archway opens up the eastern wall.

title: [Yvalyst Manor, Foyer]
description: A chandelier of jagged crystal hangs along the high beams of the foyer, the shards casting shadows across the expansive travertine floor leading to the gargoyle-set fireplace dominating the portrait-laden side wall.  Iron-railed staircases frame a marble statue at the center of the room, the figure obscuring the long hallway branching off into the interior of the manor.  Brittle veils of webbing cover the vases arranged along the perimeter, the decaying flowers drooping down towards the uneven carpet.

title: [Yvalyst Manor, Grand Hallway]
description: Iron-caged sconces frame the vast hallway, the fractured glass illuminating the bloodwood frames lining the brocaded walls in patches of light as the passage branches off into separate wings.  Narrow console tables of lacquer-covered mahogany are interspersed along the passageway, the heavily notched surfaces covered in ribbon-bound bouquets of dried tulips, the flora's colors long faded.  Sanguine-dyed wool covers the parquetry floor along the corridor, the woven carpets subtly unraveling.

title: [Yvalyst Manor, Dining Room]
description: An elongated brocade-draped table slices across the broad room, the candelabra-adorned surface covered in tiered dishes and decanters etched with stylized letter "A"s.  Silk-padded chairs encircle the elaborate display, the avian-patterned motif echoed across the claw-footed benches set against the curtained windows.  A widowwood-framed portrait dominates the northern wall, the subject's visage flickering as the wall-affixed sconces whip tongues of flame across the glass.

title: [Yvalyst Manor, Ballroom]
description: Sprigs of alyssum and amaranth are hand-painted across the parquetry dance floor, the sanguine and ivory-colored flora traced in splatters of gilded ink across the sweeping ballroom.  Pallid marble fountains spray water between the potted dark-colored foliage, the chilling mist clinging to the velvet-curtained windows, leaving the stained glass covered in rivulets of condensation.  Chiseled marble busts flank the various thresholds, each profile covered in a veil of aged, discolored lace.

title: [Yvalyst Manor, Library]
description: Ceiling-high bookcases are filled with gilt-leafed volumes and tomes, the rigid leather spines covered in a veil of dust-riddled webbing spanning across the library.  A stained mahogany ladder leans against the far wall, the bottom rungs half-buried with a haphazard pile of books and scrolls, the copper-tinged ink bleeding across the margins.  An antler-mounted plaque has been affixed above the red-stained entryway, the sharpened tines dangling in broken angles along the doorframe.

title: [Yvalyst Manor, Garden]
description: Patches of unkempt grass threaten to overwhelm the wire-framed garden beds, the tangle of thorned vines and drooping flower heads creeping towards the chipped marble fountain at the center of the broken cobblestones.  An ivory-colored statue stands within the curved bowl of the fountain, the masculine form's hands cupped upwards as rivulets of water drip down into the basin.  A copse of decaying trees drape over the far corner of the garden, the greyish yellow bark peeling downwards in flayed strips.

title: [Yvalyst Manor, Garden]
description: Tall, brittle grass encircles a dozen toparies, their androgynous forms left in disarray along the fairy ring of dirt and loose rock.  A contorted wall of overgrown briars forms the boundaries of the garden, the uneven hedges leaning precariously inwards, the sharp thorns threatening to engulf the garden beds.  A trio of empty birdbaths sit tangled in vines in the back of the garden, filled with loose feathers intermingled with clumps of dirt.

title: [Yvalyst Manor, Ballroom Alcove]
description: Silver and iron twist artistically between panes of glaesineth, enclosing the entire alcove in glass.  Starlight sparkles through the green-tinged panes, casting eerie shadows across the roses and violets hand-painted along the intricate parquetry floor.  Several candelabra are positioned about the outer walls, the light from their ghost white and blood red tapers casting dim illumination throughout the area.

title: [Sivalis' General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Sivalis' General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Sivalis' General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Gallivant Manor, Foyer]
description: The expansive foyer features mahogany parquet floors accented with marble and a three-story high ceiling.  Symmetrical staircases on either side of an arched doorway curve up to the second floor, and hallways lead into various wings of the mansion.  Hanging from the walls, several cobweb-adorned paintings feature garishly designed scenes of carnivals and funhouses.  A pair of mahogany doors leads out, darkly stained glass windows on either side.

title: [Gallivant Manor, West Hall]
description: The westerly hall stretches several yards, with numerous doors and entryways along each side.  Old paintings are draped with cobweb-covered black cloth, and at the far west end, the glass of a massive window has been painted black.  Tucked discreetly in an alcove is a set of swinging double doors.

title: [Gallivant Manor, Kitchen]
description: The expansive kitchen features a large cherrywood counter topped with cotton candy pink marble at its heart, with numerous cupboards, cabinets, and drawers lining the walls.  A hammered copper stove sits between marble and wood countertops, and amidst the gleaming cleanliness, lingering bits of cobwebs and crimson stains can be seen.  A set of swinging double doors leads out.

title: [Gallivant Manor, East Wing]
description: The easterly hall stretches several yards, with numerous doors and entryways along each side.  Old paintings are draped with cobweb-covered black cloth, and at the far east end, the glass of a massive window has been painted black.  Just beneath the window sits a merry-go-round figurine.  Midway down the hall is a cherrywood arch remarkably free of dust, cobwebs, or signs of aging.

title: [Gallivant Manor, Library]
description: Floor-to-ceiling mahogany bookcases line the walls of the library, with several plump dark leather armchairs scattered in loose semi-circles across the ebon marble and mahogany parquet floor.  A moss-covered slab of slate sits near a marble and mahogany fireplace, and a cherrywood arch leads out.

title: [Under the Manor]
description: Violet-tinged stone walls are dotted with dark green moss, and phosphorescent fungi in wrought iron holders cast the room in a dim glow.  Set up along one wall, an oversized circular board sits upright, with a series of pulleys and gears visible behind it.  A mossy stone box filled with daggers, dirks, and other sharp-bladed instruments sits off to one side, a carved ghostwood sign sticking out of it.  Tucked into a dark corner is a merry-go-round figurine surrounded by tiny, glowing crimson toadstools.Violet-tinged stone walls are dotted with dark green moss, and phosphorescent fungi in wrought iron holders cast the room in a dim glow.  Set up along one wall, an oversized circular board sits upright, with a series of pulleys and gears visible behind it.  A mossy stone box filled with daggers, dirks, and other sharp-bladed instruments sits off to one side, a carved ghostwood sign sticking out of it.  Tucked into a dark corner is a merry-go-round figurine surrounded by tiny, glowing crimson toadstools.

title: [Delirium Giftshop, Front Room]
description: A stuffed pony, outfitted with a brushed leather saddle and secured to a curved wooden base, rocks back and forth as visitors pass through this fancifully decorated entryway.  Long streamers of vividly colored satin hang from the ceiling, some dangling tiny crystalline spheres that spin slowly.  A green and white striped curtain drapes across a wide opening, and a wire basket hangs nearby on the wall.

title: [Delirium Giftshop, Back Room]
description: A wide and colorful banner proclaims, "~Get Your Souvenirs Here~" from its prominent spot along the back wall.  To one side is a souvenir-filled bookcase, complete with a line of stuffed blue bunnies perched along the base and positioned to stare up at the showcased goods.  In the middle of the space rests an elongated carved maple toychest, its lid flung open to better display its contents.

title: [Delirium Giftshop, Storage]
description: A wide and colorful banner proclaims, "~Get Your Souvenirs Here~" from its prominent spot along the back wall.  Toys and various knick-knacks lay scattered across an upholstered bench that is positioned in front of a colorfully decorated mannequin.

title: [Delirium Giftshop, Storage]
description: A wide and colorful banner proclaims, "~Get Your Souvenirs Here~" from its prominent spot along the back wall.  A large wooden doll, decorated with a variety of items, is propped up in the corner just beneath a large notice.

title: [Dollhouse, Mudroom]
description: Colorful shutters painted bright white and trimmed in yellow and green stand open to allow the moonlight to fill the small space, while a bright blue door is propped open by a wedge to allow for easy entry.  Long rows of wooden hooks house a variety of packs and haversacks, while a spindle-armed coat tree supports a motley combination of cloaks and shawls.  Miscellaneous items fill a small wicker basket that is pushed against the archway that leads deeper into the dollhouse.

title: [Dollhouse, Parlor]
description: Resembling more a salon than a parlor, the tiny room has bright yellow and white flowers painted on the walls and tiny teardrop lanterns that dangle from the white rafters.  Couches and settees are pushed to one side so that the center of the living space can proudly display a row of mannequin heads that rests upon a long table.  Tiny jewelry boxes have been placed to the right of each decorated head, while to the left are several paper hat boxes painted with bright red roses.

title: [Dollhouse, Armory]
description: Burgundy and ivory paints create an alternating striped pattern upon the smooth stucco walls of the tidy room, while thick drapes of ebon stand guard around a pair of small windows.  A long wooden stand filled with leg greaves is displayed beneath a row of lanterns, while a small lacquered table houses a variety of matching arm pieces.  Balls of yarn and spools of twine surround a rectangular slatted box filled with mittens, gloves, and gauntlets near a rocking chair that occupies one corner of the small space.

title: [Dollhouse, Kitchen]
description: Bright white cabinets hang upon the walls above polished granite countertops, their tiny faces fitted with brass and ivory handles.  Red checkered curtains flank a window that presides over a tiny stonework sink that is filled with miniature cobalt blue and white dishes.  Pantry shelves display a large glass jar filled with eyes, several large cooking pots filled with ears, and a wide porcelain ewer filled with noses.

title: [Dollhouse, Corridor]
description: Butterflies and daisies paint the white walls with vibrant hues, their tiny designs illuminated by a pair of brightly burning glass globes set at either end of the long corridor.  Sashes laden with pins flank a polished bronze mirror that is hung upon the northern wall, while a small table beneath holds a jeweler's display rack and a cobalt blue blown glass bowl.  A small rug of verdant green muffles the sound of passage leading to a narrow staircase.

title: [Dollhouse, Bedroom]
description: Flanked by round tables topped in vases, a four-poster bed fitted with a gauzy canopy occupies one corner of the seafoam green-painted room.  A steel-edged storage locker at its foot is filled to overflowing with shoes, while a painted oak wardrobe opposite it stands open displaying belts, aprons, and girdles for all to see.  Near the entry, a chest of drawers holds a motley variety of pouches, quivers, kits, and tankards.

title: [Dollhouse, The Vault]
description: Floor length mirrors decorate the paneled walls, which are illuminated by candelabras set in each of the room's four quarters.  At the heart of the room, a round-armed divan fashioned of bright red velvet sits unattended, while a trio of humanoid forms fashioned of wood display rings, bracelets, and anklets.

title: [Dollhouse, Attic]
description: Dust and cobwebs fashioned of spun cotton and bits of string decorate the rafters of the attic, while pale light trickles in through slats that board-up the space's only window.  A pair of painted toy boxes pin an enormous rug of gold, teal, and pink to the dark floorboards, their lids flown wide and their toys on display.

title: [Dollhouse, Backyard]
description: High bushes encircle the quaint backyard that has a fanciful border of paper flowers in a variety of hues.  Wooden birds are propped in decorative cloth and wrought iron trees, their wings painted in brilliant blues and greens.  A long cotton clothesline houses a variety of clothing items supported by clothespins, while a woven wicker hamper beneath is filled with a collection of matched and unmatched socks.  Sitting alone, a deep steel wash basin overflows with miscellaneous armor pieces and props the dollhouse's whitewashed back door wide open.

title: [Delirium Manor, Girls' Privy]
description: A wide bench seat has been placed to cover a dark hole across the back of the privy, a folding step stool before it.  Smoothly sanded to prevent splinters, the surface has been treated with a generous coat of varnish.  A wicker basket upon the bench holds some folded cloths, a bright-eyed yellow-haired doll, and a few illustrated children's books.

title: [Delirium Manor, Boys' Privy]
description: A wide bench seat has been placed to cover a dark hole across the back of the privy, a folding step stool before it.  Smoothly sanded to prevent splinters, the surface has been treated with a generous coat of varnish.  A wicker basket upon the bench holds some folded cloths, a wooden wagon full of painted soldiers, and a few illustrated children's books.

title: [Delirium Manor, Basement]
description: The foul aroma of decay mingles with the heavy, earthy scent of the loose, moist soil underfoot, permeating the area with a nauseating stench.  Some small objects are scattered about, though hard to discern distinctly in the dim available light.  Some rest atop the soil, some poke out from beneath, and still others have been swept into small piles.  Small mounds of loosely packed dirt make the footing disturbingly treacherous.

title: [Delirium Manor, Crawlspace]
description: Clouds of dust and dried rodent feces billow up with even the lightest passing footstep.  Nails protrude downward from the low, slanted roofline overhead, posing significant threat to the taller races.  Perched atop a decapitated rocking horse, a small eyeless troll doll holds on tightly to unattached remnants of reins.

title: [Delirium Manor, Guestroom]
description: Rather austere and uninviting compared to the nearby childrens' rooms, this guestroom has only an adult-sized bed and one small nightstand for furnishings.  A narrow window latticed with iron bars is set high up on the exterior wall.

title: [Delirium Manor, Guestroom]
description: Rather austere and uninviting compared to the nearby childrens' rooms, this guestroom has only an adult-sized bed and one small nightstand for furnishings.  A narrow window latticed with iron bars is set high up on the exterior wall.

title: [Delirium Manor, Garden]
description: Row upon row of neglected sunflowers stretch across the garden.  Pale yellow petals lay curled at their feet, while large and drooping heads hang bereft of seeds.  Fibrous, twine-bound stalks stand erect against tall wooden stakes, like long dead soldiers who can never leave their posts.
