title: [Cigar's General Store]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a carved stone shelf on one side of the shop and an oversized sea chest on the other.

title: [The Giantroad, Pass]
description: Powdery snow blankets the tableland near the northern end of a high pass, glinting in the frigid starlight like diamond dust.  A pale stone roadway, nearly concealed by the shiftless drifts, climbs to follow the rise of the terrain, delving northward toward a shrouded mountain in the distance.  Hardy pines dotting the landscape leaven the sea of white with rare glimpses of rich greenery, standing proud and tall despite the weight of the snowfall.

title: [The Giantroad, Arete]
description: Broken and devoured by time, a road of pale stone loses itself in deep snow as the highland plain gives way to a craggy arete.  To the north, the niveous thread of cultivated roadway reappears as it curves to avoid the white-clad slope of an abutting mountain.  Wind wails through the passes, low, mournful, and musical at once.  It sways the branches of nearby pines into a slow, funereal dance.

title: [The Giantroad, Watcher]
description: Undermined by the relentless prying of snowmelt, a face of the adjacent mountain has sheared away, collapsing into rubble that blocks much of the ancient white roadway.  Revealed by the rockslide, a vast stone figure strains from the wounded mountainside, one cracked hand outstretched as if reaching skyward.  Much of the colossal form is still trapped within the unyielding rock of the mountain.

title: [The Giantroad, Shattered Tower]
description: Judging from the copious jags of rubble poking out of the deep snows, the tower that stands near the western edge of the pale stone road once stretched high into the sky.  It has been brought low, and all that remains is a broken ruin as squat and useless as a spent candle.  What remains of the arched entrance suggests that it was once an entryway of staggering height.

title: [The Giantroad, Gorge]
description: The broken remains of the ancient white road travel up to the jagged rim of a steep gorge.  So deep is the gouge in the earth that its furthest reaches are lost in impenetrable shadow, and it would serve as an impassable hazard save for a colossal stone bridge spanning the chasm.  Though ancient, the carvings on the bridge are deep-graven, depicting preternaturally beautiful figures in a variety of scenes.  Beyond the bridge rises a mountain, its peak lost in the clouds overhead.

title: [The Giantroad, Crystalmount]
description: Accessible only by the virtue of a colossal stone bridge, a broad ledge juts out of one of the lowest faces of a lofty mountain that stretches into the swirling clouds above.  A vast breach yawns out of the cragged mountainside, and lightless gloom beckons beyond.  Despite the snow that heavily blankets the mountain, the space before the ragged aperture is mostly clear.

title: [Crystalmount, Cavern]
description: The faintest hint of starlight filters through a vast yawning breach in the western wall of the cavern, but the tenuous curtain of radiance does little to throw back the surrounding gloom.  It gleams feebly off of puddles of snowmelt near to the entrance, but they proceed into deeper shadow and are consumed by darkness.  Reflected ripples off of the water do not reach the cavern's distant ceiling.

title: [Crystalmount, Cavern]
description: Away from the light of the sun or moons, hints of luminescence thrive within the blackness of the cavern.  Lichen cascades down the smooth-worn stone walls in a dimly glowing tapestry, and the same green-white glow suffuses the few insects that squirm and writhe in the darkness.  Puddles of snowmelt make for a treacherous path through the cumbrous lightlessness.

title: [Crystalmount, Giant Camp]
description: Firelight from the west throws back the shadows, illuminating makeshift shelters erected from logs and stitched skins.  The crude dwellings are huge, but they are dwarfed by the scope of the cavern, the lichen-clad ceiling of which seems impossibly distant.  Great weapons, clubs and axes too large for most humanoids, lean against a near wall, crafted from steel, pine, and pitch.  Sacks of stout leather are heaped together and are brimming with dried provisions.

title: [Crystalmount, Spirit Fire]
description: Flames leap and roar from an immense bonfire built beneath a gap in the cavern ceiling through which the light of the distant stars beckons.  Huge logs and flat boulders are positioned around the pyre's perimeter and have been draped with leather and furs.  The bonfire is fed mostly with pine and spruce, which fill the cavern with the crisp effervescence of burning resin, but neither wood explains the strange bluish cast to the roaring flames.

title: [Crystalmount, Ancient Seal]
description: Glowing curtains of lichen cast strange illumination over a flat cavern wall that is covered with ancient etchings.  Spared the cruelty of the elements, they are deep-graven and simple, featuring long-limbed figures hunting, sowing, and harvesting.  At the center of the wall, a pair of round double doors gleams in the unearthly light, golvern rivets more brilliant than the precious veil iron from which they are predominantly wrought.  The vast entryway is dozens of feet high at its zenith.

title: [Crystalhall, Grand Antechamber]
description: Ancient hexagonal braziers of bronze stand to either side of the immense double doors to the antechamber, their roaring flames casting back the cavern's gloom.  The hewn stone ceiling is inlaid with bands of golvern that are gold against the black of the rock.  Pennants stitched with rampant mules, leaping flames, shards of ice, and other devices fly from polished bronze mounts beneath galleries that overlook the entryway, accompanied by garlands of iceblossom and holly with bright-colored blooms.

title: [Crystalhall, South Gallery]
description: A wide gallery curves in a gentle crescent, following the southern wall of the cavernous hall.  Its northern edge stretches out over a vast chasm that plummets into unleavened darkness, but a masterfully carved railing of hoarbeam stands between the unwary and the pit.  A pathway is formed of cubed cerulean glaes set into the black stone of the gallery walk, intricate golden inlay forming a border between the two.  The stonework is exceptional in its detail and evenness.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Crystalhall, South Gallery]
description: Toward the eastern end of the gallery, huge steps of dark stone descend toward another thoroughfare along the cavern's eastern wall.  Smaller steps have been carved amidst the greater ones to ease the way for folk with shorter strides.  Balconies that are nearly the size of plazas jut out high overhead, supported by graceful arcs of carved stone shaped to resemble clouds and flames.  Hexagonal bronze braziers light the walk, fed by pine wood that fills the air with the effervescent bite of its resin.

title: [Crystalhall, East Gallery]
description: Stones of many colors glint from the eastern wall, forming a sprawling mosaic across the stone face.  The artwork depicts brave voyagers, their features aglow with torchlight, in pitched battle beneath the shadow of a crystal throne.  Light from braziers burning nearby glistens off of the tesserae, scattering rainbows of radiant color across the black stone of the walls and gallery.  A towering golvern statue oversees the splendor, her metallic armor glinting with prismatic reflections.

title: [Crystalhall, Dais Bridge]
description: Richly inlaid with cerulean glaes and braided spirals of gold, a dark bridge arcs out over a fathomless black chasm toward a crystalline dais at the cavern's center.  Hoarbeam railings guard the crossing to either side, and verdant garlands of bright blue iceblossoms and fiery red holly berries wind along the metallic barriers.  Overhead, chandeliers of blue glaes wink with a thousand lights, scattering a constellation of sparkles across the cavern's lofty ceiling.

title: [Crystalhall, South Gallery]
description: Great steps, with smaller ones carved beside them for ease of passage, bridge the space between the southern gallery and another along the cavern's western edge.  The stairway passes beneath a vibrant mural, the considerable and obvious age of which has little dimmed its jewel-bright colors.  Statues positioned along a high balcony take the shape of adventurers ranging in size from halflings to kindred, holding carved torches aloft as if to hold back the dark.

title: [Crystalhall, West Gallery]
description: A majestic cascade of steps joins the western gallery of the hall with its southern mate.  Underfoot, the stones are beautifully inlaid with braids of dark gold that flank inset cubes of vivid blue glaes.  Carved penguins, mules, and snowbirds cavort over the face of the wall, the ornate menagerie flanking a mural occupying much of its span.

title: [Crystalhall, West Gallery]
description: Ornate gold and silver inlay arcs outward in splendorous rays from a pair of double doors in the western wall.  Above the keystone, a crowned cockatrice is picked out in brilliant gilding, its claws outstretched.  Chandeliers of tremendous size hang from the ceiling high overhead, forged from golvern and glaes, holding thousands of beeswax candles aloft.  The air is gently honeyed by their scent, a testament to their number despite the vastness of the hall.

title: [Crystalhall, Dais Bridge]
description: The brilliantly inlaid bridge stretches toward a crystalline dais at the center of the cavern.  To either side, past guarding rails of elegantly carved hoarbeam, is a plummet into the engulfing blackness of the pit below.  Though the chasm's depths are lost to light, the musical rush of water surges up from below in a symphony of splashes and burbles that echo off of the distant subterranean rock.

title: [Crystalhall, West Gallery]
description: A painstakingly detailed relief looms over the bend of the gallery as its crescent mirrors the curve of the cavern wall.  Brilliant reds and flashes of silver-gilt punctuate a scene of battle between massive creatures in a snow-covered wood, with many of the combatants standing taller than the surrounding trees.  A lazily arcing bridge joins the gallery with one along the northern wall, its railing of bluish silver hoarbeam carved with an artful runic pattern.

title: [Crystalhall, North Gallery]
description: A pale stone weapons rack at the gallery's western end appears to be mostly ornamental in function.  The weapons on it have a look of great age, their hafts and handles worn as smooth as glass, but their blades are oiled and sharp in a display of obvious care.  Silver-fringed banners in black, teal, and a variety of other colors boast an assemblage of heraldic sigils, but a dark blue banner emblazoned with a rampant mule is given pride of place.

title: [Crystalhall, North Gallery]
description: As imperious as it is dazzling to look upon, a dragon of white and blue diamond tesserae adorns the zenith of an arch framing some tall golvern-framed double doors in the northern wall.  Standing to either side are lofty figures of golvern.  The twin warriors stand with their hands on downturned greatswords, the features of their faces mostly lost to the shadows near to the cavern's ceiling.  Even further overhead, a massive chandelier adorned with glistening stones casts flickering spills of light over the cavern ceiling.

title: [Crystalhall, Dais Bridge]
description: A translucent vein of rich cerulean glaes runs evenly down the central length of the bridge as it arcs over the dizzying chasm, chased by inlaid gold.  Only the blazing chandeliers above permit any estimation of distance from the high, worked stone ceiling of the cavern.  Hoarbeam rails flank the bridge to keep unwary travelers from the cavernous depths to either side.

title: [Crystallhall, Grand Dais]
description: The great dais at the center of the cavern is a sparkling hexagonal confection of icy blue glaes.  A constellation of golden flecks winks from within the depths of the stone.  Four bridges arc away from the platform in each of the cardinal directions, anchoring it to crescent-shaped galleries arcing along the walls of the great cavern.  Tall steps climb toward a crystalline glaes throne at the center of the expansive platform.  Its shadow stretches over a quintet of newer seats cut from the same crystal.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Crystalhall, Dais Bridge]
description: Overhead, ancient chandeliers hold candles beyond count.  Their flickering radiance awakens icy blue glints in a broad vein of razern in the cavern's ceiling, evidently preserved on purpose as the walls and ceiling were hewn by the hall's builders.  The languid arc of a black stone bridge inlaid with blue glaes and pure gold joins the dais to the west with a wide gallery to the east.

title: [Crystalhall, East Gallery]
description: Above the some tall golvern-framed double doors in the eastern wall, a trapezoid of foreign stone stands out against the smooth-hewn native rock.  Black as night and shot through with veins of silver, the decoration adorns the lintel over the doorway.  Nearby, a carved Ossian pine totem has been erected, its wood painted with a riot of striking colors, and a bowl full of wintercrisp apples, iceblossoms, and resting poppies at its base.

title: [Crystalhall, East Gallery]
description: The gallery comes to an end before a spectacular waterfall fountaining with a roar from a cleft in the northeastern wall.  A polished stone chandelier hangs from hefty chains, its light turning the deluge's spray into a shifting curtain of prismatic particles.  A black stone bench traced with spirals of gold has been erected near the hoarbeam rail to face the flow, providing an excellent vantage to observe nature's might.

title: [Crystalhall, Suite]
description: Rearing basilisk statues proceed down the length of the hallway, staring down from niches along its even march.  Their jeweled eyes glint in the torchlight illuminating the passage.  Pillars of glaes twined with intricate golden tracery stretch up into the darkness, uniting into arches far overhead.  Underfoot, the floor tiles are slabs of igneous stone, evenly fitted together to show nary a seam.  Double doors in the eastern wall are framed by concentric rings of gilt.

title: [Crystalhall, Suite]
description: A silver-fringed banner of stoutfoot wool hangs from the western wall, its field embroidered with a rampant mule.  Before it stands a petrified wood desk and a comfortable chair.  The desk looks to have once been shattered into chunks, but it has been joined together by veins of dark silver.  A granite tablet sits atop the desk, riddled through with cracks but still intact.  Nacreous bands of metal stretch down the walls, twisting into intricate weaves to the north and south.

title: [Crystalhall, Chamber]
description: Opalescent stone clashes with dark, igneous rock along the smooth-hewn walls, forming beautiful interlocking shapes reminiscent of a thicket of brambles.  The chamber's doors are forged from bright golvern, their aureate hue amplified by the dancing flames of torches along the chamber's perimeter.  Barrels of provisions and crates of building materials crowd the space, seeming ill-fit for its splendor.

title: [Crystalhall, Sanctuary]
description: Cerulean pillars of glaes march evenly away from the doors, proceeding down the torchlit hallway.  The light reveals the hazy forms of preserved flowers trapped in the depths of the glass.  Mosaics along the walls depict preternaturally beautiful beings, each outlined in an aura of gemstone tesserae.  Twin fountains fill the air with the musical burble of falling water.  Their basins are tiled with jewels, and the water within is cold and clear.

title: [Crystalhall, Sanctuary]
description: Atop a tiered dais of white rock stands the ruined remnant of a runestone.  The monument resembles a spent candle, the stone melted and bubbled as if devoured by great heat.  Silver streaks traveling through the black stone glint like moonlight off of a flowing river.  Pale orbs of ancient crystal are set into the ceiling.  Silvery light spills down with a brilliance that outshines the nearby torches.  The radiance illuminates deep-graven carvings on the glossy stone walls.

title: [Crystalhall, Sanctuary]
description: The hallway comes to the end in a curved niche featuring a sprawling mural, the naturally rich colors of the pigments augmented by gemstone dust and gilt.  Within the image, a majestic woman with troubled features and golden eyes holds a pair of tablets aloft, one dark and one light.  Nacreous bands of metal cavort across the walls and frame the murals, seeming to glow faintly with their own inner light.

title: [Crystalhall, Sanctuary]
description: A rounded niche at the end of the hallway features a mural of monumental size that depicts a chaotic battle.  Draconic figures clash with vile beings of glittering shadow, their war sprawling across a burning sky.  The stones of the near wall are newer than their neighbors, their edges not yet smoothed by the passage of centuries.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Pioneer Court]
description: Stately houses with old stone facades line the street as it ends in a small cobblestone court.  Their sprawling estates are dotted with pine trees, and in one yard, a garden full of colorful flowers thrives near the banks of a steaming hot spring.  One manse at the northernmost edge of the circle has gates of pale holly inlaid with walnut, a path of flagstones beyond shaded by old pine trees festooned with bright garlands.

title: [The Frostmain, Seal Point]
description: Braying barks fill the air, rising from a bob of indolent seals who have claimed the black sand beach as their own.  Nearby, but still at a safe distance from the eyes of the judgmental pinnipeds, an open-air workroom has been constructed from pine and pitch on a short dock jutting over the water.  Several damaged boats are moored or dry-docked close to the structure.

title: [Magical Burrow, Illusionist Way]
description: The shadow of the town's wall looms over the end of the way, casting the dreary collection of homes and storefronts into darkness.  Street lamps etched with reliefs of strange figures burn brightly, colluding with the sunlight to cast back the shadow, but they are hampered in their efforts by the cold fog that chokes the cobbled road.  Most of the houses along the way are large and old, heavy curtains drawn to preserve the privacy of their owners.

title: [Magical Burrow, Knocker's Close]
description: Stately manses with slate-shingled rooftops stand far from the road, their walks protected by severe gates of black steel.  One such gate has a gargoyle's head sprouting from the stone lintel above, its black glass eyes glittering malevolently in the daylight.  Many of the houses sport evergreen hedge mazes in their yards as if to further thwart any callers boorish enough to come for a casual visit.

title: [Hint of Krint]
description: Glossy blue slate, lacquered to resemble ice, stretches across the floor of the shop, reflecting the ambient light of the corner-built fireplace and giving the space a warm, soft glow.  Grey stone walls decorated with heavy tapestries support the exposed beam ceiling, while a long wooden counter faces the entry and is draped with various pelts, hides, and fabrics for customers to peruse.  A standing tapestry loom and a birch curing rack occupy spaces on opposite sides of the fireplace.

title: [Icemule Trace, Winter Garden]
description: Partially enclosed by pale stone walls glinting with fingers of frost, the garden is shielded from much of the adjacent town center's din.  Bright winter roses in a splendor of frigid hues scale the walls in profusion, their thorny stems green despite a tracery of silvery rime.  At the center of the close stands a blue and white pavilion, its mule-printed pennants languidly waving in the breeze.  Near to the entrance, modwir bench sits by the entrance of a recessed shrine.

title: [Winter Rose Garden, Shrine]
description: Carved from pale marble that blushes faintly blue in the light of ensconced torches, the walls and arching roof of the shrine are carved with a multitude of winter roses.  The etched flowers are subtly tinted with various shades of red.  Beneath a teardrop-shaped arch of fine filigreed silver, a pale maiden statue stands with her hands raised, looking down at the kneeling forms of several statuary halflings.

title: [Icemule Trace, Meeting Pavilion]
description: Banners of blue and white frame a mule-printed tent flap marking the entrance to the spacious pavilion.  Supported by a central pillar of hoarbeam that is heavily carved with penguins, polar bears, and wolves, the enclosed space is heated and perfumed by a number of pierced censers hanging from the support beams by chains of iron.  The eastern quadrant of the pavilion is dominated by a raised pine stage festooned with blue and white banners with a weathered spruce podium at the front.

title: [Icemule Trace, Meeting Pavilion]
description: Several chairs upholstered in shades of blue and stitched with prancing penguins sit toward the western end of the pavilion in an intimate circle.  Behind them, a blizzard granite brazier cradles a small but merry fire that warms the surroundings and makes the chairs' shadows dance.  A wolf fur rug is laid out in the center of the circle.

title: [Icemule Trace, Meeting Pavilion]
description: Blue and white banners embroidered with rampant mules in cool colors hang over a sumptuous array of dishes and drinks crowding the top of a wide hoarbeam table.  An ice sculpture at the table's center depicts adventurers banding together against an immense winged manticore.  Several chairs are positioned near the buffet, upholstered in pale blue wool and patterned with tiny snowflakes.

title: [New Look, Hair Coloration]
description: The canvas walls of this small pavilion are hung with carefully tied bundles of hair in a variety of colors.  A vat of lye sits next to the pinned-back tent flap, but even that extra ventilation isn't enough to keep the harsh vapors from stinging your eyes.  Casually stacked on a low counter are bowls of henna paste, vinegar, sodden ashes, and dark ink.

title: [New Look, Haircuts]
description: An old chair with a wobbly leg takes up most of the space under this crooked awning.  A string has been tied from the side of the tent to a post stuck in the ground, and dangling from it are dull-looking shears and carving knives.  Drifts of shorn hair cover the ground, forming hummocks and valleys of blond and brunette.

title: [New Look, Hair Adornment]
description: In this shaded walkway between the three tents is a round iron table supporting a jar of brushes and a few pots of dye.  A cedar box full of bone hairpins and narrow strips of leather has been left right on the ground, in danger of being kicked over by a clumsy foot.

title: [New Look, Hairdressing]
description: Here in the back corner of the pavilion a makeshift station has been set up to wash, dirty, curl, straighten, braid, loosen, and otherwise fuss with all kinds of hair.  Jumbled together in a crate are bottles of olive oil, combs, ribbons and pins.  Wood-handled irons are propped over a small fire pit, and the smoke has started to fill the enclosed space.

title: [New Look, Skin Care]
description: Wooden screens divide this large tent into smaller spaces, but they don't block the howls of agony coming from every corner.  A raised pallet partially obscured by a thin gauze curtain rests conveniently near a set of freestanding shelves.  Stored haphazardly therein are cyclamen roots, a bowl of birch sap, some sheep dung, a bottle of lemon juice, and a tub of quicklime.

title: [New Look, Short and Tall]
description: Here inside the tent, the light wicker frame that provides support is just visible between the wool blankets used to help muffle sound.  A massive apparatus bearing a strong resemblance to a stretching rack is dwarfed only by a device whose purpose seems to involve a great deal of crushing and compacting.  Stuck into the ground is a tall pole marked off at intervals with red paint.

title: [New Look, Eye Colors]
description: The rivulets of blood trickling down the legs of a crude operating table give some indication of the unpleasantness of this procedure.  Thick glass jars are stacked three deep, each one packed full of preserved eyes with their optic nerves still attached.  A very sharp-looking scalpel has been left at the foot of the table, ready for further use.

title: [New Look, Eye Enhancements]
description: Lancets, needles, razors, and scalpels have been laid out in tidy arrays atop a narrow chest of drawers.  A solid oak chair fitted with many leather straps is pushed up against the flimsy wooden screen.  The sole nod to cleanliness appears to be a bowl of wine used to soak the instruments between uses.

title: [New Look, Nasal Sculpting]
description: This small corner has been festively decorated with sketches of noses, illustrating a wide variety of shapes and sizes.  The cheeriness is broken, however, by the display of instruments used to achieve these many effects.  A chest full of neatly-rolled bandages and a basket of brown eggs sit at the ready.

title: [New Look, Distinctive Marks]
description: The strange emptiness of this portion of the tent gives it an even more ominous feel.  The only object is an upright wooden box just large enough to contain one person.  Its narrow door latches solidly on the outside.

title: [New Look, Facial Repair]
description: A series of shaped wooden frames with adjustable metal screws have been fixed at head height in front of a row of straight-backed chairs.  They all face the near wall of the tent, where inspirational phrases have been painted in bright, cheery colors.  A few of the protruding screws still show traces of former users.

title: [Zul Logoth Tobacconist]
description: Compact even for a dwarf, this tiny shop is filled with display cases that create a little maze.  Small bottles, jars, and tins of all types and sizes line the shelves on the wall behind a heavy-set dwarf who patiently sits on the other side of a low counter.  Potted glowing toadstools have been strategically placed around the shop to provide subdued lighting.  Rich, earthy scents of tobacco fill the air.

title: [Below Deck]
description: Weathered iron slats crisscross one another to form a sturdy cage that has a matching door with an enormous lock fitted into it.  Lights are visible beyond the open metal walls, the bright yellow light providing a modicum of illumination.  A rain barrel, fed from a run-off that disappears through the ceiling, sits in one corner, while a wide bench appears to serve as a bed.

title: [Schoolhouse, Classroom]
description: Rows of benches fill the center portion of the classroom, most of them neatly arranged together.  A desk stands at the front of the room, its surface organized with stacks of parchment and books.  In the back of the classroom, a few satchels and bags have been left by their owners who were obviously in a rush to leave for home.

title: [Kraken Collective, Outcast Hall]
description: Carved into the stoic cliffs, this hideout emerges, its structure an assemblage of shipwreck remnants.  Sun-bleached walls rise to a vaulted ceiling, lined with portholes allowing a view of the sky through the lush canopies.  In the heart of the chamber, a masterfully carved war table stands ensconced by chairs assembled from salvaged ship wood.  One wall is adorned by a forged stove, while on another, a well-worn dart board hangs, made of aged wood and ringed by scores of near-misses.

title: [Office of the Registrar]
description: The hardwood floor of this office is warmed by a soft beige rug.  A sturdy wooden lectern sits on a round oak table, over which hangs a framed landscape, showing the view of the Eye of V'Tull as seen from sea.

title: [Borthuum Deed Conveyance]
description: A single chair sits next to a wide shelf that holds two stacks of paper, one stamped "Processed" in bright red ink.  Several writing implements and an oil lamp arranged between the two piles sit next to a glaes bowl filled with fresh flowers.

title: [Bungalow, Living Space]
description: Spacious and tidy, the floor of the living space is fashioned of polished oak and covered with a herringbone woven bamboo mat edged by a plaited band of natural sea grass rush.  Colorful artwork decorates one beadboard wall, the pieces hanging above a copious amount of bamboo barstools featuring plush rattan-backed seats flanked by a thatch-roofed tropical bamboo bar surrounded by a plethora of vibrant flora.  Near the open archway to the kitchen, a modest cocobolo writing desk and cocobolo bench rest beneath a copper lantern, while in the opposite corner a ladder leads to the second floor near the open door.

title: [Bungalow, Kitchen]
description: Surrounded by storm-shutters, a pair of glass-paned windows looks out onto the beach from their position along the northern wall.  Beneath the viewing portals, a farm-style stone wash basin is recessed into a long counter, while the walls above and to either side are filled with white cupboards.  Resting at the heart of the kitchen upon blue and yellow-checked tiles is an intricately carved whitewashed ko'nag trestle table surrounded by wicker-seated chairs.

title: [Bungalow, Loft]
description: Stretching from one end of the space to the other, exposed rafters support the peaked ceiling and are strung with several luminescent crystalline orbs dangling from opalescent vaalin wire.  A white-washed wooden canopy bed draped with pristine netting rests against the flat northern wall where a decorative carving hangs over its headboard and a large wooden footlocker rests against its footboard.  Spindled balusters support a small railing that overlooks the room below, a nearby ladder providing egress.

title: [Bungalow, Living Space]
description: Spacious and tidy, the floor of the living space is fashioned of polished oak and covered with a simple throw rug.  Colorful artwork decorates one beadboard wall, the pieces hanging above a wide couch flanked by a sturdy end table.  Near the open archway to the kitchen, an exquisite fly-tying workbench and a soft dog bed rest beneath a copper lantern, while in the opposite corner a ladder leads to the second floor near the open door.
location: Bungalow at Nereid's Cradle, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Bungalow, Kitchen]
description: Surrounded by storm-shutters, a pair of glass-paned windows looks out onto the beach from their position along the northern wall.  Beneath the viewing portals, a farm-style stone wash basin is recessed into a long counter, while the walls above and to either side are filled with white cupboards.  Resting at the heart of the kitchen upon blue and yellow-checked tiles is an unadorned table surrounded by wicker-seated chairs.
location: Bungalow at Nereid's Cradle, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Bungalow, Loft]
description: Stretching from one end of the space to the other, exposed rafters support the peaked ceiling and are strung with dried herbs and flowers.  A carved wooden bed rests against the flat northern wall where a diminutive handcarved elf-owl nesting box hangs over its headboard and a large wooden footlocker rests against its footboard.  Spindled balusters support a small railing that overlooks the room below, a nearby ladder providing egress.
location: Bungalow at Nereid's Cradle, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Bungalow, Living Space]
description: Spacious and tidy, the floor of the living space is fashioned of polished oak and covered with a simple throw rug.  Colorful artwork decorates one beadboard wall, the pieces hanging above a golden teakwood sofa covered in marshmallow-hued pillows flanked by a sturdy end table.  Near the open archway to the kitchen, a plain oak desk and wooden chair rest beneath a copper lantern, while in the opposite corner a ladder leads to the second floor near the open door.
location: Bungalow at Nereid's Cradle, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

description: You are in the center of a high domed chamber whose polished crystal walls cast infinite reflections around you.  The shifting, kaleidoscopic images created by the prisms confuse you and make it impossible to tell shadow from substance.

title: [Tartan Suite]
description: The tent's center pole rises twice the height of a tall giantman, while the outer canvas walls are roughly two-thirds as high.  Displayed around the perimeter are lengths of wool cloth in a variety of colorful tartans.  A large table occupies the center of the room, its surface cluttered with sewing implements, cloth remnants, and a few unfinished garments.

title: [In The Rough]
description: Scraps of furs and leathers cover the ground to keep the dust and dirt in the air to a minimum.  A suede-lined oak jewelry case sits off to the side of the tent, while a simple oak shelf mounted on a support pole sits nearer to path deeper into the shop.

title: [In The Rough]
description: The scent of tanned leathers and furs hangs heavy in the air in this part of the tent, as across many an oak frame, hides in various stages of tanning are stretched out.  Against the far wall of the tent sits a solid oak clothing rack, and adjacent to it is a low dark oak boot stand.

title: [The Fitted Spiral]
description: Sheets of heavy brown wool create a barrier between the chilly hilltop and the relative warmth of the brazier-filled structure.  Loose straw is scattered about the ground, the fresh rushes filling the air with an herbaceous scent.  Oak chairs line the walls beneath the warm glow of brass-sided lanterns that offer illumination for the wares available on the various mahogany trestles that support display planks throughout the space.

title: [Turning the Beholder's Eye]
description: Supported by a trio of barkless birch saplings, the conical-topped tent is fashioned of heavy rackhal dyed in bands of cerulean and ebon.  Raw-edged rugs of rakkein with the fleece still attached are scattered about the ground, covering the hardpacked dirt and creating an insulation that keeps the chill of the exterior at bay.  Low rough oak tables near the entry display a variety of wares that are for sale.

title: [A Hide and Leather Tent]
description: Heavy hides and leather drape across a split log frame to create this small tent.  Relatively unadorned, the interior is lit by a single oil lamp, and the packed dirt floor is covered at the center by a sleek puma fur rug.

title: [Big And Tall]
description: The walls of the wagon are painted in brilliant gold and blue hues, illuminated by glass lanterns hung from the beams overhead.  Numerous trophies from assorted animals are hung on the wall, including a large collection of rolton horns mounted above a brass plaque.  Threadbare carpets cover the wooden floor of the wagon.

title: [Black Wind Spirits]
description: The near weightless plaid walls of this tent occasionally billow out with passing gusts of wind, struggling against the stakes rooted in the ground to prevent their freedom.  Overhead, oil lanterns burn, long flames behind glass shades, imparting to the air a musty scent that mixes with the aroma of rich alcohol.

title: [The Plaid Initiative]
description: Hexagonal pieces of rakkein are bound together with thick catgut and tethered to tall naked yew poles to create a domed tent with a shielded opening in its peak.  Braziers of copper and bronze are evening spaced throughout the large expanse to provide a comfortable warmth that is a contrast to the chill of its exterior.  Long mahogany racks are arranged along the walls, the tartan fabrics therein neatly folded and pinned for display purposes.

title: [Plaid Initiative, Lantern-side]
description: Further from the entry and away from the shielded opening at the peak of the tent, lanterns have been attached to the support posts to provide illumination for the wares on display.  The lamplight cast dark shadows against the bound hexagonal rakkein, highlighting the glossy surface where a weather retardant has been applied.  Several mahogany trestles provide support to long planks that are laden with a variety of tartan fabrics.

title: [Faces of the Ancestors]
description: Stone grey and tightly bound at the seams, the heavy woolen walls of the tent form a cocoon-like enclosure around a small firepit ringed in smooth stones.  Several wickerwork containers line the walls, while bundled pallets offer sitting places closer to the warmth of the fire.  The hardpacked ground is covered with rakkein pelts, their woolly faces turned upward so that the fleece provides a comfortable cushion.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Frozen Glade]
description: Ringed by snow-dusted conifers, this quiet little glade is situated near the main gathering area.  The thick, shaggy trees form a windbreak against the biting breezes, as well as a baffle that dampens noise from the adjacent festival grounds.  Littering the ice-crusted ground are crisscrossing footprints that indicate numerous visitors.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Frozen Glade]
description: Ringed by snow-dusted conifers, this quiet little glade is situated near the main gathering area.  The thick, shaggy trees form a windbreak against the biting breezes, as well as a baffle that dampens noise from the adjacent festival grounds. title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Frozen Glade]
description: Ringed by snow-dusted conifers, this quiet little glade is situated near the main gathering area. Littering the ice-crusted ground are crisscrossing footprints that indicate numerous visitors.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Plains]
description: Damaged hammers with split handles and discarded shafts are carelessly tossed into a small clearing.  Strung up between two pine trees, a rope hammock provides a place to relax.  Numerous hammers are evident not too far away in the ruins of a pumpkin patch.  Frost covers the smashed pulp.  Written in block letters, a large warning sign is posted on nearby poles.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Plains]
description: Benches are scattered beneath trees for shade and protection from inclement weather.  Devoid of snow and grass, large rocks lined up on the ground mark out lanes that lead up to bald spots on the land enclosed with stones in a circular pattern.  A large 'X' painted in white is at the heart of the ring.  To the sides of the tracks are huge racks holding hammers with different-sized handles.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Plains]
description: Lacking grass and snow, strips of land have been cleared off and marked out with huge stones, forming wide paths that lead to barren patches of ground enclosed with stones in round patterns.  At the heart of the circle, a huge 'X' has been painted in white paint.  Beneath the canvas are multiple wooden stands housing hammers with an assortment of different handles.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Plains]
description: Bolted to a tree trunk above a stand of hammers, a large piece of wood with names and numbers written in a bold hand serves as a memorial.  Barren of snow and grass, large rocks lined up on the ground mark out lanes that lead up to bald spots on the land enclosed with stones in a circular pattern.  A large 'X' painted in white is at the heart of the ring.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Lake View]
description: Stretching out to the north, a sea of silver-barked aspens, leaves shimmering with the breeze, meets a distant lake.  Mists rise from the dark waters, obscuring the shoreline.  The majestic peaks of the Dragonspine wrap around the scene as the range pushes off from the east towards the northwest.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Outcrop]
description: Slate rock peeks out and forms a hazardous looking stairway on the hilltop, where snow and ice covers the exposed roots of trees that dangle precariously over the ledge.  Icicles of noteworthy size suspended on the tips of branches sway ominously back and forth.  Along the overly used trail, ice has formed in many of the deep grooves in the ground, making travel difficult.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Ridge]
description: Standing on this side of the chasm, about half a dozen felled trees are visible behind those that dangle over the ledge.  Perfect footprints are filled with muddy water along the pathway.  Off in the distance, only the thatched roof of a cottage is visible as white smoke wafts lazily into the air from its smokestack.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Arena Nexus]
description: The surrounding area holds a semi-circle of wooden benches, each adjacent to its own challenge arena.  Behind the benches, a small copse of ribbon-bedecked fir trees lends a festive atmosphere to the site, and offers a slight break from frigid breezes.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Arena]
description: Discarded bandages, bloodstained splints, and other refuse litter the ground beside some warped wooden benches that serve as viewing stands for the action in an adjacent circular ring.  In pairs and small groups, challengers come and go as they wait for an opportunity to settle old scores or flex their muscles in friendly matchups within the ring.  Occasionally, moans, groans, and insensible mutterings can be heard as defeated competitors are dragged here to recover and restore their wounded pride.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Holding Area]
description: Discarded bandages, bloodstained splints, and other refuse litter the ground beside some splintered wooden benches that serve as viewing stands for the action in an adjacent circular ring.  In pairs and small groups, challengers come and go as they wait for an opportunity to settle old scores or flex their muscles in friendly matchups within the ring.  Occasionally, moans, groans, and insensible mutterings can be heard as defeated competitors are dragged here to recover and restore their wounded pride.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Arena Stands]
description: Discarded bandages, bloodstained splints, and other refuse litter the ground beside some stained wooden benches that serve as viewing stands for the action in an adjacent circular ring.  In pairs and small groups, challengers come and go as they wait for an opportunity to settle old scores or flex their muscles in friendly matchups within the ring.  Occasionally, moans, groans, and insensible mutterings can be heard as defeated competitors are dragged here to recover and restore their wounded pride.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Holding Area]
description: Discarded bandages, bloodstained splints, and other refuse litter the ground beside some sturdy wooden benches that serve as viewing stands for the action in an adjacent circular ring.  In pairs and small groups, challengers come and go as they wait for an opportunity to settle old scores or flex their muscles in friendly matchups within the ring.  Occasionally, moans, groans, and insensible mutterings can be heard as defeated competitors are dragged here to recover and restore their wounded pride.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Holding Area]
description: Discarded bandages, bloodstained splints, and other refuse litter the ground beside some faded wooden benches that serve as viewing stands for the action in an adjacent circular ring.  In pairs and small groups, challengers come and go as they wait for an opportunity to settle old scores or flex their muscles in friendly matchups within the ring.  Occasionally, moans, groans, and insensible mutterings can be heard as defeated competitors are dragged here to recover and restore their wounded pride.

title: [Black Wind Spirits]
description: Front and center in this area of the tent is a square cloth-covered table, over which is a low-hanging lantern that spills amber light across the wares.  Affixed to a support pole further in is a sturdy row of pegs, catching just the edge of the circle of light cast by the lantern.

title: [Black Wind Spirits]
description: Right up against the back wall of the tent is a sturdy row of pegs mounted on a support pole.  Between the pegs and a square cloth-covered table is a cluster of small oil lanterns, their numbers creating a warm glow throughout this corner of the tent.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Western View]
description: Not too far to the west, a broad river sweeps across the region.  The thick mist covering the water occasionally parts to reveal rushing torrents of rapids, as the river pounds its way toward the human empire at the edge of the horizon.  Aspens, though sparse, grow between the hill and the river, and are intermingled with other trees.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Riverside]
description: Stirring the contents on the bottom of a nearby pool and giving the water a ruddy tea color, a torrent of water steadily drains from the melting snows of a precipice above into the basin of the river.  Tall reeds breech the water's surface, and even more crushed reeds blanket the water's edge.  Tracks leading to and from the river from both large and small creatures are in evidence.

title: [Aspen Woods, River Path]
description: An old yet sturdy dock juts into a calm section of the mighty river here.  On the opposite shore, a similar construction stands.  Fairly overgrown, the remnants of a wagon path lead up a high hill standing amid a sea of aspen trees.  The scene is cloaked in a low mist which slowly undulates up from the river, spreading out across the land.

title: [Aspen Woods, Forest River]
description: Winding though a labyrinth of aspens, a quiet river of crystal blue water flows strongly through the wood.  A series of elaborately constructed rowboats lay beached in disarray nearby, their gunwales hacked apart and hulls pierced with crudely made black-fletched arrows.  Whatever happened, it was long ago, as the boats and their fletched adornments are in an advanced state of decay.

title: [Aspen Woods, Forest Lake]
description: Cradled amid a thick grove of aspen trees is a vast lake, its water a deep blue hue and rippling with the stiff breeze blowing in from the north.  A towering waterfall fills the lake from the east as the water cascades down from the Dragonspine snowmelt.  Meanwhile, a swift river exits the lake to the west, winding its way into the wilderness.  Slowly rotting away, an abandoned dock on the lake's shore bears testament that the area was perhaps once inhabited.

title: [Dragonspine, Mountain Path]
description: Although this particular trail comes to an abrupt end, further ahead is a treacherous path that careens down the western side of the Dragonspine.  Crumbling into ruin, the track is time-worn and long abandoned.  At the bottom, a vast forest of aspens spreads forth to the west, while the upper portion of the path vanishes into a snow-laden pass.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Open Field]
description: A number of oak benches are nestled between snowbanks at the edges of a barren stretch of ground.  Scattered about the ground are long sections of stout rope, many of them now frayed and rotting.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Open Field]
description: A number of monir benches are nestled between snowbanks at the edges of a barren stretch of ground.  Scattered about the ground are long sections of stout rope, many of them now frayed and rotting.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Open Field]
description: A number of haon benches are nestled between snowbanks at the edges of a barren stretch of ground.  Scattered about the ground are long sections of stout rope, many of them now frayed and rotting.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Open Field]
description: A number of tanik benches are nestled between snowbanks at the edges of a barren stretch of ground.  Scattered about the ground are long sections of stout rope, many of them now frayed and rotting.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Tug of War]
description: A ring of iron basket torches illuminate two large semi-circular patches of bare ground that bracket a pit in the center of the field.  Discarded bits of rope, in various states of decay, lie scattered on the ground.  Nearby benches provide a viewing area for spectators and a red and blue sign is prominently placed at the edge of a field.

title: [Mist Harbor Forge, Entrance]
description: A thick, heavy atmosphere fills the air with the acrid scent of smoldering metal.  A stone hallway leads towards several forging workshops opposite a steel-banded ironwood door that serves as an exit.  Dominating the far wall, a large placard crafted from wrought iron proudly showcases the forge's emblem, depicting a roaring furnace surrounded by a tapestry of intricately forged weapons and armor.  Lined up against a wall, a large steel workbench with several tools lies in disrepair.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Cavern]
description: At the end of a twisting warren of narrow caves, the cold and lightless delve into the earth reaches a series of wider, less claustrophobic tunnels.  Signs of intentional excavation exist in the jagged stone jutting from the ground and walls.  The air cold and still, but there is a faint odor on the air reminiscent of stale vinegar.  Fungus grows thick on the walls, but its faint blue-green phosphorescence does little to hold back the dark.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Bridge]
description: The floor of the bridge of black granite is largely free of debris larger than a stray stone, but cracks and crevices lurk in the unleavened darkness.  Glowing fungus drapes the near walls, climbing in shimmering veils toward crumbling passages hidden in the darkness above, but the rock is slick and treacherous, offering no sure handholds.  The fungus's natural light is feeble and extends less than a finger's breadth from its surface, as if the oppressive darkness were conspiring to hold back its radiance.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Column]
description: Rising out of the smooth-worn floor of the tunnel is a massive mineral column as big around as a mighty oak.  It spreads into thick branches as it reaches the ceiling of the cavern before finally merging with the darker stone there.  Veins of the same pale stone wind through the walls of ubiquitous black granite.  Despite the stillness of the air currents, faint snatches of a scent like stale vinegar waft through the air in unpleasant drifts.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Cavern]
description: Ribbons of calcite in dusky orange and dried blood hues wind away from a rust-colored speleothem on the ceiling.  The rock formation looms down over the passageway like the descending fangs of some vast and hungering beast.  To the east, a ledge dips down into the inky shadows of a formless chamber below, the edges of stalagmites visible only from the faint sheen of fungus clinging to the rock.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Cavern]
description: Stalagmites jut from the uneven floor of the cavern, their jagged tips pointing unerringly at a rolling ceiling of black granite that is mostly lost in the darkness.  A clear path through the forest of stone bends toward a rough ledge.  Phosphorescent fungi glow in profusion, but their light is wan and silvery, making it look as if the rock formations are bathed in a veil of faint starlight.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Cavern]
description: Water drips in the distance, its beat slow and patient.  The work of the intrusive moisture is evident all around.  White flowstones drip down from higher ledges in the cavern like wax from a spent candle, their moisture-slicked lengths offering no purchase for aspiring climbers.  The silhouettes of stalagmites fill the darkness, lit only by the faint silvery glow of the fungus scaling them.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Cavern]
description: The sickly sweet stench of decay rises from the sloughing corpse of an immense worm, which is draped over a ledge that overlooks a dark sea of stalagmites.  Fungi and mushrooms have raced to consume the fallen monstrosity and grow in profusion across the folds of its rotting flesh.  The rock of the cavern floor is cracked around the corpse, evidently shattered during the beast's death throes.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Cavern]
description: The tail end of an immense vermiform corpse hangs over a short ledge leading to a tunnelway above.  Rancid sweetness fills the air, rising from the creature's vitrifying flesh and dissolving organs.  Life has sprung up in the wake of death, taking the form of countless mushrooms thriving on the lifeless body.  Most of the fungi are pale, but a few are imbued with splashes of color, from electric blues to pearlescent greens.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Cavern]
description: The tireless dripping of subterranean water, brackish and cold, has worn rivulets out of the floor as it approaches a low cliffside descending to a lower portion of the cavern.  Little pools ripple with each falling droplet, none deeper than a handspan.  The water lends a faint mineral tang to the air that is sweetened by the unpleasant perfume of rot drifting from somewhere nearby.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Lake]
description: Flat stones stand in short stacks along the western edge of a black lake.  The water has a brackish, mineral smell, but it appears clear and cold.  Winding, serpentine patterns wind through the grit of the shore, partially consumed by the wash of the waves.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Lake]
description: Waves that are barely more than ripples roll along the surface of the underground lake, driven by the unseen currents of the frigid water.  The ruins of a small boat lie on the rocky shore, far beyond the grasp of the water.  Mushrooms and lichen have spread over the wood as if eager to devour it.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Tunnelway]
description: The cavern's ceiling droops precipitously toward a narrow tunnel in the west.  Water drips from the jagged mouth in an even patter, giving the impression of a maw trailing drips of saliva.  A patch of small crystals sprouts from the ground near the aperture.  Murky yellow light flickers fitfully in the depths of the multifaceted gems, casting a winking luminescence over shallow pools of water occupying depressions in the rough ground.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Labyrinth]
description: Breaches in the cragged ceiling reveal a winding bridge of stone passing over the tunnel as it delves deeper into the earth.  Both are illuminated by cascades of glowing fungus that drape the walls, thriving off of the moisture and mineral-rich stone.  Despite the profusion of shimmering fungi, the pathway is dim and made treacherous by a skim of water that slicks the rocky floor.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Lake]
description: The waters of an underground lake lap at the edges of the path.  Cold and brackish, the waters are clear, but the absence of light in the cavern transfigures the lake into a fathomless pool of darkness.  A single jag of dark stone thrusts out of the waters like an accusatory finger.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Lake]
description: Pallid fish with stunted, sightless eyes dart through the water near the northern shore of the lake.  Some of them fluoresce, and dot the pool with patches of ghostly light that dart aimlessly through the water.  Waves slap ineffectually at the stony shore, sluggish and small.  They leave behind undulating patterns of fizzing white foam.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Cavern]
description: Veins of calcite wind along the wall in shades of dark red, ochre, and mauve, lending a splash of color to the black granite.  Their surfaces are waxy and scored with scratches that suggest efforts to broaden the walls of the tunnelway.  Sinuous and winding, the underground path threads between stalagmites as tall as trees.  The tops of the rock formations are lost in the oppressive darkness.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Cavern]
description: Mineral deposits reminiscent of spent candle wax cascade down the face of a short cliff, offering easy handholds on the way up to a raised tunnelway.  Stalagmites crowd the cavern floor, their spindly forms elongated as if they are stretching to reach their mated stalactites on the raised ceiling.  Water drips musically over the raised ledge, echoing strangely off of the forest of stone.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Tunnels]
description: Pulsing with a steady, resonant hum, a glowing amber barrier of energy spans a wide crevice at the end of the tunnel.  Though not quite as bright as daylight, the radiance casts back the heavy darkness of the subterranean path and colludes with the towering stalagmites to cast long shadows over the rugged cave floor.  Airy sigils with wild flourishes are etched into the rock walls around the barrier, holding wells of faint light that throb in time with its rhythm.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Breached Hollow]
description: Broad and vaguely ovoid, an unnatural hollow opens within the mottled stone to form a chamber.  Spiraling furrows, deep and sharp-edged, adorn the curved walls and unevenly sloping floor, though the topmost curve of the ceiling appears relatively smooth by comparison.  Tunnel mouths gape at irregularly spaced intervals, their recesses cast in shadow by the pulsing emanations of an amber-hued barrier stretched taut like a membrane of light across a ragged crevice in the chamber's wall.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, southwest

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Tunnels]
description: Amber radiance seethes from the west in even pulses.  It is accompanied by a faint hum that resonates through the surrounding stalagmites, making droplets of water shiver and dance as they trickle down the sides of the stone formations.  An intense odor of stale vinegar hangs on the cold air, the scent distinctly out of place amidst the melange of mineral-laden water and the earthiness of abundant mushrooms.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Tunnels]
description: A vein of quartz streaks through the floor of the tunnel, its stark white clashing with the granite to either side.  The stripe continues up one wall in a glittering stratum, where it is riddled with arteries in a variety of colors from rose to pale turquoise.  Several broken shards of stone litter the ground, having evidently rolled down from a raised portion of tunnel to the northwest.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Tunnels]
description: A burrow delving into the northern wall of the passage has caved in, littering the ground with grit and chunks of fallen stone.  A chitinous foreleg breaches out of the rubble, but it is unmoving and time has dulled its sheen.  Faint flutters of amber light beckon in an even pattern around a bend to the southeast.  The black granite of the walls vibrates faintly in time with the cresting and ebbing radiance, which seems out of place in the darkness.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Tunnels]
description: Flowstones pour down the western wall of the tunnel, nearly obscuring the black granite with formations that have the color of turmeric.  The constant dripping of water down the stones echoes down the nearby tunnels, the sound a maddening patter in the cold darkness.  Tiny mushrooms flourish in puddles along either side of the traversable path.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Tunnels]
description: A spent torch lies in a puddle at the edge of the passage, its oilskin charred.  There is no sign of its owner, but it has lain in place for long enough that fungi have sprouted over its wooden shaft.  Veins of mithril ore streak through the walls to either side, the cloudy blue of the metal stark against the surrounding black granite.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Tunnels]
description: The winding tunnel is graced by the faintest of luminescence from fungi thriving in crags and crevices.  Moisture beads on the black granite as if the walls of the tunnelway were sweating.  The water droplets trickle down the walls' ragged faces, collecting in little pools that have a strong mineral odor.  A faint thrum through the surrounding stone makes the pools' surfaces ripple and dance.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Labyrinth]
description: A deep crevice bisects the walkway near an intersection of three tunnels.  Though no wider than a handspan at its broadest point, the crack plummets down into shadow, its walls shot through with veins of pale grey mithril ore.  From somewhere deep below, the sound of rushing water echoes, but the distance has muted its mighty roar to a meek whisper easily lost in the sound of pattering water that fills the darkness.

title: [Czeroth Subterrane, Tunnels]
description: Near a bend in the tunnel, the rocky ground is spiderwebbed through with cracks as if it has buckled beneath great pressure or force.  The source of the impact appears to be a shallow burrow occupied by clusters of clear eggs, each roughly the size of a full-grown dwarf.  Within each egg, a large vermiform shape is ensconced, twitching and throbbing.  The unborn worms' movements are illuminated by the glow of clustered ochre crystals sprouting from the walls.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Glimmers of amber light dance along the tunnel mouth to to the northeast, highlighting the deep gouges that mar the stone.  Rough prisms of ametrine embedded in the walls throw violet and gold sparks back at the intrusive illumination.  The broad corridor dug through the granite follows a pronounced curve as it winds, arcing progressively upward, to the southeast.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Cinnabar crystal starbursts bloom like fiery flowers all along the grooved stone passage, though those that cower in the shadows of the uneven walls have fared better than the shattered remnants littering the central path.  Patches of silver-grey ore caught within the surrounding rock sparkle with metallic luster.  The tunnel ceiling rises to the southeast, peaking sharply as it opens into a natural chamber.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Azulene Cataract]
description: Nearly overwhelming the narrow, natural chamber, a monolith of blue labradorite surges up from the rocky floor to crest against the ceiling, its presence deflecting the adjoining hewn tunnels at an acute angle.  Frothy formations of silvery galena cling to the iridescent pillar at its apex and spill outward, further reinforcing the impression of a waterfall in reverse.  Bands of phosphorescence ringing the stalactites above cast a wan illumination that refracts through the crystalline structures and ignites their inner fire.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Frayed ropes of rusty red-orange webbing cling to ridges in the scuffed stone and unfurl trailing filaments that flutter in the warm air.  Yellowish splatters discolor the steep slope of the tunnel floor, spreading into half-dried smears riddled with scraps of broken chitin and shreds of translucent, papery film in the descent to the southeast.  Further up the passage to the east, the faint gleam of reflected phosphorescence casts a blue sheen across the walls.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Chute]
description: Overhead, swirling vapor only partially conceals the deep claw marks that pattern the shadowed granite.  Several elongated egg casings jut from hollows in the rock nearer the tunnel floor and disgorge a viscous fluid from their ruptured sides.  The yellowish substance pools in the grooved stone and oozes over the lip of a nearby stone chute.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Acrid scents drift on the moist air.  Fragments of broken crystal mingle with a muddy cement of stone dust and yellowish effluvia speckling the stone floor of the passage.  Further up the rocky walls, scrapes and furrows deepen to divots where they cross the paths of softer minerals that weave through the black granite.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Tall, spear-like crystals of translucent quartz sprout in a meandering line through the center of the granite corridor, leaving space to edge past on either side.  Several of the hexagonal prisms end not in natural points but in ragged splinters where their tips have been broken off.  Concentric bands of pale stone ripple across the tunnel ceiling, curving down along one wall before tapering off into the shadows.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Deep blue eostone crystals bristle within irregular hollows spanning the rocky ceiling and stretching down one wall, reminiscent of riven geodes embedded in the stone.  At a bend in the tunnel, rough-faced veins of cloudy violet protrude from high above and wind in sinuous descent, disappearing into the scuffed earth beneath.  Distant thuds and staccato clicks vibrate through the passage in an audible reminder of the warrens' habitation.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Ribbons of sulfur-scented vapor curl up from a wide, wet crack angling across the floor of the tunnel and contribute to the heavy, humid atmosphere of the warrens.  Tiny tangerine quartz crystals encrust the rim of the crevice, jutting at odd angles, their bright surfaces beaded with moisture.  Brown stains fan out from a shallow cavity within the concave curve of the tunnel wall, but aside from a few scraps of bronze-tinted film stuck to the stone, the hollow is empty.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: A tumble of boulders obstructs nearly half of the broad tunnel, turning it wasp-waisted at an already sharp bend.  The slope of the floor is scattered with rocky debris.  Water hisses forth in a fine mist through crevices along a stretch of wall and dribbles darkly down the stone to puddle murkily below.  From the northeast, a sloshing rumble can be heard echoing through the passage.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Glistening wetly, pale sediment collects at the lip of a ragged tear along the tunnel wall.  The thrum and roar of an underground watercourse booms and echoes from beyond the breach.  Rough striations of cloudy bluerock mottle the claw-riven stone, their sparkle muted by the heaviness of the misted air.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Moisture drips from cracks running the length of the rock wall, darkening the speckled granite in uneven streaks.  The susurrus of water rushing over stone is faint, but present.  To the east, thready veins of mottled green aventurine become wider and acquire glossy polish as they approach a tunnel intersection within the winding warrens.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Egg Vault]
description: Rippled stone around the southwest tunnel mouth gives way to the organic folds and striations of a natural cavern.  Shallow, meandering pools stretch further into the vault, churned silt clouding the blue-green water nearest their elevated edges.  Tendrils of warm mist rise from the water's surface and fill the air with a complex melange of odorous fumes.  Rosy eggs, fogged over by the heat, spill from cavities and clefts in the walls and gather in the pools, cohering in gently undulating mats.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Shallow rents spiral the circumference of the sloped burrow, interrupted by several cracks along one stretch of wall through which a fetid yellow slime slowly oozes.  A thin river of the viscous stuff wends along the declivity of the tunnel floor, joined by a rivulet of dirty water dribbling from an elevated cleft in the southeast wall just wide enough to allow passage.  The mouth of the tunnel opens wider to the northeast, where a drift of sulfurous mist faintly fogs the air.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Chute]
description: A sluggish stream of mingled dirty water and fetid, yellowish slime flows from the northeast incline and follows along the tunnel floor as it sinks downward toward a stone chute, inevitably sliding over its lip.  Thick, matted strands of ruddy silk splay across the ceiling above, clinging to the grooved stone, with more of the rubbery excretions drooping down into the chute's slick depths.  Streaks of chalky crust line the passage winding south, bracketing a thin trench lined with old, brown stains.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Mottled discolorations pattern the rough rock with an abstract mural of rust and violet stains overlaid with streaks of chalky white.  Patches of tacky residue, aglimmer with crystal dust, cling to the rutted floor.  Fragile tendrils tinted a lurid orange cling to the ceiling and waver in the warm air currents pulsing through the passage.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: The tunnel splits around a nigh-transparent crystalline column embedded with metallic red and gold rutile filaments.  Butter yellow gossamer clings to the northeast fork, partially occluding the passage from floor to ceiling along one side.  The northwest fork is clear of obstructions, though puddles of some sticky substance meander across the uneven stone.  Droplets of foul-smelling water trail away to the south.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Egg Vault]
description: Towering stalactite columns drip down from the high, uneven ceiling of the natural cavern, descending into misted pools of blue-green water alight with speckled bioluminescent algae.  The heavy air swirls with drifting vapor that reeks of sulfur and a nigh-choking astringent musk.  Wet clusters of tiny pink and crimson eggs overflow shelves carved into the rock as well as the bulbous stone formations that cradle them.  Flaky white secretions discolor the dark stone, caked more thickly nearest the eggs.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Warm air bearing the scent of mineral-laden water billows from the northeastern end of the passage, where the tunnel broadens abruptly and gives way to a cavernous space.  The dark stone here is deeply scored, streaked by some pale, lichenous substance.  Tattered veils of sickly yellow-green webbing drape across the upper mouth of the cavern and trail rust-fringed filaments that drift with the movement of the air.  Rapidly dripping water echoes from within a ragged cleft set partway up the tunnel wall.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Cobweb-fine threads of rusty silk dangle from the ceiling.  Their anchors cluster more densely to the north, wherefrom a damp draft blows.  Along the pitted floor of the passage, mottled discolorations paint an abstract pattern of unknown provenance.  Tiny crystals protrude from the stone walls, their facets jagged and chipped, their colors muted in the darkness beneath the mountains.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: The passage winds around a tiered rock formation that forms a natural series of jutting limestone shelves.  Water bubbles up from the topmost tier, hissing and spitting a fine mist at erratic intervals, and sloshes over into the lower shelves.  Colorful mineral deposits trail in layered streaks down the stone, bracketing thin streams of noxious water that diffuse across the tunnel floor.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Flashes of amber illuminate the tunnel mouth to the south and are cast back by the protruding points of quartz studding the stony ceiling.  A broad vein of aventurine paints the western tunnel fork a rich, blue-tinged green in glittering swathes, the exposed gemstone polished to glassy luster despite remaining unexcavated.  Wafting in from the northeast branch, the scent of warm, damp air mingles with an underlying note of musky astringency.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Moisture clings to the rippled rock walls, beading and sluicing downward at intervals.  At a sharp bend in the passage, the tunnel floor rucks upward at an angle.  A craggy jumble of broken stone riddled with gem-bright inclusions clutters the low ground and makes for treacherous footing.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Winding through a bulge in the tunnel wall, a fine crack in the stone spits moist, hot air and a fine spray of water, periodically hissing and overlaying the scent of sulfur on the dankness of ruptured earth.  Water drips from a slight overhang below the crack, plinking loudly into a furrow in the stone below.  The resulting runnel splits and splits again, spreading through the scraped rock and turning it glossy and black.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Fist-sized nodules of quartz emerging from within the rocky floor break up the prevailing pattern of parallel grooves that extends up the tunnel walls.  The passage slopes unevenly from one side to the other as it winds through the earth.  An occasional hiss sounds from further down the tunnel to the southeast, punctuated by percussive dripping.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: A natural column of smoky quartz juts partway into the tunnel where it bends.  The dark granite around the rough crystal formation appears haphazardly scraped away.  Shattered remnants of clouded crystal and jagged stone are mounded beneath it, trailing away along the tunnel in either direction.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Thin veins of pink granite break up the darker surrounding stone, stuttering across channels carved deep into the tunnel walls.  A pulsing amber glow beckons from the west where the tunnel empties into a larger chamber.  Broken crystal fragments litter the inclined floor, their milky facets dull in the humid darkness.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Sprawling veins of pink granite flecked with mica wind through the rutted stone.  Above, tiny eggs threaten to overflow a long, mossy cavity set high in the broad tunnel wall, the ruddy spheres glistening and clinging fast to both their fellows and the stone lip of their cradle.  A chalky white crust of dried secretions extends down from the egg shelf, striping the wall.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Whistling Pit]
description: Already broad, the tunnel widens here, its fluted floor spiraling toward the circular maw of a pit in its southern quadrant.  A similarly rounded hole burrows up through the ceiling overhead.  Air whistles through the vertical passages, carrying with it the faint, astringent scent of vinegar.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Overlapping layers of white travertine spill outward in concentric circles from a branching array of cracks in the concave tunnel wall, chasing the curve of the passage with a scalloped contrast to the darker granite.  Warm water silently wells from the cracks, dribbling down the rippled stone and leaving years of streaky discoloration in its wake.

title: [Kresh Warrens, Hewn Tunnel]
description: Wan amber light flickers across the scuffed and scored tunnel walls to the northwest, igniting iridescent striations in the rough-hewn rock.  At the light's edge, the shadows are deep, their ragged silhouettes hinting at earthen detritus lying in wait to trip the unwary.  Distant clicks and chitters echo through the winding passage.

title: [Seething Crescent, Chute]
description: Ropy threads of clotted silk, unlovely and mottled in hues of mustard and rust, droop from the mouth of a slick stone chute climbing to the warrens above.  Brackish water trickles from the aperture, trailing down the strands to patter on the spongy ground.  Its mineral scent is almost lost in the stifling sharpness of vinegar wafting by in noxious billows.  To the south, the tunnel wall gapes to reveal a sprawling an alien monument at the base of the grotto, the edifice centered around a vast crystal.

title: [Seething Crescent, Rim]
description: Niches in the stone large honeycomb the cavern walls high overhead as the natural gallery approaches a jutting overhang that cradles most of the stony crescent.  Many are empty, but several are sealed shut with a resinous ochre substance that has mostly hardened.  The cold air of the upper cavern revolts against hot air belching up from below, which is laden with a sharply pungent odor reminiscent of vinegar.

title: [Seething Crescent, Descent]
description: Two crudely shaped pillars of ochre crystal flank the zenith of a porous stone ramp that descends into the depths of the grotto.  Light throbs within the towering formations, its rhythm too regular to be completely random.  At the bottom of the ramp spreads a sweeping edifice of the same unusual material, its twisting spires and strange geometries alien and offensively unnatural.  Moisture in the air beads along the descent, droplets of water trickling inexorably downward into the depths of the earth.

title: [Seething Crescent, Recess]
description: The branching tunnelway slims into a narrow recess, walls pressing in on both sides.  Heat from nearby vents and the closeness of the space conspire to magnify the odor of old rot rising from a corpse propped up against the wall of the chamber.  Mushrooms sprout from the figure's drooping flesh, the decay of which has been accelerated by the hot dampness of the nook.  The fungi make it impossible to discern the deceased individual's features, or even its gender.

title: [Seething Crescent, Rim]
description: The eye-watering pungence of ammonia trickles from craggy vents along the ground, joining with a noxious fog that crawls over the floor of the natural stone gallery.  Thick lengths of ropy, mud-colored silk droop from the ceiling, but they have been eaten away by the corrosive gases and hang in ragged clots that ooze fat droplets onto the ground.  Only the rushing air currents of the cavern offer any relief from the toxic onslaught.  To the west, a gash in the wall offers access to a narrow tunnel.

title: [Seething Crescent, Rim]
description: Fungus drapes the mouth of a tunnel that branches off from the north, its wan phosphorescence a pale candle against the brighter, prismatic glow throbbing from within.  Several huge chunks of crystal are heaped next to the opening, their hues ranging from striking purple to pale white.  The latter match the color, if not the size, of the immense spar of crystal sprouting from the base of the grotto below.

title: [Seething Crescent, Rim]
description: Striking veins of pale minerals cut through the russet outer wall of the natural rock gallery, thinning to glinting filaments near the ground.  The stony arteries form forking patterns that look like bolts of lightning striking, their natural beauty at odds with the grotesque growths of slime mold creeping to occlude them.  As if standing guard at the base of the wall, a stuffed dog made from tattered felt sits forgotten, dirty but otherwise unharmed.

title: [Seething Crescent, Excavation]
description: Mineral veins weave through the tunnel walls, reflecting the glow of crystalline clusters sprouting to either side of the path.  The otherworldly radiance plays across the uneven terrain, revealing deep gouges in the stone floor.  Near the mouth of the tunnel to the south, shimmering curtains of fungus attracted by the moisture and warmth lend their feeble light to the crystals' fitful scintillations.

title: [Seething Crescent, Fungal Bloom]
description: Nestled within a depression near the inner wall of the rim, an ethereal garden of bioluminescent fungi flourishes.  Ghostly blues and greens cascade from the pallid mushrooms like a waterfall of gentle light, their surreal glow illuminating the path.  Their tiny spores dance by on the cavern's wild air currents, looking like phantasmal embers.  The surrounding ground is carpeted with bulbous growths of mold and is spongy underfoot.

title: [Seething Crescent, Bridge]
