description: A narrow bridge of crumbling rock joins the southern half portion of the crescent with the north.  Battered by subterranean air currents, the unforgiving span look out over a plummet onto asperous crags along the perimeter of the alien monuments occupying the cavern's lowest reaches.  The pathway is bathed in ethereal light from crystals budding from the porous tufa of the rocky walls above.

title: [Seething Crescent, Tunnel Mouth]
description: An uneven gash heralds a tunnel mouth in the eastern wall of the cavern, its descending spiral quickly winding out of sight.  Strands of thick, glutinous fiber cling to the entrance, fluttering like incongruous ribbons in the shifting air currents of the subterrane.  The spongy ground before the maw is scored with scratches, some darkened with blood, marking clear signs of a desperate struggle.

title: [Seething Crescent, Excavation]
description: Luminous clusters of crystal pulse from the ground and walls, illuminating colossal geodes studding the walls.  The gems reflect the glow in a symphony of prismatic hues, illuminating the pathway in surges of light that reveal a fine blanket of crystalline dust.  It leads toward a great mineral column sprouting from the craggy ground at the chamber's center, chips and chunks hacked out of its bulk suggesting recent efforts to harvest the formation.

title: [Seething Crescent, Bend]
description: A single flickering crystal lights a bulging bend in the cavern wall, its light skittering over viscous pools of dark fluid dotting the ground.  The light illuminates long, fossilized bones embedded into the rock, numerous but so haphazard in their arrangement as to be useless in guessing the form of the creature from which they came.  To the west, a single spar of rust-colored rock juts precariously out over the cavern depths.

title: [Seething Crescent, Overlook]
description: Buffeted by wind born from a clash between heat washing up from below and the cold of the air so far beneath the surface, the overlook juts out over the strange geometries of the plaza below.  From the finger of craggy black stone, the crystal at the center of the aberrant construction is clearly visible, colossal in size though it is still half-buried in unyielding bedrock.  Pulses of energy flash within the pale depths, oddly hypnotic in their branching patterns.

title: [Seething Crescent, Bend]
description: Luminous crystals grow along a bend in the cavern wall, dizzying clouds of radiant color drifting through one cluster only to blossom in the next, as if all are working in concert.  The overhanging ceiling juts out over the abominable plaza below, dripping with blobby slime mold that has found purchase in the moisture and heat.  A thin fringe of tufa, not grown tall enough to form true stalagmites, is all that stands between the uneven walkway and a plummet into the depths.

title: [Seething Crescent, Corridor]
description: Silken tendrils, thick and viscid, droop in tangles from the uneven ceiling of the narrow corridor.  The walls have been scratched and scraped, leaving behind runnels spotted with dried blood, and a faint iron tang intrudes upon the pervasive stench of vinegar.  Crystals grow from the cragged floor, lighting the path in smooth waves that pulse from one cluster to the next in rhythmic procession.

title: [Seething Crescent, Cells]
description: The overwhelming stench of blood blankets the tunnel, worsened by the heat belching from geothermic vents furrowing the walls.  Ringed by tumorous slime molds attracted by the subterranean moisture, the gashes look like wet, uneven mouths.  Several niches large enough to hold several humanoids have been etched out of the rock to either side of the winding path, half barred by walls of hardened resin.  One open chamber's floor is tacky with half-clotted gore.

title: [Seething Crescent, Cocoons]
description: Spun cocoons the color of rust and mustard hang pendulously from the walls, supported by ropy, mucilaginous webbing in the same ugly hues.  They throb and twitch spasmodically, bulging grotesquely in places.  Several spent casings lie discarded nearby, shriveled but unable to dry entirely in the moist environment.  Intensely warm and heavy, the air is heavy-laden with a sour vinegar stink that clashes revoltingly with the earthier odor of mildew.

title: [Seething Crescent, Rim]
description: Several strands of gossamer sway on the cool air currents near the edge of the rim, gleaming like spun glass.  Mineral deposits have formed waxy, spiraling columns that connect the overhanging ceiling with the uneven floor, framing glimpses of the monstrous crystal and bizarre plaza below as if they were images in a gallery.  Hot gusts of moisture-laden air churn up from the grotto below, laden with a sharp stink of vinegar.

title: [Seething Crescent, Rim]
description: A rough-edged corridor branches off from the main path along the uneven rim, descending toward an unseen chamber.  Wafts of heated air, heavy-laden with a cloyingly sweet odor reminiscent of fresh honey, sigh from the mouth of the passage.  Several clusters of crystal sprout from the inner wall of the rim, pulses of light rising and falling in their depths in perfect rhythm.

title: [Seething Crescent, Rim]
description: Open to the air of the immense cavern on its northwestern side, the corridor has a low ceiling that is supported by pillars roughly hewn out of the surrounding stone.  Spindly crystals in strange colors sprout from the pillars in geometric configurations.  Though unevenly spaced and crudely worked, the gems pulse in time with fretful bursts of yellowish light, the pattern too regular to be the work of mere nature.

title: [Seething Crescent, Rim]
description: Flanked by a pair of alcoves, the left one sealed by hardened resin, a tunnel branches off toward an expansive chamber to the southeast.  Ruddy yellow light seethes from within in pulses, accompanied by a pungent, too-sweet aroma.  The smell mingles in a stomach-churning melange with the fetor of old rot emanating from the southern alcove, where a humanoid figure is twined in thick lengths of shimmering gossamer.

title: [Seething Crescent, Rim]
description: The crescent-shaped rim overlooks an alien plaza centered around a luminous white crystal, the cyclopean construction possessed of strange geometries not meant for humanoid occupation.  Immense in scope and towering in height, the crystal sparks with occasional flashes of power from within.  A fringe of flowstones dangles from the ceiling of the overlook like descending talons, obscuring the view in places.

title: [Seething Crescent, Alcoves]
description: Several alcoves are dug out of the walls of umber stone, most sealed by a hard, translucent substance with a distinctive ochre shade.  A glistening resin of the same hue, reminiscent of thick tree sap, drips from the walls of one sealed niche, and has begun to harden in glassy patches.  Hot air, sulphurous and heavy, belches from a jagged vent in the uneven floor, its revolting odor of rotten eggs almost eclipsing the overwhelming stench of vinegar.

title: [Seething Crescent, Chute]
description: Viscous fluid oozes slowly down a slick stone chute with walls too even to be entirely natural in make, the slippery stone ascending into the rock of the ceiling.  Nearby, alcoves within the walls are sealed with clouded resin reminiscent of amber, though its predominant ochre hue is tinged with mauve occlusions.  A murky form is trapped in each, recognizably humanoid despite the poor visibility.  The air is warm and damp, and it seethes by in sluggish breaths.

title: [Seething Crescent, Rim]
description: Gusts of hot gas whistle up from the belly of the vast cavern beneath the overlook, meeting colder drafts near its ceiling in a clash that whips the air currents into blasts that scour the stony rim.  An almost overpowering odor reminiscent of vinegar lingers despite the efforts of the subterranean breeze.  Below, a strange complex of porous, crumbling stone spreads out from the base of a vast, pale crystal, much of which still lies buried beneath the earth.

title: [Seething Crescent, Egg Chamber]
description: Fat, long larvae writhe in pallid tangles along the floor of the vast chamber, the walls of which rise in concentric tiers toward a high ceiling dripping with stalactites.  The rings are crowded with countless eggs, each roughly the size of a human child, uniformly translucent and the color of curdled milk.  Pools of viscous reddish goop bubble at the center of the chamber, attracting the larval kiramon and filling the space with a saccharine odor faintly tinged with a hint of hot copper.

title: [Seething Crescent, Viscous Pool]
description: A wide pool of red-orange fluid, thick and sluggish, spans much of the chamber.  The syrupy substance has a pungent sweetness to it that, combined with the heat billowing into the chamber from craggy vents along its exterior, makes the air heavy to the point of suffocation.  Though little light penetrates the murky jelly, the glow of crystals in the chamber's ceiling catches on humanoid figures trapped near the surface, reduced to twisted shapes of vitrifying flesh and exposed bone.

title: [Seething Crescent, Stores]
description: Colder than the surrounding chambers and corridors, the oblong hollow stinks of death.  Bodies, more than a few of them humanoid, lie in grisly heaps, crammed carelessly into alcoves along the walls.  There is a mindlessness to the storage that suggests a singular lack of concern for the dead.

title: [Seething Crescent, Excavation]
description: Crystalline chunks the size of boulders lie piled in a recess along the tunnel, reflecting the strange ochre light of smaller clusters glowing from the walls and ceiling.  Many of the chunks are shot through with cracks or boast craggy edges that suggest they were broken free with great force rather than proper tools.  The rocky ground has been deeply gouged with furrows leading to the west.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Ramp]
description: Tangles of light throb and die within the cores of two huge crystalline pillars flanking a ramp.  Descending from the rugged gallery of natural rock above, the slope joins with a sprawling plaza of peculiar stone.  The material is riddled with large pores and does not evidence any seams or joining mortar.  It forms wild bridges and tiered terraces with lopsided geometries and strange curvature, all congregating around a mountainous crystal in the center of the phantasmagorical grotto.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Bridge]
description: Strange obelisks grow from the spongiform stone as it arcs into an undulating bridge, their edges straight near the base but turning sinuous and warped near the rounded head of each.  Their surfaces crawl with meaningless symbols too random in configuration to be written language.  The characters shift to follow the curves of the stonework.  Below, supports of the same material are positioned along the bridge's length, clad in the same nonsensical etchings.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: A spectacular mushroom grows from a cleft in the cavern floor near the terrace, its cap a confusing whorl of colors that look as if a crazed painter swirled disparate pigments together in a fit of madness.  Spores fall in a pale cloud from the bone white gills on the underside of the cap, glittering like motes of ethereal starlight in the ebbs and flows of the cavern's radiance.  Beneath the giant, the cave floor sports clusters of new fungal buds, all laden with the same uncanny hues.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: The arm and torso of a corroded bronze statue breach through the muck off the side of the raised terrace, slowly being devoured by the scouring vapors of the grotto.  Most of the features have been eaten away, but the figure's shoulders still have the trademark breadth of a dwarf's.  Heedless of the deteriorating relic, the muck bubbles and froths, stirred by heat and eruptions of foul gas escaping from below.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: White-hot embers flitter from the mouth of a natural flue off the side of the tiered plaza, darting in the air like shining fireflies.  Radiance flickers up from the depths, dancing within the aperture in a lively pattern, the fiery glow wholly different from the wan light of nearby crystals in its patterns and intensity.  Heat stings on the muggy air, overwhelmingly intense in its constant onslaught.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Bridge]
description: Hot, stinking spray lingers on the muggy breeze of the subterrane, shot high into the air by geysers in the uneven ground below.  The distinctive rotten egg stench of sulphur lingers, thickest over the pools of multicolored water stagnating at the geysers' bases.  Moisture has slicked the stone of the bridge and collected in its gaping pores, leaving pallid yellow crustings of dust where it has dried.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Monolith]
description: Joined to larger terraces by a pair of crude stone bridges, the parapet is bathed in ethereal light by the pillar of crystal spouting from its center.  The obelisk is suffused with constellations of multicolored light.  They build slowly in its depths before streaking to the surface and dying away, highlighting the unusual curvature of the monolith's faces, which taper toward a point at the monument's zenith.  Mold creeps along the platform in pulpy tangles, but a circle around the pillar remains clear.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Bridge]
description: Spars of gemstone in a variety of colors jab up from the floor of the cavern, flanking the eastern side of the bridge in a multihued vanguard.  The bridge's peculiar stone is carpeted in a fleshy layer of secretions, muddy in hue but streaked through with yellows and repulsive reds.  Blobby growths like tumors blot the surface, and some dangle hideously over the side, swinging in the moist air.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: A dark, hollow molt lies in ragged pieces across the surface of the terrace, its chitinous surface dully reflecting the light of the crystals illuminating the cavern.  Several voracious larvae feast on the husk, trailing gooey mucus over its surfaces.  More pieces litter the rocky ground below the plaza, swarming with worm-like claimants driven by the mindless hunger of infancy.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Bridge]
description: Huge mushrooms sprout to either side of the bridge as it stretches between two terraces of spongiform stone.  Their caps and fleshy stalks are imbued with exotic colors that range from iridescent blues to wild oranges, but their pale gills hold hints of unsettling hues without names.  Taller than trees, the fungi fill the air with a loamy scent that softens the acidic bite of vinegar roiling through the subterranean basin.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: Tiered gradations ascend toward a raised terrace, the pocked material from which they are formed looking to have been grown rathern than hewn into such configurations.  All along the border are obelisks in a jumble of spindly shapes, none entirely alike to another.  The edges of the platform look down on a sea of waxy, hexagonal chambers anchored to the ground.  They are possessed of a dark amber hue marred by deep red and livid violet splotches.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: Hundreds of large, ovoid eggs with leathery shells crowd the raised plaza.  They wobble fretfully, cradled by vesicles sprouting from a fibrous coating that amost completely consumes the pockmarked surface of the platform.  Stringy lengths of the substance form long tendrils anchored to crags in the nearby rock walls.  In the shadow of the terrace, the ground is honeycombed with waxy chambers sealed with hardened resin.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: Jagged crystals erupt from the umber stone of the walls, sparking with irregular bursts of sickly radiance.  The light filters through yellow-grey clouds spewing from vents in the rolling rock near the plaza's edge, lending a sulphurous stink to the sharp sourness in the hot air.  Though crudely shaped, the openings are too numerous and too evenly spaced to be purely natural in origin.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: Much of the terrace's strange stone is engulfed in a fibrous blanket of secretions.  Cyst-like swellings cradle the bases of tall, ovoid eggs, each nearly the height of a child and translucent enough to hint at a coiled form within.  Ooze seeps from their leathery surfaces, dripping in thick strings to puddle on the ground.  They reek powerfully of vinegar.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Bridge]
description: A clutch of honeycombed chambers rises out of the muck beneath the vaulting span of sponge-like stone.  Most are capped with waxy resin, but several have been breached, revealing pale, wriggling larvae in their jellied depths.  Coarse strands of ruddy silk sag from the edges of the bridge.  They sway in the humid breath of the cavern like ragged banners.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Monolith]
description: Rounded tiers of stone that resemble natural deposits of sediment rise from the floor of the cavern toward a pellucid obelisk of gemstone.  Pentagonal at its wide base, its faces warp into a lopsided spiral as they twist together near its spindly peak.  Though dwarfed by the multifaceted crystal at the center of the alien plaza, the monolith casts a long, sharp shadow in the flickering radiance bathing the surroundings.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Bridge]
description: The spongiform stone of the bridge is the color of turmeric, and there is a pronounced tilt to its length that makes it difficult to traverse.  Its shadow spreads over a bubbling hot spring with a skim of outlandish color, strange pinks and pastel greens mingling with startling blues.  Clouds of vapor hang in unsavory shreds over the water, so thick as to be nearly opaque.  They carry a strong mineral smell that overpowers the acrid stench blanketing the basin.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: Clouds of mephitic vapor whisk over the exotic stone of the raised terrace, but do not seem to disturb the churning mass of kiramon larvae swarming its surface.  Most of the distended bodies are as pale as a fish's belly, but a few are the color of dried blood or burnt umber.  They leave trails of translucent sludge behind that slicks the stones as they wriggle.  Their evident source is a forest of dry and cracked wax chambers below the terrace.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: Torrid humidity blankets the raised terrace, misting the curious stone construction with perspiration.  The steam is laden with a predominant acidic tang, but also holds the odor of minerals and damp earth.  Larvae inching their way across the ground seem undeterred by the harshness of the miasma, congregating in clumps as they form their dreadful chrysalises.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: The construction of the terrace is clearly not of humanoid design, eschewing conveniences like steps and siding and favoring organic shapes with odd elongations.  Looking as if it is grown rather than shaped, the stone has wide pores and a faintly translucent patches that are reminiscent of rosin.  At the terrace's northwestern extreme, it stretches into a languid bridge spanning to another platform constructed above the lowest reaches of the cavern.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Bridge]
description: Beneath the arc of the stone bridge, the cavern floor gives way to a gash in the earth so deep that light cannot reach its utmost verges.  Steaming water from a bordering hot spring pours over the edge in a colorful waterfall that smells of rotten eggs.  Breaching through one wall of the canyon is an expanse of white crystal the same hue as the tremendous jewel at the cavern's center, though it is impossible to discern whether or not it is of a single piece with the great gem.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Monolith]
description: A pale monolith rises from a pentagonal dais, shaped from limpid crystal without a single imperfection in its clear depths.  Scintillations of unnatural color fork up from the depths of the obelisk, brilliantly illuminating the surroundings.  The base is tangled in clumps of dense webbing in vile colors, the substance spreading across the surrounding stone like an aberrant splotch.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Bridge]
description: Far below the length of the bridge, chitinous bodies crawl with inhuman grace over waxy cells, the uncapped ones holding pools of amber jelly in which kiramon larvae squirm and twitch.  Illumination from the gigantic spar of crystal near the center of the grotto melds with the pulsating light of smaller crystals, washing the bridge in harsh hues.  Noxious vapors surge up from thermal vents in stifling waves, hot enough to make the air warp and shimmer.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: The edge of the terrace overlooks countless hexagonal chambers of resinous wax that obscure the rolling bedrock of the cavern.  Within, larvae bloat themselves on a rich amber jelly that smells of burnt sugar with an acidic edge, the aroma unusual but not entirely unpleasant, especially when contrasted with the mephitic smokes crawling through the depths.  Many of the chambers are capped with wax, but their silhouetted inhabitants are visible in the light of nearby crystals, which are brightly aglow.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: Pupae twitch and shudder in tall, leathery chrysalises that occupy much of the plaza.  The plump, spindle-shaped sacs are mostly muddy-hued and unsightly, but they are dotted in places with bright patches of iridescent orange, red, and gold that flash brighter than jewels in the ambient light.  Several spent casings litter the stone edifice, dry, dull, and decaying with their purpose having been served.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: Much of the wall of the cavern above has given away and collapsed into rubble near the tiered base of the plaza, exposing a fossil that spans nearly the length of the cavern.  Some glossy black bones, half lost in the darkness of the subterranean grotto's upper reaches, spread in unearthly configurations across the wall.  They suggest a creature of terrible size and horrific configuration, multitudinous arms and spread wings trapped as bony impressions within the ancient rock.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: Hints of otherworldly color suffuse the porous stone of the plaza, mirroring the too-vivid blues, greens, and oranges of the nearby springs.  Several obelisks, no two alike in configuration, stand along the edges of the construction.  No seams exist to mark where they end and the plaza's stone begins, making it appear as if they sprouted where they stand.  They cast wobbling shadows in the capricious light of nearby gem clusters.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: Chrysalises crowd the surface of the terrace in ghastly clumps.  Their coriaceous surfaces are sheened with slimy moisture, and swollen larvae swarm among them mindlessly.  Illumination from nearby growths of crystal filters through the vaporous gloom, turning the quivering pods into obscene shadows.

title: [Crystalline Depths, Approach]
description: Curiously organic in shape, as if it were sprouting naturally from the ground, a ramp arcs toward a parapet standing beneath the luminous shadow of a singularly massive crystal.  Pillars of solid gemstone light the way, their towering heights and organic shapes impressive in their own right, but all are dwarfed by the monumental shard above.  The walkway is bathed in its fell glow, which mutates shadows into long and terrible shapes with ghoulish configurations.

title: [Schoolhouse, Classroom]
description: Starcharts, miniature parchment models of constellations, and a variety of telescopes line the walls of the small classroom.  Small oak crates marked "Astrolabe" sit on each of the benches, though it appears one has escaped its confines as it lays to rest on the black-speckled white tile floor.  Several small windows are inset into the wall, allowing just enough room to view the outside.

title: [Schoolhouse, Hallway]
description: Brightly burning lanterns are suspended from hooks in the ceiling along the length of the hallways, their steady glow reflected in the polished linden wood floor.  Various hooks and shelves line the walls around both a windowed cobalt blue door and a windowed hunter green door, providing storage space for outer garments while classes are in session.  Fitted with stained glass, the western wall has an enormous blue window displaying a variety of scallop shells over a durable exterior mahogany door.

title: [Schoolhouse, Blue Classroom]
description: Alternating tiles of cobalt blue and alabaster stretch across the floor of the classroom, meeting the half-wall of white wainscotting that transitions to flat blue.  Various framed artwork are displayed about the room, their images depicting a variety of local flora and fauna, while the entire eastern wall beyond a glossy golden linden podium is covered in slate to create a blue-grey chalkboard.  A smattering of high stools surrounds long oak-planked tables, providing numerous seating options for those ready to learn.

title: [Schoolhouse, Green Classroom]
description: Cabinets hang along the southern wall of the classroom, beneath which are counters covered with recycled pickling jars filled with crafting supplies that range from beads and baubles to chalk and pencils.  Steel-topped worktables surrounded by mahogany chairs are scattered about the room beneath the steady glow of suspended hurricane lanterns, while an open space near the eastern wall provides room for several individuals to teach before a blue-grey slate chalkboard.

title: [Schoolhouse, West Lawn]
description: Framed by colorful rows of sunset marigolds and woolflowers, a slender pathway of crushed cobblestone wends its way through the manicured lawn of vibrant green grass to and from a small greenhouse and the schoolhouse.  Glowing lanterns dangle from shepherd's crooks fashioned of wrought iron, their soft lamplight causing the stone to glimmer.  Stretching its limbs to create a sheltering shade, a mottled dogwood tree grows in the center of the southern lawn and is laden with colorful blossoms.

title: [Schoolhouse, Greenhouse]
description: Small but high-walled, the greenhouse is crafted of rainbow-whorled glass panels and a packed dirt floor.  Three-tiered shelving units support various planters and are arranged against the glass walls, each housing nozzled gnomic devices that hum and buzz at various intervals.  A central mahogany workstation with a recessed metallic bin of dirt rests in the center of the space amid tidily stacked potting supplies.  Anchored to the glass near the door is a piece of artwork crafted of silks that honors the lifecycle of hellebore.

title: [Firefly Villa, Library]
[Firefly Villa, Trove]
description: Shadows from the flickering lantern's cut-outs in the adjacent lounge flit aimlessly through this modest room of knowledge, creating illusions of flying insects among the plethora of parchments, journals, and books lining the enclosing shelves.  Situated between two reading tables is an elaborately carved cabinet with depictions of prominent historians chiseled onto its surface.  Large bundles of aged papyrus secured with twine rest in the corner, but the ink appears to have faded from most of the pages.

title: [Wharfside Weavers]
description: Resembling a stall, the wood panel walls are supported by large posts fitted into the cobblestone street, where a series of sail-shaped canvas triangles are stretched to form a roof.  Various fabric wares are draped from a rough oak peg along the walls, while a woven marshgrass basket houses smaller items.  Though most of the shop has an open-air feel to it, there is a small, enclosed sewing room at the back that can be glimpsed beyond a large modwir door.

title: [Wharfside Weavers, Sewing Room]
description: Arranged in a chaotic array, spools of thread in various colors are attached to thin spindles that stick out of the walls, each trailing a thin string that flutters when anyone passes them.  Several stools are scattered about the floor and are surrounded by baskets filled with embroidery hoops, thimbles, needle cushions, and scissors.  A large modwir door leads to the front of the shop.

title: [Dragonspine, Snowy Trail]
description: Chiseled into the mountainside by the extreme weather conditions, the narrow, snow-covered trail follows the natural contour of an intensely steep ridge.  Massive outcroppings far above cast crippling shadows along the path and blot out any evident tracks, making the journey quite precarious.  Higher up the trail, a few towering trees bend to and fro, nearly concealing the jagged mouth of a narrow crevice boring down toward a plateau below.

title: [Dragonspine, Snowy Trail]
description: Creamy white blankets of freshly fallen snow combined with the shadowing effects of the moonlight greatly interfere with one's ability to locate the existing trail versus the edge of the mountain.  Pine needles and other lightweight vegetation, deposited by ceaseless wind gusts, lay atop the frosty bed for a momentary rest until the next blustery relocation.

title: [Dragonspine, Snowy Trail]
description: Cramped clusters of spruce trees decorate the grey-white landscape and compete for space along the narrow trail, their limbs sagging tirelessly beneath the weight of fresh snow.  Chunks of ice rain down from higher ledges and threaten any who dawdle.  A formidable precipice intersects with the trail and severs the path to lower ground.

title: [Dragonspine, Frozen Cave]
description: Deceivingly larger than expected, this cave is comprised of a sturdy rock ledge with ample room for a few adventurers, a small campfire, and a vast, open space that plummets to the depths below.  Obstructive ice stalactites hang from above and occasionally unite with a twin stalagmite to form an impressive ice column.  Plumes of steam rise from the platform edge and disperse along the ceiling to refreeze and replenish the ceaseless ice formations.

title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Cove]
description: Blue-green crystalline waters provide a peaceful and tranquil surrounding, stark in contrast to the frigid and frosty conditions high above.  Though dark, an unhindered view of the bed is still visible and showcases the unmatched beauty of underwater flora and its aquatic companions, while miniscule flecks of silvery blue sprinkled across the massive rock walls project thousands of twinkling lights across the water's surface as moonlight flows into the cavern.

title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Lake]
description: Vivid accents of purple columbine and pink windflowers interspersed between lavish clumps of feather grass surround the lake and elicit a visual explosion alongside the dramatic blue-green water.  Rippling shadows of the silhouetted Dragonspine dance across the glassy surface, a natural camoflauge to the plentiful orefish that call this place home.  Thick with river birch and silver maples, the surrounding wetlands serve as a partial barricade from the gusting winds beyond the area's perimeter.

title: [Stormpeak Base, Lake's Edge]
description: Abundantly moist and spongy underfoot, a nauseating mixture of fish, flora, and rotting vegetation seeps into the air with each step, and an audible *SQUISH* alerts any awaiting predators of your presence.  Vultures soar high in the skies above, waiting for their next meal to appear within striking distance.  To the east, a shimmering lake serves as a large repository for the runoff from the majestic waterfall visible in the distance.

title: [Stormpeak Base, Stream Bed]
description: Flowing swiftly from east to west with a down-sloped southern curve, a wide stream bisects the ground and separates the more inaccessible and treacherous section along the south edge from the traversible north side.  At the bottom of the southerly slope, following the flow of the river, is a shimmering lake, visible from various points in this region, but its full beauty only realized when within this close proximity.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Landing]
description: Completely surrounded by unnavigable boulders save a single moss-covered ramp with a precarious incline, this landing offers some shelter from what appears to be a high-precipitation area beyond.  Luxuriant vegetation rich with deep greens and patterned shrubbery paints a painting-perfect backdrop to this mud and stone-filled space around the natural embankment.  Painstakingly manicured to remove obstacles and unsightly overgrowth, the trail from the landing is precipitous but viable.

title: [Stormpeak Base, Dragon Falls]
description: Originating from an upper ridge along Thunder Plateau, a frothy waterfall seizes both power and grace in one of this landscape's most elegant creations.  Named for its movement along the spiny ridges of the mountain and its resemblance to that of a dragon and its tail, Dragon Falls is a popular attraction among locals and tourists.  Fine mist lingers in the air, dampening an over-soggy terrain and safeguarding this land from becoming more than a wonderous sightseeing spot at the mountain's base.

title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Valley]
description: With the mountain face to the east and the open range to the west, the winds of the region are unforgiving, and there is little to no shelter.  Mist from a nearby waterfall keeps the rock wall in a perpetual clammy state, and an odd layer of mold has grown along many fallen branches and rotting logs.  Secured to the mountain side are two iron tracks, and a large wooden cage is attached to a series of metal poles and steel wires.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Lower Trail]
description: Long tree branches bend and extend across the trail from both sides, a moderately protective canopy from recurring rainstorms.  Cut, debarked logs are evenly spaced in a line along the more lofty sections of the trail, allowing for valuable footing on an otherwise slippery slope.  A tremendous boom of thunder followed by a distant flash of light and the crackling of a tree branch ripping away from its birthplace is commonplace.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Lower Trail]
description: Nearing the top of the ridge, an overview of the outlying area makes a brief appearance through a sheer veil of clouds.  Winding around the edge of the mountain is a clear-cut trail that carves its way through thick growth and a somewhat rocky terrain.  Low-lying clouds impede visibility, but the superiority of the marked trail makes the journey more tolerant.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Juncture]
description: Impeding further travel to the east is a wall of tremendous boulders, a barricade to the immense summit that imposes a foreboding shadow over an already darkened trail.  Freshly cut limbs and branches rest in an orderly pile beneath a covered stand filled with a variety of pruning tools and other miscellaneous items.  Just beyond a wide crevice in the ground, a rock-spattered ledge clings to the mountain face and wends back and forth toward a moderate clearing set back from the trail's sharp edge.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Rocky Ledge]
description: With barely enough space to take a deep breath, this thin ledge, which continues across the mountain face and hangs on the precipice of tragedy, supports travelers as they precariously shuffle from one side to the other.  An up close and personal view of the mountain face shows unnoticed or perhaps forgotten details about the aged granite.  The trail appears safely reachable with a fairly effortless leap, but the trek to the south appears a bit more grueling, especially given the weather conditions.

title: [Stormpeak Base, Wetland]
description: Strong winds from the Dragonspine's lower ridges culminate and cause an uneven terrain to become more hazardous for travel.  Large birch trees have succumbed to the powerful gusts, while others have simply become slaves to the environmental demands, bending and swaying without vacillation.  Bits of debris litter the ground and cycle through a sundry list based on the wind's direction - from mushroom caps and flower petals, to fish bones and tufts of fur, this region lives in a state of disarray.

title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Valley]
description: Generous rains provide an abundance of nourishment for the local flora and a grand home of silver maples.  Despite their girth, they sway with disciplined rhythm as if repeating learned behavior after years of stormy weather.  High along the western ridge, flashes of vivid sapphire produce a luminous aura that fades quickly, making it difficult to pinpoint its exact location.  In an effort to sneak past intruders, a small creature scurries across the ground and darts beneath a pile of broken branches.

title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Valley]
description: One of the higher perches at the western end of this region, this small hilltop gives a sufficient overview of the surrounding area.  A steep incline to the east ends at a magnificent waterfall, while the northwest pathway leads to a stunning blue-green lake.  Occasional flashes of sapphire shimmer against the mountain backdrop and periodically compete for attention with the lightning strikes that seem to plague the upper plateau.

title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Valley]
description: Distant howls reverberate with an unexpected echo and break any enduring silence, reminding visitors that there are unseen dangers all around.  Footprints of all sizes riddle the ground, and scattered pieces of trash add an unsightly decor to the landscape.  Rising in elevation, the mountain ascent begins to the east, the trail visible all the way to the mountain face.

title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Valley]
description: With an increase in rock-strewn ground cover and a steady incline compared to the western valley, a continued trek to the east will undoubtedly lead to the Dragonspine Mountains.  Its rising form appears to grow with each eastward step, and upper ledges and summits are hidden behind dark shadows, regardless of the hour.  Strikes of bright light appear over a distant plateau, and afterward, a resounding crack of thunder spreads through the region with a rumble strong enough to vibrate along the ground.

title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Valley]
description: The moon is rarely given substantial opportunity to peek through the persistant cloud cover, but when the moment arises and the distant lake's surface is pierced, thousands of miniscule pinpoints of light are projected along the ground, twinkling and shimmering like brilliant stars in a clear night sky.  Smaller rocks and piles of rubble take a secondary position to much larger boulders, and reliance on a pre-cleared trail becomes necessary, as deviation from the pathway becomes treacherous and unreliable.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Clearing]
description: Built from indigenous trees, a makeshift shelter is barely enough to keep the elements from soaking the ground and everything underneath.  Thick branches, greenery, a bit of mud, and some sizeable sheets of oilcloth have all been applied to the outside to aid with weatherproofing, though heavy winds manage to keep the refuge in a state of constant repair.  Tucked neatly beneath the wood frame, with space leftover for a few travelers, a hollowed-out tree stump and a smooth cottonwood bench offer a few basic amenities.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Winding Path]
description: Moisture clings to the verdant grass like glue, the large water droplets elongating past their limit before breaking away to merge with the constant rains.  Lightning strikes nearby, and a thunderous boom across the ridge sends a flurry of creatures running for cover.  Tilted slightly to the left, due largely to the sodden ground, is a handpainted sign that has obviously been repainted a number of times.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Winding Path]
description: Steep rises and severe dips in the rocky hills makes travel along this winding path an exhausting undertaking.  Short-lived periods of moonlight peek through ominous storm clouds and cast an illuminating glow upon the darkened land, only to be eclipsed once again by the monopolizing tempest.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Trailhead]
description: Boot treads of recent travelers form intricate criss-crossed designs across the muddy pathway in a dizzying array.  Groups of voices can barely be heard beneath the sound of the driving rain, but the inability to locate their source preserves the mystery.  Carved from petrified tree bark, a large composition sits just off the trail and is turned slightly torward the north.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Boot Trail]
description: Clusters of healthy trees offset similarly sized clearings from recent fires, evident by the scorched and singed flora that managed to escape the runaway burns.  Frequent lightning strikes threaten the lush beauty of the mountain ridge, but the soil appears resilient and continues to sustain and nourish the fugitive vegetation.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Boot Trail]
description: Switchbacks with steep inclines weave between thickets and then empty out into large clearings, leaving travelers exposed to the unrelenting weather conditions.  Square blocks cut from granite slabs edge the entire length of the trail to prevent erosion of the pathway.  The techniques and approaches used to establish these trails show a proclivity in resourcefulness as well as extraordinary skill in environmental knowledge and analysis.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Boot Trail]
description: A sharp southeast curve makes a lofty descent to a wide stream that spills over stair-like rapids.  Felled timber bound together with long strands of braided, reinforced twine bind the logs together in long planks that stretch from one bank to the other, forming a makeshift bridge.  The top of the wooden structure appears unfazed by the climate, but early stages of decomposition to its underside have begun.  A silvery blue glow backlit by clouded moonlight shimmers along the water's edge.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Boot Trail]
description: Crossing a wide stream to connect the western and eastern side of the ridge is a felled-timber bridge that stands a few feet above the rushing water.  Faint outlines of a towering peak, higher than any other visible point in the vicinity, becomes visible when the cloud cover thins to a translucent veil and reveals the hidden beauty.  Intense golden flashes illuminate the sky behind the concealing nimbus in a captivating light show.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Crown View]
description: Bestowed upon the area from the summit's mighty reign, a foreboding shadow looms over the entire area beyond the dimmed lighting caused by the snuffed-out moon.  A severe drop in temperature beneath the cover of darkness is uncomfortably noticeable, especially since miniscule ice crystals appear to form along the wall of the mountainside before being washed away by a strong rain-filled gust.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Crown View]
description: Following the contour of the mountainside, the trail snakes in and out of crevices like a food-seeking reptile, but serves a distinct purpose to keep travelers away from the unstable ground beyond the shield of the summit's shadow.  Charred remains of unknown creatures are piled against the rock, placed intentionally as an offering or moved there by a larger predators is unclear.  Off in the northern distance, a rising trail wavers in and out of view, but appears to lead farther up the mountain.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Scree Deposits]
description: Piles of rocks and boulders have accumulated at the base of the trail leading to higher areas of the mountain.  Unskilled climbers falling victim to the harsh demands for passage remain wedged between the ruthless stone graves.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Upper Trail]
description: Arduous and exhausting, the trail is a lesson in patience no matter which direction is traveled.  Unyielding weather conditions and strenuous terrain leave trail-goers completely exposed without any options for shelter at this midway point of the trail.  A quick glimpse of the surrounding area shows the trail all the way from the current location to the pathway's landing -- it looks much like a boot.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Upper Trail]
description: One slip could be the difference between a good night's sleep and a night's sleep for good.  Fortunately, the steep trail has been reinforced with chipped wood and gravel, soaking up some of the mud that causes the trail to become impassable.  While the peak of the trail appears to end in a few hundred feet, the base is still quite a distance away.  A small patch of wildflowers offers a burst of color in an otherwise gloomy area.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Upper Trail]
description: High walls of granite stretch up to the clouds and shimmer faintly behind scattered opaque veils, the unique bioluminescence becoming more prevalent in their dark grey surroundings.  Blocking the path to the west are enormous boulders that have come to rest atop one another, wedged together perfectly like a completed puzzle.  Few gaps exist between the massive rocks, and it doesn't look like climbing them is an option.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Rocky Ledge]
description: No wider than a couple of feet, it has become increasingly difficult to maneuver along this sturdy strip of stone that cuts in and out of the mountain's natural shape.  Rocks crunch loudly underfoot, and smaller pebbles roll off the ledge and meet an early demise on the ground below.  Fortunately, a small clearing is a short jump over a deep crevice and should provide suitable accommodations for a brief rest.

title: [Thunder Plateau, Brink]
description: Dense clouds hang in the air with disorienting consequences until an abrupt flurry forces the misty mass to sail away, revealing an opportune glimpse of the muddy ground.  Dangerously close to the edge of the cliff, one miscalculated step could be the deciding factor between life and death.  A few powder blue feathers jut out from the wet dirt, primarily noticeable because of the utter color contrast from the drab brown path that leads away from the precipice.

title: [Thunder Plateau]
description: Sheets of rain wash violently across the waterlogged terrain that shifts and gradually transforms with each wind gust, creating an abstract landscape of mud lumps.  Sizable footprints remain imbedded into the ground despite frequent soakings, but a crippled view of the area due to cloud cover interferes with effective investigation.

title: [Thunder Plateau]
description: Deep cracks in the earth serve as a drain system along the plateau's surface, preventing an overabundance of water build-up in the immediate vicinity.  Small insects slip through the fractures, some clawing frantically at the dirt as the apathetic liquid carries them off to an undisclosed tomb.  Nearby lightning strikes briefly illuminate an eastern bluff, but not long enough to reveal any pertinent details.

title: [Thunder Plateau, Rocky Path]
description: Stretching both north and south, a long rocky path separates the soggy plateau from a steep pinnacle that is as wide as the path is long.  There are no visible steps or paths leading to the top of the mesa, but the incline's rocky surface appears somewhat navigable with a bit of effort.  Broken limbs and debris swell over the peak's edge and bear resemblance to the blended materials found in a bird's nest.

title: [Thunder Plateau]
description: Overhead, a thick metal cable can occasionally be seen through the thick puffy clouds, and a massive wall of boulders to the west blocks further travel in that direction.  Heaps of griffin droppings and unending puddles of mud make for challenging foot travel, though frequent stones and rocks provide a slightly elevated pathway for avoiding mishaps despite its equally troublesome attributes.  Rotten logs are both imbedded between rocks and boulders as well as strewn across the ground.

title: [Thunder Plateau]
description: Exposed to wind, rain, thunder, and lightning, all of which are most severe at the southern end of the north-south pathway, the immediate area is ravaged by unrelenting weather assaults.  Obstructed by a stone embankment, the dead-end overlooks a wide cavity in the plateau, and channels of rainwater stream through the breaks in the stone heap and over the edge.  Once home to statuesque and majestic trees, wrecked and rotten trunks and limbs are scattered about the ground.

title: [Thunder Plateau]
description: Thick cloud cover becomes a navigational hazard at this north end of a rock-hampered path, further obscured by a large plateau that casts its shadow over the barely visible trail.  Sounds of loose stones plumeting down the steep slope mingle with winds and pelting rain in a tympanic symphony.  A thick steel wire overhead stretches into the distance and disappears into the clouds to the south.

title: [Thunder Plateau, Northern Mesa]
description: Splintered tree branches encased in silver lichen reinforced with bits of dying flora and feathers comprise an enormous nest that partially encompasses this unusually flat plateau.  Two bracing beams support a large wooden column that has been driven through the ground at the eastern edge, and an immense iron wheel guides thick metal cables through an opening at the top and out across the open landscape below.  A sketchy rope bridge connects to another plateau to the south.

title: [Thunder Plateau]
description: Short-lived glimpses of a jagged and rocky landscape below are quickly blotted out by fast-moving clouds that steal across the dark sky.  Limited visibility, disorienting fog, and relentless rain are ingredients for a precarious adventure and are available in abundance.  Hanging precariously on a branch that protrudes from a huge circular structure made from rotting sticks, mildewed stones, and other area fodder is a tattered satchel.  A rope bridge leads to the northern plateau.

title: [Thunder Plateau, Griffin Path]
description: Unrelenting weather has a cruel effect on this area, leaving the muddy ground slick in areas where the rocks have shifted, and the rocky ground dangerous where moss and mildew have taken residence.  A precipitous rockface leading to a western plateau appears formidable, while the southern trail, lined with broken shells and cracked eggs, appears much more stable.

title: [Inside the Nest]
description: Surrounded by tightly woven sticks and broken tree limbs reinforced with a dense concoction of mud and rotten vegetation, even the smallest amount of movement is a deafening alarm to the presence of an intruder.  Bright crimson blotches disfigure the powder blue feathers that litter the roost, and a nauseating aroma rises from the avian bed, stealing all the existing fresh air.  Knee-high edges make this a formidable nest, but numerous gaps in the avian dwelling make for an easy escape.

title: [Thunder Plateau, Griffin Path]
description: Winds on the western edge of Thunder Plateau are stronger than those elsewhere, and the proximity of lightning strikes are much closer.  Chilled raindrops pelt endlessly against anything in their path and leave a trail of muddy concoctions between non-touching stones.  Downy barbs of powder blue mixed with clumps of sandy blonde fur are strewn across the ground, indicative of recent combat.

title: [Thunder Plateau, Griffin Path]
description: Sloping abruptly downward, the landscape shifts with steep drops on both the eastern and western sides of the path.  Lopsided boulders and natural rock sculptures decorate the scenery and add noteworthy visuals to the otherwise drab views in the cloud-covered and rain trodden region.

title: [Thunder Plateau]
description: Constant droplet impacts generate endless capillary waves in sizable rainwater puddles that have formed outside a dark tunnel, which appears to curve sharply to the southwest and disappear into sheer darkness.  Years of foot traffic and windblown techniques have left elaborate designs along the southern granite barricade.

title: [Thunder Plateau, Krag Tunnel]
description: Dark and dank, the perpetual moisture leaves water droplets that glisten and shimmer along the tunnel walls and drip downward, silvery blue lines embellishing the surrounding walls from one end to the other.  Claw-like gouges in the stone walls sever the shiny blue drip lines, especially surrounding a squat opening, and a bespatter of a thick, dark-colored liquid stains the ground.  The tunnel makes an extreme northeast rise toward the exit.

title: [Thunder Plateau, Kalaz Pond]
description: Below the unrelenting winds and rain of the upper plateaus, this fortuitous haven is surrounded by protective granite and a circular border of gooseberry bushes and is largely unaffected by the conditions above.  Evidenced by a mass of carved initials on the birch tree's trunk in the center of the pond, this is undoubtedly a popular fishing spot.  Persistent lightning strikes illuminate the sky far above, and constant thunder booms shake the ground and send waves of ripples across the pond's surface.

title: [Thunder Plateau, Krag Tunnel]
description: Substantial cracks in the southern wall allow adequate natural light to spill in and assist with visibility for travel through the excavated east-west tunnel.  Ground rubble is disturbed with each step and scatters rock flour mixed with dark hair fibers into the air, while ominous howls echo back and forth through the halls like bantering and conspiring predators.

title: [Thunder Plateau, Krag Tunnel]
description: While somewhat protected from the harsh conditions outside, this tunnel has dangers of its own that necessitate heedfulness.  Resting at the base of an arduous rise is a pile of aged bones, a collective grave that remains largely untouched save the addition of recent casualties.

title: [Thunder Plateau, Vista]
description: Imposing crags and rock faces dominate the western segment of the plateau, but are far less treacherous than the perpetual lightning strikes that befall the higher elevations.  Extending nearly ten feet from the eastern edge is a narrow rocky shelf that stretches over a gaping cavity of the plateau.  Blending with the current sounds of wind, rain, and thunder is the unmistakable roar of a waterfall from somewhere far below.  A sharp descent leads into a smoky tunnel.

title: [Thunder Plateau]
description: Slippery and unstable, piles of stones lie atop one another like bodies in a mass grave and hamper travel in all directions.  Dark grey clouds hang low, and intermittent bursts of light in the sky provide the only reliable area nighttime lighting.  Disfigured shadows cast from a looming western peak dance across the rocks, further impairing navigation.

title: [Thunder Plateau]
description: Perilously jagged and overburdened with dark thunderhead clouds, the surrounding landscape is slightly funereal and forlorn.  Massive boulders rest in obstructive piles to the east, lined up in orderly rows that are tall enough to prevent standard travel in that direction.

title: [Thunder Plateau, Ascent]
description: Clearly visible from this vantage point, a breach in the mountain's precipice provides a much needed egress for the overabundant storm water that escapes with fierce urgency as it plummets to the base.  Ascending to the topmost point of the area is a precipitous acclivity, taunting all who dare to conquer its challenge.

title: [Titan's Crown, Rocky Ascent]
description: At the top of a steep scree declivity, unstable rock gives way to immovable stone.  What was a steep climb now becomes a vertical one.  Mercifully, disguised within the shadow of a tall outcropping, some crude steps have been carved into the mountain.  They zig and zag as they lead the way up, moving closer to falls as they rise, until finally reaching the east bank of the waterfall's crest.

title: [Titan's Deluge, East Bank]
description: Stretching over the water from the fall's west bank, a massive stone bridge seamlessly connects to a narrow strip of craggy rocks that broadens into a wider patch of land further down the lake shore.  Almost entirely unnoticeable, a series of crude steps carved into the mountain's face has been cleverly hidden behind a rough outcropping of stone near where the water spills over the edge and plummets below.

title: [Titan's Deluge, Bridge]
description: The view from the massive bridge connecting the waterfall's east bank to the west is unlike any other.  In one direction, the shadowy gaze of a soaring, imperious mountain denies light to the ridges, plateaus, and foothills below.  In the other, it hides a crater filled with the rain of countless storms and a ring of sky-grazing black columns on an island floating in a lake that reflects the always cloudy sky.

title: [Titan's Deluge, West Bank]
description: A massive stone bridge spans the crest of the waterfall, built from the same stone as the cliffs that soar around it.  Frequent bolts of lightning launched from the sky strike the water nearby, causing the formation of dense steam that floats and curls around the structure.

title: [Titan's Crown, Tempest Shore]
description: A force of nature, the storm is a raw expression of the power and fury of the elements.  Lightning paints the sky with a blue-violet web that is reflected back on the surface of a large puddle.

title: [Titan's Crown, Tempest Shore]
description: A curved, hollowed-out section of rockface, like the negative space left behind from a column carved out of the ancient stone long ago, offers some protection from the harrowing wind.  By extending into the water, the natural alcove also prevents travel to the north.

title: [Titan's Crown, Tempest Shore]
description: Streaks of blindingly white lightning illuminate the sky, bright against dark, rain-swollen clouds, and the scent of wet stone and ozone fills the air.  Raging thunder accompanies every brilliant flash, each deafening clap an assault.  Somehow, a contorted white birch has managed to weather the storm.

title: [Titan's Crown, Tempest Shore]
description: The only plants that seem to be able to live in this hostile environment are moss and lichen.  Some sharp stones blanketed with a layer of dark green are treacherously slick underfoot and beckon you to trip and fall.

title: [Titan's Crown, Tempest Shore]
description: The distance between the shore of the turbulent lake and the island at its center is shorter here where the land and water bend to the east.  The ever-present threat of lightning would give all but the bravest, or most foolish, pause before attempting the short swim.

title: [Titan's Crown, Tempest Shore]
description: Winds howl relentlessly, and bitterly cold rain batters against a massive stone hall with ferocious intensity but rolls off the sides of the domed roof.  Rivulets of water trickle down its walls, scattering the tiny glints of light reflected in flecks of mica trapped in the large, schist flakes.  Built out from the crater wall, it creates the illusion that the hall has always been a part of the landscape and is as natural as the mountain itself.

title: [Titan's Crown, Thunder Hall]
description: The exposed natural layers of the uneven cliff face make up the back wall and transition seamlessly into the constructed ones.  Centered in the room's sunken floor, a huge stone table runs nearly the entire length of the great hall.

title: [Titan's Crown, Tempest Shore]
description: Set back from the water's edge, a large round stone hut partially conceals the mouth of a cave.  Always assailing, powerful gusts of wind blow between them and create something like a low whistle; a sad and mournful song.

title: [Titan's Crown, Cave]
description: Though shallow, the cave offers enough protection from the wind and rain to allow for the maintenance of a small fire.  The smoke fills the air, billowing up in white clouds and bathing strips of meat slowly drying on racks all around the firepit.

title: [A Round Stone Kitchen]
description: Long counters line the walls on either side of a large stone oven.  Simple utensils hang on hooks in the wall, unglazed clay cookware is piled high on built-in shelves, and a melange of savory smells fills the stone hut.

title: [Thunder Hall, West]
description: Large spheres of glowing zorchar are embedded within the stone walls, humming with electricity and filling the space with a soft white light.  Outside, the storm rages on, but only the sound of the heavy raindrops penetrates the domed ceiling.

title: [Thunder Hall, East]
description: Large spheres of glowing zorchar are embedded within the stone walls, humming with electricity and filling the space with a soft white light.  The air is damp and filled with the faintly metallic scent of wet rocks, but the chill of the outside is lessened somewhat by the protection from the wind.

title: [Titan's Crown, Tempest Isle]
description: Choppy waves of the turbulent lake assail the shore, but the way back to the lake shore is the shortest here.  Glowing softly, a hemisphere of dark blue zorchar rests on the ground, perfectly aligned with one of the zorchar-veined obsidian spires of the large ring at the center of the island.

title: [Eye of the Storm]
description: A violent wind whips around the air outside a large ring of towering obsidian spires, driving the rain sideways and fracturing the surface of the lake into choppy crests, but within their protective circle, the air is still, the rain does not fall, and the wind does not howl.  Fractal veins of white zorchar are exposed in the glossy black surface of the columns, like lightning trapped in stone, and glow with a pale blue luminescence.

title: [Titan's Crown, Tempest Isle]
description: Jagged peaks of the crater, barely visible through the downpour, rise like teeth that would consume the sky.  The storm screams with ferocious thunder, but the roar is echoed back by the mountain's maw with equal strength.  A softly glowing hemisphere of bright white zorchar rests on the ground, perfectly aligned with one of the obsidian spires of the large ring at the center of the island.

title: [Titan's Crown, Tempest Isle]
description: Some wild grasses have taken root here, but the ground is too sodden for any to thrive.  They droop under the weight of heavy rain and wilt without the nourishment of the absent sun.  Not far in front the large ring of obsiadian spires at the center of the island, a hemisphere of dark blue zorchar on the ground is aligned with one of the columns.

title: [Titan's Crown, Tempest Isle]
description: The storm pulses with energy, rain falling in sheets from dark, brooding clouds.  Electric blue lightning strike the large ring's obsidian spires, each bolt arching from one to the other and igniting a brilliance in the zorchar veins that run through them as it does.

title: [Titan's Crown, Tempest Isle]
description: Lightning flashes cast an eerie glow across the landscape, each strike accompanied by thunderous rumbles that vibrate the very air with its sound.  And within those moments of light, the truly massive scale of the zorchar-veined obsidian spires of the large ring at the center of the island can be appreciated.

title: [Titan's Crown, Tempest Isle]
description: Huge mud puddles create slick terrain that makes every step hazardous.  The torrential downpour keeps coming, ensuring that the puddles will never disappear.  A softly glowing hemisphere of bright white zorchar rests on the ground, perfectly aligned with one of the obsidian spires of the large ring at the center of the island.

title: [Titan's Crown, Tempest Isle]
description: White clouds of steam rise up from the lake where the water has been superheated by the violent strikes of the storm.  The result is a dense fog that carries the scent of ozone.  A softly glowing hemisphere of bright white zorchar rests on the ground, perfectly aligned with one of the obsidian spires of the large ring at the center of the island.

title: [Titan's Crown, Tempest Isle]
description: Dark, silvery bits of stone in the thin strip of sand circumscribing the island glint in the bright flashes of lightning that streak across the sky.  The aggressively lapping lake shifts them, always pulling some back into the water but returning others.  A softly glowing hemisphere of dark blue zorchar rests on the ground, perfectly aligned with one of the obsidian spires of the ring at the center of the island.

title: [Raining Caves, Behind the Falls]
description: Thick and heavy, the excessive humidity is harsh enough to leave one gasping for fresh, cool air, which is severely lacking in this cave system.  Connected bridges and ledges create a navigable circle around a large chasm, and a foreboding tunnel is evident on the south ledge.  Connectors of questionable craftsmanship, made from fraying rope and moldy ironwood planks, bridge the gaps between the platforms and ledges, which would otherwise be unreachable.

title: [Raining Caves, Rickety Bridge]
description: Spanning the distance to an upper southern ledge, this bridge doesn't seem sturdy enough to support the weight of a single individual, much less a group of multiples.  Wide gaps between each of its wooden slats give a bird's eye view of the rocky cavern floor, which appears to be littered with skeletal remains.  Faint growls and snorts echo through the area, but it's difficult to pinpoint their origin, as every sound seems to bounce off the walls multiple times.

title: [Raining Caves, South Ledge]
description: Providing an encompassing glimpse of the area from this lofty vantage point, it is obvious that both moonlight and moisture are able to infiltrate the cavern given the glistening rock walls and the resulting performance of twinkles that dance around the black abyss.  In addition to the ramshackle connectors, a dark tunnel, with disembodied howls emerging from its opening, begs investigation.  A tiny trickle of water flows down the slick granite wall, easily overlooked if not for a small puddle directly beneath.

title: [Raining Caves, Tunnel]
description: Dark granite walls with a slick sheen form a long east-west tunnel with what appears to be a larger open area at the eastern end.  Droplets of moisture fall from the ceiling and create a pit-a-pat that echoes throughout the corridors and resembles the sound of a light rain.  Translucid veils of mist, tinged slightly with a greenish hue, appear periodically and float in the air like clouds, only to be dispersed with the least bit of movement.

title: [Raining Caves, Tunnel]
description: Oversized and extremely hairy, a fast-moving shadow scampers along the wall and disappears into a narrow cavity.  Darkness is extreme, and intermittent sparkles of silver-blue flecks imbedded in the granite give minimal insight to spacial location.  Wafts of fresh rain sneak past but are quickly overtaken by unpleasant scents that border on noxious.

title: [Raining Caves, Tunnel]
description: While mostly advantageous, a noticeable increase in distant ambient lighting gives a splash of insight into the claustrophobic quality of these tunnels.  At the juncture of multiple passageways, a strong wind whips through the tunnel and brings with it a myriad of smells and sounds, a subterranean concoction with an unsavory appeal.  With a slight downgrade, the ground becomes increasingly slippery as the moisture levels rise and solid footing turns to mud.

title: [Raining Caves, Tunnel]
description: Whispers of familiar sounds echo from just beyond the immediate area, and short periods of intense illumination followed by furious cracks of thunder shake the encapsulating stone enough that handfuls of stone powder trickles from the ceiling and supplements the sodden state of the ground.  Silvery blue flecks mingle with the falling dust and simulate bioluminescent insects as they travel from ceiling downward.  There appears to be an open expanse to the north with substantial lighting.

title: [Raining Caves, Tunnel]
description: More jagged than smooth, but more curved than straight, the sides of the tunnel form natural shapes with bulges and recessions that spawn bizarre shadows along the ground in an already shadowy space.  Intermittent snorts and howls drift down the tunnel and then hang heavily in the air until sudden movement disperses the lingering pocket of noise.

title: [Raining Caves, Tunnel]
description: Streaming in from the east, a rancid miasma resembling a cross between rotten eggs and animal excrement makes breathing an arduous task.  Sizeable water drops rain down upon anything beneath the persistant seepage.  Previous attempts to illuminate these tunnels have proven undoubtedly futile, validated by rusty iron sconces with unused candles whose wicks weep with moisture.

title: [Raining Caves, Hound Den]
description: Piles of bones, some with bits of flesh still attached and others gnawed completely clean, are scattered everywhere with nearly every section of ground covered.  About five feet in diameter, a creature-made hole has filled with a foul smelling liquid, and bits of debris float along its murky surface.  Thick, long scratch marks around the depression's perimeter suggest it was burrowed by a clawed animal.

title: [Raining Caves, Tunnel]
description: Sizeable water droplets rain down upon everything beneath the persistant seepage and leave a layer of moisture along the ground coupled with a thick, suffocating humidity in the air.  Deep incisions are noticeable along the granite walls, scratched in patterns generated by enormous clawed paws that have swept across the stone.  Strong vibrations shake the earth underfoot and are followed by an extended series of muffled rumblings, though they seem to be originating from outside the caves.

title: [Raining Caves, Tunnel]
description: Lighting deficiencies and the constant reverberation of sounds make disorientation commonplace at this point in the entanglement of caves and tunnels.  Silvery blue flecks dot the encircling tenebrous stone walls, a quasi star-filled night sky.  With a fairly claustrophobic, maximum width of about five feet and few stretches of straight travel, the risk of body-to-stone collision is highly probable.

title: [Raining Caves, Dead End]
description: Higher than even the tallest giant, the cavern ceiling opens up to the sky to reveal dark grey stormclouds looming overhead against a nighttime sky.  Rain flows freely down the granite walls and fills up small depressions scattered about, exacerbating the humid quality of this place.  The muffled roar of a neighboring waterfall adds a natural harmony to the sounds of an approaching storm, but extended periods of such auditory stimulation can be deafening.

title: [Raining Caves, Rickety Bridge]
description: With even the most careful of steps, the bridge sways back and forth in a precarious manner, creaking and groaning as if it could surrender to its shoddy condition at any moment.  Worn smooth after excessive use, the ropes used for handholds bear an unfortunate side effect of the excessive humidity:  a chalky, dark green mold.  Splintered sections of wood detach from the structure's main slats with a distressing crack, similar to that of a bone breaking.

title: [Raining Caves, East Ledge]
description: Chilled beads of water rain down from the cave's stone canopy, a veil of moisture clouding the main panorama.  Partially excavated, with a mining pick lodged into the granite and its wooden handle broken in half, a small alcove gathers a pool of water as its entrance slopes downward.  An iron lantern with yellowed glass panes hangs from a patinaed copper hook.

title: [Raining Caves, East Ledge]
description: A short overhang provides a temporary reprieve from relentless raindrops falling from the ceiling.  Significantly cooler drafts from above plummet and commingle with the humid, warmer air below, creating a blanket of thick fog that swells and recedes, like ocean waves.

title: [Raining Caves, Rickety Bridge]
description: Without an abundance of light, the ability to identify distant objects is difficult at best.  The location of this bridge, however, is situated directly beneath a thin stream of light, infiltrating the cavern from an aperture farther up the wall.  Prowling and lurking far below are packs of hounds, some with eyes that cast a green glow, and others whose nostrils erupt a green mist.  Patches of tinged fog rise slowly into the air, but dissipate long before they reach the bridge.

title: [Raining Caves, North Ledge]
description: Seemingly suspended between two bridges, the north ledge does not connect with the wall at the floor, making movement somewhat problematic.  Periodic vibrations rumble through the cavern and rattle the floating stone slab, bits of rock crumbling free and falling to the chasm floor.  There are a number of persistent trickles, liquid threads from floor to ceiling, greatly resembling puppet strings.

title: [Raining Caves, Platform]
description: Deep scrapes and gashes surrounding a deep pit suggest that a clawed creature has either buried a treasure or wants to dig something up.  Given the harsh aromas ascending from the center of the cavern, the likelihood that dead things are buried throughout is increasing.  From this ledge, it's difficult to see any detail given the lack of lighting, but there is definite movement at the bottom of the chasm.

title: [Raining Caves, Rickety Bridge]
description: Bouncing with unbridled motion, this fragile link between the west ledge and north ledge quickly becomes a lifebuoy, evidenced by the haggard condition of the once-thick ropes that serve as railings.  An echoing drip-drop sound serves only to distract from the inability to see clearly in this mist-laden area of the cavern.  Slick walls glisten despite sufficient lighting, mostly due to silvery blue flecks imbedded into the stone.

title: [Limpidity]
description: Despite the vastness of the window, illumination for the shop is taken over by a multitude of frosted orbs that hang from the ceiling, emitting a quiet hum as they produce an even, steady glow.  Wares are arranged upon shelves and counters throughout the space, while a small worktable in one corner is covered in paints, vials, and etching tools.  A bespeckled burghal gnome glassmaker tinkers about, assisting customers with a grin from beneath his bushy mustache.

title: [The Hidden Glade]
description: Partially hidden by tall, bright green grasses, a pebble-lined brook meanders through the area and disappears under a wall of thorny brambles.  Edelweiss courts juniper saplings near the eastern edge of the meadow, while the opposite verge is shrouded in the shadows of tower conifers.  A delicate fairy ring of scotch bonnet mushrooms encircles a patch of necrotic earth that is illuminated by silvered moonlight.

title: [Hidden Glade, Boulder Summit]
description: Worn smooth from the elements and the passage of time, the boulder is surrounded in a halo of mist and moisture.  Moonlight bathes the expanse in a silvery glow that is picked up by the bits of mica imbedded into the stone.  A soft checkered linen blanket offers a quiet resting place beside a fitfully burning candle, while nearby natural steps descend from the edge of the boulder and disappear into the crystal-clear depths of the brook that passes below.

title: [Balar's General Store]
description: Beneath an oak beam ceiling, a mounted fish skeleton hangs on one of the painted black oak walls.  A rough oak crate and a low wrought iron table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a golden blonde oak floor.

title: [Balar's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Balar's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [ICICLE, Courtyard]
description: A thick-cut pine log palisade surrounds the courtyard, meeting at a large open gate.  A hitching post sits near the entrance of the enclosure, flanked by fresh hay bales and a water trough.  A large hand-carved black marble bowl rests on a polished steel pedestal in the center of the courtyard, a ring of birdseed hulls littering the snow beneath the bowl.  Off to one side, a small round table sits in a relatively protected area.  Unlit torches line a snow-edged pathway from the entrance to a rose-carved ironwood entryway with a pair of sturdy double doors.

title: [ICICLE, Ice Hound Pub]
description: Some faintly glowing lanterns reflect off the polished curved mahogany walls, creating a warm glow that illuminates the dark room.  A wooden sign with "Ice Hound Pub" burnt into the wood hangs above a blackened stone fireplace.  Cushioned booths with small tables line the curved walls of the pub.  A large polished cherrywood bar sits in the middle of the room.  Glass shelves behind the bar hold familiar and exotic alcoholic offerings.  Several doors lead in and out of the pub.

title: [ICICLE, Kitchen]
description: A white oak arch with swinging doors separates the kitchen and pub, sealing off some of the noise from the bustling staff at work.  A large fel cupboard occupies one corner, its doors ajar, revealing shelves stacked with sumptuous dishes and prepared desserts.  A white marble counter is laden with cutting boards and a variety of knives and utensils, while several pots and pans continuously bubble and bake across the numerous stoves built along the walls.

title: [ICICLE, Frozen Pond]
description: The pond is nestled in the center of a ring-shaped building, a sturdy pine door leading back inside.  Sunlight reflects and refracts across the thick layer of ice that covers most of the pond's surface, causing a dazzling diamond effect.  A multitude of razor-thin grooves mar the surface of the ice, and the pond is surrounded by heaping snowdrifts, nearly concealing a worn grey beechwood log and an empty winterberry ale barrel that rests nearby.  A cleared path leads to a small fishing dock on the southern side of the pond.

title: [ICICLE, Fishing Dock]
description: A path cleared in the snowdrifts leads to and from a weathered pine dock that extends out over the southern side of the frozen pond.  Its surface is slick from a thin layer of ice formed by the morning's frozen dew.  A hole, big enough to fit a halfling, has been cut through the ice at the end of the dock, affording a glimpse into the murky depths of the pond.  Curious fish, seeking the warmth of the sun's light, cause the water in the hole to ripple.  A stone firepit sits near the opposite end of the dock.

title: [ICICLE, Rival's Ring]
description: Benches line the curved walls of this large, open area, all facing the center where an octagonal wooden stage serves as the focal point for onlookers.  Dangling from the ceiling directly above the stage is a magnificent chandelier.  A stone statue of a penguin stands at each of the four cardinal directions of the arena, serving as silent observers.  Strategically placed furthest away from both an opening with a pair of slatted saloon doors and a large pine door on the opposite end is a refreshments table.

title: [ICICLE, Silverback Jack's]
