description: Cigar smoke hangs heavily and perpetually in the air of the gaming room.  A sign hangs above each of the entrances, a fir door and a pine door, reading, "Silverback Jack's."  Various tables are scattered around the area holding an assortment of cards, dice, and other gambling accoutrements.  Displayed prominently on one of the slightly curved walls is a dart board, hundreds of tiny, dart-sized holes peppering the wall around it.  A single dart has permanently wedged itself in a brass refreshments cart situated nearby.

title: [ICICLE, Pet Parlor]
description: From the modwir hardwood floors to the canvas-covered walls, the expansive room is a pet's wonderland filled with carpet-covered perches and towers to promote climbing and exploration.  A pet-friendly chaos of glittery balls and toys litter the floor, inviting inquisitive pet guests to play.  Plush silk pillows rest against the curved walls, a relaxation spot for pets and people alike.  Opposite a thick fir door, a tall cherrywood cabinet sits near a varnished mahogany door, a tiny pile of chewed rawhide next to it.

title: [ICICLE, Laethe Theatre]
description: A small white marble dais occupies the center of the modest theatre.  Plush velvet-covered cushions rest on the rows of benches that hug the curved walls, creating an intimate setting between audience and speaker.  An intricate, diamond-cut crystal chandelier is suspended over the dais, casting prismatic rainbows across the white marble.  A small faewood sideboard sits near a varnished mahogany door, a pumpkin-hued ash door opposite it.

title: [ICICLE, Dirvy's Office]
description: A warm glow illuminates the white ash walls from the crystal sconces placed around the office, and the scent of pumpkin pie permeates the room.  Two comfortable chairs flank a small marble table in front of a large oak desk in the center of the room.  Bay windows line the curved walls, allowing sunlight to filter in.  A carpet-covered perch sits near one window, a small wooden cage by another.  The cage door is unlocked and opened, a tiny note left in its escaped occupant's place.  A pumpkin-hued ash door leads out.

title: [the Hinterwilds - Urchin Hideout]
description: This is a fake room used to hold wayto/timeto for urchin guides.

title: [Hinterwilds - Urchin Hideout]
description: This is a fake room used to hold wayto/timeto for urchin guides.

title: [Seareach - Urchin Hideout]
description: This is a fake room used to hold wayto/timeto for urchin guides.

title: [Bard's Guild, Minstrel's Market]
description: Walls paneled in warm cherrywood hold a variety of instruments, quills, and parchment displayed like precious artifacts.  Intricate iron sconces, shaped like treble clefs, emit a soft, golden light, casting a welcoming glow over the polished wooden counter.  Behind it, an elderly bard tends to customers with a gentle smile.  The air is filled with the subtle scent of old paper and wood polish, mingling harmoniously with distant strains of music.

title: [Bard Guild, Singing Serendipity]
description: Crafted of polished lebbek, this shop is practically overflowing with instruments, stage props, costumes, and other trinkets vital to performing and bardic arts.  Several shelves hold bolts of cloth in vibrant colors, and cosmetics fill numerous bins near the main counter.  A carved lebbek arch leads out.

title: [Bard Guild, Tricks of the Hare]
description: A brightly burning fireplace has labored to fill the close air of the shop with warmth, but only enough smoke to blacken the low eaves.  Several rabbit statuettes made from fired clay sit atop an old wooden counter that marks the boundaries of a tidy office space.  On a desk behind the counter, several crystal leaves are pieced together to form an incomplete clover talisman.

title: [Bard Guild, Shop]
description: Floor-to-ceiling windows have tops fitted with stained glass in bright red and copper hues, while the shutters that flank them are open to allow the salt-laden sea breezes to trickle in.  Opposite the windows and across the rug-covered floors, a double wide archway provides egress into the Great Hall.  Eastern and western bookcases provide a variety of wares for sale, the shelves watched over by an apprentice.

title: [Bard Guild, Landing]
description: White spindled rails line the marble stairway and landing area, giving a view of the foyer below.  A teak bench is placed to one side, with a long ceramic planter to the other, full of flowering orchids and vines that hang down, reaching for the foyer below.  Covering the wall is a large handwoven tapestry reflecting vibrant colors.

title: [Bard Guild, Upstairs Hallway]
description: Standing to either side of the open window is a pair of thick verdant ferns billowing over the rim of their bright ceramic pots, their leaves draping across a patterned crimson carpet.  A beautiful marble sculpture rests next to a polished mahogany door.  The floor sparkles as beams of sunlight stream in, catching the gold flecks in the marble.

title: [Bard Guild, Upstairs Hallway]
description: Looking out over the inner garden, a tall arcing window allows the sounds and scents of the jungle to float into the hall.  A golden stand rests next to a carved teak door, displaying a colorful parrot perched on a swing inside a large filigree cage suspended from a golden stand.  A pair of mahogany chairs is placed to either side of a small matching table adorned with a sea glass vase filled with bright exotic flowers.  Draped with azure blue silk, a carved pale mistwood archway capped with a sea glass keystone is recessed at the end of the corridor.

title: [Bard Guild, Harp Room]
description: Standing in front of a beautifully carved chair, a huge silver mistwood harp dominates the small room.  Several piles of manuscripts and sheet music are stacked about the deep crimson rug.  A tall silver stand of candles sits to the side of the large arcing window, a small writing desk to the other.

title: [Bard Guild, Gold Room]
description: Cushioned with crimson, a carved wooden chair holds court amid several pieces of sheet music that have tumbled from their perch upon a claw-footed silver music stand.  Piles of journals, manuscripts, and books are stacked in, on, and around a large bookcase on one wall, while other books are neatly piled upon the lush golden carpet.  A large open window, near the back, allows sunlight to illuminate the area, though the bulk of the light is blocked by the hanging basket, brimming with jungle blossoms, that is suspended above it.

title: [Bard Guild, Upstairs Hallway]
description: Sunlight streams in through the tall open window, warming the gold-flecked marble floor.  Beautifully carved, teak molding runs down the hall, interrupted by a silk-draped archway.  Twin ceramic urns of exotic flowers stand against the wall, filling the corridor with their sweet perfume.

title: [Bard Guild, Upstairs Hallway]
description: Placed under the large, open window, a small cushioned teakwood bench looks out over the lush green garden below.  A thick crimson carpet rests before a teak-trimmed arch, its silk drapes caught by a gentle jungle breeze.  Off to the side, a translucent crystal flute ringed with bands of white gold rests protected inside a gold-trimmed polished glass case upon a gold-flecked ivory marble stand.

title: [Bard Guild, Upstairs Hallway]
description: Crystal clear water trickles from the black granite fountain set against the far wall.  Tall potted ferns stand next to a teak archway draped with pale silk.  Sounds from the garden drift in through the tall arcing window.

title: [Bard Guild, Music Library]
description: Lining the walls of this spacious room, floor to ceiling shelves are filled with every variety of book, journal, and manuscript imaginable.  Several cushioned chairs rest in front of a large, arced window draped in sheer silk, that looks out over the lush jungle.  Resting to either side of a curtained archway, a pair of candelabra stands ready to add light to the spacious library.

title: [Bard Guild, Instrument Repair]
description: Crafted of mahogany, a bench is placed before an equally well used worktable, small tools lay scattered over the surface, while several instruments in various states of repair rest to the side.  Several wooden boxes are stacked about and filled with an assortment of materials.  A leafy, green fern drapes over the edge of a hanging ceramic pot filled with huge cascading ferns dangling to the sill of the large, open window.

title: [Bard Guild, Costumes and Props]
description: Bright colors explode from the various racks and stands of costumes that fill the room.  Piled under a large window, crates of masks lay half open, spilling their contents out over the floor.  A chest of props and other performance items sits open next to a huge wall mirror.  Draped over a pair of chairs, lengths of brilliant material cascade gracefully across the marble floor.

title: [Bard Guild, Library Nook]
description: Suspended from a fine vaalin chain, candles inside a frosted crystal globe light the small area.  Cushioned benches line the length of the circular room surrounding the curtained archway.  Several paintings hang on the walls, which are paneled in rich golden teak.

title: [Bard Guild, Specialty Boutique]
description: Gold-flecked marble peeks from beneath a rich gold and crimson carpet that cushions the floor of the cozy boutique.  Several frosted crystal globes are suspended above a polished teak counter that runs the length of the room.  Various items for sale are displayed on a set of mistwood shelves.  Hanging next to a carved pale mistwood archway is a crystal wind chime.

title: [Bard Guild, Treblima's Trinkets]
description: Glaes-veined prismatic crystal chimes hang from the ceiling by thin silver chains, their rainbow-hued striations reflecting the steady light of a central lantern in a shifting, multihued display of colors across every surface in this quaint shop.  Lustrous songstones and jewelry are presented in a velvet-lined, tiered display case along the slightly curved wall, facing an arched passageway to the south.

title: [Bard Guild, Fortune's Favor]
description: Plush velvet curtains are pulled back to reveal floor-to-ceiling windows of sparkling glass, golden sunlight spilling through the panes onto polished hardwood floors.  Arranged atop a gleaming cherrywood counter, a gilded vase filled with deep pink peonies looms over a sleek jewelry tray crowded with a selection of wares.  An assortment of parchment-wrapped parcels are stacked neatly on an ivory-topped table next to an elaborate gilt-stringed harp, its fireleaf pillar carved to resemble a wood sprite.

title: [Bard Guild, Troubadour's Trove]
description: Aged layers of sheet music line the pale azure-colored walls of the shop, the calligraphy-inked parchments glazed in a lacquer of silvery gold and encircled by lily-crafted wooden frames.  Miniature carvings of various instruments are angled across a silk-draped counter, the diminutive woodwind and percussion pieces nestled between pieces of musical note-shaped glass wrought in swirls of color.

title: [Refined Repast]
description: Swathes of pale blue satin line the walls of the elegant shop, falling to the ground in pools of cascading fabric.  Covering the white marble floor is a plush carpet patterned with specks of azure and gold.  A trio of marbled stone shelves are spread with an assortment of cutlery, while several glaesine cases display a variety of glassware and place settings.  Rows of crystal lanterns hang above, illuminating the displays in their gentle glow.

title: [Refined Repast, Atelier]
description: Azure and gold fleck the thick alabaster wool carpet that covers the floor of the small room.  Several silver candelabra are placed about, their thick beeswax candles fill the room with a natural, sweet scent as well as brightly illuminate a narrow marble worktable.  Pale blue satin lines the walls of the area, their lengths shimmering in the luminous glow.

title: [Ta'Nalfein - Urchin Hideout]
description: This is a fake room used to hold wayto/timeto for urchin guides.

title: [The Lighthouse, Cramped Alcove]
description: Soaring shelves hung with wheeled ladders line every available inch of wall space in this alcove, chockablock with various gizmos, half-built devices, and the multifarious oddments of the tinker's craft.  A squat cocobolo desk on stubby, scuffed legs sits central in the alcove, its entire surface covered with a peculiar contraption fashioned of brass with myriad clockwork arms, diverse gears, and a meandrous steampipe sticking out of it.

title: [The TownCrier, Lobby]
description: The lofty open-beamed ceiling provides a glimpse of the second floor newsroom, visible just beyond a sturdy mahogany railing.  Sunlight filters through twin palladian windows flanking the entry, refracting through crystalline glass panes to wash the narrow tanik floorboards.  Opposite the entry doors, a polished mahogany reception counter holds an assortment of refreshments and a small handwritten card.  A twining grapevine fresco follows some curved steps ascending to the open space above.

title: [The TownCrier, Community Hall]
description: A wide archway opens into a spacious hall with strikingly grained mahogany walls that climb into soaring rafters.  High above, a large dome of stained glass displays four messenger birds flying in from the cardinal directions to a center emblem displaying the entwined letters T and C.  In the center of the hall, a polished tanik dance floor is flanked by groups of chairs arranged in small conversational groupings.  A pair of paneled mahogany doors framed in dark blue velvet curtains mark the northern wall.

title: [The TownCrier, Auditorium]
description: Tidy rows of plush seats are arranged facing an elevated stage.  Dark blue velvet curtains drape the wall behind the platform, their sheen set softly aglow by dimly lit crystal-globed chandeliers suspended from the darkened ceiling.  Covered in lushly carved wooden paneling expertly designed to amplify sound, the walls of the auditorium gradually narrow until they meet the sides of the stage, providing a singular point of focus.

title: [The TownCrier, Gallery]
description: A large banner is suspended from the ceiling just inside the archway, boasting an assortment of hand-drawn quills and ribbon-tied scrolls surrounding the title "Elanthian News Delivery Through The Ages."  Lush carpeting quiets the octagonal room, each wall featuring a display centered upon its smoothly plastered expanse.  High above, domed stained glass in jewel tones depicts a messenger bird coming to rest upon a twining grapevine.  A large, round rich blue leather bench provides a welcome spot to rest.

title: [The TownCrier, Newsroom]
description: Numerous desks in various states of disarray are scattered around the room, covered in stacks of books and papers, the odd bottle of ink perched precariously atop the piles.  Scraps of parchment are clipped to strategically placed contraptions hanging from beams.  A large blackboard is mounted on the west wall between an office and the conference room.  Open wood-framed cubbyholes line the south wall beneath glass-fronted news clippings, some empty, some bursting at the seams with unopened wax-sealed scrolls.

title: [The TownCrier, Break Room]
description: This cozy space provides a respite from the chaos of the newsroom, beginning with the scent of freshly brewed coffee.  Cushioned mahogany bar stools surround a high-top butcher block bar table.  An antique mahogany sideboard resides along the back wall, its surface covered with a generous assortment of treats.  Near the west wall, a well-used leather couch sits before the warmth of an iron stove.  On the stovetop, popcorn rises from a pitter-pattering copper contraption.

title: [The TownCrier, Office]
description: Lined on three walls with floor-to-ceiling bookshelves, the tidy office's fourth wall is occupied by a long horizontal window offering a view into the bustling newsroom.  A small slant-topped drafting table rests in the center of the room, a cushioned high-backed turning stool placed squarely beside.  A small-brimmed hat pinned with a square-carded news credential hangs from a polished mahogany coat rack.

title: [The TownCrier, Conference Room]
description: A long, polished mahogany table takes center stage in this well-lit meeting room.  Dark carpeting runs the length of the room, finely woven with messenger birds in flight and bordered by a twining grapevine motif in shades of taupe and mossy green.  Upon one wall, a large scale map of Elanith is framed above the tall carved credenza.  On the opposite wall, a marked-up calendar hangs beside several draft sheets of parchment.  Beside the door, a simple rectangular window looks out over the newsroom.

title: [The TownCrier, Rooftop Garden]
description: Offering sweeping views across the town's haphazard structures to the sparkling waters of the bay, the rooftop is furnished with comfortable bench seating encircling a central copper-clad firepit.  An enclosure protects the stairs leading back into the building, a well-worn dart board mounted on its outer wall.  Weathered grey tanik box planters, bursting with fragrant flora, surround the space.  Messenger birds swoop in to rest on a perch, observing the area momentarily before taking flight again.

title: [Northern Caravansary, Cuddfan]
description: Departing through the surrounding tents and wagons, a sinuous gravel-lined track connects a gaily painted bright yellow wagon to the wider world.  Laying forgotten in the nearby grass, a long oak tongue hangs off the front of the wagon, while large round stones are wedged around the high wheels.  Red-eyed colorful gaillardias and blue-hued asters grow in clusters throughout the shaggy lawn, though they stay clear of the shadows of a small alley that disappears between the back of the wagon and nearby tents.
location: Cuddfan Hollow, inside the Northern Caravansary on the outskirts of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Cuddfan Hollow, Living Space]
description: Small windows in the western wall allow natural light to filter into the tidy space, though copper lanterns, pot-bellied and glossy, hang from the exposed rafters of the ceiling to illuminate even the deepest corners of the wagon.  Compact cabinets fashioned of haon rise from the painted blue and yellow floor, each covered with glossy counters and fitted with closure toggles.  A potbellied cast iron stove sits in one corner, its chimney pipe disappearing in the roof, while a key-shaped bright blue door remains open to the outside.
location: Cuddfan Hollow, inside the Northern Caravansary on the outskirts of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Cuddfan Hollow, Sleeping Space]
description: Small and large rugs are stacked upon the ebonwood floors of the wagon's sleeping quarters, their woven patterns decorative and varied.  Fitted into the back half of the wagon, a large box bed occupies much of the space, though its underside has been cleverly fitted with a variety of drawers for convenient storage.  A pair of bronze sconces flank on either side of a bright off-white door that leads to the backyard.

title: [Cuddfan Hollow, Yard]
description: Potted plants create an organic fence that almost completely hides the various tents and wagons of the surrounding caravansary, though the prolific growth is arranged to keep the back side of a gaily painted bright yellow wagon and nearby dark alley visible at all times.  Long picnic tables rest along the northeastern section of the yard, their wide oak benches covered in thick cushions, while a large blazing bonfire surrounded by a large stone slab sits in the center.  Off to one side, a mesh-covered rain barrel sits beside a wrought iron rack filled with tinder and kindling.
location: Cuddfan Hollow, inside the Northern Caravansary on the outskirts of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Cuddfan Hollow, Rooftop]
description: Guarded by a low, copper pole railing, the platform perches upon the top of the wagon and has a panoramic view of the entire caravansary.  Large, water-resistant cushions are clustered along the western end, supported by a low wall of decorative white birch, while the eastern edge has a polished copper ladder leading to the yard below.  A small painted table shares space at the center of the rooftop with a wrought iron and brass telescope.
location: Cuddfan Hollow, inside the Northern Caravansary on the outskirts of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Cuddfan Hollow, Garden Niche]
description: Playfully embedded amid colorful potted plants that create a verdant separation wall, a vine-covered trellis strung with myriad silver and gold chimes connects the garden niche to a nearby backyard.  Curved stone benches are arranged in rows, creating audience seating around the niche's foci of a tile-lined alabaster fountain sporting a sculpture of Cholen.  Sunlight intermittently slips through the foliage, producing a play of colors upon the fountain's water and painting the stone in kaleidoscopic hues.
location: Cuddfan Hollow, inside the Northern Caravansary on the outskirts of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Oleander House, Entry]
description: Smooth sage green walls encircle the small entry, which is illuminated by frosted orbs hung in the four corners.  Rows of scrollwork wrought iron hooks hang about six feet off the ground, providing storage space for outerwear garments, while below them is a small painted wooden chest designed to house shoes.  A coarse mat of bristles and river reeds rests upon the slate tiles and is positioned before a solid modwir door, while a wall-hugging staircase leads to the second floor.
location: Oleander House, inside the city of Vornavis Proper

title: [Oleander House, Living Quarters]
description: Heavy drapes frame two floor-to-ceiling windows along the western wall of the living space, while the eastern wall is dominated by a large riverstone fireplace with a dark walnut mantel.  Cozy armchairs and couches surround a low white birch table that rests upon a rich carpet of abstract designs.  Dominating the northern wall as it transitions into a small scullery, several pieces of framed artwork hang upon the wall above a rolltop mahogany desk and its matching chair.
location: Oleander House, inside the city of Vornavis Proper

title: [Oleander House, Scullery]
description: Small and compact, the scullery is surrounded by tidy shelves and marble counters with birdseye maple cupboards beneath.  Forested globes are housed beneath the lowest of the shelves, illuminating a cutting board, soapstone basin, and a series of stove-topped ovens.  A bright white door in the northern wall leads outside.
location: Oleander House, inside the city of Vornavis Proper

title: [Oleander House, Veranda]
description: Blocking a view of the city, oleander shrubs grow along a short stone wall that separates a plot of manicured grass from that of the neighboring home.  Enameled chairs of bright white encircle an enameled wrought iron table upon the grey slate slabs of the patio, which rests beneath a canopy of emerald green canvas.  Surrounded by potted raised herb gardens, a bright white door leads into the residence.
location: Oleander House, inside the city of Vornavis Proper

title: [Oleander House, Hallway]
description: Occupying a large section of the hallway, a cherrywood curio with glass doors displays various pieces of collected bric-a-brac and keeps them safe from prying fingers.  Standing opposite one another, a painted blue door leads to the guest room, while the double-wide doors lead to the master bedroom.  An ocean-themed, circular rug dominates the landing, its glossy mahogany planks easily transitioning into a wall-hugging maoral staircase that leads to the floor below.
location: Oleander House, inside the city of Vornavis Proper

title: [Oleander House, Guest Room]
description: Tidy and compact, the narrow room has banded blue and green walls decorated with pale yellow oleander flowers.  Facing the open door, a plump floral armchair occupies a space near a window, while a narrow four-poster bed with a carved mahogany washstand is arranged opposite.  An oak-framed standing mirror of polished copper and mahogany rests beside a floral changing screen.

title: [Oleander House, Master Bedroom]
description: Large glass windows dominate the southern wall, providing the window seat that rests before it with an uninterrupted view of the streets below.  Surrounded by doily-covered tables, a large doublewide bed covered in decorative quilts rests its headboard against the pale yellow walls of soft linen.  Creating a focal point within the room, a large armoire with carved headers and footers stretches to the ceiling in full view of the open double-wide doors.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Forest]
description: Occasionally, a clump of snow falls from somewhere above you, cascading down the branches and snapping twigs as it gathers momentum.  Several trails converge here, but only two of them seem well-used.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Neartofar Forest, Path]
description: Saplings and seedlings sprout from the shadowy forest floor in dapples of moonlight, their pliable stems peppered with silver-cast, newborn foliage.  Carved deep into the ridged faces of towering old growth, the occasional pentagonal marking guides the distinct, debris-free trail as it wends through the darkened woods.

title: [Neartofar Forest, Path]
description: Abundant deciduous trees contrast the scarcity of undergrowth, though hints of new life burgeon beneath the copious canopy.  In the early stages of decay, a massive fallen elm serves as a haven to monk's-hood lichen and crawling insects, the center of its toppled form cut out to allow the trail to continue uninterrupted.

title: [Neartofar Forest, Path]
description: Winding through the woodland, the trail passes jagged stumps jutting out from the verdure-starved earth, evidence of their former lives scattered in piles laden with mushrooms and snails.  While staggered and sparse, the trees that still stand within the arboreal graveyard are ancient giants, finespun webs caught between them.

title: [Yasrenila Compound, Entrance]
description: Age-old oaks, elms, and maples bear umbrageous crowns that extend their lush shelter well beyond the edges of the glade they encircle.  Following the organic border, flowering sweetbriar shrouds a sturdy log fence split by a gated, carved beech arbor, the delicate pink blossoms deceptively hiding hooked prickles.

title: [Yasrenila, Honeybee Circle]
description: Sweetly fragrant, domes of honeysuckle part their floral curtains to reveal low doors and glass-paned windows.  Forest gnomes wander the flagstone path that meanders through the dwellings, guided by cheery sunflowers and raised gardens spilling out plentiful blossoms.  Entwined with a pentagonal fence, sweetbriar divides the compound from the forest, a carved beech arbor offering an opening in the center.

title: [Yasrenila, Honeybee Circle]
description: Magnificently ancient, a lone oak tree encroaches upon the glade, its massive roots diving beneath the log fence hidden behind pale-flowered ivybriar.  A series of squat, round-topped homes clad in lacy vines trim the forest's edge.  Nearby, a clothesline stretches between two trunks, bearing hanging garments that wave in the faint breeze.  Flat stones cut a trail between a pair of flower beds before disappearing into the shelter of a natural arbor.

title: [Yasrenila, Imaera's Alcove]
description: Woody vines arch over a sculpted marble woman cradling a sylvan, moonbeams filtering through the tangled weave in an ethereal haze of diffused light.  Carved offering bowls of seeds and nuts rest amidst the deep green tendrils bearing white florets that climb her ivory-toned feet and up the back of the arbor.  Tucked within the cozy, natural nook, an intricately woven willow twig bench offers a place for respite and reflection.

title: [Yasrenila, Wisteria Walk]
description: Lush curtains of wisteria drape from gnarled boughs that bend over the petal-strewn path leading through the trees.  Reflecting the moonlight breaking through the floral canopy, a fall of thirteen glass teardrops glints within the plethora of royal purple blooms.  Bats flit chaotically through the cloud-like shroud, diving toward the glittering droplets to pilfer a snack in the silver-cast forest.  A live-edge juniper bench nestles between a web of exposed roots.

title: [Yasrenila, Honeybee Circle]
description: Their denizens quiet and unseen in the night, numerous hives stand scattered beneath the umbrageous treetops, slivers of moonlight dappling the cedar frames.  Joined by pale sea glass blooms unfurling from bronze stems, ferns and vibrant wildflowers thrive within maple-slatted flower beds.  The dense forest edging the clearing is broken by a faint trail that disappears into the treeline beside a canopied birch stall.

title: [Honeycomb Hodgepodge]
description: Painted in bold yellow and deep black hues, garlands of carved beads and vellum-winged wood honeybees are strung about the birch frame of the stall.  A honeycomb-stitched canvas canopy shades the well-sanded counter displaying neat rows of beeswax candles and honey jars alongside assorted other wares.  Winking with fireflies, profusions of moonlit blossoms spring up on either side of the stand.

title: [Woodland Whimsy]
description: Tangled briars border the space, nearly enclosing it in a thorny embrace as they bend overhead like a prickly, sky-blocking shroud.  Remnants of a long-dried stream, raised shelves of stratified rock frame either side, extending past the threat of the brambles.  Scattered lanterns light the assortment of wooden jewelry arranged upon the brittle, crumbling ledges.

title: [Yasrenila, Starling Round]
description: Camouflaged beneath vines peppered with open moonflowers, dwellings halo an abundant garden featuring a centerpiece of a lichenous pale rhyolite basin amply veined with citrine.  The bifurcated path splits around this rainbow display as it follows the natural border of the forest surrounding the clearing.  Stained with water damage, some varnished wooden disc chimes hang over the northeasterly trail, stirred into a quiet melody by a gentle breeze rustling through the foliage.

title: [Yasrenila, Starling Round]
description: Bordered by an ivy-wound pentagonal fence on one side and the river on the other, fields stretch out across a section of cleared forest, speckled sparsely with domed structures.  Dorpers doze among the crops beside gathering baskets temporarily abandoned by the farmhands, the forms cast silver in the moonlight.  The flagstone path forks past a glimaergless-paned greenhouse as it winds into the farmland, converting gradually to roads of tamped earth.

title: [Yasrenila, Starling Round]
description: Emanating a soft glow in the darkness, gold arathiel dandelions warm the window boxes of a hexagonal wood-crafted structure set betwixt the murmuring river as it wends into the woods and a squat olivewood building attached to an ornamented pergola.  A trio of hand-carved oak mushrooms dappled in grey lichen stands amongst the fragrant verdure in a lush herb garden, the greenery flourishing with wild abandon around lasimor plant markers.

title: [Freshly Foraged]
description: Rectangular reed baskets brim with roots, mushrooms, and bundles of greens, their earthy and herbaceous fragrances permeating the air.  Piled with diced vegetables, a chopping board rests on the birch counter set between a potbelly stove and a scattering of elm tables.  Assorted herbs dry overhead, strung from a crossbeam that spans from above the open doorway to over the framed watercolor decorating the opposite wall.

title: [Freshly Foraged, Pergola]
description: Blending natural greenery with handcrafted art, ivory-veined ivy winds about the scrollworked legs of the whorled birch pergola, allowing only glimpses of the flora and fauna etched into the lacquered wood.  Glass jars strung with pastel ribbons hang from the crossbeams, the flame-tipped tealights within bringing a warm, flickering glow to a slatted knotty elm table flanked by matching benches.

title: [Bee-utimous]
description: The lattice-woven walls of oak and laurel are washed in honey-colored paint, the amber and gilded tones complemented by enamel flowers interspersed between the crossed beams of wood.  A trio of beehive-shaped lanterns are nestled at the far corner of the stacked stone counter, the display firmly positioned in the center of the shop.  Short wood-planked racks are scattered along the periphery, filled from top to bottom with bolts of undyed fabric.

title: [Yasrenila, Starling Round]
description: Moonlight catches on the rippled surface of the river as it cascades down low, rocky steps between the high, moss-blanketed banks.  Frogs croak over the murmuring water, hidden in the whispering reeds where fireflies blink in and out of the darkness.  Tucked beneath a round table of stained glass beleria framed in lasimor, latticed chairs provide a front row seat to the aquatic symphony, shadowed by a mixed canopy of foliage.

title: [Summit Academy, Ellipse]
description: Snow-topped firs stand guardian over much smaller junipers, their dark green boughs and dark blue berries providing colorful interest to the northeastern landscape.  Rounded stones of grey and brown peek through the snow-dusted grounds and lead a winding path through the dark foliage.

title: [Atoll, Obsidian Crevice]
description: Narrow and cramped, the dark grey walls of this crevice are painted with various unidentifiable symbols and markings.  An oddly dark glow can be seen to the north.

title: [Atoll, Cerulean Crevice]
description: Blue light reflects from the grotto to the south, barely illuminating the cramped, damp walls of this small crevice.  A small, manmade hole in the crevice wall holds a grey stone mermaid figurine, and desiccated remains of small crabs pile up beneath it as if in offering.

title: [Atoll, Crimson Crevice]
description: Red light from the grotto to the south reflects off the crevice's walls, illuminating several primitively carved shapes.  One section depicts some sort of battle between stick figures, a large wave looming above the combatants.

title: [Atoll, Topaz Crevice]
description: A yellow-tinted mist drifts across the slick stone floor of the narrow crevice, twining in and out of the numerous humanoid skulls stuck to the rock walls with rusted daggers.  Crudely carved beneath the skulls are several pictograms of monstrosities rising from the sea.  A citrine glow emanates from the grotto to the north.

title: [Belrog's Magic Shoppe]
description: The broad sweep of the wooden floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An oversized sea chest is pushed to the back of the shop.

title: [Belrog's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An oversized sea chest sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Belrog's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An oversized sea chest sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Brute's Magic Shoppe]
description: A pearl-handled filigreed mandolin hangs on one of the mahogany paneled walls, and a vaulted ceiling rises overhead.  A carved ebonwood dinghy sits in one corner of a polished oak floor.  There is a bamboo rack on one side of the shop and an oversized sea chest on the other.

title: [Brute's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An oversized sea chest sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Brute's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An oversized sea chest sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Summit Academy, Elenesse Court]
description: Orbs covered in frost emit a soft glow that illuminates the recently shoved path connecting the manor house to the ellipse beyond.  Enclosed by a stone wall, the courtyard is highlighted in bright colors as light slips through nearby windows, which are all comprised of painted glass.  Camellia shrubs bloom with brilliant colors at the cardinal points of the courtyard, while helleborus sprout from the frozen ground between them in dusky shades of burgundy, cream, and varying virescent hues.

title: [Elenesse Atelier, Foyer]
description: Surrounded by stonework, the exit is framed in dark mahogany with a slightly curved lintel.  The adjoining walls are covered in pristine white plaster, while the ceiling has exposed rafters that support golden linden paneling.  Flanked by floor-to-ceiling windows that provide a view of the arctic landscape beyond, an enormous cobblestone fireplace spreads heat through the open space, dispelling any chill that that tries to invade the domicile.

title: [Elenesse Atelier, Hall]
description: Stretching from the foyer in the north to the alcove in the south, a long fuzzy runner of shaggy white roltalen muffles the movement of those within the hall.  Large windows capped in keyhole arches dominate the western walls with their leaded, stained-glass designs and each is surrounded by a plethora of frosted globes that keep the expanse illuminated.  Here and there, doors provide entry to various workspaces that stretch beyond the white stucco walls.

title: [Elenesse Atelier, Alcove]
description: Crescent-shaped, the alcove has exposed dark mahogany rafters that support a ceiling of glossy golden linden planks.  Pendant-shaped lanterns dangle over the space, spreading an even illumination that aids those working nearby.  An orb-shaped cobblestone fireplace keeps the chill of arctic winds at bay, while grey suede chairs and small tables are arranged in social circles for the comfort of those working.

title: [Elenesse Atelier, Hall]
description: Stretching from the foyer in the south to the alcove in the north, a long fuzzy runner of shaggy white roltalen muffles the movement of those within the hall.  Large windows capped in keyhole arches dominate the western walls with their leaded, stained-glass designs and each is surrounded by a plethora of frosted globes that keep the expanse illuminated.  Here and there, doors providing entry to various workspaces fill the space beyond the white stucco walls.

title: [Elenesse Atelier, Hall]
description: Stretching from the foyer in the south to the alcove in the north, a long fuzzy runner of shaggy white roltalen muffles the movement of those within the hall.  Large windows capped in keyhole arches dominate the western walls with their leaded, stained-glass designs and each is surrounded by a plethora of frosted globes that keep the expanse illuminated.  Here and there, doors providing entry to various workspaces fill the space beyond the white stucco walls.

title: [Elenesse Atelier, Alcove]
description: Crescent-shaped, the alcove has exposed dark mahogany rafters that support a ceiling of glossy golden linden planks.  Pendant-shaped lanterns dangle over the space, spreading an even illumination that aids those working nearby.  An orb-shaped cobblestone fireplace keeps the chill of arctic winds at bay, while grey suede chairs and small tables are arranged in social circles for the comfort of those working.

title: [Little Ticker]
description: High ceilings supported by exposed rafters that are in turn held in place by steel footings lend the workshop a lofty feel despite the scattered tools, springs, gears, and wire that is strewn about the floor.  Open cabinets with everything from paint brushes, enamel canisters, and broken gemstones line the north and south wall, while the east one houses a window that has a painted off-white banner hanging across it.  Several finished projects rest upon a central mahogany worktable.

title: [Enlightened Pages]
description: Lacquered strips of colorful vellum are wrapped across a quintet of conjoined rings, the artistic installation chained above a parchment-stacked counter set upon the clay-tiled floor.  Spherical glass lanterns are nestled in each corner of the shop, the starburst-molded shapes displayed at various heights between the potted botanicals spilling tendrils across the nearby wooden chairs.  The faint scent of ink and cardamom traverses through the air, the smoky tendrils wending down from the rafters.

title: [Merited Metalworks]
description: Ring-shaped racks of striated sandalwood are affixed across the shop, the displays woven in zigzag configurations of colorful rope bound in tonal wires.  A brass-channeled counter sits before a mural of jewel-inset blossoms, the elongated faenor-forged leaves curved upwards to serve as makeshift containers for wares, the sharp edges cushioned by strips of metallic velvet.  Perforated sconces cast illuminated stars across the tiled floor, the flames highlighting the marbled mosaic.

title: [Merited Metalworks, Tools]
description: Woven blankets of warm-toned linen showcase a number of rattan baskets, the rectangular containers filled with various tools cushioned on strips of velvet.  Brass-chained censers gently scent the room with dried sage and blackberries, the tendrils of smoke falling slowly towards the mahogany rack set upon the wool-carpeted floor.  Set against the back wall are mosaic-framed canvases, the dimly lit display guarding several pieces of artwork behind a pane of smoked glass.

title: [Zul Logoth, Crystalline Stables]
description: Blanketing the entire stable area is a thick layer of hay that offers a subtle carpeted feel to an otherwise hard and unforgiving foundation.  Occasional drafts carry questionable aromas that seem to originate from the surrounding stalls.  Artistically painted murals decorate the tall stone walls and portray historic dwarven battles led by mounted soldiers.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: Remnants of a building that once stood proud now tumbles in ruins, the fragments of a home left covered in ash.  Sculpted rocks litter the pathway, leaving a trail of demise across the plains.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: A golden hue shimmers across the sterile dirt, the luminosity oscillating in various opacities.  The brief glimpse of color seems to give vitality to the land if only for a moment in time.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: The volatile heavens spark flares of gold, the brilliance streaking across the sky as if they were falling stars.  The ground ahead trembles, the terrain splitting apart violently before the turf settles and is left uneven.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: Tremors pulsate throughout the ground making it difficult to stand.  Tiny specks of dirt and rock bounce as the quakes reach their full strength before abruptly coming to a stop and calming again.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: The view features a series of plateaus, the breadth between them expansive and grand.  Metallic yellow lines streak parallel to their flat tops before dissipating into the air overcast sky.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: The land begins to slope upward, giving a different vantage point to the barren area.  An acidic smell lingers in the breeze, the scent making it difficult to breathe at times.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: A miasma of rancid vapor clings to the sticky heat.  As the clouds take on a more menacing appearance, bits of ash begin to fall, covering the surroundings in a fresh coat of grey.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: Deposits of sulfur cling to rocky formations, the mineral adding a touch of color to the otherwise arid vicinity.  A balmy smog lingers on the horizon, carrying an astringent odor that pierces the senses.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: Dingy mustard-hued powder collects around small reserves of seething water.  The pools spread out for miles amongst the putrid-smelling and grim wasteland.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: Soft vibrations gyrate throughout the scope of the desolate conditions, the dismal environment interrupted by the ripping of rock shifting into a new alignment.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: Gilt-striated particles twinkle against a barricade of black nothingness further ahead, before dematerializing rapidly.  The vague sound of crackling reverberates throughout the abandoned desert.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: A blaze of warmth flares up from underground, the soil taking on an unearthly glow.  Stretches of wasteland mimic the gilded luminescence in cadences, as if communicating in a scintillating code.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: A rust-colored stream runs along the evacuated realm, mephitic fumes rising up from the toxic water.  The miniature river flows along a bend, dumping the contents in a wide pond encased by sulfur veins.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: A grove of knotty and distorted trees reach up to invade the bleak skyline.  Their silhouettes begin to convulse as the earth trembles causing soot to fall from the branches in a sinister onyx snowfall.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: The expanse of fragmented loam sprawls in asymmetrical pieces as far as the eye can see, the stillness every so often disrupted by a juddering of sentiment.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: Craggy peaks loom in the distant hazy smog, their summits occasionally accented by gold highlights.  A droning buzz repeats as the luminosity continues before decrescendoing and restoring the land to quietness.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: Cracked charcoal clay runs in haphazard patterns along the floor, the ground lacking moisture or life within it.  Despite this, the air seems to hum with a low frequency, adding an odd element of vibrancy to the area.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: Small tempests of ash swirl across the plains, kicking up chalky residue and hindering any sight beyond a few feet.  A gnarled weathered tree protrudes from the ground, its trunk uprooted and a labyrinthine of roots exposed.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: The ashy-hued surroundings contrast with the horizon of an endless blackness.  A layered settlement of rocks juts outward, displaying a narrow fissure in the cliff allowing entrance into an underground cavern.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: Skeletons of plants try to emerge through cracks in the earth of the rocky terrain, the plateau overlooking an enveloping landscape of death.  The sky is blanketed by a swell of clouds carrying a storm, the brisk breeze holding the scent of ozone and sulfur.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: A rumbling of fuliginous clouds billow in the distance, brief flashes of gold light illuminating their edges.   Momentarily, the ground seems to expand before returning to its lifeless state.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: Corpses of twisted trees dot the plains, the remains hinting at a once lush landscape that is now a graveyard.  Scorch marks line the trunks, some windblown with erosion and smattered with dust.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: Each step along the terrain kicks up miniature cyclones consisting of whirls of pallid dust.  The hot air is dense and a strong malodorous stench ripples outward, creating an uncomfortable sensation.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: A curvaceous path winds through a hall of plateaus, the wind creating striped whiptail-like designs along the sides.  The squalls bellow throughout the walls, giving an eerie reminder of the living that once existed here.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: Small puddles of monochromatic oranges and yellows pop up between the uncultivated earth, the air heavy with the scent of brimstone.  Steam languidly rises up from the pools' surfaces, the sound of the liquid bubbling echoes throughout the area.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: Occasional gales of gold motes crackle and fizzle in and out of existence.  The landscape rolls and undulates for miles in every direction, providing no end in sight of the bleak environment.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: A rampant of basalt-sheened smoke competes against the turmoil of the ever changing atmosphere.  The sterile span of earth is bathed in shimmering effervescent golden hues before returning back to its unimpressive state.

title: [Bleaklands, Storm Plains]
description: The darkness parts, allowing the achromatic sky to peek out, casting some brightness over the lowlands.  In the distance, the sound of grinding rock against stone signals the earth continues to be at war with itself.  To the north and northwest of here lies the battered and abandoned remains of a once magnificent castle.

title: [Bleaklands, Nightmare Cavern]
description: The uneven earthen ground descends sharply, narrowing as it does before opening into an immense cavern.  Columns of stalagmites rise from the floor, rugged and twisted like jagged, broken teeth.  A faint, dark mist blankets the area, creeping along the base of the rock pillars.

title: [Bleaklands, Nightmare Cavern]
description: A heavy black vapor suffocates the ground of the cave, obscuring the cavern floor entirely.  The pungent odor of sulfur hangs heavily in the air and several skeletal bats hang upside down from a rocky overhang above, their bony frames still and silent.

title: [Bleaklands, Nightmare Cavern]
description: The walls of the cavern curve here and disappear entirely into a cloud of inky blackness.  A faint vibration hums nearby and veins of pulsing ichor spread across the ground like a network of shadowy webs.

title: [Bleaklands, Nightmare Cavern]
description: Swirling mist has all but obscured the surrounding walls, creating what appears to be an endless vortex of thick fog.  At the center of the smoke stands an ancient granite monolith which hums with some unseen energy.  Shadows creep along the edges of the giant statue, as if staining its surface in darkness.

title: [Shrine of Nightmares]
description: The rough-hewn ground is littered with fragments of broken glass, each shard stained in old blood.  A smooth slab of obsidian dominates the center of the cave here, and the darkness along the walls shifts and bends with a life of its own.  A statue of carved glittering crystal perches above the chunk of obsidian, its twisted shape glimmering from an unseen light.

title: [Bleaklands, Nightmare Cavern]
description: The walls along the cavern here shift from rock to living shadow, writhing and churning as tiny bubbles appear and pop along their surface.  A deep cold infuses the area, the very air heavy and almost smothering.

title: [Penelopia's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a woven seagrass ceiling, a tattered pirate flag hangs on one of the woven grass divider walls.  A long mistwood counter and some carved haon pegs sit in opposite corners while an intricate sea creatures display rests on a scattered sand floor.

title: [Penelopia's General Store]
[Penelopia's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a low skylight-set ceiling, a tropical bloom wreath hangs on one of the glazed bamboo walls.  An aqua-hued seaglass display and a long mistwood counter sit in opposite corners while a stuffed octopus rests on a scattered sand floor.

title: [Penelopia's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a woven seagrass ceiling, a painted native mask hangs on one of the woven grass divider walls.  Some carved haon pegs and a long mistwood counter sit in opposite corners while a wooden lighthouse figurine rests on a scattered sand floor.

title: [Sphere And Scythe, Shop]
description: Beneath a varnished golden oak ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A glass-topped mistwood counter and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Starkitty's Outfitting]
description: A portrait of Darkstone Castle hangs on one of the knotty pine walls, and a modwir beam ceiling rises overhead.  A pile of striped throw pillows sits in one corner of a polished oak floor.  There is a flexible willow woven basket on one side of the shop and a vine-carved mahogany table on the other.

title: [Starkitty's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a modwir beam ceiling, a blue watered silk tapestry hangs on one of the knotty pine walls.  A flexible willow woven basket and a vine-carved mahogany table sit in opposite corners while a pile of striped throw pillows rests on a polished oak floor.

title: [Starkitty's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a modwir beam ceiling, a pair of crossed bones hangs on one of the knotty pine walls.  A flexible willow woven basket and a vine-carved mahogany table sit in opposite corners while a pile of striped throw pillows rests on a polished oak floor.

title: [East Woods, River Bank]
description: The river bed dead ends here at the rise of a perpendicular cliff to the east.  A noisy fall of water pours from several clefts in the overhanging face of the rock, feeding the river current below.

title: [Circle of Trees, Glade]
description: Thick clusters of trees draped with curtains of dense vines surround the small glade.  Visible through the loosely woven canopy, pale moonbeams filter down, illuminating a lanky pale seedling.  A tangle of roots travels away from the focal point, branching out to the far edges of the clearing.  Small shrubs and rich clusters of fern carpet the forest floor, their greenery creating a verdant perimeter.

title: [Out of Pocket]
description: Wrought from burnished gold, an elaborate chandelier suspends from the arched ceiling, illuminating the carefully folded contents of a series of bins arranged in the center of the wagon.  Myriad jackets hang on gilded hooks, organized by size, with the frontmost piece serving as a display dressed up with pocket squares and knotted cravats.  A gilt-threaded satin rope gathers a wine-hued velvet curtain to one side, creating deeply shadowed folds in the lush fabric.

title: [Out of Pocket, Den]
description: Luxurious velvet pillows, the color of a rich merlot, offer cozy places to rest in the gilded sconce-lit space.  Intricate parquetry panels the walls, broken up by sumptuous curtains framing the frosted glass windows.  A bevel-edged mahogany sideboard stands adjacent to a hand-inked globe supported by a solid gold meridian.

title: [Pennywix's Widgets]
description: Copper gears have been inset into the polished cherrywood walls of this spacious wagon, each reflecting light from candlelit globes to create a warm and welcoming environment.  A brass-edged cherrywood counter rests below a copper shelf, with a copper-framed sign set off to one side.  Silk-draped cherrywood partitioning separates the wagon's interior into two sections, a copper-threaded curtain leading into the back area.

title: [Widgets, As Elanthia Turns]
description: A tiny skylight has been cut into the wooden ceiling of the wagon, allowing light to filter through a series of copper-cut stars and crescent moons that cast their celestial shadows across the small room.  A large map of the stars is tacked to one cherrywood wall, while a short bookcase and a polished counter take up the rest of the available wall space.  Silk-draped cherrywood partitioning separates the wagon's interior into two sections, a copper-threaded curtain leading back to the main area.

title: [Flora Of The Jungle, Display]
description: Lining one wall of the spacious wagon is a long table centered with a narrow crystal vase filled with bright flowers.  Hanging from the rafters, bunches of blossoms peek from inside a woven reed basket, their rich colors creating a brilliant canopy.  Pale moonbeams trickle in through a series of skylights set in the ceiling above.

title: [Flora Of The Jungle, Display]
description: Filtering through the skylight above, beams of pale moonlight fill the small area.  A silk-lined oak shelf hangs above a long wooden table whose top is covered with bits of feathers, ribbons, charms, and wire.  Strands of ivy hang down the far wall from a narrow planter that runs the length of the room.

title: [Kegistentialism]
description: The silk canopy drapes high overheard, supported by cherrywood poles along the tent's perimeter.  Taking up a large portion of the central part of the tent is a heavy oak table with thick rectangular legs, while in one corner sits a thick pine rack.  A plush green Vornavian silk carpet lays underfoot and provides comfortable footing.

title: [Woodland Convergence]
description: Soft, moss-hued, woolen carpets cover the floor of the expansive interior of the tent.  Dark green silk flows down from a polished mistwood frame, each of the poles carved with a flowering vine pattern.  A series of copper lanterns hangs from the rafters, blanketing the space with a warm glow.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, out

title: [Woodland Convergence, North]
description: Small woodland creatures are carved into the length of the wide mistwood pillars that make up the sturdy frame of the tent.  Large spans of willow green silk cascade down the structure, blending into a thick carpet of the same hue.  Tiny blossoms crafted from colorful crystals hang from an enormous chandelier, coloring the room with a kaleidoscope of iridescence.

title: [Woodland Convergence, East]
description: Dark pine green silk descends from strong mistwood framework, enclosing the space in its dark, cooling shades.  Detailed butterflies are carved about the supports, creating a fanciful design.  Woven mats of pale water reeds cushion the ground, while a trio of brushed steel lanterns is suspended from the apex, covering the room with a pale radiance.

title: [Woodland Convergence, South]
description: Shimmering silk in pale, sage green hues drapes down from the sturdy mistwood frame of the spacious tent.  The support posts are carved with a series of fern patterns that bend out from the main core.  Woven mats of fluffy, dark chestnut wool cover the ground, while bronze lanterns covered with a leaf pattern illuminate the area.

title: [Woodland Convergence, West]
description: Hardy columns of mistwood are carved with a fanciful parade of various bugs and insect life.  Dark forest green silk blankets the space, creating flowing walls and a wavering peaked ceiling. Several vaalin lanterns are suspended from above, their soft glow illuminating the beige-carpeted ground below.

title: [Blooms and Bubbles]
description: Iridescent spheres of glass are scattered across the ceiling of the shop, the pastel-washed orbs filled with a myriad of unfurling flowers crafted from brightly colored silk.  Affixed to each brocaded wall is a rectangular wicker basket, each ribbon-woven container lined in blue-checked gingham.  Set at each corner of the room is a verdant capybara topiary, the rotund forms clad in loosely sewn costumes of butterflies and moths, their gossamer wings draped across their shoulders.

title: [Strings And Things, Showroom]
description: Several frosted crystal orbs are suspended from wooden hooks that have been fixed into the walls.  A small copper-bound chest is placed on one side of the opening, while a woven frond basket rests on the other.  The air is cool, with an earthy scent filling the spacious area.  Soft carpets of woven moss cover the ground under a small white oak table.  A carved spiral staircase leads higher into the tree.

title: [Strings And Things, Showroom]
description: Built to fit the interior of the tree, the room is circular in shape, with the staircase leading back downstairs in the center.  Several shelves have been cut into the walls of the shop.  Soft, verdant moss grows on the floor, giving the feel of rich carpeting.  Pale light streams in from a small opening above.

title: [Strings And Things, Workroom]
description: Perched between a trio of thick canopy branches, a small platform surrounded by flowering vines creates an intimate gathering space.  Several pillow-like piles of moss serve as cushioned seats.  A small table piled with various tools stands off to one side.

title: [Oddments and Ephemera, Entry]
description: Beyond the ashwood door leading into the wagon lies a cluttered entryway, bracketed on either side with pockmarked shelving crowded with knickknacks, dried mushrooms, a collection of candy jars, and other miscellanea.  Perched precariously on one sagging shelf, a neatly printed placard rests catawampus near an assortment of boxes.  A shabby magenta rug with carefully mended patches covers most of the floor.

title: [Oddments and Ephemera, Further]
description: Soft candlelight illuminates the tapestry-covered walls and reveals a mosaic floor depicting ever-widening tiled spirals of every hue imaginable.  Along each wall, lengthy tables fashioned of mismatched doors atop waist-high piles of junk are burdened with jewelry cases, books, and a disorganized gallimaufry of other goods.  At the far end of the room, a weighty patchwork curtain effectively conceals what lies beyond.

title: [Island Rose, Gallery]
description: Carved from pale birch, a thick pole creates a sharp peak in the canopy of the tent.  Light breezes from outside cause the pale amethyst silk walls of the tent to billow to and fro.  A spiraled silver rack rests to one side of the space, while a lacquered tigerwood stand is displayed along the other.

title: [Island Rose, Gallery]
description: Pale amethyst silk draped from a study birch frame fashions the walls of the spacious shop.  Scattered along the edge, a series of spiraled vaalin racks contain a wide variety of wares for inspection.  In between the displays, lanterns hang from twisted silver stands, illuminating a bronze-edged mistwood chest and an etched crystal sign suspended from the rafters above.  A silk-curtained archway leads deeper into the shop.

title: [Island Rose, Atelier]
description: Amethyst and golden specks add color to the thin ivory carpet of woven plant fibers that covers the floor.  Centered in the room is a small mistwood table that holds a variety of refreshments.  A group of chairs are placed in a circular pattern about the shop.  Standing next to a silk-curtained archway is a polished silver filigree mirror.

title: [If the Shoe Fits]
description: Short silver-lacquered shelves are interspersed along the pale blue brocaded walls of the wagon, displaying a variety of cobbled footwear inset with adornments of jewels and glass.  Lantern-framed racks of willow sit at the center of the shop, the neatly wound bolts of fabric stacked vertically between the flora-painted slats.  An elongated worktable stands against the back wall, its leathery surface covered in a kaleidoscope of dyes sorted in uniform rows.

title: [Rakish Accoutrement, Entry]
description: A multitude of liana vines woven together artfully form the walls and ceiling of this cozy shop.  Set in opposite directions, two smaller rooms are somewhat visible from this main entry, each boasting their own unique selection of wares.

title: [Rakish Accoutrement, East]
description: A small cozy alcove, set aside from the main entry, boasts an intricate collection of knickknacks.  If not for the protective glass casing surrounding the knickknacks, it would be difficult to discern them from the actual wares for sale.

title: [Rakish Accoutrement, Backroom]
description: Although this secluded backroom is mostly barren of traditional furniture, numerous sealed boxes fill the room and form stacks along the liana vine-woven walls.  This space is clearly functioning better as a storage closet than a properly equipped workspace.

title: [Rakish Accoutrement, West]
description: A small cozy nook, set aside from the main entry, boasts an intricate collection of potted plants.  The flowering plants provide a vibrant and colorful offset against the simplistic liana vine-woven walls.

title: [Nature Contained]
description: The edges of the crevice affording access to this cramped space are blackened and singed as if some manner of heat contributed to its formation, though the tree's interior is left unscathed.  Perfumed with the scent of clean sap, the air is slightly humid without being uncomfortable, and occasionally, a thin wisp of a breeze trickles through to stir and refresh the air.  In the center of the chamber is a makeshift tree trunk table topped with a rough-hewn oak tray, while behind it stands a wooden half-moon shelf.

title: [Weathering the Storm, Display]
description: Nestled behind a thick curtain of ivy, this small space is cool and inviting.  Several silver lanterns hang from the branches above, illuminating the room with a warm glow.  Along the back wall are a row of wooden pegs and a large oval knothole.  The floor is covered in a thick layer of leaves that fill the space with a fresh, earthy scent.  A carved wooden sign hangs next to several depressions carved into one side wall, creating a series of shelves.

title: [Weathering the Storm, Workroom]
description: Mounds of thick spongy moss cover the ground of this cozy inner room.  Cone-shaped pendant lamps wrapped with thick strands of copper hang from the woven vine ceiling, swaying slightly with the tree's movements.  A fresh earthy scent fills the small space.

title: [Mitsoku's Niche]
description: This natural hollow is deeper than it is tall, and strings of lights with colorful shades draped along the walls illuminate the niche in an array of colors.  At the rear of the space near the ceiling, a small hammock stretches from one side to the other, little more than a vibrant scrap of cloth strung between two hooks.  Beneath is an elaborately carved oak counter, atop which rests a many-limbed jewelry tree, and a plush rainbow-hued rug cushions the floor.

title: [Mitsoku's Niche]
description: The ceiling of the hollow slopes downward in this area, forcing those much taller than a dwarf to stoop, and the walls draw closer as the chamber narrows.  Strings of lights twinkle like summer fireflies from their place on the walls, draped over and around a variety of shallow nooks and knotholes.

title: [To the Point]
description: Starburst-cut lanterns of brass subtly illuminate the faenor racks set before a mural of an elven port, the arathiel-inset windows of the cityscape glinting in shades of malachite and lapis blue.  Lacquered hangers of resaeun dot the periphery of the shop, the seapony-shaped pieces draped in various garments set between the glazed vases filled with vellum-folded florals.  Painted across the bluish green-colored floor are several tall-sailed galleons, the various ships set across the waters.

title: [To the Point, Studio]
description: Amethyst-dyed swaths of silk encircle a diminutive white marble fountain at the center of the room, the curved basin filled with a variety of gemstones occupying the castle-shaped vessel.  Radiating outwards from a sunburst-shaped chandelier are falls of silver-forged beleria the flowers' unfurled petals highlighted by slivers of lilac-tinted arathiel.  Murals of an airship-dotted sky encompass the pale blue-colored walls of the room, the far corner nestled with a crystal-inset spire rising into the clouds.

title: [To the Other Point]
description: Mismatched, tarnished brass lanterns cast a glow over a cracked glass display case set before a crudely painted mural depicting something that vaguely resembles a city of crooked buildings speckled with dull, poorly cut gems.  Empty hangers, wrought in monstrously misshapen forms, dot the walls between vases filled with rudimentary origami florals.  A translucent blue stain mottles the wood floor, the imitation water dappled with white triangles attached to bowl-like brown shapes.

title: [Echinacea Exscentellence]
description: Tempered orbs of pale white light rest within the purple-frilled hearts of fuchsia hummingbird plants that grow within planters along the upper edges of the oblong room.  The soft illumination accents the natural bands of dark wood grain in the smooth walls, cascading off their lacquered surfaces and reflecting upon dozens of flower-laden urns set upon a springy moss floor.  Entwined chocolate vines darken the egress, their three-petalled blooms drawing fireflies to their nuclei.

title: [Echinacea Exscentellence, Bower]
description: Shaped more than carved, a set of footings descend in a twisting path from the expansive aerial platform to the moss-covered chamber below.  Looping branches twine together in a labyrinthine canopy filled with verdant foliage and a smattering of bright-plumed minivet nests.  Scattered amid a variety of flower-laden urns, braided circular arame cushions adorned with wild fringes provide options for reclining.

title: [Oddments and Ephemera, Workshop]
description: In stark contrast to the rest of the wagon, this workshop is immaculately organized, albeit chockablock with tools, reference books, and jeweler's supplies.  Each gadget and gizmo gleams neatly from the hook, table, or shelf that houses it.  A glass-paneled lantern hung above a plushly cushioned bench provides ample lighting for even the most painstaking handiwork.

title: [Balmy Blooms]
description: Dusky golden sunlight pours in from an arched glass window that forms nearly the entire back wall of the divided alcove.  Blossoming wildflowers and feathered greenery are softly strewn through the entire space, a few of the wayward blooms gathered in small offerings around a slender blue quartz reliquary.  Grown over with intensely verdant mosses, an ivory sculpture of Imaera and Jaston sits at the center of the room, the opaque planes of their eyes perpetually gazing up towards the sky.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Sandy Dune]
description: As you ascend a large dune, the moon's light casts an eerie pall across the sand.  Once you reach the top, a mesmerizing view unfolds before you.  The sand below gives way to an elevated grassy field stretching out into a dark forest, its dark greenery almost impenetrable.  A cold, salty breeze cuts through the thickest cloth.  In the distance, you hear leaves rustling as the wind exposes a faint path leading into the jungle's shadows.

title: [Sorcerer's Guild, Jungle Path]
description: Thick brush prevents ease of movement as moonlight settles upon the jungle's floor.  Calls from several unknown creatures occasionally call out through the night, their echoes disappearing into the thick greenery.  A cold breeze rustles the leaves cascading down from the trees, whispering sinister secrets as the faint hint of magic stirs in the air.  A faint path leads out to some dunes.

title: [Sorcerer's Guild, Jungle Path]
description: As you continue down a narrow path, the silence of the jungle grows more oppressive.  The air is cold, while the high humidity makes the air thick and sticky, making breathing difficult.  The trees grow taller and closer together, casting the path into deeper shadows.  The trail begins to slope upward, and soon you find yourself climbing a steep incline.

title: [Sorcerer's Guild, Jungle Path]
description: The jungle is shrouded in darkness, with only the faint glow of moonlight filtering through the dense canopy.  The path, now barely visible, winds its way around a tangled thorn-covered bramble, making progress slow and treacherous.  The jungle is shrouded in an eerie stillness, a foreboding presence palpable in the air.  The rustling of leaves and snapping of twigs can be heard intermittently, but any sounds from the nocturnal creatures are notably absent.

title: [Sorcerer's Guild, Jungle Path]
description: The leaves of the trees and vines appear to twist and curl, their shapes distorted and misshapened as if some dark force possessed them.  Overgrown tropical vines adorned with florets cover the path while the shadows cast from a thorny tangled thicket seem to writhe on the ground, twisting and turning in the moonlight.  The leaves appear laced with a hint of malevolence.

title: [Sorcerer's Guild, Jungle Path]
description: The path appears endless, its twists and turns attempting to disorient those who traverse through.  The forest's thorny walls are lined with sharp thorns that glint in the dim light.  They almost seem alive with malevolence as they reach out to snag your clothing and scratch your skin.  The silence is only broken by the occasional rustle of leaves or the snap of a twig underfoot.

title: [Sorcerer's Guild, Jungle Path]
description: A thick wall of flowering vines from a thorny tangled thicket have entwined themselves around the surrounding trees, forming a wide barrier and ending the path.  Only dim light filters through the dense foliage, as the air is thick with humidity, causing sweat to bead heavily on the skin.  The scent of fragrant blooms mixes with the dampness of the air, creating an overpowering yet strangely alluring aroma.

title: [Sorcerer's Guild, Courtyard]
description: A dark stone tower looms majestically in the center of a large clearing, rising high above the trees.   Its ebon stonework contrasting against the forest's lush greenery.  Blackened trees ring the outer courtyard, their trunks warped and twisted into a menacing tribute.  A large marble statue stands guard to a polished black flagstone path that leads through a decrepit courtyard.

title: [Sorcerer's Guild, Courtyard]
description: Small shrubs and bushes line the flagstone path that leads through the courtyard, their blackened leaves and dreadful blooms creating an unnatural privacy wall.  In contrast to the surrounding area, a beautiful marble statue stands surrounded by various delicate flowers of all colors growing about the statue's base, filling the air with a sweet aroma that momentarily distracts from the tower's foreboding presence.

title: [Sorcerer's Guild, Courtyard]
description: Visible through the overgrown vegetation, the flagstone path winds its way about the tower.  Towering over the courtyard, a large marble statue stands as a focal point, jungle foliage growing over her form.  Exotic birds call out from their hidden refuge in the thorny bramble.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Ebonshade Tower]
description: The polished, black-stoned courtyard beneath your feet is cold and unforgiving, and every step taken echoes loudly against the walls of a dark stone tower.  Stretching endlessly upwards, the tower stands an imposing figure, with only a crumbling granite stairway leading up to a single thick ironwood door sufficing as an entry.  The building cloaks the courtyard in an enveloping shadow, dominating with its eerie presence.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Foyer]
description: Covering the dark stone floor, a rich burgundy carpet fans out from the entrance.  Standing to one side of a carved ironwood door is a marble pedestal veined with swirling gold; an open book rests on top, with a deep crimson banner fringed with gold hanging above.  Several pewter sconces shed light over the foyer, while two standing candelabra rest to either side of an archway draped in ebon velvet.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Boutique]
description: Covering the dark stone floor of the guild shop is a rich ebon carpet shot with slender threads of silver.  An iron rack of clothing stands off to one side of a set of marble shelves.  Centered in the room is a small wooden table holding an etched crystal case.  A series of frosted glass globes are suspended from thin pewter chain, swaying slightly as they coldy illuminate the area.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Study]
description: Several cushioned chairs and sofas are placed about the room.  A narrow bench with ornate clawed-feet rests before a small writing desk that is set between two large bookcases holding every form of book, journal, and scroll.  Evenly spaced about the room are pewter sconces, each holding a trio of candles, their symmetry broken by a large modwir-framed painting that dominates one wall.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Lower Portal]
description: Bare of any adornment except for a decorative feature, a small engraving on the polished, dark stone floor gleams under the otherworldly glow of a column of cobalt blue energy.  As the light rises and disappears into the ceiling, intricate patterns of light and shadow cast across the room create an atmosphere of sinister power.  A shimmering crimson portal madly swirls out and back upon itself, emanating a faint humming sound.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Cobalt Landing]
description: The sound of crackling energy emanates from the column of cobalt energy, its colorful essence turning in upon itself and pulsating with power.  The air in the room is heavy, with a faint scent of burnt iron.  The smooth surface of the tower's dark stone walls gleams as dim light illuminates its surface.  A velvet-curtained arch dominates the far wall opposite a grim mosaic crafted from colored rock.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Portal]
description: Smooth and cool to the touch, the dark stone reflects the magical light coloring the room.  Throwing out motes of light, a perfect column of jade-hued energy seems to rise through the ceiling above.  A shimmering crimson portal leads out to the room beyond.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Master's Study]
description: Swirling about the room is an opaque mist, which conceals the walls and floors, yet leaves a small area open around a curtained arch.  From time to time the mist parts, allowing shadowed forms to move in and out of the chamber.  Soft globes of light hover about, sending beams of pale illumination through the haziness.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Jade Landing]
description: A column of rich jade-hued energy illuminates the room, its colors swirling about their invisible cage, causing the walls to glisten as the light fans out, sending prismatic colors over the stone.   At the foot of an archway lined in ironwood, a mysterious inscription in an unknown language appears to glow softly with a pulsating white light, opposite to a beautifully detailed carving.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Portal]
description: Seeming to flow up and down upon itself, a column of deep ruby energy radiates light throughout the room.  Circling the magical flow is a copper plate set in the floor, its unique hue standing out against the dark stone.  A shimmering crimson portal leads deeper into this level of the tower.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Cauldrons]
description: Recessed about the room are several nooks, a large iron cauldron visible in each.  A trio of shelves line one wall, each covered with a variety of jars, beakers, and other various containers.  Several stone benches are placed under pewter sconces shedding light from a pair of lit candles.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Cauldron Nook]
description: Hanging from a metal tripod is an enormous cast iron cauldron.  Wood is stacked in a brazier beneath, ready to be lit.  A small table covered with various alchemy supplies stands to one side of a small wooden bench pushed against the wall.  Several cut glass globes hover above, giving off a warm glow.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Ruby Landing]
description: A narrow archway adorned with a beautiful tapestry leads into another part of the tower.
