In the opposite direction are three doors, all aglow with ruby light emanating from the twisting and turning column of magical energy.  The air seems to shimmer with magical energy as you catch a faint whiff of fragrant incense wafting nearby.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Alchemy Shop]
description: Dominating one wall is a long marble-topped worktable, the shelves above lined with jars of alchemy components.  A small counter stands on the other end of the room, next to a display of iron cauldrons, its surface covered with mortars and pestles, various pieces of lab equipment, and other alchemy supplies.  Dried flowers and plants hang in carefully wrapped bundles from the ceiling, their rich herbal scents flooding the room.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Portal]
description: Twin rings of pearl inlaid in the dark stone floor encircle a glowing column of amber energy peppered with tiny silver flecks.  Shimmering as it twirls back upon itself, a crimson portal leads beyond.  Each wall is etched with a detailed rendition of a different demon, their appearances almost too realistic.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Nexus]
description: A fountain crafted from four large black marble blocks, flecked with gold veins and etched with unrecognizable runes on each side, is centered in the room, with a small water geyser bubbling between the blocks.  A large potted fern is placed in one corner, its green leaves cascading onto the floor.  Other passageways branch off to smaller chambers filled with alchemical instruments and supplies, located on walls separate from narrow archway.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Amber Landing]
description: The walls pulsate with shades of obsidian streaked with iridescent white flashes, emanating from the radiant energy column.  Beyond a draped archway, a dim chamber shrouded in a billowing veil of ashen mist awaits.  A pair of carved ironwood doors are set into the southern wall, adorned with a a grand silk banner suspended above it.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Guild Office]
description: The shapes of unknown creatures twist and turn within the dark shadows that envelop the large room.  A fine, white mist rolls over the floor, obscuring the stones beneath it.  A large wooden desk sits in the center of the office with a single lit ebon candle glowing through the haze.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Scrying Room]
description: Hung with ebon-hued curtains, all but one side of the room is swathed in velvet.  The unadorned wall is cut with a small opening leading to a private alcove.  Carved from a large block of grey stone is a basin filled with crystal-clear water.  The surface shimmers as light from hovering crystal globes above gleams over the liquid.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Alcove]
description: Light shines down into this tiny alcove from a pane of crystal set in the roof.  The temperature is almost unbearable as the sun heats the air in the small space.  Tucked away under a small overhang is a clear glass starglobe nestled in a brass base.

Peeking in through a pane of crystal set in the roof, moonlight fills the small space.  The pale moonbeams send a flare of rainbow specks across the walls as they strike the window.  Tucked away under a small overhang is a clear glass starglobe nestled in a brass base.

title: [Annex, Demonology Workshop]
description: Shadowed in rich emerald, the dark walls of the workshop are lit by a sextet of colored glass globes that hover and bob about the room.  A marble-topped workbench covers two sides of the chamber, its surface covered with every instrument, beaker, and apparatus imaginable.  A colorful glass mosaic is pressed into the central wall.

title: [Annex, Illusion Workshop]
description: Shadowed in muted lavender, the dark walls of the workshop are lit by a sextet of colored glass globes that hover and bob about the room.  A marble-topped workbench covers two sides of the chamber, its surface covered with every instrument, beaker, and apparatus imaginable.  A colorful glass mosaic is pressed into the central wall.

title: [Annex, Necromancy Workshop]
description: Shadowed in deep indigo, the dark walls of the workshop are lit by a sextet of colored glass globes that hover and bob about the room.  A marble-topped workbench covers two sides of the chamber, its surface covered with every instrument, beaker, and apparatus imaginable.  A colorful glass mosaic is pressed into the central wall.

title: [Annex, Sorcery Workshop]
description: Shadowed in pale crimson, the dark walls of the workshop are lit by a sextet of colored glass globes that hover and bob about the room.  A marble-topped workbench covers two sides of the chamber, its surface covered with every instrument, beaker, and apparatus imaginable.  A colorful glass mosaic is pressed into the central wall.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Gathering Hall]
description: Polished to a dark shine, a massive ironwood table stands surrounded by several high-backed chairs in the center of the gathering hall.  Diffused light from a dark crystal chandelier set with slender yellow candles illuminates several finely-woven tapestries hanging from the walls, their bright threads adding color to the dark stone.  Set to one side is a crystal-topped cart holding a variety of refreshments.

title: [Ebonshade Tower, Storage]
description: Resting against the far wall, a large wooden cupboard hangs open, its contents haphazardly shoved onto the shelves within.  A small steel dust bin stands behind a slender ironwood door, its contents overflowing onto the cool, dark floor.  Set back into a corner is a copper rack holding more guild supplies.  A faint smell of dampness permeates the air.

title: [Khazar's Hold, Bank Branch]
description: The thin red carpet that covers the floor is worn in a line from the north to some teller windows, head high to a dwarf, in the southern wall.  Apart from a sign that has been hung on the wall over the windows, the only other decoration in the room is a small framed painting hung on the west wall.  Otherwise, this plain room offers no other portals or exits.

title: [Sablecross, The Gate of Owls]
description: High overhead, a vast, spread-winged owl of bronze perches atop the apex of an arched steel gate separating the town from the wilds beyond.  Cool and imperious, its metallic eyes watch the roadway below as it winds between booksellers' shops and pipe dens.  The latter breathes the scent of their sweetly earthy smokes out onto the roadway, where the odor mingles with the woodsy fragrance of incense drifting from the temples to the northwest.

title: [Sablecross, Strix Road]
description: The abounding crowds are mostly quiet as they pass by the eastern wall of a mossy stone library standing taller than most of the surrounding businesses.  Though the hush is punctuated here and there by a distant hawker's cry or the drifting sound of chanted prayers, the edifice seems to cast a pall as long and somber as its stretching shadow.  At the zenith of the library gate is a slit-pupiled eye of fire opal and obsidian depicted against a field of grey moonstones.

title: [Sablecross, Oblation Way]
description: The western wall of a mossy stone library looms over the quiet stretch of cobblestone road.  High and steepled, the stately edifice's corrugated bronze roof is graced with an even patina of verdigris.  The gate into the sedate garden encircling the library is a severe confection of wrought iron.  At its zenith, a slit-pupiled eye is formed by fire opal and obsidian tesserae that stand out against a field of grey moonstones.

title: [Sablecross, Oblation Way]
description: Sumptuous figures in bas-relief twist and writhe along the ivy-clad walls of a pale temple complex.  The shadows of the greenery conceal some of the cavorting shapes, though they provide no modesty for the licentious entanglements of others.  Clad in a coat of dark green lacquer, the bars of the temple's bronze gates are wrought to resemble wisps of drifting smoke.  They open onto a garden ablossom with orchid, rockrose, and styrax in resplendent display.

title: [Sablecross, Oblation Way]
description: Inlaid hunting cats of alternating amber and citrine gleam from the stark black sandstone walls enclosing the yard of a domed temple to the west.  A quartet of deep-graven slashes adorns the squared stone lintel over the grand bronze gates, which are graced by the forms of prowling felines.  Banyan trees stretch their branches over the wall, darkly shading the section of the way, and glimpses through the gates suggest lush grounds thick with overgrowth.

title: [Sablecross, Oblation Way]
description: Leaping flames of bronze, copper, and gold climb the steel supports of a foreboding prayer gate before the entrance of a glinting fane.  The ornate facade of the structure is wrought from intricately etched metal the color of the sky on a moonless night.  In marble planters along the high outer wall, purple nightshade flourishes alongside a riot of crawling green jasmine vines that are heavy with fragrant blossoms.  Along the wall, torches burn in smoked steel brackets despite the hour.

title: [Sablecross, The Gate of Ravens]
description: Woven into the dark steel of the western gate are flocking ravens of black alloy, their shapes echoed in black paint on the tenebrous grey stones of the outer wall.  To the southeast are the high rooftops of various temples, while smoke and the acrid tang of hot metal swirls in from the forges of the northeast.  Nearby buildings are stained black from the wafting grit of the forges and stand like shadows along the roadway.

title: [Sablecross, Rook Boulevard]
description: Dark-boled trees stand, tall and tenebrous, to either side of the wide boulevard.  Their leaves are pale, of a green that seems silvered by moonlight.  Blossoms of an unearthly hue, like snow tinged lavender, cling to the branches like wispy fleece.  Eyes like little black beads glint from the darkness of the lower boughs, and their owners' ebon feathers litter the pavement.  Tall homes with hard angles and steepled rooftops loom beyond the trees.

title: [Sablecross, Gauntlet Row]
description: The roadway winds by an ornate stone colosseum that stands atop a low hill garlanded with bloodwood trees.  Severe bronze figures clad in a veneer of verdigris gaze outward from niches along the three-tiered building's exterior, baleful gazes staring outward as if in defiant challenge.  A stone-lined pathway climbs toward the entrance, flanked by lampposts hoisting great lanterns of dark steel and cut glass aloft.

title: [Sablecross, Gauntlet Row]
description: Beneath the ominous shadows of basalt statues depicting hooded figures with powerful builds, broad steps climb up to a sprawling terrace in the southeast.  Opposite the figures, a slate-roofed armory occupies the space near the district's outer wall, its yard separated from the cobblestone street by a black steel gate.  Bloodwood trees stand tall along the pathway leading up to the entrance, and every breeze solicits a rain of leaves and carmine blossoms from their high branches.

title: [Sablecross, Gauntlet Row]
description: The street travels along a series of great steps that rise toward a terrace in the southeast.  Lofty statues, heavily muscled and hooded so that only sparse features are visible, stand guard atop parapets flanking the steps.  Across from the monumental figures are storefronts offering blades, staves, and bows, cheerfully engaging in the arms trade as if heedless to their colossal overseers.

title: [Sablecross, Gauntlet Row]
description: Smoke belches, black and thick, from the limestone chimney of a smithy hunching beneath the outer wall of the town.  Framed by a pair of old weeping willows with round lanterns hung from their branches, the shop stands at the end of a neat lane that winds beneath the stooped trees.  Several carts of dark metal ingots rest outside the smithy's arched entrance.

title: [Sablecross, The Gate of Cats]
description: Paint in autumnal hues cavorts along the dark slate walls, illuminating the etched forms of prowling cats.  They congregate to either side of a high gate of black steel with golden ornamentation.  Low stone buildings with dark windows huddle to either side of the street, casting long shadows over the paving stones.  The road splits into three wide lanes that proceed southward, the southeastern fork descending toward a bustling bazaar flourishing beneath the eastern wall.

title: [Sablecross, Caracal Avenue]
description: Near a domed dwelling at the avenue's eastern edge stands an elegant statue of dusky golden marble.  The monument is carved into the shape of a hunting caracal, its artistry capturing in lifelike detail the predatory grace of the feline's tensed musculature.  From the south wafts alder smoke in puffy white clouds, the earthy sweetness mostly masking an unpleasant, sharp melange that it accompanies.

title: [Sablecross, The Giltroad]
description: A riot of knotted silken scarves flaps in the breeze, suspended over the roadway from hooks on a pair of opposing limestone buildings.  As it winds to the southeast, the lane widens to accommodate a dazzling spectrum of stalls and pavilions that have joined the multifarious businesses huddling to either side of the path.  Carts creak along, but much of the traffic is on foot, clustering about roadside jongleurs and hoarse-voiced hawkers straining to be heard over the din.

title: [Sablecross, The Giltroad]
description: A grandiose countinghouse with marble pillars stands back from the surging throngs of the bazaar.  The old edifice's verdigris bronze roofing and elegant limestone facade contrasts sharply with the multifarious colors of nearby stalls.  Above the arched entrance hangs a heavy bronze sign that depicts a pair of balanced scales.

title: [Sablecross, The Giltroad]
description: A stately brick brokerage with a viridian awning has wide windows of smoked glass that permit only glimpses of movement within.  It stands in the shade of the outer wall, flanked by manicured pomegranate trees that are heavy-laden with plump red fruit.  The candlelight that flickers from the open door is welcoming and warm, suggesting a spot of solace away from the raucous crowds of the Giltroad's bazaar.

title: [Sablecross, The Giltroad]
description: The savory promise of cooked meat beckons on the breeze, escorted by the aromas of exotic spices in a tantalizing melange.  Spicers and food vendors alike crowd the eastern side of the street, but its western verge is occupied by a lapidary's shop.  Hanging over its dark blue door is an etched bronze sign depicting a multifaceted gemstone.

title: [Sablecross, The Grasping Gate]
description: Twisting tentacles of bronze frame a vast gate with sinuous bars wrought into the shapes of smoky tendrils.  To either side, high walls of tenebrous stone are painted with green wisps of smoke enshrouding writhing humanoid figures with lithe bodies and lovely shapes.  The gate opens onto a winding cobblestone lane that proceeds into the heart of a populous district of tall brick and stone buildings.

title: [Sablecross, Thresher Street]
description: Wrought iron lampposts are spaced to either side of the roadway, but they are unlit and the glass of their lamps is badly stained with soot.  The lane winds beneath the facades of baleful buildings the color of smoke, crowded by passersby and a somber mix of coaches, wagons, and carriages drawn by black horses and other grim beasts of burden.  A faint hint of perfume and tobacco smoke threads through the smells of the throng.

title: [Sablecross, Hollow Bend]
description: Old brownstone homes with ivy-strangled walls stand as silent judges along the roadside, their quiet watchfulness contrasting sharply with the bedlam of the marketplace to the northwest.  The lane is a broad and even march of squared paving stones that are neatly fitted together.  Weeping willows stoop to either side, standing tall between scriveners' shops and booksellers.

title: [Sablecross, Hollow Bend]
description: Most of the businesses along the lush green stretch of the bend are of the scholarly variety, ranging from several stores selling academic texts to an alchemist's workshop with its windows open to display brightly colored bottles.  A gently burbling brook spills from a crack in a nearby hillock's crown to meander alongside the cobblestone road.  Its music fills the silence, crystalline and sweet, unaccompanied save for the occasional footsteps of passersby.

title: [Sablecross, Hollow Bend]
description: A cold pall hangs over the stretch of cobblestone road, which treads uneasily beneath the shadow of the township's outer wall.  Bounded by the road, a lichyard occupies a series of rolling slopes clad in downy green grass.  Headstones, pale as bare bones, breach out of the soil, but many are graced with bright flowers and other mementos.  The yard is bordered by a fence of black wrought iron that frames an arched entrance.

title: [Sablecross, Hollow Bend]
description: A smaller row branches off of the main thoroughfare, heading northward past a clothier's with broad bay windows.  Smoked glass and silken curtains the color of the night sky guard the shop's secrets, though the open front door allows welcoming music and the scent of burning frankincense to escape.  The ironwood door is inlaid with a glinting crescent moon of black opal.

title: [Sablecross, Strix Road]
description: The road splits around a large grey marble fountain that takes the form of a parliament of owls.  The stone birds' beaks wings are widespread, and their beaks are opened wide, fountaining a spray of water that is transformed into a cascade of prismatic droplets by the sunlight.  The resplendent display of color is in stark contrast to the muted tones of the stone facades on businesses nearest the roadside.

title: [Sablecross, Bastion's Shadow]
description: The cobblestone roadway proceeds beneath a vast portcullis of black iron decorated by golden chains as it marches into the yard of the basalt-walled citadel.  Black against the brightness of the skies, the central spire of the complex points forebodingly heavenward.  Armed, dark figures along the walls stand vigilant watch over the entry, the wind stirring their concealing garments and dark cloaks.  A black walnut message board stands near to the entrance, obviously a frequent roost for ravens.

title: [The Bastion, Yard]
description: Flames burn in recessed niches along the basalt base of an imposing spire stretching into the heavens above the yard.  Guarded by high curtain walls joining the outer towers, the courtyard is a bustle of activity.  Clanging hammers ring out from forges while aurochs drawing carts engage in uneasy lowing that is mostly drowned out by the din of the crowd.  Merchants' guards unload their cargo while servants in charcoal garb hasten past to their tasks.  A vast black iron portcullis offers egress to the street outside.

title: [Sablecross, Bastion Circle]
description: To the southwest, the high rooftops of temple complexes stretch skyward, but none are so tall as the skyscraping spire at the center of the citadel to the northeast.  Rising high above the basalt walls enclosing the complex, the spire is a towering construct of shadowed stone that seems to scrape the bellies of the clouds.  Its shadow stretches over the town, black and foreboding.

title: [Sablecross, Bastion Circle]
description: Rook Boulevard blends into the road encircling the citadel at the village's center.  Steepled manses give way to smaller homes and businesses content to huddle in the shadow of the walls around the central spire's base.  Near to the walls is a stand of strangler figs that have found hardy purchase in a craggy section of the greenway, their boles tangled about the corpses of trees they have consumed.

title: [Sabelcross, Rook Boulevard]
description: A tall rookery, crooked and black, leans perilously over the roadside, casting a dread shadow across the smooth-worn cobbles.  It rises far above the thick green canopy of the encroaching trees and a story higher than most of the manses lurking beyond the greenery.  The outer sills of the rookery's cavernous windows are stained white with the leavings of countless birds.

title: [Sablecross, Bastion Circle]
description: Eerie multicolored light wafts from wardings carved along the high wall at the center of town.  It filters through the dark, tangled boles of strangler figs in the greenway below the fortifications.  Carts roll along the cobblestones, hauling metal ingots toward the forges of the Canton of Hammers, drawn by great black aurochs.

title: [Sablecross, Bastion Circle]
description: The walls encircling the base of the Bastion are high and strong, formed from great blocks of basalt that are fitted together so closely that the seams between stones are difficult to detect.  They are dwarfed by the great spire itself, a looming black talon that scrapes at the sky.  Neither businesses nor homes trespass onto the side of the curving street occupied by the fortifications, but flowers and grasses flourish in the greenways beneath the walls.

title: [Sablecross, Caracal Avenue]
description: A tannery stands far from the other structures nearby, but its singularly vile melange of tanning fluids and animal hides billows out over the cobblestone street in noisome eddies.  In the shadow of the shop burns a brazier stacked with alder logs.  Their pale smoke is laden with mild, loamy sweetness that almost manages to hold the wretched stench at bay.  Several other shops along the stretch have censers of incense burning in their windows or aromatic nosegays hung before their doors.

title: [Sablecross, Bastion Circle]
description: Multicolored light bleeds in cool hues from warding glyphs etched into the surface of the grim basalt walls defending the Bastion's base.  As if oblivious to the imposing battlements above, patches of mournbloom and bleeding heart flourish in cultivated banks at the base of the wall.  The air is cold, as if the shadow of the great spire above has leached the warmth from the surroundings.

title: [Sablecross, Bastion Circle]
description: Stalks of monkshood sway in the shadows beneath the great citadel at the heart of the burg.  Their ghostly blue flowers and bright green petals are a splash of color against the bleakness of the tenebrous basalt wall behind them.  Tall brick buildings frame the roadway as it descends to the east, retreating into the sprawl beyond the great spire and its walled base.

title: [Sablecross, Thresher Street]
description: Chatter drifts down from the high balconies of brick buildings to both sides of the lane, the dark shapes of which leave only a narrow strip of daylight overhead.  Sunlight glows tenuously off of horse-drawn stagecoaches that rattle over the cobblestone street, but the sparse pedestrian traffic along the road's edges are consigned to shadow.  The windows of the businesses above a barrister's office are dark and the chambers beyond them shrouded by curtains in lurid reds and other bright, jeweled hues.

title: [Sablecross, Bastion Circle]
description: Grim, armed figures in dark garb patrol the battlements overhead, but judging from the glowing wards scribed on the foreboding walls, they are far from the sole defense of the citadel at the town's heart.  Clustered along the wall is a stand of thriving poisonwood trees with nettle and nightshade growing at their bases.  To the southeast, the slate-roofed buildings of the Hushed Span linger in characteristic quiet.

title: [The Bastion, Antechamber]
description: Banners of charcoal silk fringed in dark golden brocade hang overhead, emblazoned with a dark tower wreathed in flames in sullen sunset hues.  They ripple in air currents rising from the vast hearths that heat the cavernous chamber.  A broad runner of lush velvet in the same hues proceeds toward an arched pair of ebony double doors with leaping flames of fireleaf inlay.  Twin suits of armor, many feet too tall to be worn by a human, flank the doors, their black ora breastplates winking in the fireglow.

title: [The Bastion, Great Hall]
description: Shadebinders in cinerious garb flank the doors and guard immense staircases of dark marble that climb toward the upper reaches of the Bastion, twining and interlacing at fantastical landings overhead.  A banquet table of inlaid widowwood stretches before a fiery hearth of grim stone fashioned to resemble a demon's yawning maw.  Sumptuously laden with bone porcelain, crystal goblets, and golden cutlery, the table is flanked to either side by ornate seats of ebony that are heavily clad in gilt.

title: [Fanghorn and Hoof, Reception]
description: The scent of old parchment and oiled leather fills the office's reception area.  Legal tomes in a variety of styles, bindings, and languages line bookshelves along the walls, and scarlet and black tapestries with gold embroidery hang between the furnishings.  Near to a paneled ebony door, an elm reception desk with widowwood panels stands guard, laden with a neat arrangement of inkpots, quills, and papers.

title: [Fanghorn and Hoof, Chambers]
description: Lush velvet curtains are drawn over the office's windows, allowing in only the faintest glow of sunlight.  The day's radiance is confined to feeble pools near each window, so the duty of lighting the chamber is left to branching candelabras sitting on a large writing desk and atop a bookshelf near the door.  The chair behind the desk is almost a throne.  It is upholstered in dark red leather and its bloodwood frame clad in gilt filigree.

title: [Sablecross, Mute Row]
description: The savory aroma of roasting meat beckons on the breeze, tantalizing and teasing from the lofty, arched windows of a thriving restaurant at the end of the row.  Along the flagstone patio, fine metal chains hold aloft a series of glass lanterns.  Though unlit, they refract the sunlight in dazzling rainbowed patterns over the outdoor seats and tables.  Atop the steepled roof, silk pennants in amber and dusky gold flutter proudly, their fabric embroidered with stylized lions.

title: [The Lion's Share, Host Stand]
description: Chandeliers bathe the entryway of the restaurant in warm lighting that awakens a tawny glow in the fine furnishings.  Beneath the light of the candles, the lifelike glass eyes of a hinterboar trophy mounted on the wall over the entrance glitter keenly.  The host's stand is carved from golden maple and is placed near the entrance, keeping the host in ready view of a smoked glass door leading into a private lounge.

title: [The Lion's Share, Lounge]
description: Secured by a smoked glass door, the lounge is an intimate space that smells faintly of tobacco and leather.   A number of cushioned leather seats sit opposite one another, separated by a smoked glass table with a frosted pattern at its edges that resembles interlocking talons.  Within reach of the table, a burled ash humidor holds cigars and matches.

title: [Sablecross, Mute Row]
description: Soft, swaying grasses carpet the incline between the meandering row and the walls of the citadel above, leaving ample space for elegant brownstone homes and a scattering of storefronts.  Among the tidy procession of businesses, an apothecary's shop with a squared chimney stands out for the garlands of herbs strung from its eaves.  Bay laurel and vervain are woven together in a colorful display of yellow and pink flowers over the front door, which is etched with a stylized mortar and pestle.

title: [Snakeroot's Apothecary, Store]
description: Lemon balm and lavender overflow the planters hung by the window of the shop.  The sweet scent from their profusion of flowers fills the small shop and is only the foremost of the multifarious herbal scents in the air.  Nosegays and herb bundles hang from the walls and occupy several small display tables in the cozy space.  Behind a high poisonwood counter, more dangerous herbs are kept, including sprigs of nightshade, clusters of white deathwort, and hemlock.

title: [Sablecross, Mute Row]
description: Blossoming flaeshorn vines climb the walls of a marble enchanter's atelier.  Intricate symbols have been carved into the dark stone, following the natural crimson veins that travel through the marble in a way that makes them difficult to follow with the eye.  Carved steps lead up to a heavy, reinforced door.  Windows of stained glass--bold cobalt, vibrant cardinal red, and rich burnt umber--give not a hint as to the workshop's interior, but their panes shine as if lit from within.

title: [The Spellforge, Atelier]
description: Tiny golden sigils are set into the surface of the marble block walls of the atelier, also gracing a rectangular marble slab at the center of the chamber.  The sunlight streaming into the chamber is heavily stained with the colors of the windows, a collection of cobalt, scarlet, and burnt umber shades.  An interlocking pattern of gold and bronze chains is set into the floor and encircles the slab's base.

title: [Silk and Shade, Shop]
description: Heavy velvet curtains of charcoal silk with green fringes obscure the shop's windows, leaving the work of lighting it to a series of candles in pierced bronze lantern holders.  Gowns and coats on mannequins along the perimeters of the showroom suggest a singular talent for the tailor's craft, embodying a variety of styles, fabrics, and cuts.  Several hooks hold completed garments, but it appears that the predominance are made to order.  A grey and green door leads to a studio set off from the main room.

title: [Silk and Shade, Studio]
description: Spools of fine fabric hang on a large rack near the door leading into the small studio.  A neat workbench holds spools of tailor's tape, pins, and shears, all pristinely arranged.  On the sill of the sole window in the room sits a fresh-cut rose with petals the color of flame.

title: [Sablecross, Lichyard]
description: Even rows of black marble tombstones march along the soft green grasses near the entrance of the lichyard, only halted in their precise procession by the roots of dark-boled bloodwoods dotting the grounds.  The cool breeze carries distant birdsong and the occasional creaking of the cemetery gate, but otherwise it is as if a pall of silence hangs over the graves.  A mausoleum resting in the shadow of the fence is grander than the surrounding tombstones and is intricately carved with bas-reliefs.

title: [Eldritch Elixirs, Showroom]
description: Brightly colored bottles catch the sunlight streaming through the wide bay windows facing the street.  They cast fragments of bright color--scarlet, green, and indigo--across the other wares in the showroom, an eclectic collection of wands, amulets, potions, and other arcane implements.  Atop a pedestal of carved ebony, a glass display holds a sliver of plinite the color of absinthe, but the crystal is spiderwebbed with deep cracks.

title: [Eldritch Elixirs, Acquisitions]
description: More of a workroom than a sales parlor, the room smells faintly of acrid catalysts and burning sulphur.  The likely source of the odor is a series of spiraled tubes, beakers, and vials full of strange bubbling liquids that sits behind the narrow teak sales counter.  Several bottles holding quicksilver, oil of antimony, and spirit of hartshorn gleam from a shelf that would require a ladder to reach, their identities obvious from neat labels beneath each.

title: [Sablecross, Lichyard]
description: The rows of tombstones become less even as the ground grows more hilly.  A pauper's gravestone, devoid of ornamentation, is spiderwebbed through with cracks, but most of the memorials are well-tended.  Several have bouquets of mournblooms and other flowers left before them.  No offerings sit before a small black monument near the furthest verges of the lichyard, but it is heavily ornamented with the forms of entangled serpents.

title: [Snakeroot's Apothecary, Cures]
description: In a glazed pot by the rear window of the shop, a tuft of moon sedge soaks up the daylight.  Several cots, reasonably comfortable but simple in make, are arranged neatly in the room.  Healing herbs, several gemstones, and a roll of bandages sit on a folded fabric square atop a small table near the window.  The acrid scent of astringent hangs faintly in the air.

title: [The Lion's Share, Dining Room]
description: Trophies of the hunt hang from mounting boards on the slate walls of the restaurant alongside spears and bows that have the appearance of great age.  Serving staff bustle around tables and booths, carrying gold-chased silver platters laden with delicacies.  Through the melange of dishes, the savory aromas of roasting venison and garlic win through, but they are only a few of the tantalizing aromas promised by the kitchens.  Some glass-paneled doors lead out onto the patio, where more seating is available.

title: [The Lion's Share, Patio]
description: Fine metal chains hang over the patio, suspending a series of glass lanterns.  Though unlit, they catch the daylight and refract it in a constellation of rainbowed shards that illuminate the surfaces of the round tables that occupy the patio.  A quiet but picturesque street runs along one side of the patio, while on the other, some glass-paneled doors lead into the rustic opulence of the restaurant.

title: [Pleasant Pheasant Table]
description: Songbirds pattern the wallpaper near to the wooden table, their plumage coming in a variety of colors and styles.  The tabletop itself is carved with a preening pheasant with its tailfeathers spread in a vainglorious display.  A spray of brightly colored feathers rings a small lamp at the center.

title: [Pride's Bounty Table]
description: Prowling lions adorn the wallpaper near the wooden table, their eyes intent as if they are circling prey.  Carved into the iridescent mother-of-pearl tabletop is a roaring lion stands atop a jutting precipice of stone.  A small tiger's eye obelisk serves as the table's centerpiece.

title: [Woodland Spirit Table]
description: The wallpaper near the table depicts a wild-looking man with lambent eyes like those of a wolf.  Woodland spirits cavort over the ornately carved tabletop, engaged in acts of play and mischief.  Pendant lamps resembling chunks of raw stone cast warm illumination over the area, and the air holds the subtle fragrance of wildflowers.

title: [Vorwyn's Lapidary, Gallery]
description: Glass displays spaced throughout the room hold samples of the lapidary's art: tourmalines fashioned in the shapes of teardrops, diamonds cut to enhance their splendorous white fire, and firedrops winking like solid flame scattered across beds of black velvet.  Though not large, the shop appears prosperous, its floor patterned with porcelain tiles forming a pyramid of charcoal and lilac squares.  A fresco on the eastern wall portrays a plump, long-haired lapidary plying his trade with a hammer and chisel.

title: [Gaunt's Run, Showroom]
description: It is dim inside the shop, but not dark.  Glimaerstone lamps are hung along the walls, their light trained on a number of glass display cases arranged around the large room.  The cases are mostly empty, though there are half a dozen items within them, mostly trinkets and baubles of little apparent value.  The floor is covered in a rich wall-to-wall carpet the color of burgundy wine, and a velvet curtain of the same color masks a doorway leading eastward.

title: [Grigg's Countinghouse, Lobby]
description: Bronze braziers hang from the central beam of the ceiling by glittering metal chains, warming the air and casting the surroundings in firelight.  Guards stand ready by the double doors of the entrance, armor and weapons mostly concealed by dark cloaks.  Columns proceed northward, flanking a gold-tasseled scarlet runner as it proceeds toward the clerks' desks.

title: [Sablecross, Silkbend]
description: Separated from the commotion of the bazaar by a long alleyway, the bend is flanked by stately shops and older homes.  An elegant fence of spiraled dark iron bars extends along the southern side of the street, and at its center is an arched black gate with golden flourishes.  Orchids flourish along the perimter of a sprawling terrace on the other side, and beyond the yard awaits an expansive alabaster bathhouse.

title: [The Anshelin Baths, Terrace]
description: Copper-bound planters stake out the edges of the flagstone terrace.  Orchids grow in profusion in the raised beds, the riot of blooms ranging in hues from snowy white to startling fuchsia.  Cloying sweetness from scented oils drifts from the double-door entrance of a capacious marble bathhouse, which reveals an opulent interior lit by candles.  The stone is predominantly cream-hued, but has flourishes of richer ash rose traveling through it in striking veins.  An arched black gate leads back out onto the road.

title: [Sablecross, Silkbend]
description: The railing of the upper balcony on a nearby manor house dangles a single scarlet kerchief that matches the dwelling's red-limned door.  Heavy velvet curtains shroud the windows and those of the carriages parked in its courtyard.  Opposite the manse is a large open-air theater with a thatched roof over its circumference.  Lampposts stand to either side of the path leading to the playhouse.

title: [Shadowplay Theater, Seating]
description: Rows of carved wooden seats are arrayed before the raised stage, though there are cordoned standing areas for those too tardy or too poor to win themselves a chair.  Though a thatched roof covers a portion of the house and stage, the center of the building is open to the sunlit sky.  Shimmering curtains of rich emerald velvet hang to either side of the stage, held open by golden braids.  A painted green door accesses the theater's backstage.

title: [Shadowplay Theater, Backstage]
description: Wooden beams crisscross the low roof of the backstage space, which is a bit cramped but tidy.  Desks with attached mirrors sit along the walls, each vanity laden with pots of face paint and lipstick in a rainbow of colors.  Several have wigs hung from pegs along their sides, and though most are the color of natural hair, a few come in vivid greens, pinks, and purples.  An emerald green curtain separates the small room from the stage, and a painted green door leads out into the theater.

title: [Sablecross, Attar Court]
description: Rose bushes line the greenway encircling a small court at the street's end, suffusing the air with their velvety perfume.  Benches along the court's exterior provide respite, though they and the cobblestones are littered with vivid crimson petals.  A small fountain wrought to resemble two lovers embracing spills musically into a shallow marble basin.  Nearby, a mossy brick retaining wall tangled with ivy protects a small, secluded tea shop.

title: [Seline's Teahouse, Patio]
description: Cerulean roses hang over the mossy brick wall enclosing the patio, dappling the ground with their gently swaying shadows.  Wenge tables and benches are spaced about the enclosure, shaded by black canopies patterned with plum-colored flowers.  Smoked glass windows proceed along the wood-paneled exterior of the tea shop.  The smell of steeping tea creeps through the front door, perfuming the air with floral and herbal notes that are as soothing as the gentle breezes that whisper over the wall.

title: [Seline's Teahouse, Counter]
description: The smell of steeping tea hangs like perfume in the air, herbal and floral notes lingering in a heavy pall over the front room of the shop.  A wide wenge counter with inlaid purpleheart blossoms stands near to the entrance, forming a rounded rectangle around a tall shelf laden with porcelain jars of tea leaves.  Drifting curtains of black silk patterned with deep violet blooms hang over an archway heading eastward into the tea room.

title: [Vorwyn's Lapidary, Procurement]
description: Guarded by a high counter of jewel-inlaid walnut, an elaborate gold and steel lockbox holds a pile of silver, gold, and copper coins.  The tools of a jewelcrafter's trade hang from a rack of the same fine wood, hammers, chisels, tongs, and hand drills all maintained with painstaking care.  A worktable beneath the rack houses a pair of lathes.  Though clean, the wood of the table glints with gem dust in the light streaming through the windows.

title: [Gaunt's Run, Broker]
description: Shaded glimaerstone lamps illuminate the wood-paneled walls of the shop's back office, awakening reddish glints in the smooth ebony.  Behind an antique desk hangs a portrait in an elaborate gilded frame.  The canvas features an older man, his hair silvered at the temples, standing with a pomegranate in hand.  He is tall and raw-boned.  To either side of the portrait, cases hold tablets, daggers, and other artifacts of times past.  A burgundy rug softens the alternating wenge and white oak flooring.

title: [Grigg's Countinghouse, Clerk]
description: Stained glass windows cast shards of colored light on the gold-tasseled scarlet runner as it approaches a long thanot counter, behind which sit clerks in formal attire.  Several are busy counting piles of gold and silver coins, some with strange shapes like hexagons and squares.  One has platinum tradebars stacked before him.

title: [Grigg's Countinghouse, Broker]
description: Clinks and clacks of coin being counted echo off of the walls, the product of the tireless work of brokers exchanging currencies.  They work behind the comfort of a carved thanot counter that separates a tidy workspace from the bustle of the countinghouse.  Stacks of foreign promissory notes form neat piles on the brokers' desks, some marked with strange languages, or symbols barely recognizable as words.

title: [The Anshelin Baths, Foyer]
description: Sunlight streams through the entryway, warming the cream-colored marble of the foyer and awakening rosy veins in the masonry.  A tawny carpet proceeds to the front desk, which is scattered with a spill of orchid petals.  Amber candles burn in crystal holders at the edges of the desk, filling the chamber with a warm spiced aroma that is a pleasing counterpoint to the orchids' perfume.  A gracefully carved arch leads further into the baths, and from the corridor beyond comes the crystalline sound of flowing water.

title: [Shadowplay Theater, Stage]
description: A broad stage of oak curves outward toward the audience, flanked by spills of green velvet.  The curtain to the west provides access to backstage, concealing any bustle within from the eyes of the audience.  Masterfully shaped glimaerstone spheres are arrayed on a wooden beam above the stage, shaded to provide the stage with focused light for performers.  Their radiance almost manages to obscure view of the house in a veil of luminescence.

title: [Seline's Teahouse, Tea Room]
description: Veil-like curtains of black silk adorned with blossoms in deep violet hang over the arched entrance to the tea room, nearly concealing a small private nook.  Round tables of fine-grained wenge occupy the close chamber, the unoccupied ones arrayed with fine bone cups and plates, golden teaspoons, and napkins of amethyst silk.  Cerulean roses hanging over the patio wall outside dapple the carpeted floor with their gently swaying shadows.  Their shapes are murky through the smoked glass windows.

title: [Jade Wind Table]
description: Airy spirals of jade inlay adorn the top of the ornate table, which is carved from ebony polished to a black gleam.  Delicate carvings of swirling winds and graceful leaves grace the edges.  A lamp nearby bathes the space in soft, virescent light.

title: [Seline's Teahouse, Nook]
description: The table occupying the nook is smaller and its tooling more intricate than the others in the tea room.  Covered by a shade of brass that has been pierced with floral patterns, a single candle lights the niche, the sweetness of its beeswax commingling with the omnipresent scent of dried tea leaves.  Blue rose petals are artfully scattered across the tabletop around the place settings.

title: [Seline's Teahouse, Tea Room]
description: Gently lit by lanterns lacquered with vivid blue roses, the far end of the tea room is a serene space framed by black curtains.  A cast iron stove graced by a pattern of brushed silver thorns stands near a lacquered black steel bin with compartments for tinder and logs.  Atop the stove sits a pale porcelain kettle painted with blue and green wisps.

title: [Midnight Jasmine Table]
description: Porcelain vases hold sprigs of night-blooming jasmine, the flowers perfuming the air with their honeyed fragrance.  The top of the table is etched with little flowers, their edges dusted with silver as if bathed in a veil of starlight.  Overhead, the ceiling is painted with a mural of a night sky, but with spirals of white petals floating through the dark firmament.

title: [Shining Crescent Table]
description: A gleaming moon of silver glints brightly from the surface of the table, which is carved from a block of dark modwir.  Paper lanterns pierced with stars and crescent moons hang overhead, casting gentle light over the secluded niche.  A spray of moonflowers sits in a small vase at the table's center.

title: [Matters of Metal, Smithy]
description: Soot stains the circular wall enclosing the smithy, darkening toward the rafters.  The crisscrossing beams overhead are intensely black, stained by decades of smoke.  Near to a stone-lined forge, an old anvil with a veil iron face and horn is littered with fragments of glistening metal.  An oaken tool rack hung opposite the forge holds tongs, hammers, and pokers.

title: [Gauntlet Row Armory, Yard]
description: Rows of training dummies stand in the dirt yard, their burlap bodies stuffed with straw.  One dummy is painted with a crude silver-edged black sword symbol on its chest and has an especially lopsided face.  The barracks, a large grey stone building with a sloping slate roof and evenly spaced square windows, has wings that frame the yard on three sides.  A black steel gate to the south allows egress to the row.

title: [Titan's Triumph, Anteroom]
description: Vaulted arches soar above the anteroom of the colosseum, proceeding toward a long, torchlit hallway in the north.  Statues of powerfully built men and women stand atop marble plinths at the bases of the support columns, their visages proud, imperious, and occasionally cruel.  Smaller alcoves to either side of the entrance house desks for the cashiers and clerks.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Sablecross, Warden Terrace]
description: Vast blocks of stone form an uneven arch at the entrance to a circular henge at the southwestern verges of the flagstone terrace.  Crude carvings on the lintel stones take the forms of crossed scimitars, and livid crimson pigments are worked into the etchings to accentuate their shapes.  Unforgiving daylight filters through the spaces between the stones, hinting at a black structure lurking at the center of the foreboding ring.

title: [The Bloodhenge, Standing Stones]
description: Ancient carvings travel in wavering lines across the towering blocks of tenebrous grey stone composing the henge.  Blood red pigment has been smashed into the carvings, illuminating them with crude smears.  They depict figures engaged in acts of mass bloodshed, the massacres raging in size from the dozens to thousands.  A pair of crossed black ora scimitars hangs from rivets above the entry arch, their edges limned a murderous crimson.  Henbane flourishes in the shadows of the standing stones.

title: [Sablecross, Warden Terrace]
description: A strange chancel of blue-black glaes stretches high, its shadow spreading monstrously across the flagstones of the terrace.  Alien in structure and chaotic in form, it looks to have sprouted from the tortured earth of the hillside behind it.  Sunlight refracts violently off of the glaesine construction, scattering in vivid shards of indigo light across the ground.  A jagged-edged gash leads into the structure at its base, looking for all the world like a tortured maw.

title: [Chancel of Ruin, Entry]
description: Statues with little commonality of form stand at the four corners of the antechamber, carved from porous black stone that glints wetly in the light of torches hung from the walls.  Caught in twisted sconces of blackened steel, the torches' flickering flames awaken strange glints of otherworldly color in the cyclopean blocks of blue-black glaes composing the alien architecture.  Shadows flirt with the hideous statues, making their hodgepodge of tentacles, wings, and claws seem to twitch with agitation.

title: [Chancel of Ruin, Font of Stars]
description: Iridescent water splashes from a font of porous black stone carved into the shape of a creature with one large eye and many wings, falling into a star-shaped black stone basin.  Countless candles in blackened steel holders fill niches on the eastern and western walls, sending the shadows of the chamber into a riotous, flickering dance.  Archways in both directions are etched with multifarious eyes, a six-tentacled star adorning the keystone of each.  Ungainly, slick steps to the north clamber toward a monstrous altar.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, up

title: [Chancel of Ruin, Altar of Dust]
description: A mural engulfs the surface of the northern wall, bending with the curves of the stone to embrace the raised dais.  It depicts a twisted form of snatching claws, gnashing teeth, and grasping tentacles, sprawling outward from one massive eye with a star-shaped pupil.  An altar of pocked ebon stone sprouts twisting appendages that hold aloft a globe of quivering urnon.  No candles illuminate the chamber, but a large indigo sphere hangs from the ceiling, casting fitful radiance on the surroundings.

title: [Chancel of Ruin, Reliquary]
description: Canopic jars line shelves along the western wall, formed of a thick, smoky crystal that is blacker than the dark glaes of the walls.  There are larger relics as well.  Mounted on the northern wall is what remains of a singularly massive reptilian skull, its age-darkened bones and jagged teeth those of a powerful predator.  Opposite it, in a case lined with charcoal grey velvet, is a strip of glittering hide that is swathed in shadows.

title: [Chancel of Ruin, Reliefs]
description: The hallway is dark and cold, with a hint of mildew lingering sour on the air.  A scant few candles are placed in niches to light the darkness, and their radiance seems feeble against the greater darkness pressing down on the passageway.  All along the eastern wall, reliefs are carved out of porous black stone.  Time has smoothed but not erased their procession of images.  Overhead, a star with six tentacles has been carved into the ceiling.

title: [The Bloodhenge, Temple Approach]
description: Wild firethorn and black violets grow in profusion before the temple in untamed banks, their blossoms mimicking the colors of the red-veined black stone construction.  Twin braziers of crude black steel flank the entrance, adorned with a pattern of interlocking swords.  They fill the air with biting, dancing cinders and a wash of prickling heat.  A mighty henge of grey stone rings the temple grounds, and daylight filters cruelly between the great monoliths.

title: [Temple of War, Antechamber]
description: The tang of bitter iron chokes the air of the temple, which is ablaze with the heat from great rough-edged hearths along the walls.  Shields in a variety of shapes, sizes, and makes hang from the walls over the hearths, reflecting the roaring flames.  Before a shallow set of steps leading northward, a wide basin of crude metal sits beneath a blackened steel chalice.  Red banners arc overhead like sprays of blood, wavering in the air currents awakened by the heat.

title: [Temple of War, Spoils]
description: Heaps of coin, jewelry, and other spoils clutter the chamber in gleaming profusion, casting dazzling reflections of the torchlight illuminating the arched hall.  More spills from huge chests of bloodwood and redsteel, themselves supported by piles of treasure.  Standing imperiously over the trove is the statue of a massively muscled man in black marble, his callused hands clenching twin scimitars.  Steps proceed upward through a hammered black steel arch at the far end of the chamber.

title: [Temple of War, Swordborn Altar]
description: Combatants clash in vividly realized battle across the walls overlooking a dais of grey-shot ebon stone, splashes of crimson and glints of silver punctuating the dark imagery.  At the center of the dais stands an altar supported by statues of grotesquely muscled warriors.  The dark steel slab appears to have been wrought from the remnants of several dozen swords, their sharp-edged shapes melded together but not entirely lost to the forge.  Steps proceed down through a hammered black steel arch.

title: [Gauntlet Row Armory, Barracks]
description: Evenly spaced square windows proceed along the walls of the barracks, letting in spills of daylight that harshly illuminate the interior.  In lines as straight as tombstones in a cemetery, bunks proceed to either direction.  Each has a footlocker at the base, but personal touches, a copper locket hung over a bedknob, or a carved set of initials in the wood, are few and far between.  Emblazoned on one wall is the sigil of a dark tower wreathed in flames.

title: [Titan's Triumph, Clerk]
description: A splendid mosaic of jewelled tesserae dominates the western wall of the colosseum, depicting a massively muscled figure battling with a silver-scaled wyrm with scintillating wings.  The titanic clash makes the comparatively mundane activities beneath it seem mildly incongruous.  A red-inked ledger sits atop a curved blackwood desk at the base of the sprawling artwork.

title: [Titan's Triumph, Cashier]
description: Along the eastern wall of the colosseum are a series of windowed booths occupied by well-dressed cashiers.  The glass windows are secured by steel grates, but should the fortifications fail to protect the staff, there are also squads of armed guards standing warily in brigandine armor nearby.  Most of the workers' desks hold piles of coin in an assortment of denominations, promissory notes, and tradebars in varying sizes and metals.

title: [Titan's Triumph, Hall of Glory]
description: Brilliantly lit by torches hung in sconces along the walls, the hallway has a vaulting ceiling painted with aged frescos of victorious combat.  It proceeds toward a great portcullis of ironwood reinforced with black and gold vultite.  From beyond, the roar of the arena calls.  Alcoves spaced along the walls hold suits of polished armor, though one arched opening in the western wall houses a broad flight of marble steps ascending to the stands.

title: [Titan's Triumph, Stands]
description: Stands comprising tiered seats and steps of carved stone encircle the colosseum floor, providing an excellent view of the battles down below.  Bold banners, black and scarlet with a golden tower wreathed in flames on each, are held aloft by poles along the uppermost tier.  Marble steps descend back down to the lower reaches of the colosseum.

title: [The Raven's Roost, Post]
description: An uncomplicated chandelier of iron and brass hangs from the ceiling near the entrance, supplementing the meager light streaming through the doorway into the windowless chamber.  In an alcove sits an old modwir desk, the space atop it littered with stacks of letters and unsent parcels.  From above comes the muted cawing of ravens.

title: [The Raven's Roost, Parcels]
description: Shelves have been anchored into the crumbling walls of the rookery, lining all of them but the northernmost.  Stairs proceed through an arch in the north wall, climbing toward the rookery's tower.  The way is lit by a pair of feebly burning torches in iron sconces spotted with rust.  A chorus of caws and the soft thunder of flapping wings echoes down the stairwell, amplified by the narrow space of the stairwell.

title: [The Raven's Roost, Tower]
description: A cacophony of caws and squawks fills the rookery tower, resounding off of the low eaves of the roof.  Hundreds of ravens dwell in the space.  The scent of their droppings commingles unpleasantly with the sweetness of a layer of straw on the floor, which is also scattered with shiny black feathers.  Windows in each of the four walls provide a high vantage of the stately village below.

title: [The Fane of Steel, Courtyard]
description: Dark grey paving stones march in neatly ordered rows between meticulously cultivated planters boasting scarlet canna lilies and black dahlias.  Dusky grey steel tracery gleams harshly from the dark stone facade of a majestic fane beyond the garden's edge.  The building strives vaingloriously into the sky, its stained glass windows ablaze with dancing firelight from within.  A steel prayer gate adorned with metallic flames opens onto the street outside, but the noises of the outside world are distant and muted as if in reverence.

title: [The Hunter's Close, Grounds]
description: Tall pillars sprout from beds of catswort along a broad path that sweeps from the gates of the compound toward a low sandstone temple in the near distance.  Two long reflecting pools reside amidst the thriving greenery, brilliantly colored carp flashing in their wavering depths.  Cinnamon and sandalwood trees shade verdant ferns and other exotics, perfuming the air with their commingled scent.  Glimpses of soft earth through the abundant flora evidence the passage of small tracks through the undergrowth.

title: [The Hunter's Close, Anteroom]
description: Lambent eyes glare down upon the entryway of the temple, the twin shards of chatoyant golden stone set into the mask of a carved sandstone panther head adorning the opposing wall.  Other felines are depicted in mosaic tiles spreading across the floor of the entry, blood amber and obsidian tesserae giving shape to lions, lynxes, and caracals.  The hall bends into a sharp crescent as it continues to the northwest and northeast, while due north, an arch carved with leaping cats leads toward the central altar.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out

title: [Sablecross, Vesper Crescent]
description: Shaded by a stand of bloodwood trees that crowd the hillocks to either side of the road, an elaborate temple of jade-hued sandstone shares a wall with a ziggurat of red basalt.  Metal disks inlaid into the wall form a pattern of scales, the ornamentation starting in bronze and transitioning gradually to ruddy copper near the squared arch leading into the ziggurat's yard.  The temple has a sinuous gate crowned by a striking serpent's head, and glittering emeralds wink from deep within its shadowed maw.

title: [The Fang, Garden]
description: The earth of the garden is spongy and moist and littered with decaying leaves.  The faint sweetness of rot lingers on the still air, and thick billows of fog crawl along the ground between stands of weeping willow and cypress.  Dirge-vaon grows thick to either side of a trail running from the gate to a sallow green stone temple lit by torches spitting emerald flames.  The temple takes the form of a colossal serpent rearing up above the garden's canopy, its eyes alive with emerald flames.

title: [The Fang, Antechamber]
description: Emerald flames spit and hiss from a cavernous hearth that takes the form of a serpent with its maw open.  The snake's sickle-like fangs are black silhouettes against the inferno within, which heats the antechamber to an uncomfortable degree.  Scintillating green cinders drift on the air currents, pirouetting past banners and an aged tapestry portraying a man with a scaled face and a serpentine shadow.  A winding green stone staircase coils sinuously toward the upper story of the temple.

title: [The Fang, Sinuous Hall]
description: Atop a winding green stone staircase stretches a long hallway that proceeds past the staring eyes of countless snakes carved onto the dark walls in bas-relief.  The serpents span a variety of shapes and sorts, but each has eyes of emerald that seem to glint with viridian flames from within.  Undulating to the left and right as it winds southward, the walkway passes by the statue of a scaled man clad in luxuriant robes.

title: [The Crimson Ziggurat, Yard]
description: Shaded by stands of bloodwood that mostly obscure sight of the walls and entry arch, the yard is an expanse of spongy, reddish soil punctuated with red anemones and delicate violet iris.  A small stream flows through the wooded grounds, but it has an unsavory hue and flavors with the air with the bitter tang of copper.  Flagstones so darkly red as to appear black wind sinuously toward the steps of a ruddy stone ziggurat flanked by a quartet of spindly minarets, each crowned with a two-headed serpent.

title: [The Crimson Ziggurat, Entry]
description: The statue of an elven man with flowing hair and a warrior's muscles towers over the rest of the antechamber, nearly scraping the domed ceiling above.  His face and figure are repeated in friezes occupying alcoves on the walls, although in them he is bathed a startling crimson.  In one of his hands, he clasps a serpent of violet stone.  Floor tiles of the same hue spiral sinuously outward from the statue's pedestal.  To the north is a tall archway curtained with billows of blood red velvet.

title: [Temple of Flesh, Garden]
description: Beyond widespread gates of bronze, apricot trees flourish around the perimeters of the lush garden, their pendulous fruits swaying languidly in the breeze.  Orchids sprout from fertile soil amidst densely overgrown shrubs.  Tantalizing glimpses through the greenery hint at intricately carved statues of jade depicting intertwining humanoid forms that mark a winding path toward a temple of milky green marble.

title: [Temple of Flesh, Antechamber]
description: An archway vaults over the entrance of the temple, formed from acrobatic bodies of pale green jade enthusiastically intertwined with one another.  Garlands of liana woven with orchids and rockroses drape over the delicate shoulders of a statue atop a dais trimmed in tentacles.  The glow of amber beeswax candles reflects gently off of the burnished green marble of the floor.

title: [The Profane Archive, Garden]
description: Near to the garden's ornate entry gate stands a statue of a robed woman, her arm raised to hold a spread-winged owl aloft.  Her eyes look imperiously down upon a flagstone path that weaves through neatly tended banks of sage.  Beneath her shadow lazes a tranquil lotus pond alive with vibrant amber blooms, a veritable rainbow of koi swimming in the murky waters beneath.

title: [Sablecross, Vesper Crescent]
description: Sheer walls of onyx-hued sandstone enclose the garden of a nearby temple.  Black-boled lor trees with sallow red leaves strain up over the wall as if snatching at the sky.  Elaborate jackal head carvings adorn the columns to either side of the gates, which are wrought from lightless metal and graced with flourishes of dusky gold.  Opposite it, a smaller compound houses a dark blue temple, black sand from its yard scattering through its silver-chased indigo arch.

title: [The Deep Shrine, Garden]
description: Small dunes of black sand flank the walls of the temple yard, flattening into traversable terrain near a silver-chased indigo arch.  The sands give life to only scant vegetation, with only a hint of bright green seagrass sprouting here and there.  A strip of stone walkway provides the sole means of crossing a dark, still pool of briny water that occupies much of the grounds.  On the other side, a squat temple of dark blue stone lurks, its architecture strange and grim.

title: [The Deep Shrine, Coils]
description: Carved from deep blue stone that is slick with moisture, the walls of the antechamber are shaped to resemble the body of a coiled eel.   The stone creature's bulging eyes stare down from an arched passage to the north where its mouth ought to be, jagged teeth of stone pressing down from the curve of the arch.  Spirals of sea glass are inlaid into the marble floor, which is as dark as the ocean's depths and shot through with jagged silver veins.

title: [Temple of Screams, Grounds]
description: Gold-flecked ebon paving stones wind through the foreboding metal gates, weaving beneath red-leafed lor trees and twisted rowans that claw like taloned silhouettes at the daylit sky, casting snatching shadows on the dark earth.  Golden moonflowers grow alongside banks of night-blooming black jasmine, peeking from among the lightless flowers like watching eyes.  Its entrance marked by a stylized jackal head of amber, a temple with a black marble facade lurks beneath the shadows of the trees.

title: [Temple of Screams, Great Hall]
description: Imposing jackal heads of carved ebony stand atop black marble pedestals, lining the walkway into the dark depths of the temple.  A scattering of candles fitfully illuminate the entryway, awakening flecks of gold in the stone like a spray of sharply glittering stars.  Censers along the chamber's perimeter trail poppy smoke in dark, lazy spirals, filling the air with a soporific perfume.

title: [The Profane Archive, Garden]
description: Moss crawls up the facade of the library, tinging the grey stone blocks a verdant green.  Vines have grown into an arch over the entryway, which is lit from within by the glow of flames.  Above the zenith of the living arch, a stylized bronze book is set into the facade, watched over by a slit-pupiled eye.  Banks of sage to either side of the flagstone walkway bake in the sun, filling the air with their dry, herbal aroma.

title: [The Archive, Vestibule]
description: Flanked by torches, the arched entrance of the structure opens out onto a well-tended garden dominated by sage bushes.  The torches hang in elaborate bronze sconces wrought to resemble partially unfurled scrolls.  The wall opposite the entrance features a glinting mosaic of jeweled tesserae depicting a man holding a burning brand before a kneeling throng.  Waves of intense heat distort the air around an amber-inlaid grey marble arch at the mosaic's center, making its edges shimmer and dance as if alive.

title: [The Archive, Radiance's Price]
description: Heavy chains of dull golden metal are riveted to the ceiling and walls of the expansive atrium.  They cruelly enmesh the statue of a raw-boned older man, suspending his form above a sea of dancing flames roaring from a stone-walled pit.  The heat of the flames makes the air of the cavernous chamber shimmer and warp, and the stones of the wall seem to writhe in the inferno.  Opposite the arch leading to the edifice's vestibule, a corridor proceeds northward before branching off to the west.

title: [The Profane Archive, Garden]
description: Sage bushes thrive in the shadows of the limestone walls enclosing the meditation garden of the library.  The dry, herbal scent is strong in the air, lingering over the grounds like incense.  Flagstones wind between tufts of moon sedge, weaving beneath an ornamental arch of grey marble that is shot through with striking green and wan yellow veins.  Near the eastern gate of the compound, a statue of a elderly man stands near the path, holding a flame aloft in one gnarled hand.

title: [Sablecross, Vesper Crescent]
description: Two temples, alike in their black stone construction, stand opposite one another at a bend in the road shaded by immense yew trees.  One shrine is a stygian marble building beyond a metallic wall of interlocking hexagons.  Spidersilk threads stretch across the openings in the metal, glistening like spun silver, and an octet of garnet eyes is inlaid into the lintel over the gate.  The arch leading to the second, a smaller, blocky building, is adorned with a bleached skull with a crack down the center.

title: [The Slayer's Den, Yard]
description: A squared basalt arch marks the entrance to the yard of a small temple of shadowy stone.  Planters of neatly tended foxglove, nightshade, and deathwort are crafted from planks of dark wood, their careful cultivation suggesting the work of a precise and skilled gardener.  Before the entrance, pale flagstones form a cracked skull symbol that stands out amid the pale green grasses.

title: [The Slayer's Den, Entryway]
description: Skulls line alcoves along the walls of the temple's antechamber.  Some are darkened by age and riddled with jagged cracks, while others are clearly more recent acquisitions.  Haloed by candlelight, the alabaster statue of a small man with a wiry build stands at the chamber's center, his dancing shadow stretching almost to the entrance.  A bundle of foxglove lies heaped at his feet alongside offerings of coin and incense.

title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Garden]
description: Spiderwebs glint silver in the daylight that creeps through the branches of crooked birches enclosing the temple's yard.  The silken webs stretch between the trees and entangle a gate of ebon metal along the plot's perimeter, though the noise of the abounding street is muffled and distant.  Dark flagstones offer a path through the creeping undergrowth toward a dark stone vault nestled deep within the thickly clustered trees.

title: [Shadowsilk Passage, Dark Path]
description: Tiny black arachnids writhe over the cragged surface of the cave walls, and in the light from the web-rimmed entrance, their bodies seem a shifting sea of quickened onyx.  The surreptitious sussurus of countless scurrying steps echoes down a northeastern tunnel, where green-tinged pale phosphorescence relieves the shadows.  A pungent scent like crude oil saturates the air.

title: [Sablecross, Vesper Crescent]
description: White bleeding-heart and crimson mournbloom flourish in beds at the base of an alabaster wall framing the garden of a temple to the north.  The temple's gates are adorned with figures in brass, their clinging attire brazenly highlighting lissome builds.  Beyond, the temple is built from blocks of white marble shot through with crimson and rose veins.  A circular fountain of the same material stands at the middle of the road, supporting a statue of a preternaturally beautiful man with outstretched arms.

title: [The Garden, Yard]
description: White and red roses crawl the gilded fence of the garden, the pristine buds and blossoms filling the air with a gently sweet perfume.  No less lovely are the abundance of mournblooms and bleeding heart that prosper in beds lined with pale chunks of stone, jealously guarded by stinging nettle.  The flora bounds a trail of crushed alabaster running from gates of white imflass to a pale marble temple erected far from the street.

title: [The Garden, Antechamber]
description: Lush, pale silks cascade in luxuriant spills from the high domed roof of the antechamber, each graced with a scant spiral of crimson petals.  The floor of red-veined white marble tiles radiates outward from a dagger-pierced heart formed from tesserae at the room's center.  Drifting in the breeze beckoning through the entrance, the silks reveal glimpses of silvered manacles hanging from arched recesses in the walls.

title: [The Garden, Statuary]
description: Daylight filters in through brightly colored windows of stained glass, awakening rosy hues in the marble statues lining the walk.  One sculpture, that of a beautiful man clad in sheer robes, is given pride of place atop a tall pedestal, but all of the statuary depicts beings of preternatural beauty.  Most are twined in chains about the wrists and neck.

title: [The Garden, Rose Chamber]
description: Pristine red and white roses sweeten the small alcove with their velvety perfume, notes of honey and spice lingering on the air.  Pedestals draped in white velvet hold a variety of relics.  One supports a coiled whip, another a blackened humerus fused with shards of blue-black razern, and a third a crystal bottle full of ruddy sand.  Each has a placard beneath it.  The eastern wall boasts a teardrop-shaped mirror of silver, the decoration's simplicity in peculiar counterpoint to the chamber's elegant decor.

title: [The Garden, Living Harvest]
description: The roof of the temple cuts away to reveal open sky over a neatly manicured garden.  Pathways of crushed alabaster wind between planters ablossom with crimson and white roses.  The garden's real bounty occupies large mistwood stakes driven into the ground.  Many hoist lithe figures in clinging silk shifts hanging from manacles of white imflass, their moans and cries an incessant drone in the air.  A carved alabaster archway leads into a small sanctuary at the garden's edge.

title: [The Garden, Sanctum of Thorns]
description: Brambles of vivid green paint stretch and coil along the walls of the small sanctuary, unfurling from a slender man limned in pale pigments.  The silk-swathed figure stands possessively behind an ornate altar of carved ivory fashioned in the shapes of acrobatic bodies wreathed in garlands of rose and sweetbriar.  Rose and mournbloom incense intertwine in a dreamy haze, perfuming the air, which is occasionally punctuated by screams from the garden outside a carved alabaster archway.

title: [Temple of Screams, Night's Door]
description: Banners of stygian velvet trimmed with golden brocade are emblazoned with prowling jackals.  They twist in a cold breeze with no apparent source that gusts through the hallway in frigid surges.  Standing solitary atop a low circular platform at the chamber's center is a pair of doors hewn from black stone that reflects no light.  Shards of amber dreamstone gleam from the frame as if lit from within.

title: [Temple of Screams, Nightmares]
description: The walls of the hallway are a lightless black, matte in a way that reflects no ambient radiance.  Despite their tenebrous shade, hints of color swirl through the darkness, taking on strange forms.  The images stretch along the walkway, creeping toward faltering radiance in the west, where stairs of gold-shot marble ascend to a semicircular dais.

title: [Temple of Screams, Shadow Altar]
description: Eyes of amber glint sharply from the mask of an ebony jackal statue, the shadow of which looms over an altar of obsidian.  The stone is roughly hewn and twisted, but it supports a chunk of pure dreamstone shaped into a crude orb.  Torches flicker in sconces along the walls, throwing back the darkness, but casting long and sinister shadows.

title: [The Deep Shrine, Delve]
description: Crude friezes are painted along the walls of dark blue stone.  Under the feeble light of nautical lanterns hung from the ceiling by swaying chains, the paintings fluoresce an unsettling, vivid indigo, revealing the writhing bodies of countless eels.  Underfoot, the floor is transparent, offering glimpses of darting fish as they glint and gleam in the uncertain light.  Stairs of silver-shot marble descend into the depths below.

title: [The Deep Shrine, Altar]
description: Silver-shot indigo steps descend to a dome-shaped chamber lit only by nautical lanterns.  Their briny smell suggests that their feeble flames are fed by whale oil.  Walls of thick glass hold back the press of dark water in every direction, the lanterns' light offering only the faintest glimpses of black shapes swimming and squirming through the water.  At the center of the chamber sits an altar cut from a single great chunk of seaglass.  Over it looms a statue of an eel devouring its own tail.

title: [Temple of Flesh, Nave]
description: Lurid tapestries of scarlet and milky green silk flutter overhead, making the humanoid forms they depict undulate and writhe.  Cushions in the same colors are strewn in uneven rows across the smooth marble floor, proceeding toward northbound steps clad in runners of sumptuous velvet.  In jade-framed niches along the walls, friezes depict bodies embracing and clambering atop one another while an exquisite woman shrouded in green smoke looks on.

title: [Temple of Flesh, Altar]
description: Vibrant friezes beckon in jeweled tones from the domed ceiling and jade-framed walls of the sanctuary.  At its center, steps radiate downward from a circular altar of red and green jade with supports carved in the shapes of feminine figures.   Censers hang from the ceiling on spiraling chains of bronze, swaying as they release sweetly scented smoke in lazy, cloying clouds.

title: [The Hunter's Close, Menagerie]
description: Sandstone pillars stretching from floor to ceiling take the shapes of leaping cats, their agile forms carved in motion.  They support a multifaceted crystal dome that spills sunlight into the chamber.  The brilliant illumination cascades down the powerfully muscled back of a slumbering lion facing the entryway.  The beast looks as if it might rock with an intake of breath at any instant, but it is merely a statue, similar in make to the felines of ebony and bloodwood set into niches along the walls.

title: [The Hunter's Close, Offerings]
description: Reliefs spread along the walls of the chamber, depicting felines lazing, hunting, and at play.  Their ancient pigments have been faded by the grinding passage of time, but the carvings themselves have been well preserved.  A mosaic depicting interlocking felines, one ebon and one crimson, spreads from the base of a low sandstone pedestal.  Atop it stands a wide brass bowl caked in dried blood.

title: [The Hunter's Close, Altar]
description: Glinting shards of sunlight fall onto the sandstone slab floor of the chamber, revealing faint carvings in the stone shaped like paw prints.  They wind between the forms of cats carved from bloodwood and ebony that range in size from the meanest housecat to powerful lions.  All look toward a broad altar ablaze with beeswax candles, their honeyed scent mingling with cinnamon and sandalwood incense.  The wall behind the altar is limned with the image of a man with a cruel smile and lambent golden eyes.

title: [The Fane of Steel, Narthex]
description: Far above, a ceiling of stained glass looms, painting the sunlight in fiery colors as it filters through to fall in sharp-edged shards to the charcoal grey marble floor of the narthex.  Sumptuous curtains of flame-hued velvet frame the walls, save for the northernmost, which boasts a hammered steel arch leading to a grand staircase.  Before it stands a massive throne of steel graced with a froth of gilt and inlaid rubies, empty but for a dark metal crown worked to resemble tongues of leaping flame.

title: [The Fane of Steel, Grand Stair]
description: Roaring flames of gilt frame the steel of a hammered arch leading to the temple's narthex.  Mirroring stairways of grey marble lushly clad in runners of flame-hued velvet curve away from one another as they ascend to the upper reaches of the fane.  Along the southern wall, an elaborate mural depicts a preternaturally beautiful woman with dark skin and sharp grey eyes standing beneath the wings of an immense draconic figure.

title: [The Fane of Steel, Gallery]
description: A long hallway proceeds from a pair of spiraling staircases toward steps leading to a raised dais in the north.  Luxuriant curtains of flame-hued velvet soften the severity of the gallery's high marble walls, which display priceless paintings framed in gilded steel.  Sunlight is transfigured into fireglow by the brightly colored shards of the stained glass ceiling, which continues out over the narthex far below.  The masterwork depicts a sinuous black draconic figure breathing a wall of raging fire.

title: [The Fane of Steel, Altar]
