description: The outline of a crown in steel and gilt has been inlaid into the marble of the far wall, where it glints menacingly in the radiance pouring through the stained glass ceiling.  Torrents of flame blaze from three great stone hearths set into the walls, their infernal breath filling the air with oppressive, stinging heat.  Atop an altar of grey steel etched with golden tongues of fire, a charcoal grey prayerbook lies open, its pages edged in brilliant gilt.

title: [The Crimson Ziggurat, Fountain]
description: Framed by arched walls filled with friezes depicting sacrificial rites and scenes of carnage, the stretch of hallway is broken by a black stone fountain atop a series of circular steps.  The spigot, fashioned of mauve eahnor in the shape of a two-headed serpent, spits a constant flow of thick carmine fluid into the bowl below.  Candlelight, stained startling crimson, flickers through a black bloodwood door in the northern wall.

title: [The Crimson Ziggurat, Stone]
description: Gutters and channels in the floor form a gruesome arcane pattern.  They radiate outward from a flat black stone that is several feet high and roughly the length of a tall humanoid.  Overhead, the zealous countenance of a faintly scaled elf stares down, his crimson eyes burning with merciless fascination.  Red and violet asps intertwine along the borders of the ceiling painting.

title: [The Crimson Ziggurat, Altar]
description: A two-headed serpent of violet and scarlet stone strains across the walls of the sanctum, a blood-drenched figure with scales on his face caught amidst its powerful coils.  Before him stands an altar carved from a single piece of bloodstone.  Fountains to either side spray blood into basins of marble, the crimson flow stark against the pale stone.  Candles burning in huddled groups around the chamber's perimeter light the room, but cannot excise the scent of copper from the air.

title: [The Slayer's Den, Approach]
description: Mirroring mosaics flank the hallway, the eastern one, which depicts a cracked white skull on a field of black, giving way to an arch leading into a shadowed chamber.  Its mate portrays a hand wielding a glinting steel dagger and is made from glass tesserae dyed in a variety of hues.  Runners of black wool with an ivory fringe proceed north toward an altar.

title: [The Slayer's Den, Contract Hall]
description: A hawk of ebony is perched atop a stand of the same material, its talons clutching the upper roll of a scroll scrawled with a list of names.  Other such scrolls are furled and sealed with wax, housed in niches honeycombing the walls.  The low ceiling is inlaid with a skull made from polished ivory, pristine save for a crack digging into its left temple.

title: [The Slayer's Den, Dark Sanctum]
description: A fresco stretches across the northern wall of the temple's sanctuary.  Staring gravely down upon a raised dais occupied by a bone-inlaid ebony altar, a smallish man with emotionless blue eyes and an agile build is framed by a field of shadows.  The legs of the altar sprout from a pile of skulls heaped at its base.  The bones are of a wide variety of sizes and shapes, unalike but united in death.

title: [Shadowsilk Passage, Dark Path]
description: Whorling nets of shadowed silk funnel down into fathomless crevices and crannies in the wall of the cave, while others hang from the ceiling like tattered parodies of curtains.  Green-tinged luminescence burning in the hearts of the sticky strands serves as an uncertain and treacherous cynosure through the stygian passage.  Toward the end, the spidersilk grows dense and more radiant before culminating in a wall of webs.

title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Widow's Trap]
description: Swarms of tiny spiders with glistening incarnadine bodies scurry through the phosphorescent darkness.  The crude oil smell of thousands upon thousands of tiny spiders threads through the air, muting other scents just as the thick and faintly glowing webbing dangling from the ceiling muffles sounds.

title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Webwall]
description: A dense wall of inky webs occludes a sprawling mural limned across the face of the southwestern wall, but glints of sanguine enamel wink through like rubies.  Coruscating in the light of a dancing torch, the black bodies of multitudinous spiders skitter along the webs, engaged in tireless industry.  The sconce holding the torch is wrought of black alum and studded with red cabochon gems.

title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Sacrifice]
description: Driven by torchlight from the southeast, shadows race over the huge back of a black stone spider statue rearing back to strike.  They linger on a huge red crystal hourglass breaching the smooth plane of the stone creature's back.  The statue's shadow looms over the sullen glow of rubies inlaid into a dais of black ora.

title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Venom]
description: Torchlight flickers to the southwest, but the span of the eastern chamber labors under the heavy press of shadow.  Rearing up out of a nest of blackness darker than pitch, an immense spider statue hewn from oily black stone dominates the eastern quadrant of the shrine.  Its carapace is swollen and huge, and a pair of serrated razern fangs curve down from its jaw, each tinged a darker hue by bile-green fluid staining its surface.

title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Alcove]
description: Luminous garnets studding the face of the northern wall limn the uneven stones of the walkway a dark carmine hue.  They cluster most tightly about the bulk of an oily black alcove enameled with crisscrossing webs, casting their inner fire over the pages of a slender black tome atop a silver pedestal.  Tattered cobwebs drip down from the ceiling in glittering curtains, forming jagged patterns at the corners of of the shrine.

title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Supplication]
description: A mammoth statue reigns over a raised metal dais rimmed with uncut rubies and garnets, representing a hideous fusion of woman and spider.  Tiny strands of spidersilk sway around her form, each thread lit from within by ghost-pale green phosphorescence.

title: [The Fang, Overlook]
description: Two immense fangs of stone bear down upon a wide aperture in the southern wall, permitting a dizzying view of the land below, from the green-tufted tops of weeping willows and cypresses to the bustling streets of the village beyond.  Only the spire at the center of town stands taller.  Despite the wind swirling through the opening, the air holds intense, prickling heat, its obvious source the emerald firelight crackling from archways to the northwest and northeast.

title: [The Fang, Altar of Souls]
description: Hungry fires burn green in alcoves along the walls, making the air behind a stygian stone altar warp and shimmer with their infernal heat.  Their radiance dances off of the facets of viridian soulstone shards set into the black walls in an undulating pattern.  It bathes the curves of the altar, which is carved into the shape of a large, coiled snake.  The western wall yields to a huge circular window made up of crystal panes.  Cruel daylight streams through the glass, casting long, dark shadows through the chamber.

title: [The Fang, Altar of Truths]
description: Intense flames roar from alcoves along the walls, their dancing radiance scattering off of viridian soulstone shards that weave along the walls like a sidewinder's path.  Standing before the inferno is a pure white altar of stone that takes the form of a scaled man with no mouth.  Along the eastern wall, a circular glass window allows daylight to join with the fiery radiance, and the altar shines almost blindingly with the reflected glow.

title: [The Archive, Bibliotheca]
description: Ancient petrified oak bookshelves proceed into the distance in every direction, neatly stacked with countless books.  The acrid scent of preservatives mingles with the dusty tang of old parchment in the dry, cool air.  Gold-trimmed charcoal grey carpeting runs down a wide central aisle toward a raised desk topped by a curve of marble.  Atop it are stacks of recently returned tomes and a huge ledger holding enough yellowed pages to be an epic in its own right.

title: [The Archive, Dais]
description: Silver leaf and gilt illuminate artwork on the wall above a raised dais mounted by a set of steps.  The figure, a man with an unkempt beard in rough homespun robes, is bent with the weight of age and knowledge.  His aged eyes balefully look down upon a carved stone altar draped in offerings of lavender, bay laurel, and Vornavian hemlock.  Atop the altar stands a slender grey obelisk, simple in form but intricate in craftsmanship.

title: [The Archive, Reserve Collection]
description: A quiet chamber is separated from the rest of the library by a fireleaf arch carved to resemble leaping flames.  At the zenith of the woodwork is a slit-pupiled eye.  Glass cases framed in veil iron dot the perimeter of the richly appointed recess, each containing a book on a bed of dusky golden velvet.  One pale book is bound in kroderine chains, while a black tome nearby has wards drawn in chalk beneath it.

title: [Forsaken Manse, Yard]
description: Black trees snatch at the cold sky along the wall of the small estate.  Dead or dying, the plants of the yard are mostly buried by snowfall, though the space before a small shrine in the shadow of the trees is mostly clear.  The manse has fallen into disrepair and not a hint of light beckons from cracked windows hidden behind heavy boards meant to keep out intruders.  Along its facade, a trio of slashes are gouged out of the masonry as if an animal's claws have sliced through the stone.

title: [Summoning Chamber]
description: Pale green liquid pulses as it flows over the walls in thick rivulets, to collect in a central pool recessed in the stone floor of the chamber.  Steam rises up from the glowing ooze as it ripples and swells, seemingly by its own accord.  A verdant haze shifts and moves through the air, adding to the iridescence.

title: [Pathway, Recent Work]
description: An assortment of smoothed cobblestone within this area are moist and soft to the touch, with a heavy varnish of brown-red moss covering every surface.  Lofty trees running parallel to the road molder beneath their mossy garb, having no leaves visible and not a breath of wind to stir them.

title: [Pathway, Ups and Downs]
description: The neighboring environment has a sophisticated appearance as the ground lacks the slightest evidence of dust upon its polished surface.  Waist-height walls to each side of the path have a rigorous, yet almost jagged, appearance.  Peculiar looking trees seem to spike out of the ground in geometric forms, suggesting that they have grown beyond their natural pattern.

title: [Pathway, Small Clearing]
description: While the area directly around the road itself is cleared, large areas of the foliage become progressively dense the further away from the path one would dare to travel.  The tree branches spreading overheard appear to link seamlessly together, blocking any hint of light from above.  The effect makes the immediate area a patchwork of soft light and deep shadow, while in the distance, the shapes of what appear to be large rectangular boulders lie at the edge of your vision.

title: [Pathway, Benches]
description: Large rectangular boulders have been placed along the roadside to provide a temporary sanctuary for weary travelers.  The adjacent trees have thinned just enough to allow spectators to view the sky, but even more evident is the thickness of the forest, not so far away.  Far from the bothersome traffic, this respite could even serve well as a camp for a large caravan.

title: [Pathway, Vine-Covered Boles]
description: The curves of the road mimic the thick vines which curl through the brush and around the dense and tall trees.  Each tendril forms an intricate design against the host trunk as it trails down to the ground, abruptly ending where the foliage has been fastidiously cut back by unseen caretakers.

title: [Pathway, The Fork]
description: To the north the road divides around a large tree which has been spared, one lane passing on either side of the massive trunk of this aged forest denizen.  Despite the scattered dry leaves resting on the table and bench, the area beneath its branches appears to offer a neatly manicured shelter, creating a peaceful place to stop for a picnic or merely to rest weary feet.

title: [Pathway, Around the Trunk]
description: Sturdy branches of the big tree to the east overhang the road, and under their shade the road is more moss than cobblestone, hushing each footfall.  The quiet of the scene is a peaceful change from ringing hoofbeats and rattling wagons on the rest of the road.

title: [Pathway, The Fork]
description: To the south, the cobbled way splits to avoid a large tree, the forks of the road diverging to circle the ground beneath its wide-spreading limbs.  The boughs of the tree almost appear to unfold and direct travelers approaching from the northwest to either side of its trunk.

title: [Pathway, Flowered Beds]
description: A straight stretch of the road runs through carefully groomed surroundings.  Widely spaced trees line the thoroughfare, their branches forming immense and leafy arches overhead.  Along the road, pale pastel flowers offer a splash of light color to those passing through the shadows of the trees.

title: [Pathway, Cobbled Walk]
description: Intricately pieced cobblestones form a pathway here, which have a smooth and slickly cleaned surface.  Thick, carefully trimmed grass lines the border of the stones, pushing right up to the edge of the tall forest trees, which lean intermittently overhead.

title: [Pathway, Arboreal Gateway]
description: Imposingly tall and ancient trees appear in the distance on either side of the road.  Nearby, in place of what used to grow wild and free, intertwined saplings and decorative shrubs have been planted into a more formal arrangement.  Beyond the reach of this gardened area, a border of stone keeps the hindrances of the encroaching wilderness at bay.

title: [Pathway, Patterned Walk]
description: As the meandering road continues, the stones themselves begin to form a pattern.  A multitude of tiny dark and light stones have been placed to fashion a slightly inset, maze-like design centered in the carefully paved road.  The design is map like, but seems to have no definite beginning or end.

title: [Pathway, The Clearing]
description: A large black marble edifice stands in the clearing, nestled snuggly at the base of the nearby mountains.  Veins of silver and gold intertwine uninterrupted along the stonework, and closer inspection reveals nary a visible seam anywhere along the outer wall.  At first glance the building would appear to be formed from a single, solid piece of rock.  Set into the smooth marble wall is a platinum-banded ironwood door.

title: [Pathway, Around the Trunk]
description: The roadway bends around the eastward side of the tree in a wide circle.  Within the arc, the tops of gnarled roots break the surface here and there, and the builders of the road have taken pains to avoid disturbing them with the paving stones.

title: [Droughtman's Maze, Opal Lounge]
description: The lighting here is dim, but not enough to obscure the opalescent wallpaper.  Couches and upholstered chairs in every shade of the rainbow are scattered around the room in groups, surrounding tables set with food.  A long mahogany bar occupies one wall, which is hung with a mirror that only magnifies the maelstrom of color in the room.  One has to wonder if the decor is an attempt at opulence, or if it is intended to induce patrons to drink more, just to blunt their senses.

title: [Maze, Observation Deck]
description: Light seems to follow you as you move about, allowing you to see what is directly in front of you, but very little of what lies beyond.  A slight odor of peaches is prevalent throughout the hallway.

title: [Maze, The Diamond Room]
description: White marble walls speckled with tiny diamonds enclose a formidable sitting room.  Hanging from the ceiling, a large crystal chandelier bears an array of lit candles, giving off a glorious light reflected through the crystals.  Nestled against the far wall is a plump white sofa, offering comfortable seating to WATCH the ongoing show through the large window on the opposite wall.

title: [Slave Pen]
description: Low-ceilinged and shallow, this room is lighted only by the modest rays of moonlight permitted by the small porthole.  Iron manacles, flecked with rust and what might be dried blood, are attached to a bolt on the inner bulkhead.

title: [Slave Pen]

title: [Scrip Shop, Upstairs]
description: The tall metal-framed windows enclosing the room have been boarded shut, the iron nails sticking out in irregular angles to create makeshift hooks.  Heavy, hole-ridden sheets of green velvet loosely cover a series of pristine wooden crates, the fabric pooling across the knitted rugs covering the dusty planks.  A pair of driftwood-carved sculptures flank a gilt-painted curio in the far corner, the open doors draped in a fine layer of brittle cobwebs.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Evergreen Walk]
description: Old pines tower to either side of the flagstone walk beyond a pale holly gate, the trees sheltering banks of driven snow beneath their verdant boughs.  Garlands festoon the branches of the evergreens, woven together from beautiful flowers foreign to such an unforgiving clime.  A manse with a gabled roof rules over the expansive estate, and welcoming candlelight flickers in its mullioned windows.  The front doors are of burled pine and are carved with prancing mules in relief.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Foyer]
description: A crystal chandelier hangs over the foyer of the manse, casting shards of light over a silver seal set into the pale marble floor.  The leaping mule etched into the metal is repeated in relief on the front doors, which are framed with windows that look out onto a snowy walk.  Opposite the entry, a grand staircase with banisters twined in fir garlands sweeps up to the second story.  Hallways branch to the west and east, proceeding beneath trefoil arches accented with ornately carved maplewood.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Upper Hall]
description: A dark pine staircase spirals up toward the upper story of the manse, its banisters twined with fir garlands that perfume the air.  A long runner patterned with prancing mules in blue and white proceeds down the main hall of the manse's upper story, which branches off into lesser hallways leading to family and servant quarters.  The bordering railing offers a view of a spectacular chandelier fashioned in the shapes of hundreds of icicles, glittering and glowing with the light of dozens of votive candles.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Parlor]
description: Flames roar and pine wood gives a merry crackle from within a stone-framed hearth yawning out of the northern wall.  Comfortable couches of supple stouthorn rolton leather are positioned to take fullest advantage of the proffered heat.  A marqueted credenza positioned between two pairs of mullioned windows overlooking the yard profers holds bottles of spirits offer warmth of a different variety.  Smells of roasting meat and baking tarts waft gently from a trefoil arch in the eastern wall.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Dining Room]
description: Mullioned windows with cerulean velvet curtains allow moonlight into the chamber, the centerpiece of which is a rough-hewn table of honey oak ringed by chairs.  The opposing wall is given over to a long aspen bookshelf holding countless tomes, its glass doors criss-crossed by wrought iron bars brushed with silver.  Patterns of gold leaf frame the coffered ceiling, highlighting a painting of battle in the streets of a port town.  A trefoil arch opens onto a parlor, while a smaller pine door leads to the kitchens.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Kitchen]
description: The kitchen's windows are open to allow the cold air in, leavening the heat washing from brick ovens along the walls.  One holds a great boar roasting on a spit, while another heats a cauldron of spicy stew, and a third is occupied by racks of baking tarts.  On a spruce trestle table, more pastries are laid out in various stages of assembly.  Bowls of spices, from salt to paprika, occupy marble countertops along the walls.  Nearly concealed by some hogsheads of mead, a trapdoor descends into the cellar.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Cellar]
description: Racks along the rough stone walls hold great barrels of wine, ale, and mead, leaving space in the center of spacious cellar for sacks of barley, hanging carcasses that have been salted to preserve them, and stacked wheels of stoutfoot blue cheese.  Despite the efforts of a lone torch ensconced on the northern wall, the cellar is bitterly cold.  Frost glints from the walls and ceiling.  A short ladder allows egress through a riveted pine trapdoor above.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Sunroom]
description: Glass-paned double doors on the eastern wall look out the silhouetted apple trees of an orched dotted with drifts of snow.  High windows frame the chamber, allowing moonlight to stream in from a variety of angles.  It spills gently over snowflake-patterned grey divan that are draped with knit fraelhan blankets in a variety of autumnal hues.  A thick fringed rug patterned with colorful leaves softens the marble floor.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Orchard]
description: Some glass-paned double doors along the side of the manse open out of a cozy sunroom lined with tall glass windows.  Neat rows of fruit trees frame a path leading away from the doors through a small orchard, mostly consisting of wintercrisp apples, but with a few hardy varieties of plum and cherry mixed in.  The air is crisp and clean and the walls of the estate muffle most of the noise from the abounding town.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Upper Hall]
description: A nook at the end of the hallway is home to a verdigris bronze statuette that depicts a ragged halfling man leaping at a heavily muscled krolvin, dagger flashing.  Several beeswax candles burn in bronze holders around it, brightening the dark corner.  A runner patterned with prancing mules in blue and white adorns the cedar planks of the floor, gliding toward a knotted pine door.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Upper Hall]
description: Family portraits, some badly damaged by the elements and age but nonetheless lovingly framed, hang over the stretch of hallway.  Doors leading off to guest suites come in a variety of woods, and each is incised with the stylized silhouettes of local fauna, from wolves to penguins.  Sweet beeswax candles in sconces along the walls light the way in the absence of windows.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Upper Hall]
description: The upper hallway comes to an end near a pair of black walnut double doors, which are framed in an elaborate arch featuring inlaid chunks of holly, oak, and alder that from a gently undulating pattern.  Beeswax candles ensconced to either side illuminate the rich grain of the wood.  Before the entrance, an ancient Mhoragian rug depicts a cavalry charge.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Orchard]
description: On a lazy rise at the northwestern edge of the estate, a steel-framed glass greenhouse stands amid the rows of snow-dusted fruit trees.  Outside stands a wheelbarrow full of fresh soil and several sacks of compost.  The orchard proceeds almost up to the wall of the state, over which the slate-tiled roof of Clovertooth Hall can be seen.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Greenhouse]
description: The warm air of the greenhouse is sweetened by perfume from exotic plants blossoming throughout the large enclosure.  Smaller flower pots hang in tiered displays from the ceiling, while larger ones form sinuous aisles on the stone floor.  Most of the flowers growing are not native to the region, the bright petals of dragonstalks and honeysuckles suggesting origins rooted in warmer climes.  A wrought iron bench offers a place to rest and observe the verdant beauty.

title: [Witch's Cottage]
description: Wispy tendrils of fragrant smoke unfurl from sticks of incense on a stand beside a feather bed.  Sturdy chairs, hand-carved in botanical themes, surround an aged oak table centered in the humble abode.  Perched atop the table rests an assortment of glass-paned lanterns, some cradling flitting will-o-wisps within their clear embrace, others with tiny doors ajar, awaiting new inhabitants to brighten the home.  In contrast to a tall witchwood door at the front entry, a tiny exit, looking suspiciously like a mousehole, leads out the back.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: Hacked and burned, the northern buttress roots of a large ceiba are cleaved close to its trunk, while southern ones have arcs carved into them provide egress into the swampier parts of Bittermere Woods.  Departing from the tumbled cobblestones of an ancient pathway that is partially claimed by the forest, a moss-covered stepping stone walkway disappears into the northern expanse.  Suspended in the dark canopy, heavy black iron cages sway as avians land upon them, causing shackles bound to skeletal feet to clang against their undersides.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: Heavily corded vines drape across the buttress roots that rise along the eastern edges, separating the dark swamp from the remains of a road overtaken by nature.  Glints of metal within the vines hint at something hidden in their depth.  Scattered cobblestones resemble pearly white islands within a sea of mist that clings to the ground, obscuring hazards and wonders alike.  Faint, yet rhythmic, the sound of metal striking metal rings through the air.

title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: Pale, silvery light spills across a twining path that follows the meandering curves of buttress roots whose ribbon-like structures form a wall along the eastern edges of Bittermere Woods.  Chill air invades the swampy space as the ground transition from mud and dirt to a faint cobbled road with stones that are cast about like a child's toys by the pervasive growth of bramble and vine.  Spider tendrils, feelers for nearby vines, clog the walk, avoiding a wide wooden gate leading into the northwestern woods.

title: [Quinton Manse, Garden Fountain]
description: Surrounded in the serrated, black-purple leaves of towering beech hedges, the small garden is quiet and serene.  Flowerbeds of echinacea and zinnia rest at the edges of angular flagstones that are overgrown with leafy pimpernel.  A decorative marble fountain with a wide ledge sits at the heart of the space, its waters cascading over a copper mandrake statue.

title: [Gavelsdown Hall, Parlor North]
description: Twilight hues spill through the open windows, giving the dimly lit room a bruised appearance that is a vivid contrast to the plush carpeting and gold fixtures.  High-backed leather armchairs are arranged in social circles throughout the space, while an elaborately carved cabinet occupies a space along the back wall.  The thick scent of cherry tobacco fills the air.

title: [Twisted Lodge, Windy Atrium]
description: The warped stone walls of this atrium are layered with numerous shields, carved and chased with whorled grooves in equally varied patterns.  Broken furniture throughout the room constantly slides and flips around, making it difficult to navigate north, toward a hall of flames and ash.

title: [Stable Interior]
description: Creeping shadows smother the glow of iron lanterns chained to the central ceiling beam, the faint illumination skimming the dust settled over every surface.  A tamped earth floor, scattered with moldy hay, splits the two rows of decaying stalls and leads to the back door.  Only remnants of metal bars remain on the stall doors, leaving jagged teeth to frame the windows, blazing orange with the consuming rust.

title: [Pasture]
description: Gentle hills roll beneath the auroral sky, the dusty earth mottled with sparse, yellowed grasses and the occasional sanguine flower patch.  A meandering muck-blocked streambed separates the fence-divided pastures from an imposing, fog-shrouded forest looming to the west.  Its open, white-framed doors slightly askew, a dark red stable stands at one corner, an empty rusty steel trough set along one of the warped and peeling walls.

title: [Twisted Lodge, Burning Hall]
description: The scorched stone walls of this hall are layered with numerous shields, carved and chased with grooves in equally varied patterns.  Ethereal flames lick at the remnants of two tapestries that flank a twisted crimson ora podium facing toward the scorched remains of wooden pews that now litter the floor amid piles of blackened bone and grey ash.

title: [Twisted Lodge, Frozen Chamber]
description: The rimy stone walls of this chamber are layered with numerous shields, carved and chased with grooves in equally varied patterns.  Frost covers a cracked wooden floor, and icicles precariously jut from an arched stone ceiling as minuscule, glimmering snowflakes constantly form and diffuse in the blink of an eye.  A fog-shrouded gash is all that remains of a door and some steps that lead south and upward.

title: [Tanglemist Path]
description: A tangle of trees rises high overhead, ghostbells blooming amidst springy moss at their trunks.  The path narrows to the southwest, the forest closing in and casting dark shadows that obscure what lies beyond.

title: [Tanglemist Path, Glade]
description: Thick woods open into a small glade of moss, grass, and wildflowers.  A well-worn path curves to the west, while a smaller, winding trail leads deeper into the trees.

title: [Thistlegear, Blackthorn Hedge]
description: A tall blackthorn hedge keeps the Tanglemist Woods at bay, and a trio of small homes nestles beneath it, each with neatly rowed gardens.  Curving east and south, a small road is lined with more gardens, a scattering of buildings, and tiny aragless spheres strung between cherrywood poles.

title: [Thistlegear, Western Edge]
description: Cozy homes connected by tiny paths and rustic gardens fill the area, a small road wending its way past them all.  Tiny aragless spheres strung between cherrywood poles refract ambient light, and neatly trimmed hedges block the woods from encroaching into the enclave.  To the southeast, farms and fields are visible.

title: [Thistlegear Enclave, Farming]
description: Farm houses, stables, and small silos stand along the southern road of the enclave, and past them are fields of crops, vegetable gardens, and grazing pastures.  Far in the distance, hedges frame the farmland, continuing the enclave's protection against the woods and all it contains.

title: [Thistlegear Enclave, Gate]
description: The woods crush up against towering blackthorn and rowan hedges, and tendrils of vines reach for a rowan and brass clockwork gate.  A narrow, winding road can be seen beyond the gate, and within the enclave, an expanse of farmland fills the southern area.

title: [Thistlegear Enclave, Stream]
description: A small stream meanders its way through the protective hedges to the east, traveling from the woods and into the enclave where it lazily twists and turns between houses for several hundred yards before winding back through the hedges and out of sight.  To the west, thickets of shrubs interspersed with cherry trees are set behind more cottages and homes, providing a wall of privacy between them and the central hub of the enclave beyond, and aragless spheres strung on cherrywood poles line the road.

title: [Thistlegear Enclave, Gardens]
description: Sprinkled between flora-filled gardens, riverstone shops and homes fill the northeastern quadrant of the enclave.  Tall hedges in a variety of verdant hues blockade the dark woods looming ever-present to the north and east.

title: [Thistlegear Enclave, Heart]
description: Numerous tiny shops cluster around the small cobblestone roads that meet at a grassy sward.  Festooned with copper gear-linked ribbons, cherry trees arch over a stone well, and a small gazebo nestles amidst rosebushes.  Just off the grassy expanse is a stone-paved plaza with booths, carts, and kiosks surrounding a clockwork fountain.

title: [Thistlegear Enclave, Town Hall]
description: The small road terminates here in a circle of cobblestones fronting a two-story riverstone building.  Hedges of blackthorn, yew, and holly loom on three sides, effectively cutting this small cul-de-sac off from the rest of the enclave unless approaching by the road.  Set between clever statuary comprised of stone and gears, cheerful flowerbeds add splashes of color against the vibrant greens of the hedges.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Road]
description: Spindly, skeletal-like trees dip down across the narrow dirt road, the winding pathway seemingly swallowed by the dense, dark-shadowed woods leading deeper into the grounds.  A loose scattering of gravel lays before a brass clockwork gate, the spear-shaped finials engulfed by thorny briars contorted across the entry.  Small stacks of stone line the dried grass along the path, each one stained a rust hue.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Road]
description: Gnarled arboreal forms weep dark reddish purple leaves across the dirt path, the finger-like branches reaching out across the narrowing road as the foliage thickens.  Sinuous vines weave through the sparse vegetation of the patch of woods, ensnaring themselves along the iron and vaalin gate, the long spires hung with hand-carved totems.  An imposing stone mansion is visible through the melange of briars, the angled gables shadowing the gardens below.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Grounds]
description: The silhouette of an imposing, stone-built mansion rises above an overgrown garden covering the expansive lawn, the wide pathway framed by distorted topiaries looming over the shattered cobblestones.  A broken marble-crafted fountain stands at the center of the walkway, the cracked basin covered in a curtain of blackened moss.  Gnarled vines engulf the imposing iron and vaalin gate, the spear-tipped finials impaling the decaying sanguine roses ensnaring the framework, leaving the twisted metal stained in dull red.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Grounds]
description: An uneven pergola of scorched wood lays bare across the patches of dead grass, the half-collapsed structure leaning away from the direction of the stone-crafted mansion.  Brittle strands of webbing drape across a small grove encircling the perimeter of the grounds, the silken veils billowing with the ambient breeze, the leafless twigs piercing through withered insect carcasses.  Chipped marble statues flank the pathway leading north, the expressionless faces marred by vein-like cracks across their lips.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Aviary]
description: Dozens of iron-bound birdcages creak loudly upon the rusted poles scattered throughout the garden, the warped doors barely clinging to the latches.  A haphazard labryinth of dark-colored grasses leads up to the beast-carved door, the entry flanked by a duo of moss-draped gargoyles looming from tall pillars.  Set at the far corner of the grounds is a solitary marble statue, the androgynous form standing before discarded piles of dirt-caked feathers and shredded ribbons of embroidered silk.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Gardens]
description: Overgrown maple trees obscure the periphery of the grounds, their long finger-like branches bleeding purplish red leaves across the rust red-stained cobblestones set along the uneven path.  An imposing outline of the mansion casts sinuous shadows across the patches of dried grass, the clumps of detritus encircling the small mounds of dirt scattered across the lawn.  Thorn-riddled vines consume the iron-framed garden beds scattered through the area, the metal frames bent into contorted shapes.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Foyer]
description: A branch-pierced dome of murky glass shadows the fur and dust-covered floor of the spacious foyer, the ceiling's design obscured by caked leaves, the contorted wires framing the split staircase leading up into the mansion.  Broken ivory busts are set on rotting mahogany pedestals, the artwork displayed along the walls that open to the hallway, the elongated passageway bisecting the stairs above.  Set into the marble are scraps of twisted metal, the pieces extending out towards the various pathways.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Hallway]
description: A dull carpet of frayed wool and silk covers the expanse of the open hallway, the cobweb-ridden walls interspersed with cloth-covered portraits and unlit brass sconces.  Set against the periphery are narrow wooden tables cluttered with piles of paper and knickknacks coated in mottled layers of dirt, the surfaces placed between the arch and door at the end of the elongated room.  Draped along walls are heavy velvet curtains, the silken ropes left in tangles slithering across the floor.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Workroom]
description: Half-finished automatons frame the dusty corners of the workshop, their hulking frames suspended by thick, twisted lengths of rope.  Scrawled notes engulf the parchments covering the brocaded walls, the scrolls unfurling down onto the tool-filled workbench, the clutter threatening to tip over the glass lanterns nestled near the edge.  Hooked curtains of oil-stained cloth obscures the stairway, the length bound by iron chains, the same metal forged into a short gate leading towards the twisting hallway.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Dungeons]
description: The hallway leads to a series of iron-blocked cells, the scent of moss and wet hay permeating the crumbling stones enclosing the dungeon.  Several thick-barred doors hang broken from their hinges, the entryways scattered with small, dull yellow bones left broken across the empty cells.  The sound of dripping echoes across the dank walls, interspersed by the skittering of claws across the ground.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Library]
description: Dust-caked bookcases span from floor-to-ceiling, the various levels cluttered with broken ladders scattered along the expansive room.  A sheet-covered chandelier hangs three stories above the dirt-covered parquetry, the cobweb-draped spectre hanging precariously from thick, rusted chains creaking with the ambient breeze seeping through the cracked dome ceiling.  Haphazardly strewn about are several tables and velvet-padded chairs, the furniture partially buried beneath decayed foliage and torn curtains.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Kitchen]
description: Blackened iron pans hang above the well-aged copper stove, the wall-length counter flanked by wooden racks of glass jars and garlands of dried herbs knotted in dark twine.  A pair of suede-cushioned stools sit on either side of the hallway, each one framed by small stacks of books and baskets filled with silken ribbons.  Thin, dust-coated webs hang from one corner of the ceilng to the next, the brittle lacework curtaining the sheets of parchment tacked onto the side walls.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Upstairs]
description: Tall, mold-riddled columns encircle the vast second floor, the mahogany pillars separating the numerous hallways and doors radiating from the cloth-covered object at the center of the carpeted floor. Oilcloth covers the rectangular frames affixed to the peeling walls, the pieces covered in overgrown weeds. A detritus-scattered pile of metal is nestled along a far corner, propped against a broken bench beside the iron-railed staircase.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Study]
description: A leaf and dirt-caked fireplace serves as a focal point of the expansive study, the muck-stained stones framed by twin mahogany bookcases littered with discarded garbage.  A pile of armchairs lays scattered between scattered books and wooden planks tossed between the cushions, the torn pages strewn across the floor.  The far corner is piled high with discarded knickknacks and containers, the contents obscured by a sheet of mud-stained oilcloth.

title: [The Old Ossuary, Boneyard]
description: Piles of bones, some bleached to whiteness and others still with shreds of flesh clinging to them, are scattered around this yard in orderly clumps.  A rough pathway has been organized through the scattered debris to a clearing in the middle of the chaos that holds a short bloodstained table and an overturned mammoth skull with massive yellowed tusks.  A pile of skulls has been assembled into a makeshift crypt, the entrance flanked by blue-flamed torches.

title: [The Old Ossuary, Crypt]
description: Despite being made of interlinked bones, this crypt seems fairly sturdy.  Flickering blue flame illuminates the space from lit candles sitting inside several of the skulls set into the crooked walls, the eerie light making it seem like the skull's eyes are glowing.  The floor, unlike the rest of the structure, is made of packed dirt.

title: [Sounds Beyond, Display]
description: Rough-hewn wooden beams support a ceiling of thatch-covered planks of various lengths and thicknesses.  Flickering light from a single oil lamp throws irregular shadows across the uneven stone walls.  Several large clay urns are scattered about a woven rug centered on the rugged stone floor.  A small archway covered with a tattered blanket is partly hidden by a series of makeshift shelves suspended from rusted chains hanging from the supports above.

title: [Sounds Beyond, Storage]
description: Rugged in its construction, the small stone room is scattered with various urns and crates, each a tangle of scrap metal, wires, and gears.  An overturned wooden barrel stands before a narrow slab of slate balanced between two splintered crates.  Exposed beams support a single lantern that illuminates the area in a pale glow.  Partially hidden in the shadows is a small archway covered with a tattered blanket.

title: [Murky Tunnel]
description: A dark, cramped tunnel unwinds, ever-constricting as it continues, progressively more and more narrow as it descends steeply beneath the cemetery.  Inky black silence blankets everything, broken only by the occasional soft whisper of a sepulchral breeze.

title: [Murky Tunnel]
description: Rough, uneven surfaces press in from all sides, and spectral strands of cobwebs drape from the ceiling like decaying lace.  The ground continues its precipitous decline, and the air grows cooler, suffused with a strange, otherworldly glow as faint, dusky light spills from a dimly glowing fissure far ahead.

title: [Starlit Cavern, Lakeshore]
description: Riven from the subterranean as if clawed by some monstrous beast, a massive cavern unfurls, revealing a preternaturally still underground lake.  Far overhead, tiny arcane lights wink in and out of existence, looking for all the world like a vast night sky twinkling and reflecting off the lake.  At the water's edge, a vine-choked gazebo sits, its entrance flanked by a half-moon ebonwood table piled high with a gallimaufry of wares.

title: [The Kettle Black, Entry]
description: Dried ears of corn, their surfaces split and faded, are scattered all over the floor of this partially capsized stall.  A cracked display stand seems to have escaped the destruction of the rest of the space, while a slatted wooden crate painted with a stylized ear of corn sits askew in one corner.  A crooked curtain hangs partially from the ceiling and seems to hide a potential storage space.  The air is musty and smells of stale popcorn.

title: [The Kettle Black, Storage]
description: Multiple burlap bags, some of them displaying the tops of dried ears of corn, line the walls of this tiny storage space.  While the area is still cramped, it seems to have escaped much of the destruction of the rest of the stall.  A scarred work table, its surface covered in random assortments of tools, sits in one corner, while a rickety stool has been pushed in front of it.

title: [Witch's Cottage, Garden Path]
description: A wide wooden gate, painted in shades of blue and white, offers both entrance to and egress from this lush garden.  A shaded path of packed dirt and pebble-sized gemstones winds into a dense garden of delicate ferns and gently waving grasses.  The tops of colorful mushrooms peek from between their greener neighbors, welcoming visitors with inviting splashes of soft crimson, vivid violet, and lemon yellow spots.

title: [Witch's Cottage, Garden Path]
description: Measuring between a few inches to nearly two feet in height, a multitude of delicate ferns grows to either side of a shady, packed-dirt path.  Each individual frond branches off into smaller pinnae, leaving a feathery interlacing of greenery seemingly hovering just above the moist earth.

title: [Witch's Cottage, Garden Path]
description: Delicate fronds of moisture-beaded ferns reach across the gem-lined border of a moonlit walkway as though hoping to caress the legs of passersby.  Dotted around and amongst them are multicolored mushrooms emerging from the rich, dark, and loamy soil.  From a nearby cluster of saplings, crickets lend their voices to the night with a series of plaintive chirps.

title: [Witch's Cottage, Front Porch]
description: Sturdy floorboards of whitewashed oak form a decorative herringbone pattern on the front porch landing of this isolated cottage.  Centered prominently within the cottage's clapboard face is a tall witchwood door.  For as sturdy as the flooring appears, an ominous creaking can be detected whenever anyone nearby approaches the open doorway.

title: [Chimes in the Mist]
description: Frost clings to the windows, tossing silver-limned abstract images upon the hardwood floor and producing a faint chill near the edges of the room.  Dried herbs, charms, and mementoes hang from the ceiling, their surfaces cast in flickering crimson and orange hues created by a fire that burns within a wrought iron stove.  Aged wicker chairs encircle a rustic oak table topped with a smattering of tallow candles that melt upon its surface.

title: [Chimes in the Mist, Bedroom]
description: Heavy drapes, faded and worn, hang from tarnished brass rods over the frosted windows, the skeins of fabric parted enough to allow the violet, cerulean, and coral sky to paint in the room in its twilight hues.  Flanked by end tables, a four-poster bed rests in the center of the northern wall upon a braided rug.  Opposite, between two large windows, a painted oak armoire stands open, allowing a peek at its contents.

title: [Starlit Cavern, Gazebo]
description: Cat's claw vines snake through every gap in the latticework of pale linden that composes the spacious gazebo, smothering any light from outside.  Wrought iron planters cling to the walls, each cradling an unusual miniature tree.  Some pierced bronze lanterns shaped like pointed stars swing from the ceiling, casting a soft purple glow from the crystalline nodules within.  Discreetly tucked in one corner, a smooth bloodletting basin rests on clawed feet, its surface slick with traces of a dark, viscous substance.

title: [Witch's Garden, Cottageside]
description: Towering overhead, fronds of lacy ferns take on the countenance of trees.  Nothing appears as one might expect here, with the thick and woody bases of oversized mushrooms making passage between them seem like an insurmountable feat.  Only thin rays of moonlight are visible through the filtering foliage above.  A fern-lined woven reed basket has been placed beside a tiny ground-level opening in the cottage wall.

title: [Witch's Garden, Spore Scatter]
description: Large, black obstacles litter the ground here, obscuring the path both ahead and behind.  Varying in size from a large rock to a small boulder, each rounded black object seems to have dropped from the underside of the enormous green fronds overhead.  Their surprisingly squishy surfaces give a brief, springy lift to those brave enough to climb atop and jump from one to another.  One of the larger round objects seems to have narrowly missed landing on a wax-dotted white birch crate.

title: [Witch's Garden, Hag's Hollow]
description: A steep drop from the lush growth above makes this winding trail somewhat difficult to traverse.  Beside the trail, a rotten gourd stands its ground, watching for evildoers or knaves.

title: [Witch's Garden, Journey of Gems]
description: Gemstones nearly the size of boulders threaten to block any attempts of visitors to venture away from the established path.  Their glassy, colorful surfaces provide only precarious handholds for clambering over their rounded and polished faces.  Fiddlehead ferns with curly green tops rise far overhead like statuesque sentinels.

title: [Witch's Garden, Hag's Hollow]
description: Poised beneath the steep ledge rising to the lusher garden above, the path winds upward through a cluster of gigantic shriveled mushrooms.  Boulder-sized gemstones of peridot, glimaerstone, and emerald lend a sparkle of color to the garden as the rays of moonlight filtering through the foliage play across their smooth surfaces.

title: [Witch's Garden, Tall Tails]
description: Giant horsetail ferns rise in a straight and sturdy manner toward the sky.  Whorls of soft, needlelike branches radiate outward at even intervals off the multi-ribbed stem.  What little moonlight is able to penetrate the greenery is reflected by the somewhat glossy surface of the moisture-laden ground underfoot.

title: [Under the Witch's Cottage]
description: The dank and musty aroma here is so pervasive as to almost cause choking.  A few cracked beams supporting the cottage above sow seeds of doubt about one's safety here, but fortunately most of the heavy wooden structure overhead is dry and intact.  A scattering of black mold spores near the crawlspace opening shows the primary area where moisture seeps in.

title: [Witch's Garden, Tip of the Cap]
description: Colorful towering mushrooms soar upwards from wide and woody stems.  Though most of their caps can't be seen from this vantage point, a few toppled fungi still proudly display their bright crimson and orange tops, each splashed with creamy white dots.  The earthy aroma of moist soil and mushrooms hangs heavy in the still, nightime air.

Colorful shriveled mushrooms soar upwards from wide and woody stems.  Though most of their caps can't be seen from this vantage point, a few toppled fungi still proudly display their bright crimson and orange tops, each splashed with creamy white dots.  The earthy aroma of moist soil and mushrooms hangs heavy in the still, nightime air.

title: [Under the Witch's Cottage]
description: A pervasively organic aroma is quite strong here, no doubt emanating from the numerous piles of mulch-filled burlap bags.  Each is stacked neatly, one atop the other with only a few tatters of burlap and scattered mounds of mulch showing where rough or careless handling may have led to spillage and waste.

title: [Under the Witch's Cottage]
description: The otherwise plain brown layer of dirt underfoot is spruced up in spots with splashes of yellow, red, and blue paint.

title: [Under the Witch's Cottage]
description: Muddy footprints leave damp tracks in the otherwise dry and dusty ground beneath the forest cottage home.  A large wax-covered worktable is centered in the space, the scuffed earth around it marking where chandlers, both masters and apprentices alike, have gathered to practice their craft.  A metal bucket bearing an abundance of opaque wax cubes teeters precariously on the top shelf of a nearby display rack offering a selection of colorful vials.

title: [Witch's Garden, Golden Bursts]
description: A few hardy wildflowers have established a foothold in this garden between and betwixt the ferns and the fungus.  Tall stalks of golden creeping jenny display their bright yellow petals overhead, mimicking the look of misplaced suns in the nightime sky.  Amber gemstones the size of boulders line the path here, relecting the colors of the moonlit flowers high above.

title: [Witch's Garden, Morel Trace]
description: A steep drop from the lush growth above makes this winding trail somewhat difficult to traverse.  Beside the trail, a rotten gourd stands its ground, watching for evildoers or knaves.

title: [Witch's Garden, Lightscape]
description: Scattered clusters of fiddlehead ferns circle the rim of a cavernous hole lurking beside the path.  High overhead, the silver-tinged fronds of a tall and spreading fern drape across the pathway, blocking much of the direct moonlight.  Refracted light from the variegated giant makes dappled shadows across the landscape of the surrounding garden.

title: [Witch's Garden, Shadowfern Way]
description: A steep drop from the lush growth above makes this winding trail somewhat difficult to traverse.  Beside the trail, a rotten gourd stands its ground, watching for evildoers or knaves.

title: [Witch's Garden, Death and Decay]
description: Giant mounds of shriveled mushrooms loiter beside the pathway.  Several specimens have collapsed into large pools of slimy mushiness one would be loath to fall into.  Others maintain their tall forms overhead, but their caps droop and threaten to topple, while their sticky, discolored stems release as foul an odor as one can imagine.

title: [Witch's Garden, Verdant Way]
description: Poised beneath the steep ledge rising to the lusher garden above, the path winds upward through a cluster of gigantic shriveled mushrooms.  Boulder-sized gemstones of peridot, glimaerstone, and emerald lend a sparkle of color to the garden as the rays of moonlight filtering through the foliage play across their smooth surfaces.

title: [Witch's Garden, Puffball Path]
description: Giant spherical fungal bodies, creamy white to light brown in color, are scattered across the garden path as though humongous children left behind their toys.  The thin-walled puffballs are mostly intact, but a few have broken open, dusting a radiating trail of yellow-brown spores beside them.

title: [Witch's Garden, Verdant Way]
description: A steep drop from the lush growth above makes this winding trail somewhat difficult to traverse.  Beside the trail, a rotten gourd stands its ground, watching for evildoers or knaves.

title: [Witch's Garden, Tanglewood]
description: Mycelium spreads its fungal net both around the perimeter of a large dark pit and around the stems and shoots of giant flowering plants nearby.  It drapes across boulder-sized gemstones lining the pathway, looking almost comically like the grey and white tangle of an old woman's hair that has never been brushed.

title: [Witch's Garden, Crimson Loop]
description: Poised beneath the steep ledge rising to the lusher garden above, the path winds upward through a cluster of gigantic shriveled mushrooms.  Boulder-sized gemstones of peridot, glimaerstone, and emerald lend a sparkle of color to the garden as the rays of moonlight filtering through the foliage play across their smooth surfaces.

title: [Witch's Garden, Undercover]
description: Little moonlight is able to filter through the ceiling-like cover overhead.  Striated fins form the underside of a shriveled mushroom above - like a wide and firmly planted umbrella.  The giant, varicolored fungi seem to have positioned themselves in a protective circle around a gnarled tree stump, where their deep, earthy essence settles over the garden's visitors like a dry, old, musty blanket.

title: [Witch's Garden, Crimson Loop]
description: A steep drop from the lush growth above makes this winding trail somewhat difficult to traverse.  Beside the trail, a rotten gourd stands its ground, watching for evildoers or knaves.

title: [Witch's Garden, Morel Trace]
description: Detritus, leaf litter, and broken bits of rotting logs are scattered across the trail, making the footing somewhat precarious.  A shriveled mushroom, gargantuan in size, rises far overhead and threatens to topple if one gets too close.

title: [Witch's Garden, Morel Trace]
description: Clusters of fiddlehead ferns sprout up between half-rotten logs, nodding with their curly heads as if greeting esteemed guests from afar.  Footprints in the moist soil mark the passage of foragers through this glade.

title: [Witch's Garden, Morel Trace]
description: The ground here is so folded and buckled that even standing still might be treacherous.  Beneath the ground-level chaos, deep furrows and pits loom ominously.  Some particularly wide pits with overgrown edges seem designed to beckon the unwary to venture too close.

title: [Witch's Garden, Morel Trace]
description: Clusters of giant shriveled mushrooms and a few fiddlehead ferns line the barely visible path through the moist and uneven ground.  An attempt to aid passage has clearly been made with the placement of at least some small illumination along the way.

title: [Witch's Garden, Morel Trace]
description: Heavy with moisture, the slippery moss overtaking the pathway makes traversing this area a risky proposition.  A rotten gourd rises tall beside the perimeter, standing watch over the ground with rapt attention.

title: [Witch's Garden, Morel Trace]
description: A towering toadstool, its stem a gradient of black to tan to white, looms large over the otherwise green space.  A few curly topped fiddlehead ferns nod sleepily nearby, resting in the tall shadow of a shriveled mushroom.

title: [Witch's Garden, Morel Trace]
description: The trail rises more steeply toward the main garden above.  Dropping off just beside the trail, a steep gorge lies in wait for the unwary traveler.  A rotten gourd nearby keeps close watch for any danger that may loom.

title: [Witch's Garden, Morel Trace]
description: Ferns of the fluffy variety as well as ferns of the fiddlehead type rise up sharply from the moist and humid earth.  From far above, large round spores fall to the ground, posing a serious risk to tiny passersby.  Sadly, a rotten gourd standing guard can do little to mitigate the aerial assault from the giant green fronds.

title: [Top of the Fiddlehead Fern]
description: The view from this vantage point is breathtaking!  The fronds of the fiddlehead ferns poke out of the thick, blanketing flora like a baby chick emerging from its shell, and the sunlight is no longer obscured by the surrounding foliate.

title: [Fresh from the Coven]
description: Onyx-embroidered jacquard curtains frame the shop, the layered fabric draped across the lyshaelyn-inset windows casting various beams of color upon the elongated counters.  Root-crafted bookshelves line the grey-colored stone walls, the tomes and scrolls obscured by the graduated lengths of dried herbs interspersed between the knotted yarns ropes looping across the ceiling.  A duo of heliodor-eyed cats stand at the back of the room, their blackened iron tails coiled around their clawed feet.

title: [Fresh from the Coven, Pantry]
description: A diminutive cast iron stove stands in the corner of the shop, the aged oven framed by a pair of branch-like perches covered in colorful threads.  Twisted roots are crafted into makeshift shelves along the velvet-draped walls, each one decorated with a variety of powder-filled jars and knickknacks draping down the edges.  Tall hand-painted curios stand against the walls, the compartments filled with skeins of vibrant yarn alongside several unfinished projects.

title: [Nereid's Voice]
description: Birch logs of varying sizes are strapped together with rawhide and chinked with tufts of fleece, creating a snug shelter that is airtight despite the fridged air outside.  Tendrils of smoke drift up from a small fire that rests in a depression at the center of the floor and is surrounded by layers upon layers of sheepskin blankets.  Dozens of charms dangle from long cords that are anchored to the ceiling, each hanging decoration clinking together as the wind outside sighs.

title: [The Kraken Communal]
description: Kraken-wrought lanterns are scattered along the bamboo-framed pavilion, their long tentacles grasping at the crossbeams above an elongated banana leaf-covered table at the center of the room.  A variety of vert-colored sailcloth cushions are placed along the length of the table, the seating resting upon the woven mats set along the wood-planked floor.  Set below an imposing pirate flag is a ship-carved basin, the container filled by a series of bamboo tubes flowing into the glass bowl.

title: [Otterstide Pool]
description: A scattering of flat-topped boulders encircle the blue-colored waters of the pool, the ripples gently lapping against the strands of sea kelp clinging to the sun-bleached rocks.  Bright flags of sailcloth hang in garlands across the ramshackle lighthouse erected from various scraps of wood, the ship names carved across the planks in a myriad of languages.  Nestled away from the rocks are several otter-carved stools and tables covered in banana leaves, the seating shaded by a grove of verdant palm trees.

title: [Ramshackle Lighthouse, Overview]
description: The chilly wind blows across the open space, amplifying the sounds of waves crashing across the Tenebrous Cauldron as they echo across the wooden framework.  A hemp rope-knotted vine hangs along a beam set across the cylindrical roof, swaying gently in the ambient breeze, causing the tiny bells woven through the fibers to tinkle quietly.  Unoccupied nests of straw and shredded parchment frame the staircase leading down to the ground, the wall above them affixed with small trinkets crafted from sea glass.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Canopied Walk]
description: This section of the boardwalk is connected to the others across the way by a rope-strung bridge suspended over the sand overhung by a metal-lined painted wooden sign.  Overlapping pieces of dark linen combine to form a canopy that hangs from splintered wooden pillars, framing the area and largely blocking the sun.  Several lanterns are hung from these pillars, offering an alternative light source.  Ornamental rugs layered in squares are placed at the boardwalk's edges between driftwood crates of varying sizes, offering space for individual market stalls.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Canopied Walk]
description: Many woven reed pillows and several benches are haphazardly set across this open section of boardwalk.  The multiple pieces of linen that form the canopy above are pinned against their supporting pillars, revealing a bright sky.  At one end of this area, a driftwood bar has been set up.  Next to it, some sandy wooden stairs lead under the boardwalk but are blocked by a muscled half-elf.  At the other end, several linen hammocks are suspended between the pillars.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Canopied Walk]
description: The centerpiece of this sparse, uncovered section of boardwalk is a river rock hearth set on metal legs.  Around it, a considerable space has been cleared to allow bystanders to gather.  To one side at the boardwalk's edge, a woven net tangled with bits of kelp hangs from twin driftwood pillars through which bright azure waters stretch toward the horizon.  To the other, wooden pylons are set to mark spaces to fish or use as tie-offs for smaller watercraft to be pulled up close to the boardwalk.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Canopied Walk]
description: Multiple pieces of stitched-together linens cover the area and drape down to the boardwalk's edges, forming a dim tunnel of planks, pillars, and cloth.  Through a few pinned-back sections of this linen canopy, the night sky is visible.  Small, rug-covered squares line the tunnel, offering additional space for market stalls.  This tunnel gives way to an open boardwalk with a wooden fountain at its center, surrounded by several cloth pillows and a series of lanterns.

Multiple pieces of colorful, stitched-together linen cover the area and drape down to the boardwalk's edges, which paints this area in a soft, multihued glow during the day.  Small, rug-covered squares mark the path forward and offer additional space for market stalls.  These stalls give way to an open boardwalk with a wooden fountain at its center, surrounded by several cloth pillows and a series of lanterns.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Canopied Walk]
description: The boardwalk here carries over the ocean, with driftwood pillars plunging into the azure waters below.  The linens that form the canopy are tied back against the beams supporting them, allowing the sun to shine through.  These same beams also have metal hooks attached, where smaller ships can be tied up alongside the boardwalk.  Woven mats form a semicircle at one end of the boardwalk surrounding a stone pool lined with lanterns, offering space for merchants to peddle their wares.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Canopied Walk]
description: The wooden planks of this section of the boardwalk are discolored with crimson stains from fresh catches brought ashore.  Multiple market stalls set between driftwood crates frame the area.  Gaps in the wood below afford brief glimpses of clear azure waters over white sand, with bits of kelp concealing bright, darting schools of fish.  The entire scene is overhung by a bright multihued sailcloth canopy with stitching of nautical imagery and a series of forged metal lanterns.

title: [The Peaceful Porpoise, Narthex]
description: Piles of unwashed robes and soiled linens crowd around a chipped granite sarcophagus.  Mildewed tapestries, hung at irregular angles and emanating a musky stench, muffle the sound of dripping water.  Worn into the stone floors is an uneven path, made from footprints in various shapes and sizes, that terminates behind a tattered azure curtain embroidered with a faded dolphin.

title: [The Peaceful Porpoise, Grotto]
description: Damp and dilapidated rugs, their scent cloying and dank, conceal cracks along the surface of a granite mezzanine overlooking a honeycombed grotto.  The sound of water dripping from crystalline stalactites echoes as it falls into a subterranean lagoon, causing ripples that glow and fade as they expand.

title: [Reflection's Interlude, Plaza]
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Wisteria Pergola, East]
description: Diaphanous curtains of tulle are draped across the rope-bound framework of the pergola, the airy fabric pooling along the creeping thyme covering the ground.  Hand-woven garlands of blue-violet wisteria decorate the repurposed wooden benches facing the central pavilion, the florals tucked with tiny notes written with childlike calligraphy.  Clusters of clay-potted foliage encircle the periphery of the pergola guarded by a lacquered piece of origami, the tiny toads nestled in beds of tumbled pebbles.

title: [Wisteria Pergola, South]
description: Diaphanous curtains of tulle are draped across the rope-bound framework of the pergola, the airy fabric pooling along the creeping thyme covering the ground.  Hand-woven garlands of blue-violet wisteria decorate the repurposed wooden benches facing the central pavilion, the florals tucked with tiny notes written with childlike calligraphy. title: [The Stationer's Nook]
description: Open, airy windows are framed by sheer ivory curtains that flutter in the salty breeze coming from the harbor.  A large teak writing desk dominates the center of the room, its surface scattered with parchment, quills, and pots of ink.  Displays of signet rings are arranged along the walls, while sticks of wax, paper rolls, and inkwells are neatly displayed on a series of shelves.  Ceramic lamps hang on pewter chains from the arched ceiling above, casting a gentle glow over the shop.

title: [Grim Sands, Dock]
description: Dark and forbidding, a sturdy wooden dock rules over a small bay sheltered by the curve of the isle's coastline.  The pilings are old, their upper halves stained with the droppings of sea birds; the lower encrusted with barnacles.  Deprived the fury of the tides, the waters of the bay lap languorously at the wood.

title: [Glaoveln, V'Koort Docks]
description: The dockyard is shrouded in an eerie mist that blankets the entire area, adding to the deep chill that settles in from the arctic shores beyond.  The wooden piers creak and groan as krolvin ships sway gently in the murky waters.  The salty air is thick with the smell of fish and seaweed.

title: [The White Wyrm, Gangway]
description: Bulkheads press in unforgivingly to either side of the narrow gangway that allows egress from the ship.  Threaded through the pale imflass paneling are thin veniom filaments, the bluish metal agleam with glints of silver.  Above the escape hatch, a fanciful metal placard depicts a cold wyrm with its wings spread and snout at a defiant upward tilt.

title: [Grim Sands, Longboats]
description: Several small vessels have been dragged past the high water line.  One, an overturned longboat, has been scraped clean of barnacles and is slathered with fresh patches of pine tar.  A well-worn pathway parallels the bend of the shoreline as it travels to the east.

title: [Grim Sands, Shoreline]
description: The gelid air is filled with the sharp tang of brine, an odor intensified by the heaps of seaweed strewn across the black beach.  Several seals laze on the rocks of an island just off the shore, their barks and brays traveling on the stiff breeze.  Though not especially distant, the intervening waters are violent, cold, and dark.

title: [Grim Sands, Altar]
description: Spent tallow candles huddle together atop a blue-green seaglass altar that has been erected just beyond the reach of the highest tides.  The monument is obviously old, its edges worn smooth and its base half-buried in the sand.  Several tokens lie in a heap of kelp before it, coins, bits of scrimshawed bone, and copper jewelry commingling freely in the bed of rubbery seaweed.

title: [Glaoveln, V'Koort Docks]
description: The dockyard is shrouded in an eerie mist that blankets the entire area, adding to the deep chill that settles in from the arctic shores beyond.  The wooden piers creak and groan as krolvin ships sway gently in the murky waters.  The salty air is thick with the smell of fish and seaweed.

title: [Glaoveln, V'Koort Docks]
description: The dockyard is shrouded in an eerie mist that blankets the entire area, adding to the deep chill that settles in from the arctic shores beyond.  The wooden piers creak and groan as krolvin ships sway gently in the murky waters.  The salty air is thick with the smell of fish and seaweed.

title: [Grim Sands, Shoreline]
description: Rolling banks of black sand shield the upper shoreline from the relentless assault of the surf.  The low dunes are dotted with splintered fragments of smooth white driftwood and thick clumps of dark seaweed.  Salt stings sharply on the frigid air.

title: [Grim Sands, Shoreline]
description: A low ridge of igneous rock breaches out of the sands.  Crude steps have been cut out of it to ease the climb toward a trail that meanders northward on a hesitant approach to the looming stone cliffs overlooking the beach.  Snow and dried kelp are heaped around the base of the ridge, deposited by storm and sea.

title: [Grim Sands, Sandy Ridge]
description: The path climbs onerously toward black cliffs in the distance, aided on its way by rough-carved steps hewn out of the dark stone of the sandy ridge.  Sea birds circle above, dark shapes against the starry blackness of the sky.  Their cries echo off of the surrounding rocks, filling the air with a shrill cacophony.

title: [Grim Sands, Inlet]
description: The coastline cradles a shallow inlet of clear water.  Despite the wind whipping at the water's surface, its depths are calm and occupied by schools of little fish that glint like bright silver coins in the cold moonlight.  Nearby seabirds eye the pool with predatory focus.

title: [Grim Sands, Shoreline]
description: The surf crashes violently on the smooth black sands of the coast, sending up eruptions of white spray.  A piece of driftwood claws up from the sand, white as bone.  Despite the bone-breaking force of the tide, the tenacious branch remains firmly in place.

title: [Grim Sands, Shoreline]
description: Lichen thrives in the shadows of rounded stone boulders near the shore, the blankets of green contrasting sharply with the unrelieved black of the sands.  The rocks are stained with the droppings of sea birds that flock the beach, seemingly heedless of the intense cold.  Brine is bitter-sharp on the air.

title: [Grim Sands, Jetty]
description: A rocky jetty stretches out into the forbidding waters of the Frostmain, the crevices and cracks between stones home to hardy crabs and small seabirds.  The latter have built nests of dry tundra grass here and there, and the red of the nests stands out sharply from the volcanic stone.  Though slick with spray, the rocks provide ample footholds.

title: [Grim Sands, Shoreline]
description: To the northeast, a trail of shale gravel winds away from the shoreline, climbing toward steep cliffs of igneous stone that overlook the beach.  White foam glistens from the black sands.  Its fizzing fills the silence between the crashing of each great wave.

title: [Grim Sands, Obelisk]
description: An ancient obelisk of silver-shot ebon stone stands watch over the stretch of beach, its features corroded by the tireless onslaught of the salt air.  Briny water has eaten away at the base, leaving it peculiarly smooth.  A garland of kelp tangles around it, the fronds glazed with a thin layer of frost.

title: [Grim Sands, Shoreline]
description: The volcanic sands of the beach stretch out like a vast obsidian canvas.  Dotted here and there with kelp and bleached white driftwood, the black expanse is possessed of a stark and rugged beauty.  Waves crash down on the shoreline, filling the air with icy seaspray.

title: [Grim Sands, Shoreline]
description: Water, cruel and cold, laps at the black sand, leaving behind foam as white as the snowbanks further up the shore.  Briny air whips across the beach in knife-edged gusts, stirring the fronds of kelp that dots the sands in thick, dark clumps.  The distant cries of a seabird cut through the thunderous rumble of the surf.

title: [The White Wyrm, Main Deck]
description: Evenly lit by glimaerstone spheres set into the overhead, the intersection of the main deck is narrow.  Veniom filaments travel along the bulkheads, which are made of teak and reinforced with pale imflass the color of fog.  They fan out from a hatch to the west that is also the source of the low, rumbling thrum that pulses through the deck.  At the northern end of the corridor, a reinforced hoarbeam door carved with a rampant mule is stationed at the center of the bulkhead.

title: [The White Wyrm, Captain's Cabin]
description: Far from ostentatious, the cabin is a small chamber graced by few personal touches.  The bunk is tidily made, its blanket embroidered with a blue mule, and a teak sea chest is situated at its foot.  A small grey and blue carpet occupies the deck before a reinforced hoarbeam door.

title: [The White Wyrm, Main Deck]
description: Toward the fore of the ship, the main deck widens.  Crates and supplies are stacked along the bulkheads, secured to them by hooks and sturdy hempen ropes, save around the base of a pale metal ladder that leads to the upper deck.  They leave sufficient space to access crew quarters through a narrow archway in the eastern wall.  Heavily reinforced with golvern, a riveted imflass hatch leads toward the ship's bridge.

title: [The White Wyrm, Bridge]
description: The ship's bridge is sealed off from the rest of the ship by a riveted imflass hatch that is reinforced with golvern.  Curving along with the forward bulkhead, great windows provide the ship's bridge with a panoramic view and allow in daylight that melds with the even radiance of glimaerstone spheres set into the overhead.   Chairs fan out across the raised deck in a half-circle, secured by heavy bolts.

title: [The White Wyrm, Crew Quarters]
description: Evenly spaced recesses in the inner and outer bulkheads house sparse bunks stacked two high.  Stowed beneath the lowermost of each pair of bunks is a set of foot lockers, shut and padlocked.  There is little opportunity for privacy in the cramped living space, a fact complicated by the narrow archway leading out onto the main deck.

title: [The White Wyrm, Upper Deck]
description: Vast propeller assemblies sprout from the upper deck, crafted from the same pale golvern as its rails and plated hull.  Interspersed between them are a series of cannons wrought from the same metal.  Shot racks lining the decks are laden with solid iron cannonballs.  The racks, like the hoarbeam deck underfoot, are heavily etched with dimly glowing runes.  A pale metal ladder leads to the lower deck.

title: [Glaoveln, Herndrok Pier]
description: The sounds of hammers and saws echo from a shipyard nearby, as the creation and repair of war vessels carry on at all times.  Cold winds rip across the pier, carrying the salty scent of the sea and the pungent odor of fish guts.  The dark waters reflect the dreary sky, creating an almost gloomy ambiance.

title: [Glaoveln, Herndrok Pier]
description: The sounds of hammers and saws echo from a shipyard nearby, as the creation and repair of war vessels carry on at all times.  Cold winds rip across the pier, carrying the salty scent of the sea and the pungent odor of fish guts.  The dark waters reflect the dreary sky, creating an almost gloomy ambiance.

title: [Glaoveln, Prozd Pier]
description: The wooden planks of the dock creak loudly, their surfaces stained with salt and swathed with glistening frost.  A maze of large krolvin warships stretches out into the murky waters, their figureheads carved into the ferocious images of various sea monsters.  The area is shrouded in a thick, icy fog that obscures several forms moving along the pier.

title: [Glaoveln, Prozd Pier]
description: The wooden planks of the dock creak loudly, their surfaces stained with salt and swathed with glistening frost.  A maze of large krolvin warships stretches out into the murky waters, their figureheads carved into the ferocious images of various sea monsters.  The area is shrouded in a thick, icy fog that obscures several forms moving along the pier.

title: [Glaoveln, Prozd Pier]
description: The wooden planks of the dock creak loudly, their surfaces stained with salt and swathed with glistening frost.  A maze of large krolvin warships stretches out into the murky waters, their figureheads carved into the ferocious images of various sea monsters.  The area is shrouded in a thick, icy fog that obscures several forms moving along the pier.

title: [Grim Sands, Sandy Ridge]
description: Winding drunkenly, the path passes beneath the shadow of a bluff hundreds of feet overhead.  Atop it stands a stone lighthouse that can be glimpsed from several vantage points along the ridge.  Murres have nested in the cragged rock face below the old stalwart and fill the sea air with their throaty cries.

title: [Grim Sands, Cliff Base]
description: Approaching the base of the cliffs, the pathway splits, with one branch curving along their base to the east.  The other travels northward up a chasm between high bluffs, climbing precipitously as it goes.  Red grasses grow in profusion, sheltered from the worst of the wind by the rising land.

title: [Grim Sands, Cliff Base]
description: Piles of rubble bar further progress eastward along the trail.  The jagged ebon stones are all that remains of an expanse of cliff face that have broken away, undermined by the tireless efforts of the elements.  The rockslide has revealed a massive fossilized skeleton trapped in the rock, its form sinuous and serpentine.

title: [Grim Sands, Chasm]
