A series of chain-bound shelves line the walls leading to additional rooms, the wares displayed in carved wooden boxes and bowls stained in ichor.

title: [The Annex, Northeast]
description: A trio of sharpened daggers pierces through the room's back wall, each weapon conveniently striking the eyes and mouth of the unknown portrait covering the torn vellum.  Several frayed bags litter the floor beside straw-layered crates filled with merchandise, the dried stalks spilling down upon the bloodstained floor.  Ink-stained tally marks mar the surface of the tall cabinet nestled in the corner, the glass-paned doors restrained by lengths of braided rope.

title: [The Annex, Northwest]
description: Canvas-covered crates litter the room, the containers stacked ceiling-high between narrow wooden tables covered in various artifacts and piles of aged parchment.  A fine dusting of cobwebs curtains the unevenly plank-hammered walls enclosing the shop, the layers split by rusted nails dangling multiple scraps of paper and stacks of notes.  Faint whispers echo between the floorboards, the pieces of wood stained in streaks of blackish red.

title: [The Daily Grind, Entry]
description: Much of this birch-paneled room is taken up by a brass-hinged display case, the contents arranged carefully on each shelf.  Tucked into one corner, its lid open wide, is a squat box crafted from interlinked bronze and birch panels.  The wooden floors are meticulously clean, though the faint smell of cooked meat and blood lingers in the air.

title: [The Daily Grind, Accents]
description: The room is paneled in whitewashed wooden planks, punctuated by long pale birch shelves stocked with various bottles.  Below the shelves is a row of haphazardly spaced copper hooks made from bent gears that boast a series of cooking utensils.  A wooden rack stands beside the entrance, offering a selection of recipes.

title: [Wet and Dry]
description: The walls of the windowless smokehouse are lined with shelves above a long counter, while meats, fish, and plants in various stages of drying hang from the ceiling.  At one end of the cramped room is a cast iron stove beside a wooden crate.

title: [Coalescence]
description: Large glass tanks, filled with a glowing virid liquid, are arranged along a continuous, curved stone wall that encloses this crudely carved-out space under the streets of Bloodriven Village.  Glyph-etched crystals adorn a variety of armors displayed on some pitted green metal busts in the center of this oval chamber, surrounded by a haze of virescent fumes that clings to the irregular, muddy floor.  Opposite a pitted metal ladder leading up to an acid-stained black metal hatch at one end of the ellipse, an angular twisted stone archway leads to a dark chamber beyond.

Large glass tanks, filled with a glowing virid liquid, are arranged along a continuous, curved stone wall that encloses this crudely carved-out space under the streets of Bloodriven Village.  Glyph-etched crystals adorn a variety of armors displayed on some pitted green metal busts in the center of this oval chamber, surrounded by a haze of virescent fumes that clings to the irregular, muddy floor.  Opposite a pitted metal ladder leading up to an acid-stained black metal hatch at one end of the ellipse, a twisted black metal shelf is haphazardly mounted to the wall.

title: [Right to Flare Arms, Porch]
description: Beneath an adequate fel roof, thick pine planks form a sturdy square floor raised a single ply from the ground.  Scraps of various woods offer a railing to lean against, opposite a chipped cobblestone archway bookended by a front-lipped sloped maple table and an elevated tinted glass display.

title: [Right to Flare Arms]
description: A large space provides ample room for standing and working alike, with walls dedicated to organizing various wood and leather crafting tools.  Standing alone in the center is a simple wooden table, the floor worn on the long side that faces an invar-legged ironwood workbench.

title: [In the Shadows of the Sparrow]
description: Poorly illuminated, the shop has a single lantern to light the space, which leaves most of the wares that are on display in shadows.  Sparsely furnished, there is a low wooden counter along the eastern wall where a robe-swaddled merchant covered in veils that leave only her eyes visible warily watches customers.  A blue cloth-covered table sits in the center of the space, half-in and half-out of the shadows.

title: [The Demon Drop, Lesser]
description: A short step down reveals a dimly lit hallway, with the scent of aged leather and alchemical spices lingering in the air.  On either side, some wooden racks of armor stand as silent sentinels, their surfaces reflecting the soft glow of crystals embedded in the ceiling.  The hallway, lined with shelves holding faintly glowing crystal flasks, stretches ahead further into the shop.

title: [The Demon Drop, Greater]
description: The hallway opens into a circular chamber, its stone walls lined with meticulously arranged racks of armor that gleam under the ambient glow of ceiling-mounted crystals.  Each suit stands tall and imposing, the air thick with the smell of fresh dyes and polish.  The floor beneath is etched with runic patterns that spiral out from the center of the room.

title: [The Journalist]
description: Freshly bound journals sit atop rows of linden shelves lining the walls of this otherwise unremarkable little shop.  A burled walnut pedestal displays stacks of colorful parchments, while an easel carries a neatly-inked notice calling for your attention.

title: [Totemic Spirits, Shrine]
description: Beeswax candles, their flames burning with a pale blue light, are scattered over every flat surface in this small shrine.  A flat stone altar takes up the entire back wall with several totems and idols placed reverently atop it, while a squat cedar box pyrographed with tribal markings is shoved into a far corner.  Small animal bones, feathers, and talons litter the floor and the air smells faintly musty.

title: [With a Flourish]
description: Iron-riveted racks of weaponry are arranged across the ebonwood walls of the shop, the polished hafts and oiled blades glinting in the ambient light above a live-edged display of burled walnut.  Illustrations of various combat techniques frame a leather-covered counter at the center of the room, the branded surface covered with various insignias and coats of arms labeled with parchment placards.  A pair of velvet-lined trunks flank the tall counter, the curved lids decorated in jeweled arabesques.

title: [Amalgamations]
description: Three walls of soot-stained brick enclose an angular workspace inside this stout building, clearly partitioned from the rest of the structure by a long, interior wall.  Dwarves work over a row of anvils stationed around a brick firepit, hammering away at glowing hot metal in their tongs before dousing the finished blades in a trough of green-tinged liquid.  A pitted green metal rack is mounted to the longer of two exterior walls, while an acid-stained table resides against the shorter, adjacent to a reinforced door leading out.

title: [Amalgamations, Corner]
description: Most of the narrow, stained floor here is covered in scraps of discarded metal.  Black alloy slabs, ready for the forge, are stacked beside a dark glaes vat of bubbling, green-tinged acid.  The walls are set with twisted black hooks, each bearing the weight of a shield.  Across the ceiling, a series of cables operate an oblong, ragged bellow beside a series of pitted metal tubes that vent upward and outward from the interior of this workspace.

title: [Amalgamations, Backroom]
description: A pitted black metal archway is the only way in or out of this short, cramped space.  Barrels, crates, and metal boxes are haphazardly stacked along the grey brick walls, leaving barely enough room to navigate between them.

title: [Balance and Frenzy, Entry]
description: Faded walls stretch down long corridors to the east and west.  A bold red line divides the room in two, stretching from the floor to the ceiling.  A pile of weapons is propped up against a small table on the back wall.

title: [Balance and Frenzy, West Wing]
description: A circular alcove connects back to the main room of the shop.  A pile of weapons is strewn about the back wall in a haphazard manner.  Small shafts of light filter in sporadically through the ceiling above.

title: [Balance and Frenzy, East Wing]
description: Painted, oblong rocks are stacked from floor to ceiling to create a colorful backdrop on the walls.  A pile of weapons is raised up on a small stone platform in the center of the room.  A black and white spiral is messily painted on the ceiling.

title: [Clockwerke Solutions]
description: Though dusty and dimly lit, the small shop is tidy and well organized.  A copper-edged polished oak counter sections off a space where the gnome tinkerer can work uninterrupted by the customers on the opposite side.  Recessed into the wall, a hive of honeycomb-shaped containers houses a variety of gears, springs, chains, and casings, while tools are housed upon hooks in the wall.  Hooks in front of the large window display several clockwork pieces that are for sale.

title: [Skayl Mix]
description: Smokeless fire rages through an imitation lava tube bisecting the level glaes floor, its shimmering light provoking flecks of gornar in the sphere's tinted glaes surface.  Off to the side stands a stone dwarven warrior statue, the lifeless eyes of his tilted head fixed on the ceiling's apex.

title: [Annex, House Aspis Lobby]
description: Simple, but elegant, the teakwood flooring of this room is polished to a lustrous sheen.  A silver velvet pennant edged in viridian hangs near a heavy, white muslin curtain.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove facing a wall of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and placed on a marble counter.

title: [Argent Aspis Annex]
description: Two huge toadstools in large stone pots illuminate a large, comfortable room.  Dusky brown granite benches line two of the marble walls, facing each other across the sapphire carpet.  Above one of the benches hangs a magnificent silver dragon standard.  On one wall, a brass arch allows exit to the corridor outside, while on the other wall a curtain provides entrance to the locker area.

title: [Argent Aspis Lockers]
description: A small swarm of fireflies flit about in a cylindrical cage hung from the granite ceiling.  Their blinking green and yellow glows softly illuminate this small room.  Though the marble walls are unadorned and the granite floor is uncarpeted, the room still provides a quiet place for contemplating the contents of your locker.

title: [Embassy, Lockers]
description: A crystal oil lamp illuminates the secret vault space behind the tapestry.  Casks of tipple are stacked against one wall.

title: [Spiritlight Dahcre Chamber]
description: Wrapped in the warm embrace of dark maplewood wainscoting, this room invites the intrepid adventurer to rest.  Comfortable puma-hide couches form an open square facing a silver-veined white marble hearth, above which is set a maple-framed silver looking-glass.  Along one wall, flanked by two green banners displaying silver dragons, a well-stocked bar offers refreshment to the thirsty.  A silver-edged green faenor medallion is set at the apex of the soulstone studded arch leading into the room.

title: [Darkened Chamber]
description: A single glaesine sconce attached to the wall illuminates the small chamber, casting a fitfully flickering light across the room's few features.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Dangling from a chain at one side of the room is a small mithglin ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Private Locker]
description: Jade green marble veined with cream covers the small amount of floor space, while pale oak paneling forms a modest wainscoting.  A white-on-cream figured silk covers the upper portion of the walls.

title: [Aspis Haven, Coffee Roasters]
description: The awakening scents of freshly roasted espresso and brown sugar fill the air in this cozy room.  A long maoral bar stands to one side, guarding an enormous brick-faced oven spanning the entire length of the wall.  Scattered throughout the room are several mismatched tables and chairs in a variety of arrangements.  The remaining walls boast a curated selection of small artworks and a floor-to-ceiling tapestry.  A silvered faewood bin rests below a large mounted blackboard just to the left of a green and silver chevron patterned curtain.

title: [Aspis Lockers]
description: Carefully arranged across the floor are plush, powder blue carpets patterned with multicolored interlocking bubbles.  The rear wall of the chamber is comprised of numerous small, locked compartments.  For your convenience, your personal locker is placed on a low granite-topped counter.  On the wall opposite the counter hangs an oil painting rendered in vivid colors.

title: [House Annex, Argent Aspis]
description: Devoid of nearby furnishings, the western wall is dominated by a green-fielded argent dragon mural that is illuminated by the warm glow of several frosted glaesine globes anchored to the ceiling.  Plush silver carpeting dappled with jade green threads lends the otherwise austere space a coziness that is enhanced by the presence of a plush verdant green settee.  A lacquered beige door leads to the hallway, while an argent-edged verdant green curtain provides access to the storage facilities.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: Ivory drapes hang upon the walls, their overly long lower edges pooling upon the soft rug that stretches from wall to wall.  The drape's silken lengths are unfettered except where they are parted to provide egress through an argent-edged verdant green curtain.  A lacquered green oak counter sits in the center of the circular chamber, beneath the light of an enormous seaglass orb that is held aloft by a woven hemp basket.

title: [Pearl Lounge]
description: A carved modwir sextant on a plain pedestal dominates the center of the room.  The smooth, dark tables are inlaid with intricate mother-of-pearl patterns.  The backs and the arms of the chairs are also marked with the same designs.

title: [Pearl Lounge, Cubbyhole]
description: This narrow, cramped space ends abruptly at a curtain.

title: [Pearl Lounge, Lockers]
description: You stand in a tiny, cramped space.

title: [Mulberry Room]
description: Shelves line the walls, each one filled to capacity by soft, furry toy pumas, wildcats and penguins.  A family of toy bears sits at a small table, as if patiently awaiting their tea and tarts.  Near the arch is a bin heaped with stuffed toy monkeys, their tiny black eyes glittering mischievously.

title: [Mulberry Room, Cubbyhole]
description: The small room ends in a dark leather curtain which is drawn shut.  Remnants of old advertising slogans are painted onto the curtain.

title: [Mulberry Room Locker]
description: The grey stone walls are bare, except for brass wall sconces with candles burning cheerfully.  A woolly, rolton fur rug stretches out on the floor of this small room.

title: [Lockers, Antechamber]
description: A simple wooden chair and a short square table are the only furnishings in this bare room.  The open ceiling shows the warehouse roof high above.  The sounds of workers moving crates in the warehouse below can be easily heard through the thin floors.

title: [Warehouse, Lockers]
description: The far wall of this small room is filled with an array of small, locked doors.

title: [Lockers, Antechamber]
description: A simple wooden chair and a short square table are the only furnishings in this bare room.  The open ceiling shows the warehouse roof high above.  The sounds of workers moving crates in the warehouse below can be easily heard through the thin floors.

title: [Warehouse, Lockers]
description: The far wall of this small room is filled with an array of small, locked doors.

title: [Argent Aspis Annex]
description: The floor, made of unglazed octagonal tiles, is partly covered with a thick carpet.  A window, screened with intricately carved wood, is set high on the wall.  Set beneath the window is a heavy terra cotta urn containing a flowering plant.

title: [Argent Aspis, Cubby]
description: This small antechamber to the locker area is lighted by a simple brass oil lamp.  The walls, crafted from smooth panels of yew wood, are bare of any adornment.  A plain cotton rug muffles your footsteps.

title: [Argent Aspis, Locker]
description: With the curtain closed behind you, all sound from outside the locker area has been hushed.  Sitting on a spotless green baize counter is your locker.

title: [Chthonian Dark, Arch]
description: Mist crawls and seethes along the ground, writhing like a thing alive.  The eddies of impenetrable fog conceal the ground underfoot, but here and there are glimpses of pocked stone etched with a pattern of interlocking wings.  A vast ebon archway rises out of the surrounding mists, unimaginably black and towering in scope.  So dark is the smooth stone of its construction that its edges and features are difficult to discern.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Chthonian Dark, Sanctum]
description: Heavy curtains of mist writhe over the stone floor of the sanctum, but they give wide berth to a raised dais of slick black stone adorned with a gilded bas-relief ring of interlocking feathers.  The relief is echoed overhead in concentric rings that rise to form a dizzyingly high dome that stretches up into impregnable blackness.  Despite the oppressive darkness, there is a luminous glow to the edges of the stones and throne that resembles nothing worldly.

title: [Willow Hall, Kitchen]
description: Set within a hollowed section of a willow tree, the kitchen has a warm atmosphere permeated by the scent of food cooking.  A stone firepit is topped with a mantel of woven willow branches holding various sparkling pots and pans, and above a trio of stoves, a willow branch serves as a rack holding various utensils and teas.  In the center of the room is a massive polished table that appears to have grown from the floor.  Staff scurry back and forth under the watchful eyes of the head cook and the head baker, and some louvered swinging doors lead out.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Aside the Walk]
description: The sand alongside the boardwalk is cool and flecked with bits of washed ashore seaweed and organic material.  Many pieces of colorful, stitched-together linens drape down over the boardwalk's edges and reach nearly to the sand.  These linens billow in the breeze and are backlit by lights from above.  Fronting these vibrant pieces of cloth and lit by stout candles, a long and battered driftwood table has been placed.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Aside the Walk]
description: A faint, foul odor cuts through the night air.  Discarded bait and decaying fish-parts strewn from the boardwalk above litter the sand, staining it a coppery brown-red.  Above these myriad stains and flanking the boardwalk's pillars is a candle-lit driftwood table.  The rhythmic sound of waves pushing ashore into the dunes that flank the area offers a constant counterpoint to the periodic trills of wildlife.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Aside the Walk]
description: Moving away from the boardwalk is a sheltered area flanked by slick boulders and large hunks of driftwood.  The sand slopes gently down toward a dark shore littered with the outline of rocks, more driftwood, and other debris.  In the middle of this slope, centered on a flat patch of cleared dirt, is a wide wooden bench carved with a six-tentacled octopus that looks over a rocky stretch of shore.  Centered above the bench is a metal lantern atop a driftwood pillar.  In the distance, the calls of birds and other wildlife mingle with the sound of waves.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Aside the Walk]
description: Moving away from the boardwalk is a series of dark and crisscrossing sand-blown trails snaking between slick boulders and large pieces of weathered driftwood.  Amid this collection of debris, a gnarled and weather-stripped tree with twisting branches towers over the multitude of thin trails.  Before the gnarled tree, on a dark patch of cleared dirt, rests both a wide wooden bench and a metal lantern atop a driftwood pillar.  In the distance, the calls of birds and other wildlife mingle with the sound of waves.

title: [Skins and Grins, Salesroom]
description: The air is thick with the pungent stink of tanning agents and the sickly sweet odor of animal carcasses.  Windows opened to let the malodorous melange escape share the stony walls with fine furs and fangs from a wide assortment of beasts.  Behind the counter a swarthy furrier works her trade, aided by tanning racks and vats of murky yellow fluid.  A massive skull with curled horns and a long jaw hangs over the partition.

title: [Locker Alcove]
description: You are standing in a tiny room whose facing wall is an array of small, locked doors.  A locker has been removed for you and is sitting on a small counter.

title: [Locker Alcove]

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Garden]
description: Revealing a trellis covered in climbing roses, the twisting turns of the garden are filled with a medley of scents.  Succulents line the edges of the path, their thick leaves and varied shapes providing texture amid white and grey pebbles.  A carved stone birdhouse hangs from a tree branch, and an antique wooden wheelbarrow brims with blooming flowers freshly transplanted to the space.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Garden]
description: Ornamental grasses sway in the breeze, their long shoots sheltering the meandering pathways of the garden.  Stepping stones cross a small, shallow pond, where lily pads float on the surface and silvery fish slip through the turquoise waters.  A wooden arbor marks the entrance to a secluded nook with a carved stone bench, and an open gate leads to the avenue beyond.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Garden]
description: Winding through the garden, a stone path flanked by playful sprays of moss invites a leisurely stroll.  Ornamental grasses sway gently in the breeze, their delicate blades dancing like whispers.  Beneath the shade of a wide-canopied lemon tree, an old wrought iron bench beckons, its intricate design a testament to time.  The vibrant yellow lemons hanging above create a striking contrast against the lush greenery, offering a refreshing splash of color.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, northwest

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Garden]
description: Meandering past beds of colorful flowers and shrubs, the path runs parallel to a small, bubbling brook whose banks are lined with ferns.  A gently arched wooden bridge arches over the brook, offering a picturesque crossing.  Nearby, a delicate wind chime made of seashells creates a gentle melody when manipulated by the sea air.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Garden]
description: Draped in sky-blue clustervine, a latticed wooden pergola casts intricate shadows across the tiled seating area, where the cool night air offers a refreshing escape.  A mosaic fountain stands in the center, its water gently cascading into a small brook that flows softly over cracked pavers, glistening in the moonlight.  Potted plants surround the area, their colorful succulents and blooms catching the glow of nearby lanterns.  At the edge of the space, a weathered sundial, bathed in silver light, marks the passage of time under the stars.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Bericsaba Market, Pathway]
description: Beyond the wrought iron gate, a pebbled path of blue shale, red marl, and white travertine winds through dense laurel shrubs, cypress, tamarisk, and juniper.  Their branches arch and weave together, casting shifting patterns of shadow across the ground.  Fallen needles and leaves gather along the edges, softening the borders where stone meets earth.  The air is thick with the scent of resin and damp soil.  As the path unfurls, the undergrowth thins, revealing a small clearing at the edge of a colonnade.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Path]
description: Granite and marl create a smooth avenue that winds through a sprawling garden.  Stone benches provide resting spots, while vibrant blooms and lush foliage line the path.  A small statue of sculpted marble stands at a fork in the path, while a birdbath, surrounded by lavender, invites local wildlife for a dip or sip.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Docks]
description: Steps carved from white travertine create a transitional space between the sprawling dock system and the rocky shoreline.  A weathered wooden sign directs visitors to the harbor master's shed nearby.  The shed itself is a quaint structure with a red-tiled roof and an ornate iron lantern hanging by the door.  Nearby, a small crate filled with fishing nets and tools is arranged as if the pieces have been placed out to dry.

title: [Harbor Master's Shed]
description: Rough-hewn wooden walls display nautical maps, charts, and maritime tools hung with care.  An old weathered wood desk scarred with use occupies one corner, piled with logbooks, a brass compass, and a lantern for late-night work.  Opposite, a simple cot with a woolen blanket offers a place to sleep.  Shelves line the walls, filled with jars of ship supplies, spare parts, and weathered books.  Sunlight filters through a long rectangular window, casting a warm glow across the room.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Docks]
description: Flanked by stark white travertine pillars, charcoal grey planks form a walkway along the shoreline as they connect a sprawling pier system to the mainland.  Tide pools filled with colorful sea anemones and small fish dot the area, providing a glimpse into the vibrant underwater world.  Crowning nearby cliffs, a pageantry of verdant greenery sways in the seaside breeze.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Docks]
description: Supported by stark white travertine pillars, the boardwalk runs along the shores of Ornath, connecting the various piers with the mainland.  Below them, protected by the structures' elevated supports, small tide pools offer a peek at starfish and crabs in their natural environs.  Slightly acrid, the air is filled with the scent of salt and seaweed.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, west
