title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Docks]
description: Stretching along the shoreline, charcoal grey planks rest on white travertine columns, protecting the habitats below as they connect to a sprawling pier system.  Stone sculptures of sea creatures are half-hidden in the tide pools at the path's northern edge, their surfaces worn smooth from constant contact with the lapping waters.  In the distance, the cliff's green crown of vegetation offers a peaceful, natural backdrop.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Docks]
description: In the shadowed recesses of a grotto, the pier extends gracefully into the tranquil waters as it departs the primary dock structure.  A weathered wooden sign, hanging from a rope, swings gently in the breeze, marked with the name of the grotto.  On one side, a collection of small, intricate seashells is displayed in a small netted pouch, their delicate forms a contrast to the rugged surroundings.

title: [Drake Harbor, Pier Five]
description: Charcoal grey wood planks span the length of the pier, supported by stark white travertine pillars.  Copper rings are set into the pillars for securing boats, their polished surfaces gleaming in the moonlight.  Small, colorful fish swim in the clear waters beneath the dock.

title: [Drake Harbor, Pier Five]
description: White travertine pillars support the dock's charcoal grey wooden planks.  At regular intervals, large wicker baskets filled with seashells are placed along the edge of the pier, their contents glistening with seawater.  The air is filled with the sound of waves and the distant cries of seabirds.

title: [Drake Harbor, Pier Five]
description: Charcoal grey wood planks stretch across the pier, supported by white travertine pillars.  Wooden buoys, weathered and worn, are attached to the pillars along the dock's length.  Clear aquamarine waters reveal a sandy bottom scattered with shells.

title: [Drake Harbor, Pier Five]
description: Weathered wooden planks extend outward from the dock, upheld by white travertine columns etched with deep fluting.  A weathered nautical flag flutters gently from a tall mast lashed to the pier's edge, its colors muted by salt and sun.  Light filters through the clear, aquamarine water, casting shimmering patterns on the sandy bottom below.

title: [Drake Harbor, Pier Five]
description: At the pier's end, a broad platform stretches over shimmering aquamarine waters.  Embedded into the wooden planks, a timeworn mariner's compass appears battered from both the weather and regular use.  Leaning against the sturdy railing, fishing rods await their next adventure.  Beyond the platform, the horizon blends sky and sea, offering a breathtaking view of the open waters.

title: [Drake Harbor, Pier Four]
description: Gleaming in the ambient lighting, white travertine pillars support the dock's weathered wooden planks.  At regular intervals, wooden benches are attached to the pillars, offering a place to sit and enjoy the view.  The air is filled with the scent of salt and seaweed, mingling with the faint aroma of fresh fish.

title: [Drake Harbor, Pier Four]
description: Charcoal grey wooden planks are flanked by stark white travertine pillars, the combination creating a sprawling dock system.  Weather vanes are mounted atop the pillars, their intricate designs spinning gently in the breeze.  Beneath the pier, the aquamarine waters shimmer with the reflection of the sky.

title: [Drake Harbor, Pier Four]
description: White travertine pillars rise from the water, supporting the pier's dark grey planks.  Wooden crates filled with exotic fruits are stacked along the edge, their bright colors contrasting with the dark wood.  The distant greenery atop the cliff provides a lush backdrop to the scene.

title: [Drake Harbor, Pier Four]
description: Extending into the aquamarine waters, the pier features charcoal grey wooden planks bordered by white travertine columns.  Glass fishing floats hang from the pillars, their surfaces clouded by years of exposure to the sea.  The gentle rocking of the dock creates a soothing rhythm, blending with the soft lapping of waves against the sturdy structure.

title: [Drake Harbor, Pier Four]
description: Suspended from a sturdy frame at the pier's end, a grand bronze harbor bell stands watch over the waters.  Next to it, a weathered sea chest, darkened by years of exposure, rests firmly on the planks.  Aquamarine waters lap gently against the dock, their rhythmic movement a constant companion to the bell's silent presence.

title: [Drake Harbor, Pier Three]
description: The pier's charcoal grey planks are bordered by white travertine pillars.  Along the length of the dock, darkened iron rings are set into the planks for securing boats.  A pile of coarse fishing nets rests near the center, their coarse fibers interwoven with bits of seaweed.

title: [Drake Harbor, Pier Three]
description: Stark white travertine pillars rise from the aquamarine waters, supporting the dock's charcoal grey planks.  Suspended from the pillars are wooden birdhouses, each one uniquely painted and adorned with seashells.  The distant greenery atop the nearby cliffs is just visible through the haze of sea mist.

title: [Drake Harbor, Pier Three]
description: Weathered, charcoal grey planks stretch across the pier, supported by white travertine columns.  Scattered along the dock are small barrels filled with fresh water, their lids secured tightly to prevent spillage.  The soft murmur of the ocean is punctuated by the occasional cry of seabirds.

title: [Drake Harbor, Pier Three]
description: The pier, fashioned of charcoal grey wood, is held up by stark white travertine pillars.  Coils of thick, tarred rope lie neatly coiled at the base of each pillar, their surfaces sticky and dark.  Small colorful fish dart through the clear, aquamarine waters beneath the dock.

title: [Drake Harbor, Pier Three]
description: Awash with the soft glow of several lanterns, the pier's end is spacious and open.  In the center, a wooden table holds navigation charts secured by small stones to prevent them from blowing away in the gentle seaborn breeze.  A faint haze of mist darkens the horizon, turning the aquamarine waters indigo further away from the encompassing light.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Pier Two]
description: Charcoal grey wooden planks stretch across the pier between stark white travertine pillars.  Bronze hooks are embedded into the pillars, holding fishing nets that flutter slightly in the breeze.  The sound of waves lapping against the dock is accompanied by the distant calls of seabirds.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Pier Two]
description: With its charcoal grey planks weathered by the sea, the dock is supported by white travertine pillars.  Clusters of barnacles cling to the lower sections of the pillars, their rough surfaces contrasting with the smooth stone above.  At the edge of the pier, a large coil of rope lies in a tangled heap.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Pier Two]
description: The pier extends over the aquamarine waters, its charcoal grey planks connected by white travertine pillars.  A row of smoking and illuminated copper lanterns hangs from the pillars, their glass panels fogged with salt spray.  Beneath the pier, schools of silver fish dart through the clear water, creating shadows that stretch and shrink with the tide.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Pier Two]
description: Stark white travertine pillars support the dock's charcoal grey planks.  Along the edge of the pier, small wooden crates filled with shellfish are stacked, their contents glistening with seawater.  The gentle rocking of the pier creates a soothing rhythm against the background of the ocean.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Pier Two]
description: Draped in long shadows, a rust-covered large iron anchor lies at the pier's edge, displaying its maritime antiquity for any that dare to look close enough.  A collection of buoys appears grey and silvered in the moonlight, the forgotten stack threatening to plunge into the night dark waters.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Pier One]
description: Glistening in the ambient light, damp charcoal grey planks stretch across the pier between stark white pillars of carved travertine.  Copper cleats are attached at regular intervals, their polished surfaces reflecting the aquamarine waters below.  Ropes coil near the base of the pillars, their fibers rough and weathered from the salty sea air.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Pier One]
description: Stretching out into the clear aquamarine water, the pier's charcoal grey wooden planks are bordered by white travertine pillars.  Large baskets brimming with freshly caught fish are set near the end of the dock, their woven sides wet with seawater.  The distant greenery atop the sheer cliff is barely visible against the skyline.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Pier One]
description: Built of charcoal grey wood, the dock extends between gleaming white travertine columns.  Tethered to the pillars are pots, their wooden frames darkened by constant exposure to the sea.  Seaweed clings to the lower portions of the dock, swaying gently with the tide.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Pier One]
description: Damp charcoal grey planks span the pier, held aloft by pristine white travertine pillars.  Cobalt blue and emerald green blown glass orbs dangle from the overhead ropes, catching the moonlight and casting colorful reflections onto the aquamarine waters below.  Waiting cargo crates are stacked neatly near the end of the pier.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Pier One]
description: The pier ends in a wide, open space surrounded by aquamarine waters.  A table stands at the center, with a detailed map carved into its surface.  Nearby, a ship-filled bottle showcases exquisite craftsmanship, capturing the essence of a grand vessel in miniature.

title: [Asterlight Athenaeum, Garden]
description: Ferns in autumn-hues rise around a small babbling brook where a gently arched wooden bridge provides access to other parts of the garden.  Surrounded by decorative blooms, a small red marl and travertine patio set with white wrought iron chairs and tables rests before a three-story vivid green library with cheerful yellow accents.  Off to one side, a small fountain is surrounded by blown glass hummingbird feeders and marble bird baths amid colorful butterfly weed bushes.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Ixia Ave]
description: Nestled beneath travertine terraces, a small avenue features the beginnings of a grand staircase that rises towards the cliffs above.  Carved into the stone, the steps resemble the scales of a dragon's back, and a pair of stone statues guards the ascent.  Surrounding the staircase are several vine-covered buildings, their walls adorned with blooming vines and their roofs covered in terracotta.  Clusters of cistus shrubs stretch between a white wooden gate and the open doors of a sturdy stable, their delicate blooms perfuming the air.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Ixia Ave]
description: Under a blanket of stars, azure waters shimmer across travertine terraces, forming cool pools that beckon passersby to visit for a nighttime dip.  Steam from the pools higher up the cliff forms a pale haze in the air that dances and sparkles as the starlight above twinkles.  Creating a cozy retreat, a cobalt blue sailcloth canopy arcs over a resting area illuminated by blown glass globes.  A solitary tamarisk tree, in full bloom, casts intricate shadows upon the starlight-illuminated travertine nearby with its twisted branches and looping roots.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Myna Way]
description: Bordered by tobacco wood benches, a narrow half-shell shelter housing a statue of Ronan sits along the northern edges of the travertine and red marl avenue under star-filled skies.  Blossoms of evening primrose, nocturnum orchids, night phlox, and deer-horn cactus lift their petals, heads held high in the cool night air.  Candles scattered throughout the shelter cast flickering light upon the pavers and form dancing shadows against the shelter's walls.  Opposite, a modest shop is surrounded by lofty junipers.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Myna Way]
description: Under starlight, shadows play within an ancient Ornathian maple, causing smoky bands of silvery light to tickle the wild foliage that decorates the ground.  The red marl and travertine pavers of the avenue fade into the rocky terrain around a massive marble temple.  Marble pillars gleam softly, reflecting the moonlight, while the opening in the domed roof frames the night sky, adding a touch of tranquility to the sacred and serene space.

title: [Tholos of Silence, Entry]
description: Framed in pillars, the entry departs from the grey, white, and moss green pebbles at the edge of the avenue and transitions seamlessly to grey-veined marble.  Above, the underside of terracotta pan tiles are visible as they shelter the entry, extending around the curve to the inner sanctuary into the surrounding corridor.  Enormous doors of ironwood stand open, allowing entry to the round room beyond.

title: [Tholos of Silence, North]
description: Pristine marble floors stretch from the inner sanctuary's smooth walls, disappearing beyond a series of pillars beneath a landscape comprised of thousands of smooth grey, white, and moss agate stones.  High above, copper lanterns are anchored to the terracotta roofing tiles, shedding golden light upon a nearby painted mural.  Sea breezes drift through the area, its cool, ethereal fingers causing a subtle, brief chill in the air.

title: [Tholos of Silence, Alcove]
description: Starlight filters through the intricately carved pillars, casting a gentle, silver radiance on the grey-veined marble floor of the tholos.  Built into the curving eastern wall of the inner sanctuary and almost touching the terracotta ceiling, an illuminated floor-to-ceiling alcove houses a carved stone statue of Gosaena.  A small, banded altar of gneiss rests at the statue's bare feet.

title: [Tholos of Silence, South]
description: Sheltered from the elements by terracotta tiles, the corridor of the tholos follows the circumference of the inner sanctuary on one side and is framed by high pillars on the other.  Dominating the sanctum's wall is a detailed mural, its edges painted in a nebulous effect that causes it to fade instead of having a clearly defined border.  Beyond the pillars, a rock garden stretches from the temple's steps to distant, conical-shaped thuja trees.

title: [Tholos of Silence, Sanctuary]
description: Creating a haze of silver, starlight filters through the open ceiling above, painting the sanctuary in a dim glow that causes the unornamented marble walls to seem ethereal.  Heady fragrances fill the air at the heart of the space, their source the large, flower-filled urns placed around an alabaster altar that sits upon a raised dais.  Enormous ironwood doors painted in a wash of moss green flank the exit, each piece carved with a silver scythe.

title: [Tholos of Silence, Altar]
description: Enormous urns of calla lilies, hyssop, and ligularia rest upon the alabaster altar, which is illuminated by the soft glow of starlight filtering through the open dome above.  Smooth and cool to the touch, the stone's surface is devoid of carvings, though the steps leading down the dais and into the sanctuary are heavy with battlefield frescos.  A sense of peaceful quietude fills the air.

title: [Tholos of Silence, Crypt]
description: Despite the lack of airflow, the underground chamber is humid but much cooler than the rooms above.  Marble walls and floors are polished to a high, reflective sheen, allowing the scant handful of shielded lanterns to keep the space in a twilight-like glow.  Hundreds of niches decorate the walls, each filled with large and small urns surrounded by simple offerings of dried flowers, candles, or incense.  A long white bench rests at the center of the chamber, and a set of wall-hugging stone steps provide egress.

title: [The Moonlit Mercy]
description: Flung wide to admit the cool night air, the surrounding windows are devoid of glass, allowing the silvery starlight to slant across the ebonwood floorboards in long bands of luminous light.  Blown glass orbs collect in the ceiling and are arranged in celestial patterns, their soft glow illuminating a serving counter and silver-handled dark oak armoires.  Soft whispers fill the air as white-robed acolytes provide blessings to those that visit.

title: [Travertine Terrace, Canopy]
description: Smooth and subtly textured, the ground beneath the cobalt blue canopy is fashioned of planned travertine.  Brightly colored cushions are scattered about the wide area, forming small and large social circles around low cedar tables covered in chilled offerings.  Several smaller, kidney-shaped pools of azure water naturally form to the north and east, each one filled from those higher up the steep incline.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Ixia Ave]
description: Starlight paints the Spine of Koar in silver light, the great staircase a shadowy backdrop to the red marl and travertine avenue.  Surrounded in long, sword-shaped leaves, star-shaped ixia rise along the undeveloped landscape to the northwest amid tightly furled, purple-tipped oxalis.  Opposite, a bright blue boutique with a white shutter door stands open to visitors, lamplight spilling from its windows.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Ixia Ave]
description: Starlight casts a silvery glow on an opulent bank's grand domed roof, emphasizing its elegant design and smooth curves.  Marble walls with golden accents give off a subtle glimmer as they reflect the light of nearby blown glass lanterns.  Whorled heather, kriti, sea spurge, and fan palms frame the building, their slender fronds and pale blossoms painted in gradient shades of silver and grey.  Broad marble steps, veined in gold and grey, proceed from the avenue up to the doors, which stand open and inviting.

title: [Isle of Ornath Bank, Lobby]
description: Grey and gold-veined marble sprawl across the floor, the highly polished surface reflecting the sunlight that spills through the glass windows at the base of the pendentive dome above.  Golden linden inlay at the heart of the floor creates a compass rose that is wreathed by calligraphed words.  Limestone pillars, in groups of three, rise from the eight points of the pentagonal room, each group supporting arches over the branching hallways.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, out

title: [Northwatch Bank, Lobby]
description: Polished white marble floors reflect the lights of pendant lanterns anchored to the ceiling, the combination of reflected light and soft glow from above effectively illuminating the space and dispelling any chance of shadows.  An arched corridor leads back to the central lobby of the bank, while twin arches in both the west and east provide services.  Cushioned in velveteen, a series of seats encircle a miniature Oblin spruce.

title: [Northwatch Bank, Collections]
description: Mimicking skylights, frosted glass panels framed in pine accents are anchored to the ceiling, diffusing the light of lanterns and creating a soft glow through the office.  Supported by darkened iron, the large desk is fashioned of a sturdy piece of dark-stained elm and stands prominently at the heart of the room.  Beyond the clerk-attended piece is a tapestry of winter landscapes that almost hides the marble walls.

title: [Northwatch Bank]
description: Brightly lit by overhead pendant lanterns, the counter area features intricate carvings of snowflakes and mountain ranges on the marble teller counters, each conveying icy landscapes in brilliant detail.  Behind the counters, a mural showcases fjords and mountains, conveying a coldness not easily felt within the humid space.

title: [Bank, Western Branch]
description: Crowned in a small dome, the lobby is a nexus for multiple banks and collection offices.  A central archway heads eastward towards the central entry, while the northern and southern walls are a hive of arches.  Pendant lanterns issue a steady white glow, keeping the space free of shadows and brightly illuminated.  Cushioned in velveteen, a series of seats encircle a potted and groomed juniper.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Vornavis Bank]
description: Brass rods anchored to the white marble walls support long swathes of emerald green Vornavian silk, the unfettered ends pooling upon the polished floors.  A massive chandelier hovers over the space, illuminating the various teller counters fashioned of golden linden and carved with elegant swans with splayed wings.  An enterprising employee has roughly carved an orange-red lobster into the lower left corner of one counter, its claws open at the regal bird's webbed feet.  Beyond the counters is a mural.

title: [Torren Bank, Collections]
description: Smooth marble walls and vaulted ceilings create a crisp, professional setting in the debt collection office.  A one-eared Torren debt collector, dressed in garish pickle green robes, sits behind a desk of polished mahogany, its edges adorned with subtle carvings of scrollwork and stork feathers.  Behind the desk, a mural depicting the Tower of the Sea Princess sprawls across the wall.  A large brass inkwell shaped like a ship's anchor sits on the desk, while a copper hourglass filled with blue sand rests on a nearby shelf.

title: [Seareach Bank, Collections]
description: Carved with the Sunriders' emblem, a red cutlass before a golden sun, a high-backed wooden chair dominates one corner of the office.  Sand from the Sea of Fire encased in sand-filled jars lines the shelves, with labels denoting various tribal regions.  An iron-bound ledger rests on a sturdy desk, its cover embossed with the seal of Seareach.  Behind the desk, a clerk in canary yellow robes moves about the space handling patrons as well as other organizational tasks.

title: [Seareach Bank]
description: Pendant lanterns dangle over the area, casting a warm glow over deep blue tapestries adorned with the red eagle crest of Seareach.  Gold-trimmed display cases house snakestones in hues of green and blue, the carved pieces arranged upon copper-hued velvet.  A polished marble counter with swirling patterns of sand and sea stands before a wall of intricate mosaics that depict the coastal trade routes of Brisker's Cove.  Tanned bankers work behind the counter.

title: [Vornavis Bank, Collections]
description: Smooth marble walls, veined with delicate streaks of green, frame the collection office.  Brass sconces, shaped like graceful swans with outstretched wings, hold aloft glass globes that cast a warm, steady glow over the room.  At the center of the office stands a heavy desk of dark walnut, its surface meticulously inlaid with a mosaic of emerald and gold that forms the Vornavian crest.  Behind the desk, a tall bookshelf displays rows of leather-bound ledgers, each spine embossed with a different year.

title: [Torren Bank]
description: Sunlight filters through narrow, gold-trimmed windows, warming the white marble walls.  Gold-accented counters are carved with river motifs, depicting swirling currents and leaping fish.  A brass rod supports a canopy of light blue silk, embroidered with Torre's white stork crest.  The far wall features a mural of Torre's docks, where storks swoop over anchored ships.  Pendant lanterns, with copper stork bodies and etched glass panels, hang overhead, casting a soft, steady light.

title: [Landing Bank, Lobby]
description: Polished white marble floors reflect the lights of pendant lanterns anchored to the ceiling, the combination of reflected light and soft glow from above effectively illuminating the space and dispelling any chance of shadows.  An arched corridor leads back to the central lobby of the bank, while twin arches in both the southwest and northeast provide services.  Cushioned in velveteen, a series of seats encircle a potted speckled alder.

title: [Landing Bank]
description: Transforming the opulent space, wooden beams of roughly hewn modwir are installed under the vaulted ceiling, causing the pendant lanterns to cast lattice-like shadows upon the floor.  Alternating oak and pine planks create a false wall designed to hide some of the white marble, its face covered in a chaotic mural in bright colors.  Protected by guards, tellers work from a pair of high counters, a potbellied stove resting between them.

title: [Landing Bank, Collections]
description: Marble walls adorned with a variety of artwork feature gold veining that spiderwebs across their polished surfaces, glinting in the light of pendant lanterns high above.  Dominating one side of the office is a large vault door carved with intricate Saramar runes and surrounded by six keyholes and a numbered dial.  Rustically carved pine shelves, garish against the marble, are filled with ledgers and tomes.  These shelves crowd around a utilitarian desk of carved maple, where a demure giantman debt collector studiously works.

title: [Southwestern Branch]
description: Crowned in a small dome, the lobby is a nexus for multiple banks and collection offices.  A central archway heads eastward towards the central entry, while the northern and southern walls are a hive of arches.  Pendant lanterns issue a steady white glow, keeping the space free shadows and brightly illuminated.  Cushioned in velveteen, a series of seats encircle a potted blooming canver tree.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Bank of Phyon, Collections]
description: White marble and gilded accents form a refined backdrop in the collections chamber within this section of the bank.  A polished mahogany desk with intricate inlays stands along one wall, while a mural of distant coastal vistas spans another.  Nearby, a bookcase filled with neatly arranged ledgers catches the soft light reflecting off the marble floor.

title: [Bank of Teras Isle, Collections]
description: Dark, polished stone from Teras darkens the surrounding white marble, creating an imposing yet refined atmosphere.  Behind the heavy, iron-banded desk sits a grizzled dwarven debt collector, his beard as braided as the intricate carvings on the desk.  A massive iron safe with ornate gold details dominates one corner, its face emblazoned with monikers of the Borthuum Company and Kharam Dzu.  On the opposite wall, a tapestry illustrates the long journey from Teras Isle to Ornath, featuring ships navigating treacherous seas.

title: [Bank of Teras Isle]
description: Rich granite from Teras Isle lines the lower walls, contrasting beautifully with the white marble.  Gold veins, naturally running through the stone, shimmer under the pendant lanterns.  Central to the room is a teller counter, forged from Terasian ironwood, detailed with hammered gold, and shaped like waves crashing against the shoreline.  Above, a large mural depicts the ancient volcano of Teras, with dwarven miners chipping away at its base.

title: [Bank of the Folly]
description: Mahogany counters arranged side-to-side form a horseshoe shape at the center of the space, their high sides intricately carved with repeating kraken motifs.  Beyond, a large, circular mural depicts azure and indigo waters with frothy white waves where the many tentacles of a kraken emerges from the depths.  Pendant lanterns of blended sea glass and black iron shed their wavering light upon coastal-themed artwork that hangs on the walls between the booths and the lobby beyond.

title: [Bank of the Folly, Collections]
description: Surrounded by crowded shelves littered with ledger books, nautical charts, and a variety of bric-a-brac, the office has a cramped appearance.  An enormous desk, its surface largely bare, sits at the center of the space and is surrounded by several stools that create a companionable space as if the clerk were having a gathering instead of collecting debt.  One marble wall is devoid of shelves, its surface instead covered by an enormous map of Kraken's Fall.

title: [Bank of Phyon]
description: White marble walls and gilded accents lend a sense of refinement to the chamber, where several teller booths stand in a neat row.  A large black oak-framed painting dominates one wall, depicting a vast glacier with an outpost nestled at its edge, its icy expanse rendered in sharp, crisp strokes.  Opposite the painting, a grand brass chandelier hangs from the high ceiling, its curved arms supporting frosted glass globes that diffuse a soft, even glow throughout the space.

title: [Bank, Eastern Branch]
description: Slipping past the limestone pillars in the west and east, the corridor is lined in stained glass windows that paint the marble walls and floor in prismatic colors.  An arched ceiling composed of bas-relief filigree patterns covers the corridor, the filigree designs converging upon the chained anchors of pendant lanterns.  Decorative linden benches rest within the pooled light that spills from above.

title: [City-States Bank, Lobby]
description: Polished white marble floors reflect the lights of pendant lanterns anchored to the ceiling, the combination of reflected light and soft glow from above effectively illuminating the space and dispelling any chance of shadows.  An arched corridor leads back to the central lobby of the bank, while twin arches in both the northwest and southeast provide services.  Cushioned in velveteen, a series of seats encircle a potted dwarf resaeun sculpted into a full cascade.

title: [City-States Bank]
description: Polished white marble floors reflect the lights of pendant lanterns anchored to the ceiling, the combination of reflected light and soft glow from recessed windows above effectively illuminating the space.  Arched wooden counters crafted from ancient, dusky haon line one side, each adorned with delicate silver inlays depicting various elven city-states.  Painted within panels upon the surrounding walls, a variety of murals offer bright splashes of color against the austerity of the surrounding marble.

title: [City-States Bank, Collections]
description: Tall bookcases line the walls, filled with ancient tomes and scrolls bound in rich, deep green and brown leathers, meticulously organized and labeled in flowing elven script.  At the center, an imposing desk made from polished ebony wood sits, its surface clean except for a single ornate inkwell and quill.  Standing behind the desk is a silk-veiled tanned elven collector, his back to a lattice-framed mural depicting a serene elven garden.

title: [Cysaegir Bank, Lobby]
description: Polished white marble floors reflect the lights of pendant lanterns anchored to the ceiling, the combination of reflected light and soft glow from above effectively illuminating the space and dispelling any chance of shadows.  An arched corridor leads back to the central lobby of the bank, while twin arches in both the northeast and southwest provide services.  Cushioned in velveteen, a series of seats encircle a pruned dwarf zydris.

title: [Cysaegir Bank, Collections]
description: Bright colors and light zydris accents bring a touch of Cysaegir into the marble halls of the bank.  Polished white floors reflect the natural light streaming through large windows recessed into the ceiling, while pendant lanterns supplement the lighting as needed.  The walls are adorned with delicate zydris carvings, showcasing platform trees amid ambling brooks.  A desk of golden zydris with intricate grain lines stands as the centerpiece, its surface meticulously organized with ledgers and scrolls.

title: [Cysaegir Bank]
description: Polished granite counters line the walls, each one adorned with free-flowing flyrsilk banners in vibrant hues.  Soft, ambient light filters through translucent panels anchored to the ceiling, each depicting dragonflies in flight, their wings catching the light and casting intricate patterns on the floor.  Between the counters, murals of Cysaegir are arranged amid those of Cysaelotar.

title: [Bank of Zul Logoth, Lobby]
description: Polished white marble floors reflect the lights of pendant lanterns anchored to the ceiling, the combination of reflected light and soft glow from above effectively illuminating the space and dispelling any chance of shadows.  An arched corridor leads back to the central lobby of the bank, while twin arches in both the northwest and southeast provide services.  Cushioned in velveteen, a series of seats encircle a carved stone tree.

title: [Bank of Zul Logoth, Collections]
description: Dimly lit by frosted glass lanterns, the office features smooth marble walls inlaid with decorative stone patterns.  A carved desk, fashioned from a solid piece of black basalt, stands near a display of finely cut geodes, showcasing the dwarven craftsmanship and each pieces natural beauty.  Fidgeting slightly, a rotund dwarven clerk moves between the display, the corridor opening, and the desk.

title: [Bank of Zul Logoth]
description: Vaulted ceilings and pendant lanterns illuminate the teller counters, which are hewn from polished granite with shimmering gold veins.  Behind the counters, an enormous wall mosaic crafted of veniom depicts Eonak at his forge.  Geodes of varying sizes and colors are embedded into the stonework, adding a touch of natural beauty to the room.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Ixia Ave]
description: Framed by towering fan palm trees, the red marl and travertine avenue stretches to the southeast, while a smaller street of cobblestones departs from the main thoroughfare in a southwesterly direction.  Single story homes decorated with shutters and terra cotta roofs are built along the northwest and have small, pebbled pathways that connect them to the avenue.  Beyond the quaint abodes, the ground gives way to raw granite before plunging into the sea.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Ixia Ave]
description: Storax trees cast long shadows over a fenced shipyard.  Moonlight illuminates the area, with the wooden hulls creating dramatic silhouettes.  A calm settles over the shipyard, contrasting with the daytime hustle and bustle.  Starlight spills through carob and apricot trees that line a street to southwest, causing the cobbles to wear dabbled shadows.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Fig Lane]
description: Starlight filters through the dense canopies of apricot and carob trees, casting faint, dappled patterns across the cobbled lane.  A bright yellow stucco building on one side glimmers softly, its vibrant hue muted to a pale glow in the dim light.  Opposite, the tangled flora appears as a dark, shifting silhouette, its blooms barely visible but perfumed with a faint, sweet fragrance.  The air is cool and quiet, carrying the distant murmur of waves and the occasional rustle of leaves.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Fig Lane]
description: Set just beneath a gentle incline to the north, the cobblestone lane spreads into a crescent-shaped courtyard bordered by modest homes and shops, all topped with terra-cotta roofs and accented by bright white shutters.  Resting at the center, a copper and stained glass fountain sits, filling the air with the soft sounds of trickling water.  Along the north end is a greenhouse surrounded by an herbaceous garden, while the south end supports a copper-roofed locksmith shop.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Yuzu Way]
description: Perched at the crest of the gentle incline, a stately kermes oak spreads its vast canopy, casting intricate shadows over the cobblestone below, as well as the neighboring pawnshop and store.  The oak's gnarled branches cradle the breeze, their leaves rustling in soothing whispers.  Growing between the tree's lateral, ropey roots and along the edges of the street, wildflowers flourish in an untamed riot of color, crowding the street corners and spilling over the worn stones.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Yuzu Way]
description: Silvery moonlight settles over the cobblestone street, outlining lime-washed floral designs in a gentle glow.  Lanterns sway among the apricot, carob, and tamarisk branches, their warm, golden light casting playful shadows that drift across the lane.  Deep hues cloak a bright red shop facing a three-story vivid green library, each struture decorated in shutters that are touched by the subtle silvery light.  Pampas grass near the roadside sways in the starlight, its feathery plumes resembling strands of luminous silk.

title: [Reef's Radiance, Entry]
description: Bright white shutters with heavy slats decorate the walls, leaving the entry and flanking windows wide open to the starlight and the cool evening breeze.  Drifting amid cabinets and display cases, the half-elven jeweler Asmora tends to customers when not working on new jewelry pieces at a nearby workbench.  The jewelry on display glitters in the ambient light created by wall-hung lanterns, creating prismatic hues on the white stucco walls.

title: [Reef's Radiance, Backroom]
description: Wrought iron lanterns hang overhead, casting warm illumination across an array of display cases that showcase refurbished wares.  Crushed velvet blankets, chosen for their neutral tone, rest beneath protective glass, letting each item stand out on its own merits.  The layout of the cases allows ample space for viewing, while windows set high along the walls invite a gentle breeze that brushes past decorative hangings.

title: [Reef's Radiance, Appraiser]
description: Devoid of windows, the small shop room is nonetheless brighter due to the lanterns that hang from the exposed rafters.  Bright white paint decorates the walls and ceiling, though the floor is fashioned of lacquered teak.  Working behind a counter, the half-elven jeweler Celamyr appraises a variety of jewelry and gemstones when not greeting customers.

title: [Asterlight Athenaeum, Entry]
description: Warm light floods the library, spilling from large-globed lanterns that perch upon railing tops, as well as the surface of a round circulation desk that is attended by a willow-thin human librarian.  Forming a clover-shaped arch over both the entry and exit, a set of staircases fashioned of dark-burled camphor stained a reddish gold hue provide access to the floor above.  Railings and shelves in matching tones decorate the teal walls as they climb towards an enormous iron and glass skylight that is recessed into the domed ceiling.

title: [Boughs of the Kermes Oak]
description: Silvery starlight filters through the leafy boughs above, casting long, dappled bands of light across a platform nestled high in the kermes oak.  Wooden planks, bound tightly by rope in intricate, decorative knots, form the sturdy floor, their grain weathered but smooth.  Cushions in muted tones are scattered across the space, offering small comforts amid the rustling leaves.  Beyond the edge of the platform, the small harbor town sprawls below, its rooftops glinting faintly in the moonlit view.

title: [Scales of Trade Pawn, Entry]
description: Teak walls frame the shop's interior, their surfaces lined with shelves displaying trinkets, oddities, and small treasures.  A long counter with a smooth, worn top runs along one side, its drawers filled with ledgers and cloth-wrapped parcels.  Several cases hold polished jewelry and rare coins, their surfaces reflecting the glow of hanging lanterns.  Braided rugs cover the floor, softening footsteps, while narrow windows let in gentle sea breezes.  A ladder leans against a corner shelf stacked with books.

title: [Scales of Trade Pawn, Wares]
description: Set apart from the main room, the enclosed chamber is softly illuminated by hanging lamps, their warm glow casting gentle shadows across the walls.  Long wooden tables stretch in neat rows, each carefully arranged with items for resale.  Glass-shielded shelves along the walls hold several trinkets and curios on display that are not for sale, while overlapping braided rugs underfoot muffle sound.

title: [The Mistrift Sanctum]
description: Turquoise walls shimmer softly as arcs of electricity leap between suspended lightning rods, casting fleeting patterns of light across polished yellow pine floors.  Silver and gold celestial symbols frame the doorways, their intricate designs catching and scattering the flickering glow.  Near the back of the room, a dark wooden counter stands quietly, its surface marked with faint scorch lines.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Ixia Ave]
description: Sprawling across the southern terminus of the marl and travertine avenue is a single-story villa, its white stucco walls and terracotta roof visible in the moonlight against the dark blue sea behind it.  Shutter-framed, arched windows and wide doorways allow the sea breeze to enter the building.  Verandas featuring flowering vines of clematis and copper tea flowers decorate the front of the villa, while gardens filled with spiny restharrow, autumn squill, and craspedia create a diverse landscape.

title: [Harbor's Echo Inn, Foyer]
description: Wide floor-to-ceiling windows stand closed to the cool island breezes, their glassless faces covered by storm shutters that are tilted ever so slightly to retain a view of the gardens beyond.  Grey-streaked tobacco wood lends an earthy rustic air to the foyer, while blue slate tiles glisten in the moonlight.  Rattan chairs provide space for reclining, allowing guests to recline without interruption.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, out

title: [Harbor's Echo Inn, Front Hall]
description: Gazing out onto sweeping verandas, the wide floor-to-ceiling windows of the hallway are covered in rainbow-whorled glass that subtly warps the view beyond.  Surrounding tobacco wood walls are washed in monochromatic hues as moonlight slips through the windows to paint them with an ethereal touch.  The quiet murmur of guests enjoying a meal spills out of a pair of white shutter doors.

title: [Harbor's Echo Inn, Front Desk]
description: Arranged along the northern wall, a refurbished tobacco wood desk is attended by a young half-elven clerk who greets visitors and answers questions with aplomb.  Several hooks with either tags or keys hang upon the wall, each tidily labeled with a room number, and a wide cork message board allows visitors and locals to leave notes for one another.  The eastern and southern corridors lead toward the inn's guest rooms, while a door to the southeast offers egress.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, northwest, out

title: [Harbor's Echo Inn, Guest Hall]
description: Wide windows dominate the southern and eastern walls, the pristine and polished glass providing a view of the outside veranda and the ocean beyond.  Large vases filled with flowers rest beneath their bright white sills.  Frosted globes emit soft illumination as they dangle over the striped teak and tobacco wood floors.  Beside each other in the northern wall are a pair of frosted glass doors leading to the inn's guest rooms.  One is decorated with an etched rose, and the other, an etched wren.

title: [The Rose Room]
description: Refurbished tobacco wood furnishings fill the air with an earthy aroma that is sweetened by the delicate citrus and sweet clover notes of the coral and tangerine-hued ranunculus that fill the porcelain vase in one corner of the room.  An enormous bed covered in a thick comforter dominates the cobalt blue-tiled floor, while an ivory porcelain wash basin rests upon a nearby bureau.  Ebon-framed sketches decorate the stucco walls, each depicting roses in various states of bloom.

title: [The Wren Room]
description: Refurbished tobacco wood furnishings fill the air with an earthy aroma that is sweetened by the delicate citrus and sweet clover notes of the parchment white and plum ranunculus that fill the porcelain vase in one corner of the room.  An enormous bed covered in a thick comforter dominates the cobalt blue-tiled floor, while an ivory porcelain wash basin rests upon a nearby bureau.  Ebon-framed sketches decorate the stucco walls, each depicting wrens in various stages of life.

title: [Harbor's Echo Inn, Guest Hall]
description: Wide windows dominate the southern and eastern walls, the pristine and polished glass providing a view of the outside veranda and the ocean beyond.  Large vases filled with flowers rest beneath their bright white sills.  Frosted globes emit soft illumination as they dangle over the striped teak and tobacco wood floors.  Beside each other in the northern wall are a pair of frosted glass doors leading to the inn's guest rooms.  One door is decorated with an etched crab, and the other door, an etched shell.

title: [The Crab Room]
description: Refurbished tobacco wood furnishings fill the air with an earthy aroma that is sweetened by the delicate citrus and sweet clover notes of the bright red and sunny yellow ranunculus that fill the porcelain vase in one corner of the room.  An enormous bed covered in a thick comforter dominates the cobalt blue-tiled floor, while an ivory porcelain wash basin rests upon a nearby bureau.  Stained glass mosaic tiles decorate the stucco walls, each depicting brightly colored abstract representations of crustaceans.

title: [The Shell Room]
description: Refurbished tobacco wood furnishings fill the air with an earthy aroma that is sweetened by the delicate citrus and sweet clover notes of the white-hearted dusky rose and green-hearted saffron yellow ranunculus that fill the porcelain vase in one corner of the room.  An enormous bed covered in a thick comforter dominates the cobalt blue-tiled floor, while an ivory porcelain wash basin rests upon a nearby bureau.  Ebon-framed watercolors depicting coastal scenes decorate the stucco walls.

title: [Harbor's Echo Inn, Front Hall]
description: Rich and warm, the scent of drying tobacco emanates from the surrounding repurposed wood walls.  Moonlight gives the hallway an ethereal cast as it streams through garden-facing windows to the west and south.  Providing a cheery contrast to the grey-streaked walls, nearly turquoise blue slate tiles spread across the floor.  The low murmur of voices spills out of a pair of white shutter doors.

title: [Harbor's Echo Inn, Bar]
description: Devoid of windows, the small bar is dimly lit, a swirl of tobacco smoke dancing in its rafters.  Rattan-seated stools surround a long bar fashioned of repurposed tobacco wood, its smooth surface lacquered to a lustrous shine.  Large pieces of stuccowork decorate the grey-hued walls, the bright white composition providing a stark contrast to the wood beneath.

title: [Harbor's Echo Inn, Veranda]
description: Polygonal pavers fashioned of stones in dark grey form the round-edged floor of the veranda.  Bright white grout, the same vibrancy as the stucco that adorns the inn, gleams in the moonlight.  Decorative flowers, produced by painting on the stone with lime, sit at the center of each stone.  Scattered about, cobalt blue wicker chairs recline amid large terracotta urns teaming with verdant growth.  A pair of blue shutter doors provide entry to the inn.

title: [Harbor's Echo Inn, Veranda]
description: Offering a view of the sprawling coastline, the stone-paved veranda is surrounded by a low wall of red-tipped photinia.  Terracotta urns rest against the living wall, providing a vibrant contrast to the russet-hued foliage.  Positioned at an angle to each other, a pair of cobalt blue wicker chairs are set before a wide glass window built into the face of the inn, their seats covered in bright white cushions.

title: [Wavesong Grotto, Approach]
description: White-washed stone gives way to a gravel path that crunches beneath each step, winding through tall, swaying beachgrasses.  White sand presses up against the edges of the walkway, blending seamlessly with the soft hues of white and grey pebbles underfoot.  To the southwest, the pier of Sleeping Drake Harbor sprawl, its edges lined with bobbing boats.  To the southeast, turquoise waves sparkle, broken by travertine statues that rise elegantly from the water's surface.

title: [Wavesong Grotto, Walkway]
description: Curving along the edge of the grotto, the path reveals a stunning inlet carved from the shoreline, its shape resembling a perfect slice of pie.  Blue waters shimmer over white sands flecked with mica, each grain catching the ambient light with a soft sparkle.  Across the inlet, the cliffs of the Agora Promenade rise dramatically, their rugged faces touched by shifting hues.  Nearby, travertine statues stand in elegant relief, their intricate forms more visible against the calm waves.

title: [Wavesong Grotto, Walkway]
description: Beneath the towering cliffs, the grotto glows with kaleidoscope-like hues as jute-knotted glass fishing orbs light up the water.  Their soft, shifting colors ripple across the waves, casting the surrounding statues in ethereal shades of blue, green, and amber.  The carved wing of the Spine of Koar gleams faintly in the moonlight high above, lending an ethereal beauty to the shadowed cliffs and shimmering waters.

title: [Wavesong Grotto, White Beach]
description: White sands curve gracefully along the grotto's edge, where rough oak steps lead down to clusters of oyster beds and shimmering tidal pools that mirror turquoise waters.  In these shallow pools, tiny marine life flits among patches of seaweed, while a long driftwood table nearby displays assorted wares designed to house pearls.

title: [Wavesong Grotto, Oyster Pools]
description: Rough oak steps lead upward from glistening kidney-shaped tidal pools to a stretch of white sand, their surfaces weathered by salt and time.  Amid the pools and dunes, a copper-bound rough oak barrel stands beside a shucking oyster harvester, its form worn yet unmistakably functional.  Shallow waters mirror the sky, capturing fleeting images of drifting marine life along the rugged shore.

title: [Wavesong Grotto, Walkway]
description: Gravel slopes gently southwest, revealing piers where boats rock lazily in the turquoise waters just beyond a sturdy protective railing.  Behind the walkway, verdant bushes heavy with coral-hued roses add bursts of color, their fragrance mingling with the salt-tinged breeze.  Beachgrasses sway in rhythmic waves alongside the stone path, where white and grey pebbles crunch softly underfoot.

title: [Harbor's Echo Inn, Veranda]
description: Offering a view of the sprawling coastline, the stone-paved veranda is surrounded by a low wall of red-tipped photinia.  Terracotta urns rest against the wall, providing a vibrant contrast to the russet-hued foliage.  Positioned at an angle to each other, a pair of cobalt blue wicker chairs are set before a wide glass window built into the face of the inn, their seats covered in bright white cushions.

title: [The Ocean Spirit]
description: Whitewashed walls serve as the shop's backdrop, adorned with delicate sketches of island wildflowers.  Sporadic splashes of color highlight select blooms, adding strategic accents.  Wide, open windows invite natural light and sea breezes, while frosted teardrop globes suspended from the ceiling cast a soft glow.  A long counter spans the center of the room, dividing the space, while racks and hooks display garments.  In one corner, a freckled half-elven seamstress works quietly, her needle moving with steady precision.

title: [Asterlight Athenaeum, Tier 2]
description: Curving around the atrium, the second floor frames the grand circulation desk below, its presence marked by a tile mosaic in teal, white, and canary yellow.  Towering bookcases stretch toward the vaulted ceiling, their warm wood tones complementing white wrought iron railings.  Lanterns perch atop the posts, casting dappled light across the floor.  Above, staircases spiral toward the next level, their curves forming a clover arch over a quiet reading alcove nestled beneath its embrace.

title: [Asterlight Athenaeum, Tier 3]
description: Rising to teal-painted walls and a white stucco dome, this floor curves beneath a vast skylight, its iron framework supporting beveled glass panes that flood the space with sunlight.  Clover-shaped arches frame the upper level, their carved edges accentuating the graceful design while providing reading nooks amid the towering bookcases.  Railings trace the perimeter in intricate, ivy-like patterns, while twin staircases of dark-burled camphor descend in sweeping curves, leading to the level below.

title: [Whispering Waves Stables, Entry]
description: Lofted ceilings are supported by exposed rafters, while long windows on the western and eastern walls are wide open to allow every bit of cooling air into the stifling stable.  Hay is stacked low to the ground, leaving room for the wide-bladed fans to spin from their secured place in the ceiling.  Turning slowly, the fans are attached to some kind of pulley system that disappears out one of the windows.

title: [Whispering Waves Stables, Stall]
description: Blackened iron latticework stretches across the ceiling, descending in filigreed designs to mark the confines of individual stalls built into the walls of the stable.  Windows high above keep air flowing through the structure, which is cool despite the humidity outside.  Rain barrels are arranged within the center of the corridor, their tops covered in mesh to keep unwanted pests at bay.

title: [Whispering Waves Stables, Stall]
description: Light-toned wood forms the doors of each stall, their hinges and handles a dark contrast of blackened wrought iron.  High above, a series of long windows greet the ceiling, their open faces providing a view of the sky above.  Along the southern wall, a series of racks house a variety of tools necessary for maintaining the cleanliness of the stables.

title: [Spine of Koar, Legs]
description: Stone steps wind through travertine terraces, rising alongside steaming mineral pools too hot for mortal flesh to enjoy.  The ancient stonework displays the marks of time, worn smooth by countless footsteps.  Carved into the rocky wall, a dragon's claw opens empty and inviting, its scales catching the starlight.  Iron lanterns hang from hooks, their stained glass panels casting vibrant reflections of red, blue, and green onto the travertine surfaces.

title: [Spine of Koar, Hips]
description: Widening slightly, the eastern section of the staircase has a small alcove filled with a stone bench and a large dragon egg sculpture nestled within creeping vines.  Steam from the surrounding travertine terraces cools in the night air, shimmering in the starlight as it dampens the surrounding stones.  Stone steps continue the ascent, their surface carved with scales while opposite, stairs descend towards a small harbor.

title: [Spine of Koar, Back]
description: Traversing a series of grand stone steps, the staircase meanders along the dragon's lower spine, offering sweeping views of the travertine terraces below.  Faintly warm mineral springs flow alongside, their gentle steam rising to the cool air.  Carved details of dragon scales cover the steps, their edges worn smooth by centuries of use.  Ornate iron lanterns, suspended from intricate brackets, cast a soft, ambient light that dances across the terraces' gleaming surfaces.

title: [Spine of Koar, Back]
description: Steps continue along the lower spine of the dragon carved into the slopping terrain, but here, one of the surrounding travertine pools has overflowed, cascading onto the stairs.  Charcoal grey planks span the flooded sections, creating a bridge over the shimmering, mineral-rich waters.  Moisture clings to the planks, glistening in the starlight.  Striations of white, beige, and rust in the surrounding stone highlight natural patterns formed by mineral deposits over millennia.

title: [Spine of Koar, Wings]
description: Steps wind upward, growing narrower as they ascend past jagged rock faces.  A flat expanse on the western wing supports a cafe, positioned directly across the mineral springs and pools that define the travertine terraces.  From the eastern side, a dramatic travertine arch is carved into the flanking wing and curves outward, creating a grand canopy that shelters the small establishment.

title: [Drakeshade Cafe, Entrance]
description: Steps carved like dragon scales slip past the broad landing as they pass the cafe's small entrance with their ascending and descending routes.  Flanked by low stone walls adorned with creeping thyme, this transition space offers a gathering place sheltered and shaded by the carved travertine wings above.  Iron railings, weathered by the sea air, frame the pathway, guiding visitors safely between areas.

title: [Drakeshade Cafe, Central Patio]
description: Small tables and chairs arranged under protective umbrellas in bright green and blue canvas fill the cafe space.  Serving as the heart of the establishment, a central circular bar has a variety of food and drink on offer for guests to purchase.  Mosaic flooring, with intricate patterns of blues and greens, complements the mineral pools' hues.

title: [Drakeshade Cafe, Overlook]
description: Offering a stunning view of the travertine terraces below and the sheer cliffs above, the veranda is encircled by stacked marl stones that form a protective wall.  Comfortable seating areas are arranged throughout the semi-circular space, their tops decorated in bright blue, green, and red cushions that offer a contrast to the stark white travertine of the area.

title: [Spine of Koar, Shoulders]
description: Winding steps dance across the spine of the dragon carved into the travertine and marl cliff and cut through its shoulders as it climbs past sweeping stone reliefs of a single serpentine arm.  The appendage extends dramatically outward, talons embedded into the cliff's face as if holding the mountain in a powerful embrace.  Delicate carvings highlight the dragon's form, merging with the natural travertine textures that frame the staircase.

title: [Spine of Koar, Neck]
description: Winding upward along the sinuous neck of the dragon carved into the stone, the staircase curves gently away from the cliff face as it ascends towards the head at one end and descends to the shoulders on the other.  Solid railings of dark iron guard against falls as both the eastern and western sides are open to the air.  A majestic view of the dragon's head reveals enormous aquamarine stones set in the eye sockets, their topaz centers glowing like twin suns.

title: [Spine of Koar, Head]
description: From this vantage point, a vast panorama of the island's terraces and distant horizons spreads out for all to see.  Curved and serpentine, the floor resembles the shape of an enormous dragon's head.  Stone steps, meticulously carved into the dragon's neck, wind their way downwards to the distant harbor and an ornate staircase ascends to the cliff's apex.  Ornate iron railings, adorned with intricate dragon motifs, feature lanterns whose colorful glass panes decorate the area in their prismatic light.

title: [Spine of Koar and Pentas Avenue]
description: Serving as a threshold to the staircase and an archway onto the avenue, a pair of imposing sculptures depict a robed woman reaching up to touch the snout of an enormous drake, whose head leans towards her in a gesture of respect.  Intricate gold-veined tiles form patterns upon the surrounding avenue, while travertine planters filled with succulents and white pebbles line the path.  Frosted globes recessed into nearby cypress trees illuminate the avenue.

title: [Bericsaba Market, North Ray]
description: Smooth dirt spreads across the circular clearing, its surface packed firm and traced with faint imprints of past visitors.  White marble pillars rise just south, their floral-plinth bases forming a quiet threshold to the colonnade beyond.  Northeast, a pebbled pathway of blue shale and red marl curves into the dense tangle of laurel, cypress, tamarisk, and juniper, vanishing beneath shifting layers of shade.  Near the edge, a rustic traveller's wagon stands beneath a canvas awning, marked by the scent of pigment and oil.

title: [A Deluge of Dyes]
description: Decorative copper wire is inlaid into the dark wood along the upper reaches of the paneled walls, the swirling designs chasing each other around the room.  Wrought iron lanterns shed their light from chains that dangle from the ceiling, their window panes etched with birds in flight.  Resting beside a pot-bellied stove, and built into the back of the wagon, is a curtained bed with drawers beneath, while a series of suspended ledges display dyes in glass bottles.

title: [Bericsaba Market, Colonnade]
description: Warm light fills the colonnade, spilling from stained glass lanterns suspended from the terracotta ceiling.  Shifting colors dance across the floor tiles and nearby vendors stalls, creating geometric patterns upon their surfaces in emerald, green, and amber.  Ribbons and banners stir lazily in the breeze, their ends curling and twisting about the pillars they are anchored to.  Murmured exchanges and the clink of coins drift through the air as a testament that the market is open despite the hour.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Bericsaba Market, Colonnade]
description: Cypress and thuja trees enclose the space in deepening shade, their branches shifting softly as night settles over the colonnade.  At the northeastern point, an open passage leads to a tile-lined patio, its surface glinting where light catches the smooth ceramic.  A wine vendor lingers near the edge, a vibrant cart adorned with glass baubles casting soft, fractured reflections across the stone.  Shadows deepen beyond the trees, their outlines shifting as the night air stirs the canopy.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Bericsaba Market, Northeast Ray]
description: Deep shade pools beneath towering thuja and cypress, their dense branches enclosing a secluded patio of smooth stone tiles.  Along the western edge, colorful ribbons stretch from the colonnade's roof to the treetops, their cobalt blue, yellow, and white strands rippling in the rising heat.  Flames dance within iron braziers, casting flickering light over the gathered sturdy chairs.  Shadows shift across the stone as embers crackle softly.  To the south, an arch of rambling roses spills dark blossoms over iron lattices.

title: [Bericsaba Market, Colonnade]
description: Faint embers glow in the firepit below, their warmth carrying the rich scent of slow-roasted meat through the eastern passage.  Shadows stretch along the tiled floor as torchlight flickers beneath the arches, casting shifting patterns across the stone.  A bread vendor lingers beneath a farm stand awning, arranging fresh loaves in quiet order.  To the west, the colonnade opens into a courtyard, its fountain reflecting the warm hues of nearby flames as water ripples in steady motion.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Bericsaba Market, East Ray]
description: Nestled between towering evergreens, stone tiles stretch beneath a canopy of shifting green.  A long firepit, its edges blackened with age, sits at the center, where a sturdy iron spit hangs over the embers.  A low granite counter curves along one side, its surface smooth and cool, scattered with wooden boards and empty clay bowls.  To the south, an arch of bougainvillea provides access to another cooking area, while opposite, a cascade of rambling roses drapes over a northern patio entrance.

title: [Bericsaba Market, Colonnade]
description: Thuja and cypress trees loom in quiet rhythm, their interwoven boughs creating a screen before a tile-lined patio where food vendors work over glowing embers.  Frosted glass lanterns cluster beneath the arches, their softened light pooling against the marble floor.  Resting within the colonnade is a white pine kiosk, its pale surface standing out against the deep hues of woven blankets, cloaks, and shawls draped in brilliant layers.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Bericsaba Market, Southeast Ray]
description: Beyond a dense screen of thuja and cypress, pale stone tiles spread beneath the shifting canopy, their surfaces worn smooth by time.  Heavy branches cast moving patterns of light and shadow, enclosing the space in quiet seclusion.  A roasting spit stands over a sunken firepit, its iron frame blackened by years of steady flame.  Along the edges, stone benches rest beneath the sheltering trees.  To the north, an arch thick with bougainvillea spills magenta and orange blossoms, leading to another patio.

title: [Bericsaba Market, Colonnade]
description: Pillars frame the entrance to a southern corridor where flowers press close beneath the towering cypress, their outlines barely visible in the starlight.  To the north, cobalt blue ceramic tiles stretch across the courtyard, their deep hues muted in the hush of night.  Banners ripple faintly, their slow movements casting shifting shadows against the stone.  Stalls filled with beads and baubles catch the lantern glow, their gleaming wares nearly obscuring a raised dais beyond.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [Bericsaba Market, South Ray]
description: Towering cypress trees stand in precise rows, their narrow spires forming a sheltered corridor along a straight path.  Beneath them, blue shale pavers create a firm walkway, their edges softened by creeping white star flowers.  Wild windflowers and gerbera daisies bloom in scattered bursts of color, contrasting against the deep green shade.  Wisteria vines form an arch over the colonnade's entrance, while to the south, the path leads directly to a dome-roofed tholos, its white pillars rising against the sea.

title: [Ever After]
description: Muted tapestries of pale greens and golds hang from the dark paneled walls of the spacious wagon.  Flickering candle sconces illuminate the space, casting a soft, golden glow throughout.  Intricately carved wooden shelves hold an array of rings displayed on soft, rich fabrics with some featuring small glass cloches protecting particularly delicate or ornate pieces.  In one corner, there is a carved bench with cushions made from woven fabrics.  A small round table, displaying a selection of pouches, is set nearby.

title: [Tholos of Niima]
description: White marble pillars form a perfect circle, their bases connected by a low wall that separates the space from the sea beyond.  Beneath the domed roof, thousands of blown-glass fishing orbs hang from delicate iron chains, their cobalt, emerald, and amber hues shifting in the changing light.  At the center, a marble statue of Niima rises from a sculpted tidepool of anemones, one hand extended to a child kneeling at the edge, offering a single windflower.  Beyond the open archways, the ocean stretches to the horizon.

title: [Bericsaba Market, Colonnade]
description: Ribbons ripple gently against marble pillars, their movement faint beneath the lanterns' glow.  Stained glass panels cast mosaics of color over the tile floor, blending into the deepening shadows.  Towers of suede-covered books stand beneath the arches, their rich colors subdued in the dim light.  A fabric-draped stall rests nearby, journals arranged in careful stacks, their covers gleaming where the lanterns' flicker catches the embossed details.  The faint scent of parchment lingers in the cool air.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, southwest

title: [Bericsaba Market, Southwest Ray]
description: Narrow paths extend northward, linking this space with its northern counterpart, while to the south, sea grass shifts in the breeze, growing in thick tufts between grey and white pebbles.  Fragments of crushed seashells catch the light, scattered in irregular patterns.  Beyond the grassy screen, the ocean stretches toward the horizon, waves a constant presence.  Along the west, animal pens line the edge, their colored awnings marked with homestead symbols.  Eastward, marble steps rise to the colonnade.

title: [Bericsaba Market, West Ray]
description: A narrow dirt track runs north to south, linking the northwest and southwest rays, its surface worn smooth by steady passage.  Faint animal calls drift from both directions, mixing with the rustle of wind through the trees.  To the east, marble steps ascend toward the colonnade, their edges softened by years of use.  Opposite, a heavy iron gate stands closed, marking the entrance to the Trans-Island Road, where blended brick, travertine, and marl form a well-trodden path stretching toward distant farmlands.

title: [Bericsaba Market, Northwest Ray]
description: Red marl and travertine form a worn path that stretches from the colonnade into a compact clearing.  To the east and north, laurel bushes press close, their dense foliage forming a natural boundary.  Westward, wooden pens rest against a rough incline of rocky scrubland, their canvas-covered shelters offering shade along the edges.  A narrow dirt track winds south, disappearing between the trees, while to the east, marble steps rise toward the colonnade, where white pillars frame the open-air expanse beyond.

title: [Bericsaba Market, Colonnade]
description: Ribbons coil around the marble pillars, their trailing ends shifting with the breeze before falling still near the floral-carved plinths.  Stained glass lanterns sway above, casting fractured patterns over the smooth tiles below.  A wooden kiosk stands to one side, its counters lined with trays of polished stones.  Nearby, a fabric-draped stall displays raw and cut gemstones, each catching the shifting lantern light.  Moonlight filters through, glinting off the scattered facets of the wares.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Bericsaba Market, Colonnade]
description: Lanternlight spills across the corridor, flickering as the wind stirs ribbons wrapped around nearby pillars.  To the west, a dirt clearing meets the road beyond, where the last travelers pass in quiet footsteps.  A vendor tends to a wooden stall stacked with bundles of dried herbs, their faint fragrance rising in the night air.  Eastward, marble and ceramic tiles meet in an open-air courtyard, where the steady trickle of water echoes softly, its rippling surface reflecting the glow of scattered firelight.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Bericsaba Market, Courtyard]
description: Ribbons drift from a raised platform at the courtyard's southernmost end, their movement slow and rhythmic in the night air.  Urns filled with blossoms encircle the dais, their faint fragrance mingling with the warmth of the nearby torches.  Shadows flicker across the cobalt blue tiles, their glossy surfaces reflecting the unsteady glow.  Beyond the colonnade's arches, vendor stalls rest in stillness, their vibrant awnings now dim silhouettes beneath the soft light of scattered flames.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Bericsaba Market, Courtyard]
description: Torchlight flickers against the cobalt tiles, its warm glow shifting across the glossy surface in uneven ripples.  Anchored within rings along the pillars, the torches burn steadily, their golden light reflecting off the cascading water.  At the courtyard's center, a mountain-shaped fountain rises, its sculpted stone tiers shadowed beneath the firelit glow.  Copper statues of goats and sheep glisten beneath the flowing streams, their aged patinas casting faint greenish hues across the wet stone.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Bericsaba Market, Voting Booth]
description: Soft grey canvas walls enclose the modest space, their edges weighted to steady the structure upon the marble tile floor.  To one side, a wooden booth stands with a slanted writing surface and a small slot for casting votes.  Faint scuffs mar the tiles beneath, evidence of many footsteps passing through the temporary shelter, and a single lantern hangs from the peak, casting a soft glow through the fabric and leaving the corners dim.

title: [Stony Sheep Meadows' Icy Wonder]
description: Swathes of crisp linen canopy the booth, their pale fabric shielding the frozen treats from the warmth of the air.  Sturdy wooden counters, painted deep cerulean, hold chilled basins nestled in beds of crushed ice, each brimming with flavors both familiar and unexpected.  Small ceramic bowls, glazed in muted earth tones, rest beside neatly stacked wooden spoons.  A chalkboard sign, its edges decorated with pressed wildflowers, displays the day's offerings in looping script.

title: [Bericsaba Market, Courtyard]
description: Cobalt blue tiles gleam beneath the flickering glow of nearby torches, their deep hues darkened where shadows gather between the pillars.  Awnings ripple faintly in the night air, their colors softened in the dim light as they cast shifting silhouettes across the tables below.  Quiet voices drift beneath the arches, blending with the distant sounds of the evening market.  To the south, a fountain's steady flow echoes through the stillness, marking the slow passage of the night.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

Faint scuffs mar the tiles beneath, evidence of many footsteps passing through the temporary shelter, and a single lantern hangs from the peak, casting a soft glow through the fabric and leaving the corners dim.

title: [Cover to Cover]
description: The narrow stall has been erected with a framework of sturdy wooden shelves, the corners framed in metal-looped swatches of various materials dyed in bright colors.  A bookish Ornathian clerk rests behind a map-carved olivewood counter, the elongated surface extending at an odd angle to showcase a velvet-padded chest, the container covered in stylized calligraphy.  The faint scent of oud and saffron drift within the enclosed space, the aroma emanating from a peahen-shaped censer.

title: [Bericsaba Market, Voting Booth]
description: Pristine white canvas walls enclose the modest space, their edges weighted to steady the structure upon the marble tile floor.  To one side, a wooden booth stands with a slanted writing surface and a small slot for casting votes.  Faint scuffs mar the tiles beneath, evidence of many footsteps passing through the temporary shelter, and a single lantern hangs from the peak, casting a soft glow through the fabric and leaving the corners dim.

title: [Bericsaba Market, Voting Booth]
description: Crimson canvas walls enclose the modest space, their edges weighted to steady the structure upon the marble tile floor.  To one side, a wooden booth stands with a slanted writing surface and a small slot for casting votes.  Faint scuffs mar the tiles beneath, evidence of many footsteps passing through the temporary shelter, and a single lantern hangs from the peak, casting a soft glow through the fabric and leaving the corners dim.

title: [The Crafty Crustacean]
description: Pale wood forms the kiosk's frame, its surface sanded smooth where knots and grain swirl in quiet patterns.  A simple awning of woven flax stretches overhead, its edges stitched with geometric borders.  Neatly folded blankets rest upon a counter, their vibrant hues spilling across the pale surface.  Hanging from wooden pegs, shawls and cloaks drape in layered cascades, their fringed hems shifting as air moves through the passage.  Beneath the counter, small baskets house bolts of fabric.

title: [Lustre and Flame]
description: Sunlight dances across an array of delicate wares, each piece of blown glass shimmering in dazzling hues.  Shelves on a dark-stained wooden display house vases with swirling colors, intricate figurines, and strands of luminous beads that glisten like captured starlight.  A silk-draped table holds smaller trinkets in the form of miniature animals, delicate perfume bottles, and marbled paperweights.

title: [A Glimpse of Grandeur]
description: Dozens of hand-sketched silhouettes cover the velvet-draped walls of the shop, the sheets of pale vellum drawn in vibrant images of gowns encircled by calligraphic notations.  Faenor-wired mannequins are posed before an ivy-carved resaeun display, the quartet bedecked in custom-tailored pieces and intricate footwear.  Framed by twin vases of glazed porcelain stands a ceiling-high mirror, the reflection creating the illusion of a much larger interior, the looking glass suspending garlands of parchment flora.

title: [Eternal Sunshine]
description: Sturdy wooden beams frame the stall, their surfaces darkened by years of handling and exposure.  Woven baskets sit atop a painted hunter green counter, brimming with dried fruits, nuts, and bundles of fragrant herbs tied with twine.  Small clay jars, their wax-sealed lids marked with trade sigils, line the back shelf in neat rows.  Beneath the counter, burlap sacks rest against the stall's supports, their coarse fabric cinched tight with knotted rope.  The scent of preserved citrus and crushed leaves lingers in the air.

title: [Bericsaba Market, Voting Booth]
description: Violet canvas walls enclose the modest space, their edges weighted to steady the structure upon the marble tile floor.  To one side, a wooden booth stands with a slanted writing surface and a small slot for casting votes.  Faint scuffs mar the tiles beneath, evidence of many footsteps passing through the temporary shelter, and a single lantern hangs from the peak, casting a soft glow through the fabric and leaving the corners dim.

title: [The Dreaming Pond Bakery]
description: Rough-hewn wooden beams frame the farm stand, its slanted awning stretched taut overhead in faded tones of ochre and sage.  Loaves of fresh bread rest neatly within baskets, their crusts scored with intricate patterns, while a nearby counter is covered in dishes and jars filled with marmalade or chutney.  Beneath the counter, burlap sacks filled with grain lean against the stand's sturdy supports, their coarse fabric marked with trade sigils.

title: [Bericsaba Market, Voting Booth]
description: Off-white canvas walls enclose the modest space, their edges weighted to steady the structure upon the marble tile floor.  To one side, a wooden booth stands with a slanted writing surface and a small slot for casting votes.  Faint scuffs mar the tiles beneath, evidence of many footsteps passing through the temporary shelter, and a single lantern hangs from the peak, casting a soft glow through the fabric and leaving the corners dim.

title: [Precious Stone Vineyard]
description: Boldly painted wood forms the body of the cart, its panels adorned with scrolling vine patterns in rich emerald and gold.  Strands of glass baubles hang along the edges, their shapes resembling clustered grapes and citrus fruits, glinting with every shift of air.  Wooden racks hold bottles of deep red and pale amber liquid, their wax-sealed tops resting in orderly rows.  A small counter juts from the side, polished smooth from use, where goblets and carafes wait to be filled.

title: [Bericsaba Market, Voting Booth]
description: Blue canvas walls enclose the modest space, their edges weighted to steady the structure upon the marble tile floor.  To one side, a wooden booth stands with a slanted writing surface and a small slot for casting votes.  Faint scuffs mar the tiles beneath, evidence of many footsteps passing through the temporary shelter, and a single lantern hangs from the peak, casting a soft glow through the fabric and leaving the corners dim.

title: [Hidden Mire Marvels]
