Flickering torches and lanterns are positioned along driftwood barrels, their dancing light casting deep shadows across a collection of krolvin ships.

title: [Glaoveln, V'Koort Docks]
description: The dockyard is shrouded in an eerie mist that blankets the entire area, adding to the deep chill that settles in from the arctic shores beyond.  The wooden piers creak and groan as krolvin ships sway gently in the murky waters.  The salty air is thick with the smell of fish and seaweed.

title: [Glaoveln, V'Koort Docks]

The wooden piers creak and groan as krolvin ships sway gently in the murky waters.  The salty air is thick with the smell of fish and seaweed.

title: [Glaoveln, Herndrok Pier]
description: The sounds of hammers and saws echo from a shipyard nearby, as the creation and repair of war vessels carry on at all times.  Cold winds rip across the pier, carrying the salty scent of the sea and the pungent odor of fish guts.  The dark waters reflect the dreary sky, creating an almost gloomy ambiance.

title: [Glaoveln, Herndrok Pier]
description: The sounds of hammers and saws echo from a shipyard nearby, as the creation and repair of war vessels carry on at all times.  Cold winds rip across the pier, carrying the salty scent of the sea and the pungent odor of fish guts.  The dark waters reflect the dreary sky, creating an almost gloomy ambiance.

title: [Glaoveln, Herndrok Pier]
description: The sounds of hammers and saws echo from a shipyard nearby, as the creation and repair of war vessels carry on at all times.  Cold winds rip across the pier, carrying the salty scent of the sea and the pungent odor of fish guts.  The dark waters reflect the dreary sky, creating an almost gloomy ambiance.

title: [Glaoveln, Prozd Pier]
description: The wooden planks of the dock creak loudly, their surfaces stained with salt and swathed with glistening frost.  A maze of large krolvin warships stretches out into the murky waters, their figureheads carved into the ferocious images of various sea monsters.  The area is shrouded in a thick, icy fog that obscures several forms moving along the pier.

title: [Glaoveln, Prozd Pier]
description: The wooden planks of the dock creak loudly, their surfaces stained with salt and swathed with glistening frost.  A maze of large krolvin warships stretches out into the murky waters, their figureheads carved into the ferocious images of various sea monsters.  The area is shrouded in a thick, icy fog that obscures several forms moving along the pier.

title: [Glaoveln, Pulct Docks]
description: Choppy, icy waters extend beyond the docks while a faint arctic mist rises from their shadowy depths.  Waves slosh loudly against the wooden pilings, broken up often by the raucous barking of krolvin in the distance.  A cold wind whistles through the rigging of some nearby ships.

title: [The Annex, Further Northwest]
description: The dim chamber is steeped in gloom, lit only by the streaks of light filtering through cracks in the ceiling beams.  Burlap sacks slump against the walls, their bulging forms crowding between tarnished trunks and a line of mismatched cabinets with warped drawers half-ajar.  The web-strung beams overhead creak with each clammy draft, while the warped floorboards bear scuff marks and dark, grimy streaks.

title: [The Annex, Misdirection]
description: Giant holes have been punched into the makeshift walls of the room, the sections of fencing and broken bits of ships still covered in netting-tangled barnacles and rotted seaweed.  Rusted tin buckets litter the dusty ground, spaced between the wide jars of cloudy liquid caked in layers of dirty wax and hair.  A trio of torn canvas bags sits heavily upon a sunken patch of flooring, the containers surrounded by a graveyard of desiccated insects.

title: [Under the Sea]
description: Basalt rocks, slick and ragged, rise from a sand-ravaged ground littered with tangled clusters of lifeless kelp and seagrass.  Beyond the surrounding bubble of air is a murky ocean filled with imposing shadows from large aquatic beasts that pass just out of sight.  The acrid scent of the sea assaults your senses, and you sense that at any moment, the bubble could pop, and water could come rushing in.

title: [Warehouse, Lockers]
description: The far wall of this small room is filled with an array of small, locked doors.

title: [Warehouse, Lockers]
description: The far wall of this small room is filled with an array of small, locked doors.

title: [Talon Isle, Docks]
description: Silvered by time and the cruel caress of the elements, the expanse of dock is littered with pale sand and strewn with drying leaves from the vines tangling its pilings.  Bright flowers in the colors of a spectacular sunset unfurl along the lengths of the vines.  A few frayed black ropes hang from one of the pilings, swaying like raven locks in the ocean breeze.

title: [The Tonbury, Dark Hold]
description: Ruined chests and dilapidated coffers lie half-submerged in brackish pools, their frames and banding eaten by saltwater.  Coins corroded past the point of worthlessness cascade across waterlogged planks, mingling with burst velvet pouches whose threads have frayed to ghostly wisps.  Crumpled goblets, mostly copper but a few silver, lie scattered about, and a rust-stained crown with its gems pried out rests off-kilter on a rotted beam nearby.

title: [The Tonbury, Dark Hold]
description: The low-ceilinged hold echoes with the drip of seawater.  Brine laps at crates fractured to reveal tarnished ingots, their edges rounded and pitted by years of abandonment.  A few scattered links from what was once a gold chain are trapped between the planks of the hold, forming a glinting and uneven trail to a corroded saber driven into the wood of the deck.

title: [Seawind Haven, Promenade]
description: Coconut palms lean slightly over a coral-hued stone cottage tucked away from a seashell path, their fronds swaying above.  Lining a flagstone walkway are clusters of hibiscus and ginger bloom in brilliant colors.  A polished brass lantern with blue-tinted glass hangs from a driftwood post next to an ivy-draped white lattice archway draped in climbing passionflowers.

title: [Seawind Haven, Promenade]
description: Kapok trees rise overhead, a dense canopy spreading out from the thick, sturdy trunks.  A wrought iron gate, thickly overgrown with climbing roses, marks the start of a stone-lined walkway.  Curving through clusters of plumeria and orchids, a pale path of seashells joins a sandy path that winds downward toward a wooden dock.  Ferns and philodendrons press along the edges, their greenery filling the spaces between the blossoming growth.

title: [Seawind Haven, Promenade]
description: Dense clusters of heliconia and bird of paradise fill the area with sweeping fronds and vivid color.  A pale path of seashells winds between the plants, its curve leading toward a bluestone cottage.  A driftwood post supports a polished brass lantern with blue-tinted glass, its frame worked into the shape of curling fronds.  Tall palm trees rise in even rows beyond a copper-roofed quaint stone residence.

title: [Seawind Haven, Promenade]
description: Dense clusters of hibiscus and ginger line a narrow footpath, their vibrant blooms standing out against deep green leaves.  Clumps of calathea and monstera fill the spaces between the flowers, creating layers of tropical greenery.  Twisted pandanus trees flank a tall latticework archway before spreading out to mark the edges of the clearing, their stilt-like roots forming natural barriers along a seashell path.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, southwest, west

title: [Seawind Haven, Promenade]
description: Sun-bleached fragments of crushed seashells pave a narrow path that winds through a flourishing tropical thicket, where palms and broad-leafed plants lean overhead.  A polished brass lantern with blue-tinted glass hangs from a driftwood post, its frame shaped like curling fronds.  A black marble door is set into a vine-draped hillside, while a tall tower with a large telescope protruding from the top floor rises above the trees.

title: [Seawind Haven, Promenade]
description: Seashells trace a winding path through dense tropical growth.  Bougainvillea and jasmine spill in bright cascades among the leaves, filling the area with vivid color.  A mango tree spreads out alongside a sturdy wooden lodge, its curved fronds sheltering branches laden with ripening fruit.  Tucked amid the greenery is a stone house, its walls wrapped in flowering trumpet vines.

title: [Seawind Haven, Promenade]
description: Ferns and broad-leafed palms fill the spaces between, while flowering bougainvillea climbs toward the lower branches, spilling color across the shaded ground.  A rugged driftwood fence stretches along the edge of the clearing, its posts uneven and weathered.  A crushed seashell path meanders by a giant teak tree, its massive trunk pierced by an ornate black iron gate wrought with dragonflies set deep within the wood.

Ferns and broad-leafed palms fill the spaces between, while flowering bougainvillea climbs toward the lower branches, spilling color across the moonlit ground.  A rugged driftwood fence stretches along the edge of the clearing, its posts uneven and weathered.  A crushed seashell path meanders by a giant teak tree, its massive trunk pierced by an ornate black iron gate wrought with dragonflies set deep within the wood.

title: [Seawind Haven, Promenade]
description: Pebbles form a winding path between stands of ginger and hibiscus.  Nearby, tall coconut palms lean over a driftwood fence in graceful arcs.  A polished brass lantern with blue-tinted glass hangs from a driftwood post.  Weaving through ferns and palms, a crushed seashell walkway offers a soft, shimmering trail.

title: [Seawind Haven, Promenade]
description: Curving gently around the side of a turquoise villa, a cobblestone walkway disappears behind the building.  Clusters of hibiscus and bougainvillea bloom along the edges, their striking colors spilling over low hedges.  A papaya tree rises above a sturdy knotty pine staircase leading up to an elevated cottage, its tall trunk laden with ripe fruit.  Ferns and broad-leafed palms line a crushed seashell path as it weaves through the tropical foliage.

title: [Seawind Haven, Garden]
description: Tropical plants teeming with blossoming flowers surround a small riverstone pond centered in the lush garden.  Stone paths wind about the foliage, leading to a shaded pergola with wicker seating.  A bamboo fountain is tucked away amid the greenery.  A thick canopy spreads out from the branches of tropical trees, blanketing the garden in a veil of shadows.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Drunken D'Wharf]
description: Reaching out from the shoreline, a long pier stretches over the gentle waves, its wooden posts, darkened by years of salt and spray, rise from the water, bound together with thick ropes and iron bands.  Moored to the weathered pier, a two-masted brigantine looms tall against the horizon.  A grumpy dwarven sailor stands close by, his watchful gaze intent and alert.  Near the water's edge and nestled among some dwarf fruit trees, a solitary weathered bench offers an expansive view of the bay.
location: Drunken D'Wharf, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Sunlit Sanctuary, Landing]
description: Light reflects off of the polished copper underbelly of the roof's awning, that stretches protectively over a planked walnut door on the knotty pine landing.  Heading in a straight line to the grassy yard below, a sturdy knotty pine staircase is flanked by brightly illuminated lanterns fitted with radiant cobalt blue windows.
location: Sunlit Sanctuary, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [The Brewery, Pathway]
description: Harbored within silver-kissed sea holly and tall, blue-green seagrass, a tiny bungalow fashioned of white-washed grey driftwood glows in the moonlight.  Sanded planks of pine, illuminated by copper-shielded candles, traverse the distance between the beach and front door, while yellow-eyed fleabane and tangles of delicate sea lavender blossom surround the support posts.  A thin stream dips beneath the wooden walkway, its salty water feeding into a tidal pool with rhythmic abandon.  Disappearing in the bungalow's shadows is a pearly white shell-lined pathway.
location: The Brewery, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Cold River, Slayer's Solace]
description: Behind the tavern, a wide stone patio stretches out toward the jagged northern horizon, where the night sky dances with shifting curtains of auroral light.  The vividly hued ribbons ripple through the low clouds, casting faint, ethereal hues across the snow.  At the patio's center, a large firepit burns bright, its crackling flames holding the cold at bay.  Fur-covered benches ring the blaze, their surfaces worn smooth by years of constant occupancy beneath the stars.

title: [The Brewery, Backyard]
description: Perfectly manicured and vibrant green, a small lawn of dense centipede grass stretches from a driftwood bungalow to a short picket fence fashioned of narrow white slats.  Departing from the shadows at the eastern edge of the bungalow is a pearly white shell-lined pathway that forks to connect a red teak and silver birch stable at one end and a pale silver driftwood door at the other.  A small patio of glazed terracotta tiles offers a place to relax, the many bright white lounge chairs scattered upon it forming a loose circle around a tidy firepit.

title: [The Brewery, Kitchen]
description: Flanked by windows in the eastern and western walls, the remaining wall is dominated by low cabinets, high shelves, and a sturdy rhimar-lined cupboard.  Piping in one corner allows smoke from a pot-bellied stove to exit the bungalow, while an oversized soapstone basin beside it is fed by exterior pipes that conveniently draw water into its deep recesses.  A butcher block table surrounded by tall stools sits in the center of the room.
location: The Brewery, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [The Brewery, Stable]
description: Silver-hued driftwood planks form the finished facing of the stable's walls, while thick ship ribs provide structural support.  Lanterns are bolted to the inverted keel at even intervals, the bright illumination dispelling shadows and highlighting a tidily swept birch floor.  Tacked to a central post is a crisp vellum chore list outlining the duties of any proper horse owner, the lone lantern above it shedding light upon the east-facing door just beyond.
location: The Brewery, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [The Brewery]
description: Wheat-hued rattan woven into a herringbone pattern stretches across the ceiling and is supported by bright white pillars of pine.  Conical-shaped fishing baskets hang upon the pale green walls, the bottles within reflect the sunlight in prismatic patterns about the space.  Plump floor cushions of beige and cream encircle a wood-framed low square table at the heart of the grass-green bamboo floor.  A tall screen of linen opposite a slanted greyish door provides a modicum of privacy for the bedroom beyond.
location: The Brewery, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [The Brewery, Bedroom]
description: Wide, glassless windows wreathe the semi-circular room filling it with pale moonlight and gentle seaborne breezes that bring a chill to the night air.  Anchored to the conical ceiling, fine bug netting encircles a four-poster white birch bed draped in silky beige sheets and a down-filled chocolate brown comforter, while an ornate and carved mahogany armoire rests against the southern wall near a tall screen of linen that leads to the cottage's commons.
location: The Brewery, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Drunken D'Wharf, Private Pier]
description: The pier juts out from the shoreline into foamy waters, its thick beams aged from years of salt spray.  A teak-framed tavern with a slanted roof of slate tiles stands atop sturdy beams driven deep into the seabed.  Smoke curls from the chimney of a bustling workshop, carrying the scent of burning wood and forge fire.  Iron rings are embedded into the edge of the pier, anchoring thick ropes that stretch toward a two-masted brigantine.  Bridging the gap between ship and shore, a gangplank rests, its boards worn smooth by countless boots.
location: Drunken D'Wharf, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Whiskey or Bust, Deck]
description: The vessel's deck is laid with sturdy planks of dark oak, worn smooth by years of boots and brine.  The central mast rises like a spine from the heart of the ship, thick with rigging and taut lines.  Mid-deck, a wide hatch sits flush with the planks, its iron handles used to lift the heavy cover.  At the stern, the captain's wheel stands, forged of iron-braced wood, its grip worn from constant use.  Behind the wheel is a stout wooden door set into the sterncastle opposite a gangplank leading to the pier below.
location: Drunken D'Wharf, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [The Drunken D'Wharf, Tavern]
description: The interior is dimly lit by iron sconces and the walls lined with wooden beams, darkened from years of smoke and soot from a central hearth.  Shelves sag beneath an impressive collection of earthenware jugs, glass bottles, and wooden casks behind a bar crafted from a massive slab of salt-stained oak.  In the corner, a copper still affixed with a drakar plate gleams in the torchlight, its coils twisting over open flames.
location: Drunken D'Wharf, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Whiskey or Bust, Captain's Room]
description: The cabin has curved walls and a low ceiling that creaks with the rhythm of the sea.  A set of tall, paned windows look out over the ship's aft, allowing sunlight to spill in by day and moonlight to gleam on the polished brass fittings by night.  In the center sits a broad oak desk, strewn with navigational charts, a compass, and a brass candleholder with stubs of wax.  To one side, a bunk is fastened to the wall, fitted with a thick mattress draped in wool blankets and a richly embroidered coverlet.
location: Drunken D'Wharf, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Whiskey or Bust, Galley]
description: At the heart of the space is the stove, an iron cauldron hanging suspended over its flame.  A heavy wooden table is bolted to the floor nearby, its surface nicked and scorched from years of chopping and spills.  Bundles of dried herbs dangle from beams above, swaying gently with the ship's motion.  Clay jugs of vinegar, grog, and water are lashed down in netting to keep them from crashing loose in heavy seas.  Along one wall, a curtained opening leads further into the depths of the ship.
location: Drunken D'Wharf, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Whiskey or Bust, Cargo Hold]
description: The only light seeps in from lanterns hung on pitted iron hooks, their flames flickering against the curved wooden ribs of the hull.  Thick beams cross overhead, reinforced with iron bolts and streaked with rust from years at sea.  Wooden barrels and casks dominate the hold, stacked and roped together for stability while crates of tools, ropes, and sailcloth are wedged between larger items against the bulkheads.  A heavy locker has been carefully placed atop a small oak counter alongside one wall.
location: Drunken D'Wharf, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Whiskey or Bust, Crow's Nest]
description: Perched high atop the central mast, the crow's nest sways gently in the tropical breeze.  The timber beneath is sun-bleached and marked with knife carvings of names, tally marks, and crude drawings left by bored lookouts over countless voyages.  Strapped securely to the railing of the crow's nest with leather bindings is a brass telescope, its polished casing gleaming.  A woven hammock is strung up, rocking slightly in the soft breeze.  Far below, the tropical island town bustles with color and sound.
location: Drunken D'Wharf, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [ArborSong, Front Lawn]
description: Dense orchards surround the manicured lawn, protecting the edges of the estate.  An inviting garden thrives in between an old manor and its well-appointed stable, guarded by an enormous ancient modwir tree.  Wrapping their boughs in a semi-circle over the smaller plants, one tree with an especially thick branch supports a rope swing near the overgrown gated walkway.

title: [ArborSong, Gardens]
description: Lush and vibrant with the brilliant colors of thriving plants, the garden flourishes so close to the waters edge in its disorganized fashion.  Roses of various hues, orchard trees laden with ripe fruit, as well as a lilac bush and some meandering sweet honeysuckle, all lending to the sweet-smelling air.  A small fountain sits centered among the growth.

title: [ArborSong Falls, Lagoon]
description: The water here is a clear turquoise blue, fed by the waterfall that cascades down from the cliffs above. With the gentle splashing of the falls and the occasional birdsong, the air is filled with the scent of flowers and the chorus of peeper frogs.  Low mossy rocks circle the lagoon but lead upwards to a ledge high in the cliff. A small sandy beach area leads out to the estate's gardens.

title: [ArborSong, Dungeon]
description: Stepping down the flight of stairs, a cold iron-barred cell contains a small threadbare cot, while a pair of dark iron rings set into the floor and two within the ceiling and a small rack are all that remain inside.  A long broom lays on the floor outside the bars near a large wooden lever that appears to control the cell door.

title: [ArborSong, Cell]
description: Isolation and desolation seem to be the theme here.  The flimsy cot holds a fur that might once have been a blanket, while ominous stains darken the floor beneath the embedded iron rings, often trailing outside the cell to a chipped basin near a fallen broom in the corner.  Only the cell door appears untouched by decay.
location: Arborsong, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Epilogue, Courtyard]
description: Well-worn cobblestones of ashen grey and taupe form a winding trail towards a wood-framed dark stone cottage encircled by a copse of full-grown apple trees, a thin trail of chimney smoke dancing between their sturdy branches.  A colorful garden of fruits and vegetables encloses either side of the trail, the faint sounds of buzzing and the occasional shuffle from its woodland occupants causing the fauna to rustle.  Resting next to a stag-carved mahogany bench are a variety of supplies, the gear protected by the slanted roof.
location: Epilogue, inside the dwarven caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Epilogue, Chamber]
description: Wood-framed maps, their once vibrant ink aged beneath the panes of glass, hang between paintings of local flora and wildlife that dot the stone-stacked walls of the stone cottage.  Two half-circles of worn leather couches enclose an intaglio-carved table in the center of the room, the seating opening up to a trophy-adorned fireplace rising to the ceiling.  Crystalline decanters and glasses rest upon a wheeled steel cart nestled in a back corner.
location: Epilogue, inside the dwarven caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Epilogue, Bedroom]
description: The domed ceiling of the room has been painted with an expansive map of Elanthia, the cities inlaid with burnished eahnor, while the bodies of water reflect their shards of vivid sapphire.  A circular bed of lacquered mahogany lays beneath the cartographic design, illuminated by a pierced golden lantern casting scattered patterns of light across the wood-planked floor.  Haphazard piles of books lay stacked upon leather-bound trunks nestled to either side of a carved stone staircase.
location: Epilogue, inside the dwarven caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Epilogue, Kitchen]
description: Iron-framed windows enclose tall panes of glass, the mosaics casting colorful shadows against the lacquered wooden counters of the expansive kitchen.  Lattice-woven wicker baskets spill over with a bounty of goods, the containers hanging above the counters from thin iron chains that softly clink together as they sway above an elongated linden table.  Set beside an antler-framed door is a small porcelain basin, its base forged from eahnor into the image of rearing stallions flanking an elaborate tower shield.
location: Epilogue, inside the dwarven caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Epilogue, Dock]
description: The faint rustle of the surrounding willow trees echoes against the wood and stone forming the dock area of the cottage, their branches dipping low into the river.  A rope-enforced dock extends out into the steadily flowing waters, its pillars dotted with soft moss and algae that brush against the flowing waters.  A cobblestone firepit sits within a cluster of flat-topped slate rocks, leaving a mahogany chest of various supplies half-hidden between stacks of firewood and foliage.
location: Epilogue, inside the dwarven caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Dragonfly Den, Winding Stairs]
description: Spiraling, a wooden stairwell carved inside the giant tanik hugs close to the sapwood as it climbs between platform and residence.  Fragrant and polished to a smooth finish, the interior ranges from a mid-brown hue to a dark red.  Small glass sconces are fitted over wicked oil half-bowls that illuminate the narrow way.  Sturdy and secure, a looping rope handrail drapes in shallow scallops to aid those venturing the steep stairs.  At the top soft light beckons, while below is a quiet darkness.
location: Dragonfly Den, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Dragonfly Den, Retreat]
description: Surprisingly roomy for being inside a hollowed-out tree trunk, a swaying rope bridge leading from the retreat to the limestone cliff at the far opposite of the spiraling stairway lets in a soft breeze.  An over-stuffed sofa and complementing chair with ottoman are placed around a highly polished tanik table sitting low and holding some refreshments.  Resting on a square of dark terra cotta tile, a small black iron brazier glows steadily, the bright coals sending out a welcome warmth.  Decorations are minimal, allowing the patterns of the sapwood grain to stand out.
location: Dragonfly Den, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Dragonfly Den, Canopy Deck]
description: Almost at the top of the canopy and breaking past the reach of most surrounding trees, much of the vast skyline opens up and affords glimpses over the surrounding montane.  A smooth handcarved bench outfitted with a thick seat cushion and several small pillows provide a comfortable setting to sit and gaze.  Winking glints of light flash as viewing angles capture sight of obscured lakes or meandering rivers through the forest.
location: Dragonfly Den, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Dragonfly Den, Chamber]
description: A wide, open-ended sleeping niche has been carved out of the limestone cliff, providing an expansive view just below the canopy of trees, as the uppermost reaches begin to thin out.  More sunlight is present here, adding both warmth and light.  In addition to an oak bed with an over-stuffed mattress piled with a thick zaffre blue quilt and matching fat pillows, an oak side table and dresser set off to one side complete the furnishings.  Steel doors suspended on rails are etched with flitting dragonflies filled with bright enamel in jewel-tone hues.
location: Dragonfly Den, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Dragonfly Den, Rainfall]
description: Redwood planks with slight gaps form a solid deck over the limestone ledge, atop which sits an outdoor relaxation bath.  A heavy chain attached to a metal pipe jutting out from the cave wall hovers over a holding tank leading to a punched steel disk suspended at one end of the bathing vessel.  Giant tanik trees surround the outdoor setting, creating a privacy screen, admitting beams of moonlight.  The scented air of the forest and rushing waterfall nearby contribute a relaxing vibration while one reclines neck-deep in hot water.
location: Dragonfly Den, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Dragonfly Den, Cookery]
description: Carved into a limestone cliff near a weald of giant tanik, the open archway from the rope bridge casts some light in this cave-like cookery.  Small epiphyte-filled niches add color and life to the pale walls, and a hanging pot between them holds a cascade of spidery brassavola orchids fragrant with a soft, citrusy scent.  Bamboo piping emerging from the far wall slides fresh water into a deep porcelain sink, and to its left is an iron-handled rhimar chest propped up on thin iron legs.  To the right is a tall, rectangular iron brazier partly inset within the wall, next to a curtained portal leading out to a sturdy deck-covered ledge and the forest.
location: Dragonfly Den, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Symbolization, Neutrality]
description: Artwork of Arkati and spirits cover the walls of this small room, portraying those that claim neutrality.  A door inlaid with rune-shaped cinnabar leads back out towards the orchard, while a thick curtain heads further inwards.  Standing center in the room, a large mahogany table is cluttered with jewelry-crafting tools, a felt-lined box, and a paper-stuffed tray.

title: [Symbolization, Elicitation]
description: This small backroom is more cell-like than not.  Set against the back wall, a small cot sits nearly bare, topped only by a thin cotton sheet.  Standing next to the cot is a low desk, covered with several piles of paper, jeweler's tools, and a diminutive lantern.  A thick curtain leads back out to the main room.

title: [Symbolization, Light]
description: Artwork of Arkati and spirits cover the walls of this alcove, portraying those that claim Liabo as home.  Inlaid with gold-filled runes, a glass-fronted cabinet stands prominently to one side, while a smaller pyrite-inlaid curio stands opposite.  Sitting snuggly between the two is a low padded chair.

title: [Symbolization, Dark]
description: Artwork of Arkati and spirits cover the walls of this alcove, portraying those that claim Lornon as home.  Black pearl-filled runes are inlaid upon a glass-fronted cabinet which stands prominently to one side, while a smaller obsidian-inlaid curio stands opposite.  Sitting snuggly between the two is a low padded chair.

title: [Something Borrowed]
description: Several wire-framed mannequins are displayed along the flora-draped mahogany walls of the small shop, the forms decorated in pale-colored gowns and tunics crafted from fine silks and brocades.  A ceiling-high glass display dominates the center of the room, the various tiers framed by long ribbon-knotted garlands of origami doves and hearts dunked in bright glitter.

title: [Something New]
description: Ceiling-skimming floral displays threaten to consume the brocaded walls of the room, the rug-covered floor beneath it sprinkled in a kaleidoscope of petals and leaves leading up to a series of colorful marble vases set on fluted podiums.  Wire-strung origami birds soar across the sky blue silk-paneled chandelier, their lacquered wings dusted in large flakes of glitter.

title: [Stillwater Timber, Salesroom]
description: A tall window framed in mahogany knotwork offers a picturesque view of Icebriar Lake.  Polished oak planks span the floor, their waxy sheen catching the soft glow of lanterns along the paneled walls.  Hollow stumps repurposed as bins cradle bundled branches, while iron-banded cases display an assortment of containers.  The faint resinous scent of freshly cut wood drifts in through a black and red check-patterned curtain leading to the workroom.

title: [Stillwater Timber, Workroom]
description: The scent of resin hangs thick in the air, mingling with the faint tang of freshly cut wood.  Racks holding bundles of branches, sorted by grain and length, line the walls, and sawdust gathers beneath a mahogany worktable in neat, untouched piles.  A wide hearth burns at the far wall, the fire steady but strangely cold, while shadows cling to corners, their edges diffused in the gentle glow.

title: [Sockpuppetry, White Room]
description: This part of the hovel is spare, with all surfaces painted a snowy white.  There were once windows, but they have been boarded over with white-painted driftwood that is further colored by the silhouette of a vivid vermillion marionette.  In the room's center, two stone sarcophagi sit side-by-side, each large enough to comfortably fit a small child.  Each sarcophagus is a different color and is draped with bright linens.  A wide brass plaque is affixed to the wall on one side of the room.  A battered driftwood door leads out.

title: [Sockpuppetry, Black Room]
description: The interior of this section of the hovel is spare, with all surfaces painted a dark, void black.  There were once windows, but they have been boarded over with black-painted driftwood that is further colored by the silhouette of a vivid silver marionette.  In the room's center, two stone sarcophagi sit side-by-side, each large enough to comfortably fit a small child.  Each sarcophagus is a different color and is draped with bright linens.

title: [Sockpuppetry, Violet Room]
description: The interior of this section of the hovel is spare, with all surfaces painted a bright violet.  There were once windows, but they have been boarded over with violet-painted driftwood that is further colored by the silhouette of a vivid indigo marionette.  A wide-mouthed stone ossuary, also painted violet, sits in the room's center.  A threadbare velvet curtain sections off a small nook at the area's back.

title: [Sockpuppetry, Storage]
description: Sectioned off by a threadbare velvet curtain, this back area of the hovel is large enough for a small crowd to gather.  The only distinguishing feature is a child-sized pale blue stone coffin, which sits on the white stone floor in the area's center.

title: [Chapel of Fading Moments, Nave]
description: Whitewashed stone walls rise into a steep, shadowed peak, their surface rough despite the fresh coat of paint.  Light filters through tall stained glass windows, scattering fractured bands of coral and blue across the flagstone floor where rows of plain wooden pews stand in solemn order, their edges worn smooth with use.  Flanking the open doors, a series of wrought iron hooks juts from the stone, their stark outlines fading into shadow as the gloom beyond swallows their presence.

title: [Chapel of Fading Moments, Altar]
description: Two shallow steps rise to meet an unadorned marble altar, its surface marked only by a hammered copper alms bowl encircled with a scattering of trinkets and baubles.  From above, the rafters vanish into shadow, their beams occasionally caught by shifting colors of Naidem's sky as they slip through the high windows and spread across the floor in uneven bands.  Beyond the altar hangs a row of ancient tapestries, their fabric thinned with age and their patterns lost to time, the faded threads blurring into obscurity against the wall.

title: [Cloak and Mirrors]
description: Dozens of widowwood-framed mirrors cover the velvet-curtained walls of the shop, the geometric cuts of glass draped in garlands of dark-colored florals and twisted vinework spilling down towards the elongated counters.  Partially concealed by vellum-cut leaves and dried petals are carved ebony trays lined in obsidian silk, displaying the various wares amidst the haze of incense smoke permeating the room.

title: [Cutting a Figure, Entry]
description: Large bay windows open onto the main thoroughfare, their panes capturing the spectral bustle of Naidem while hues of coral and blue from the aurora-washed sky spill inward.  An iron-footed cloth mannequin dressed in a corset vest stands near the glass, its outline softened by the glow of nearby wall sconces.  Bathed in a mingling of window light and candle flame, a cloth-draped service counter displays several signs, while a silver-framed oil portrait hangs along the wall to complete the setting.

title: [Cutting a Figure, Display Room]
description: Frosted globes hang like crystal teardrops from the ceiling, each casting a soft white glow that pools gently across the floor.  Hooks along the walls display corset vests in varied styles, their silhouettes outlined in pale light.  To the south, a double arch provides egress.  Heavy velvet drapes in deep shades of black and wine cover the windows of the eastern and western walls, while the backwall is dominated by an expansive oil-based painting.

title: [Domicile of the Shapers]
description: Moss carpets the ground in a dense, springy layer, its emerald nap muffling all movement within the hyrrad.  Slender saplings, coaxed into graceful arcs, form the walls and ceiling, their living boughs braided to hold the structure aloft.  A single opening above frames the aurora-kissed sky, its shifting hues spilling onto a low wooden table, while around the opening dangle sheaths, scabbards, and cases of varied size, each suspended by cords that sway gently with the movement of air on the exterior.

title: [Eaux de Joy, Perfumery]
description: Angled roofline windows tinted with hues of yellow cast a warm glow, giving a decidely jaundiced pall to everything and everyone.  Sconces filled with lightly fragranced bdellium oil soothes without overshadowing the scented wares.  Pale amethyst glass globes illuminated by fiickering wicks help offset the sickly hue, prisms fragmenting along each surface where the crystal has crazed.  Half-curtains of neutral linen can be levered into place to cut natural illumination when it gets too bright.

title: [Eaux de Joy, Salon and Workshop]
description: More subdued lighting than found in the entry beyond, the somber setting lends a hushed tone conducive to quiet work and focused study.  Fat velvet cushions in shades of tea and wine are arranged in a semi-circle around a round rosewood worktable set before several dusty shelves filled wth all manner of vials, tubes, jars, and bottles.  Hanging from the center of the ceiling sways a large chandelier of citrine crystal points clustered around several candle-lit votives.

title: [Jolly Jinglers, Entry]
description: Bright harlequin silks sweep into high panels, their diamond patterns shimmering in the glow of drifting motes.  Woven baskets are anchored to the pavilion's support posts, each filled with ribbons, feathers, or baubles that spill color into the space.  A crescent counter stands at the center, its motley cloth covering flanked by mannequin heads that model extravagant hats with silent flair.

title: [Jolly Jinglers, Jangling On]
description: Bright pennants in mismatched hues drape from the pavilion's inner frame, their lengths swaying with each whisper of air.  Beneath them, polished stands present rows of long-toed poulaines, each pair arranged so the bell-tipped points curl upward in gleaming arcs.  Nearby, a series of polished racks bristle with doll-headed batons, their painted faces grinning in candlelit cheer as the faint sound of jingling echoes through the tent.

title: [Neither Here Nor There, Entry]
description: Nebulous mist collects along the ceiling, pooling in shifting layers that diffuse a faint glow across the chamber.  At the center rests a solitary sarcophagus, its outline blurred by the wavering haze above.  Wall niches gape along the sides, their hollow depths steeped in shadow.  Against one wall stands an aged wooden bench, its seat holding a shallow bowl where curls of half-burned paper linger like forgotten prayers.

title: [Neither Here Nor There, Exedra]
description: Mist drifts faintly overhead, its glow pooling against the curve of the northern wall where the exedra reaches its terminus.  From the south, the view frames the sarcophagus beyond, its silhouette softened by haze.  Along the wall, a curved stone bench juts outward, carved from the same blocks that formed the mausoleum itself.  Hundreds of pillar and votive candles cover its surface, their wavering flames casting restless shadows.  Near the apex rises a towering statue, a small altar nestled at its feet.

title: [Scales and Shadows, Foyer]
description: A thin mist drifts over cracked obsidian tiles, curling toward a warped archway framing the exit opposite a sturdy door leading toward the back office.  A splintered lectern leans against the far wall, flanked by sagging banners covered in soot and dust.  Overhead, a crooked chain suspends a lantern with a cold, blue-green flame casting shadows upon a broken trunk turned askew.

title: [Scales and Shadows, Office]
description: Stone walls reinforced with iron bands enclose the cramped back chamber, its corners crowded with office furniture and storage racks.  Facing a sturdy door exiting to the foyer is a scarred desk strewn with ledgers and quills set beneath a barred window flanked by mesh-fronted cabinets holding tagged parcels and tools.  In the corner, a cold iron stove rests, while a single lantern overhead throws long shadows over a worn chair.

title: [Scales and Shadows, Cellblock]
description: Iron-barred cells stretch along the narrow hall, each confining warped armor bound in heavy chains and tagged with rusted plaques.  Between the cells, tallied etchings score the stone amid claw marks crusted with old blood.  Light from dim lanterns swaying overhead flashes across the walls as unseen footsteps echo with the clink of phantom keys.

title: [Scales and Shadows, Tribulation]
description: Bare stone curves into an oval chamber beneath a vaulted ceiling, its surfaces scarred with uneven tallies and spiraling gouges.  Bolted to the center of the floor is a heavy iron chair with corroded manacles, while barred display cases and rust-pitted lockers line the walls with secured wares.  Overhead, warped mirrors and a swaying lantern scatter distorted reflections in restless patterns.

title: [Sparked Interest]
description: Dominating any other form of illumination within the destroyed interior of this house is a floating, large crystal jar full of swirling, scintillating gemstones.  Sparks arc from one gemstone to the next at a continuous, measured pace, a colorful display of light refracting from each surge of electricity across the surfaces of the jar and its contents.  A scorched shallow pit resides below the jar, various bits of lightning glass scattered across the remnants of a wall and upheaved dirt.

title: [The Unholy Chapel]
description: What once was a quaint chapel has been burnt and desecrated, leaving behind only scorched skeletal remains.  Above, the missing roof offers a clear view of the eerie auroras dancing against the black sky, with only the charred remains of the chapel's steeple marring the scenery.  Hanging across the walls on some jagged nails appears to an assortment of weapons.  Ripples of dark energy writhe across the dilapidated walls and flooring and across the remains of some blackened pews and a charred stone altar inlaid with black ora runes.

title: [The Unholy Chapel - Undercroft]
description: Cool, damp air fills this vaulted, brick-lined space.  A single sputtering torch casts long, dancing shadows that swallow rows of sturdy stone columns.  The scent of earth and dust hangs heavy in the air, disturbed only by the echo of occasional footsteps on the worn flagstones.  A long stone table rests silently in one of the darkened corners.

title: [Threads of the Widow, Entry]
description: Glistening webwork spans the ceiling in intricate layers, each strand spun from metallic threads that gleam in hues of copper, gold, silver, and platinum.  Suspended from long posts along the northern and southern walls, enormous spools feed the woven canopy above.  Dewy light from embedded moonstones clings to the threads in soft glimmers.  Beneath the shimmering web, long tables form a central showroom where wares are displayed in neat rows.

title: [Threads of the Widow, Showroom]
description: Racks of metallic-threaded gowns line the walls, each garment hanging in graceful drapes that shimmer with the movement of the air.  Overhead, a canopy of copper, silver, and gold threads forms a delicate web that spans the ceiling.  At key junctions, moonstones carved to resemble bundled prey emit a soft glow, casting a moonlit sheen across the space.  An open wooden door leads into a candlelit workroom.

title: [Threads of the Widow, Workroom]
description: Dusty shelves line the walls, their surfaces crowded with lit candles that send wavering light into the dim corners.  Cobwebs drape the upper reaches and trail between shelf supports, their fine strands glimmering in the glow.  An aged witchwood rocking chair sits near a pair of benches pushed to one side, their wooden seats polished by years of use.  Beside the exit, a curl-topped large orange jack-o-lantern with a broad, goofy grin rests on the floor as if standing guard.

title: [Twisted Hovel, Workshop]
description: A culmination of briars, brambles, and branches are twisted skillfully to conform to the design of a skilled artisan, forming an overlapping, angular design throughout the interior of this small dwelling.  Dark liquid drips from a large, sagging branch curling along the apex of the domed ceiling, making an audible *plop* as each drop falls into a wide bowl atop a haphazard makeshift workbench.  Both the heat of a kiln and chill of winter meet here from different parts of the hovel.

title: [Twisted Hovel, Kiln]
description: Rivulets of slowly moving, dark liquid descend along the brambled walls around a cylindrical large copper kiln, pooling within a naturally formed basin on the floor.  A blackened smoky quartz pedestal is wedged between two gnarled branches that jut upward against an angular, thorn-covered ceiling.  Wavering buffets of cold air from the west constrasts harshly with the constant, oppressive heat in this corner of the hovel.

title: [Twisted Hovel, Laboratory]
description: A precise, symmetrically cut, rectangular rhimar slab is centered in this corner of the hovel, with just enough space for a thin uneven shelf along the curved wall furthest from the hovel's workshop.  Gusts of heat waft in from the east, where a large kiln is shrouded in a haze of pale grey smoke.

title: [Twisted Infusions]
description: A long, multihued rug stretches from north to south, parallel to a lacquered wall.  Along the rug, a whorled black and white table displays some offerings placed upon it.  Trophies and artwork cover the windowless walls, from painted pieces to those won and preserved over time.

title: [Twisted Infusions]
description: A multihued rug from the north ends here, rounded and tasseled, where it matches an equally rounded room.  The shelf-laden wall curves almost entirely around a flame red twisted ironwood table that curves to match the symmetry between the rug and the wall on either of its sides.  To the west, a massive sword is displayed in an otherwise unfinished part of the dwelling.

title: [Twisted Infusions]
description: The walls of this room are unfinished, some parts revealing the stonework beneath what is the begining of artfully applied plaster.  Wood sections of the frame reveal some of the exterior wall.  The work is scattered and unfocused around a large dark steel toolbox, each part of the room in various stages of completion.

title: [Hollowlair, Den of the Fiend]
description: Channels burrowed into the walls, floor, and ceiling of the chamber house glowing black runes, carved and barbed with razern.  The entire room appears caught within the Ur-Daemon's grasp, with Marlu's form looming over it.  Manacled and shackled chains line the walls, are mounted to the ceiling and floor, which is marked by a series of drains.  From the horrific stench, undoubtedly a result of the fetid and festering flesh on the restraints and clogging the drains, there seems to be no escape other than a barbed stone door.

title: [River Muagh, Muddy Bank]
description: Small birds flit through patches of wild flowers that dot the narrow bank along the shallows.  Grey ash clumps along the water's edge, and much of it remains trapped within the stalks of fiddlehead ferns and cattails that jut from the mud.  Tethered to a stout wooden dock, a row of soot-stained rafts bob up and down in the shallows near the glaes-inlaid, grey granite wall of Bentock's Adventurers' Rest.

title: [River Muagh]
description: A well-tended rock garden faces toward the river, where massive boulders, tiny pebbles, and all sizes of rocks in-between are piled into unique geometric shapes.  Bentok's Adventurers' Rest towers over the east bank, where a stout wooden dock is anchored in the shallows.  The two sides of the river bubble peacefully as they join and flow north from around the sides of Ghorsa Isle.

title: [River Muagh]
description: The town walls of Kharam-Dzu rise from either side of a steep, granite-faced canyon that guides the river north.  Flowing at a steady pace, the crystal clear waters reveal the darting shapes of numerous fish as they contend for the prized meal of other, smaller fish.

title: [River Muagh, Granite Canyon]
description: The river flows languidly northward, lapping against the sheer walls of a ruddy granite canyon on both sides.  Atop the eastern canyon wall, the highroad parallels the path of the river before veering behind an outcropping of pearl grey boulders.  A gnarled root juts from the canyon wall, casting a jagged shadow across the moonlit waters.

title: [River Muagh, Granite Canyon]
description: The canyon walls rise high above the river on both sides, and visible clusters of dark obsidian and basalt contrast sharply against the otherwise ruddy and grey-veined granite.  The water flows steadily north, taking tiny clumps of fallen grey ash along with it.

title: [River Muagh, Granite Canyon]
description: Sheer, granite canyon walls taper downwards from the south, the ends eroded and cracked as the landscape transitions into a muddy, verdant expanse of canver and mistwood trees to the north.  Considerably wide and deep, the river flows into white-capped rapids from the canyon's base.

title: [River Muagh, Rapids]
description: Churning, white-capped waters flow northward, between patches of smoothed rocks that protrude above the surface near the foot of a tall granite canyon to the south.  The width of the river makes it a rather simple task of avoiding any hazards.

title: [River Muagh, Confluence]
description: The rushing waters of the river are met by a surging, tributary stream from the eastern bank, and the flow of the river shifts northward as it meanders between crowded canver and mistwood trees.  Thin, thorn-covered vines hang from gnarled branches that reach over the water's edge, and have conglomerated along the eastern bank.

title: [River Muagh, Tributary Stream]
description: Quickly moving waters flow west from a deep pool to the south, the bend here sharply turning where a granite outcropping interrupts the treeline.  The branches of canver trees extend over the stream and entwine with each other, while verdant undergrowth saturates every traversable space beneath them.

title: [River Muagh, Waterfall]
description: Crashing down a rocky, moss-covered ridge to the south, a towering waterfall pours into a wide pool that feeds into the River Muagh as the current sweeps it north.   A verdant bank flanks a rugged wooden dock, which looks oddly out of place amid the foliage.

title: [River Muagh, Verdant Bank]
description: Lush, interlaced canver trees cluster along a verdant bank, covered in numerous colonies of mushrooms and surrounded by patches of cattails and fiddlehead ferns.  Dangling from their branches, a plethora of pink-throated white blossoms provide a starkly contrasting canopy to the thunderheads that darken the sky.  Tiny golden and silvery fish dart around some soot-stained rafts tethered to a rugged wooden dock, in a constant race after each petal that falls into the current.

title: [Teras Isle, Verdant Trail]
description: Slumped over amid passionflowers, heliconia, and other tropical flora, a bowed ancient canver tree has crushed another of its kind beneath its significant girth.  Insects buzz and flit through the enormous, tangled mass that is the tree's branches, entrenched in a sea of pink and white blossoms.  The splintered husk of the crushed tree lies half-buried alongside the depressed mud of the trail, now home to a family of noisily chirping crickets.

title: [Teras Isle, Verdant Trail]
description: Fruit-bearing trees reach skyward along both sides of the trail, surrounded by patches of wild growth.  The smooth, grey granite of a wall peeks through the foliage to the east, and a layer of fog undulates near the ground.

title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Approach]
description: Secured by heavily reinforced hinges on a grey granite wall, an invar-banded gate is guarded by a small parapet to either side.  The wall extends north and south, beyond numerous rows of sturdy saplings, curving from view as it bends to encircle the settlement beyond.  Armored dwarves stand at attention within each parapet, crossbows at the ready.

title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Vestibule]
description: An invar-banded gate rests in a half-opened position, at the ready to barricade the settlement against the wild denizens of Teras Isle.  Opposite the gate, a raised invar portcullis serves as the second line of defense, its sharp tines held in position above the cobblestone threshold leading into Kragnek Dzu.

title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Promenade West]
description: Masterfully carved cobblestones are aligned in opposing spirals, their roughly textured surfaces and contrasting hues contributing to the artfully detailed masonry.  Armored and uniformed dwarves stand guard in parapets on the granite wall to either side of a raised gleaming invar portcullis, the settlement's only defensible entryway.  A magnificent fountain splashes noisily to the east in the center of a concave plaza.

title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Crater Plaza]
description: Dominating the central gathering area of Kragnek Dzu, a magnificent fountain towers over a masterfully constructed concave plaza.  Water bubbles and splashes between colorful, chromatic glaes fragments in a wide carved stone basin that surrounds the fountain's centerpiece, a massive teardrop of pure white glaes artistically formed as if plummeting into the basin just above the water's surface.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Promenade North]
description: The north quarter of the promenade meets a quickly moving stream.  Babbling and splashing turbulently northwest, the stream flows under a short stone bridge before curving out of sight through an invar grate in the settlement's wall.  A short barrier of dark glaes protects the cobblestones near the water's edge.  To the south, a magnificent fountain rivals the noisy babbling of the stream.

title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Promenade South]
description: The cobblestone path of the promenade divides and weaves between colorful dwellings and varied merchant stalls, adjoining a row of stone houses to the south, a small market to the east, and a magnificent fountain to the north.  Constantly falling grey ash has been pushed into small piles at each corner, either intentionally or by the heavy amount of traffic moving through the area.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, northwest

title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Promenade East]
description: Cobblestones meet at a crossroads in the east quarter of the promenade, where a briskly moving narrow stream splatters along the settlement's northern edge.  Rushing from its source to the east, the stream bends sharply along smoothed, granite stonework.  On the opposite bank, a cluster of mangroves and taller trees form a tightly compacted, impenetrable wall of wild growth.  To the west, you can hear the splashing of water as it lands in the basin of a magnificent fountain.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Stone Mill Road]
description: The cobblestones of the promenade come to a sudden end, transitioning into a rugged gravel road.  Alongside the road is a narrow stream that gushes forth from a bubbling hot spring, its surface layered with roiling fog.  A stout stone mill resides between the promenade and the spring, its waterwheel turning steadily in the rushing waters.  Berry-laden bushes grow between mushroom-covered mangroves along the opposite bank.

title: [Stone Mill, Mead Hall]
description: Large, artfully carved blocks of mistwood are pushed against the walls, serving as makeshift tables amid a sea of casks used as seating throughout the hall.  The raucous clinking of mugs and boisterous storytelling does little to drown out the constant drone of the mill's waterwheel.  An old long-bearded dwarf stands amid a circular mistwood bar in the middle of it all, shifting his attention between a ruddy clay stove and a wooden rack full of glass bottles.

title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Hot Spring]
description: Rising steam forms into layers of mist and fog that turbulently shift across the surface of the opaque, pale white waters of the bubbling spring.  A stream of the upwelled water has carved its way through the irregularly shaped rocks surrounding the spring, splashing along some carved grey granite steps leading to Stone Mill Road.

title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Ragnak Market]
description: Booths and stalls comprise a busy market that serves as a hub of commerce within Kragnek Dzu, bustling with activity as crafters and merchants toil away with their wares.  A small stone shop stands in the middle of the market, displaying a row of finely crafted, colorful metal scabbards in its only visible window.  Large canver trees entwine their branches over a walkway leading southwest, toward a row of squat stone houses.

title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Ragnak Row]
description: Squat stone houses are arranged in two rows along a short, ruddy road of smooth granite cobblestones, the paths leading to the entrance of each dwelling boasting myriad pieces of colorful glaes artwork.  Large canver trees entwine their branches over a walkway leading northeast, toward a small market.

title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Glaes Court]
description: The cobblestones abruptly end where a massive glaes dais is anchored into the ground beneath its center, and supported around its circumference by uniform, grey granite pillars.  A towering grove of mistwood trees form a dense barrier around the dais, interspersed with thick brambles and patches of wild flora.

title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Glaes Dais]
description: The flat, smooth surface of the dais is covered in a layer of perpetually falling grey ash.  Other than where the dais connects to some wide, stone steps leading down to the cobblestones of Glaes Court, seven granite pillars support the dais at equal intervals around its circumference.  Crowning each pillar is an artistically symbolic statue of a tool crafted with apparent dwarven styling: an adze, an anvil, an awl, a chisel, a grinding wheel, a hammer, and a hand saw.

title: [Adorned Deliverance]
description: Symbols of the Arkati are carved into the walls of this tidy shop.  Dwarves hurry between spools of metallic wire and a tool-covered workbench, and short lengths of bent metal wire are organized in rows across its surface.  Completed talismans are displayed on small hooks, dangling from a long wooden rod.

title: [Emblematic, Atrium]
description: The angular interior of this building is crafted from carved sections of wood and stone, comprised of short hallways adjoining a row of six workrooms to this chamber.  A vaulted ceiling curves upward from each of the glaes-framed archways that mark the entrance to each workroom, forming a wooden dome that is carved in bas-relief with emblems of various flora and fauna.  Each emblem is arranged within one of many concentric circles, centered around a Ragnak Clan crest at the ceiling's concave apex.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, out

title: [Gamordi's Goods]
description: Flat slabs of dark basalt form the walls, floor, and ceiling of the perfectly cubical space that is the shop's interior.  Worktables line one wall, covered in various tools used to work with leather, gemstones, and metals.  The other side of the shop is lined with fully stocked shelves, attended to by a pair of young dwarves dressed in white-striped, teal and grey uniforms.  A pair of wrought invar lanterns, one on each side of the shop's large window, provide ample amounts of light.

title: [Emblematic, Workroom]
description: The walls of this narrow workroom are decorated with numerous emblems.  A short table and bench are covered in artist's tools, and pots of differently colored powders and fluids are organized in a nearby rack.

title: [Emblematic, Workroom]
description: The walls of this narrow workroom are decorated with numerous emblems.  A short table and bench are covered in artist's tools, and pots of differently colored powders and fluids are organized in a nearby rack.

title: [Emblematic, Workroom]
description: The walls of this narrow workroom are decorated with numerous emblems.  A short table and bench are covered in artist's tools, and pots of differently colored powders and fluids are organized in a nearby rack.

title: [Emblematic, Workroom]
description: The walls of this narrow workroom are decorated with numerous emblems.  A short table and bench are covered in artist's tools, and pots of differently colored powders and fluids are organized in a nearby rack.

title: [Emblematic, Workroom]
description: The walls of this narrow workroom are decorated with numerous emblems.  A short table and bench are covered in artist's tools, and pots of differently colored powders and fluids are organized in a nearby rack.

title: [Ragnak Clan Cuts]
description: Smoothed timbers of fruitwood trees are lashed together into a frame and floor for this sturdy, elevated booth, upon which myriad weapons are hung for display.  Superbly masoned river stone half-walls are capped by windowed sections of lattice, arranged between upright, carved stone pillars at the booth's two furthest ends.  A bead-shrouded opening at either end provides one way in and one way out, each angled toward the bustling market of Kragnek Dzu.

title: [Ragnak Clan Defenses]
description: Opened, free-standing displays in this enclosed stall offer samples of various ruddy brown armors, from cloth and soft leathers to chain and plate.  One display has four distinct types of shields mounted to its opened doors, framing the suits of plate armor within.  Another supports an arrangement of horizontal poles supported by both sides of a large cabinet, each dangling robes and leathers of slightly different design and size.  A dwarven artisan attends to patrons as they approach to barter and haggle.

title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Rock Garden]
description: The settlement's clan hall stands proudly in the middle of a large rock garden filled with smooth pink, blue, grey, white, and black stones of different sizes.  Dark glaes statues of dwarves holding myriad crafting tools decorate a carved stone path leading to the hall's glaes-framed entrance.  A clustered treeline almost completely encircles the area, broken only by a short stone bridge that traverses a quickly moving stream to the south.

title: [Clan Hall, Entrance]
description: In sharp contrast to the stone construction of the hall's floor and ceiling, panels of blonde mistwood cover the lower half of the walls in this spacious entryway.  Each panel is decorated with a row of colorful, dwarf-cut gemstones along its beveled top, where the wall transitions to smooth grey stone.  A young dwarf stands attentively near a short granite table to one side of a strip of grey-bordered, dark green carpet that leads north.

title: [Clan Hall, Meeting Chamber]
description: A long strip of grey-bordered dark green carpet ends at a row of wide, curved stone steps leading up to an elaborate eonake-framed podium and a row of carved stone seats behind it.  To either side of the carpet, grey granite pews are arranged to face the podium.  A pair of invar-framed lanterns hang from chains overhead, one to each side of the raised platform upon which the podium stands.

title: [River Muagh, Ashen Bend]
description: A narrow outcropping of crystal-flecked granite juts from the surface of the river on the west bank, towering over the younger trees growing along the water's edge.  Grey ash striates the muddy, flower-covered banks as it slowly washes into the water's edge.

title: [River Muagh, Ashen Bend]
description: The river is wide and calm as it curves between an impassable barrier of mangroves, trees, ferns, and cattails along each bank.  Constantly falling grey ash muddles the clarity of the surface, stretching into a thin film that floats and clings together.

title: [River Muagh, Mangroves]
description: Wide and slow, the river meanders northward between clustered mistwood trees that tower over the banks on both sides.  Tiny black birds flit through the branches, the bravest occasionally diving into the tall grasses to find a snack.

title: [River Muagh, Mangroves]
description: The river meanders between wide, mangrove-laden banks, burbling as it flows eagerly toward the sea.  Dark, jagged cliffs are barely visible above the treeline to the north, almost hidden within the churning maelstrom of black clouds overhead.

title: [River Muagh, Dark Cliffs]
description: A forest of mistwood and canver trees to the south comes to a sudden halt as dark cliffs jut towards the sky on both sides of the river.  The sky is filled with pitch black thunderheads; a churning amalgamation of raw power.

title: [River Muagh, Dark Cliffs]
description: Barren of life, the dark cliffs are jagged and inhospitable.  The winds from a churning black maelstrom roar above the cliffs and blow harshly through a wide channel carved through them by the river's unending quest to flow into the Obsidian Sea.

title: [River Muagh, Mouth]
description: A churning black maelstrom blocks the sky on the eastern, seaward facing side of lifeless, dark cliffs that flank the river along both banks.  The wind whips about with an intensity only rivaled by dwarves charging toward free ale, and surging waves from the Obsidian Sea meet the River Muagh head on.  A battered raft tethered to a jagged basalt ledge is caught in a constant, turbulent mix of brackish water, tossed one way, then the other.

title: [River Muagh, Basalt Ledge]
description: The angled surface of the ledge is worn smooth from countless years of scouring rain, though its seaward-facing edge is sharp and jagged from undercutting waves battering it relentlessly.  Fierce swells continuously crash against a row of basalt rocks near a dark cave leading into the cliffside, forcing seawater violently upward toward the churning maelstrom that roils across the skyline.

title: [Dark Cliffs, Bloodied Cave]
description: Layers of dried blood and soot cover the walls and floor of this towering cave.  Deep slashes and gouges mar the walls where tools or weapons have struck with great force, revealing deep black basalt beneath the surface.  The gargantuan skull of a bizarre, leviathan creature hangs from the ceiling by numerous twisted dark glaes chains.

title: [Gargantuan Skull]
description: The dark spaces within the skull are intermittently interrupted by the angular edges of a pale, bony interior.  Small fractures run across the top and widen into cracks as they branch toward a large, jagged gash in one side that reveals the only way out.  The one remaining eye socket is angled outward on the opposite side, serving as a makeshift window from within this bizarre space.

title: [The Gallivant, Arcade]
description: Blind arcades glazed in vivid blue lapis bracket a paved path, terminating abruptly at a wall-like tangle of dense jungle greenery.  Cozily hugged by overgrown liana vines, an eye-catching circular sign touts "PRIZES" in bold block lettering.

title: [Piper's Peepers]
description: Spindled roots dangle from the ceiling, nature finding a way to invade the home within the barrow despite thick rafters and heavy planking.  Copper-sided lanterns are spread throughout the space, their sides decorated in avians that create shadows on the rough walls and hard-packed dirt floor.  A simple cot rests in one corner near a fireplace, while a variety of containers in blue, red, and green are clustered near the exit.

title: [Ember Ridge, Slope]
description: From the ember light-limned ridge, the land slopes gently downward, and a meandering path emerges and proceeds through a tall vine-woven arch bedecked with a banner and into the valley below.  From this vantage point, the tops of hardwood trees arrayed in autumnal dress are lit from beneath, beacons of warmth in a perpetual twilight.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: The immensity of the valley below erupts within the darkened, lunate cradle of the opposite rise in a riot of fiery hues.  Cushion-plump crowns of scarlet, yellow-gold, and tangerine top the trees, the ground beneath their plumed limbs hidden entirely by the display.  A low-lying fog haunts the perimeter of the wood, while the heart of the grove seems to glow with a light born of the myriad leaves.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: A small wooden footbridge, lost to the elements after years of disuse, spans a thin run of water that twists its way down the slope, ever running toward the shallowest point within the valley.  Small stones and clumps of moldering leaves bend it out of shape, diverting the water in a series of turns and miniature falls that leave a lingering gurgle of water in the air.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: The path is marked only by the twin, parallel tracts that run its length, each worn down to dirt through an age of fallen leaf cover by what might have been a cart or wagon.  Stones are arranged at each joint of the split rail fence that zig-zags its way alongside, each of the mounds adorned with both bright and newly fallen foliage and old and decaying leaves.  Hemmed in by the fence, brightly colored trees press in on both sides and oversee a stream that meanders down the incline of the hill.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: A perpetual twilight reigns beneath the canopies of oak and ash trees aflame with crimson and amber leaves.  Tufts of long-stemmed, cider-hued wisp lanterns glow softly from the base of every other post in the split rail fence lining the path, supplementing the middling light to guide the way.  The trailing run of water has widened into a small stream, carrying on its surface fallen leaves rather than being diverted by them.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: The sound of moving water is ever present in the gurgling of the stream that follows along the path on the other side of the fence like a devoted traveling companion.  Easing into a comfortable pitch for walking, the slope of the earth underfoot flattens at the valley floor, and the dirt path is embedded with tumbled stones in a nature-made cobbled lane.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: Though splitting to run both east and west, the path's forward movement terminates in an aged wooden platform that is built out over a mill pond in a crescent-shaped deck.  Benches line its railing, and where the supports keep hold of dry land, amber-glowing wisp lanterns grow in dense patches, lending to the warm, quiet ambiance of this place of rest.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: At the wood's edge, a gnarled stump hunkers between the other towering trees, shorn off as if felled by a wicked storm.  Its bark and open-faced wood is charred as if by lighting, and the twisting of its break suggests high wind.  Even so, it has found new life as a jagged altar of sorts -- myriad pillar candles stand in a crescent on its shorn brow, and wax has pooled and spread across its face, offerings of flowers and small tokens trapped in its cooled flows.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: Beneath the limbs bedecked in strands of gold-glowing paper lanterns, tiny fireflies dance between each individual luminary as if stringing them together with threads of light.  The effect is mesmerizing, making of the surrounding branches and leaves stained glass mosaics that gleam under the touch of the flickering light.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: Tall stalks of wisp lanterns have grown up at the end of a fallen half-submerged tree trunk that still clings to land, shooting up between the broken branches and curled dead leaves.  The toes of the tree, gangly roots made brittle by time and exposure, peek out of the water, having long since wiggled free of the soil that once gave them life.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: Moss-covered pilings rise in uneven measures from the pond, stretching in parallel lines from the shore to deeper depths.  The flooring they supported is only partially intact, with the boards at the farthest reaches rotting and collapsing into the dark water.  What of the platform that remains nearest the shore is questionable in its stability, any certainty buried under ages of moldering leaves and fallen branches.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: The remains of a building, little more than some inwardly collapsing walls and a rusted tin roof, are lofted just above the water's surface by dark pilings, and a broken and disused wooden water wheel lays off to the side amid the trees.  A millstone, half-buried in the soft soil at the pond's edge, betrays the building's forgotten purpose and diverts the slow trickle of a stream into the water.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: Large, diamond-shaped vellum lanterns crown strands of smaller luminaries threaded through the branches overhead, and the ribbons holding them in place accentuate the fiery hues with flashes of bronze and copper.  Along the ground, the bright shapes cast by the lanterns sway with every breeze that brushes through the trees, adding the soft whisper of a rustle to the gurgling of a nearby stream.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: Within the dark depths of the wood, warm flashes of golden light bob and weave between the shadowed trunks of the trees, tiny motes that flare to life, die, then are resurrected in their dance toward the path.  The closer they get, the brighter they are, until eventually the meandering fireflies break from the underdark of the wood and join their light with that of the luminaries overhead.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: A cluster of sugar maples, white ash, and birch trees draped in fiery orange and yellow-gold raiment are artfully posed amid the more darkly crowned, red-violet sweetgum trees along the path's edge, providing a vibrant overhang to a painted tin-roofed stall.  Swags of plum-hued gauze festoon the edge of the roof, tacked in place with posies of folded corn husks, dark berries, and acorn clusters.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: To the northwest, the trees recede to the edge of an open grove that lies beyond a woven willow branch archway.  Gauzy bronze-hued fabric is arranged along the crest of the arch and drapes each side before continuing in a shallow swag along the adjoining fence.  Miniature paper lanterns dangle like luminescent fruit from the tree limbs overhead, dispelling any darkness from the path.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: Plaid tablecloths in shades of umber, goldenrod, and deep burgundy drape a collection of square tables with hay bale seating arranged in a circle within the open grove, far enough from the trees to avoid the mist collecting there and close enough to the central bonfire to feel its warmth.  Beneath a banner lofted by rough-hewn wooden poles is a gourd-adorned buffet with an autumnal plaid tablecloth, with stacks and piles of dishes and silverware stocked at one end.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: Thin fingers of mist recoil from the path that leads westward, their feathery lengths bathed in a golden cast by the wisp lanterns growing at the base of a sweetgum tree just beyond the bordering split rail fence.  The trunk of the tree is festooned with wide-cut burlap ribbons from which dangle clusters of dyed corn husk bows, colorful sprigs of leaves, and acorn accents.  In the air, a vague hint of smoke accompanies the chill.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: Whorls of mist tease the edges of the path as it rambles to the east, and the trunks of the sweetgums and white ash trees are decorated with wide-cut burlap ribbons pinned with arrangements of colorful leaves, acorns, and dyed corn husk bows.  Faint strains of music accompany the chill in the air, and tufts of wisp lanterns light the spindly figure of the split rail fence that zig-zags southward.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: In the scant windows left open by the full, color-laden tree branches overhead, glimpses of the twilight sky press through, and the miniature paper lanterns strung from the underside of the canopies keep the darkness at bay.  Swags of gauzy bronze-hued fabric drape the fencing that bookend either side of a similarly adorned woven willow branch archway that leads to a bright clearing to the northeast.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: A wisp lantern-dotted perimeter rings a dance floor of glossy brown birch and white oak parquet panels, while a group of musicians sit tucked beneath an overhang of sugar maple tree branches laced with glowing lanterns.  The remainder of the leaf-carpeted edging is strewn with small, three-legged tables encircled by tightly bound, square hay bales draped in bronze and crimson checkered fabric.  Amidst the tables is a tiered wooden drink stand adorned with miniature gourds.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: Music breezes lightly through the air, soft as a memory, insulated from escape by the dense tree cover overhead.  Leaves of wine red-violet are offset by intruding limbs draped in golden yellow that warm to ember-bright orange, and the scent of maple sap is high in the cool, lantern-lit air.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: Within the deep woods on the other side of the split rail fence that separates the path from a misty maze of trees is the shadowy outline of an old barn.  Its countenance is askew, slanted to one side, and bearing the shape of a bent, old man, stubbornly hobbling along with a cane.  Gaping holes in its side gaze at onlookers like dark eyes, the jagged edges of the crumbling wood lined by the pale fall of light from nearby lanterns.  To the southwest is an awning-covered field.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: Bronze gauze fabric continues in shallow scallops along the fence alongside the path, and clusters of long-stemmed wisp lanterns grow at the base of each post, causing the decoration to wink and glitter beneath the glow.  The scent of damp lingers in the air, little more than a specter beneath the aroma of fragrant hardwoods.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: The dense forest runs right up to the edge of a dark-faced pond, crowding thickly along the narrow strip of shore that runs between the trees and the water.
