Rocks and debris litter the bank as it trails like a dark ribbon off into the darkness and fog in the distance, while closer at hand sits a bench fashioned of a split tree trunk, slightly back from the water's edge, and newly budding wisp lanterns luminesce softly about its legs.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: So still as to produce a mirror-like surface, a pond lies motionless against its shore, where a stacked pile of smooth stones stands sentinel.  Diffuse veins of color crawl across the water's face, reflections from the wide stretch of open sky above.  The effect is disorienting, creating a tunnel-like mirage as the firmament and pond extend to the same fog-misted point on the horizon.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: Luminaries dangle from the branches of neighboring trees, their soft glow illuminating the branches in pinpoints of yellow, white, and gold light.  The scent of moldering leaves hangs heavy in the cool air, side by side with that of maple sap and freshly disturbed earth.  It adds a certain weight to the air that is heightened by the dimness of the surroundings and the stillness of the pond.  Resting beside a copper and mahogany bench is a woven river reed basket filled with smooth stones.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: The quiet *ploop* of something dropping into the pond carries through the chill air from time to time, and the sound is evidenced by the accompanying shallow ripples that disturb the water's surface.  As the tiny wakes break on the shore, the reflections of the lantern lights in the trees undulate, winking languidly in the darkness.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: A particularly ornate luminary dangles from the underside of an oak's bough, its glass-paneled facets cast in a variety of jewel tones and framed in black iron.  Around it, strings of smaller paper lanterns are strung, themselves painted with the rich colors shed by the radiant centerpiece.

title: [Luminary Festival, Mud Dippin']
description: Round pools of stagnant water are bridged by thick oak planks, which are nearly as wide as the puddles themselves.  Twisted vines and young saplings have been braided together with colorful ribbons to create a decorative railing to either side of the walkway.  A small dirty boy stands near a pile of mud-covered pails, his bare feet playing in a large puddle of mud that flows around the base of an iron water pump.

title: [Luminary Festival, Rolton Tails]
description: Oak planks lead to and from the small clearing, which has a firm ground covered with yellow and green moss.  Purple-edged canvas of faded blue is stretched between autumn-kissed trees to create a protective awning, beneath which an unshaven huckster presides over a basket of rolton tails.  Anchored to a third tree is a cutout of a painted wooden rolton that has a painted black star where its tail should be.

title: [Luminary Festival, Ball Toss]
description: Scattered apple trees dot the terrain, which is covered in small and large boulders draped in yellow and green moss.  Resting within the ring of trees is a small ivory-canopied stall, its smooth expanse covered with a pyramid of murky white glass cider carafes.  A mustachioed huckster paces between the stall and a pile of brick-colored balls, his friendly glances drifting to the aurora-laced sky.

title: [Festival, Catfish Noodlin']
description: Trickles of a westward stream cascade down the slope, filling a pool surrounded by white stones with silt, leaves, and other fine detritus.  The pool spreads south and eastward, though its edges are confined by rocks.  A small plank dock juts into its depths, a young boy reclining upon a rhimar chest where a hastily scratched wood sign leans.

title: [Luminary Festival, High Striker]
description: Towering above the surrounding foliage, and reaching higher than the various apple trees that dot the landscape, is a tall bell-topped pole marked incrementally in black paint.  Smaller posts surrounding it are decorated with either black ribbons for failures or the blue ribbons of prize winners, their ends trailing to the moss-dappled ground.  A large wooden-hafted mallet rests against the pole, with a burly muscular huckster looking on.

title: [Luminary Festival, Pop It]
description: Sheets of thin wood are strung between leafless apple trees and bound in place by thickly braided hempen cords.  Rows of brightly colored inflated orbs are anchored to the face of the wooden sheets, which are pockmarked with hundreds of tiny puncture marks.  A pile of sharp metal darts lies on the stump of an old tree that acts as a makeshift counter, while a dirty huckster lounges nearby.

title: [Luminary Festival, Duck Bob]
description: Sheltered by the broad, leaf-laden limbs of an ancient oak, the small clearing is covered with thick blades of grass.  Several large bricks support an enormous wooden tub that is filled with water and wooden ducks.  Lounging nearby, a freckled young boy watches over the floating avian collection.

title: [Festival, Pumpkin Chuckin']
description: Perched near the stone-littered top of a small incline, the clearing descends to the west into a grassy expanse that ambles away from the burbling stream.  Painting the pale green grass in orange, white, and yellow hues are the remains of hundreds of pumpkins, their vine-topped heads and curved sides scattered about as if a great battle was waged by the vegetable.  At the top of the clearing, a hefty korrigan stands within a field of bright orange pumpkins marked by a seed-covered bright orange sign.

title: [Luminary Festival, Barrel Fish]
description: Hemp rope marks the perimeter of this small clearing, while thick strands of duckweed float on a somewhat obscured water course.  Blankets of yellow-headed moss grow upon shale slabs that are partially buried into the soft ground and short tufts of grass grow everywhere else.  To the southwest, the dark shadow of leafless apple trees haunts the landscape.  A tall lanky fellow stands beside a tray of assorted knives resting atop a few stacked crates and an open-lidded red wooden barrel.

title: [Festival, A Token Gesture]
description: Scattered throughout the uneven terrain are large and small boulders covered in yellow and green moss.  Apple trees stretch their crooked arms to the aurora-painted sky, their spindled limbs clacking together in a faint breeze.  Slouched against a large box, a dirty gjenganger boy plays with a stick next to a large wooden frame, a bucket filled with pile of wooden tokens rests just beneath the frame.

title: [Harvest Luminary Festival]
description: This small, natural niche in the dense wood is outlined by a series of small square hay bales and tree limbs bedecked in strands of bright vellum luminaries.  A few larger pendant lanterns with patterned glass shades cast geometric shapes on the leaf-covered ground, making the fallen colors glow in the light.

title: [Luminary Festival, Awning Field]
description: Colorful awnings in teal, gold, and copper stretch across the grassy field and are held aloft by tall poles wrapped in burgundy and mustard yellow ribbons.  Laughter trickles in from other sections of the field where guests play games of darts in hopes of winning tickets for the various prizes found throughout the fairgrounds.  Beyond the shelter of the awnings, luminaries decorate the trees and bushes, their bright glow making the foliage seem deeper and darker.
paths: Obvious paths: north, west, northwest, out

title: [Festival, Balloon-n-Darts]
description: Reclining beneath a large section of burgundy awning, a bored and lanky bodach makes lackluster attempts to draw customers to his game.  An arrangement of fletched darts rests upon a rough clapboard counter that creates a barrier between the walking space and a large colorful gaming board.  Faintly flickering lights draw attention to luminaries hung in the trees beyond the field.

title: [Festival, Balloon-n-Darts]

Beyond the shelter of the awnings, luminaries decorate the trees and bushes, their bright glow making the foliage seem deeper and darker.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, west, out

title: [Festival, Water Cannons]
description: Wedged between a small copper-sided chest and a water-filled oak barrel, a rough painted oak sign provides information for the game that can played beneath this section of the awning-covered field.  Various water cannons, some broken and others displaying signs of recent repair, are scattered about the moss-covered ground, though a few in working condition rest against the base of the barrel and appear ready for use.  Splitting her attention between cannon and patrons, a mop-haired freckled girl collects coins and tinkers with jovial abandon.

title: [Festival, Water Cannons]
description: Wedged between a small copper-sided chest and a water-filled oak barrel, a rough painted oak sign provides information for the game that can played beneath this section of the awning-covered field. Various water cannons, some broken and others displaying signs of recent repair, are scattered about the moss-covered ground, though a few in working condition rest against the base of a small copper-sided chest and appear ready for use.  Splitting her attention between cannon and patrons, a mop-haired freckled girl collects coins and tinkers with jovial abandon.

title: [Hotel, Thirteenth Floor]
description: A cylindrical dark crystal chandelier casts a starburst pattern across a vaulted ceiling and pale cream-colored walls illuminating a pair of ebonwood double doors.  Flanked by potted direblooms, a satinwood console table bears a silver tray stacked with sealed envelopes and a burnished brass call bell.  Freshly polished, a faint trace of lemon wax drifts up from a dark-stained, basketweave parquet floor.

title: [Penthouse, Lounge]
description: Bathed in warm candlelight from a dark vaalin chandelier, shadows cling to the richly paneled satinwood walls and heavy brocade curtains pulled back to reveal expansive glaes-paned windows.  The parlor's centerpiece, a low-backed settee upholstered in deep crimson damask, faces a glassy obsidian fireplace over which hangs an oval gilt-framed mirror.  A grand mahogany side table sits under a cluster of ancestral portraits, the paint on their austere faces cracked and flaking.

title: [Penthouse, Hallway]
description: Perched upon a glass-topped fel bookcase crowded with leather-bound texts, a taxidermy raven with a solitary, faceted onyx eye peers down the long corridor.  On one side, a child-sized carved walnut rocking chair sits vigil next to a pair of paneled pumpkin ash doors carved with interlocking vines and curling leaves.  A plush crimson carpet runner shows the way to an imposing door showcasing a gargoyle-headed brass ring.

title: [Penthouse, Guest Suite]
description: Across from a wrought iron-framed bed fitted with a plump feather mattress, a lacquered mistwood dressing table is partially concealed behind a painted silk screen for privacy.  A framed painting of the hotel grounds hangs above the dark-stained poplar mantel of a stone fireplace, a bundle of pristine white birch logs stacked to one side.  Arranged as a reading nook in the corner, a well-worn leather chair with an octagonal ebony side table crowded with books is positioned by the window.

title: [Penthouse, Kitchen]
description: Moonlight spills through muntined windows across black slate tiles, catching on brass fittings and the curve of a great hearth set with a cast iron stove.  At the center, a dining table of polished blackwood is set with silver candlesticks and a simple arrangement of aurora marigolds, while four bourde-upholstered chairs wait neatly around it.  Walnut cupboards line the room, displaying fine porcelain dishes and crystal jars filled with a variety of spices.

title: [Penthouse, Master Suite]
description: Illuminated by windows of slender glass panels divided by overwrought mullions reaching nearly to the ceiling, the room is dominated by a massive four-poster bed forged from dark glaes, the tapered pillars traced with swirling inlays of silver.  The doors of an ebony wardrobe stand slightly ajar, the contents reflected in an adjacent full-length mirror.  Attached to the armrest of a tone-on-tone damask chaise lounge, a silver tray can be used for tea service or doubles as a makeshift writing desk.

title: [Penthouse, Bath]
description: Polished brass fixtures gleam against walls paneled in dark cherry wood, their shine softened by candlelight from a conspiracy of black vaalin raven sconces with outstretched wings.  At the center of the chamber rests an ink-veined grey marble tub of considerable size, its rim carved with serpentine patterns, while the base is a sculpted sea of waves frozen in mid-crash.  A stack of folded white linen towels are tucked underneath a lacquered fel washstand set with an oval smoky nacre basin.

title: [Twelfth Floor, Front Stairs]
description: Softened by the glow of birdlike brass sconces, the stairway landing rests in hushed dignity, its walls clad in paneled mahogany and the floor covered with thick carpet.  Against the wall, a slim rosewood table offers a crystal decanter half-filled with stagnant water.  A red velvet rope has been strung across the opening of a darkened hallway, a small sign proclaiming the area off limits to guests.

title: [Eleventh Floor, Front Stairs]
description: A sweeping staircase spirals downward in a graceful arc, the wide steps carpeted by a runner of plush ebon velvet with gilt embroidery that catches the light from a crystal chandelier overhead.  A masterpiece of carved mahogany, the balustrade is inlaid with delicate gold filigree, while each newel post bears an avian-carved finial.  On the landing, a hallway leads into a guest floor of the hotel.

title: [Tenth Floor, Front Stairs]
description: An expansive oil painting depicting the hotel gardens from a birds-eye view hangs near the entrance to a long hallway.  Furnished with a spindly table, its centerpiece a tapered black glaes vase filled with jewel-toned direblooms, the landing offers a brief respite between floors.  The curve of the staircase draws the eye naturally toward the chandelier-lit ceiling above.

title: [Ninth Floor, Front Stairs]
description: Carved with delicate flourishes of acantha leaves, the banister follows the broad, sweeping curve of the gleaming mahogany steps along the winding staircase.  Near the arched opening of a long hallway on the landing is a cushioned bench, designed less for rest than for ceremony, as though the climb itself is part of the hotel's silent pageantry.  Above, the stairs still wind on.

title: [Eighth Floor, Front Stairs]
description: Tall, narrow windows admit slants of starlight that gleam on floriated brass sconces set into the walls at regular intervals.  Beneath the graceful curve of the stairs, an arched passageway invites you into a quiet hallway, its carpet muffling every footfall.  The faint scent of wood polish lingers in the air.

title: [Seventh Floor, Front Stairs]
description: A sweeping staircase of dark polished mahogany rises gracefully to the upper floors, the lofty stairwell illuminated by the soft, flickering light of a large silver candelabrum.  The rail curves in a graceful arc, its banister broad enough to slide down its length.  To one side of the landing, an arched doorway opens into a long, carpeted hallway that leads deeper into the hotel.

title: [Hallway, Seventh Floor]
description: Polished dark wood paneling showcasing intricate moldings is paired with rosette-stenciled buttercream wallpaper along the passage.  At regular intervals, winged leather armchairs provide resting spots amid potted wraith ferns.  A gracefully winding staircase of rich mahogany rises at one end, its banister carved with floral motifs.

title: [A Carpeted Landing]
description: Crystal droplets, pendants, and beads draped over an elaborate gold leaf frame create a dazzling display of illumination in the grand stairwell of the hotel.  Framed by gilded railings on both sides, the centerpiece is a sweeping, curved staircase, clad in polished mahogany and adorned with a crimson carpet featuring gold floral motifs.  A dried garland of purplish black hissing ivy and midnight belladonna cascades down each banister, filling the air with a sweet, yet acrid, fragrance.

title: [The Forest of Fate's Holding]
description: Shadow presses close where a narrow trail slips out of the forest and into the fire-lit clearing beyond.  The towering trunks of arboreal giants crowd together, their branches knitting a canopy that swallows most of the sky.  Through the gaps, faint streaks of an aurora-green sky glimmer before fading.  Thickets of sloe and fern press close to the path, their tangled growth creating a living wall.  The air hangs thick and damp, as if the forest holds its breath.

title: [The Forest of Fate's Holding]
description: From beyond the surrounding shrub brush comes the low murmur of a brook, its waters moving unseen but steady, a hidden current threading through the forest.  Trees rise thick around the path, their canopy sealing off the sky until the wind sighs and lets slip streaks of azure, violet, and coral light.  A pale ring of mushrooms rims the track's edge, their caps glistening in the dimness.  Beside them towers an ancient tree, its limbs trailing with grandpa's beard moss that sways in the shifting air.

title: [The Forest of Fate's Holding]
description: Three narrow tracks converge, their junction shaping a shallow clearing where grass threads across the ground in scattered tufts.  Overhead, the canopy knits tight, keeping the sky distant and dim, though faint currents of air drift through with the scent of damp earth.  Near the center rests a broad boulder, its surface softened by moss and etched with faint grooves worn by time.

title: [The Forest of Fate's Holding]
description: Sloping subtly downward, the trail crosses a brook whose waters spread outward in a shallow run across smooth stones.  Moss clings to their damp surfaces, lending a muted green sheen where the light catches.  The water moves with a soft, lyrical cadence, its current slipping southwest beneath natural pillars of granite.  Overhead, the canopy presses close, dimming the passage in a gloom where little light breaks through.

title: [The Forest of Fate's Holding]
description: Converging from every direction, four paths meet in a ragged junction, their dirt surfaces crowded with wiry grass, pockmarked with tiny holes, and scattered with loose stones.  At the center rises a weathered post, its lantern crown faintly askew, metal darkened by age and damp air.  Around the clearing, young growth presses hard against ash, beech, and fir, the spry trunks thrusting upward to pierce the canopy only to spread their own leaves as they contribute to the gloom.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, west

title: [The Forest of Fate's Holding]
description: Twisting forward like a game trail, the narrow track is hemmed close by bent trees whose arching limbs knit a low vault overhead.  Darkness thickens beneath their boughs, the air damp and heavy.  Nodule-ridden turquoise vines crisscross the ground in tangled knots, their thorny tendrils glistening faintly in the ambient light as they engulf fallen wood and overtake nearby brush.  Shadows deepen in the cramped passage, as if the forest itself leans inward to watch.

title: [The Forest of Fate's Holding]
description: Threading between arching trunks, the game trail winds through the forest before vanishing into thick undergrowth as little more than a shadow.  At the center of a ring of bowed trees stands a round bark-sided hut sporting a thatched roof.  To one side, a small garden of medicinal and culinary herbs grows in loose rows that meander into the woods, their tended edge giving way to wild sprigs.

title: [Gloamholt Heart]
description: Ill-lit and cramped, the hut is small but tidy.  An enormous riverstone hearth, surrounded by aging chairs with reed-woven seats, dominates the northern wall, a wrough iron hearth hook anchored beneath its mantle.  Grimy windows gaze unblinkingly into the dark of the forest, the space before them filled with low cabinets, ribbon and reed baskets, and a large soapstone basin.  A low sleeping pallet rests opposite a crooked hoarbeam door, its blankets neatly folded.

title: [The Forest of Fate's Holding]
description: Curving sharply, the path doubles back on itself, dipping southeast beneath a break in the canopy and curling south toward a distant convergence of pathways.  Light spills unevenly through the opening above, pooling across roots, fallen needles, and struggling saplings.  At the curve's heart rises an oak of impossible age, its trunk split down the center into twin columns.  From one sturdy limb hangs an ancient swing, its seat carved from a weathered branch and suspended by ropes braided of coarse grass.

title: [The Forest of Fate's Holding]
description: High above, the canopy loosens to let in scattered traces of sky, its pale light falling across a small glade where a carpet of blooming heather blooms in low swathes of muted purple.  To the west, tall oak and spruce rise in close ranks, their roots tangled amid dense stands of fern.  The path curves through the forest, its surface broken by half-buried stones that catch the light and seem to glow against the shadowed earth.

title: [The Forest of Fate's Holding]
description: Eastern stretches of the path run beside an expanse of lady ferns, their fronds feathered and dense, crowding together in layered waves of green, plum, and bronze.  Across the track, autumn-hued leaves mingle with fallen evergreen needles, mottling the ground in a patchwork of color.  Towering trunks rise overhead, their lower branches stripped bare, reaching upward like arms lifted in supplication, while beyond them, faint glimpses of twilight hues filter through the canopy's dark weave.

title: [Solindago Anox]
description: Marking the pathway at the transition point where the savanna enclosures and rocky northern habitats of the wild cats and bears meet, the area is dominated on the south by burnished grasses and to the north by verdant bushes and towering pines.  A wide-canopied acacia spreads its shade upon the grasslands on one side, while blending with the spindled and curving conifers on the other.  Benches surround a small outcropping where a freckled half-elf vendor hawks her wares from a semi-circular bar.

title: [Solindago Anox]
description: A wide grassy field protected by a large enclosure sits to the west of the path, and a large piece of transparent glass serves as a window to the world within the large habitat.  A subtle breeze blows through the enclosure, stirring the grasses and leaves on the trees that rise up from the ground.  An ebon-feathered cockatrice can be seen moving about the field.

title: [A Stone Chamber]
description: A single oil lamp hanging from the high vaulted ceiling illuminates the small oval chamber.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Firmly bolted to the wall at one side of the room is a small, cast-iron ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Lounge Lockers]
description: Warm light filters through the curtained opening, faintly illuminating the simple cell.
