title: [Helden Hall, Lockers]
description: A large wooden counter fills this area, and your locker sits on top of it.  The torchlight flickers, as if in excitement as you prepare to open your bounty-filled locker.

title: [An Icy Pool]
description: The water is ice-cold!  Freezing trails of vapor form with each breath, and you wonder how long someone can take the cold before freezing into a solid block of ice.  Even though the pool looks frosty enough to form ice on its surface, you begin to feel slightly invigorated by the chilly water.  That feeling lasts for only a few moments though, before numbness begins to threaten your extremities.

title: [Helden Hall, Bladegirt's Den]
description: As your eyes adjust to the darkness you discover you are in a dank cave.  The lack of light makes it impossible to judge the room's immensity.  In the center, you make out the form of a large rock covered with bearskins.  Across from the rock bed, you see a firepit.  Off to the side, you see a ferocious grizzly bear.

title: [Helden Hall, Strathe's Room]
description: Muted light accompanies a peaceful silence throughout the room.  Despite being simple and relatively unfurnished, it still looks comfortable.  A deceptively large modwir bed stands near the window, covered in pillows, with a bookcase nearby.  The stone floor is bare except for a large polar bear skin at the foot of the bed.  Heat radiates from the fireplace set in the wall below an exquisite banner.

title: [Helden Hall, Drektor's Room]
description: This room seems smaller than the others, and smells lightly of pine.  There is a large bay window on the far side of the room.  Against one wall is a simple down bed covered with a dark blue quilted blanket and a few pillows.  A fine oak desk takes a corner near the window, with a single leather-backed chair in front.  A small bookshelf is bolted above the desk.

title: [Lockers, Antechamber]
description: A simple wooden chair and a short square table are the only furnishings in this bare room.  The open ceiling shows the warehouse roof high above.  The sounds of workers moving crates in the warehouse below can be easily heard through the thin floors."

title: [Warehouse, Lockers]
description: The far wall of this small room is filled with an array of small, locked doors.

title: [Rowanberry Room]
description: Long drapes of dark red velvet cover the walls, softening the effect of the polished blood-red tiled floor.  Low tables topped with black marble hold dozens of votive candles in crystal holders.

wayto.35991: lean on tart book in bookcase

title: [Rowanberry Room, Cubbyhole]
description: The small room ends in a dark leather curtain which is drawn shut.  Remnants of old advertising slogans are painted onto the curtain.

title: [Rowanberry Locker Room]
description: The grey stone walls are bare, except for brass wall sconces with candles burning cheerfully.  A woolly, rolton fur rug stretches out on the floor of this small room.

title: [Helden Hall Annex]
description: Two huge toadstools in large stone pots illuminate a large, comfortable room.  Dusky brown granite benches line two of the marble walls, facing each other across the sapphire carpet.  Above one bench hangs the Helden Hall house crest.  On one wall, a brass arch allows exit to the corridor outside, while on the other wall a curtain provides entrance to the locker area.

title: [Helden Hall Lockers]
description: A small swarm of fireflies flit about in a cylindrical cage hung from the granite ceiling.  Their blinking green and yellow glows softly illuminate this small room.  Though the marble walls are unadorned and the granite floor is uncarpeted, the room still provides a quiet place for contemplating the contents of your locker.

title: [Agate Lounge, Cubbyhole]
description: This narrow, cramped space ends abruptly at a curtain.

title: [Agate Lounge, Lockers]
description: You stand in a tiny, cramped space.

title: [Helden Hall, Locker Annex]
description: Suffused light emanates from a black marble fireplace set against the far wall, supplementing the light streaming through small shuttered windows.  A natural, unobstructed walkway across the white marble floor is created from the curtain to the fireplace by the placement of a deep-seated leather couch and an opposing sturdy table with an assortment of papers scattered upon it.  A glass-fronted display case is set against the wall next to a wall-mounted blackboard and an iron-worked framed picture hangs above depicting beautiful Aelotoi figures, with wings unfurled.

wayto.35998: pull black tome on display case

title: [Helden Hall, Cubbyhole]
description: Small and cramped, the room is more like a closet.  A curtained archway covers one whole wall, while a small lever protrudes from another.

title: [Helden Hall, Lockers]
description: Carefully arranged across the floor are plush, powder blue carpets patterned with multicolored interlocking bubbles.  The rear wall of the chamber is comprised of numerous small, locked compartments.  For your convenience, your personal locker is placed on a low granite-topped counter.  On the wall opposite the counter hangs an oil painting rendered in vivid colors.

title: [The Armor Lounge]
description: The massive granite hearth is flanked by two sets of gleaming armor.  The rich hardwood floor is covered with a small area rug embroidered with repeating patterns of red and white.  Comfortable looking oak chairs are scattered about the room, several pulled close to the hearth as if waiting to share in quiet conversation.  Two large broadswords are mounted above the mantel, their blades crossed, their edges sparkling in the firelight.

title: [A Stone Chamber]
description: A single oil lamp hanging from the high vaulted ceiling illuminates the small oval chamber.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Firmly bolted to the wall at one side of the room is a small, cast-iron ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Lounge Lockers]
description: Warm light filters through the curtained opening, faintly illuminating the simple cell.

title: [The Matross Dahcre Chamber]
description: Powerful columns of limestone anchor the corners of this ample room, rising high to brace the double-vaulted ceiling.  Some rush-seated oak chairs are clustered around a polished granite hearth in the northwest corner.  Lit by blazing torches on either side of a beveled glaes mirror, a large oak table along the south wall holds a laden refreshment tray.  Twin banners of a sword and shield flank the limestone arch into this hall, above which is set a silver-inlaid granite medallion.

title: [Darkened Chamber]
description: A single glaesine sconce attached to the wall illuminates the small chamber, casting a fitfully flickering light across the room's few features.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Dangling from a chain at one side of the room is a small mithglin ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Private Locker]
description: Jade green marble veined with cream covers the small amount of floor space, while pale oak paneling forms a modest wainscoting.  A white-on-cream figured silk covers the upper portion of the walls.

title: [House Annex, Helden Hall]
description: Devoid of nearby furnishings, a serpent-entwined claidhmore mural decorates the western wall under the light of several frosted glaesine globes that dangle from the ceiling.  Plush argent carpeting dappled with azure threads lends the otherwise austere space a coziness that is enhanced by the presence of a pale blue crushed velvet settee.  A lacquered beige door leads to the hallway, while a silver-edged lapis blue silk curtain provides access to the storage facilities.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: Ivory drapes hang upon the walls, their overly long lower edges pooling upon the soft rug that stretches from wall to wall.  The drape's silken lengths are unfettered except where they are parted to provide egress through a silver-edged lapis blue silk curtain.  A lacquered hoan counter sits in the center of the circular chamber, beneath the light of an enormous seaglass orb that is held aloft by a woven hemp basket.

title: [Silvergate Inn, Kitchen]
description: Centered in this bustling kitchen is a long maoral butcher block worktable.  Cast iron stoves line one wall with copper shelves holding spices and containers.  Glass oil lamps flicker brightly, illuminating the room as the mullioned windows offer a view of dancing fireflies.  Baker's racks are situated next to a large brick oven, while small tables holding trays of food sit opposite a horizontally divided oak door.  Nearly hidden in a recess are a long basin and an insulated ice box.

title: [Warehouse, Lockers]
description: The far wall of this small room is filled with an array of small, locked doors.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove facing a wall of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and placed on a marble counter.

title: [Opal Lounge, Lockers]
description: You stand in a tiny, cramped space.

title: [Halan Lea, Shore of Khesta'Dahl]
description: Smooth stones scatter across the shoreline, their rounded surfaces shifting slightly where waves brush against them.  Along the western water's edge, a row of globleflower shrubs forms a low barrier, their bright yellow blooms rising above dense green foliage.  A walnut and ironwood bench rests beside the winding track, and several bowls sit within easy reach.  In the shallows, lake sedge and cattails nod in the breeze, while far to the west, the lake breaks into small distributaries that slip into the taller grasses as they fade from view.

title: [Halan Lea, Western Track]
description: Distributaries from the lake wind just beyond conical gers, their narrow channels slipping through the grass at the backs of the western dwellings.  Across the worn walking path, the eastern side opens into a broad paddock where goats, sheep, and muskox wander in loose groups.  A fence fashioned of birch saplings marks the boundary, its pale uprights edging a small path that leads to the enclosure's interior.

title: [Halan Lea, Western Track]
description: Following an established track bordered by blue-green fescue, the area widens into an arch that cups a long birch-sapling fence along its eastern side.  A juniper-banded amber canvas ger and a wool and hide-latticed ger rest at the apex of the curve, their felt-wrapped backs turned toward a rolling sweep of grasslands where distributaries from Khesta 'Dahl slip away and vanish among tall feathergrass and sheepgrass.  Near the track's bend,  displays a twist of braided reeds hung with smooth lake stones that click softly in the breeze.

title: [Halan Lea, Sheltered Pasture]
description: Chunky Saens Valaire nanny and billy goats meander along the paddock's outer edge, keeping close to a grass-tied birch sapling fence as they nose through the low grass.  Within the enclosure, stoutfoot rolton younglings and a variety of fluffy lambs cluster in loose groups, their small forms shifting across the open ground.  Trampled paths cross the interior in pale lines where hooves have pressed the grass flat.

title: [Halan Lea, Western Track]
description: Resting side by side, a small peaked ger and a silver-striped niveous canvas ger are framed by the rolling grasslands at their backs where moonlit-swept blades ripple under passing breezes.  To the north, a birch sapling fence encloses a paddock filled with brindled sheep, stoutfoot roltons, and Saens Valaire goats moving in loose groups across the interior. In the open grasslands to the southwest, Mhoragian muskoxen doze amid the tall, waving blades.

title: [Halan Lea, Western Track]
description: To the south, the grasslands roll away in a wide stretch that spreads through the valley, while to the far east beyond the village's edge, the dark stain of woods rises from the mists of Khesta 'Dahl.  Domiciles dot the track, their entries turned toward a pasture where brindled sheep, stoutfoot roltons, and Saens Valaire goats roam.  Patches of caribou moss spread across the ground in pale green cushions, their rounded forms marking where the soil grows thin.

title: [Halan Lea, Rundling Green]
description: Set at the edge of a small hillock where a line of alternating larch and birch steps rise toward the summit, a small market spreads across an open expanse with its borders shaped only by the placement of stalls and carts.  To the northwest, the broad paddock of grazing animals lies in clear view beyond the shifting grass.  Near the market's center, a rowan tree grows in a sturdy, upright form, its feathered leaves and bright clusters of berries standing vivid against the open sky.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, southwest

title: [Halan Lea, Rundling Green]
description: Moving sinuously from north to south, the wide village track cuts through low fescue as it passes a small hillock crowned with a fire.  Along its eastern flank, an enormous ger banded with orange geometric patterns sits against the backdrop of a paddock wrapped in a birch-sapling fence.  Multiple chimney pipes pierce the conical roof, each sending a thin curl of steam upward into the open sky.

title: [Halan Lea, Grassland Entry]
description: Passing an unseen boundary, the tall grasses of the grasslands give way to bright yellow-green fescue that frames the beige tracks of the village.  Pockets of rock-strewn soil break through the turf where saussurea grows in thick clusters, its pale, downy blooms standing high above the scattered stones.  To the north, a small hill rises above the surrounding gers, its summit ringed with pennant-topped posts and crowned by a carefully built bonfire stack.

title: [Halan Lea, Rundling Green]
description: Positioned along the southeastern edge, a bright white felt ger and a ruddy dumpling-shaped ger face a web of narrow trails that branch into different parts of the village.  Beyond their circular forms, the grasslands rise and fall in long, wind-shaped waves.  Directly opposite, a line of alternating larch and birch steps climbs the hillside, each tread set into the earth in a steady progression that leads toward the gathering space above.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Halan Lea, Rundling Green]
description: Low-roofed but wide, a cobalt blue felt-sided ger crouches between the hillocks, its oblong shape giving it a slightly unusual presence beside the north-south track.  Wild tufts of sheepgrass cluster around its base, and bright white pebbles ring the footing before converging into a narrow path that meets the main route.  Wide boulders flank the entry, each one topped with neatly fitted sheepskins.

title: [Halan Lea, Shore of Khesta'Dahl]
description: Mist from Khesta 'Dahl drifts across the shoreline where a damp wooden boardwalk extends into the water, its narrow planks leading toward small fishing vessels that bob in the shifting haze.  Nearby, a line of alternating larch and birch steps climbs the hill to the south, the glow of a bonfire visible at its summit through breaks in the mist.  Established beige pathways curve around the hillock in worn, looping routes, passing the low growing fescue that rises in dense yellow-green patches along its edges.

title: [Halan Lea, Docks of Khesta'Dahl]
description: Shoreline stretches east and west in a continuous curve, the boardwalk running parallel to the water as it follows the worn track through fescue that clusters at the base of a southern hill.  Fishing racks rise at intervals along the path, their wooden frames strung with neatly hung lines and drying nets.  Nearby, simple smoking stations stand under open awnings, each fitted with low hearths and tiered grates where fillets rest in orderly rows above smoldering embers.

title: [Halan Lea, Shore of Khesta'Dahl]
description: Boardwalk planks stretch along the shoreline, their path paralleling the mist-hazed waters where small fishing vessels bob in slow, steady motions.  Wind chimes sway from the crossbeam of a freestanding arch fashioned of braided larch and birch poles, their pale surfaces catching the shifting light as the wood beneath them creaks in the breeze.  A line of alternating larch and birch steps climbs the hillock to the south, a bonfire's glow visible above.

title: [The Ciderstep Inn]
description: Rafters sweep upward toward the roof ring in a clean vault, their lengths bound with orange geometric bands that repeat in steady intervals around the interior.  Wood planks form a smooth circular floor, each board fitted tightly against its neighbor.  Near the central post, a slow dark walnut counter stands ready for check-ins, its front carved with shallow compartments and its top kept clear for use.

title: [The Ciderstep Inn, Sitting Room]
description: Partition walls curve to form a short hallway on the western side, their felt coverings banded with narrow blue geometric patterns.  Beyond the passage, a compact sitting area opens on a rug woven in cool tones of deep blue and white.  Thick round cushions in matching hues ring a low round table of dark-stained birch, where a shallow wooden dish rests filled with small morsels set out for visitors.

title: [The Ciderstep Inn, Sitting Room]
description: Partition walls curve inward to form a short hallway leading deeper into the ger, their felt-wrapped frames marked with narrow bands of orange geometric patterning.  Beside this passage, a compact sitting space opens on a small area rug woven in muted orange and cream.  Plump round cushions rest around a low birch table, its smooth top supporting a short clay vase filled with mixed grassland blossoms.

title: [The Ciderstep Inn, East Hall]
description: Curving along the ger's eastern interior, the hallway arcs north before meeting the western passage.  White felt forms the outer wall, while the inner curve rises in orange-dyed panels marked with narrow geometric bands.  A pair of entries open into adjoining inn rooms, their frames fitted cleanly into the felt-wrapped lattice.  Dark walnut planks span the floor in smooth, even lines.

title: [The Ciderstep Inn, West Hall]
description: Curving along the ger's western interior, the hallway arcs north before meeting the eastern passage.  White felt forms the outer wall, while the inner curve rises in blue-dyed panels marked with narrow geometric bands.  A pair of entries open into nearby inn rooms, their frames fitted cleanly into the felt-wrapped lattice.  Dark walnut planks span the floor in smooth, even lines.

title: [Hearthstone Cookery]
description: Clay beehive ovens rise in a low arc around the stall's rear and sides, their rounded forms filling the air with heat and their surfaces marked with faint soot at each vent.  A striped awning of yellow and green stretches overhead, its fabric tied to smooth white birch poles planted firmly in the packed earth.  Set beneath the sheltering cloth, a broad dark walnut table holds neatly arranged wares and small samples laid out for inspection.

title: [Twig and Tally]
description: Lashed woods form the stall's frame, each pole bound with braided feathergrass rope that has faded to a soft beige along its twisting strands.  The entire back wall rises in a mural of the surrounding grasslands, its rolling shapes rendered in dyed bark, dried moss, and layered leaves pressed flat against the panels.  Spanning the front of the space, a lashed dark walnut twig table creates a clean divide between the work area and the steady flow of the market's thoroughfare.

title: [Halan Lea, Seat of Fire]
description: Wide and flat at its crest, the hillock forms an open gathering place where a large blazing bonfire burns at the center in a steady column of rising heat.  Steps descend the slope at each ordinal point, their lines cutting clean paths into the surrounding grass.  Carved benches and flat-topped boulders fitted with sheepskins provide seating around the fire, while river reed baskets filled with sticks rest nearby for tending the flames.  One edge overlooks the rolling grasslands, while the opposite side opens toward Khesta 'Dahl.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Wongerful Heartfelt Blankets]
description: The white felt walls are mostly covered with tapestries of elaborate diamond patterns in a riot of saturated colors.  Wall hooks with blankets hang where the circular wall meets the rafters, which are strung with purple and red streamers.  The rafters end in a roof ring with dangling rustic lanterns, lighting up the bright tapestries and colorful rugs.  The shop is dominated by a sturdy wooden table curving along the walls.

title: [Featherfall Blessings, Display]
description: Braided wool forms a circular rug at the center of the hide ger, its muted strands arranged in tight spirals.  Copper lanterns hang from the roof poles above, their surfaces marked by gentle hammering.  Along the curved wall, a woven grass basket rests beside a low crate that supports a neat pile of prayer rugs.  Further around the curve, a carved wooden box sits on a hide-draped stand, its surface cut with simple, deliberate patterns.

title: [Hearth and Hide]
description: Warm lamplight spills across tightly packed shelves of small-size armor, each piece crafted from supple goat hide, brushed wool, or polished leather.  The curved walls of the ger are lined with felt panels stitched in spiraling horn motifs, and a faint scent of juniper smoke lingers in the air.  Tools hang neatly beside a low workbench.

title: [New Heights]
description: Inside this small ger, several mannequins are scattered haphazardly about amongst a littered floor covered by dead leaves, nut husks, and shriveled berries of various sorts.  Criss-crossed lattices of birch, pine, and rowan make up the khana, which is covered by a thick layer of felting and held in place by large bands of leather.  A wide loft, accessible via a narrow ladder, hangs above the mannequin's heads, blocking their view of the roof ring.

title: [New Heights, Loft]
description: Situated within a human's height of the roof ring, this platform is all but empty.  A hammock swings gently overhead, hanging from the rafters to just within a halfling's reach.  The only other decoration is a small lantern that sits near the ladder.

title: [The Well-Tressed Toe]
description: Strands of tiny square mirrors hang from the narrow rafters, their beveled edges scattering the roof ring's light into rainbow-limned patterns across the latticed khana.  A polished birch table stands behind the central hearth, its ornamental tapestry worked in dense embroidery of interlinked geometrics.  Atop a goat hide rug of curly wool, a multi-pronged stand spreads its feet and gleams with an assortment of rings.

title: [Foretold You So]
description: Smoke curls from a brazier of smoldering herbs, filling the ger with a haze scented with sweet sage and resin, the wispy tendrils eventually finding their way through the roof ring.  Along the dark-stained juniper khana, backed by amber-tinted canvas, a series of hooks bear varied rows of small bags and pouches.  Neatly stacked cases rest upon a wooden display traced in subtle inlays depicting pale snow lotuses.

title: [Weave Got You Covered]
description: Strips of fabric and leather decorate the twine-suspended wooden loops scattered across the framework of the wool-draped ger, the bundles of material bound by knotted threads.  Several sheepgrass baskets encircle the perimeter of a low-set juniper table at the center of the room, the trinket-filled containers interspersed by small wool-stuffed toy goats.

title: [Roaming Around]
description: Thick furs soften the hard ground beneath low wooden tables heaped with wares, several overstocked baskets tucked underneath.  A central brazier burns warmly, its smoke curling up through a hole in the tent, casting dancing shadows across woven blankets hung for decoration and added insultation.  Hanging strings of colorful beads sway gently as cold wind drafts blow through the canvas opening.

title: [Windstep Trinkets, Display]
description: Goat-hide walls stretch across the criss-crossed khana, held firm by belly bands while the continuity of the ger broken only by a tied door frame.  Rafters rise into the central roof ring above cases and stacked crates along the curved walls.  Copper lanterns hang from rafter joints, and a woven carpet covers the packed ground next to a blanket-draped archway.

title: [Nor'Saens Valaire, Halan Lea]
description: Wind-carved posts rise on either side of the path where the grasslands narrow into the village's edge, their tops hung with trailing sea buckthorn, rawhide strips, and knotted cords that flutter high above the swaying grasses.  Clusters of sea buckthorn grow at the bases of the posts, their thorny branches thick with narrow leaves and bright orange berries.  Beyond the markers, the path broadens among the first scattered gers.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [Halan Lea, Fishing Ger]
description: Lengths of fishing line are secured between twisted rafters overhead, dangling numerous small fish covered in salt and spices.  The floor of the ger is covered with woven reed mats, some stained with dry blood and others with various seasonings.  A pair of huge fish jawbones is adjoined in the center of the roof, where the rafters are secured to their large, jagged teeth.  Bright white walls of thick felt are well kept, with only a few lightly stained patches near a short wooden rack from the day-to-day toil.

title: [Brughan Dumplings]
description: Heavy layers of ruddy felt encircle a round wooden table in the center of this dwelling.  Colorfully painted saplings are bound and formed into rafters from which the felt is stretched and pulled taut into walls and a roof.  A slotted ring, carved from the adjoined tusks of a large creature, supports the rafters and binds the top of the structure.

title: [Halan Lea, Eastern Track]
description: Rugged vermillion felt wraps the central ger in sharp contrast to the two white gers flanking it, each topped with a pole bearing a streaming red pennant.  All three entries face the wide sweep of the valley's grasslands where bright violet-headed milkvetch grows thick among the yellow-green blades.  Goats graze along the edges of the trail, their movements parting the grasses in slow, shifting paths.

title: [Sock It To Me!]
description: The ger's canvas is painted a bright vermillion lined with thin, silver-hued stripes that run the full length of the interior.  A series of circular targets dot the sloping canvas roof, all inlaid with painted-on crossed pairs of socks set in each target's middle.  Several larger targets line the floor, painted onto wooden planks set atop the dirt floor, with a red-painted furniture collection set atop them.  A small sign is placed before the collection of furniture.

title: [Halan Lea, Eastern Track]
description: A trio of domiciles borders the southeastern edge of the branching pathway, the rolling grasslands stretching behind them in broad waves.  Opposite a rugged sky blue ger, the route that angles northwest is marked by colorful pennants that turn and flutter in the light breeze.  Tall stalks of allium rise between the gers, their spherical violet blooms standing bright against the shifting yellow-green of the surrounding grass.

title: [Dizzying Heights]
description: Stylized green grass lines the canvas's bottom, carrying halfway up the interior, after which the color changes to a vivid sky blue.  Across the canvas, grey-painted mountains rise above the grass and are crossed with painted niveous white clouds.  Atop these peaks are halflings posing, proudly holding billowing flags.  In the room's center, placed on the dirt floor, a sky blue wooden table is laden with carved stone game pieces.  Across from the table, a small wooden rack is placed.

title: [Halan Lea, Well of the Elders]
description: Perched atop a small hillock, an expansive bright white felt ger girded in bright blue and red bands rests on an elevated wooden platform that forms a wide patio encircling the fabric-wrapped structure.  Beneath the platform, shale and shard rock spread in uneven patches where limestone saxifrage grows in dense clusters, its pale blooms and glossy leaves creating a living carpet across the stones.  Extending outward from the large domicile, a line of colorful pennants trails down the slope, each cloth snapping lightly in the breeze, while at the edges of the hillock is a cluster of smooth stones.

title: [Seat of the Elders]
description: Verdant green, sunny yellow, and rose red paint the eye of the father in an interwoven pattern of sun and rose symbols, its carved ring rising above stacked figures of shaggy ponies arranged in a vertical column.  A broad wool rug rug covers the entire floor, its dense weave forming a long rectangle that stretches from the entry to the central post.  Rafters slope downward in clean lines, their ends settling neatly into the painted ring overhead.

title: [Seat of the Elders, Rose Hands]
description: Several sunny yellow armoires painted with interlocking rose vines stand in a neat row along the outer felt wall, their bright panels set in tall, rectangular frames.  Fleece blankets lie draped over plump qiviut cushions scattered across an intricate tapestry rug strewn with flowers in varied stages of bloom.  Small clay stoves sit at intervals around the space, each sending up a steady warmth that fills the chamber.

title: [Sanctuary of the Healer]
description: Soft felt walls rise in a neat ring around the chamber, their surface muted by hanging bundles from an oak-framed drying rack of herbs set along the outer curve.  A simple sleeping pallet rests on the wooden floor nearby, its thick cushion fitted with a tightly stitched wool cover.  A small pot-bellied stove stands close to the wall, its steady heat warming the enclosed space.

title: [Seat of the Elders, Sun's Eyes]
description: Cabinets painted in deep cobalt line the khana, each surface adorned with knotwork sun symbols that loop and twist across the wood.  Plump qiviut cushions are arranged in a loose circle, folded fleece blankets in muted hues draped across them.  An intricate tapestry rug sprawls beneath it all, its four woven quarters shifting from the pale tones of spring to the saturated heat of summer, then into autumn's russets and winter's stark whites.  Small clay stoves rest at intervals, their steady warmth softening the air.

title: [Sanctuary of the Mind]
description: Honeycomb-shaped cubbies ring the space, their compartments fitted with tomes and neatly rolled scrolls, while lanterns placed along the upper ledges cast a steady light.  Shielded vessels filled with ruby red coals maintain a dry, even warmth, their glow steady beneath protective grates and lids.  A thick fleece rug spans the floor, its dense fibers muting footsteps and softening the acoustics within the sacred chamber.

title: [Shore of Khesta 'Dahl]
description: Riverstones in shades of grey, cream, and muted rose blanket the shoreline of Khesta 'Dahl, their rounded shapes glimmering as the water laps over them.  Tufts of lake sedge and cattails that cluster near the shallows, their narrow blades rising in loose fans where the ground dips toward the waves.  To the east, the dark forest presses close to the waterline, while a small hillock that rises to the south is traversable by a set of alternating larch and birch steps.  Mist from the lake drifts inland in thin, cooling sheets.

title: [Halan Lea, Eastern Track]
description: Dark trees line the village's eastern edge, their trunks rising in close ranks where the mist from the northern lake drifts through the undergrowth and clings in low sheets along the forest floor.  Resting with its back to the mist and woods, a pristine white felt ger is a bright contrast to the shadowed timber beyond.  Around its base, mats of stonecrop spread across the rocky ground, their small star-shaped yellow blooms clustering in tight patches.  A door painted in warm saffron faces the village.

title: [Halan Lea, Eastern Track]
description: Larkspur and edelweiss scatter through the tall meadow grass along the village's southern edge, their blooms rising in bright pockets as the blades shift in moonlight.  To the east, black currant and sarsaparilla shrubs mark the boundary of the dark wood of larch, birch, rowan, and pine.  At the curve of the track stands a lone ger, its felt walls stitched with sweeping indigo arcs that form a continuous ring.  Towards the southern section, a juniper-framed stall is surrounded by soot-stained, short brown grass.

title: [Cuisine of the Northern Steppes]
description: Colorful rugs woven from vibrantly dyed qiviut cover the circular shop, the fabric stitched in patterns of wild geese leading up to the elongated pine and rowan table set at the center.  Triangular racks of juniper are wedged along the khana of the ger, the containers set between cupboards, trunks, and other ingredient-filled larders.

title: [Hearthpot]
description: Behind a juniper-framed stall, glowing coals spread wide across a shallow but elongated pit, their heat feeding a dozen blackened pots and iron skillets.  Steam rises in fragrant waves from simmering broths thick with noodles and woven steam baskets resting atop pots.  The scent of rendered meat, mild dough, and toasted spice carries into the surrounding meadow.  Bunches of peppers dry above the embers, their skins glowing faintly in the firelight.

title: [Furward Fashion]
description: Sagging under the weight of heavy coats, juniper racks crowd the felt-and-lattice ger until only precariously narrow paths remain to wind through the chaos.  On scattered tables, rough-hewn birch heads model plush hats, their blank faces half-hidden beneath shaggy fur and fluffy earflaps.  A metal wood-burning stove in the center, set dangerously close to fuzzy hides, warms the space with a stifling heat.

title: [Nor'Saens Valaire, Grasslands]
description: Grasslands roll outward in wide, unbroken waves, their yellow-green tones shifting beneath the wind as the path extends toward the north where mists rising from the lake cast a pale glow around the distant village of scattered gers.  To the east, a river slips from the water's edge and winds toward buckthorn, larch, and rowan that act as vanguard to a dark forest.   West and south, the expanse continues without interruption, while far to the north, snow-capped peaks form a plum-hued backdrop.

title: [Northern Steppes, Caravan Stop]
description: Wooden beams support the low roof of the open shelter, their surfaces silvered by wind and time.  Stretching the length of the dwelling, a low and worn wooden bench covered in sheepskins rests beneath the sporadic sway of copper and wrought iron lanterns, offering a place of respite for weary travelers.  Ruts line the earth track beyond the edges of the shelter, where a slender pathway winds through tall grasses rippling in uneven waves, each blade painted in green and yellow hues.

title: [Willow Hall, Padissar's Room]
description: The carpenter's ability to blend nature and domicile within the confines of this room is awe-inspiring.  The walls are meticulously carved to resemble willow bark.  A luxurious green carpet mimics grass underfoot.  Beneath a beam carved in the likeness of a branch, an enormous feather-stuffed bed dominates its corner.  In the opposite sits a desk, tidy and neat, betraying the infrequency of its use.

title: [Paupers, Private Library]
description: Bookcases, ornate tapestries, and paintings spread across the walls depict the history of the House of Paupers and the races of Elanthia, along with a row of high-hanging glaes orbs serving as the source of lighting.  A pair of small wooden footstools is tucked between the bookcases, and a pair of worn leather wingback chairs rests against the wall opposite the archway leading out of the room, next to which is a small granite bar.  A large rosewood desk envelops an entire corner of the library near a shadowy bookcase.

title: [Paupers, Vault]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove toward the rear of the vault.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and rests open on a stone counter.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Passage]
description: Faint blue and green light originating from a pair of copper sconces illuminates the narrow, one-way passageway.  A sense of dampness pervades the area, with rivulets of water occasionally cascading down the stone walls from an unknown source.  Hanging from the walls are a number of artifacts, which have been stored, broken or their use long forgotten.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Under the Pond]
description: Well-lit, this sprawling circular chamber is filled with numerous couches, stools and chairs placed haphazardly about.  A massive glass ceiling allows a clear and transparent view into the pond directly above.  The faint sound of rushing water can be heard, although the exact source is unclear.  Looking almost out of place is a carved linden wardrobe that rests next to a slightly singed purple door, which adds to the unusual decor.  Placed in the center is a square driftwood table allowing for any number of conferences, debates and clandestine meetings.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Rimalon's Room]
description: Dozens of nautical charts are plastered on the walls of this tightly cramped room.  Some piles of half-opened tomes are haphazardly strewn about, mingling in with stacks of scrolls and discarded parchment.  Four small stools are gathered around an easel displaying a detailed depiction of the port of Solhaven and its bay.  The only visible sleeping surface amongst the clutter is a faded cot, although the layer of cat hair present on it suggests the identity of its most recent user.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Artificery]
description: Various equipment is spread out amongst four expansive workstations located in each corner of the room.  Discarded projects are scattered between scorch marks and other oddly discolored areas.  Curiously suspended in midair, a sizeable blue sphere hovers above, its smooth surface giving off a pale blue light.  Numerous grates are installed into the walls and ceiling, the largest set in the floor at the direct center of the workshop.  A thick iron lever is recessed into the stone next to a glowing archway.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Cupola]
description: Although the cupola is rather small, the daytime view is spectacular from the eight linden-framed windows centered on each of its cypress panel walls.  A woven cloth hammock is stretched along one side from iron hooks imbedded in two of the corners.  Opposite the trapdoor set into the wooden floor, a stool rests near a carved tanik end table, which proudly displays a spherical glass fishbowl.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Glade]
description: Branching off the main pathway, this glade is interrupted by a gently bubbling brook.  Conifers crowd the edges of the green, bowing in to cast shadows over most of the open space, while the whistle of songbirds can be heard above the water's noise.  A simple cedarwood bridge arcs low over the brook, heading off towards a grassy knoll.

title: [Chalet Cairnfang, Approach]
description: Conifers give way to a veritable alpine oasis perched on the side of the mountain, where deposits of slate and granite rise to prominence toward rocky crags above.  Nestled atop a gently sloping grassy knoll, a rustic fel-framed chalet is afforded a grand view of the vista below, with tended flowerbeds cradling its perimeter.  Patches of sunlight gently dapple the tree-laden path behind a simple cedarwood bridge leading across the brook, while a woven trellis draped in flowering wisteria beckons eastward.

title: [Chalet Cairnfang, Garden]
description: Gentle falls of blue wisteria drape through a woven trellis, their petals partially obscuring a neat clearing of manicured grass.  The hushed burble of water tumbling into a nearby pond plays quiet accompaniment to a sweet chorus of birdsong drifting from the surrounding foliage.  Low wicker tables flanked by cushions rest in a casual semi-circle around a chalkboard, propped up against an ancient pear tree, with great boughs swaying in the alpine breeze and causing dappled sunlight to dance beneath.

title: [Chalet Cairnfang, Lounge]
description: Great beams of darkened fel rise high averhead toward a vaulted ceiling, the dusky wood contrasting against pale plaster walls, many of which are lined in bookshelves, curios, and a single, inconspicuous door.  Within the lounge's heart, several stuffed leather chairs are arranged in a semi-circle near a wide limestone fireplace, with a low carved linden table resting between them.  Warm sunlight streams in through a wide bay window, illuminating the cozy room while offering a striking view of the valley.

title: [Chalet Cairnfang, Pantry]
description: Longer than it is wide, the pantry is lined on either side with narrow rosewood shelves and cabinets, their bounty great enough to lend the room a sense of mild claustrophobia.  The far wall features a low row of built-in cubbies complete with a locker prominently arranged for easy access.  Warm sunlight spills through a narrow window above, reflecting off a small imflass mirror resting on one shelf and gently illuminating the pantry's shadows with a gold glow.

title: [Chalet Cairnfang, Wine Cellar]
description: A chill in the air belies the chamber's depth beneath the chalet.  Surrounded by gently sloping granite walls, each carved with a relief giving the impression of stacked stone blocks, the wine cellar bears several vibrant cherrywood wine shelves set nearly floor to ceiling.  Soft golden light from a trio of pewter lanterns overhead illuminates a long rosewood counter resting against the far wall, where a locker rests on the polished surface beneath a carved golden linden mirror.

title: [Rone Academy, Locker Entrance]
description: This small room smells of years of dust and mildew.  Books needing repair are stacked all around.  Scrolls are grouped according to their contents, each waiting to be painstakingly cross-translated into the tongues of Elanthia and bound into volumes.

title: [Rone Academy, Lockers]
description: A faint smell of mildew permeates the room.

title: [Rone Academy, Lockers]
description: A faint smell of mildew permeates the room.

title: [Warehouse, Lockers]
description: The far wall of this small room is filled with an array of small, locked doors.

title: [Winterberry Room, Locker Room]
description: The grey stone walls are bare, except for brass wall sconces with candles burning cheerfully.  A woolly, rolton fur rug stretches out on the floor of this small room.

title: [Rone Academy, Locker]
description: With the curtain closed behind you, all sound from outside the locker area has been hushed.  The counter is topped with deep green baize which shows little wear.

title: [Rone Academy Lockers]
description: A small swarm of fireflies flit about in a cylindrical cage hung from the granite ceiling.  Their blinking green and yellow glows softly illuminate this small room.  Though the marble walls are unadorned and the granite floor is uncarpeted, the room still provides a quiet place for contemplating the contents of your locker.

title: [Topaz Lounge, Lockers]
description: You stand in a tiny, cramped space.

title: [Rone Academy Lockers]
description: A multitude of locked compartments line the walls of this small alcove.  One of the lockers has been removed and placed on a low granite-topped counter.  On the wall opposite the counter hangs an oil painting.

title: [Lounge Lockers]
description: Warm light filters through the curtained opening, faintly illuminating the simple cell.

title: [Private Locker]
description: Jade green marble veined with cream covers the small amount of floor space, while pale oak paneling forms a modest wainscoting.  A white-on-cream figured silk covers the upper portion of the walls.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: Ivory drapes hang upon the walls, their overly long lower edges pooling upon the soft rug that stretches from wall to wall.  The drape's silken lengths are unfettered except where they are parted to provide egress through a silver-edged dark purple curtain.  A lacquered haon counter sits in the center of the circular chamber, beneath the light of an enormous seaglass orb that is held aloft by a woven hemp basket.

title: [House Arcane, Portico]
description: A protective trellis, overgrown with dark green ivy, shades the entranceway to House Arcane.  Over the wrought-iron entrance gate, a rough, stone gargoyle broods, instilling an aura of ancient mystery and adventure.  High walls of black onyx rise from either side of the gate, their polished smoothness contrasting with the trailing ivy.  A flagstone walk extends from gate to door, splitting the grassy turf into two identical squares.

title: [House Arcane, Foyer]
description: This small vestibule is the terminus to the rest of the House.  The spiral staircase is made of the same darkly finished hardwood with which the room is panelled; the steps themselves are covered by a soft, forest green carpet which cushions your steps as you pass through the room.  Paintings lining the walls treat your eyes to colorful renditions of ancient heroes and their quests while smells of whiskey, spices and wood mingle in your nostrils.
tags: meta:mapname:Wehnimer's Landing - House of the Arcane Masters

title: [House Arcane, Kitchen]
description: This room is suffused with the smells of sausages, herbs and meats that hang among the cooking utensils along the low ceiling.  Lining one wall is a long wooden counter fronted by several bar stools, and against the other is an icebox, cooled by circulating brine siphoned in from the chilly waters of the Bay.  A golden baker's rack adorns the wall next to the icebox.

title: [House Arcane, Bar]
description: The house taproom is finished to rustic perfection with cherrywood-panelled walls, a stone floor covered by a huge bearskin rug, and a cherrywood bar fronted by a round table and several chairs.  The flickering light of hand-crafted oil lamps glints off the bottles, prompting an undeniably parched and thirsty feeling in your throat.  In the far corner, a set of steep stairs leads down to the basement.

title: [House Arcane, Landing]
description: Standing at the top of the spiral staircase, you can look down the long hallway leading to the members' rooms.  The unfinished plaster of the walls is divided at intervals by strips of dark wood that begin at the ceiling and intersect with the paneling two-thirds of the way down the wall.  Cast iron oil lamps extend from the strips, giving the corridor a dusky yellow tint.

title: [House Arcane, Hallway]
description: The carpet beneath your feet is a soft, forest green that muffles your footsteps.  To one side, you see a door of unfinished modwir.

title: [House Arcane, Hallway]
description: Soft, golden light flickers gently against the polished wood panelling as the air stirs with your presence in this quiet section of the hallway.  Set into one wall is an incredibly stunning door of black-veined, white marble, fitted with a knob of polished onyx which gleams in the lamplight.  On the opposite wall is a dark cherry door with a cut crystal doorknob.

title: [House Arcane, Hall's End]
description: The hallway ends here with a set of steep, wooden stairs which ascend to the third floor.

title: [House Arcane, Talon's Room]
description: Awestruck by the opulence of your surroundings, you notice that the walls appear to be made of lustrous, black-veined white marble.  The floor is a mosaic of white marble inlaid with squares of gleaming black onyx.  A hand-woven carpet of intricate detail and rich, deep coloring covers the floor before a great fireplace of white marble and antiqued silver.

title: [House Arcane, Arwen's Retreat]
description: Rich, dark cherry paneling encompasses this spacious room, dominated by an oversized four poster bed and a large armoire.  Nightstands on each side of the bed hold matching brass oil lamps.  A black marble fireplace is flanked by floor-to-ceiling bookcases, while a pair of comfortable-looking wing chairs face it.  A suit of armor stands guard over a small walnut writing desk nestled into one corner, and ivory damask drapes frame a large picture window through which starlight softly filters.

title: [House Arcane, Noonga's Room]
description: Tall wooden weapon racks line the southern side of the room along with various armour stands.  Soft furs and a pillows make a comfortable looking bed below a large painting.  Several chests, smashed to pieces, lay scattered nearby.

title: [House Arcane, Landing]
description: Here, at the top of the steep, wooden staircase, you look down a corridor whose white plaster walls have been covered with maps of distant lands and lacquered with a thin, smooth glaze.  Farther down the hallway, a number of doors guard the private rooms of House members.

title: [House Arcane, Hallway]
description: You pass along the carpeted hall under the soft, amber glow of lamplight.  To one side is a heavy oak door with a misshapen knob and a small plaque set into the surface.  Across from it, a varnished wooden door leads to Lord Corwin's chamber.  Hanging on the wall nearby is a hand drawn map of lands you recognize as having been spoken of by Sages in ancient tales.

title: [House Arcane, Hallway]
description: Two oil lamps flank the mahogany door to Lady Kayla's room.  Their soft light flickers and dances over the intricate carvings in the hard wood.  Her doorknob is cut from the heart of a large shard of golden quartz and sparkles like the eye of a crystal dragon.  On the other side of the hallway is a doorway draped in black velvet which, parted, reveals a door panelled with black vultite.  Almost hidden in the shadows is an onyx door that leads to Zharahk's room.

title: [House Arcane, Dagmar's Workshop]
description: The workshop of Lord Dagmar is lit by smoky torches ensconced on the wall.  Hung over the fire is a simmering cauldron and beside the fireplace you see an intricate table covered in melted wax.  The floor around the table reeks of alcohol.  Near the table is a wooden cot covered with rumpled bedding.  Bookshelves built into the walls are packed to overflowing with ancient tomes of magic.

title: [House Arcane, Corwin's Room]
description: This room produces a deep feeling of true warmth and comfort in you, despite its unpretentious fittings.  A plain oak-framed bed sits along one wall and a simple maple table flanked by wicker chairs stands nearby.  A welcoming glow emanates from the fireplace.  Piled on the table are a number of scrolls tied with silk and secured with wax seals.

title: [House Arcane, Kayla's Room]
description: A gentle sea-breeze blows through the white linen curtains that cover a large window in one wall.  Directly across from the window is a large canopy bed.  In the corner stands a double-door wardrobe closet made of imported dark mahogany.  On the opposite wall you notice a large vanity with an oval mirror and a plush velvet bench.  To the right of the fireplace is a plush loveseat and in a corner of the room, a dressing curtain.

title: [House Arcane, Zharahk's Room]
description: A large circle drawn upon the floor occupies most of this room.  It appears that the circle is drawn with a mixture of chalk and salt.  There are five red candles at equal distances around the circle, and lines of dried blood drawn on the floor connect the candles, forming a star within the circle.  Along the far wall of the room is a canopied bed covered with black silk sheets.

title: [House Arcane, Moon's Place]
description: The room is dimly lit by a crackling fire that flickers in the granite fireplace.  A thick velvet rug covers the floor before the hearth.  Three walls are hung with heavy drapes dyed a color deeper than midnight.  Nearly all light is swallowed up and the room seems a lair for dark thoughts.  A giant painting of a misty forest draws your eyes upwards, and you realize the ceiling has been painted to match the night sky.  So real it seems that for a moment, your head swims in confusion.

title: [House Arcane, Lounge]
description: The lounge is freshly painted with a colorful mural winding its way along the walls, depicting the four seasons in realistic shades and hues.  Wooden tables and chairs offer a place to rest and relax after a long day's journey.  The north wall contains a wooden door flanked by a pair of windows.

title: [House Arcane, Deck]
description: The sky is set with twinkling stars and the moons shed their soft glow upon the area.  Lounge chairs placed on the unfinished boards of the deck offer comfort for stargazers or for a group of friends to gather.  Grapevines cover the house's exterior around the door and the railing that surrounds the deck.  Over the rail, you can make out the Bay, and the sound of small waves crashing on the sandy beach reaches your ears from below.

title: [House Arcane, Pier]
description: Situated on the tidal-flow area of the river, this simple, sturdy pier is built from heavy yew planks fastened with iron nails to massive pilings sunk deep into the river bed.  Simple lanterns spaced evenly along the solid wood railings provide soft warm light against the night.  At the end of the pier, a small fish-shaped blackboard hangs from one of the pilings.  Two comfortable wood chairs and a pair of benches provide seating for fishermen or nature lovers.

title: [Teras Isle Table]
description: The tabletop is carved with images reminiscent from the Isle.  Among them is a siren lizard, a pyrothag, and a firethorn shoot.  On the table is a detailed figurine replica of the Tower, faithfully duplicated down to even the glass statue.

title: [Wehnimer's Landing Table]
description: This natural stained table is carved with kobolds, trolls, and goblins, among others.  A small miniature replica of the town gates sit in the middle and even includes tiny people standing around it.

title: [River's Rest Table]
description: Various carvings cover the tabletop, representing life in River's Rest.  In the middle rests a detailed miniature of the Citadel and the surrounding gardens.  You even notice a tiny gardener tending a bed of flowers.

title: [Icemule Trace Table]
description: This white table is painted with scenes from Icemule in shades ranging from light to dark blue.  A glistening carved crystal penguin miniature with onyx eyes decorates the table.

title: [Elanthia Table]
description: A colorful map of Elanthia is painted on the tabletop with a stars representing each town.  A large, swirling blue-green crystal ball with a gold ornate base graces the table.

title: [House Arcane, Garden]
description: Nestled between the river tower and the north wall of House Arcane, this small garden is a flood of greenery.  A magnificent yew tree crowds the west wall, its many trunks weaving upward like giant knuckled fingers to support a broad canopy of branches.  The eastern side of the garden, awash in moonlight, has been planted with herbs, a few root vegetables, and a border of flowers.  Still further east, the rocks of the promontory drop down to the river below, the sea gates close at hand.

title: [House Arcane, Yew Tree]
description: The ancient heartwood of this mighty yew has long since passed into memory, replaced by a great hollow and surrounded by a gnarled ring of new trunks.  The greenery gives mute testament to its vitality, and the surrounding wood is sound, showing no sign of rot.  An earthy scent persists in the air despite a slight breeze, and silence reigns within the hollow.  Moonlight breaks through the branches above to illuminate an oblong riverstone.  A single branch stretches out from an inner trunk.

title: [House Arcane, Billiard Parlor]
description: The House gameroom is a slightly shabby room lit by stained-glass lanterns that dangle from the ceiling.  Varicolored light from them falls upon the rugs that cover the walls.  An assortment of scuffmarks and stains mar the otherwise interesting pattern of various squares of hardwoods that makes up the flooring here.  A billiard table occupies the center of the room, alabaster and marble balls racked on its surface.  Leather couches line two of the walls, along with a pair of coffee tables.

title: [House Arcane, Basement Office]
description: The austerity of the room makes it a perfect setting for the house officers to carry out their duties.  The walls are panelled by unfinished wooden slabs cut from the great oaks of the lower forest.  The filing cabinet, bookcase, and desk, though lacquered, are of the same rough wood.  A simple rug covers the floor, and the only decoration present is three golden statuettes--a gavel, an abacus, and a quill pen--arrayed along the far wall.

title: [House Arcane, Storage Vault]
description: Dim lighting is provided by small oil lamps affixed to the walls.  The walls, floor, and ceiling are made of inlaid ora, which seems to absorb and muffle all sound.  Built into the rear wall is a series of strongboxes for use by House members.

title: [House Arcane, Storage Vault]
description: Dim lighting is provided by small oil lamps affixed to the walls.  The walls, floor, and ceiling are made of inlaid ora, which seems to absorb and muffle all sound.  Built into the rear wall is a series of strongboxes for use by House members.

title: [House Arcane, Lockers]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove to one side of the House vault.  Your locker has been removed for you and is resting on a mein counter.

title: [House Arcane, Lockers]
description: This is a secluded alcove to one side of the House vault.  Your locker has been removed for you and is resting on a mein counter.

title: [House Arcane, Sauna]
description: Warm steam engulfs you as you enter the House spa, and you slip a little on the uneven surface of the floor.  The irregular shape of the room is due to the fact that it was hewn from the volcanic rock indigenous to the area, its obsidian surface carved and polished to a smooth sheen.  The swirling pool at the room's edge is fed by a natural hotspring that wells up from a small opening and fills the curved tub carved there.

title: [House Arcane, Swirling Pool]
description: Immersed in the warm water of the natural hotsprings below, your muscles relax and pleasant images float through your mind.

title: [Lockers, Antechamber]
description: A simple wooden chair and a short square table are the only furnishings in this bare room.  The open ceiling shows the warehouse roof high above.  The sounds of workers moving crates in the warehouse below can be easily heard through the thin floors.

title: [Lockers, Antechamber]
description: A simple wooden chair and a short square table are the only furnishings in this bare room.  The open ceiling shows the warehouse roof high above.  The sounds of workers moving crates in the warehouse below can be easily heard through the thin floors.

title: [Warehouse, Lockers]
description: The far wall of this small room is filled with an array of small, locked doors.

title: [Warehouse, Lockers]
description: The far wall of this small room is filled with an array of small, locked doors.

title: [Lingonberry Room]
description: The walls are panelled with knotted yellow pine.  Some intricately carved pine benches stand against the walls.  Pale red marble tiles, burled with different shades of white, gleam on the floor.

wayto.36135: lean tart book in oiled bookcase

title: [Lingonberry Room, Cubbyhole]
description: The small room ends in a dark leather curtain which is drawn shut.  Remnants of old advertising slogans are painted onto the curtain.

title: [Lingonberry Room Locker]
description: The grey stone walls are bare, except for brass wall sconces with candles burning cheerfully.  A woolly, rolton fur rug stretches out on the floor of this small room.

title: [House Arcane Annex]
description: The floor, made of unglazed octagonal tiles, is partly covered with a thick carpet.  A window, screened with intricately carved wood, is set high on the wall.  Set beneath the window is a heavy terra cotta urn containing a flowering shrub.

title: [House Arcane, Cubby]
description: This small antechamber to the locker area is lighted by a simple brass oil lamp.  The walls, crafted from smooth panels of yew wood, are bare of any adornment.  A plain cotton rug muffles your footsteps.

title: [House Arcane, Locker]
description: With the curtain closed behind you, all sound from outside the locker area has been hushed.  The counter is topped with deep green baize which shows little wear.

title: [Annex, House Arcane Lobby]
description: Simple, but elegant, the teakwood flooring of this room is polished to a lustrous sheen.  A jade velvet pennant trimmed with crystal hangs near a heavy, white muslin curtain.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove facing a wall of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and placed on a marble counter.

title: [Arcane Masters Annex]
description: Two huge toadstools in large stone pots illuminate a large, comfortable room.  Dusky brown granite benches line two of the marble walls, facing each other across the sapphire carpet.  On one wall, a brass arch allows exit to the corridor outside, while on the other wall a curtain provides entrance to the locker area.

title: [Arcane Masters Lockers]
description: A small swarm of fireflies flit about in a cylindrical cage hung from the granite ceiling.  Their blinking green and yellow glows softly illuminate this small room.  Though the marble walls are unadorned and the granite floor is uncarpeted, the room still provides a quiet place for contemplating the contents of your locker.

title: [Diamond Lounge]
description: The walls are paneled in finely polished cherry wood.  Diamond sconces hang above the fireplace on either side of a framed etching of Teras Isle.  Carved maoral chairs stand beside a small table set with a chess game in progress.

title: [Diamond Lounge, Cubbyhole]
description: This narrow, cramped space ends abruptly at a curtain.

title: [Diamond Lounge, Lockers]
description: You stand in a tiny, cramped space.

title: [House Arcane, Cysaegir Lounge]
description: Dark, hardwood flooring is polished to a brilliant shine.  In one corner, a few tables and chairs are placed about a grey stone fireplace with a large iron log holder by its side.  On the other side of the room is a jade-inlaid ebonwood arch to the right and a jade velvet curtain that leads deeper into the annex.

title: [House Arcane Locker]
description: Carefully arranged across the floor are plush, powder blue carpets patterned with multicolored interlocking bubbles.  The rear wall of the chamber is comprised of numerous small, locked compartments.  For your convenience, your personal locker is placed on a low granite-topped counter.  On the wall opposite the counter hangs an oil painting rendered in vivid colors.

title: [The Cherry Lounge]
description: The walls are covered in panels of rich cherry wood which reflect the light of the sconce, adding to the warm comfort of the room.  Embroidered chairs are set about the room in no apparent order.  A small table is drawn up next to one of the chairs with a small opened book resting on top.  A sword and a staff are mounted above the artfully carved marble hearth, crossing each other in a symbol of defense.

title: [A Stone Chamber]
description: A single oil lamp hanging from the high vaulted ceiling illuminates the small oval chamber.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Firmly bolted to the wall at one side of the room is a small, cast-iron ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Lounge Lockers]
description: Warm light filters through the curtained opening, faintly illuminating the simple cell.

title: [Mana Staff Dahcre Chamber]
description: This elegantly appointed room, with cherrywood-panelled walls and a floor of snow white alabaster, offers a comfortable place for the weary adventurer.  Several wingback armchairs upholstered in soft leather are drawn up around a black marble fireplace, above which is set a beveled glaes mirror.  Various flagons and carafes rest on a cherrywood bar nearby, which is flanked by twin banners bearing a serpent's head.  An opalescent feystone medallion gleams at the top-most joint of the mistwood arch leading into this room.

title: [Darkened Chamber]
description: A single glaesine sconce attached to the wall illuminates the small chamber, casting a fitfully flickering light across the room's few features.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Dangling from a chain at one side of the room is a small mithglin ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Private Locker]
description: Jade green marble veined with cream covers the small amount of floor space, while pale oak paneling forms a modest wainscoting.  A white-on-cream figured silk covers the upper portion of the walls.

title: [House Annex, Arcane Masters]
description: Devoid of nearby furnishings, the western wall is dominated by a jade green dragon mural that is illuminated by the warm glow of several frosted glaesine globes anchored to the ceiling.  Plush silver carpeting dappled with soft green threads lends the otherwise austere space a coziness that is enhanced by the presence of a plush argent silk settee.  A lacquered white door leads to the hallway, while a silver-edged jade green silk curtain provides access to the storage facilities.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: Ivory drapes hang upon the walls, their overly long lower edges pooling upon the soft rug that stretches from wall to wall.  The drape's silken lengths are unfettered except where they are parted to provide egress through a silvery white birch counter.  A silver-edged jade green silk curtain sits in the center of the circular chamber, beneath the light of an enormous seaglass orb that is held aloft by a woven hemp basket.

title: [House Arcane, Hall of Lords]
description: The Hall of Lords is an enormous round room with black marble walls and a floor of snow white alabaster.  Twelve granite columns rise from floor to ceiling in a ring around the Hall.  The room is dominated by a bench-flanked mahogany table at which the House conducts all of its official business.  Above, the vaulted ceiling is covered by a breathtaking mural.

title: [The Black Rose, Foredeck]
description: A bronze-beaked falcon figurehead adorns the prow of the vessel, its spread metal wings cleaving to the crimson-painted hull.  Wrought from the same metal, a high railing takes the form of a knotted rope supported by sculpted figures of slender men and women spaced about the edges of the deck.  A polished redwood ship's wheel crowns a raised platform several paces behind the metal falcon.
location: The Black Rose, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [The Black Rose, Amidships]
description: The golvern-edged propellers of the ship shine in the sunlight, casting a wavering blur of reflected radiance over the smooth-worn and polished planes of wood below.  Fanciful tracery forms golden vines up the trio of cylindrical supports leading up to the whirring blades.  A burled cherrywood hatch fastened with a black iron ring lies at the center of a hollow formed by the supports.
location: The Black Rose, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [The Black Rose, Aft]
description: A long redwood bench sits at the far rear of the airship, framed by a railing with rounded edges that embraces the squared aft of the ship.  Far enough away from the ceaseless drone of the main propellers to be almost quiet, the deck provides a view of the steering blades situated midway down the ship's aft hull.  Beyond them is a dizzying view of the earth below.
location: The Black Rose, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Black Rose, Captain's Quarters]
description: Sunk partially into the hull of the ship, the quarters are impeccably cared for with polished wood planks of various species forming a tight-fitting wall to keep the weather and wet out.  A polished oak-framed window, providing a view out of the ship's aft, occupies a space above an intricately carved modwir desk that has a sturdy rolling chair resting in front of it.  Floor to ceiling, a set of glass-faced bookcases dominate the space opposite a tidy overstuffed bed covered in squared clean cotton sheets and a heavily embroidered quilt, while the open veniom door occupies the remaining wall.
location: The Black Rose, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [The Black Rose, Belowdecks]
description: Dusky blue tubes plated with refined veniom stand as tall as a man and far wider, lining the interior hull of the ship.  The metal sparkles dimly in the half-light.  They resonate faintly with the constant vibrations twitching through the ship, releasing a faint hum into the cool air.  Glass pipes full of rushing water direct their frothing current eastward toward a steadily pulsating light source.
location: The Black Rose, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [The Black Rose, Aether Lounge]
description: A canopy of faceted crystal panes framed in a delicate latticework of perforated mithril braces encloses an alabaster terrace.  Hanging glimaerstones cast a warm glow upon a spidersilk hammock strung between two beams.  Nearby, a small pot-bellied stove is bookended between a pair of wingback chairs.
location: The Black Rose, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [The Black Rose, Engineering]
description: Approaching the engineering section, the lengths of crimson-varnished wood give way to lightless blocks of crystal.  An enclosure of precious metals fans out around a pulsating hexagonal blue crystal, the source of an ethereal pulse bathing the chamber in blue-white luminescence.  Faint, haunting notes pour forth from the depth of the crystal in a strange and unending song.
location: The Black Rose, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Lake Pass, Ridge]
description: To the north, a large lake spans across the view, its dark expanse both eerie and still, while in the opposite direction, a treacherous path climbs up from meadow-like fields in the distance.  Directly below the ridge, a fetid bog sends her foggy tendrils slithering upward, where they wrap around the edges of a small shack.
location: Finders Keepers, inside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Lake Pass, Rickety Shack]
description: Creaking and shifting incessantly, the elm wooden walls and roof, and even the rotting doorway, of the shack appear to be hanging on to the very edge of total collapse.  A short jagged-edge table stands in the center of the room, with two rickety chairs framing its length.  Along the rear wall, a makeshift chimney is filled with soot and burnt, decayed remains, and the air is filled with an overwhelming amount of dust and a sharp, rancid stench.
location: Finders Keepers, inside the elven city of Ta'Illistim
