title: [Finders Keepers]
description: Thin, flowering vines creep along the stone walls in this underground space.  Overhead, the root system draping down from the ceiling is twisted into an elaborate chandelier that illuminates the richly appointed quarters.  Set atop a fel and willow floor, a pair of dark-hued divans is arranged around a low table.  At the base of a spiral stone staircase, a gold-edged mirror is dark rather than reflective.
location: Finders Keepers, inside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Finders Keepers, Bedchamber]
description: Pure alabaster lines spread out within the dark, mottled stone walls, where candelabras adorned with white candles highlight the spiderweb-like patterns.  A curtain of climbing vines spreads across the ceiling and, despite the underground setting, is dotted with tiny crimson and violet blossoms.  A plush rug of dark blue partially spreads over the fel and willow flooring.  In between a carved willow writer's desk and a stone pedestal holding a small basin, a four-poster bed is lavished with soft blankets.
location: Finders Keepers, inside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Finders Keepers, Star Nexus]
description: Crumbling stone walls reveal wet earth behind them, from which vines and roots spring forth with clingy tendrils.  Darkly colored fel flooring is inset with a large, perfect circle of pale willow wood in the center of the room.  The ceiling rises up in a small, golden dome dotted with glowing specks of black, like dark constellations against a sunlit sky.  A jeweled chest resides against the wall opposite a curved stone arch.
location: Finders Keepers, inside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Garden Getaway, Entry]
description: Sunlight glitters upon crushed seashells lining a small pathway that ambles through the rich foliage to and from a small cottage.  Butterflyweed, bright lavender and deep burgundy in hue, stands out against the bright paint of the home and holds court with several winged beauties, while glaesine bowls holding honey and nectar hang from a nearby umbrella tree.

title: [Garden Getaway, Living Room]
description: Glossy, golden linden floors reflect the warm sunlight as it trickles in through the shutter-lined windows that adorn each of the small room's white-washed, knotted oak walls.  Multi-hued braided rugs are scattered in overlapping layers in the center and are held in place by two armchairs and a low divan.  A large fireplace adorned with a mahogany mantle is flanked by floor-to-ceiling bookcases, which house dormant hurricane lanterns.

title: [Garden Getaway, Kitchen]
description: Cupboards line the eastern wall above a smooth granite counter that sparkles in the sunlight with flecks of mica.  Ebon and slate blue tiles create a checked pattern upon the floor, which is reflected in the glaesine globes that dangle from the ceiling.  Pushed against the opposite wall, and set beneath a tiny white oak-framed window, is a small cloth-covered table surrounded by wicker-seated chairs.  A pot-bellied, cast iron stove makes the room comfortably warm from its position near the open back door.

title: [Garden Getaway, Tiny Garden]
description: Clinging to the tall, stone privacy wall are the combined vines of white honeysuckle and purple wisteria, their mingled fragrance perfuming the sun-dappled garden.  Lush green grass covers the grounds from the cottage door to the small gardening shack in the back section, which is surrounded by blooming flowerbeds.  Stretched between two towering elm trees is a striped canvas hammock, and a white marble bird feeder is flanked by carved marble benches.

title: [Garden Getaway, Loft]
description: Dyed a rich green hue, fleece pelts cover the floor from wall to wall and offer a soft, plush comfort beneath the steeply peaked roof.  Upon one side of the white-walled room is a luxurious feather bed covered with crisp white linens and a down comforter, while directly across stands a towering modwir armoire with painted doors.  At the foot of the bed rests a simple foot locker and several glowing glaesine globes dangle from the exposed rafters amid boughs of fresh and dried lavender.

title: [Emberstone Hall, Dock]
description: A wide driftwood dock rises above the water and stretches to a sandy beach where large palm trees sway with the ocean's breeze.  Meticulously carved wooden steps lead from the shore up to a high rolaren gate where a two-story manor lies beyond.
location: Emberstone Hall, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Emberstone Hall, Courtyard]
description: Lanes of trimmed lush grass stretch across both sides of the courtyard, and tall rose bushes line each wall.  Polished riverstone fountains rise up on each side of a white pebblestone walkway that snakes from a high rolaren gate to a pair of dark mahogany doors.  Burnished wooden benches form half-circles around each fountain.
location: Emberstone Hall, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Emberstone Hall, Atrium]
description: The manor opens up into a large circular chamber with a high glass dome ceiling.  A dark ironwood tree rises up from the center of the room, its branches bathed in sunlight from above.  Finely dressed servants bustle between a mahogany archway and a long hallway, while a wide stairwell ascends to the second floor.
location: Emberstone Hall, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Emberstone Hall, Rock Garden]
description: Rows of verdant hedges extend along the back wall of the manor, while vibrant flowerbeds create a border along a spruced walkway that winds through the garden.  A stretch of pebblestone creates a circle in the heart of the garden where a dozen stones and rocks have been placed about.  An unseen bird makes its presence known with the occasional quiet chirp.
location: Emberstone Hall, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Emberstone Hall, Grand Ballroom]
description: Rows of gold-wrought crystal chandeliers hang from the ceiling and reflect against the lacquered rosewood floor, which stretches the entire length of the ballroom.  Ornate ivory arches line the north and south walls, while the entire eastern wall is set with a wide-paned window.  A marble-topped bar occupies a corner of the room, and various refreshments decorate its surface.
location: Emberstone Hall, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Emberstone Hall, Banquet Hall]
description: Posts of dark mahogany support the vaulted ceiling of the spacious hall, while some large paned windows allow the island sun to lighten the room.  A dark oak banquet table occupies the center of the hall, large enough to comfortably seat two dozen people.  Gold-framed paintings hang on each side of the entrance to a long hallway.
location: Emberstone Hall, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Emberstone Hall, Upstairs Hall]
description: A lavish navy blue carpet runs the span of the hallway, which ends at a pair of glass doors.  Various oil-painted portraits hang from each wall, broken up only by a dark mahogany double door.
location: Emberstone Hall, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Emberstone Hall, Terrace]
description: A half-wall of stone surrounds the open terrace and affords an expansive view of the island at day.  The bright sky blends in with the sparkling waters of the ocean that stretch off the coast.  The wavering image of the sun can be seen dancing on the waves.
location: Emberstone Hall, inside the frozen environs of the Pinefar Trading Post

title: [Emberstone Hall, Bed Chamber]
description: Two corners of the bedroom hold tall arched windows, and beams of sunlight give their nearly opaque surface an eerie glow.  Two ivory-hued candles rest upon a great ebony desk, their flickering flames casting shadows across its surface.  Warm light radiates from a row of glaes orbs set into the ceiling above, their luminosity revealing a wide lacquered bookshelf near a dark mahogany double door.
location: Emberstone Hall, inside the frozen environs of the Pinefar Trading Post

title: [Bungalow, Living Space]
description: Spacious and tidy, the floor of the living space is fashioned of polished oak and covered with a simple throw rug.  Colorful artwork decorates one beadboard wall, the pieces hanging above a wide couch flanked by a sturdy end table.  Near the open archway to the kitchen, a plain oak desk and wooden chair rest beneath a copper lantern, while in the opposite corner a ladder leads to the second floor near the closed door.

title: [Bungalow, Kitchen]

Resting at the heart of the kitchen upon blue and yellow-checked tiles is an unadorned table surrounded by wicker-seated chairs.
location: Bungalow at Nereid's Cradle, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Bungalow, Loft]
description: Stretching from one end of the space to the other, exposed rafters support the peaked ceiling and are strung with dried herbs and flowers.  A carved wooden bed rests against the flat northern wall where a decorative carving hangs over its headboard and a large wooden footlocker rests against its footboard.  Spindled balusters support a small railing that overlooks the room below, a nearby ladder providing egress.
location: Bungalow at Nereid's Cradle, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Barn, Northeastern Aisle]
description: This barn is cavernous, but still very well lit via the combination of flickering flames emanating from delicate ivory sconces at regular intervals around the perimeter of the barn, and a discreet smattering of indirect lighting from various windows placed in the ceiling.  The floor underfoot is straw, but it is clean and sweet-smelling, and has been carefully raked to lie flat.  The center of the space contains a large number of chests and crates, each one placed directly across from a stall.

title: [Barn, Northeastern Aisle]

title: [Driftglass Fayre, Clearing]
description: Cinchona shrubs and trees of various sizes encircle the clearing amidst the towering banyan and teak trees of the surrounding jungle.  A large blazing bonfire sits at the center of the area, rough teak benches scattered about it, and several small pathways lead deeper into the dense vegetation, each marked with driftglass-inlaid teak posts.  A winding trail follows along the banks of a freshwater stream, leading upstream and beyond the nearby confluence of stream and river.

title: [Driftglass Fayre, Copse]
description: A massive banyan tree reigns supreme here, its enormous aboveground root system creating several nooks and crannies large enough for most to stand upright within them.  Springy moss carpets the ground, and lush ferns and flowering vines wind between the smaller trees that ring the copse beneath the banyan's expansive canopy.

title: [Driftglass Fayre, Camp]
description: A canopy of flowering vines drapes between banyan, teak, and cinchona trees that surround a large glade.  The grass has been trampled down, leaving ample room for carts and tents.  Several camping sites are evident here as well, tucked between trees and tall ferns.

title: [Driftglass Fayre, Fern Bower]
description: Numerous ferns of varying sizes and shades of green grow along the edges of an expansive open area, their lush verdancy almost obscuring ghostly white orchids and vibrant red mushrooms.  A few carts and tents are scattered along the perimeter, felled trees pulled around firepits, and a faint path cuts through and disappears into the jungle beyond.

title: [Driftglass Fayre, Coppice]
description: This coppice has several nooks and crannies, where tents can be seen deep-tucked within the jungle greenery.  The flowering branches of the cinchona trees arch above to create a floral ceiling, light filtering through to dapple the panicgrass-covered ground.

title: [Cultured Confections]
description: Loops of dried herbs and flora decorate the wooden framework of the shop, the fragrant bundles spaced between the iron-wrought lanterns set above several jadewood shelves.  Wood-carved piebald kozas frame either side of the elongated dark thuja counter, their wide horns enclosing small woven baskets of wool and grass.

title: [Tumbled Trinkets, Entry]
description: Bright canary yellow walls of canvas drape from the central post, each spread outward and pulled taut to create an open space beneath the conical roof.  Rugs of jute, linen, and flax spread across the wild grass, their woven designs a blend of gold, chocolate brown, and teal.  Metal hooks attached to the supports display a variety of wares, while woven baskets house assorted trinkets.

title: [Tumbled Trinkets, Workspace]
description: Falling in unfettered folds from the conical peak to the grass-dappled ground, the walls are fashioned of canary yellow and anchored by large, tumbled stones in grey and white.  Scattered rugs of teal and chocolate brown rest upon the wild grass, whose blades peak up in stiff tufts wherever the rugs fail to meet.  A makeshift sleeping pallet covered in blankets rests beside a workbench covered in various jewelry-making tools, while a lantern hung from the central post fills the space with bright light.

title: [Driftwoven, Supplies]
description: Mahogany-toned wool panels form the tent's enclosure, stretched in even vertical runs that meet tightly at reinforced seams.  Carved oak supports rise at measured intervals, each post etched with knotwork patterns and narrow channel cuts that follow the grain.  An etched bronze lantern hangs from a crossbeam, its surface worked with small geometric ridges.  Burlap sacks stand in short rows, their seams whip-stitched and their open tops folded outward, with some satchels resting beside them.

title: [Driftwoven, Supplies]
description: Mahogany-toned wool panels form the tent's enclosure, joined at reinforced seams and held taut by carved oak supports.  Each pole rises at regular intervals, etched with repeating knotwork patterns and shallow grooves along the grain.  A bronze lantern hangs from a crossbeam, its surface patterned with narrow ridges.  A large piece of leather lies in the center of the tent, piled with assorted goods that press against its worked grain and faint tooling marks.

title: [Wanderlace Corsetry, Display]
description: Canvas walls stand in broad, even panels, their seams bound with sturdy cord.  Tall candles line the entrance on holders formed from wooden disks carved with repeating geometric cuts.  A wooden rack occupies the back section, its frame shaped from bent branches lashed together.  A thick woven carpet spans the floor, its surface marked with dense patterns and raised threads.  At the far end, a curved support shapes an archway covered with a drape of horn slivers and narrow clay cylinders.

title: [Wanderlace Corsetry, Supplies]
description: Canvas partitions form a smaller backroom, the drapery joined with tight loops.  An archway opens to the side, its upper span shaped from bent wood wrapped in narrow woven bands.  Candles rest on shorter holders carved from hollowed stumps that are set along the walls.  Large woolen cushions ring the space, stuffed densely and stitched in blocky patterns of fiber and hide.

title: [Goat with the Flow, Enclosure]
description: Midnight blue wool walls hang in deep, even folds, the fabric thick and tightly woven.  Along the seams, subtle stitching creates faint geometric patterns, and the panels overlap slightly at intervals, adding texture and depth.  Bronze lanterns hang from the ridge and edges, and wooden-panel enclosures are strewn with bales of straw.  An archway draped with a dark woven curtain rises along one wall, while a narrow wooden walkway runs through the center.

title: [Goat with the Flow, Storage]
description: Panels of midnight blue wool run along each wall, gathered into thick drapes of fabric.  Bronze lanterns hang from the ridge and edges, while stacks of straw are arranged into simple seats along the sides, with a few loose bales scattered throughout.  An archway draped with a dark woven curtain rises along one wall.

title: [A Festive Tent]
description: The tent's entry area is spacious and has several smaller areas behind particolored swathes of silk.  Ribbons of intricate nakheva drape across the silk walls and dangle overhead, and dozens of plump cushions are scattered across the floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, northwest, out

title: [A Festive Tent, Alcove]
description: Separated from the main tent by a particolored drape of silk, this alcove has several small benches and seating cushions along its sides.  A small workbench is set along one wall next to a vase of inlaid driftglass.

title: [A Festive Tent, Study]
description: A small desk is covered in several stacks of books, and a zivka-stitched quilt hangs between this area and the tent's entry.  A few sketches of Chirasi life have been affixed to the wall behind the desk, along with a rough map of an indeterminate area with a broad "X" marking one location in vibrant red ink.

title: [A Festive Tent, Workspace]
description: Workbenches clutter the area, each awash with piles of craft materials -- wax, fabric, dyes, driftglass, and more.  A cascade of silk falls from the ceiling to separate the workspace from the main tent.

title: [Waybound Chairs]
description: Their layered dyes worn thin, colorfully painted fabric panels line the interior of the tent, depicting a continuous procession of wagons and goat-drawn carts winding across gentle hills and through lush forests.  Carefully stitched leather edging separates the scene with clean lines.  Folded chairs of various woods and woven materials ring the space, stacked neatly atop low, travel-scarred chests.

title: [Khethiss Stream, Approach]
description: A freshwater stream cuts through the jungle, winding its way toward a larger saltwater river visible through the thickets of banyan and teak.  Cinchona trees create tiny bowers here and there between the two waterways, and colorful flowering vines add pops of color to the verdant surroundings.  A trail winds its way through a dense thicket to the west, while the stream-bordering path continues in a mostly northerly fashion.  A teak railing inset with a carved sign separates the path from the stream.

title: [Khethiss Stream, Whirlpools]
description: A protective railing inset with a sign has been placed between the path and the banks of the stream, as the waters run swiftly and are replete with whirlpools.  Dozens of ferns line the far bank of the stream, and a few glints of glass can be seen along the muddy shores.

title: [Khethiss Stream, Swift Waters]
description: The waters of the nearby stream run swiftly, with numerous jagged rocks jutting out and creating swirling eddies.  The ground along the shore appears to be of a rich silt, and brilliant blue plumbago shrubs line the banks and wrap themselves about the cinchona trees shading the path.  A carved sign has been placed where the foliage clears somewhat to allow for the best view of the stream.

title: [Khethiss Stream, Waterfall]
description: To the north, the terrain rises steeply, creating a gentle waterfall that cascades down into a deep pool.  Here, the waters move in slow, eddying waves that pick up speed the farther south they go.  The banks of the stream are gently sloped and easily accessible, and a carved sign has been placed next to a cluster of vibrant pink and red torch ginger plants.

title: [The Flower Pools]
description: Several deep pools comprise this section of the stream, fed by a series of small waterfalls, and cinchona trees hold the greater trees at bay, creating a glade filled with an abundance of plants and flowers.  Colorful gingers, both torch and shell, commingle with bellflowers, jasmine, and starclusters.  Burgundy-tinged ti plants gather about the pools' edges, and vines drape across the top of the downstream waterfall.  Upstream, the trail has been blocked off, a carved sign placed along the teak blockade.

title: [The Crossroads]
description: Your skin tingles as you step into a soft white mist that seems to sparkle with a faint glow.  The mist extends in every direction as far as you can see, and there are several portals close at hand leading to mysterious places.  Do you dare venture further?  You take a deep breath as you carefully consider your choices.

title: [The Crossroads, Lounge]
description: This comfortable room apart from the hustle and bustle of The Crossroads allows for quiet conversation.

title: [The Crossroads]
description: The soft white mist that seems to sparkle with a faint glow lazily reaches this far and continues to extend in every direction as far as you can see, and several new portals open up before you, leading to mysterious places.  Which will you approach next?
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [The Crossroads]
description: More soft white mist that seems to sparkle with a faint glow hovers about the area, and extends in every direction as far as you can see.  Several new portals open up before you, leading to a number of mysterious places.  Which one will you choose first?

title: [The Wasteland, Vault Entrance]
description: Upon the face of the mountainside, an enormous vault entrance has been built into the rock.  The steel of the entrance has been destroyed due to something coming into close contact and exploding, which leaves whatever was protected behind it exposed to the elements.

title: [The Wasteland, Nothingness]
description: Stained soil is covered in mounds of trash that have cluttered the ground.  Off to the southeast, the path leads to a mountainside, while the northeast is completely submerged in a dark, oily substance.

title: [The Wasteland, Nothingness]
description: The ground here is littered with a dark, oily substance that has made traversing through the area a bit tough.  A very narrow path leads from the northwest to the east.  Along a wooden structure, a rope hangs just out of reach.

title: [The Wasteland, Nothingness]
description: Barren land stretches for miles and miles, as if some sort of magical explosion went off.  The night sky is clear, but a faint green gas emits from the lifeless grey soil.  A barely-recognizable wooden structure stands here, however the overall appearance still looks like it was a two-story house.

title: [Deserted House, Entry]
description: The interior of the house has been utterly destroyed.  Mounds of trash and waste litter the floor, while the walls have been boarded up several times with different collections of wood.  Along the eastern wall, some steps lead down to the cellar.

title: [Deserted House, Hallway]
description: The hallway is quite bare and dreary, no furniture or wall hangings are present in the room.  Drab walls enclose the narrow space, which are marred with fist-sized holes upon the surface.  A battered wooden door lies on the eastern wall leading further into the house.

title: [Deserted House, Wyrom's Office]
description: A pair of metal sconces stand guard over a battered wooden door, each intricately made to resemble the open maw of a drake.  Red carpet has been placed on the floor leading both northwest and northeast, however at each end, the carpet has been torn to shreds.  A large granite plaque hangs on the wall across from the door.

title: [Deserted House, Wyrom's Office]
description: A tall bookshelf covers the eastern wall of the office, which is covered in dust and cobwebs.  Several windows are boarded-up and are painted with runes of hate, rage, death, and destruction.  A faint draft can be felt throughout the room, the origin of it unknown.

title: [Deserted House, Wyrom's Office]
description: Along the northern wall, a series of oil paintings hang just over a ruined ebonwood desk and chair.  The room is cluttered with vellum notes and balled-up pieces of paper all over the floor, leaving the place a mess, however, the chaos seems to have been organized.

title: [The Wasteland, Tunnel Shaft]
description: The tunnel shaft is quite narrow and offers little elbow room to move around.  A small ledge is the only bit of space one can rest within the shaft.  The ladder only heads up and down from here.

title: [The Wasteland, Catacombs]
description: A stream of vile blackened liquids runs from east to west here; the watery substance has emitted a cloud thick green gas that has settled over the catacombs.  A tunnel shaft lies high above, which can be reached by a ladder that is affixed to the fungus-covered walls.

title: [The Wasteland, Catacombs]
description: Blackened liquid pours out through the sewer gate, which leads out of the catacombs and into the Wasteland.  Rubble has blocked access leading northeast, however, peering through the wreckage, the catacombs continue to branch out.

title: [The Wasteland, Nothingness]
description: A dark, oily substance drains from a sewer tunnel, which has created a saturated pool of muck to wade through.  The vile substance makes any further travel difficult without a watercraft of some sort.

title: [The Wasteland, Catacombs]
description: Fungus-covered stone walls make up the catacombs' interior, their mossy green hue offering very little luminance to the area.  Along the top of the tunnels, a trapdoor can be reached.  Filthy blackened liquid runs along the ground, the smell almost nauseating.

title: [Dungeon, Antechamber]
description: Along the northern wall, a large mithril gate stands between an iron-banded door and a steel-banded door, while a pile of wooden crates line the western wall.  Fresh blood splatter drips down the stone walls, forming dark red pools upon the ground.  Within the center of the room, a granite staircase leads further underground.

title: [Deserted House, Cellar]
description: The cellar is quite small, with the walls almost completely hidden from stacks of crates, barrels and casks.  Faint blood stains coat the floor; the pattern resembling that of something being dragged.  Leading up, some steps head back upstairs.

title: [Undercroft, Approach]
description: Limestone walls enclose the undercroft's entry, with a single torch barely giving enough light.  An eerie fog fills the room, its presence clearly unnatural.  Vaulted ceilings give the entry a very spacious feel, however, a pile of rubble blocks any further passageways that would lead deeper within.  Along the northern wall, a granite archway stands before a limestone sarcophagus, while on the southern wall, a granite staircase leads up.

title: [Dungeon, Arena]
description: The area here is prepped for war.  Weapon racks and armor stands line the room for easy access to grab equipment and go.  Countless cages and cells occupy the room, to harbor whatever is needed to shower Elanthia in fire and brimstone.  Along the southern wall, a large mithril gate is the only means to escape this room.

title: [The Vault, Cave-in]
description: Inside the vault, the entire area has caved in.  Rock and steel lie everywhere, covering any further passage within.  Almost hidden from view, a shattered glass hatch is barely visible under all the rubble, while an enormous vault entrance stands guard over the entire mess.

title: [The Epoch]
description: The steel structure looks like it once was a vehicle of some sort.  Glancing out the cracked portholes, the machine has what resemble wings on both sides, but the vehicle itself doesn't appear as it was meant to fly.  A steel chronometer lies on the dashboard that has been heavily damaged; it also appears to be what controlled the vehicle.  Above all the wreckage, a shattered glass hatch serves as the only exit.

title: [Deserted House, Wyrom's Office]
description: Piles of random papers and books are stacked high, blocking the view of the walls.  Upon the floor, a large map of Elanthia sits taking up the majority of the space here.  Resting on the northwestern corner of the map is a large wyrmwood crate, which is in rough condition.  Empty bottles and cans are thrown all over the place, leaving little room to walk around.

title: [Itzel's Palapa]
description: Thick mahogany supports crisscross the high, thatched frond roof.  Twined strands of colored lights wrap around the beams, illuminating a pair of suspended hammocks and a battered picnic table.  The sandy ground is littered with caps and pottery sherdlets.  Off to one side, a fire pit and a plastic beer cooler sit dangerously close to one another.

title: [Mariath's Manse, Outside]
description: Modest by most comparisons, the manse is only two stories high.  Blackened mortar and brick make up much of the structure, timbered with crimson window lintels and wooden shutters.  Ornately carved rosewood doors at the entry feature silvery vaalin hinges and other fittings, and are flanked with oil lamps to illuminate the night.  A scrollworked wrought iron "M" is bolted near the top of the white brick chimney billowing forth smoke, and crimson trumpetflower vines scale the walls with their riotous blooms.

title: [Mariath's Manse, Antechamber]
description: Small and featuring space for outerwear to be hung up, and muddy footwear to rest, the entry just inside the door has been built in a manner to contain the elements and prevent them from moving further inside.  A pair of black brocaded satin curtains thickly lined with crimson-dyed linen partially blocks the archway leading north into the house.  Above, a vaalin chandelier holds several tall black candles protected with globes of crystal.

title: [Mariath's Manse, Rotunda]
description: Cylindrical and two stories tall, the rotunda has a very open feel due to the lack of furnishings save for a central table set with a big vase of assorted flowers in hues of crimson and blackish purple, and the crystal-paned dome overhead.  Ebonwood-banistered curving staircases meet at the second floor landing where there is a single rosewood door.  To the east is an archway, while under the stairs is a corridor leading back to the kitchen.  An antechamber sheltering the front door is to the south.

title: [Mariath's Manse, Kitchen]
description: Pristinely clean, it is clear the kitchen staff takes great pride in keeping the place neat and orderly, even while at the height of preparation and cooking.  Two large ovens sit side-by-side, fueled with fragrant wood from a stockpile stacked below.  A tall fireplace is well ventilated, as not a wisp of smoke escapes out into the room, despite all the pots hanging from the rack set over the the flames and glowing coals.  Scarred but well-conditioned, an oak worktable dominates the center of the room.

title: [Mariath's Manse, Terrace]
description: Imperfect slate and travertine tiles are arranged to create a terrace just outside the kitchen, and a large pergola is strung with strings of tiny votive holders filled with flickering candles.  Beneath the flowering vines sits a huge slab of mica-sparked granite serving as a dining table, with long polished benches of rosewood flanking it.  Off to one side is a deep fire pit set with rods used for roasting and a hive-shaped oven for baking.

title: [Mariath's Manse, Salon]
description: Small and circular, the sitting room is comfortably furnished with overstuffed chairs and settees upholstered in onyx and crimson floral brocade.  Ebonwood tables rest next to each and vaalin oil lamps illuminate the room with a warm glow that matches the flames in the black marble fireplace.  Tall windows open up the western wall, while an archway to the west leads out to the main sections of the manse.

title: [Mariath's Manse, Entresol]
description: Just off the salon, a low balcony looks out over the gardens and spies part of the back terrace, as well as the expansive rolling hills of the countryside striped with vineyards and riparians.  Crickets fill the night air with their song, and the scent of earth, fresh water, and flowers float by.  Only big enough for a few people, no furnishings clutter this space, but several pots featuring showy flowers rest near the low wall.

title: [The Crossroads]
description: More soft white mist that seems to sparkle with a faint glow hovers about the area, and extends in every direction as far as you can see.  Several new portals open up before you, leading to a number of mysterious places.  Which one will you choose first?

title: [Scrimge's Office]
description: A tall bay window draped in thin, dark linen curtains serves as a backdrop to this expansive room.  Twining sage vines adorned in wild sunset-hued gladiolus blooms, frame the window and creep out from behind the curtains, spreading across the back wall and up toward an elaborate eahnor chandelier hanging from the peak of the domed ceiling.  A wide black walnut bookcase rests against one of the brocaded walls.  A leather chair sits behind a black walnut desk.

title: [Private Beach, Ivry's Island]
description: Long stretches of glowing white sand stretch along this tranquil oceanfront.  Dotted here and there with tall coconut palms, the incredible starry view is mostly unobstructed.  Gentle waves roll onto the shore, each throwing a small spray before ebbing back out into the dark sea.

title: [Private Beach N, Ivry's Island]
description: Long stretches of glowing white sand stretch along this tranquil oceanfront.  Dotted here and there with tall coconut palms, the incredible starry view is mostly unobstructed.  Gentle waves roll onto the shore, each throwing a small spray before ebbing back out into the dark sea.  A comfortable looking seating area has been arranged in the sand.

title: [Private Beach S, Ivry's Island]
description: Long stretches of glowing white sand stretch along this tranquil oceanfront.  Dotted here and there with tall coconut palms, the incredible starry view is mostly unobstructed.  Gentle waves roll onto the shore, each throwing a small spray before ebbing back out into the dark sea.  A large cleared work area has been made in the sand.

title: [Private Island, Ivry's Oasis]
description: Thick bamboo stems make up the roof, pillars, and backside of this cozy beach office.  Long gauzy silk draperies fall from the overhead framework and lay pooled along the outer edges of the soft white sand floor, partially obscuring the expansive ocean view.  Sounds of the waves rolling just outside quietly filter in, punctuated with the occasional seagulls cry.

title: [Marstreforn's Golem Repair]
description: A nearly infinite number of tiny, transparent packages are systematically organized in vertical rows, covering all the available space on the walls of this cramped, narrow shop.  Framed glass cases are strategically arranged to prevent anyone from accessing the walls, each filled with a multitude of gadgets and marvels.  Dominating the center of a mottled tile floor is a group of angular steel racks that display numerous boxes painted with colorful artwork.  The smell of chemicals is overwhelming.

title: [The Washed-a-Shore]
description: A narrow strip of land stretches out for a few hundred feet, roaring waves threatening to engulf it on every side.  To the east lies a row of battered ships, the broken vessels barely intact as their debris floats haphazardly in the murky waters.  Washed up on shore is a massive black warship, its entire length almost torn in two.

title: [A Ruined Black Ship]
description: Blackened by paint and scorched by fire, the ship still retains its original dark hue even after its demise.  Ripped asunder, the ship's deck is split in half, the aft twisted and pointed towards the sky.  A broken ship's wheel lies on the ruined deck and reads, "Wyrom's Wyrmship."  A rope has been bolted into a wooden plank which overlooks a small crimson schooner.

title: [A Broken Crimson Schooner]
description: The corpses of ninjas litter the deck of the schooner, their blood long ago staining the wood.  Tattered sails flap eerily with the cold ocean breeze, the only sound being that of the sloshing waves below.  A blood-stained ship's wheel lies broken in half, one side reading, "The Marshal of Marstreforn."  A makeshift ladder leads up to a massive black ship while a stained gangplank leads down to a sandy shore.

title: [Are-You-Ashore]
description: Digging into the sandy shore is a small gangplank leading to a small crimson schooner within the shadow of a massive black ship.  To the east resides a large island, its distance shore dotted with massive red trees and towering mountain ranges.

title: [Under the Sea]
description: A narrow tunnel leads down into the ocean, its walls covered with glass.  The undersea passageway provides a view of the ocean life beneath the waves.  Large murky shapes move about in the distance while nearby a troupe of sea creatures, including a red lobster, a blow fish, a seahorse and some star fish play tiny instruments while watching you pass.

title: [Lair Lair, Pants on Fair]
description: A sea tunnel opens up into an enormous circular chamber encompassed by walls of thick granite.  A massive statue dominates the center of the room, almost reaching the domed ceiling.  Behind an ebony desk sits a long-haired woman with a featureless face, occasionally looking up from her desk to stare at a pair of ornate double doors.

title: [Kenstrom's Bureau]
description: Standing to both sides of ornate double doors are two elven barmaids, their curly red hair hanging over their emerald eyes, eternal smiles shaped upon their ivory faces.  A large aquarium runs the length of an entire wall, its waters clean but only skeletal fish littering the bottom of the tank.  A circular navy blue rug leads up to a pair of plush leather chairs which face a wide ebony desk.  Behind the desk sits a closet door covered with alloy chains and a sign reading, "No Skeletons In Here."

title: [The Strategy Stage]
description: Cold and colorless, the room resembles a stone bunker which is devoid of any real decor, with the exception of a large corkboard in one corner.  On the board is a map of Wehnimer's Landing, a hit list, a family photo, and two tickets.

title: [Hearth's Desire, Lookout]
description: Icicles dangle precariously along the sharply slanted roof of the lookout, the transparent ice encrusted along the reinforced ropes stretching down towards a northern post.  An iron-hinged telescope sits buried beneath thick layers of warg fur, the snow-dusted pile set beside the upside down crates.  A pair of spherical glass lanterns hang above, swaying in the ambient breeze before the sybil-shaped dart board and rack nailed to the rope-bound posts.

title: [Hearth's Desire]
description: A glinting blanket of snow covers the tall ironwood trunks along the periphery of the encampment, the rope-secured barricades spaced with iron-caged braziers forged into vertical tusks.  Frost-covered barrels sit clustered across the straw-strewn dirt, the makeshift seating encircling the pole-framed bonfire contained between the weathered rocks set in a wide circle.  Steady light radiates from the flag-adorned structures at the back of the encampment as a steady stream of cooking smoke rises above.

title: [Hearth's Desire, Cookhouse]
description: The brisk, icy air slips through the spike-tied canvas flaps of the tent, the dark fabric brushing against the trays set on nearby pedestals.  A pot-bellied stove of blackened iron stands at the back corner of the crate-walled room, the various pots and pans hanging above and interspersed by bundles of dried tobacco.  A clockwork basin of pipes and cogs loft an herb-filled box between the jar-filled shelves flanking the corners.

title: [Hearth's Desire, Gathering]
description: A sturdy framework of rope-bound planks supports the layers of boar hide and hard-packed earth insulating the interior of the expansive pavilion, the straw-covered ground draped in rectangles of canvas and rolled mats.  A circular fireplace rises at the center of the stone-encircled pit, its candle-covered mantel decorated with rows of carved steins.  Crates of supplies flank the tall counters along the periphery, the blanket-packed sundries and envelopes marked with wax seals.

title: [Hearth's Desire, Serenity]
description: Elongated iron-caged braziers flank the periphery of the stone-edged waters, the drakar-piped wooden tub set below the glass-framed dome showcasing the auroral swirls in the eternal evening sky.  Scattered warg furs cover the planked floor leading towards the log-framed bed, the downy-stuffed mattress piled with thick woolen blankets.  A forest-carved ironwood table sits low at the foot of the bed, the ground beneath it graced by a diminutive version of the oversized bed.

title: [Forging Complex of the Kraken]
description: A cool breeze ruffles the canopy overheard, the tears in the fabric offering a temporary glimpse at the night sky constellations.  The salty scent of sea air wafts through the complex's skeletal walls, mixing with the smell of heated oils and metals and further punctuated by the stench of sweat.  Beside open crates filled with refined slabs of metal are iron braziers, the coals smoldering within.  Forgemaster Kutlosa stands beside the entrance to some some open-air forging workshops, a cocky grin playing on her lips.

title: [The Black Rose, Sylvan Retreat]
description: Fitted into a curved bronze framework, panels of glass line the outer wall of the workshop, their surfaces etched with protective runes that shimmer faintly in the light cast by suspended glimaerstone orbs.  A tall gnomish-crafted workbench dominates the center of the space.  Crystalline tubing snakes along the ceiling, carrying a faint azure glow from deeper in the ship, and hanging plants trail verdant tendrils from the tubing overhead.  A pile of jade-hued silk cushions  sits between the outer wall and a built-in verdigris copper brazier.
location: The Black Rose, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Ashraam's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, a ruby-eyed grinning skull hangs on one of the glossy mistwood walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sits in one corner while a bronzed drake sculpture rests on the black marble floor.

title: [Militia Keep, Main Hall]
description: Guarded from the outside world by a steel portcullis, this area seems to serve as little more than a buffer for the main building.  Two arched stone doors stand to the north, ready to swing in or out at but a moment's notice if the need should arise.  Several cots and benches have been arranged along each wall, neighbored by sturdy racks stocked with nearly every kind of medical implement.  A pair of large golden banners hangs from the ceiling, proudly heralding the keep's entrance.

title: [Militia Keep, Meeting Hall]
description: Beyond the arched stone doors to the south, the meeting hall has been carefully arranged to accommodate an audience of nearly any number.  Long tables neatly form up the center of the room, each chair turned to face the modwir podium at the main wall, above which looms a massive golden tapestry bearing the Militia's crest.  Several smaller tables and booths surround the area beneath arches of stone, offering more private seating away from the center of activity.

title: [Militia Hall, Courtyard]
description: Although it is enclosed on all sides by thick walls of stone, the courtyard offers a glimpse of the world outside the keep.  The most noticeable feature is a circular pit of sand, flanked by several racks of wooden weapons and other implements of martial training.  Burlap dummies of hay and thick wooden poles have been arranged along the perimeter, each one bearing the notches and tears of frequent use.  Separate from the main building, a stone tower dominates the northern wall.

title: [Militia Keep, Tower]
description: A precisely angled ceiling of thick iron plates arcs overhead, supported by the carved stone that makes up the tower.  Several windows surround the cramped chamber, offering views just large enough to take in the sprawl of the city below.  Each wall has been affixed with carefully arranged racks of provisions, keeping the floor free of clutter while allowing adequate room around the large ballista.

title: [Militia Keep, Barracks]
description: Plenty of torches line the walls of the barracks, illuminating the area sharply.  Four thick stone pillars are scattered across the room to support the ceiling, each displaying the Militia's coat-of-arms upon golden tapestries.  Several tables and chairs are bunched up in the center of the room, offering plenty of seating while simple cots and cotton hammocks line the walls for those who need rest.  Pushed up against the eastern wall is an iron and modwir credenza.

title: [Militia Keep, Study]
description: Brightly lit by polished wall-mounted sconces, the study is paneled in dark-hued walnut, providing the expansive chamber with a tranquil atmosphere.  Sturdy bookcases overflowing with collections of tomes, ledgers and books line the perimeter of the room like stalwart sentinels.  A long central conference table stretches across the carpeted floor, its surface cluttered with various maps of Wehnimer's Landing and the outlying environs.

title: [Militia Keep, Cellar]
description: While the cellar is quite large, crates and boxes cover most of the eastern stone wall.  Set standing in the center of the room are two modwir racks, separated by a gleaming suit of full plate armor, which looms in guardianship over the proceedings.  An elaborate sigil has been etched into the stone of the southern wall, marked between two brocade tapestries that display the Militia's coat-of-arms.  A reinforced steel and iron door sits on the western wall abutting an upwards-leading set of steps.

title: [Militia Keep, Holding Cell]
description: The only light in this small, rough-walled room comes from the torches in the corridor, flickering dimly through the barred window in the door.  Most of the room remains cloaked in shadow, but appears to be completely bare of any decoration except for a barred cabinet mounted on the south wall.  There is a hint of damp in the air, and a slightly moldy smell.

title: [Militia Keep, Summoning Chamber]
description: Tall wrought iron candlesticks hold thick pillar candles of beeswax, offering a modicum of illumination.  Chalk residue remains in a thin layer upon the wooden floor, providing testament to some past ritual.  A small table rests against one wall, its surface strewn with the various paraphernalia required in the practice of the summoning craft, while pieces of waxed vellum inked with celestial calculations and archaic symbols spill over and onto the ground.

title: [Seawind Haevn, Onyx Rose Ranch]
description: Vibrant green grass grows within a meadow spotted with goldenrod, larkspur, and the occasional black-eyed daisy, while towering modwirs form a natural boundary to the wild growth.  Lined with smooth river stones, a narrow dirt track ambles between the edge of the path and a two-story stable with wide haon and birch doors.  A cheerily burning lantern hangs from the widow's peak, its light illuminating the stained glass window beneath it.
location: Onyx Rose Ranch, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Shadowlight Gallery, Reception]
description: Graduating from silvery pewter to rich plum, the walls are smooth and unadorned, providing a semi-neutral backdrop to the ornate, blown glass sculptures used to illuminate the space.  Several settees in silver-tacked aubergine recline along the western wall where a sterling silver serving cart provides refreshments to visitors, while opposite a brass and oak coat rack provides a tidy place to store garments.  Fitted with an ornate stained-glass window, an ebonwood door leads to the streets of Mist Harbor.

title: [Shadowlight Gallery, Visual Art]
description: Polished, blonde bamboo floors stretch across the room connecting the various parts of the building with a unified appearance.  Creating artistic splashes in the slate grey walls, narrow floor-to-ceiling alcoves are fitted with decorative stained glass images, each illuminated by recessed glowing frosted orbs.  Upon the opposite wall, a series of framed artwork pieces are arranged in a variety of shapes and sizes around a keyhole archway fitted with a matching door.

title: [Shadowlight Gallery, Tactiles]
description: Hanging upon the black walls, wooden shadow boxes are illuminated from within by thin rods of glowing blown glass.  White pine curios occupy the four corners, their tops covered in large earthen pots of glossy blue and teeming with ivy plants whose gangling limbs are coaxed into tiny hooks that encircle the room at ceiling level.  A thin runner of mingled blue and green knotwork leads to an exterior door.

title: [Shadowlight Gallery, Motion Art]
description: Encircled by a high stone wall, the small courtyard is paved with glossy terracotta tiles and surrounded by a border of manicured grass.  At its center, a copper-lined stone fountain housing an ornate bronze statue dominates the space, while small  and chairs are secreted away amid arching arbors of mingled tea roses and peonies.  Hidden amid calico ivy leaves, a painted door provides entry to the residence.

title: [Shadowlight Gallery, Studio]
description: Cramped yet tidy, the studio has a solid mahogany floor and slate walls.  Honeycomb cubbies are built between the floor and underside of an ascending spiral staircase, the octagonal compartments filled with all manner of supplies, half-finished projects, cups, bowls, and other bric-a-brac associated with the art of creation.  A long paint-marred table provides ample room for new creations and has a tall metal-fortified stool set before it.

title: [Shadowlight Gallery, Attic]
description: Spartan at best, the second story fills the entirety of the residence's floor space and is built between the eves of the roof.  Tiny glass jars filled with fireflies illuminate the space and hang in profusion from the exposed rafters.  Pressed against the north and west wall, a thick blanket-laden sleeping pallet has a battered old oak footlocker at one end of it, while a mirror-topped antique wash stand rests next to a descending spiral staircase.

title: [The Lodge, Lawn]
description: Sheltered in the heart of town and amidst a grove of trees, this earthy structure beckons visitors with an intricately carved pair of oak doors.  Hand-stripped logs of age-darkened oak are carefully placed to form the circular walls.  Two smaller outbuildings are visible around the circumference, their rounded exteriors radiating outward to match the arc of the main structure.  The triskelion architecture of the lodge is clearly discernable in the lichen-covered riverstone foundation.

title: [The Lodge, Main Lounge]
description: Plump pillows and overstuffed sofas encircle a massive riverstone fireplace sunken into the center of the room, creating a comfortable place to relax.  Large animal pelts are scattered underfoot, cutting the chill of the stone flooring.  Sturdy oaken beams bring the circular walls to a peak overhead.  Against one wall, a long sideboard offers food and drink.  A glass panel leads out to a lush garden.

title: [The Lodge, Museum of Memories]
description: Carved into the oak panels of the far wall, a graceful tree of life spreads its branches.  Polished stone familiars are evenly spaced around the room.  Perched on rounded pedestals, they stand sentinel over small tables holding carefully placed historical artifacts. To the east of the entry, three paintings in gilded frames and an incongruous boar's head hang above the familiars.  To the west, the curved wall bears two plaques, one silver plaque and one gold plaque, hung side by side on the smooth oak paneling.

title: [The Lodge, Meditation Chamber]
description: Finely grained teak-paneled walls join seamlessly with a polished stone block floor, blending in a flawless match of color and texture.  Dominating the center of the room is an interweaving spiral pattern etched into the floor blocks, the only decoration in an otherwise empty room.  The sole break in the seamless join of tree and earth is a square stone block embedded at hand level in the wood.

title: [The Lodge, Enchanting Workshop]
description: Several dozen crystal shards float just below the high ceiling, illuminating the space with a multicolored display of lights.  On the floor, four interlocking circles of runic designs form a triangular pattern, echoing the triskelion construction of the building.  The main wall is scribed in silver with carefully painted characters, each of which refracts the undulating light from above.  A floating glass table hovers near a rune-carved arch.

title: [The Lodge, Garden]
description: Nestled between two radiating arcs of the lodge, the garden stretches across a pristine flora-filled lawn to the edge of a bubbling hot spring.  Swirling mists of steam rising from the water obscure a small gazebo.  Translucent lanterns sway in the breeze, casting dancing lights across the garden.  White wooden benches topped with cozy floral cushions offer comfortable seating near a silver serving cart.  A glass panel leads inside the lodge.

title: [The Lodge, Hot Springs]
description: Narrow beams of moonlight stream through the wisteria vines that arch over the steam filled spring.  Tiny points of light shimmer across the surface, while heat from below maintains a steady uplift of currents.  The garden beyond is blurred by rising swirls of mist.

title: [The Frostmain, Black Jetty]
description: A jut of volcanic stones jabs into the frigid grey waters.  Seafoam clings to the black rocks, its susurrus a steady counterpoint to the crashing of the waves.  Though the air is crisp and clean, a faint scent of fishy brine lingers on the icy breeze and is especially thick around a small dark shack built along the shore.

title: [The Frostmain, Talbot's Point]
description: Black basalt knuckles punch seaward, their slick faces lacquered with brine and rime.  Icy swells heave against the point, breaking to spindrift that salts the air.  A carved totem, weathered until only flakes of paint are left on its surface, rises from a cleft in the rock, its grim faces stacked in storm-dark wood, whalebone tusks pegged into snarling mouths.  Wedged into the spaces between black stones, abandoned rods lean like tired old men, lines trailing in the water.  The air smells heavily of kelp.

title: [Kravzhak's Crab Shack, Shop]
description: Though a bit ramshackle and ill-built, the small one-room shop is built to hold out most of the cold.  Rods of various lengths and makes hang from hooks along the walls.  A firepit has been dug into the floor, and in it burns a small fire that warms the room and fills the air with the smell of woodsmoke.  Near to the slightly slanted counter sits a rhimar-lined black wooden chest that smells faintly of cold fish.

title: [Lyronde's Magic Shoppe]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A wicker basket and an etched brass bin stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Lyronde's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A gilded maple cabinet sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Lyronde's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [The Justicar's Temple]
description: The small temple of the Justicar is adorned solely in shades of the most brilliant white.  This makes it hard to see the crystal altar that dominates the center of the room.  Behind the altar is a small door.

title: [Albatross, Main Deck]
description: Sunlight glints off the polished rosewood and mahogany decks.  A mahogany-framed entry inlaid with ornate gold filigree leads inside the riverboat, while the deck wraps about it all.  Carefully piled silk rope sits next to a gaily beribboned mahogany gangplank leading off the boat, which is adorned with carved mistwood albatross perched along the railings.

title: [Albatross, Aft]
description: The mahogany decking wraps around the back of the riverboat, coming to a halt around a narrow hatchway leading toward the paddlewheel.  Sunlight shines upon the polished brass railings that sweep the sides of the Albatross.

title: [Albatross, Paddlewheel]
description: Sunlight glistens upon the water that drips off the giant propelling mechanism.  A small housing encircles the paddlewheel -- the area filled with the timber that the riverboat uses for fuel.  Adorned on each paddle are golden sheets of metal in the shape of feathers.  Iron rings are bolted to the water-damaged decking, with one particular ring that is slightly misshapen.

title: [Albatross, Gambler's Rest]
description: The casino floor begins here and branches off in all directions.  Rosewood and mahogany doors are barely visible along the tapestry-covered walls, which are lined with some dark leather couches and serving trays.  In the center of the room is an elaborately carved mistwood staircase that climbs up to the next level of the riverboat, and a silver-inlaid mahogany archway leads toward the bar, ballroom, and buffet.  A short flight of steps lead down to the cashier.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Albatross, Pirate Lottery]
description: Several rows of tables line the room, each one of them surrounded by a number of chairs.  Upon each table rests a machine with a silvery button in front of it.  A circular platform made from gold and silver-veined marble stands at the northern end of the room.

title: [Albatross, Chain Tumblers]
description: Purple carpeting spans the entire room, silver and gold accents create the image of an albatross in the center of the floor.  Several contraptions, each with a chain dangling from it, line the walls in this circular room, with stools placed in front of each contraption.

title: [Albatross, Let It Ride Lobby]
description: The lobby branches off into a number of gemstone tile tables that lead to individual games being played.  An enormous chandelier hanging from the ceiling dangles prismatic crystal cards, each varying in hue, which brighten the floorspace.

title: [Albatross, Roulette Pit]
description: Richly paneled walls and lush crimson carpeting are illuminated by myriad candles behind hunter green glass, but the focal point of this pit is the elaborate roulette wheel on a polished mahogany table.  The numbers chart, betting sign, and rules poster are all framed in gold and hang from the rosewood walls in easy view of all gamblers.

title: [Albatross, Dart Room]
description: The mahogany flooring here is scuffed, especially a several yard area directly in front of a gold-edged rosewood dart board set with thin sapphire rings.  Comfortable couches and chairs are scattered about at safe distances from the dart board and its flight path.

title: [Let It Ride, Pearl Table]
description: Small windows along one wall permit a view of the deck and the sunlight-drenched waters far below.  Richly hued chestnut marble flooring sparkles as if dusted with gold, and rosewood paneling polished to a luminous glow encloses the room.  However, the focal point is a tile table sparkling with pearls.  A dealer stands behind the table, and a sign is propped up on it.

title: [Let It Ride, Zircon Table]
description: Small windows along one wall permit a view of the deck and the sunlight-drenched waters far below. However, the focal point is a tile table sparkling with rubies.  A dealer stands behind the table, and a sign is propped up on it.

title: [Albatross, Silvers' Taproom]
description: Sunlight filters through the heavy, leaded crystal windows that span floor to ceiling on the port and starboard sides.  A gold-accented mahogany counter sits in the center of the dark green marble floor.  To the north, music echoes from the ballroom, while a tapestry-lined hallway leads toward the buffet and a silver-inlaid mahogany archway leads toward the casino floor.

title: [Albatross, Ballroom]
description: An enormous crystal chandelier, shaped like a soaring albatross, hangs from the ceiling by a vaalin chain.  A full band of musicians fills the raised stage at the far end, and the rosewood floor is gleaming with polish.

title: [Albatross, Bewildered Buffet]
description: Leaded crystal windows line the aft and starboard walls, with daylight pouring in from the outside and shining upon the buffet.  Darkly hued chestnut marble covers the floor, its alabaster and gold veins forming an albatross at the center.  Just around the corner from the tapestry-lined hallway are a pair of crystal doors leading toward the kitchen.

title: [Albatross, Patrons' Hallway]
description: Elegant beeswax candles hang from the ceiling in hunter green glass holders, their light dappling the richly carpeted hallway and casting shadows along the rosewood walls.  Solid gold and silver filigree frame the entryways leading to the various shops on this level of the riverboat.  An ivory-inset mahogany archway and a gold-trimmed rosewood door rest on the western wall, which is lined with colorful tapestries.  Several chairs and serving trays are set out throughout the hallway.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, northwest

title: [Albatross, Gift Shop]
description: Gold and alabaster wind in sinuous loops across a dark chestnut marble floor, and gilted carvings of elegant men and women gambling and gamboling cover the rosewood walls.  A small marble-topped table sits near the arch leading out, and a mahogany cabinet is against one wall.  Set out in the center of the gift shop is an elegant display case, the panes of glass each etched with an image of an albatross in flight.

title: [Albatross, The Smoke Stack]
description: Alternating dark and light wood paneling encloses the darkly lit small room filled with the scent of fresh tobacco lingering in the air.  A glass display case fills the northern wall of the shop, boasting neatly layered rows of cigars and fresh tobacco jars, while a matching display counter exhibits the shop's various pipes and pipe tobacco options.

title: [Albatross, Ladies' Luck Lounge]
description: The bright hue of the plush, padded dark magenta velvet walls is tempered somewhat by a curtain of linked gold disks.  An opulent chandelier casts candlelight over the circular room, bathing a multi-tiered champagne fountain beset by a pair of plush magenta velvet chaises inverted head-to-toe from each other in the center of the room with a warm, pink glow.  A lacquered rosewood mirror leans up against the wall beside a highly varnished wood table, while an array of highly polished gold hooks mark evenly spaced intervals around the circumference of the room.

title: [Albatross, Merchant's Nook]
description: Several tapestries are displayed on the walls, each depicting one of the various gambling games aboard the Albatross.  Affixed on both sides of the rosewood door is a single sconce, each illuminates the room.  Scattered throughout the lounge are a number of soft divans, offering a comfortable atmosphere.

title: [Albatross, Patrons' Hallway]
description: Cheerfully festooned gold railings enclose the open-air hallway, and a large portion of the surrounding area is visible from this vantage point.  Daylight reflects off the waters far below, and the expanse of the deck is visible.

title: [Albatross, Upper Hallway]
description: Dark chestnut marble veined with alabaster and gold stretches the length of the hallway, and dark mahogany walls are elaborately carved in relief with aristocratic scenes of gambling, drinking, and hunting.

title: [Albatross, Upper Hallway]
description: Narrow lengths of purple carpeting cover the dark chestnut marble flooring of the hallway.  On the north wall is a heavy rosewood door and on the opposite wall facing it is a silver-traced door.  The remainder of the hallway branches off into other rooms, likely the quarters for the staff on the riverboat.

title: [Albatross, Captain's Quarters]
description: An immense stained glass window overlooks the deck below with sunlight pouring through the colorful panes of glass.  The daylight brightens the area around a desk pushed up against the far wall.  Upon the rosewood desk is a detailed parchment log book, as well as stacks of paperwork.

title: [Albatross, Fortune's Suite]
description: This cozy suite on the port-side of the mid-level deck has large windows with views of the surrounding area and the waters below.  Richly appointed tapestries adorn the walls, and the polished mahogany floor is inlaid with rosewood dice and fortune symbols.  A silk-draped featherbed is on a raised platform near the windows, where it bathes in the rays of daylight.

title: [Albatross, Luck's Suite]
description: The suite spans the width of the mid-level deck, situated at the fore of the riverboat with large floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the main deck below.  Hammered gold runners hold elegant rugs atop ebon marble floors, and ornately carved cherrywood walls reflect the lustrous glow of the sun.  A few steps down into a sunken room lead to an immense, richly curtained bed piled high with luxurious bedding.

title: [Everybody Must Get Stoned]
description: Several small stone chests, some with rocks sitting atop them, are shoved onto dusty shelves.  More rocks are plopped into a stone replica of Duskruin Arena, and a few battered gems and rocks roll around in small basalt enclosures.  A cloaked gnoll sits on a scuffed chair near the back.

title: [The Celadon Thread]
description: Bundles of leafy cuttings, fragrant twigs, and dried blossoms are stacked neatly upon wooden shelves lining the wagon's curved walls, their mingled scents creating a warm and earthy redolence that fills the air.  A counter of bark-edged walnut, bisected by a vein of dried azure resin, anchors the space with a sense of balance as it displays wares for sale.  Beneath it, additional goods peek out from large woven baskets stacked side by side.

title: [Grinding Gears, Interior Clock]
description: Walls of old, dilapidated planks of sun-bleached wood are held haphazardly together by crooked nails and strands of copper wire.  A persistent ticking echoes throughout the space, as overhead a chaotic assortment of gears, cogs, and springs appear to support a large brass pendulum that sways slowly, in perfect rhythm.  Spanning the back wall is a lacquered countertop covered in a cluttered pile of odd instruments, bottles, and wares around a glass display case.

title: [Pinions and Pulse]
description: This stone walled chamber is illuminated by a steady lattice of suspended lights that reveal a series of glass display cases arranged with deliberate symmetry.  Inside each case rests a wing-shaped pin, some emitting a pale glow while others pulse with darker energy.  Subtle motes of light and shadow drift within the cases, occasionally brushing against the glass.  Fine runic etchings are carved into the floor and walls, suggesting controlled containment rather than decoration.

title: [Sales From The Crypt]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the polished oak walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the oak floor.

title: [Starsworn's Weaponry]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet.

title: [Starsworn's Outfitting]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [House of Thorns, Boutique]
description: Separated off from the main gallery is a smaller, private workshop, whose dark walnut-stained floor matches the straight beam ceiling above.  Set on the wainscoted walls is a long cork notice board with several order parchments attached.  A pair of rollers from a silver-edged lacquered bolt display have been removed and set on a marble-topped sturdy wooden worktable.  Underneath the worktable sits a series of white ash shoe forms, well-organized compared to the remainder of the room.

title: [Ilixil's Emporium, Front Room]
description: Tiny cobalt blue cages line the walls of the anteroom, their translucent glaes bars aglow with pale violet light.  Diamond orbs hang from the ceiling on thin silvery chains.  Prismatic refractions from where light touches them cut through the lingering shadows of the chamber to reveal a circular dome overhead.  Underfoot, a faded grey and blue carpet softens the basalt tiles of the floor, running up to the foot of a gilt-trimmed ebony cabinet.

title: [Ilixil's Emporium, Back Room]
description: Set back from the light of the road outside, the windowless space toward the back of the emporium has many empty cages, from which emanate keening songs in an alien chorus.  The low light is just enough to illuminate the edges of a gold-trimmed ebony chest at the center of the room, its broad frame flanked by two skulls atop poles.

title: [Meadow, Wildflower Patch]
description: A deceptively tranquil and seductive meadow spreads out before your eyes.  You are overwhelmed for a moment by the sweet smell of the wildflowers and the constant hypnotic humming of insects.  A sink hole in a depression gushes forth with a trickling spring to one side, while along the other side of the opening, a small, mud path is evident.

title: [Meadow, Ruins]
description: Wandering aimlessly through the pleasant meadow, you notice a few ruined markers, milestones, and a number of weed-covered mounds just to the north.  A dark, thin vertical shape and a squarer black one cleave the sky farther north.  Receding into the distance are low mountains in the northeast.

title: [Meadow, Grave Mounds]
description: You weave your way through the narrow spaces between a score or so of low mounds covered with sparse vegetation.  On closer inspection, you realize they are actually ancient mass graves, hastily dug and filled.  To the south, the refreshing meadow beckons.  To the north, the dark, vertical shapes take on the terrifying aspect of some unearthly bird poised for flight.

title: [Meadow, Tower's View]
description: The mounds thin out here and the land is flat, choked with thick undergrowth.  Beneath your feet you feel large stones and debris, including arrowheads, spear tips, and shards of rusted metal.  Farther north, is another slight slope, which drops off abruptly.  From the center of the depression, rising like some phoenix not yet restored to youth, is the keep of Black Swan Castle.

title: [Meadow, Scorched Ground]
description: The ground here is scorched, and not even weeds have sprung up.  The nascent slope of the bank encircling the moat here is also barren, as though an unnatural blight had been visited upon it.

title: [Meadow, Trail]
description: The flat ground becomes barer, the weeds thin out, the castle looms closer.  The jumble of small trails converges to a track leading along the banks of the moat.

title: [Cesspit]
description: The muck that has filtered through the grate for decades, or perhaps centuries, covers the floor of this watery hollow in the wall of the castle.  The stench is unbearable, and things which you do not particularly wish to identify splash at the surface now and then.  The ancient stone walls are covered with slime, lichens, and crawling things, and it is very hard to breathe in what little air remains.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Moat]
description: Gliding between the clumps of aquatic weeds choking the moat, and the inexplicable miniature maelstroms swirling around you, you utter a curse to yourself, inadvertently swallowing a large dose of the nauseating water.  You gag and redouble your efforts to traverse this obstacle.

Clumps of aquatic weeds choke this section of the moat, the hidden underwater roots forming a net for any stray appendage.  Miniature maelstroms swirl inexplicably between the weeds, indicating that there may be more beneath the surface than just roots.

title: [Moat, Whirlpool]
description: Your body is jerked like a puppet by the forceful currents of the whirlpool.  No light penetrates the murky black water, making it difficult to tell which way is up.  There is little you can do to prevent being drawn downward into the lower depths of the foul moat.

title: [Moat, Underwater]
description: Your eyes strain to find any light in the murky black water, but there is none.  The cold and pressure indicate that you are deep below the water's surface.

wayto.36352: ;e waitfor 'and pull you down even further into the murk'

title: [Moat, Bottom]
description: The moat floor is just within reach, if you wanted to tempt the black, eyeless creatures that scuttle along through the muck.  You can just make out the outlines of a hundred years' worth of junk that has had the misfortune of finding its way to the moat bottom.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Drawbridge]
description: The decaying drawbridge suspends precariously by rusted chains that hang steadfastly frozen in place.  The strength of the old planks appears to have been sapped by the elements, attempts at forcible entry, and long neglect.  They groan ominously as the currents of the smelly moat swirl beneath you.  It is easy to see both the the shore and the castle entrance from where you stand, and face only a matter of choice of which direction you decide to go as the drawbridge creaks beneath your weight.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Courtyard]
description: A large, dirty heap of straw is piled against the southeast stone walls here.  Although the straw looks positively ancient, you notice fresh depressions in it, and some shallow, narrow depressions in the moist earth around the pile.  The gate in the southern wall is blocked by a raised drawbridge.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Courtyard]
description: The portcullis is rusted shut, and through its barred windows you can see the now-useless drawbridge, halted in mid-course upon chains long welded solid by corrosion.  The edges of the planks comprising the portcullis and the drawbridge are charred and rot has set in.  An old watchtower stands off in a corner to the west.  At the far end of the open courtyard rises the keep, the stone pediment above the ebony doors beckoning like a mawing beak of some black bird.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Courtyard]
description: Permanent gloom seems to hang in this corner of the courtyard.  The shadows of the broken and violated battlements of the fortress wall merge with those of the dark, stone tower.  Scrapes, grooves, and deep striations on the surface of the stones speak of determined enemies without clamoring to reach great treasures within.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Courtyard]
description: From this angle, the haze surrounding the keep to the northeast seems to take on the ever-cycling hues of the rainbow.  No longer merely a black, lifeless interloper against the sky, the stronghold now seems to pulsate with secret malevolent life.  Although no wind can penetrate the surrounding walls, a low, constant rustling sound can be perceived, like the beating of giant wings.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Courtyard]
description: Seared grass, carbonized twigs, and trampled dirt indicate that invaders had breached the walls and mounted an assault on the east flank of the keep.  The burned-out shed here is little more than a blackened frame, with poles forming a peaked roof to which cling charred tufts of thatch.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Keep]
description: The grand ebony doors of the Black Swan are carved in beautiful, yet somehow subtly disquieting, detail.  Impossibly shaped, the keep itself rises vertically and spreads its black wings out, casting a commanding shadow over the courtyard.  The entire facade is rife with strange architectural fillips and hideously attenuated crenelations.  It is like some evil black bird of prey, ready to take flight.

title: [Keep, Entry Hall]
description: The grand, sweeping lines of the structure that were a main feature of the exterior of Black Swan Keep continue on inside the structure.  The dark, carved walls meet to form an asymmetrical dome far above your head, where bats and pigeons have made their homes over the decades of disuse.  Large ebony doors stand at one end of the hall, and a narrow arch spans between two spindly columns that are partially hidden within the shadows.

title: [Keep, Corridor]
description: Dim, dust-speckled light filters in through small airshafts along the ceiling, illuminating a path through the rubble leading away from a narrow arch between two spindly columns.  Broken furniture and mildew-covered lengths of cloth mingle with the mud and dirt on the granite floor.  The walls contain tall niches, each housing a metal cage, now ruined, that bears traces of gilt and a few semi-precious stones.

title: [Keep, Corridor]
description: This corridor is unremarkable and mostly featureless, save for the airshafts above and the debris on the floor.  Through the dust and muck covering the granite, you notice that the cracks between the paving stones seem wider along this section, and you feel as though the floor gives slightly beneath you with each step.  Each footfall elicits a low, creaking groan.

title: [Keep, Guardpost]
description: A raised stone platform against one wall of the corridor holds a broken desk and a few rotting chairs.  Assorted rusting spears have been propped up in the corner, and sawhorses, chains, and iron levers anchored to the floor indicate that this was some kind of work area or guard post.  A long, deep groove bisects the ceiling above.

title: [Keep, Corridor]
description: The walls of the corridor curve sharply here, making it almost impossible to see what is around the corner.  Strange squealing sounds echo through the corridor, but turn out only to be a group of rats viciously fighting over some scrap of something foul that could be considered food.  Their little bodies swarm around back and forth, locked in combat, ignoring you completely.

title: [Keep, Corridor]
description: The corridor here widens into an anteroom ending in a large stone door.  The room is mostly empty save for a small table with a simple vase on top, which contains the stains of a ring of evaporated water and the sad remains of some long withered away flowers.

title: [Keep, Outer Chamber]
description: This chamber is full of old junk.  There are some bent and corroded pots of all shapes and sizes lying about haphazardly.  In one corner, an old heavy basin lies broken, one side completely shattered from its impact with the floor.  Several stacks of old buckets beside a large stone door, corroded together so that it would be difficult to pull them apart.

title: [Keep, Warded Passage]
description: The dead carcasses of various types of vermin litter the floor here.  Rats, mice, bats, and fat spiders lie scattered everywhere, some looking freshly slaughtered.  The passageway seems as if it was once heavily guarded, betrayed by discarded weapons and armor propped against the walls or cluttering the floor.

title: [Keep, Dining Hall]
description: A thick veneer of red lacquer covers the walls, carved in deep intaglio.
