Burnished tableaux of blazing red phoenixes and haughty fighting bantams accented with cinnabar and carnelian inlay are etched into the surfaces, sectioned off by a series of ceiling-to-floor columns.  A long cedar table, beset by banks of chairs, runs down the center of the hall.  You also see a leaning cracked marble column and a frayed velvet curtain.

title: [Keep, Study]
description: Exposed rafters stretch out overhead, the dark wood complementing the deep indigo leather walls painted from floor to ceiling with scores of magnificent peacocks in bold strokes of iridescent blue and gilt.  Piles of worm-eaten manuscripts and books are heaped on the floor, and broken bookshelves litter the room.  A clear path runs through the rubble from a frayed velvet curtain on one wall to a barricaded door directly opposite.

title: [Keep, Dressing Room]
description: A stone basin rests in the middle of a long, low stone table, beset by a silver pitcher and a rectangular silver tray filled with assorted hairpins.  Torn carpets, now stiff and wiry with mildew, in hues of yellow made darker by time and wear, cover the floor.   A narrow staircase leads up.

title: [Keep, Sleeping Quarters]
description: The stone here has been limed and whitewashed, though it is now dingy with age and soot.  Piles of white bedclothes, stained with blood and black smudges, are strewn about.  There is no sign of any furnishing, save for a large stained glass-fronted wardrobe still standing against the far wall.  A narrow staircase leads down.

title: [Keep, Glowing Passage]
description: Except for a narrow ledge, there is an abrupt drop-off here on three sides.  The walls are coated with a slight phosphor that sheds dim light.  A natural cave-in has left the ledge littered with rubble.  Some of the rubble has been cleared away, revealing a stairwell that spirals downward.  You also see a small opening.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Tower]
description: The floor of the tower is filled with rubble and debris, leaving barely any room to squeeze through the chunks of stone and fallen timber.  Mounds of dirt and sand make it almost impossible to reach the remains of a black marble spiral stair that ascends to the lookout point above.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Tower]
description: This is the lookout floor of the tower.  A spiral black marble stair winds its way down in the center, while a granite platform carved into the walls allows access to the north and east doors, and the south and west windows, for watches and emergencies.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Courtyard]
description: The center of the courtyard is the sole spot where sunlight regularly manages to sneak past the guardian shadows of the towers and walls.  Weeds grow luxuriantly and tall grasses have gone to seed in what once may have been an extravagant flowerbed, nearly obscuring a spoked long-armed catapult.  Cradled in the crook of the walls, the guard tower rises up through the mists, but is overshadowed by the massive keep to the north.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Black Swan Castle, Courtyard]
description: Sparse grass interrupts the mostly barren area just before the stone wall.  A few ruts and holes in the ground hold rainwater, forming puddles that reflect the black forms of the tower to the southwest and the keep to the northwest.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Courtyard]
description: Moss and black powdery lichen coat the stone wall in this northwest corner of the courtyard.  The keep of Black Swan Castle rises above you to the east, nesting upon a base of black granite and marble, with weeds growing around the foundation.  This part of the wall is also covered in vegetation, with vines working their way up, as if seeking sunlight and freedom.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Shed]
description: The shed is old and dilapidated.  Dozens of spears aged well past the point of usefulness lean up against a dented and rusted metal cabinet.  Corroded metal spheres and round boulders used for catapult ammunition have been stacked neatly in place, but are covered in a heavy layer of dust and have obviously been neglected for a long time.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: The dark, curving shape of the keep obscures the view of the northwestern section of the ramparts from here, along with a good portion of the courtyard.  Just over the moat, it is possible to see an old catapult silhouetted against the mist-shrouded slopes farther east.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: Here the path along the ramparts becomes very difficult, with many gaps and missing stones.  On one side of the wall there are the dour and somber forms of the tower and keep, while on the other there is the delightful contrast of a beautiful vista of fields and meadows.  The juxtaposition is striking and diverting, but the occasional crumble of stone is a sharp reminder to watch where you place your feet.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: This lookout faces southeast, providing a view of the flatlands to the south and the uplands to the east.  The avian black shape of the keep looms overhead, and a tower rises like an ebony-shafted spear above the walls of the fortress.  On the ground just outside of the wall, a catapult stands watch, broken and useless.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: The currents in the moat rush swiftly beneath the drawbridge to the west below.  Gazing over the other side of the wall, you see uneven patches of grass and dirt in the courtyard.  A large quantity of dirty straw is heaped at the base of the interior wall.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: You stand along the top of the wall here, treading very tentatively since this spot, directly over the drawbridge and portcullis, seems to have incurred the most damage from without.  The remaining path is only a single paving stone wide in spots, and feels likely to give way under the slightest strain.  Through gaps in the wood and stones, you can see the moat swirling beneath.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: The tallest tower of the fortress provides the highest point for detecting enemy onslaughts.  The thin and elegant stone structure seems to stretch and crane over the landscape, like some vigilant bird poised to take flight at the first sign of attack.  Two windows, now like lifeless eye sockets, are sunk into the western and southern curves of the tower.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: The natural obstacles provided by the dense forest and rocky mountains to the northeast have resulted in this lookout being in much better condition than the catapult-barraged walls to the southwest.  The umbra of the keep further darkens the charred ground and outbuilding in the courtyard below.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: The ramparts here are not in such an advanced state of disrepair behind the lookout tower.  The dark granite is mostly unmarred on both the inner and outer walls.  This area seems to have been spared from the full force of enemy attacks.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: A green patch of grass in the middle of the courtyard looks incongruous in the midst of all the disarray and decay.  Tiny white flowers nestled in the grass can just barely be made out dotting the ground below, brightening up the area even further.  A breeze stirs the air for just a moment, bringing a bit of welcome, cool air.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: Some vines have struggled their way up the ramparts here.  Their strong roots and tendrils have weakened the stone, and as you proceed, you dislodge small flakes that tumble into the moat below.  The front of the Black Swan Keep is clearly visible from here, its eerie upward sweep momentarily distracting you from your careful footing.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: Looking down along the shore of the moat, you see one particularly tall, solitary tree.  It can also be noted that the corner of the keep is close, but it is not close enough for anyone to leap with any certainty of making the perilous jump.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: The blank solid granite wall of the Black Swan casts a clammy chill over this part of the rampart path.  To the north, you see the dark green tops of oaks, with a smattering of pine and modwir trees.  A cold, strong updraft of air from the space between the outer wall and the back of the keep makes it difficult for you to keep your balance.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: It is a bit difficult to see your way about clearly here in the deep shadows of the keep.  Though the walls are near, it is too far for you to be able to jump across or clamber over from the ramparts to the building itself.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: The rear corner of the keep rises up before you.  The building is carved in upturned patterns of glistening black granite scrolls, giving it the aspect of being covered in gleaming black feathers.  Down in the alley between the keep and the wall, there is only blackness and a long drop.  The moat over the other side of the wall looks black from this vantage point as well.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: The shadow of the keep's roof is cast across the rampart path.  Looking down into the courtyard, you see a burned-out hulk with a dark patch around it.  The treeline to the north goes on as far as the horizon.

title: [In the Catapult]
description: You are curled up into the half-circle of the cup of the catapult.  You can survey the surrounding turf nicely from here.  You also see the tip of the rope.

title: [Dungeon, Grand Chamber]
description: The warm glow in this chamber from the many beautiful bronze sconces is almost cheerily bright.  Grand architecture is evident in the rich green tiles, giant columns, and gold leaf trim adorning the room.  The intricate richness even extends to a gleaming silver archway, a lustrous golden archway, and a sparking emerald green portal which are set equidistant from each other around the atrium.  A three-armed stone pedestal stands in the center of the chamber, boasting a yellow plate, a red plate, and a blue plate.

title: [Dungeon, Corridor]
description: In stark contrast to the gleaming silver silver archway, this corridor has been made of large, heavy dark stone.  The sturdiness of the walls, however, has not prevented someone or something from burrowing a large hole right into one wall.  Bits of limestone rubble and other debris lie scattered around as testament to this endeavor, creating a bit of a walking hazard.  An elaborate fresco has been painted on the opposite wall, drawing the eye to its bold colors and demented imagery.

title: [Sea of Sacrifice, Shore]
description: In contrast to the smooth stone of the dungeon, the walls of this large cavern are natural limestone.  A large underground lake stretches out before you, bright turquoise and crystal clear in the shallows and intensifying to a deep, dark blue as the lake retreats into the shadows beyond your view.  The pointed stalactites above are reflected in the water's surface like a perfect mirror, giving no evidence of its depth.  The southern wall is punctuated by a freshly excavated hole and an old rust-stained sign.

title: [Dungeon, Corridor]
description: The corridor is a complete mess.  Mounds of dirt and debris lie scattered everywhere and rocks lie haphazardly in hazardous heaps. One of the many supporting columns lining the corridor has fallen and leans diagonally across it at a very precarious angle.  Some of the others have been shaken and do not appear to be very straight, but seem to be secure enough in their positions for the time being.

title: [Dungeon, Corridor]
description: This corridor is massive in size, the ceilings reaching high overhead in a curving arc.  The floor is unblemished and smooth save for some scattered pitted holes and debris.  Occasionally small chunks of rock fall loose from uneven portions of the ceiling to smash down into the floor with loud sounds that echo all over the corridor.

title: [Dungeon, Corridor]
description: You are at the south end of a long, dark corridor.  The passage turns west here.

title: [Dungeon, Landing]
description: A dark haze obscures a large opening in the wall near the bottom of a spiral stairwell, preventing you from seeing through it clearly.  The whole room is dimly lit and unadorned save for a tattered and faded grey banner that hangs forlornly on the wall.

title: [Dungeon, Stairwell]
description: A bright sconce illuminates the top of a spiral stairwell, gently lighting the glistening stone steps that lead down into the darkness below.  The steps look easy enough to traverse, but are slick with moisture and there are no railings to aid someone in case of an unfortunate slip.  A small oaken door off to the side adorned with a heavy iron clacker is the only other method of egress from this small chamber.

title: [Dungeon, Light Room]
description: The chamber is small and cramped, with little room to move about.  A table with a strange contraption sitting on top of it dominates the room, taking up most of the available space.  An unassuming oaken door seems to be the only way in or out of here.

title: [Dungeon, Mana Storm Room]
description: This large, square room seems to have been carefully crafted from fine black marble, down to the trapezoidal doors to the south and west.  Long veins of milky white swirl through the smooth, dark material, giving the entire room the appearance of being in the heart of a mana storm.

title: [Dungeon, Treasure Room]
description: Large iron-bound chests filled to the brim with coins are stacked in a haphazard manner around the room.  Some of the glorious bounty of coins spills out across the floor messily, like a shimmering carpet of discarded wealth before a trapezoidal door.  Precious gems wink and shimmer from amid the gold.  All kinds of fine trinkets and finery lay spread out or in careless piles, hoarded, but uncared for.

title: [Dungeon, Red Corridor]
description: Deep red stone makes up the walls of the corridor.  Sconces give off a warm glow that exaggerates the crimson in the stonework, making the walls appear to run with fresh blood in the shifting light.  There is a simple door set into the wall, unassuming against the stone.

title: [Dungeon, Red Corridor]
description: The stone here is tinged red in hue and streaked with powdery veins of grey.  The walls are unadorned and the floor is bare, leaving the corridor hollow and empty.  You also see a large door.

title: [Dungeon, Grand Staff Room]
description: You are in a large, square room constructed of a cold, grey stone.  The ceiling is remarkably low, and the walls appear coated with some sort of slick substance that glistens in the light.  You also see a stone pedestal in the center of the room with an elaborately crafted staff seemingly jammed upright between the pedestal and the low stone ceiling.

title: [Dungeon, Chamber]
description: The air in this chamber is cool and damp.  In the center of the floor is a sturdy iron grate.  Nothing but darkness can be seen through the slightly rusted bars, but far away, you can hear the sound of rushing water.  Little else is remarkable about the room save for two identical trapezoid-shaped, east and north doors.

title: [Dungeon, Chamber]
description: The faint sound of rushing water rises from the sturdy iron grate set into the center of the floor.  The room is flanked on the north and south by two identical trapezoid-shaped doors.

title: [Dungeon, Sphere Chamber]
description: Strange etchings adorn the walls of this dark stone chamber.  The ceiling is low and dips at odd angles, almost inviting the unwary to strike their heads on the protruding rock.  A trapezoid shaped door is recessed into the rock, almost blending in with its surroundings.

title: [Dungeon, Pit Bottom]
description: The floor here is literally littered with remains.  Bleached white bones stand in stark white contrast to piles of armor and weapons.  Long, stringy webs cover most of the walls.  There is some kind of movement deep within the heavy, obscuring webs.

title: [Dungeon, Pit Bottom]
description: This small chamber has been crudely dug from the surrounding rock.  There are old, broken fingernails and light scratches in the stone around one section of the wall.

title: [Dungeon, Mugwump Lair]
description: The air here is thick with rot and decay and there is some kind of slick, disgusting substance coating the walls that smells absolutely foul.  A bed of sharp twigs and scratchy straw carpets the floor here and feels suspiciously itchy.  A small opening leads back out.

title: [Dungeon, Landing]
description: This room is fairly large.  The wide base of a tall spiral staircase takes up a fair portion of it, looking grand and massive.  The grey stone walls are slick with cool moisture and you can hear the faint dripping sounds of water all around you.

title: [Dungeon, Short Corridor]
description: The corridor is short, divided neatly down the middle by a gaping pit.  It is impossible to see just how deep it is, but it is only about six feet wide, which is a conceivably easy jump for just about anyone.  A wide iron door has been set into the wall well away from the pit, presumably to prevent the unwary from stumbling down into its depths.  There is a strange green portal on the wall opposite the door.

title: [Dungeon, Statue Hall]
description: This corridor is fairly short and straight.  Near the north end it is separated, oddly enough, by a six foot wide pit of indeterminable depth.  An elegant marble statue of some type of humanoid figure occupies a large ornamental niche in the wall.  Aside from that, the corridor is bare and empty.

title: [Dungeon, Short Corridor]
description: The stone floor slopes gently upward here, curving around a corner.  The corridor is lined with little niches that are filled with an old waxy residue where presumably candles were once placed.  Now the niches are filled with dirt and grime, and have been completely neglected.

title: [Dungeon, Corridor]
description: This bit of corridor is an intersection leading off in several different directions.  They look practically identical to one another and there are no markings in this area to let you know which section you may already have traveled through.  A single misstep and it could be quite easy to get lost.

wayto.36440: ;e if !GameObj.loot.any?{|i| i.name =~ /opening/};move('west');move('north');fput 'pull statue';fput 'turn statue';move('south');move('east');end;sleep 0.2 until GameObj.loot.any?{|i| i.name =~ /opening/};move('go opening')

title: [Dungeon, Corridor]
description: The walls in this corridor are riddled with tiny, uneven cracks.  Cold moisture runs down the cool grey stone in slow-moving trickles, sliding slickly toward the ground.

title: [Dungeon, Corridor]
description: This corridor is dark and smells musty.  A light layer of dirt and grime coats the walls and the floor, threatening to dirty anything it touches.  Set into the west wall is an odd, trapezoid-shaped door.

title: [Dungeon, Corridor]
description: The stone walls are streaked from years of seasonal water damage trickling through black dust.  It appears to be a complete dead end here, the wall at the end of the corridor ending abruptly in a blank stone face with a metal grate built into its base.

title: [Dungeon, Guardian Room]
description: An elaborate montage of gold leaf and richly colored paints adorn the heights of the highly vaulted ceiling.  There is a glittering golden archway recessed into the west wall and an open portal leading through to the east.  The most impressive features of this chamber, however, are the two monolithic golden statues of heavily armored warriors on either side of the eastern portal.

title: [Dungeon, Anteroom]
description: The small anteroom, made of standard stonework and wooden beams, is mostly bare and empty, sending eerie, hollow echoes into the adjacent rooms.  A red tapestry, faded and old, is the only adornment in the room, but whatever design was once proudly displayed there has been lost to time.  An open portal leads into a larger chamber to the west.

title: [Dungeon, X Room]
description: This cylindrical room is predominantly occupied by a large stone column directly in the center.  Upon the column is carved a large 'X', while off to the side, attached firmly to the rounded wall, is some sort of plaque.

wayto.36427:
touch x on plaque
go panel

title: [Dungeon, Mirror Mirror]
description: Mirrors protrude from every surface in this chamber.  They come in all shapes and sizes, mounted on the walls, and grouped closely enough together that it seems almost as if you are trapped inside of a giant crystal, shadowed by various frames.   Your image is reflected back at you with enough complexity in every direction to cause feelings of disorientation as you move around.

title: [Dungeon, Corridor]
description: Thin tendrils of silky spiderwebs constantly tease at your skin as you travel this corridor, billowing up and settling back down with every tiny movement you make.  The spiders themselves industriously labor on with the business of making more webs, blissfully ignoring your presence save to move out of your way as you pass.  A portal on the wall, although unusual in design, appears as if it can be opened without too much trouble.

title: [Dungeon, Chamber]
description: You are in a small round chamber.  A dark iron grate is attached to the ceiling and slender chains hang down at odd intervals, ending in various types of tiny, sharp hooks.  Several of the hooks have been adorned with the bodies of rats and other helpless rodents.  They turn slowly in the air as you pass, faces frozen in death.  You also see a great stone slab which seems to be blocking any further progress to the west.

title: [Dungeon, Shaft Room]
description: This small chamber is occupied primarily by a large shaft in the center with handles in four directions.  There is no indication here what it might be used for, but it seems to be in good repair.  A shallow groove on the floor offers a circular pathway around the shaft, presumably to be used by those who would be doing the turning of the device.

title: [Dungeon, Cavern]
description: This chamber appears to be relatively new.  The walls have been roughly carved from the surrounding grey rock in a simple manner with no finishing touches having been added anywhere in sight.  The dull roar of rushing water emanates from the south and water clings to the surface of the walls, making them glisten with moisture.  You also see a rusted metal gate.

title: [Dungeon, Waterfall]
description: This natural limestone cave was created by an underground spring.  The southern wall is covered by a giant sheet of water which cascades from a channel high above, pouring down through a wide fissure.  The waterfall pounds down onto the rocks below, as noisy as it is beautiful.  A manmade passage leads back to the north.

title: [Dungeon]
description: This dim dungeon corridor curves gently from south to west.  The bare stone walls are cold to the touch and slick with a layer of moist condensation.  Thin rivulets of water creep down the face of the walls, dripping slowly to pool on the floor and leave filmy puddles.  Occasionally, a small black beetle scurries across the grey rock floor and slips into a crack in the wall, disturbed by your presence.

title: [Dungeon, Cavern]
description: The narrow corridor curves sharply, making it impossible to clearly see what may be around the corner.  An upper portion of the wall seems to have buckled inward, but it has not collapsed and seems sound enough.  The floor slopes slightly downward, making the gravelly rubble strewn across the floor a slight tripping hazard.  A faint creaking sound can just barely be heard in the distance.

title: [Cavern, Ledge]
description: You stand upon a precipitous ledge overlooking a vast cavern which drops frighteningly into the darkness.  You see a set of three wooden disks, suspended from the ceiling by thick chains, spaced evenly between your ledge and a similar one on the eastern side of the cavern.  With some skill you could probably jump onto the first disk from here.

wayto.36435:
;e waitfor 'The nearest disk, with no one on it, swings near the ledge'
move 'jump disk'

title: [Cavern, Wobbly Disk]
description: You intensely clutch the thick, cold chain which extends from the wobbly disk platform on which you stand to the cavern ceiling above.  Below you is a seemingly endless drop.  As the disk swaps back and forth, it alternately teases you with being near enough to jump to the ledges to the east or west.

wayto.36434:
;e waitfor 'You swing near the western ledge'
move 'jump ledge'
wayto.36436:
;e waitfor 'You swing near the disk to the east', 'The disk to the east swings near'
move 'jump east disk'

title: [Cavern, Wobbly Disk]
description: You intensely clutch the thick, cold chain which extends from the wobbly disk platform on which you stand to the cavern ceiling above.  Below you is a seemingly endless drop.  As the disk swaps back and forth, it alternately teases you with being near enough to jump to the disks to the east or west.

wayto.36435:
;e waitfor 'You swing near the disk to the west', 'The disk to the west swings near'
move 'jump west disk'
wayto.36437:
;e waitfor 'You swing near the disk to the east', 'The disk to the east swings near'
move 'jump east disk'

title: [Cavern, Wobbly Disk]
description: You intensely clutch the thick, cold chain which extends from the wobbly disk platform on which you stand to the cavern ceiling above.  Below you is a seemingly endless drop.  As the disk swaps back and forth, it alternately teases you with being near enough to jump to the disks to the east or west.

wayto.36436:
;e waitfor 'You swing near the disk to the west', 'The disk to the west swings near'
move 'jump west disk'
wayto.36438:
;e waitfor 'You swing near the eastern ledge'
move 'jump ledge'

title: [Cavern, Ledge]
description: You stand upon a precipitous ledge overlooking a vast cavern which drops frighteningly into the darkness.  You see a set of three wooden disks, suspended from the ceiling by thick chains, spaced evenly between your ledge and a similar one on the western side of the cavern.  With some skill you could probably jump onto the first disk from here.

wayto.36437:
;e waitfor 'The nearest disk, with no one on it, swings near the ledge'
move 'jump disk'

title: [Dungeon, Machine Chamber]
description: Some sort of large contraption predominates this room.  Endless gears, levers, and switches make up the confusing device and it looks incredibly solid and heavy.  With no easy to discern the true purpose of the massive machine, its gargantuan bulk fills the room with an odd sort of menace.

title: [Dungeon, Stream Shore]
description: Though this room is manmade, a channel of water runs straight through the center, entering from a tunnel to the south and emptying into another to the north.  The stream does not appear deep, but it is swift.  On the other side, the corridor continues eastward.  You also see a large iron lever positioned in a slot on the wall.

wayto.36419: ;e if !GameObj.loot.any?{|i| i.name =~ /opening/};fput 'pull lever';sleep 0.2 until GameObj.loot.any?{|i| i.name =~ /opening/};end;move('go opening')

title: [Dungeon, Stream]
description: You find yourself walking across the surface of a swiftly flowing stream.  Inexplicably, you do not sink even the slightest bit, but the strong current is rushing you toward the north wall and you find that you must sidestep in order to keep your balance.  It might be best to move as quickly as possible.  You notice several glowing rods which seem to penetrate the surface of the water at the southern end of the tunnel.

You find yourself wading through a waist-deep stream that cuts through this chamber.  The water is numbingly cold and the waters move swiftly, making the going difficult and uncomfortable.  There is a set of rods overhead that drip with moisture as if they have recently been removed from the water.

title: [Dungeon, Chamber]
description: It is not very well lit here, and it smells absolutely terrible.  Tiny piles of dried rodent droppings liberally litter the filthy floor and the thick coating of dust shows the passage of hundreds of little feet.  You can hear high-pitched squeaks and squeals and can almost sense the motion of many small bodies in the darkness.

title: [Dungeon, Chamber]
description: This small chamber is cool and damp.  There are no furnishings in sight and there is barely any light to see by.  The gossamer drape of a neglected spiderweb hangs down from an unlit torch on the wall, thick and heavy with old dust and grime.

title: [Dungeon, Green Tunnel]
description: The walls are thickly coated in some disgustingly smelly substance that glows a strangely luminescent green.  The entire tunnel here is slowly, but perceptibly rotating clockwise, spinning just enough so that one has to slowly step to the side every once in a while in order to properly stand upright.  Barely loud enough to be heard, you can perceive the sound of rock sliding smoothly against rock.

title: [Dungeon, Green Tunnel]
description: The thick, glowing green substance that thickly coats the curved walls drips and glops from top to bottom as the tunnel rotates slowly in a clockwise manner.  A faint, soft grinding is audible above the glopping and squishing of the goo as the tunnel spins around and around on its course.

title: [Dungeon, Green Tunnel]
description: Both the amount and the stench of the luminescent green substance have accumulated at this far end of tunnel.  The tunnel rotates fairly quickly in a clockwise manner, making it very difficult to stand upright.  A faint grating noise can be heard as the tunnel grinds on its course, spinning in a disorienting fashion, around and around.

title: [Dungeon, Warrior Statue]
description: This massive, echoing chamber is made of softly hued yellow stone, a contrast to the sickly hue of the slowly rotating green tunnel to the south, the only obvious exit.  The area is well lit by burning torches resting at regular intervals against the walls, which cast shifting shadows against a large stonework warrior statue that stands occupying the entire forty-foot high northern wall.

title: [Cavern, Ledge]
description: You are precariously perched upon a ledge, the chance encounter of which has saved you from a drop to certain death in the chasm below.  Moving along its length, you realize you could probably make your way back up to the western ledge of the cavern above you.

title: [Field, Exterior]
description: The sounds of rushing water from the spring to the west, the rustle of unseen forest creatures to the north, and an occasional plop, splash and sucking sound from the moat compete for your attention.  The spring's course bends here, disappearing into a thick clump of trees that signals the beginning of a great wood to the north.  Very faintly in the east, you can see pale outlines of peaks.  Dominating the southeast vista, the ruins of the Black Swan hover on the horizon.

The rustle of unseen forest creatures meandering through the trees and the occasional sucking plops and splashes from the disgusting moat subtly vie for your attention.  The spring's course bends here around a solitary modwir tree, disappearing into a thick clump of trees that branch out into the beginning of a dense forest to the north.  To the east, you can faintly see the pale outlines of mountain peaks.  Dominating the southeastern landscape, you can see the ruins of the Black Swan on the horizon.  You also see a rope stretching from the top of a tree and across the moat to the castle.

title: [Field, Exterior]
description: The cool shade and air generated by the dense woods directly north of the path provide a disturbing counterpoint to the uneasy shadow of the high, square keep due south.  Its visage seems to haunt you at every turn, like the sinister gnomon of some giant sundial, ticking off each remaining moment of your mortal life.

title: [Field, Exterior]
description: All along the fetid moat, the upsweeping form of the keep is oppressive, its shadow from the southwest giving no shade or comfort.  The hideous carvings and eaves that mark the upper floors of the Black Swan are evident above the outer walls.  Gargoyles, scaly things, unnamed fell beasts, all squatting atop tiled, upturned roofs at weird angles.

There is no respite from the heat to be had here in the shade of the massive keep.  The building blocks any hint of a breeze, making the air almost unbearably stagnant and warm.  Clouds of gnats rise from the fetid moat, viciously attacking any living thing nearby in a frenzy of voracious hunger.

title: [Field, Exterior]
description: The cool breeze off the mountains in the east offers little respite from the sticky air as you travel along the bank.  The east wing of the castle complex can be discerned, and the pall of the menacing edifice is ever across your path, the jagged gaps atop the ruined outer walls casting sharp, fang-like shadows.  The breeze suddenly shifts, bringing the lapping sounds and rotting water weed smell of the moat to you.  A tall, gaunt structure atop the small hummock due east diverts your attention.

A cool breeze off the mountains to the east offers little respite from the sticky air as you travel along the bank.  Occasionally though, the wind shifts, bringing with it uncomfortable heat and the rotting stench of the castle moat.  The castle stands broken, yet still forbidding in your sight. The jagged gaps atop the ruined outer walls cast sharp, fang-like shadows across your path.  Due east, stands a tall, gaunt structure atop a small hummock.

title: [Field, Exterior]
description: The grassy field widens here, providing a cool spot to rest and a good point to ponder the keep and its mysteries.  Peering out over the moat through the steamy haze above, you can see the entrance and a half-lowered drawbridge.  Below in the moat, small eddies froth and gurgle.  A dilapidated catapult stands forlornly on a clear swath of ground, silent witness to past battles.

The field dips slightly in elevation here and is free of rubble and debris.  The wind gently rustles through the short grass, providing a slightly cooler place for a person to find a moment's rest.  Peering out over the moat through the steamy haze above, it is possible to see the entrance to the castle and the drawbridge.

title: [Field, Exterior]
description: This open area is scented by wafts of air from the south, but the sight of the Black Swan as you gaze upwards drives all but dread from your mind.  The rubble-strewn embankment here circles the outer rim of the moat and completely girds the castle.  Loose stones and mounds of dirt make walking difficult.  The shattered ruins of a drawbridge lay scattered on either side of the moat, leaving an entrance on the other side, but no possible approach.

title: [Field, Exterior]
description: You are due west of the castle and the path runs right along the sharp drop-off of the moat.  You take care not to slide down into the water, as the bank has been eroded or dug away here.  It almost looks like something was clawing at the earth from the water below.  From such close range, the stagnant water looks murky and venomous.  The dark tower in the southwest corner of the castle lies southeast.  The curves of the keep loom northeast.

title: [Field, Exterior]
description: Wiry shrubs and skinny reeds grow along a narrow, swift spring to the west.  A deep crevice to the south and west appears to be its source, and makes further travel in those directions impossible.  From this angle, you can see the round tower above the stone walls of the fortress, scarred and pitted from relentless assaults, and the rusted, half-lowered drawbridge, open as if frozen in one last cry of agony from the throat of the dying Black Swan.

title: [Treetop]
description: You are securely perched on a fork between the trunk and a stout branch of the modwir.  The foliage is thick enough to obscure your view of the countryside.

title: [Field, Exterior]
description: The mountains to the east taper off towards the south, dense underbrush marking the transition between upland and plain.  The east flank of the castle compound, its walls, and the drawbridge over the moat, suspended in mid-air, are visible from the crest of this small hummock.  The skeletal remains of an old catapult, a fossil of some past siege, stand in the center of the high ground.

The mountains to the east gently taper off toward the south with dense underbrush marking the transition between upland and plain.  The eastern flank of the castle compound and the drawbridge are visible from the crest of this small hummock.  The skeletal remains of an old catapult, an aged fossil of some past siege, languish in the center of the high ground.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Moat]
description: You are in a slipstream carrying you just beneath the shadow of the half-lowered, decayed drawbridge.  The bleak, sinister currents are particularly powerful at this, the deepest point in the moat.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Moat]
description: The outer wall of the castle is just beyond your reach as you swim through the turbid waters, intent on staying afloat.  The dark form of the rusted drawbridge is above you, casting greater gloom from the northeast.
The outer wall of the castle rises from the turbid waters life a sheer cliff face.  The dark form of the rusted drawbridge looms precariously overhead, casting greater gloom from the northeast.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Moat]
description: The moat is foul-smelling and seethes with the vapors of decaying vegetation.  Clouds of mosquitos and gnats hover above the surface, making you pause from your strokes to swat them away so you can see.  The water is not very cold, but you feel a chill that is more bone-deep than merited merely by the slight change in temperature.

The foul-smelling moat seethes with the vapors of decaying vegetation.  Thick clouds of mosquitos and gnats hover above the surface, making it difficult to breathe without taking in either a mouthful of water or bugs.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Moat]
description: The scummy green surface of the moat is disturbed slightly here by some vines trailing down the outer wall and dangling into the water.  Though they do not seem very stout, they are firmly anchored to the crumbling black granite by myriads of hairy tendrils.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Moat]
description: Here the moat laps up fast against the steep vertical outer wall of the castle.  The dark stones are slick and slimy with algae, and too smooth to afford any hand-  or footholds.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Moat]
description: Water laps up and through a small grate in the stone wall here which appears to be a remnant of the castle's primitive sanitation system.  While you can grasp the metal bars, they do not seem to yield to force.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Moat]
description: The surface of the moat here is smooth and reflective, like a smoked glass mirror.  You swim along, beguiled by its omninous beauty.  Just beneath your fast-kicking legs, you sense odd, turbulent vibrations welling up from the water's depths.

title: [Emberstone Hall, Workshop]
description: Basalt steps rise toward a passage at one end of this half-subterranean chamber, its walls hewn from the island's dark volcanic stone.  Invar brackets and fittings lend the space a distinctly dwarven character, their red-speckled black surfaces complementing the surrounding rock.  A invar-fitted workbench dominates one wall, flanked by a grinder and polisher, while several sketches of hammer and blade designs have been tacked above it.  A heavy invar-banded door stands opposite the steps.
location: Emberstone Hall (Forge), inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Emberstone Hall, Forge]
description: Heat lingers in this basalt chamber, radiating from a domed brick forge set against the far wall.  A massive invar anvil stands at the room's center, positioned beneath a teardrop-cut amber crystal suspended from a web of fine mithril chains.  A tempering trough rests within arm's reach of the anvil, fed by a copper pipe that runs along the wall.  A shallow eonake-traced niche has been carved into the basalt while a heavy invar-banded door stands opposite the forge.
location: Emberstone Hall (Forge), inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Journey's End, Sanctum]
description: A spacious bath unfolds beneath a glass ceiling, its height and clarity giving the room an open, airy presence.  Tall windows line the walls, framing the space in natural light.  A claw-foot white porcelain tub serves as the focal point, complemented by a slender vanity supporting a stone wash basin beneath a wide mirror.  Set unobtrusively aside are a slatted hamper and a filigree bin.  Woven rugs and simple wooden furnishings add texture, while potted greenery enhances the spa-like atmosphere.

title: [Journey's End, Bedchamber]
description: Pale silk walls give way to a series of large, rounded windows that bathe the room in moonlight.  A massive canopy bed dominates the bedchamber, draped with alabaster gauze, its luxurious silk spread is a sapphire blue embroidered with a silver jacquard pattern.  Covering the floor is a thick shag rug woven with various shades of ivory and fitted into a deep recess on the far wall is a wide mistwood dresser.  Suspended from a silver chain is a beautiful crystal lamp, its surface etched with blooming roses.

title: [Journey's End, Lounge]
description: This expansive lounge feels vast, furnished with deep leather couches paired with mahogany side tables.  Tall curtained windows along the northern wall soften any light that spills in.  A long driftwood bar spans the space in front of the windows.  The eastern wall is claimed by a massive stone fireplace crowned by a thick mantle, while on the opposite wall a dark mahogany double door opens into an adjoining bedchamber.  Polished hardwood floors complement raised-panel wainscoting covering the walls.

title: [Lirafyr Cottage, Kitchenette]
description: Paneled, dark-stained walls enclose this small kitchen; countertops line the eastern wall along with a rhimar-lined box, cooking stove, and sink.  Matching counters make up an island in the center of the room with a silver trashbin resting against it, and a small brass chandelier hangs overhead surrounded by pots and pans.  Through a double-arch to the south is a little breakfast nook with a bay window, while a matching archway to the north leads into a library carved out of the base of the sequoia tree.

title: [Lirafyr Cottage, Library]
description: Entering into the base of the large sequoia tree, the air has a strong, albeit pleasant, scent of fresh cut lumber.  Stairs jut outwards from the timber giant, spiraling upwards into the darkness above, while the remaining spaces have been carved into built-in shelves filled with books.  Completing the cozy room is a large riverstone fireplace imbedded into the northern wall with a dark velvet loveseat settled nearby.

title: [Lirafyr Cottage, Breakfast Nook]
description: Double raised paneling lines the walls of this small room with hand-carvings along the upper trim line, the pattern cascading downwards to eventually fade about mid-way down.  Encroaching the majority of the southern wall is a large bay window, while pressed up against it is a square dinette table with some matching chairs.  Stark in contrast to the otherwise dark wood-paneled room is a pale green door to the east, while a small crystal bar sits in the northeast corner.

title: [Lirafyr Cottage, Bedchamber]
description: The twisting staircase comes to a rest at a platform surrounded by waist-high railing, its posts resembling scaled wings of dragonflies.  Large circular windows encased within the timbered walls of this abode are placed at the north and south, offering views of the surrounding landscape down below.  Situated amongst this floating terrace is a flyrsilk-draped four-poster bed with a red oak armoire standing nearby and a suede divan resting against the southernmost window.

title: [Lirafyr Cottage, Garden]
description: Encircling this small outdoor area is a white picket fence, lining the exterior of the pale barrier are flowering hedges, offering a bit of privacy along with its sweet fragrance.  Standing like soldiers in each corner of the plot are two fruit trees, an apple tree and a fig tree with some oak planters following behind them.  Braced against the exterior wall of the house is a redwood garden lattice, allowing wisteria vines to climb upwards for their blooms to create a waterfall of whites, pinks, and purples.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Way of the Wise]
description: The way narrows through a gem-set golden arch.  Bright golden banners are draped from the walls and overhang the path, each embroidered with a detailed pattern of scrollwork.  Wall sconces holding silver candles are interspersed alongside these banners and light the way.  The floor has been assembled from a series of faded cloudy gemstones, each faintly etched with scrollwork.  Some wide stone benches are arranged before a golden velvet curtain leading inside.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Way of the Wise]
description: Through a golden velvet curtain is a dim space lit by silver candles.  Gilded banners line this alcove as the way aggressively narrows opposite the entry.  At the confluence of these banners and the room's patchwork light, a raised stone dais arrayed with lit candles fronts a gem-set metal statue of a woman studying a scroll stretching from floor to ceiling.  Depicting a long-haired scholar in a flowing gown, additional carved scrolls rest piled at her feet.

title: [Nucky's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A narrow glass-topped table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Citizen Lounge]
description: Sunlight bathes the octagonal lounge in hues of green and blue as it filters through the stained glass skylight overhead.  Several white trellises boasting varieties of clematis vines span across seven of the room's walls, leaving the one with a blue tanik door otherwise bare.  Surrounding a bed of goblin gold moss are multiple flyrsilk pillows in various sizes and hues arranged in a chaotic array as they line the floor.

title: [All About That Lace]
description: Ribbon-forged lengths of mixed metals trace across the silk-curtained walls of the room, the thin-wired pieces creating a latticework between the rounded windows interspersed between the shop wares.  A clear-lacquered violetwood rack stands in the middle of a verdant-colored rug, its thin, splayed branches curled slightly upwards to cradle several nest-shaped bowls of clay and terracotta.  Swirls of colorful paint cover the wood-planked floor below, set beneath flora-shaped lanterns.

title: [All About That Lace, Workroom]
description: Ceiling-high shelves line the lace-covered walls of the workroom, the fine-grained containers filled with folded articles of clothing, the garments also draped across several mannequins nestled in each corner.  A multi-tiered display of metal and wood stands at the center of the room, filled with various baubles caged in bowls of colorful blown glass.  Lengths of jewel-toned fabric are suspended above the display, the swathes wrapped with mixed metal chains and strips of oiled leather.

title: [Artistic Expressions]
description: Iron-framed panes of stained glass illuminate the mirror-tiled display surrounded by wired sculptures covered in sheets of blank canvas set upon a pedestal of jade-veined marble.  Kaleidoscopic ribbons of silk drape in a loose lattice across the curved roof of the wagon, the lengths suspending blown glass droplets filled with vibrantly colored paint.  Affixed across the mural-painted back wall are a series of paint-covered buckets and pails, the sticks nestled in beds of tumbled marbles.

title: [Artistic Expressions, Backroom]
description: Wood-framed canvases cover the walls of the shop, their surfaces splattered with vivid paints applied by both brushes and hands, the floor below them speckled in a rainbow of color.  Triangular shelves are affixed at the corners of the room, each one filled with a variety of wares scattered between glass jars of paint and pots of dark-colored ink.  Slivers of light cut through a stained glass dome set high above, casting kaleidoscopic shadows across the wooden planks.

title: [The Bee's Knees]
description: Potted flowers crafted from vellum and silk trace the periphery of the jadewood-planked floor, the wide terracotta vessels vibrant against the sky blue linens draped across the wooden framework.  A gilded honeyed oak beehive stands perched upon a counter of leaf-etched faenor, the wares highlighted by the tiny bee-shaped lanterns suspended across the beams.

title: [Better in the Saddle]
description: Brass-forged hooks and log-hewn racks frame the periphery of the expansive shop, the saddles showcased beside oversized toys depicting various mounts caught in fanciful poses.  Crossed wooden lances are affixed above the evenly spaced displays and counters, the roof above suspending brightly colored banners crafted from embroidered wool and silken fringe.

title: [Bowl Me Over]
description: The walnut-paneled walls of the wool-curtained shop are decorated in framed parchment recipe cards, the black-inked calligraphy flanked by herb-carved racks painted in shades of green and sepia.  Fragrant spice-filled jars are interspersed across the oiled wooden counters, each parchment-labeled container displayed on one of the stacks of leathery cook books.

title: [Bowl Me Over, Backroom]
description: Rope-hung canvases are spaced between the oiled wooden shelves affixed to the periphery of the shop, the colorful artwork depicting various cuisines labeled in ornate calligraphy.  Neat stacks of colorful recipe cards lay across an elongated maedatha-draped counter, the parchment arranged between wide vases filled with cutlery and dried flora.

title: [Breaking Bread]
description: Tall stacks of burlap bags partially block the iron-framed windows of the shop, the wood-planked floor below them covered in a dusting of various flours and oats.  A riveted oak half-barrel sits to the side of a long marble-topped counter, its pristine surface interspersed with folded cloths and oiled stone bowls alongside several vellum-paged tomes.  Set against the back wall is a ceiling-high canvas sketched with an oversized loaf of bread alongside several notes listing the individual components.

title: [Call of the Wild]
description: Leafy fronds of verdant-colored leather drape across the bamboo-lined walls of the shop, partially shading the glass-paned enclosures interspersed between colorful terracotta pots.  Open cages of twisted brass wire are suspended at each of the corners, filled with grass-like shreds of wheat-colored threads and scraps of velvet spilling down across the tiled floor.  A scattering of well-worn pillows sit along the edges of the room, each one topped with a thick blanket of embroidered wool.

title: [Claws and Effect, Entry]
description: Russet and beige canvas billows gently overhead, the thick material sheltering the space from the bite of alpine air.  Ironwood tables line either side of the entry, their surfaces covered with bright blue cloths that showcase the offered wares, while copper-bound pale oak trunks stand open near a central post.  Pendant lanterns dangle from the support beams, casting pools of painted light across the thick rugs scattered underfoot.  Several braziers glow warmly throughout, warding off the mountain chill.

title: [Claws and Effect, East]
description: Canvas in russet and beige stretches overhead, enclosing this portion of the pavilion in muted warmth.  Copper-bound pale oak trunks and woven yucca frond baskets fill much of the space, the latter opened wide to display their contents.  Smaller braziers of hammered copper are lofted on iron brackets, their elevated flames casting a diffuse and even glow down across the thick rugs underfoot while also keeping the alpine chill well at bay.

title: [Claws and Effect, Shadow Side]
description: Wares crowd every surface of the pavilion's back wall, filling ironwood tables, copper-bound pale oak trunks, and woven yucca frond baskets in equal measure.  Pendant lanterns range along the northern edge while hammered copper braziers stand lofted on iron brackets along the eastern, their combined glow and warmth creating a blend of color and light that settles across the forest green rugs laid thickly across the ground.

title: [Creative Couture]
description: Ivy garlands are intertwined with strands of paper-cut flora and lengths of jewel-crafted insects, the decorative chains radiating outwards from a perforated starburst chandelier illuminating the room.  A grouping of wire-framed mannequins are framed by a duo of bronze-riveted containers, their leather surfaces branded in a variety of stylized fauna.  The subtle scent of bourbon and pink lavender permeates the shop, the tendrils of smoke traversing from a crescentic censer nestled in the far corner.

title: [Creative Couture, Interiors]
description: Honeycomb-crafted shelves are interspersed across the ivy-strewn walls, the mixed woods covered with decorative pieces spaced between tiny fauna carved from soapstone.  A low wooden platform stands at the center of the room, encircled by terracotta pots and vessels of colorful stained glass.  Set against the back wall is a tiled mosaic of a rotund capybara, the lackadaisical mammal sitting in a flourishing orangery alongside a small nightjar.

title: [Dessert Vibes, Confectionary]
description: The room is of simple, makeshift construction, with a driftwood floor and a vaulted ceiling.  The room is also exceptionally colorful, with all surfaces painted in a riotous landscape of bright hues.  A desert vista graces the walls, with sea green cacti sprouting forth from magenta sands. The sky, drawn into the ceiling in peacock blue, is set in perpetual morning, with a violet sun over a painted wooden door flanked by azure clouds.  Above the sun, a broad sign is nailed to the wall.

title: [Dessert Vibes, Confectionary]
description: The walls are predominantly two-toned and depict a desert landscape, with emerald green sands painted beneath a pale violet sky.  At the horizon where the colors change, silver clouds with black-painted winking expressions further decorate the walls.  In the room's middle, a series of tangerine-hued driftwood crates and a series of silver-hued driftwood boxes are arranged to display wares.  A glaesine orb serves as a lantern for the shop, hung in the room's middle and casting a flickering light.

title: [Dessert Vibes, The Drop]
description: Small and flat-bottomed, the room is a small hole that looks like it was roughly dug out, with uneven walls and small piles of clay-rich dirt off to the sides.  Stuck into the walls at the ceiling are several long bamboo poles which dangle large hard candy sculptures.  Haphazardly arrayed across the dirt floor are a series of red and white candy-striped burlap pillows.  A broad driftwood sign hands askew on the wall, loosely nailed into the dirt.  Several votives placed along the room's edges light the hole.

title: [Dhu Impress, Silk Garden]
description: Panels of pastel silk are stitched together to form a colorful, oversized sunshade protecting this opensided haon stall and the eye-delighting wares displayed here.  Amid the flower presses and journals set out on a couple of tables, vases are filled with fresh flowers that bring the outdoors inside with their bright blossoms and sweet fragrances.  Sunlight pours in, adding a cheerfulness to the cozy setting.

title: [Diminishing Demises]
description: Heat radiates from a grand limestone fireplace, its carved mantle adorned with swirling motifs of waves and celestial bodies.  An enruned shadowglass obelisk rises from the center of the room, its polished surface inscribed with intricate glyphs that shimmer in the shifting light.  Windows capped with keyhole arches line the western wall, their stained-glass patterns casting rippling reflections across the smooth stone floor.  Shadows dance, caught between the flickering fire and fractured light.

title: [Fryc and Shives Laboratories]
description: An iron-framed dome of stained green and blue glass casts dancing beams of light across the clay-tiled floor of the vestibule, illuminating the gilded aragless set into each tile.  Wood-crafted clocks dominate the planked walls, the available space between the duo of mahogany doors covered in brass-pinned sheets of parchment scrawled in dark ink.  A gear-fused, mixed-metal automaton stands at the center of the room, the mechanical device covered in a coating of thin oil and grease.

title: [Chitinous Creations, Common]
description: Thick iron-linked chains suspend a myriad of glass lanterns above the room, highlighting the oiled mahogany platforms staggered against the parchment-covered walls.  Tall multi-drawer chests frame each mechanical mount, the slightly ajar containers filled with wrenches, pliers, and other polished instruments alongside copper flasks filled with oil.  Sets of ring-bound instructions hang from a clockwork-framed corkboard, the various booklets written in a variety of languages.

title: [Chitinous Creations, Uncommon]
description: Miniature prototypes of the mechanical mounts are suspended high above their true-sized counterparts, the fine-grained mahogany platforms affixed with brass plaques written in a variety of languages.  Iron-hooked tools are neatly arranged across the back wall, the hammers and wrenches placed well within reaching distance to the walnut worktable nestled in the far corner.  Cylindrical pipes adorn the available wall space, the riveted pieces occasionally emitting tiny puffs of floral-scented steam.

title: [Eight-Legged Innovators, Common]
description: Motes of multicolored light hang suspended before several rune-carved mahogany platforms, casting colorful shadows across the mechanical mounts perched on the elevated stands.  Graduated glass flasks and bottles line the iron-forged racks on the surrounding walls, the surrounding slate tiles covered in calligraphic strokes of chalk outlining varying instructions.  A short wooden ladder stands in the corner of the room, the trio of rungs decorated in glistening webs.

title: [Innovators, Uncommon]
description: Glass-crafted cauldrons serve as lanterns for the velvet-covered platforms at the center of the room, each vessel engulfed in a webwork of aragless illuminating the sigil-carved floor.  A labyrinth of mixed-metal pipes covers the rear wall, the hammered tubes extending into a series of spigots spread across a stone-set worktable, its surface decorated in grimoires and suede-spined manuals covered in complex mathematics.  An arachnid-shaped clock adorns the far upper corner, nestled in a web of thin wires.

title: [Office of Alchemist-Mages]
description: Brass-framed pieces of slate cover the velvet-draped walls of the office, their rectangular surfaces linked by threadlike webs of silk scattered with tiny clockwork spiders.  Glass-filled racks of cork-stoppered bottles and jars are placed along the periphery of the office, the components framed by tall bookcases crafted from petrified roots.  A tri-legged iron cauldron sits amongst a bevy of scrolls and leathery grimoires, the ingredients scattered across the marbled surface of an ebonwood table.

title: [Office of Engineers]
description: Elongated sheets of parchment unfurl across the wood-planked walls of the office, the charcoal-sketched surfaces connected by thread-strung pins wrought into brass-winged beetles.  The tall mahogany bookshelves are overstuffed in a variety of leather-bound tomes and folios marked with strips of copper wire and scraps of velvet.  A rectangular glass lantern sits partially buried upon the well-oiled walnut table, wedged between the stacks of finely inked vellum and tool-filled rolls of brushed suede.

title: [Honeyed Gears, Entry]
description: Steam coils lazily from unseen vents as bursts of metallic clinks and candy-sweet fizzles echo through the cluttered space.  Diagrams flap along the walls, barely holding fast under tacks bent from overuse.  A disorganized pile of metallic cylinders dominates the corner, surrounded by half-finished contraptions and sugar-encrusted tools strewn across every surface.

title: [Honeyed Gears, Backroom]
description: Cool lamplight casts gentle shadows across polished floors and pristine surfaces.  Shelves, each flawlessly aligned, display labeled containers and gear-lined cases.  Near the far wall, a smooth walnut writing desk gleams beneath perfectly stacked folios, its drawers closed flush.  The faint scent of ginger and old ink lingers like a quiet promise of precision.

title: [Insurmountable]
description: Providing shade from the sun, a bright red awning stretches wide across the short wall where the wagon opens into the grounds.  Opposite the entry, a small window looks out over the rider's seat, its worn wooden frame allowing air to pass freely through the space.  Along the length of the wagon, several wall-mounted racks and floor-to-ceiling shelves line both walls, neatly holding two distinct styles of saddles, their leathers ranging from pale, sun-bleached tones to darker, oil-rich finishes.

title: [Moody Jewels]
description: This modest boutique has been fashioned into a small theater of sorts.  Atop a simple elevated stage, a pair of expressive mannequins model an array of jewelry for sale.  One mannequin broods, his head drooped low, while the second mannequin struts jauntily, limbs posed as if midstride.  A simple notice hangs pinned to the tent's black canvas walls, calling your attention.

title: [Palette Perfections]
description: Chemicals linger in the air, the sharp tang of crushed pigments mingling with the sweetness of drying oils.  Large windows with keyhole arches filter light through leaded stained glass, casting shifting hues across an alabaster counter marred with spills of ochre, indigo, and madder root.  A half-finished mural blooms across stucco walls, swirling between rough sketches and vibrant detail.  Beakers and ceramic bowls clutter a side table, their contents shimmering in pools of liquid sapphire, burnt sienna, and deep viridian.

title: [Pitcher Perfect]
description: Deep wine red canvas drapes in gentle folds, casting a warm glow over the cozy interior.  A sturdy wooden counter, its surface stained by years of contact with fruits and spices, stretches across the space, while baskets filled with fruit rest nearby.   Hanging lanterns sway overhead, their amber light flickering over the gleaming wine-bowls and goblets that line the mahogany shelves along the tent's curved walls.

title: [Song Sung Blue, Entry]
description: Woad-blue canvas walls curve upward to a ceiling where branches are lashed into place, their surfaces tangled with trailing vines that gather near the tent's crown like a living canopy.  Cauldron-topped braziers glow at measured intervals, the heated water within filling the air with steam and humid warmth.  Verdant wool rugs spread across the ground in mimicry of grass, while carved hollows cradle carefully woven nests.  Resting near a chain-strung dark woad blue flap, an ornate gilded perch is surrounded by a bit of mist and loose feathers.

title: [The Webs We Weave]
description: Verdant suede-leafed foliage decorates the honeycomb-cut bronze cabinets angled in various corners of the shop, the wall-high partitions interconnected by a series of nakheva-woven webs.  A rectangular table of desert ironwood graces the far wall, its fine-grained surface lined with clusters of jewel-crafted bouquets arranged in riverglass vases.

title: [The Webs We Weave, Alcove]
description: Oversized leather-woven webs are suspended at various lengths along the wood-paneled ceiling, the latticed lengths decorated by gauze ribbons dyed in rich jewel tones.  Arranged in each corner are grass-framed clusters of glass flowers, the colorful blossoms each set within a stone-crafted circle formed of loosely stacked pebbles.

title: [Straight and Arrow]
description: Heavy iron filigree supports set with small candle cups frame the pale grey silk sidewalls of this domed octagonal shop.  Bright sunlight filters through the thin fabric and the open doorway.  A small carved haon rack displays several fletching razors, and a nearby blue thanot case features a variety of colorful feathers that can be trimmed to adorn arrows.  Fragrant boughs of bay laurel twined with draping clusters of violet wisteria loop from strut to strut in a scalloping valance.

title: [Ursine Emporium, Entry]
description: Lamplight casts a soft glow across the interior of the sprawling tent, where violet canvas panels meet niveous ones in sweeping drapes overhead.  Pale rugs in varied textures are scattered across the packed earth, muffling footsteps.  Along the walls, carved wooden racks and padded stands display an array of gear sized for bears, including harnesses, layered fabrics, polished fittings, and ornate tack, each arranged with care beneath the gentle shimmer of hanging lanterns.

title: [Ursine Emporium, Back Room]
description: Partitioned by a drape of heavy violet canvas, the backroom is quieter than the entry room of the shop, its corners touched by the steady glow of low-burning lamps.  Niveous shelves line the walls, holding spools of dyed leather, bolts of thick fabric, and shallow trays filled with polished metal fittings.  A central worktable bears signs of recent use, with chalk markings, loose threads, and measuring cords strewn across its surface.  The air carries the scent of wax, wool, and well-oiled hide.

title: [Ursine Paddock, Entry]
description: Rough-hewn fencing of arctic pine surrounds a wide, trampled yard speckled with tufts of shedding fur.  Sunlight filters through drifting clouds, glinting against claw-scored wood and frozen earth.  Bears of various sizes shift between idle pacing and resting near shallow feeding troughs.  Carved totems are featured in each corner of the paddock, their worn surfaces etched with iconography unique to their post.

title: [Central Paddock, Uncommon]
description: Flattened earth forms a wide circular clearing at the paddock's center, its surface stamped with broad pawprints and drag marks from heavy bodies.  A ring of upright logs surrounds a low platform of stone and pine, its surface stained from years of use.  Empty harness frames and iron stirrups hang from pegs embedded in the platform's edges, swaying gently in the wind.

title: [Uvaldov's Pinions and Cogs]
description: Gears, cogs, and pinions are worked throughout the interior of this heptagonal stall, and it is unclear if the multitude of gizmos and gadgets provide any useful function to the integrity of its structure.  A crooked brass clockwerke table disjointedly follows alongside four of the walls, displaying a variety of weapons.  Dangling from the angular ceiling, seven lanterns glow brightly with green-yellow phosphorescent luminescence.

title: [Virelion Hall, Nook]
description: Shadows gather in the corners of the narrow cranny, kept at bay by a single brass wall sconce, the flame burning low and steady.  One wall is given over entirely to velvet-lined niches, arranged in neat rows from the stone floor to the gently arched ceiling.  Densely filled with faded rows of names and dates, a leatherbound ledger lies open on a slanted writing surface against the back of the recess.

title: [Wax Poetic]
description: Leafy garlands of cire lace florals drape along the upper beams of the arched wagon, the vibrantly colored flowers gathered in ribbon-tied loops.  A honeycomb-shaped display stands at the center of the shop, flanked on either side by a pair of comically large statues of plump honeybees caught in dramatic poses, each insect dusted in gold and amber glitter.

title: [Sunscar Sanctum, Apex Awning]
description: Tall drakar pillars rise in a loose ring, supporting a sandy brown awning that traps an uncomfortably dry warmth beneath it.  Heat from large braziers flanking the paddock entries scorches the ground to brittle shades of yellow and brown, where grass gives way to dry, patchy earth.  Beyond the awning's edge, late snow clings to the meadow, while east and west, enormous scorpions roam within paddocks.

title: [Sunscar Sanctom, Common Paddock]
description: Blackened iron fencing encloses the broad paddock, its bars set deep into the ground and rising in stark lines around the open space.  Great braziers stand at each corner, their steady flames casting waves of heat across the enclosure.  Within, the ground lies dry and trampled, the last traces of grass worn to brittle patches as the enormous scorpions roam freely beneath the open sky.

title: [Sanctum, Uncommon Paddock]
description: Blackened iron fencing encloses a broad paddock, its bars driven deep and rising in stark lines around the open space.  Great braziers burn at each corner, their heat drying the ground to brittle patches where grass once grew.  Along the far edge, a low outcropping of stone breaks the uniformity of the enclosure, its surface worn smooth by wind and age.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Great Hall]
description: Beyond the threshold, the tower opens into a circular chamber of cold stone.  A spiraling stone staircase of the same ancient building blocks as the walls winds upward from the center, coiling patient and deliberate toward the floors above.  An iron railing traces the circumference, and behind it the curved walls rise in bookshelves, broken only by an open stone-ringed archway.  Iron candelabras ring the stairs, their candles casting a low amber light that deepens the shadows rather than drives them out.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Office]
description: Windowless and ancient, the chamber sits sealed against the outer world, its thick stone walls muffling exterior noises.  Alcoves set into the stone cradle glowing orbs and glass-shielded lanterns, filling the room with pale light.  A heavy carpet cushions the floor, and an enormous cobblestone fireplace holds the damp and cold at bay.  Small workspaces are scattered without order throughout, as if the chamber has long answered to many.  Rough-hewn stone frames an open stone-ringed archway leading into the tower beyond.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Second Floor]
description: White stone walls rise bare along the second level, broken only by wrought iron sconces shaped like curling vines that cradle softly glowing candles and an open door set within smooth masonry.  At center, a spiraling staircase of pale wood treads and cobbled stone risers winds both up and down, a slender iron railing tracing its curve as it dips into shadow below and climbs toward the third level.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Laboratory]
description: Cool air spills through shuttered windows set deep into the stone, their panels drawn wide to reveal the frost-bound landscape of Summit Academy.  Long worktables crowd the space, cluttered with glass alembics, stained vials, and scorched instruments marked by years of trial.  At one end, a low hearth, when lit, aids in pushing back the deep chill of the air that seeps through the open windows.  Covering the stone floor, a worn rug lies mottled with old burns and faint chemical stains.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Third Floor]
description: Plum velvet drapes sweep along a third of the curved wall, their folds gathered in heavy arcs that soften the stone, while the remaining span is carved into recessed shelving lined with neatly arranged volumes and small curios.  At center, a spiraling stone staircase continues its ascent, pale wood and cobbled stone turning upward toward the fourth level as its iron railing glints in the ambient light.  Flickering light dances along the descending steps, slipping around the curve before fading into shadow.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Bed Chamber]
description: Broad windows set deep within pale stone are flanked by sturdy shutters and framed in heavy, dark velvet drapes that fall in straight, weighty lines.  Near the far wall, a low hearth rests within a carved limestone surround, ready to lend warmth when lit to the otherwise austere space.  A dark four-poster bed of dark wood rests beneath a woven throw in muted earth tones, while a small cedar chest of sticks and saddle stand sit nearby.  Opposite, a zydris-framed painting captures a powerful horse in motion, its form rendered with precision.

title: [Spire, Fourth Floor Landing]
description: Set upon a wide landing, a small study has been arranged, its stone kept clean and free of dust, lending the space a quiet sense of care.  Slender arrow-slit windows fitted with panes of sky blue and silver glass filter soft, shifting light across a delicate writing desk and wooden stool.  Fine nicks still mark the frame of the door that stands opposite, though their edges have been smoothed with age and use.  Nearby, a spiraling stone staircase winds both up and down, vanishing into shadow below even as it rises toward the next level.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Bed Chamber]
description: Soft light filters through narrow windows, settling across a bedchamber arranged with deliberate care.  Along one wall, a painted mural stretches wide, depicting a grove of surita trees rising from a winter-wrapped mountainside, their pale trunks and dark boughs standing against drifting snow and distant peaks.  A low bed of pale wood rests nearby, dressed in layered textiles of soft blue and silver, while a low hearth sits ready to warm the space when lit.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Fifth Floor]
description: At rest, a dusty suit of platemail stands balanced against the greatsword it holds point-down before it, its surface kept clean and free of dust.  Across from the armor, a faint chill lingers around an open door, cool air slipping quietly into the space.  Nearby, a spiraling stone staircase winds both upward and downward, continuing toward the sixth level while fading into shadow below.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Bed Chamber]
description: Dim light presses through tightly shuttered windows, leaving the chamber in muted shadows.  Sheets of draped cloth cover most furnishings, their folds tucked close as if prepared for long storage.  Along one wall, unlabeled crates are stacked in careful rows, their surfaces clean and undisturbed.  A low bed rests beneath its covering nearby, its mattress tightly rolled and bound with heavy straps.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Conical Summit]
description: Exposed rafters support a conical roof of fresh thatch, its structure rising overhead and lending the space a warm, rustic scent.  Wide windows stand open to the surrounding grounds, letting in clean air and unbroken views of the grounds beyond the tower.  At center, a hot-bellied cast iron stove rests upon a stone pad, its curved chimney snaking upward along the wall before disappearing through the roof.  Nearby, a spiraling stone staircase descends only, its curve dropping away into the levels below.

title: [The Vengeful Siren, Docking]
description: The glaesineth-enclosed deck has a small door leading out and a brass-edged koa gangplank climbing up to a second-story door.  Small openings at the top of each wall let in the sea air, and their transparent nature allows an unfettered view of the dunes and ocean.  An anchor-topped coil of hempen rope sits neatly in one corner, the anchor polished to a high sheen.  Painted onto the artfully sea-weathered wood of the wall is "Welcome to the Vengeful Siren!" with a brass ship's bell hanging next to it.

title: [The Vengeful Siren, Main Cabin]
description: Several small bull's-eye windows set at regular intervals line the outer walls, each outlined in gleaming brass.  The area resembles a ship's cabin, complete with an aperture leading to the west, and a silver and brass hatch with a discreet teak ladder in the ceiling.  Centered over a rattan couch is a narra-framed oil painting, and a sextant hangs next to a highly figured koa door.  Intricate marquetry in koa, teak, mahogany, and narra depicts a giant kraken in the middle of the floor.

title: [The Vengeful Siren, Stern]
description: Sunlight reflects off the gleaming brass railing lining the spacious, pointed balcony, and a sturdy koa and brass telescope occupies a break in the railing at the far point, allowing it to swivel across both island and sea.  Hanging from the wall on one side of the aperture leading inside is a carved ivory dart board.  A lacquered koa cupboard rests beneath it, a frosted glass pitcher on top pushed into the shade.  The humidity hangs heavy in the air, the tang of salt on the nigh-perpetual ocean breeze.

title: [The Vengeful Siren, Galley]
description: Awash in sunlight, the cozy galley is comprised of light-hued, polished wood flooring with cheerful whitewashed walls featuring ocean blue accents.  A wave-etched white stone basin sits beneath a seaglass mosaic depicting the island, and a small kitchen table is positioned near an oversized brass and koa pantry.  A narrow-tipped balcony filled with greenery is visible through a koa-inlaid glass door.

title: [Vengeful Siren, Captain's Cabin]
description: This room encompasses the entire third story of the building, with bull's-eye windows perfectly aligned along the length and two large picture windows on either end looking down upon the second-story balconies.  One side comprises the sleeping area, with a carved narra bed and a koa wardrobe, and the other a sitting room of sorts with a nacre-inlaid teak desk and several chairs around a riverstone fireplace.  Scattered across the polished koa and teak floor are several lamps and a few handwoven carpets, with a silver and brass hatch by one wall.

title: [Sarowyn's Outfitting]
description: The broad sweep of the wooden floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the polished oak walls.  A narrow glass-topped table and a simple wooden shelf are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [The Best Defence]
description: Polished oak walls rise from a polished oak floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and a vaulted ceiling completes the picture.  A glass-covered box case and a wide knotted oak counter stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Emporium of the Silver Veil]
description: Cozy and tidy, the shop is illuminated by sunlight that filters through a trio of stained glass skylights set between the exposed beams of the ceiling.  Olivewood stretches across the ground, the richly grained planks supporting a tall sephwir bookcase housing various trinkets and baubles.  It stands opposite a furrowed and knotted olivewood counter that is lacquered to a glossy sheen and inlaid with cerulean resin.  Near the massive laje-inset olivewood door is a sephwir-framed chalkboard decorated in a flowing script.

title: [Goat Couture]
