description: A dark modwir bookshelf rests against a pale maple wall, its top shelf filled with booklets bearing gold, platinum, and sanguine foil covers, each stamped with "DA" on their spines.  Hanging from a modwir ceiling is a rectangular black chalkboard displaying asking prices for the booklets, with imperfect erasures suggesting frequent price changes.  A polished maple counter rests along the opposite wall with an ornately woven red rug covering a pale maple floor, completing the room's decor.

title: [Skyship, Storage]
description: Tall wooden crates evenly line the area and are pressed up against the metal bulkheads.  Some are open-topped and contain armaments, including metal swords, shields, and varying pieces of heavy armor.  Others visibly overflow with more mundane supplies, from animal pelts to bolts of thick cloth to bundled wooden cords.  Above these crates, broad ropes dangle from numerous metal hooks, with some of these ropes remaining attached to individual crates to aid movement.

title: [Skyship, Triage]
description: A bare, pale ash grey stone floor is lined with rectangular leather sheets that appear to be covering large, humanoid bodies.  A series of paths is open in the rows between the bodies, allowing for access to every corner of the area.  Each of the sheets is dyed jet black, with the color concealing any imperfections or discolorations in the leather.  A large wooden panel attached to one of the bulkheads overlooking the scene is streaked with hundreds upon hundreds of thin crimson tally marks.

title: [Skyship, Assembly]
description: A wide area is bare of decoration with two notable exceptions.  On the grey-blue metal bulkheads, a series of banners hangs prominently.  Woven from bright threads and in pristine condition, these banners are of varying sizes and shapes.  Each banner exhibits a custom patterning of colorful pictograms, as if relying on them to tell their stories.  On the stone floor, dozens upon dozens of small, bright white circles have been painted in tight rows, each wide enough for a large individual to stand within

title: [Skyship, The Sands]
description: Lines of black wooden benches flank long, horizontal strips of packed sand across a stone floor.  Colored a bright vermillion and sectioned off with bright white paint, the sand is also splotched with darker flecks of long-dried crimson that similarly dot the adjacent benches.  Above, a series of lanterns are placed in suspended cages, casting the area in a perpetual, ethereal glow.

title: [Skyship, The Circles]
description: A blue-grey floor covers the area, its surface a gritty and unpolished stone.  The bulkheads are of a matching hue to the floor, but made instead of a smooth metal.  Circles of packed dirt and sand are intermittently spaced across the area, each with a scuffed leather training dummy erected in its center.  These sand circles are covered with crimson splatters of varying patterns, all long-dried.

title: [Skyship, The Cages]
description: Metal cages hang suspended from the ceiling along the bulkheads of the room.  The metal used to forge these cages appears uneven and rough, with visible, sharp protrusions densely placed across their interiors. Some of these cages are empty, but others contain remains in various states of decay.  Symbols are faintly scratched into the metal bulkheads alongside these cages, but most have faded beyond recognition.

title: [Skyship, Muster]
description: A broad ruined tunnel opens across the room's eastern edge.  Before the debris-cluttered opening, a straight, bright vermillion line has been drawn.  On the tunnel's side of the line, the floor is made from a highly polished, immaculate white stone.  On the opposite side, a dirt and sand mix is uneven, hard-packed in places and disturbed by footfalls in others.  These sands are further marred with broad and dark crimson splotches.

title: [Skyship, Deep Chambers]
[Skyship Lift]
description: A heavy metal gate seals the elevator opening, its surface covered in thick, vivid silver-white symbols that look freshly painted despite the ship's age.  The platform beyond is polished white stone, immaculate except for a single crimson handprint smeared near the center.  Along the gate's frame, tiny glaesine studs glow faintly, brightening when the elevator aligns with a floor and dimming when it departs.

A single lantern hangs above the platform, suspended in a black iron cage and filled with ashen white light that never flickers.  A ring of burnt parchment scraps has been pressed into the floor's seams, trapped beneath a thin glaze of hardened resin.  When the elevator rises, loose ash lifts in a slow halo around your ankles, swirling like a small storm that refuses to settle.

The room is a metal square, with no discernable pathways in the bulkheads leading out.  A constant, droning whir of large machinery echoes from behind these bulkheads, but its exact source is unseen.  Pale silver-white runes are painted across the floor, all alight with a faint magical glow.  A series of lanterns hangs from the ceiling, casting crisscrossing shadows across the area.

The elevator floor is a thick metal grating, the gaps beneath revealing a hollow drop littered with dried debris and dark stains.  At the platform's edges, shallow trenches catch runoff and funnel it toward circular drains stamped with simple stick-figure pyrography.  When the elevator moves, a wet, sucking echo rises from below, as if the shaft itself breathes.

A long recess in the wall reveals a counterweight assembly: a stacked column of bone and stone bound in iron bands, rising and falling behind a grated screen.  The bones are mismatched, humanoid ribs alongside thicker animal femurs, each stained a dull, old brown as if soaked in smoke.  A single skull is fixed to the grate at eye level, its teeth painted vermillion like a warning.

title: [Skyship, Living Corridor]
description: A long corridor stretches into the distance.  The air is stale and hot, and the smell of sweat and body odor are pervasive.  Chalk and wax-drawn pale white runes accent the bulkheads, lit by lanterns suspended from the ceiling that sway with the ship's movement.  Small alcoves ae sectioned off by thin wooden walls along the corridor's length, each fitted with a rope netting bed and with room enough for one large individual to stand.

title: [Skyship, Living Corridor]
description: Metal pipes run the length of the ceiling and resonate with faint reverberations.  The bulkheads are undecorated and are grooved at their base by thin trenches fitted with small, circular grated drains at even intervals.  Organic debris clutters the trenches, as if it had been swept aside and left to rot.

title: [Skyship, Living Corridor]
description: The corridor is lined by metal shelves attached floor-to-ceiling onto the bulkheads.  Some books are placed on the shelves, but far more are scattered across the floor, their torn pages rustling as air moves down the path.  Thick metal benches are set along the corridor, placed in sections with gaps in the shelving, also covered with books.  Tomes and parchment in varying states of deterioration surround these benches in large piles, as if they had been indiscriminately shoved out of the way.

title: [Skyship, Living Corridor]
description: The air is humid and rank with the smell of blood and decay down a cluttered corridor that has been repurposed into a series of hastily built fortifications.  Sleeping alcoves to either side of the area have been emptied, their contents stacked haphazardly along the way forward as piles of trunks, overturned empty crates, and varied loose debris.  Some humanoid remains are scattered across the area, half-buried under debris and stuck with dried blood.

title: [Skyship, Living Corridor]
description: The corridor widens slightly here into an oval shape and the smell of sweet smoke lingers in the air.  In the oval's center, a stone fire pit is placed on top of the metal floor.  Ash and charred bits of wood litter the pit, which is further cluttered by organic debris.  Open-topped empty wooden barrels and wooden crates line the bulkheads.  Above these containers, dried meats and cloth sacks hang from metal hooks attached to the bulkheads.

title: [Skyship, Living Corridor]
description: Storage trunks are packed tightly together in long rows that run the length of the area's metal bulkheads and a lingering, stale smell hangs in the air.  Some of these containers are shut, but others are busted open at their hinges.  Varied clothing and nondescript debris are scattered across the floor, where they appear to have been stepped on and pushed to the room's edges by those passing through.

title: [Skyship, Living Corridor]
description: The metallic smell of blood lingers with sweet notes of ripening decay.  Covered gigas corpses line the bulkheads, each with thick grey sheets placed atop them, concealing the remains from view.  The metal floors are discolored with dried crimson stains, as are most of the sheets.  In most places these corpses are stacked several bodies high with the concealed figures packed tightly to fit as many as possible.

title: [Skyship, Core]
description: The temperature cools as you progress deeper into the ship's core, with circular openings in the side bulkheads releasing chilled air.  Above, a giant rectangular container filled with an ethereal, highly viscous liquid, runs the length of the ceiling.  The liquid swirls as it changes color rapidly and repeatedly, passing through all colors in the rainbow in a single breath before it starts over.  As a result, the walkway is constantly cast in a shifting light.

title: [Skyship, Core]
description: Myriad cylinders flank the walkway, extending from beneath the floor and connecting to the ceiling.  Crafted from a transparent glaesine, each cylinder is filled with a swirling, opaque mixture that appears like highly viscous, ethereal sea water in a variety of bright colors.  Glaesine pipes attached to these cylinders line the ceiling and carry into the distance in all directions, going along the walkway and through the hull, carrying the liquid elsewhere on the ship.

title: [Skyship, Core]
description: Intense heat radiates from the machinery lining the area's bulkheads, causing the air to ripple and waver.  A pale blue smoke filters through gaps in the floor, originating from the massive gear-lined devices that are visible in cavernous space beneath the walkway.  A wide and flat brazier hangs above the walkway via a series of chains, the fire within it casting a spiderweb of soft orange light across the metal ceiling.

title: [Skyship, Core]
description: A towering gear-lined obelisk of panels, levers, and twisting metal rises out of the floor in the middle of the area, carrying all the way to the ceiling, where a series of thick pipes curl out and upward from it like limbs on an octopus.  Steam escapes the joints of these pipes, clouding the area around the obelisk in a haze.  The whir of machinery throughout the area creates a constant, rumbling din, with periodic vibrations rumbling the walkway and shaking the obelisk.

title: [Skyship, Core]
description: The path widens and rises slightly as the floor transitions from a solid metal walkway to a firm grating.  Below, broad clockwerke machines vibrate, whirr, and emit constant streams of smoke and steam.  Above, metal pipes run the length of the ceiling in all directions, attached via a series of bright, greasy metal chains.

title: [Skyship, Core]
description: A giant metal furnace sits to one side of a walkway emitting a constant stream of thick, black smoke from a wide grating attached to its front.  Across from the furnace, gear-set panels and stout, smoke-belching pipes line one of the bulkheads, which rattles with the constant motion of the gears.  The path below radiates warmth and steam rises from it across the area.  Above, dark metal pipes attached to the furnace travel along the ceiling into the distance while they shake with a low, ever-present hum.

title: [Skyship, Core]
description: The area is dark and hot, and the air is thick with humidity and the acrid smell of smoke.  Lanterns attached to the ceiling cast crisscrossing shadows at all angles.  The bulkheads are lined with floor-to-ceiling clockwerke devices fitted with metal gears and steam-ejecting pipes that hum and vibrate with constant activity.  The floor is a hard metal interspersed with thin strips of dark wood that proceeds deeper into the ship's core.

title: [Skyship, The Cells]
description: A thin pool of fetid water fills a small recession that runs the edges of the room, fed by a series of leather tubes attached to bladders that hang from the ceiling.  Humanoid skeletal remains lay face-down alongside the pool, while further remains have been pushed into the room's center.  Flies swirl about these remains, which have long succumbed to dark blue-green rot and give off a vile, rank odor that fills the area.  A series of void black banners painted with silver-white runes hang on the bulkhead

title: [Skyship, The Cells]
description: The metal floor throughout the area has been lowered by several feet from the entrance level.  The downslope of the changing level is gradual, shallowing out into a broad recession littered with tattered, putrid debris, including clothing, skeletal remains, and organic waste.  Thin pieces of cloth have been loosely arranged across the recessed floor as makeshift beds, while above a bright and opaque glaesine orb casts the area in a perpetual light.

title: [Skyship, The Cells]
description: A long rectangular room opens before you.  The longer sides of the metal bulkheads are lined with narrow, recessed sleeping shelves -- not quite wide or tall enough, which would be an uncomfortable fit for a giantkin.  Each shelf is hammered out of the bulkheads and is further strung with coarse white ropes that, together, form small pockets of netting to help hold individuals attempting to rest in them.  In the area's four corners, piles of organic waste attract squadrons of small, flying insects.

title: [Skyship, The Cells]
description: A powerful, rank odor assaults your senses.  The source appears to be a small, raised stone platform that sits to one side of the room.  Rotting, flyblown food debris is splattered across the platform and scattered alongside it.  Further putrescent piles have been haphazardly shoved into the corners, clearing an open area across the room's center.  Above the platform, the outline of a hatch is visible, cut into the metal ceiling and stuck with decaying organic matter.

title: [Skyship, The Cells]
description: A blue metal door opens on a tall corpse pile stacked in the room's center.  Built from the remains of varying races, with giantkin, humans, and elves all visible, the pile also contains various animal parts, including pieces of fur and bones.  The area around the pile is marked by a deep crimson discoloration from where blood has seeped into the stone floor.

title: [Skyship, The Cells]
description: Organic debris clutters the area that opens off of a red door.  Food scraps and organic waste mingles with decomposing bodies across a rough stone floor, which has been thoroughly discolored by the mess, and large and uneven crimson stains from where blood once pooled.  Tattered clothing ripped into makeshift bedding is pushed into loose piles against the bulkheads.  A series of opaque glaes orbs fixed to the top of each bulkhead light the scene in a perpetual, ethereal glow.

title: [Skyship, Prison Entry]
description: The room is spare and built from a rough, unpolished metal floor, bulkheads, and ceiling.  Across one bulkhead, a slab of dark stone covered with runic symbols is fixed with ropes.  Two metal doors are built into the other two bulkheads, to either side of both the tunnel and slab, one red and one blue.  In the room's center, an opaque glaes orb hangs from the ceiling and casts the scene in a pale, ethereal blue light.

title: [Skyship, Cages]
description: Three grated metal sluices run the length of the room, each displaying evidence of catching debris that has sloughed into them, including dried blood, gore, and stuck remains.  Though thin, the drains let material pass through but also allow individuals to walk atop them.  Drag lines of blood and matted fur cover the room, all leading toward the runnels.

title: [Skyship, Cages]
description: The area's center is filled with unopened cages made from thick metal bars with thin gaps between them to allow air to pass through.  Inside of these cages are numerous indistinct skeletal remains that commingle across the floors alongside rotting globs of flesh.  The remainder of the room is spare and open, with only traces of blood lining the main routes between ways in and out.

title: [Skyship, Cages]
description: The area is sparse except for collections of debris that includes torn, bloodstained clothing, stripped skeletal remains, fur, and unidentifiable organic matter.  These collections are piled as small nests, pushed together, flattened, and discrete.  The lanterns that hang overhead and provide lighting for the area have been largely torn down, casting shadows across the room.

title: [Skyship, Cages]
description: Four pools sit on either side of the room and are fed by giant metal pipes suspended from the ceiling.  These pipes appear long dry, and the fetid, brown-black water in the pools is commingled with muck, debris, and the remains of both animals and humanoid figures.  A wide path splits these pools in a cross and runs the length of the area.

title: [Skyship, Cages]
description: The air in the room is pungent and metallic, nearly overwhelming to the senses as the scent of rot mingles with blood.  Indistinct skeletal remains, both animal and humanoid, are loosely stacked in piles that have been dragged to one side, as is evidenced by the crimson trails streaking across the floor alongside them.  Rotting meat is strewn about the remains and is further stuck to the floor across the area.

title: [Skyship, Cages]
description: Blood of varying types collects on nearly every surface of the room, from the floors to the bare metal bulkheads.  Fresh blood pools around half-eaten humanoid corpses that, save for their general shape, are difficult to identify.  Dried crimson stains widely coat the floor and are dotted by footprints, both animal and humanoid, having traveled through it both deeper into the cages and back toward the exit.

title: [Skyship, Cages]
description: Thick metal bars run floor-to-ceiling, sectioning off a majority of the area as the beginning of a giant prison cell-like cage stretching deeper into the ship.  An opening where the metal bars used to latch has been destroyed, with the gate for that piece resting alongside the opening, having been torn off its hinges by a shearing force that has left the metal warped and jagged.  Dried blood mixed with animal fur coats the floor, leading in all directions.

title: [Skyship, The Corridor]
description: The shelves in this section have been thoroughly raided, pages from books torn and scattered with tattered parchments strewn across the floor, as if multiple individuals had haphazardly looted their contents.  The glaes-covered viewing cavity set into the floor continues through this section, only several sections are absent the withered figures from elsewhere in the area.  Thin, diagonal cracks frame its edges, but its structure appears largely intact.

title: [Skyship, The Corridor]
description: The corridor widens, and a thick smoke rises from a pit in the area's center created by a shattering of the glaesine viewing cavity that made up part of the walkway.  Debris smolders in the hole: embers alight charred books and smoking husks disfigured beyond recognition.  Jagged glaesine shards are sprinkled everywhere, evidencing the violent strength necessary to breach the walkway.  The path remains wide enough around the gap, however, to pass.

title: [Skyship, The Corridor]
description: The corridor dead-ends abruptly at a metal shelf-lined circle.  The glaesine viewing cavity set into the floor is wholly destroyed, forcing the path down along its ash-streaked hollows.  In the area's center, a smoldering corpse pile mixed with books and paper fragments releases wisps of dark black smoke.  Thick runes are drawn in a mix of vivid white paint and dark crimson blood around these charred forms.  A single, broad metal brazier hangs above and lights the area.

title: [Skyship, The Corridor]
description: The floor is a single piece of translucent glaes runs the corridor's length, topping a hollowed cavity.  Desiccated, naked bodies of varying races line this recess.  Bright gemstones glowing in a rainbow of hues are inset into the forehead of each preserved figure.  The entire scene is illuminated by sconces mounted throughout the area that cast a dim, flickering light.

title: [Skyship, The Corridor]
description: While the book and parchment-lined metal shelves flanking the corridor continue into the distance, a small, raised dais in the area's center about halfway interrupts the path.  A pile of crimson-hued gemstones sits atop a metal pedestal upon this dais.  A bright light shines down from a hole in the ceiling above the gemstones, scattering thin beams of red light across the floor, shelves, and ceiling.

title: [Skyship, The Corridor]
description: The corridor begins to gently curve here and the metal shelves curve with it, forged from sweeping, parabolic pieces of iron.  Fractured grey glaesine fragments of varying size litter the floor, scattered from the chipped and broken remains of the panels that formerly lined the shelving.  A small sitting area is built part-way through the area, featuring a wide iron bench surrounded by books, scrolls, and loose parchment.

title: [Skyship, The Corridor]
description: The corridor here is lined with floor-to-ceiling massive metal shelves fronted with translucent pale grey glaesine panels.  Myriad tomes, scrolls, and parchment pieces line these shelves, obscured somewhat by the thick paneling.  Broad metal braziers dangle from the ceiling, spaced evenly and casting a dim but warm light that shifts as the braziers sway with the ship's periodic movement.

title: [Lamamelodia's General Store]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a plain wooden table on one side of the shop.

Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Kighte's General Store]
description: The broad sweep of the wooden floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table and a plain wooden table are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Kighte's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Kighte's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Kobold Village, Shaman's Hut]
description: A half-collapsed tent of stitched hides leans against a crooked totem pole carved with too many eyes.  The air reeks of sage, cheap incense, and something unmistakably like burnt hair.  Shelves sag beneath jars of teeth, dried roots, and a cracked crystal orb that emits a low hum.  Atop a cluttered table rests a variety of carved bones, clumps of wax, and a crystallized sea blue eyeball.

title: [Shadow Valley, Shaman's Hut]
description: A warped hut stands half-embedded in the darkness, its walls stitched from shadows and veined with faint silver light.  The interior feels cold but is lit by lanterns that burn with no visible flame, their ghostly glow throwing rippling silhouettes that never quite match their sources.  Glass jars line crooked shelves, each holding fragments of bone or swirling smoke.  Strange sigils creep across the floor, fading and reappearing as if alive, while a reed bed rests nearby, its surface damp with frost.

title: [Skyship, The Rows]
description: The entire stone floor of the area is rutted with wide, dirt-packed grooves.  The surface of the dirt in these grooves is further streaked with white paint that has been thickly brushed as varying runic symbols.  Suspended above these grooved rows are black ropes that hang unevenly from metal hooks in the ceiling.  On one side of the area, a metal etching of gigas soldiers is prominently affixed to a black stone slab attached to one of the metal bulkheads.

title: [Skyship, Worship]
description: Bright banners and runic symbols line the area's bulkheads.  The banners are dotted with varied iconography, from pictographs to vivid color patterns in the threading.  All hang from thick black stone slabs attached to the metal bulkheads.  The symbols on the banners match those carved on stone slabs placed across the floor, the carvings further highlighted on these slabs by a chalky material rubbed into them.  The stone floor is otherwise bare except for a painted white circle in the area's middle.

title: [Skyship, Hydration]
description: The metal bulkheads here are lined by a series of stone troughs filled with cloudy water.  Above each of these troughs, a weathered leather bladder is suspended from the ceiling.  From these bladders, stitched leather tubes attached to both the bulkheads and ceiling allow water to flow into the troughs.  The floor beneath is a hard-packed dirt marked periodically by water discoloration from where the leather tubes perpetually leak, along with large-printed footfalls from where people have gathered.

title: [Skyship, Holding]
description: The area's floor is divided into two sections, one of hard-packed dirt and the other of a thick, puce-hued fabric that appears like a grass-styled carpet.  The dirt section is flat, marked by extensive evidence of footfalls across it and edged by a large, foul-smelling trough that runs the length of the bulkheads.  The carpeted section is similarly bare, except for sections big enough for several individuals to lay side-by-side that have been demarcated by white lines painted onto the fabric.

title: [Skyship, Mess]
description: Crates line the area's metal bulkheads, each stamped with the same, crude flame-etched animal pattern.  Spread across the stone floor are a series of thin woven rugs, each coated with varying stains and lingering organic debris, each broad enough for several large-sized individuals to sit upon them, and each with a wooden bucket in their center.  A stitched leather tube hangs above each of these rugs, with several visibly dripping water intermittently into the buckets beneath them.

title: [Skyship, Dais]
description: In the area's center sits a dais of packed dirt that has been raised in the stone floor.  A pedestal of bone has been placed atop the mound, built primarily from the longer leg and arm remains of larger creatures but also set with multiple humanoid skulls at its base.  Wide grooves are carved in the floor surrounding the mound, each marked with bright vermillion paint on the interior.

title: [Skyship, The Fire]
description: The unlit remains of an enormous ruined bonfire, a mix of burned logs, ash, and stone, dominate the room's middle and are placed on a slightly raised dirt mound sectioned from the rest of the room by white stone boulders the size of a large giantkin's head.  Around the mound, thin white lines painted on the rough-hewn stone floor give an indication of where groups assemble.  Above, the ship ceiling is painted with a constellation of ashen white stars.

title: [Skyship, Arches]
description: Broad and dark metal arches line the area's bulkheads.  One such arch is built over a collapsed metal tunnel, while all others frame silver-white runic symbols painted upon the bulkheads.  Sealed wooden crates marked with similar runic symbols in paint and wax are scattered across the room.  Above, thick white ropes coated with ash-hued wax and deep crimson paint hang from the ceiling in tight tangles.

title: [Skyship, The Pits]
description: The area's floor is a series of cages, their tops made from a thick metal grating with bars close enough to allow traversal, but open enough to allow air and liquid to pass through.  The cage interiors are bright, lit by pale blue-white lights from unseen sources revealing solid stone floors covered with extensive blood stains and splattered with bits of dried viscera.  Runic symbols drawn with cloudy white wax are also visible on the cage bottoms.

title: [Skyship, Processing]
description: Twin vats carved from stone rise from the metal floor on opposite sides of the area.  Each vat is fronted by a broad glaes panel that, while somewhat opaque, is translucent enough to make out the contents that float in a cloudy liquid.   The first vat contains humanoid figures in varying states of decomposition.  The second is filled with loose bits of flesh-stripped bone.  Runic symbols are drawn in a mix of wax and blood on the sides of these vats, flanking the glaes panels, and across the ground.

title: [Skyship, The Ropes]
description: A flat, packed dirt floor lined with unlit candles covers the area.  Above, thick white ropes hang in broad and bulbous tangled knots.  Visible in these tangles are desiccated bodies of varying races, each appearing whole but glossy, as if they had been coated in a thin layer of wax before being collected within the ropes.  Runic symbols appear on the floor below each prominent tangled body, all drawn in a bright white paint.

title: [Skyship, Refuse]
description: A thin layer of an inky black liquid covers the floor of a wide, flat room.  Bits of garbage, skeletal remains, other debris of varying size extend out of this liquid across the area.  The metal bulkheads are slick with moisture and stuck with loose organic material.  A wide series of votives attached to the ceiling cast a dim, flickering light.  The room is otherwise spare, excepting a single red metal button upon the ceiling, adjacent to the votives, and a jagged crack in the bulkhead.

title: [Skyship, The Spire]
description: A gem-studded electrum spire rises out of the middle of the area's rough stone floor.  Rough, cloudy rubies are set across one side of the spire, arranged patterns that mirror the runic symbols painted across the floors, bulkheads, and ceiling in deep crimson.  A solid painted white line encircles the spire.  Set on the spire's side of the line is a series of unlit, ash grey candles.

title: [Skyship, Bonework]
description: Three large stone pits are recessed into the floor across one side of the room.  Each of these pits is filled to its top with bone, from fragments to limbs to entire skulls heaped indiscriminately.  Surrounding these pits are further bone piles of varying remains obviously belonging to both humanoids and animals.  Runic symbols are painted in faded crimson throughout the area: on the ground, across the bulkheads, and even on the ceiling.

title: [Skyship, The Mounds]
description: Twin, rectangular and parallel raised mounds of packed earth built up on the stone floor run the length of two sides of the room.  Atop each mound is a weathered bone totem assembled from a varied collection of skeletal remains.  Flanking these totems are bright banners stitched with runic symbols.  The room's middle is set in a slight depression, with the stone floor sloping away from the mounds.  Thick crimson lines are drawn across the floor in runic symbols mirroring those on the banners.

title: [Skyship, Research]
description: The room is divided into two separated parts.  One side is a broad, metal passage, wide and unadorned, a through-way in the section.  The other is inaccessible, hidden away behind a series of dyed blue-black panes fitted between thick metal bars that run the length of the area, floor-to-ceiling.  These panes are opaque and narrow, with room enough for only a single figure to stand at one to attempt to peer through its impossibly cloudy glaes.

title: [Skyship, Research]
description: The area is unnaturally cold and slick, with frost and frozen water droplets visibly clinging to the room's metal surfaces.  The chill appears to emanate from a series of pale blue runes stamped on the bulkheads.  Placed below these runes and further stacked into piles across the area are an indeterminate number of corpses, each pale as if their blood has been fully drained.  Sealed wooden crates pushed against the bulkheads are labeled only with a single, pyrographed stick figure burned onto them.

title: [Skyship, Research]
description: A series of humanoid mannequins of varying size and body type line one side of the room, strapped to thick metal poles with leather belts.  Wide black wooden boards are placed at the base of each mannequin, and atop each board lies a figure of the same race as the mannequin looming over it.  These figures appear to be the subject of experimentation, with open crates of metal tools set alongside cut-open corpses in differing states of surgery.

title: [Skyship, Research]
description: Numerous tall glaes cylinders dot the area, towering over the dim, narrow passageways between them like a dense grove.  These cylinders are dyed an opaque, chalky white and each is underlit at its base by a series of orbs emitting an ethereal blue glow.  While it is difficult to precisely determine the contents at a casual glance, each cylinder appears to be completely filled with a cloudy liquid containing the silhouette of a humanoid figure.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Skyship, Research]
description: Pure white metal tables line the area's bulkheads around an open center.  Each table exhibits extensive, dark discoloration of varying red-black hues.  Clusters of small lanterns dangle from hooks in the ceiling, lowered so they hang just above each table to illuminate whatever work is conducted on them.  Visible grated sluices are placed evenly across the floor, marked with the same discoloration as found on the room's tables.

title: [Skyship, Research]
description: Tall and broad wooden crates form a maze of storage throughout the area, with shadow-crossed passages between them wide enough for several individuals to proceed alongside each other.  The crates are marked with varying pyrography, including stick figure bodies, the silhouettes of tools, stacked books, and crossed bones.  Several lanterns hang from the ceiling, casting a dim, bronze light across the area.

title: [Zhaleek's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table and a simple wooden shelf sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Bhast's Armory]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A suit of silver-chased armor sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a lacquered wooden shelf on one side of the shop and an iron-banded wooden chest on the other.

title: [Bhast's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a colorful Icemule map hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A heavy wooden desk and a lacquered wooden shelf sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Bhast's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a stuffed caribou head hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An iron-banded wooden chest and a long varnished counter sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Dirvy's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a billowing silk ceiling, a pair of crossed bones hangs on one of the white silk-paneled walls.  A wide knotted oak counter and a gilded maple cabinet sit in opposite corners while some puffed raw silk pillows rests on a colorful mosaic floor.

title: [Dirvy's Magic Shoppe]
description: Gold-veined marble walls rise from a gold-speckled marble floor.  Just above an iron candelabra hangs a ruby-eyed grinning skull, and a low skylight-set ceiling completes the picture.  A low wrought iron table and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Dirvy's Magic Shoppe]
description: A bundle of dried flowers hangs on one of the honey gold oak walls, and a low skylight-set ceiling rises overhead.  A well-pruned lemon tree sits in one corner of a golden blonde oak floor.  There is a floral-etched ceramic case on one side of the shop and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on the other.

title: [Maory's General Store]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a plain wooden table and a simple wooden shelf.

title: [Medulis's Magic Shoppe]
description: A pair of wooden snowshoes hangs on one of the pale oak walls, and an oak beam ceiling rises overhead.  A polar bear rug sits in one corner of a varnished oak floor.  There is some hammered copper display hooks on one side of the shop and a vine-carved mahogany table on the other.

title: [Medulis's General Store]
description: Beneath an oak beam ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the dark oak walls.  A glass-topped mistwood counter and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sit in opposite corners while a stuffed grizzly bear rests on a russet oak floor.

title: [Medulis's General Store]
description: Beneath an oak beam ceiling, a colorful Icemule map hangs on one of the honey gold oak walls.  A gilded maple table and a gilded maple cabinet sit in opposite corners while a plush black bear fur rug rests on a honey gold oak floor.

title: [Skyship, Research Entry]
description: The room is largely unadorned, spare, and open, consisting of painted pure white metal bulkheads with a matching floor and ceiling.  A stone relief mounted to the bulkhead on the area's far side and is the sole distinguishing decoration.  The floor's pale, sterile grey coloration is notably marred by numerous metallic crimson stains, drag marks leading in every possible direction.

title: [Arctius' General Store]
description: Refurbished driftwood walls rise from a varnished dark oak floor.  Just above a miniature Solhaven Bay model hangs a curl-edged vellum wall map, and a domed white stucco ceiling completes the picture.  A Vornavian silk-covered table stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Skyship, Exterior]
description: The path is wide, forged from dark metals fused together.  Faded flags draped along the skyship's exterior billow and catch the wind.  The path below hums with a steady vibration that emanates from somewhere within the ship.  Steam shoots from periodic gaps in the hull, ejecting out as thin, ethereal wisps of vapor that are quickly dispersed into the dark.

title: [Skyship, Exterior]
description: The metal walkway widens, expanding into an oval-shaped platform extending off of the skyship's dark exterior.  At one side of the oval, close to the half-wall at the ship's edge, a series of steps are raised several feet off the ground and are flanked by unlit metal lanterns extending from tall poles.  Facing these steps, thick, chalked white lines are drawn onto the ground in rows.  Thick cord nets attached to the ship surround the area, fixed to both the half-walls and overhanging, dark metal beams.

title: [Skyship, Exterior]
description: Wind whips across the dark walkway in a shrill, constant near-shriek, funneled down the path by the skyship's streamlined metal architecture.  To one side, pushed against the skyship's metal body, twin gigas corpses lie face down on the walkway, their forms stuck and matted extensively with dried blood.  Steam issues forth from the ship's hull throughout the area, floating away into the dark night.

title: [Skyship, Exterior]
description: Large gaps in the half-wall that lines the metal path alongside the ship and divides the external walkway from a dark free-fall have been loosely covered by sections of thick rope netting.  These nets appear loose in spots, flapping vigorously in the chill winds that whip across the ship's exterior.  A series of tattered flags drape from the iron beams overhanging the walkway, their bright colors a contrast to the metallic exterior and the dark night sky.

title: [Skyship, Exterior]
description: A metal path hangs in the dark sky along the skyship's side.  Wide iron beams overhang the walkway, extending from the ship in sweeping wave-shaped curves and attaching to a half-wall that divides the path from a precipitous and dark drop.  Regardless of the area's caged appearance, there remains ample room to walk under the iron beams and alongside the half-wall.  In the distance at the path's end, a glaesine dome visibly rises from the ship.

title: [Skyship, Exterior]
description: A collapsed and ruined metal tunnel occupies much of the ship's bulkhead along this portion of dark exterior walkway.  Formerly an entrance portal back inside, the tunnel is inaccessible, its exterior faded and dull, the runic symbols upon its exterior wiped into a silver-white blur of chalk.  A makeshift barricade of bloodspattered crates and loose metal surrounds the tunnel in a semicircle, as if those who assembled it hurriedly hoped to stop something from passing through.

title: [Skyship, Exterior]
description: The path rises slightly toward a flat, square-shaped platform encased by a glaesine dome fused to the ship.  The pervasive shriek of wind along the ship's exterior is lessened in the area.  On the platform's far side, a metal viewing glass marked with chalked-on white runes points through a hole in the dome toward the distant, inky horizon, its base fused to twin metal poles extending from the deck.

title: [Brayern Isle, Docks]
description: The blue-green docks extend over the bright blue water, which is clear enough to see down to the volcanic rocks below.  Beneath the docks, thick circular pilings drive down into bright blue waters that gently lap against an ebon, volcanic stone-laden shore.  Longboats are tied against these pilings, hewn from the same wood as the docks.  Above, the sky and horizon are obscured, both caught in the electric blue haze of the distant mana storm.

title: [Brayern Isle, Docks]
description: The sky and horizon are obscured, both caught in the electric blue haze of the distant mana storm.  The docks here are new, built from polished blue-green wood and still bearing partially unpacked crates from construction.  Beneath, thick circular pilings drive down into bright blue waters that gently lap against an ebon, volcanic stone-laden shore.  Longboats are tied against these pilings, hewn from the same blue-green wood as the docks.  A long bridge over the water leads ashore.

title: [Brayern Isle, Docks]
description: The docks here are still under construction, with visible gaps between planks and ropes that block a plunge into bright blue waters.  Crates are placed in orderly piles along the way in various stages of unpacking.  The sky and horizon are obscured, both caught in the electric blue haze of the distant mana storm.  Longboats are tied against the pilings that support the docks, both hewn from the same blue-green wood.

title: [Brayern Isle, Beach]
description: The island rises above you.  Against the electric blue haze of the mana storm is a mountainous spire lined with palms and thick vegetation.  The shoreline is a mix of ebon-hued volcanic stones and displaced boulders that have slid down the mountain over the years.  Off of the bridge to the docks is a prominent stone statue with an accompanying wood and stone sign.  Twin lantern-lined paths lead down the beach in either direction.

title: [Brayern Isle, Beach]
description: A small path lined with lanterns runs along the area where the beach turns inland.  The shoreline is filled with ebon-hued volcanic rocks worn down by the island's waves.  The adjacent jungle is dense, pushing all the way up against the beach.  Trills of life sound, accompanied by the periodic rustling of foliage.  The way into the jungle leads through the vegetation as a series of increasingly steep, sloping switchbacks.

title: [Brayern Isle, Jungle Path]
description: The path here is a series of switchbacks, a mix of stone-lined trails and brief, rope-lined bridges to cross small gaps.  Lanterns line the way.  Thick vines reach down from above and encroach the path from the sides.  This vegetation shivers periodically, betraying hints of life.  The thrum of water moving against rock is more muted here than down by the beach, but still loud.

title: [Brayern Isle, Beach]
description: A small path lined with lanterns runs along the area where the beach turns inland.  The shoreline is filled with ebon-hued volcanic rocks worn down by the island's waves over the years.  The sound of these rolling waves is offset by periodic trills of life throughout the adjacent jungle and distant voices from the nearby docks.  The way into the jungle leads up, cut out of the thick vegetation along a series of gentle, sloping switchbacks.

title: [Brayern Isle, Jungle Path]
description: Running alongside the volcanic mountain is a dense, canopy-covered path.  The adjacent vines and plants periodically tremble with creatures passing through but otherwise unseen, and the nearby warbling of birds and scrambling of small animals is ever-present.  Thick vines reach down from above and encroach from the sides, as if they were trying to grab at passersby.  The trail slopes at a severe angle; the path north leads up the mountain and the way south heads back toward the beach.

title: [Brayern Isle, Jungle Path]
description: Opening out of thick jungle on either side of the path is a small, canopied clearing.  In the center, some stone benches have been set so travelers may rest in this glade.  Alongside them is a simple bamboo fountain.  Lanterns line the area's perimeter, with openings facing only inward so as to not cast excess light into the jungle.  A winding, boulder-strewn path leads visibly toward the cliff face and a dense vine-twisted opening leading up to a narrow platform above.

title: [Brayern Isle, Fortress Approach]
description: Half of the path from the beach plateaus here, emerging from the jungle canopy partway up the volcanic mountain.  To one side, lush vines and densely-packed trees block one's advance.  To the other, blue-green logs form a tall fortress wall with lanterns and several violet-hued banners hanging from it.  A flat patch of dirt and volcanic rock away from the wall is home to a small bonfire encircled by river rocks.

title: [Brayern Isle, Fortress Approach]
description: At the head of this plateau is a fortress built out of a muted blue-green wood.  Twin ends of the wooden walls along the paths from below meet here, connected by a wide metal portcullis built into the walls that opens to the fortress interior.  These walls are carved with sharp spikes at the top to discourage surreptitious entry.  Above the portcullis is a bright violet cloth pennant stitched with onyx threads.  Suspended from supportive hooks along the fortress walls, and placed intermittently along the trails leading back down from the plateau, is a series of lanterns.

title: [Brayern Isle, Fortress Approach]
description: The view from this path sees the beach below, the docks, and the mana storm.  The roiling, electric blue hues of the storm are in sharp contrast to the softer, whitecapped waves beneath them.  Both are like a painting when compared to the jungle's darker greens.  To one side, the jungle blocks one's advance.  To the other, tall blue-green logs form a fortress wall with lanterns and several violet-hued banners hanging from it.  A flat patch of dirt and volcanic rock away from the wall is home to a small bonfire encircled by river rocks.

title: [Brayern Isle, Jungle Path]
description: Carved-out hollows line a path along a sheer cliff that divides jungle plateaus along the volcanic mountain.  Massive, onyx-hued boulders punctuate the lush treescape below, remaining where they have landed since dislodging from higher altitudes.  A strung rope and a small sign next to the edge separate travelers from a high dive.  A series of stone lanterns are suspended along the cliff face.  A rope ladder anchored to the rock face leads to a narrow platform above.

title: [Brayern Isle, Jungle Path]
description: Running alongside the volcanic mountain is a dense canopy that gives way to a narrow path along the cliffside.  The mana storm above is bright, casting a slight blue haze across the landscape.  Thick vines reach down from above and encroach the path from the sides, as if they were trying to grab at passersby.  The path north leads up the mountain, and the way south heads back toward the beach.

title: [Brayern Isle, Jungle Path]
description: The path here is a series of switchbacks, a mix of stone-lined trails and brief, rope-lined bridges to get across small gaps.  Thick vines reach down from above and encroach the path from the sides.  This vegetation shivers periodically, betraying hints of life.  The thrum of water moving against rock is more muted here than down by the beach, but still loud.

title: [Brayern Isle, Cliffside Watch]
description: A stone wall and a plank-reinforced stone floor define the edges of this canopy-covered hollow erected in a small cliffside pocket.  A narrow path toward a vine-twisted opening offers access, as does a rope ladder along the cliff face.  Built on river rock slabs is a small bonfire, with several chairs set around it.  A metal viewing glass wrapped in vines is propped against the stone wall, offering a view of the jungle below or of the churning mana storm that surrounds the island.  The area is lit by several lanterns attached to the cliff face.

title: [Brayern Isle, Fort Brayern]
description: Silver-striated white stone bricks line the floor of this fortress.  Above, a wide leather tarp pulled tight with thick ropes protects from harsh weather.  Ingress is granted via a metal portcullis built into the blue-green wooden fortress walls, which are hung with weathered violet-hued banners and lanterns.  The area's centerpiece is a small pool surrounding a blazing bonfire built on a raised white stone platform.  Some plush pillows surround both.  Wide white stone stairs with a prominent sign adjacent lead up and onward.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Brayern Isle, Fort Brayern]
description: The centerpiece of this corner of the fortress is a white stone fountain, filled by a series of sloping tubes that run along the blue-green wooden walls.  Around the fountain and across the area are several piles of plush pillows, offering copious seating for guests.  Multiple marble sculptures line the walls, each carved with meticulous detail.

title: [Brayern Isle, Fort Brayern]
description: Shelf after shelf line the walls in this spare portion of the fortress.  Armaments of all shapes and sizes line these shelves, as do miscellaneous building and masonry supplies.  Alongside them, wood and metal crates are piled precariously high.  A series of gem-studded stone lanterns attached to the fortifications completes the area.

title: [Brayern Isle, Fort Brayern]
description: The carved wooden fortress walls, the wide leather tarp overhead, and the area's luxuries are incongruous with the dense jungle visible over the walls and between gaps in the wood, and with the perpetual electric blue mana storm above.  Multiple marble sculptures line the wall, carved from the same white stones that form the bricks that make up the floor.  Between these sculptures, a stone shelf is lined with delicacies and has pushed-up chairs for seating.  A large sign is hung over the shelf.

title: [Brayern Island, Fort Brayern]
description: A wooden half-wall occupies the area's middle, connected to both several woven hammocks and the taller fortress wall.  Several lanterns line small shelves on the half-wall alongside these hammocks.  Supply crates visibly containing food and sundries fill much of the rest of the area.  Leather tarps suspended above keep out harsh weather but are also cut with rectangular patches that, when pulled back, offer a wide view of the sky and its perpetual mana storm.

title: [Brayern Island, Portal Dais]
description: Scratches mar the ground, evidence of objects being dragged along toward the stone stairs and down into the fortress.  The jungle cliffs outside the fortress are visible over the blue-green wooden walls, with twining vines plunging down sheer rock faces and out of sight.  To the north, a tall white stone arch containing opaque, wavering energies stands out against the mana storm's electric blue highlights.  Ahead of it, a checkpoint wooden kiosk with a wide sign attached to its front stands in the way.

title: [Brayern Island, Portal Dais]
description: A tall white stone portal lined with jeweled runes dominates the dais, casting ripples of wavering silver and gold light across the way forward.  The portal's illuminating energies sharply contrast the muted greens and blues of both the jungle and the mana storm above.  A multitude of gemstones line the arch from the ground to its apex, which is set with a large rune-etched diamond that gently pulsates.  Alongside the arch, a large sign is placed.

title: [Nyessem, Portal Room]
description: A tall white stone portal lined with jeweled runes sits on a white stone pedestal at one end of the room.  Set at its apex is a large rune-etched diamond.  Descending from the portal, a semicircle of white marble stairs leads to a recessed path.  Flanking this path, the walls glow with a shimmering pearlescence that limits the need for additional light.  Some bright violet-hued banners trimmed with silver threads line the length of the room, matching the silver-hued cloth pillows arranged around the room.  Overhead, some gem-studded carved stone lanterns line the way north and onward.

title: [Nyessem, Portal Checkpoint]
description: Violet-hued banners line one wall, over an arrangement of plush violet and silver-hued pillows arrayed for comfort.  Across the entire opposite wall, a cascading white stone fountain carved into the wall displays dozens of water-filled tiers pouring down to a polished gem-inlaid basin.  Next to a tall sapphire-lined tunnel, a stout stone kiosk set with a wide sign has been built as a checkpoint.  Above both, a bright violet cloth pennant stitched with onyx threads is prominently displayed.

title: [Nyessem, Ring Loop Entrance]
description: Meticulously carved from pearlescent white stone, the walls here suggest the area was hollowed and then detailed to accent the stone's innate glow.  Shapes of jewel-studded flowers, animals, and geometric patterns have all been artistically etched into the walls.  In particular, a wide gem and stone relief of two individuals holding orbs stands out, dominating a prominent section opposite a tall sapphire-lined tunnel.  Beneath the relief and from alongside the installation, a marble fountain flows liberally into a shallow marble pool.  In the room's middle, a wood and stone sign covered in metal letters offers instructions.

title: [Nyessem, Ring Loop]
description: The tunnel does not have a natural curve, its architects instead favoring a more severe jutting in either direction away.  The far corner of this turning point slopes down, leading into a hollowed-out semicircular bowl.  Several cascading rows of benches are carved between stairs leading down, each covered with many pillows for seating.  At the bottom, a polished stone table has been placed as a makeshift podium.  Opposite this miniature amphitheater is a deep white stone fireplace striated with pure silver.

title: [Nyessem, Ring Loop]
description: The tunnel widens here, providing ample space for several rows of people to walk alongside each other.  Although many ornate lanterns are set to offer light, the tunnel's white stone walls emit a pearlescent glow that makes the lanterns' use more ornamental than practical.  Luminescent clusters of crystal formations overhead add to the room's ambient light.  A bright watercolor painting of the Maivaldius family hangs to one side, nearly ten feet tall and twice as long.  Across from the painting, a quartz-studded tunnel leads down.

title: [Nyessem, Ring Loop]
description: This path is difficult to make out, as a sculpture garden of lush Nyessemian trees dominates the area.  The trees in this garden come together to form a tree-shaped stone fountain, with water pouring forth from individual stone faces carved on each tree.  This water collects in a wide stone pool beneath the installation, which glows with such luminescence that its depth cannot be casually determined.  On the room's other side, a perpendicular and narrow slope leads up.

title: [Nyessem, Ring Loop]
description: The tunnel dims, as the light emitted by the white stone walls has been muted in this section.  Off to one side, a three-sided stone altar is flanked by dozens of candles.  Throughout the room, many pillows have been placed for guests to take ease in their reverence.  Across from the altar sit three stone obelisks, one white, one ebon, and one grey.  Before them sits a small metal sign.

title: [Nyessem, Room of Observation]
description: A circular platform rises out of the room's center, under a silvery blue spotlight.  Placed on this platform is a metal viewing glass glowing with a pearlescent light.  A wood and stone sign covered in metal letters is set next to the glass, so it cannot be missed by those approaching.  Opposite the platform, a perpendicular and narrow ascent slopes up.

title: [Nyessem, Ring Loop]
description: The path divides, with a perpendicular cobbled section diverting off to a broad emerald-studded tunnel.  From out of the tunnel, the faint sound of flowing water resonates and the pungent floral aroma of greenery wafts on the air.  At the tunnel's mouth, a prominent metal plaque is embedded in the stone.  Across, a long stone sculpture of twin Nyessemian trees dominates the area opposite.  Between the sculpture's trees, a polished stone table is laden with food and drink options.

title: [Nyessem, Ring Loop]
description: This portion of the tunnel is spare, lacking the decoration or amenities of other sections.  Along the room's edges, where the floor and wall connect, the room's slight downslope carries the water in twin stone fountains toward the west.  Alongside each of the fountain's halves, hooded figures periodically gesture with the flow of water, as if indicating that guests should continue in that direction.

title: [Nyessem, Orb Approach]
description: The walls here are colored a dark, matte black.  A pale silver spotlight emitting its beam straight from the ceiling focuses on a glittering gem-studded arch.  Flanking the arch on all sides are some dark crimson banners trimmed with bright violet threads.  Above the top banner running perpendicular to the arch is a gem-cut crest for the Maivaldius family.  At the crest's center is a large rune-etched diamond.  Opposite the arch are some wide stairs.

title: [Nyessem, Ring Loop]
description: This portion of the tunnel is spare, lacking the decoration or amenities of other sections.  Along the room's edges, where the floor and wall connect, the room's slight downslope carries the water in twin stone fountains toward the east.  Hooded figures stand alongside these fountains, periodically gesturing with the flow of water, as if indicating that guests should continue in that direction.

title: [Nyessem, Ring Loop]
description: Pink quartz crystals and fiery red rubies line the white stone walls leading to a broad ruby-studded tunnel down, reflecting their multihued light across the floor.  The faint movement of large amounts of water can be heard down the tunnel's mouth.  Next to the opening, a pastel-hued cloth banner trimmed with silver threads and its riot of colors draws the eye.  Nearby, some wide stone benches carved with a bubble motif are a place for respite.  Alongside them, a marble side table offers refreshments.

title: [Nyessem, Room of Observation]
description: A circular platform rises out of the room's center, under a pale golden spotlight.  Placed on this platform is a wooden viewing glass etched with silvery runes.  A wood and stone sign covered in metal letters is set next to the glass, so it cannot be missed by those approaching.  Opposite the platform, the tunnel splits, with a perpendicular and narrow ascent sloping up.

title: [Nyessem, Ring Loop]
description: The light emitted by the white stone walls is more muted in this section of tunnel.  Off to one side, a two-sided stone altar is flanked by dozens of candles.  Throughout the room, many pillows have been placed for guests to take their ease in reverence.  Across from the altar sit twin stone obelisks, one white and one ebon.  Both are carved inward with relief sculpture, the first obelisk of Lady Maivaldius and the other obelisk of Nyessemian figures.  Before them sits a small metal sign.

title: [Nyessem, Ring Loop]
description: The tunnel splits here, with a perpendicular and narrow slope leading up.  A stone fountain and the stone pool opposite this split dominate much of the area.  The luminescent mineral white hue of the pool's stone reflects the room's ambient light, giving the water an ethereal quality.  In this water, some marble sculptures of muscled Nyessemian men have been erected, each set in a striking pose to accent their unnaturally large, muscled forms.  Next to the pool, a metal sign offers a warning.

title: [Nyessem, Ring Loop]
description: The tunnel widens here, providing ample space for several rows of people to walk alongside each other.  Luminescent crystal formations overhead, paired with the natural glow of the area's white stone walls, light the way.  To one side, a rough charcoal portrait of Lady Maivaldius with twin orbs dominates the wall.  Across the way is a broad topaz-studded tunnel.

title: [Nyessem, Ring Loop]
description: The tunnel does not have a natural curve, its architects instead favoring a more severe jutting toward either direction away.  At the far corner of this turning point, a round hollow has been carved out of the angular corner to serve as a standing bar.  A wide stone shelf fused to the wall is laden with delights and offers a companionable place for several chairs to be pushed up against.  Opposite the shelf, a pastel oil painting of Nyessemian revelry is prominently displayed.

title: [Nyessem, Promenade]
description: Built above the Ring Loop and accessed via the stairs from below, this walking path is similarly wide but twice as tall, formed from the same pearlescent white stone walls found throughout Nyessem.  Instead of a ceiling, a pale blue mist hovers in the air, mimicking a clouded sky.  Next to the stairs is a stone cart with refreshments and a small sign.  Pillows are intermittently spaced for taking one's ease.

title: [Nyessem, Promenade]
description: The walkway narrows here, set between a white stone wall lined with a long marble relief of lush Nyessemian vines and one carved with arch-shaped hollows.  Sculpted between the relief's stone tendrils is a pale green stone arch, with emerald-threaded curtains cinched above.  At one end of the walkway is a narrow slope alongside a tall, vine-carved white stone fountain.  The other end leads back to the promenade's main square.  Above, a pale blue mist mimicking a cloudy sky flows like milky water.

title: [Nyessem, Promenade]
description: The walkway narrows here, set between a white stone wall lined with marble sculptures of Nyessemian women and one carved with arch-shaped hollows.  Velvet-threaded curtains are cinched above the hollows, over a pale violet stone arch.  At one end of the walkway is a narrow slope alongside a polished white stone fireplace.  The other end leads back to the promenade's main square.  Above, a pale blue mist mimicking a cloudy sky flows like milky water.

title: [Nyessem, Testing Module Exit]
description: Twin cascading stone fountains run the room's length, simulating gentle waterfalls along two sides of this area.  Soft, silver and violet-threaded cushions are spread across the floor between these fountains, piled into a variety of improvised arrangements.  In the room's center is a marble table set with refreshments.  Suspended prominently over a broad topaz-studded tunnel is a wood and stone sign.

title: [Nyessem, Testing Module Exit]
description: Two sides of this room are draped in unadorned violet banners, hung in close proximity.  The far wall has been replaced with a square-shaped portal, the surface of which is aglow with wavering energies that change in color from a pale violet indigo to bright sunflower, and then back again.  Set in the portal's apex is a large rune-etched diamond that gently pulsates, lit with a pearlescent, blurry radiance.  Across large areas of white stone floor, many large cushions have been placed.  There is also a conspicuous circular tube next to the portal.

title: [Nyessem, Indigo Pools]
description: Softly glowing light issues from a pool in the center of the cavern, its indigo illumination warring for dominance over that of the shadows cast by stalactites anchored in the ceiling.  Crystalline structures formed of salt deposits line the porous walls of volcanic rock, their surfaces remaining slick from the constant draining of water from above.  A warped wooden bench rests at the front of a short wooden dock with its back to the steep incline that disappears into a pale violet stone arch.

title: [Nyessem, Indigo Pools]
description: A heavy mist hangs in the air like a gathering storm, impeding visibility in this deep and humid cavern.  Disturbed by a multitude of sea life below its surface, a large pool ripples constantly, thin indigo-hued tendrils darting to and fro across its glassy top.  A makeshift pier, crafted from moss-covered planks, juts out from the grotto's rocky edge and provides a perfect fishing perch.

title: [Nyessem, Fire-lit Caverns]
description: Recessed into the porous walls, a small fire cheerily parts the gloom of the cavern and sends its grey smoke up through a chimney fashioned of cracked stalagmites.  Smooth stones, some large enough to sit upon, dot the area, while fish bones gleam bright white in the dark.  A large rhimar-lined chest stands ready to use by local "fishermen."

title: [Nyessem, Indigo Pools]
description: Warm heat emanates from the southwestern wall, causing the area to fill with a faint, clinging fog as the cold of the nearby pool clashes with the tepid air.  Hanging like pendulums, stalactites laced with mica reflect the light of nearby torches and illuminate the ceiling like a thousand, tiny shining stars.  A warped wooden bench rocks slightly on the uneven ground.

title: [Nyessem, Promenade]
description: A long glass window tinted pale yellow dominates one side of this room, offering guests a view of the Ring Loop below.  In combination with the blue mist above, a pale green light is cast across the floor and the white stone walls opposite.  The walls house arch-shaped hollows with sunflower-threaded curtains cinched above them.  A cushioned wood couch and a gem-studded stone settee are placed before the window, offering guests a place to sit.  A narrow descent returns to the Ring Loop.

title: [Nyessem, Promenade]
description: This walkway is wide and extends off into the distance in multiple directions.  The way down, through the stairs at one end, is shrouded in shadow with occasional pearlescent flickers.  The contrast between this near-darkness and the blue mist above lends the area a surreal duality.  In the middle of the walkway is a four-tiered white stone fountain surrounded by thickly piled silk pillows.

title: [Nyessem, Promenade]
description: A long glass window tinted light green dominates one side of this room, offering guests a view of the halls below.  The luminescence of the area's walls, in combination with the blue mist above, casts a violet light across the white stone floor.  Arch-shaped hollows with emerald-threaded curtains cinched above them are carved into the walls, ready to be released when the additions to this area are completed.  A stone shelf is fused to the window and has many chairs pushed up to it.  A narrow descent returns to the Ring Loop.

title: [Nyessem, Baths]
description: A ruby-studded tunnel opens on a steam-filled room heated by a series of braziers in one corner.  Next to them, a polished marble basin is filled with cool, clear water.  A long stone table set with refreshments sits before a wall with small holes to hold personal effects.  A wide mirror edged with lines of glittering gemstones dominates the opposite wall.  At the mirror's heart is a large rune-etched diamond.

title: [Nyessem, Baths]
description: Thick steam and the smell of scented oils are both pervasive here.  Across most of the room, an oval-shaped pool lined with multihued gemstones is filled with cool, clear water that shimmers with an ethereal quality and is fed by a small stone fountain.  Hung against the far wall, a row of linen hammocks offers a place for repose.  Similarly, an ornate cane-backed settee is available in a far corner, next to some stone benches and a large bronze brazier emitting wisps of steam.

title: [Nyessem, Gardens West]
description: Crisscrossing paths are placed between rows of Nyessem crops in this humid room.  A suspended fruit and herb garden hangs from a trellis system, with its tendrils and blooms forming a prominent canopy that partially obscures the metal pipes bolted to the ceiling, which lead to both a multi-tiered white stone fountain and a gem-studded glass greenhouse.  Vibrant rose bushes decoratively occupy stone troughs along the walls.  A preserved arbor-lined opening leads deeper into the gardens.

title: [Nyessem, Gardens East]
description: The centerpiece of this room is a blue-green Nyessemian tree set with a rune-etched diamond.  A series of gem-inlaid stone lanterns hang from the tree's branches.  Behind the tree, a tall white stone fountain pours its water down from the ceiling into twin water-filled gutters, which flow alongside some stone display cases and the tree.  A lush flower garden draped from the walls covers three of the room's walls, thick with twining vines and blooms at every height.  A preserved arbor-lined opening leads out.

title: [Nyessem, Maivaldius Museum]
description: The white stone walls in this room of the museum are dull and lacking their familiar glow, causing a long shadow to be cast from a broad quartz-studded tunnel.  To one side, two large portraits are cast in bright light: a stylized watercolor painting of an older woman and a dark oil painting of a severe man.  Opposite them, across the room, two others are crossed in shadow: a puzzle-fit stone mosaic of an older man and a smudged charcoal etching of a withered man.  In the room's center, a slab of white stone is set on a long table under a bright spotlight.

title: [Nyessem, Maivaldius Museum]
description: The room is so dark that the walls to either side are hard to make out.  At the room's far end, a gem and stone relief of an elegant woman rises, lit by a pale gold spotlight in the ceiling.  The most prominent feature of this relief is the rune-etched diamond set in the subject's forehead.  Some wide stone benches are set in the middle of the room, with a large metal sign and some lanterns adjacent.

title: [Nyessem, Orb Distribution]
description: The walls here glow with a palpable pearlescence, more so than any of the other rooms through a glittering gem-studded arch out.  A stone path speckled with multihued gemstones runs the length of the room, perpendicular to the arch.  Along this path are six enormous white stone figures, all meticulously carved with painstaking attention to their varying humanoid forms.  A prominent metal plaque is attached to the wall on the room's far side.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Nyessem, Orb Distribution East]
description: Glittering lines of gemstones run the length of the room where the walls connect to the ceiling.  Hidden light sources behind the gems cast a rainbow of thin light beams across the floor, meeting at a pedestal in the room's center.  On this pedestal are twin stone obelisks, illuminated by a bright spotlight from above.

title: [Nyessem, Orb Distribution West]
description: Glittering lines of gemstones run the length of the room where the walls connect to the ceiling.  Hidden light sources behind the gems cast a rainbow of thin light beams across the floor, meeting at a pedestal in the room's center.  On this pedestal are twin stone obelisks, illuminated by a bright spotlight from above.

title: [Nyessem, Primal Empowerment]
description: The walls glow with a palpable pearlescence.  A stone path speckled with multihued gemstones meanders to the center of the room, surrounding a flame-veined carnelian pedestal and a rune-carved snowflake obsidian plinth.  Between the pedestal and the plinth, a squat marble pillar topped by a gem-inlaid silver orb is erected.

title: [Nyessem, Chimeric Empowerment]
description: The white stone walls glitter with a rainbow of fine, inset gemstone scattered unevenly in varied constellations.  At the area's center, a matte ironwood-veined basalt plinth and a marble-grafted polished faewood pedestal rise from the floor.  A slight recess is carved into the floor around these pillars, and within it burns a singular long and narrow fire that alights the room.

title: [Nyessem, Testing Approach]
description: Glittering lines of gemstones run the length of the room where the walls connect to the ceiling.  Hidden light sources behind the gems cast a rainbow of thin light beams across the floor.  On the far side of the room, the white stone wall ripples and wavers, creating the illusion of a large portal.  Set atop this wall in the room's center is a large rune-etched diamond that gently pulsates.

title: [Nyessem, Dark Cave]
description: A handful of flickering torches casts dim light across the area, barely revealing the details of the curved stone walls.  Water trickles through lichen-covered cracks and ridges, pooling into shallow puddles on the uneven floor.  In the center of the cave stands a saltglass-lined driftwood display case, its surface glistening in the heavy, humid air.

title: [Nyessem, Watery Expanse]
description: A murky expanse of water, an endless pool, stretches an untold distance into a cavern of uncertain size.  A thin, off-grey fog hovers just over the pool, shrouding its surface.  Wide metal braziers hang from the cavern's ceiling, lighting the expanse in a faint amber glow.  At the water's edge, a long and warped wooden bench offers a place for repose.

title: [Nyessem, Crystalline Cavern]
description: The way dead-ends in a bulbous cavern lined with cloudy, off-white crystalline formations that jut from the water-slick walls.  At the area's center, its surface covered by a thin grey fog, sits a pool of uncertain depth.  On one end of the room, a series of metal braziers lining the wall cast their amber light across the area, causing the crystalline formations above them to glitter.  A warped wooden bench sits at the pool's edge.

title: [Nyessem, The Platforms]
description: A wide series of blue-green wooden platforms extends into the distance, over a dark and fog-shrouded pool that extends the length of the cavern.  A craggy formation covers the ceiling in a mix of ivory, amber, crimson, and violet crystals that jut sharply downward, as if pointing toward the pool.  A low thrum emanates from somewhere beneath the water, its source uncertain.

title: [Nyessem, Dark Island]
description: The blue-green wooden platforms continue into this area from the north, extending toward a circular dark stone island surrounded by one large, dark pool.  The surface of this pool is a deep, onyx hue, so murky that not even light from the many metal braziers placed across the island and suspended from the water-slick walls penetrates it.  Across the island, a single, long warped wooden bench has been placed.

title: [You Went to Jaired]
description: Enclosed by brilliant cut-glass walls, the shop features a braided seagrass rug in the center of its seagrass floor.  A silken sea-themed tapestry hangs under the skylight-set ceiling.  Right near the front is a long mistwood counter and a variegated copper jewelry tree.

title: [It Can Only Be Jaired]
description: Beneath a glass-tiled vaulted ceiling, a faded treasure map hangs on one of the brilliant cut-glass walls.  A torn sailcloth hammock and an oversized sea chest sit in opposite corners while a stuffed octopus rests on a swirled sea glass floor.

title: [Jaired: The Galleria]
description: A painted silk wall panel hangs on one of the blue-speckled sea glass walls, and an etched seaglass ceiling rises overhead.  A tropical floral arrangement sits in one corner of an intricate patterned floor.  There is a wide knotted oak counter on one side of the shop and some carved haon pegs on the other.

title: [Ayaa's Magic Shoppe]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the woven grass divider walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a plain wooden table on one side of the shop and a simple wooden shelf on the other.

title: [Ayaa's General Store]
description: The broad sweep of the wooden floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table and a plain wooden table are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Ayaa's General Store]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A plain wooden table and a plain wooden table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Zrenigotham House, Orchard]
description: Nestled in a quiet meadow under a silver-lit sky, the orchard rests in moonlight, rows of tall trees casting soft shadows, their ripe fruit glowing faintly in the cool night air.  A nearby garden whispers with life, its blooms muted but vivid in the pale glow.  The pond shimmers, still and inviting beneath the stars.  In a moon-dappled clearing, perfect for quiet reflection, a sprawling stone manor rises in the distance - still, timeless, and bathed in ethereal light.  An arched modwir gate provides access to the wilds beyond
location: Zrenigotham House, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Zrenigotham House, Sitting Room]
