description: Moonlight filters through a large mahogany-framed window with built-in seating, casting a silver glow across the sitting room.  Lamps latticed with thin silver metalwork are placed about, joined by a small stone fireplace as a source of ambience in the cozy area. A padded pale ivory silk settee and two armchairs invite rest, while a glass-topped sidetable awaits nearby.  Bookcases line the walls, brimming with literary gems, and fresh flowers add subtle color.  A winding staircase offers access to the upper level and a set of glass-paneled doors open up to an arched hallway.
location: Zrenigotham House, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Zrenigotham House, Kitchen]
description: Moonlight filters in through a wide double-pane window, casting a silvery glow on the smoke grey stone floors flecked with pale rose inclusions.  The rich mahogany walls deepen in shadow and a dining table, ringed by carved dark wood chairs, is draped with cool ivory linen.  A standalone pantry with detailed doors looms like a relic near one wall, resting on clawed feet.  A cloud grey porcelain sink rests upon a long counter beneath the window's pale light, while an arched hallway offers access back to the sitting room.
location: Zrenigotham House, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Zrenigotham House, Pond]
description: From the stillness of the water, the orchard surrounds you in a hush of moonlight and shadow.  Branches stretch above like dark lace against the sky, their reflections wavering softly around you.  The grassy shoreline forms a gentle rim, edged with wildflowers and fallen fruit that scent the cool night air.  Crickets sing from the trees, and the breeze stirs ripples that carry the hush of the orchard across the pond.
location: Zrenigotham House, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Zrenigotham House, Master]
description: A winding staircase leads to the master chamber, where tall windows offer a moonlit view of the orchard, its trees silvered under the night sky.  Soft shadows stretch across the room, cast by the pale glow drifting over a great carved modwir bed upon an expansive rug of lush miniver, its outline gentle in the dim light.  Modwir nightstands stand quiet gaurd, each bearing an elegant glass lamp.  A brass sidetable holding a white porcelain basin rests near mahogany-framed mirror.
location: Zrenigotham House, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Boatyard Dock]
description: Built over the rocks and sand of a promontory that juts a short distance into the Locksmehr River, this dock has been patched together several times since its creation.  Newer planks mingle with the old, and irregular gaps between them show that the work was done with haste rather than precision.  A stout fishing vessel is tethered to the pilings, its sails in dire need of mending, and a row of sturdy wooden dinghies is moored along the far end.

title: [Nautilus, Glassthread Chamber]
description: Beyond the entry, an expansive chamber unfolds beneath the vaulted arcs of the immense nautilus.  Gossamer filaments of glassthread vine crisscross the septa, each strand swaying gently in the lazy currents that drift through.  Flecks of bioluminescent plankton cling to the glassthread, lending the room a soft, dynamic shimmer.  Broad, nacreous ribs of shell curve overhead, and silken sediment settles in gentle riffles along the floor that mirror the graceful ridges above.

title: [Gnifty's Armory]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A cedar and oak footlocker and a cedar and oak footlocker sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Raincail's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table and a simple wooden shelf sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Raincail's Armory]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A plain wooden table and a simple wooden shelf stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Raincail's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a plain wooden table and a simple wooden shelf.

title: [Salty's Services, Exterior]
description: A promenade off of some wide sand-stuck stairs leads up from the distant beach and opens on a metal-patched driftwood warehouse.  Before the warehouse is a boardwalk-style through-way that is mostly empty.  Occasional fishers, gaudily dressed merchants, or townsfolk pass.  Adjacent to the warehouse, a small and seaweed-lined shack is built and lit by torches lining its walls.  pposite and across the promenade from the shack, a distressed hovel leans against the warehouse.

title: [Salty's Services, Foyer]
description: Opening off of a wide driftwood arch, the area is cavernous and spare, with high ceilings and a plain wooden floor scattered with loose sand.  Varied multihued banners line the wooden walls, each adorned with the sewn-on image of a stylized kraken.  Above, a metal brazier hangs from the ceiling, casting a dim light across the warehouse entry.  A narrow winding stairway disappears upward into the warehouse's second floor, while a broad kelp-lined curtain opposite the arch leads further inward.

title: [Salty's Services, Warehouse]
description: A broad kelp-lined curtain opens on a massive warehouse facility.  Sturdy-looking wooden beams reinforced with iron bars hold the towering structure in place over a domed roof lit by wide metal braziers.  A wide path leads forward and is flanked by small standalone buildings within the facility, each in a varying state of repair.  Battered-looking hovels reside alongside well-maintained storefronts.  Vendors and potential customers alike walk the hall, perusing the options.

title: [Salty's Services, Warehouse]
description: The dissonance between storefronts on either side of the broad path is pronounced.  Alongside well-maintained buildings with pristine, shining materials lined with colorful banners and signage, dumpy-looking driftwood assemblages lean upon their better-maintained neighbors like drunken family members at parties who have had one too many.  Passers-by stop and consider options on their path down the thoroughfare, and the overall warehouse size causes voices to carry into its ceilings with a faint echo.

title: [Salty's Services, Warehouse]
description: A fire has swept through the area, only affecting one side of the storefronts along the broad path.  These ruined buildings are now a mix of burned driftwood, fire-marked metal, ruined cloth, and dark, debris-mixed sand that is piled high atop the entire mess, likely to help smother the initial blaze and subsequent smoldering remains.  Small wooden posts linked by thick rope separate the ruins from the path and the surviving shops across from them, which carry on unmarred by the fire.

title: [Salty's Services, Warehouse]
description: The path widens, expanding out into an oval around a stone starfish fountain with a shallow stone pool beneath it.  This fixture dominates the area and is surrounded by children playing by the pool's edges, customers stopping to appreciate the fountain, and tired-looking vendors sitting cross-legged by the water.  Above, a wide sailcloth sheet dyed a bright violet attached to shops on either side of the promenade overhangs the scene, enclosing the area in an attempt to give it greater serenity.

title: [Salty's Services, Warehouse]
description: The way through the warehouse dead-ends in a semicircle of shops surrounding a wood-lined marble relief of a thrashing kraken, which faces the path into the area, its many marble tentacles splaying outward from the relief's main body.  Two of the relief's tentacles prominently clutch a silver-bordered driftwood sign.  The entire installation is directly opposite some wide stone benches carved with a starfish motif, where several warehouse merchants and customers take repose.

title: [Krytze's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Krytze's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Krytze's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Rhodrimawr's General Store]
description: Enclosed by patterned white walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a plain wooden table and a simple wooden shelf.

title: [Rhodrimawr's General Store]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the patterned white walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a plain wooden table on one side of the shop and a simple wooden shelf on the other.

title: [Rhodrimawr's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the patterned white walls.  A plain wooden table and a simple wooden shelf sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Nisugi's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Faiyth's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A swirl-pattern deep bloodwood stand and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Salty's Services, Landing]
description: A tangle of ropes and netting hangs over a wide room off a narrow winding stairway.  Caught within the amalgamation are varied larger containers, lengths of wood, fishing poles, and tattered bits of clothing.  The room is relatively unadorned, except for triangle-shaped series of votive-topped barrels at its center.  Amidst the barrels, Administrator Salty stands, leaning on a propped-up driftwood sign atop one of the barrels, facing the stairway.

title: [Salty's Services, Displays]
description: Stone and wood-carved creatures, figures, and objects of varying size and shape clutter this section of the warehouse, placed in a disorderly manner such that there is no clear path through them from one end of the area to the other.  The carved figures represent a collection ranging from sea creatures to noteworthy Kraken's Fall sights and figures.  Above, several iron braziers cast a significant light across the area, ensuring the room is bright enough to observe the multitude of decorative options.

title: [Salty's Services, Displays]
description: Art pieces adorn this section of the warehouse, which is also set with a thick black carpet that fills most of the floor.  Small carved statues are set across this carpet, while the driftwood walls are lined with tapestries, paintings, and boards stuck with various sea creatures.  To one side of the room, a puce-hued plush easy chair is placed, and sitting upon its overstuffed cushions is a stout half-elf vendor.  Alongside the vendor are painting supplies, bolts of cloth, discarded bits of food, and empty bottles.

title: [Salty's Services, Walls]
description: The area is spare, with its most prominent feature being a wide wooden bench carved with twin starfish set in the room's middle over a threadbare carpet.  This bench offers a view of the area walls, which are an amalgamation of style and material, mirroring the options for sale here as individual segments of wall.  Simple votives are set alongside the bench and are also interspersed throughout the room, allowing for better viewing of the varying types of wall patterns the warehouse offers to prospective merchants.

title: [Salty's Services, Signs]
description: Preconstructed signs made from various woods are densely stacked across the area, as if the entire storage operation for them is contained within the room.  Signs and sign-making materials are placed precariously to the height of several giantkin wall-to-wall.  Flecks of paint aggressively splatter the floor and also the ceiling, like whoever made these signs was set in a pitched battle against them.  A dark iron brazier, also speckled with paint, hangs from the ceiling and dimly lights the area.

title: [Salty's Services, Ceilings]
description: Unlike other areas of the warehouse, the room is pristine.  Long, rectangular samples of wood, glass, and stone used in ceiling work lean against the walls and are interspersed by varied plants whose pots match the wood color they are set alongside.  Above each ceiling material sample board, wall-inset votives lend a decent amount more light to the area than other, adjacent parts of the warehouse.  The floors are covered by carpets in a variety of darker tones, primarily shades of blue and purple.

title: [Salty's Services, Containers]
description: Samples of wood and stone are cluttered alongside a small raised platform to one side of the area.  Upon this platform, a tired half-elf vendor stands, surveying the merchandise and watching passers-by.  Alongside the vendor is a sturdy-looking wicker chair and several votives that light the platform.  Surrounding the platform, and next to the example wood planks and stone slabs, are completed pieces of furniture for sale, including racks, tables, and other displays.

title: [Salty's Services, Containers]
description: Boxes, trunks, baskets, and other smaller containers of varying woods are collected about the area, approximating the offerings that prospective merchants might purchase from this section of the warehouse.  Each of these containers is open, giving customers a complete view of what to expect from a sale, except for a starfish-set driftwood chest conspicuously set to one side.  Votives of varying size are set alongside each container, providing a dim light to better consider options.

title: [Salty's Services, Roofs]
description: Sample building materials are piled high along the walls and are stacked high in the corner as the way through the warehouse turns at a sharp angle.  Long planks of driftwood, oak, bamboo, and several other woods are set in clear view of this main path.  Above, the warehouse is noticeably damaged, and a conspicuous fabric-covered hole stretches broadly across a wide section of ceiling, with a muted light filtering down through it.

title: [Salty's Services, Facades]
description: Loose building materials are strewn about the area.  Nails, buckets of pitch, and varied boxes half-full with supplies are set about haphazardly.  Above, a hanging metal brazier forged in the shape of a starfish provides a meager light to the collection.  Periodic figures pass through the area, stepping around the accumulation to proceed.

title: [Salty's Services, Management]
description: One side of the room is set with a series of cabinets, desks, and chairs, each stacked and overflowing with papers.  A brazier hanging above is set with votives and provides a bare light.  The room's other half is the through-way, with periodic merchants and customers walking through on their way to other parts of the second floor.  Shuffling around and busying themselves with the papers scattered across the room's more cluttered half is a weathered tall half-elf, the local shop authority.

title: [The Jocular Oculist, Main Deck]
description: Swaying to and fro, near-white canvas sails flap noisily in the breeze, adding a calming distraction from the vessel's rushed crew members.  Red pine planking, laden with puddles from a recent washing, stretches across the deck in eye-catching patterns of mixed horizontal and vertical arrangements.  Thick braided ropes hang from brass hooks along the main mast which casts shadows across a wooden grate in the center of the main deck.  Adjacent to a red pine gangplank, some stairs lead down to the lower level.

title: [The Dragon Macaw, Deck]
description: The expansive deck is made of highly polished teak with occasional gear-shaped scuffs providing purchase.  Twists of colorful sailcloth stitched with stylized dragon-like parrots swoop between ironwood poles and hold dozens of tiny crystalline lamps glittering in the sunlight.  A gear-framed sign points toward the main cabin, which is invitingly open, but all other egresses into the ship are heavily guarded by scowling burghal gnomes armed to the teeth.

title: [The Dragon Macaw, A-Parrot-ly]
description: One entire wall of the cabin is comprised of a jade and wrought iron tree with dozens of spreading branches covered in lifelike mechanical parrots.  The rest of the cabin is awash with gadgets, gears, and mechanical doo-dads in various stages of assembly.  Behind a counter almost but not quite free of clutter, a burghal gnome sits tinkering with a bright green mithril parrot.

title: [Optimistic Views, Cabin]
description: Rose-colored silks drape decoratively across red pine rafters that frame a wooden grate in the ceiling.  Neatly arranged on a glass counter are velvet-lined boxes filled with a variety of wares, and a small brass tree displays some of the shop's more sophisticated offerings.  Placed prominently on the wall between some stairs and a wooden door carved with sea creatures is a brass plaque.

title: [The Peashirmen]
description: Little more than a fishing boat, the skiff is painted bright orange and edged in glossy black.  Low seats are attached to the gunwale, the trio set at the center of the vessel, while a canvas tarp is draped across the triangular stern and bound in place by rope lashings.  A single, lateen-rigged pine mast rises out from the boat, its bright purple and yellow sail safely furled and lashed in place.

title: [The Resonant Hull, Deck]
description: Weathered cypress and aged cedar form this double-masted vessel, its hull and railings lacquered in deep vermilion.  Two angular fin-shaped sails rise from the deck like the wings of a folding screen, while the vessel's heart houses a small-roofed chamber, its sliding paper-paneled screens and graceful hipped roof framed by natural wood planking.  Bare plank decking runs stem to stern between carved rail posts, where a narrow boarding ramp extends like an outstretched hand.

title: [The Resonant Hull, Chamber]
description: Sliding paper-paneled screens line three faces of the chamber, their pale latticed surfaces diffusing light evenly across the interior.  The rear wall stands in contrast, solid cypress planking running floor-to-ceiling in continuous grain, supporting the racks and stands arranged before it and along the side walls, while two woven mats sit toward the center, flanking a low cypress table.  Providing accenting hues, vermilion trim follows the base of each wall and the screen rails above.

title: [The Lucky Nirisaka]
description: Weathered jadewood planks comprise the vast majority of the ship and its deck, evidence of a ship long at sea; affixed to the prow, however, arches a polished ghostwood figurehead of a one-eyed flounder, its ugly ghost white countenance a contrast to its dark green surroundings.  A smaller, more whimsical version of the nirisaka is carved into a sign dangling above a side entrance of the ship's spacious cabin.

title: [The Lucky Nirisaka, Wares]
description: Lotus silk panels adorn the walls; dark-to-light oceanic-inspired shades rise from the floor to meet with swirls of dusky pink, gold, and jacinthe hues arched with gradient blues growing ever darker until they meet the starsilk-draped ceiling, a silken sunset over a deep ocean.  Sea life origami adds a bit of whimsy, with more displayed in a corner case.  A tall counter separates the front of the shop from the back, where numerous variations of erithi clothing are neatly stacked along shelves and in bins.

title: [The Skinstainery]
description: Splotches of ink and scraps of parchment sketches cover the warped wooden planks of a small parlor with a driftwood worktable in the center.  To one side, the shelves of a repurposed bookshelf are crowded with jars of pigment, stained cloths, and needles, while a hatch-marked partition has iron hooks from which hang a slew of leather aprons.  A folding chair sits next to a dented metal bucket in the work area lit by a sooty brass lantern swaying overhead.

title: [The Kraken's Dispatch, Deck]
description: Polished from stem to stern, the ship has pristine sails painted with the flotilla's signature ebon kraken floating in a crimson pool on a field of emerald green.  Large crates are stacked everywhere, each stamped with various ports of call and the phrase, "Mail for the Flotilla if you can find it."  A spacious staircase leads down, with a neatly lettered sign right next to it.

title: [The Kraken's Dispatch, Delivery]
description: Behind a polished mahogany counter, shelves and cubbies line the walls, filled to overflowing with packages, parcels, envelopes, and letters.  Mail accoutrements for purchase are neatly displayed along the walls closest to the spacious staircase leading up to the main deck.

title: [Pearls Before Brine, Deck]
description: Sheets of patched canvas stretch overhead, forming a sun-bleached awning above a broad, uneven deck.  A rusted anchor chain snakes between overturned crates forming makeshift tables, a variety of trinkets and wares piled on top.  Towards the bow, a pair of skull-shaped iron lanterns illuminate a narrow opening to a steep stairwell that leads down into the cargo hold.

title: [Pearls Before Brine, Hold]
description: Thick with the scent of brine and tar, the hold is cramped, the low beams forcing most visitors to stoop.  Along one bulkhead, repurposed crates have been stacked to form shelves of salvaged goods, while to the stern, a makeshift door crafted from an old hatch leads into a storage alcove stuffed with battered trunks.  A tattered parchment chart marked with red-inked routes lies on a rickety gaming table strewn with candle stubs and empty rum bottles.

title: [She Sells Seashells]
description: A makeshift canopy of hempen rope and sailcloth covers the oiled mahogany-framed shop, the draped lengths decorated with globes of vibrant glass casting a kaleidoscope of colors across the map-covered counter.  At the center of the room sits a driftwood sculpture of a coconut crab, its upraised claws clutching garlands of dried flowers and palm fronds while its short legs sit buried in a barrel of black sand.

title: [The Merry Kraken, Deck]
description: The Merry Kraken stretches wide and long, a kraken-carved arch leading into a covered area taking up the majority of the upper deck.  Flying from the mainmast is a white flag embroidered with a whimsical lemon yellow kraken holding several drinks in its lavender-hued tentacles.  Cargo waiting to be secured in the hold below is stacked neatly in multiple places across the deck, and a sign points to the arch saying, "Market of Lost Things this way."

title: [The Merry Kraken, Market Entry]
description: Dim light filters in through two bullseye windows to port and starboard, casting mote-filled rays of light and shadow along the piles of canvas-covered wares that almost fill the entryway.  Some oversized double doors of iron-reinforced oak lead into the market.

title: [Market of Lost Things]
description: Lanterns of tinted glass sway from chains overhead, painting the planked floor in drifting patches of red and turquoise.  Stacked crates form a crooked walkway between crowded stalls displaying their wares, the underlying clink of coins echoing throughout the market.  Along the starboard wall, a crudely painted kraken points the way to the nearest exit.

title: [Market of Lost Things]
description: The passage is divided by reinforced beams that frame narrow entries to storage alcoves, some converted to small kiosks or makeshift sleeping bunks.  Hooks and nails crowd every available plank, holding lanterns, baskets, and signs advertising wares.  Cargo nets hang overhead, securing a few forgotten wine barrels bearing brands from foreign ports.

title: [Such Strong Hands]
description: Framed by dark wood, the stall is lit by archaic lanthorns anchored to its four supports.  Salt-stained shingles create a functional roof, while brass and bronze fixtures keep the various shelves anchored to the three walls.  Trinkets crafted of bone line the shelves, their smooth faces slightly yellowed and illuminated by the surrounding lanterns.

title: [Fashion Always Floats]
description: Roughly hewn pearwood walls, waterlogged and discolored, create a small, close-quarters kiosk covered by an awning fashioned from ragged sailcloth in sun-faded hues of red and yellow.  Hay and dried sea grass are scattered across the ground, the brittle blades crumbling as shoppers move through the space.  Despite being illuminated by several candle-filled bronze lanterns, the wares arranged within nearby chicken coops remain difficult to make out, resembling nothing more than piles of plucked feathers.

title: [Market of Lost Things]
description: The straight passageway is narrow, with small brightly painted kiosk fronts packed shoulder to shoulder.  Floorboards are reinforced by crossbeams, forming visible seams that mark old repair work.  At the far end, a rope hoist pulley is fixed along the low ceiling for lifting crates to the lower deck levels.

title: [Market of Lost Things, Hold]
description: Draped in layered silks that mute sound and filter lantern light into soft pinks and ambers, the corridor is filled with perfumed smoke curling up into the evenly spaced beams overhead.  Painted signs promise fortunes, trinkets, and wines of rare vintage.  Along the bulkhead, oaken barrels double as tables where merchants sip spirits, trade gossip, and throw dice.

title: [Market of Lost Things, Hold]
description: The floor of the hold is formed from salvaged decking arranged in tight squares over grating that drains to the bilge.  A handful of permanent stalls line the curved walls, framed by iron struts wrapped in hemp rope, while the central aisle remains open for handcarts and barrows.  Folding canopies of patched sailcloth stretch from beam to beam, allowing the market spaces to reconfigure as needed.

title: [Offshore Fashion]
description: Loosely knotted lengths of fishing net decorate the salt-stained walls of orange and blue canvas, the lattice weighted by iron hooks displaying several garments.  Paper-lacquered nielira and narwhals stand posed at the sides of an oversized brass-plated chest, their tentacles and horns hanging lengths of colorful jewelry.

title: [Market of Lost Things, Hold]
description: The vessel's cargo braces have been converted into permanent booth partitions, creating compact vendor alcoves arranged around a central tent area.  Low ceilings and uneven flooring make movement cramped, but clever carpentry has added trap storage compartments underfoot.  Warped wicker baskets brimming with ripened fruits and bins of exotic spices fill the air with an intoxicating scent.

title: [Red Skies, Main Deck]
description: Freshly swabbed, the wooden planks of the main deck are painted a deep crimson.  Iron-ringed masts rise up from the center of the ship, their rigging blackened with pitch, and overhead, the canvas sails hang like tattered scarlet wings flapping in the salt-laced sea breeze.  Coils of rope and stacked barrels line the railings, while a great wheel of dark cocobolo wood stands aft, its surface polished smooth by the hands of countless helmsmen.

title: [Red Skies, Wares]
description: The low-ceilinged cabin is lit by a swaying oil lantern, the smoky light casting sharp shadows across a pair of crossed cutlasses ornamenting the stern wall.  A broad mistwood table bolted to the floor dominates the center, strewn with curled charts, navigational tools, and a half-drained bottle of rum.  Crimson drapes frame the expansive, salt-stained windows, while a bed constructed of oak and rope lies tucked behind a curtain of faded sailcloth.

title: [The Reel Deal]
description: Carved driftwood poles propped up about the small tent support lengths of pale sailcloth.  A dark, threadbare carpet covers a wooden floor made of deck boards.  Hanging from one of the beams, a copper lantern sways back and forth above an iron-banded oak barrel.  Tucked in the back of the space is a polished driftwood table covered with various objects.

title: [The Reel Deal]
description: Thick sailcloth is supported by a frame of carved driftwood that creates the walls and canopy of the spacious tent.  A bronze-edged wooden chest is centered on a worn dark carpet that partially covers the deck board flooring.  A pair of sconces illuminate a tiered driftwood stand surrounded by stacks of crates, boxes, and various supplies.

title: [Tempest Queen, Main Cabin]
description: Whitewashed and trimmed in gilt, the main cabin is lavishly decorated with turned wood columns and fanciful scrollwork.  Crystal chandeliers hang in a spacious salon flanked by first-class staterooms, while a grand staircase leads to amusements on the upper deck.  Music and laughter spill through a pair of swinging doors.

title: [Tempest Queen, Second Deck]
description: Plush carpet runners muffle the sounds of constant foot traffic between the lounges and entertainments on this level and the main deck below.  Tucked into dimly lit alcoves along the hallway, velvet-cushioned settees invite respite and casual conversation.  On the starboard side, a gilded plaque is mounted on a burnished mahogany door.

title: [Tempest Queen, Smoking Lounge]
description: Reserved for gentlemen, the richly appointed lounge smells of fragrant tobacco.  Opposite a gilded arch, a pair of brass-buttoned dark leather couches faces each other across a low ivory-inlaid table.  A felt-topped gaming table is arranged with a quartet of high-backed chairs, a trolley nearby stocked with playing cards and white jade dice.

title: [Tempest Queen, Upward Deck]
description: Enclosed by a sturdy railing, the uppermost deck of the barge offers an omnidirectional view of the environs.  Huddled in the middle, rows of chaise lounges are kept clear of the promenade area.  A burnished brass signal bell hangs in silence outside of an abandoned pilothouse housing the ship's wheel.

title: [Tempest Queen, Lathes' Cabin]
description: Featuring a spectacular colored glass window spanning the cabin's width, this private parlor for the ladies aboard offers plush velvet chairs and settees, all in shades of deep crimson and rich gold, arranged for intimate conversation.  A silver serving cart is laid out for a tea party, the delicate porcelain settings painted with a lace pattern and rimmed with gold.  A centerpiece of fresh peonies nestled in greenery fills the room with a sweet, yet refreshing fragrance.

title: [Tempest Queen, Saloon]
description: Dimly lit by brass lanterns casting an amber glow over worn wooden tables and mismatched chairs, the saloon walls are adorned with peeling parchment posters and faded illustrations that tell a story of the boat's history.  A polished mahogany bar showcases an array of cut glass decanters and liquid-filled bottles that glint in the low light, while a dwarven bartender serves up drinks with a showman's flair.  Amidst a cloud of cigar smoke, patrons sing off-key to the tinny melody of an aged music box in the corner.

title: [Tempest Queen, Stateroom]
description: Fine linen curtains frame an overlarge porthole in the wall above a carved mahogany bed featuring a plump, feather-stuffed mattress.  Partially concealed by a silk-screened partition, a bar of fragrant cedarwood soap floats on the surface of a water-filled, copper tub next to a small stool piled high with plush cotton towels.  A crumpled pamphlet lies on top of a polished mahogany night stand, an open drawer revealing a cut glass decanter and a shot glass of whiskey.

title: [Derelict Queen, Ramp]
description: While the outer hull of The Derelict Queen is battle-scarred, the bow is pristine, with polished interlocking oak and teak decks and a carved mahogany figurehead.  Ivory canvas sails are attached to sturdy masts with neatly arranged rigging, while a brilliant incarnadine sail edged in midnight black stands out at the foresail.  Fluttering in the ocean breeze, a flag flies from the prow.

title: [Derelict Queen, Main Deck]
description: Ivory canvas sails stretch above the oak and teak floor, the tall masts casting shadows across the incarnadine ramp framed by knotted hemp ropes.  A rope-entwined ironwood staircase leads upwards to a velvet-curtained archway flanked by iron-forged windows, the sea glass geometry highlighted by slivers of nacreous shells, each cluster of glass forming images of sealife.  Affixed across the masts are weblike lengths of ebony netting, the ladders anchored to curved eahnor hooks set at various intervals.

title: [Derelict Queen, Deck]
description: The faint cry of cormorants echoes high above the deck, the avian forms gliding across the black-edged incarnadine sail fluttering with the ambient breeze.  Eahnor-forged cannons stylized like wyverns and griffins line the sides of the ship, their long claws hooking into the oak and teak floor, each one encircled by lengths of hempen rope.  A heavy iron chain drapes over the wooden railing, the weight covered in dried kelp and home to several crustaceans, the tiny crabs darting in and out of the links.

title: [Derelict Queen, Audience Room]
description: The thin-planked walls are covered from floor to ceiling with chests and coffers crafted from numerous woods and metals, the locked containers spaced out between carved marble statues of sea kobolds.  Rich, well-brushed furs line a trio of steps leading up to a lacquered silk-cushioned throne, the seat haloed by bladed weapons entangled in knotted lengths of rope.  Several barrels and chairs are scattered at the center of the room, each one decorated in the shredded lengths of patchwork flags.

title: [Kyncera's Cabin]
description: Hook-gathered lengths of velvet and brocade are draped across the wood-planked walls, the rich, ocean-colored tones partially obscured by the various flags displayed in states of disarray.  A cushion-covered bed spans the back of the cabin, curtained off in silver and gilt-beaded silks, the arabesques spilling down across the raised platform.  Nestled in the corner is a worn leather chair encircled by a pair of round tables, the surface covered by several bottles and blown-glass instruments.

title: [Fluctuations]
description: Bands of blue-white energy wreath an emerald green pillar centered in this circular chamber.  Symmetrically carved, flat white stones encircle the pillar, arranged to provide just enough space to walk around them.  The floor is covered in intricate, dark grey glyphs oriented in a series of complex geometric patterns between each obstacle.

title: [Coalescence, Dark Chamber]
description: Darkness consumes the furthest areas of this misshapen, twisted chamber, visibility nearly absent other than the dim light provided by a virid glow that emanates from beyond an angular twisted stone archway.  Virescent tendrils undulate and swirl out of a shallow haze-shrouded pool centered in the muddy ground, ebbing as they spread toward and cling to the jagged walls.

title: [Trapper's Shack, Addition]
description: This addition is somewhat larger than expected given the exterior dimensions of the shack.  Still, a simplistic approach was clearly taken in its construction, as there is very little in the way of adornment or embellishment to be seen.  A heavy table stands in the center of the room, and a large armor rack dominates the far wall.

title: [Coalescence, Dark Chamber]
description: This end of the chamber tapers toward a series of gouges in the misshapen walls.  The skeletal remains of a large, serpentine beast lie just below the gouges, its twisted length partially sunken into the muddy floor.

title: [A Pirate Looks at Four Teas]
description: White sand peppered with black covers the floor in wave-like patterns.  A bucket with a small shovel propped up against it sits on a small sand castle in the corner.  An iron-banded crate rests half submerged in the center of the room.

title: [Petal to the Metal, Entry]
description: Wads of moss and clumps of leaves have been shoved between the intertwined tree trunks making up the walls of this enclosed space, the extra foliage mixing together with the mottled lichen and climbing ivy vines covering every surface.  Filtered sunlight creeps in from the hole in the ceiling where woven branches form the roof, while hanging jars of phosphorescent algae illuminate the wares within a knotty pine display case and a hollowed tree stump.  A foggy glass-inset door leads to an attached greenhouse.

title: [Petal to the Metal, Greenhouse]
description: Flowers, bushes, and trees sprout in every open surface of this greenhouse, bathing in the sunlight that spills in from the glass panels that make up the walls and ceiling.  A raised flower bed runs along one wall, while the floor is mostly dirt with a cobblestone path bisecting the middle.  The air is full of the smells of moist earth.

title: [Aggro Culture]
description: Sooty grime clings to the warped wooden floorboards of the cramped store, some gouged and splintered from years of badly aimed trial swings.  The air is thick with the sour stink of sweat, old blood, and dust.  A sagging ebonwood counter sits crooked in the corner, flanked by a pair of rickety stocks repurposed into weapon racks.

title: [Petal to the Metal, Nook]
description: Sunlight filters through the branches of the ceiling and falls upon a tall leafy topiary shaped like an archer and a rickety wooden shield rack made from a trellis.  Moss covers the trunks of the trees making up the walls of this nook, while discarded leaves are scattered over the packed dirt floor.

title: [Be Warez, Backroom]
description: The backroom of the shop is well-lit, the silk-draped walls a sharp contrast to the decrepit area to the south.  An open dusty wooden chest sits upon a chaise of rich burgundy velvet, covered in bits of dried catnip and carcasses of gutted mouse-shaped toys.

title: [Underground Temple, Cave In]
description: The unevenly packed earth crumbles with the faint trembling from below, causing clouds of dust to cover the air in an obscure haze.  Fissures form along the ground, the cracks filled with rocks of various sizes, obscure pieces of armor, and a large maul wedged between the dirt, the weapon prominently etched with an asp wrapped around the head.  Raggedly cut cloaks and backpacks lay scattered across the larger boulders, spilling out their contents beneath the sand and detritus.

title: [Bloodforge, Smithy]
description: Bursts of heat drift in from an adjacent room, and a sulfuric scent lingers in the air.  A blackened pine sawhorse draped with layers of thick padding is nudged against a large worktable cluttered with numerous knives, tongs, chisels, and a variety of other instruments.  Burning embers escape from a small furnace in a fiery crimson spray and threaten to set the worktable ablaze.

title: [Beyond Barriers, Staves]
description: The silken walls of the massive crimson pavilion stir with an unseen, yet chilly wind.  Every corner of the tent is occupied by deep shadows that shift ever so slightly, like rolling waves of murky ink.  Eyeless scarlet despanal spiders crawl lazily along wooden posts, providing a warm, blood red glow to the room.

title: [Beyond Barriers, Blunts]
description: The silken walls of the massive crimson pavilion stir with an unseen, yet chilly wind.  Every corner of the tent is occupied by deep shadows that shift ever so slightly, like rolling waves of murky ink.  Eyeless scarlet despanal spiders crawl lazily along wooden posts, providing a warm, blood red glow to the room.

title: [Beyond Barriers, Ranged]
description: The silken walls of the massive crimson pavilion stir with an unseen, yet chilly wind.  Every corner of the tent is occupied by deep shadows that shift ever so slightly, like rolling waves of murky ink.  Eyeless scarlet despanal spiders crawl lazily along wooden posts, providing a warm, blood red glow to the room.

title: [Once Upon a Time]
description: Heavy lengths of charcoal grey velvet cover the western windows of the shop, blotting the scant moonlight crawling along the half-working clocks interspersed along the walls.  A fine shimmer of dust veils the hourglass-shaped tables at the center of the room, the flat surfaces littered with parchments and tomes stuffed with scraps of suede.  Copper-piped frames dangle polished pocketwatches along the eastern wall, the long chains swaying in perfect time with each tick.

title: [Hexbane's Outfitting]
description: The broad sweep of the wooden floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the painted black oak walls.  A heavy white granite counter and some hammered copper display hooks are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Hexbane's General Store]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A white marble shelf stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Hexbane's General Store]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a brass treasure chest on one side of the shop and a Vornavian silk-lined display case on the other.

title: [Shespar's Weaponry]
description: Knotty oak-paneled walls rise from a varnished dark oak floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs an oak-plaqued stuffed trout head, and an exposed pine rafter ceiling completes the picture.  A set of carved felwood shelves stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Shespar's General Store]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a vine-carved mahogany table on one side of the shop.

title: [Shespar's General Store]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a plain wooden table on one side of the shop.

title: [Sivalis' Outfitting]
description: Mahogany paneled walls rise from a dark-stained oak floor.  Just above a scaled model of Hearthstone hangs a portrait of Darkstone Castle, and a vaulted ceiling completes the picture.  A narrow glass-topped table stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Glimae'den Wildwood]
description: Towering tanik and modwir trees rise along the cobblestone pathway as it curves to the northeast, their branches intertwining overhead.  Fallen needles add a russet brown hue to a thick blanket of pincushion moss along the ground.  The air is cool and still, carrying the clean scent of pine and soil.

title: [Glimae'den Wildwood]
description: The forest opens onto a modest clearing, the ancient trees forming a natural alcove around a weathered building nestled among their trunks.  The whisper of wind through the high branches is joined by the low hum of bees drifting lazily near the building's eaves.  Fitted cobblestones lead the way to a pair of eight-paneled doors, marking the entrance to Cyrasei Lira'ka Meadery.

title: [Glimae'den Wildwood]
description: A break in the trees reveals a white oak trellis draped in sweet pea vines, their pink and purple blooms cascading down its sides in soft drifts of color.  Moss and fallen petals blanket the ground beneath the arch, the spent blossoms fading into dull hues.  The air carries the sweet fragrance of blossoms, mingled with the green scent of the surrounding forest.

title: [Cyrasei Lira'ka Apiary]
description: Sunbeams streak through breaks in the leafy canopy above, dancing across a red-streaked brown conical hive and a quadrate blue tanik beehouse as a gentle breeze wafts through the area.  From within the hives, a constant, harmonious buzz flows out to create a deep, peaceful thrum beneath the rustle of leaves.  Floral-carved windchimes hang from lower branches, blending smoothly with the hum from the colonies.

title: [Cyrasei Lira'ka Apiary]
description: Set within the shade of a towering tanik tree is a squat fyrswn'ava alveary with rounded graduating tiers, sunlight occasionally gleaming against its celadon bands.  Moss carpets the ground in thick, springy layers, dotted with clusters of wood sorrel and creeping thyme.  Fallen leaves in amber and bronze hues rest against exposed roots that curl through the soft earth like knotted fingers.

title: [Cyrasei Lira'ka, Veranda]
description: A lacquered cottonwood pergola, its crossbeams draped with thick honeysuckle vines, filters sunlight into shifting patterns upon a brightly colored mosaic centered within the cobblestone patio floor.  Scattered tables along the fenceline offer seating along with a view of the apiary beyond, while others are clustered closer to a pair of stained glass doors offering entry to the meadery.  The gentle hum of bees drifts across from the nearby hives, a constant, peaceful accompaniment to the clink of glasses and low conversation of those gathered.

title: [Cyrasei Lira'ka Meadery]
description: Hexagonal pine shelves line the walls in a honeycomb pattern, with some framing small windows overlooking the adjoining apiary.  Warm amber light filters through glass jars set within the windowed shelves, casting a soft glow across the worn, wooden floor.  Displayed among the other shelves are clay bottles of mead alongside candles, carved wooden dippers, and small pots of salve.  The scent of honey, vanilla, and almonds lingers in the air.

title: [Cyrasei Lira'ka Meadery]
description: A long slab of dark, polished mahogany, positioned upon old whiskey barrels, serves as a counter running the length of the far wall, its surface etched with years of use.  Oak stools padded with honey-toned leather are arranged in a neat row along the counter, while smaller tables with cushioned chairs sit in quieter corners.  Lit candles flicker in glass sconces along the walls, their soft glow reflecting off rows of bottles perfectly arranged on open shelving behind the bar.

title: [Sutara Flyr Emporia]
description: A thin veil of mist lingers in the air, faintly prismatic in the sunlight, as the sound of rushing water echoes from down an irregular slate walkway slick with moisture.  Frog calls drift through the area, rising and falling against the distant roar.  Rock cap moss blankets the stones and boulders bordering the walkway, the largest crowned by a carefully placed dragonfly statue.

title: [Sutara Flyr Emporia]
description: Gently leveled ground bordered by low stone edging and pockets of groundcover spreads out near the pond's northwest bank.  Crimson fountaingrass and split-leaf philodendron frame views of the pond and the flower-covered island beyond.  Small structures sit back from the shoreline, leaving broad stretches of open earth between them.

title: [Sutara Flyr Emporia]
description: Scattered clouds briefly obscure the sun, casting gentle shadows over cottages built along the pond's bank.  Between the cottages, ceramic statues of anthropomorphic mushrooms, painted in the vibrant red-and-white pattern of fly amanita, hold steel-wrought dandelion cypselae, some frozen in mid-flight.  Ripples in the pond weave around broad lily pads, each set with a small, unlit votive.

title: [Sutara Flyr Emporia]
description: Pickerelweed rises from the pond's edge, saffron bumblebees abuzz as they flit along the purple flowers.  Wood-bordered steps descend the gentle gentle slope, giving way to a crushed stone walkway meandering around the water.  Irregular paths break from the walkway and lead to small structures perched along the bank.

title: [Sutara Flyr Emporia]
description: Wandering between lush flower beds, a crushed stone walkway lined with evenly spaced crystal lanterns encircles a large pond dotted with blooming lily pads.  Twin willow trees, their cascading branches dipping into the water, frame a small wooden bridge leading to the central island.  A white lattice archway draped in flowering vines provides egress to Linsandrych Common.

title: [Sutara Flyr Emporia]
description: Tiny frogs hop from pad to pad as they travel the surface of the pond.  Along the banks, clusters of cattails sway, their brown fuzz beginning to turn fluffy and white.  Past the water's edge, on an island centered in the pond, a circular building rises amid fields of colorful wildflowers.

title: [Sutara Flyr Emporia]
description: Running east to west, a crushed stone walkway broadens as it meets a small wooden bridge that arches over the pond toward a central island.  Tall reeds, interspersed with blossoming stargrass, cluster along the bank, framing the bridge's approach.  Beyond the bridge, fields of colorful wildflowers surround a circular building crafted of stone.

title: [Sutara Flyr Emporia]
description: Winding along the pond's edge, a crushed stone walkway, bordered by clusters of creeping thyme, veers north from its westward path.  Bright cerulean dragonflies dart above floating lily pads, while small fish occasionally break the water's surface in pursuit.

title: [Sutara Flyr Emporia]
description: Several small structures face a wooden bridge of weathered planks, sunbleached to a pale grey, and the wildflower-covered island it connects to.  Colonies of monk's-hood lichen gather along the base of the bridge, spreading across debarked logs scattered near the pond's edge.  Large ceramic frogs, some dressed in enameled waistcoats and others sporting gold-glazed monocles, are whimsically posed atop the various logs.

title: [Sutara Flyr Emporia, Island]
description: Secluded from the emporia by reed canary grass at the edge of a wide pond, a small island garden forms a quiet oasis.  Centered within it, an alabaster marble fountain is encircled by four stone benches, while broad patches of wildflowers lend vibrancy throughout the space.  A circular building wrought from exposed timber beams and irregular stones rises just beyond the garden's heart, its solid construction marking a functional presence among the serene surroundings.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Sutana's Designs, Entry]
description: Interwoven woods in geometric patterns form a marquetry floor that radiates outward from a low, brass-edged pedestal at the center of the room.  Exposed beams and carved zydris trim define the broad, open space with a subtle decagonal outline.  Along one wall, a spiral-columned archway leads into the office, while evenly spaced floor braziers cast a steady glow upward, highlighting the woodwork and illuminating the surrounding walls.

title: [Sutana's Designs, Signage]
description: Narrow racks and angled stands hold an array of shop signs, each carved, painted, or framed with care.  Small hooks and easels display the wares at graduated levelsl, while placards note materials and finish.  Warm lantern light illuminates the subtle grain of wood, the texture of painted surfaces, and the delicate detail of each carving.

title: [Sutana's Designs, Facades]
description: Wide timber beams cross overhead, their surfaces smoothed by careful finishing.  Along the walls, scaled facade panels are mounted in neat rows, each displaying a different combination of wood, stone, or plasterwork.  Low tables hold labeled material samples arranged for easy comparison, while soft lantern light illuminates the space and catches on brass fittings.

title: [Sutana's Designs, Roofs]
description: Polished timber rafters catch the warm glow of hanging lanterns as they cast soft light across the room.  Neatly arranged along low shelves and angled display stands, miniature roof samples show a variety of shingles, tiles, and thatched coverings.  Small boards and labeled trays hold extra material samples, displaying the texture, grain, and finish of the various wares.

title: [Sutana's Designs, Containers]
description: Heavy shelving lines the walls, stacked with cases, baskets, and chests of varying size and material.  Hinged lids rest open on several displays, revealing smooth interiors and careful joinery.  Along a central worktable, smaller boxes are arranged in tidy rows beside labeled placards, while warm lantern light flickers across worn wood and woven fibers.

title: [Sutana's Designs, Surfaces]
description: Rows of tables, counters, and stands fill the room, each carefully finished and arranged for easy comparison.  Light from hanging lanterns glints off polished wood and lacquered surfaces, highlighting grains, patterns, and hand-carved details.  Small trays and boards hold material samples and miniature models for easy inspection of texture, color, and finish.

title: [Sutana's Designs, Ceilings]
description: The room is open and airy, with polished timber supports and angled scaffolds allowing easy viewing of miniature ceiling sections overhead.  Sample panels hang or rest on tilted displays, showing carved beams, vaulted arches, and delicate plasterwork.  Small placards and sample boards provide notes on materials, finish, and style, inviting careful inspection.

title: [Sutana's Designs, Walls]
description: Broad display frames line the room, each fitted with large wall sections showcasing different woods, finishes, and treatments.  Some panels are left smooth or knotted, while others bear scorch marks, stamped patterns, or brushed metallic accents.  Lantern light rakes across the surfaces at an angle, bringing out grain, seams, and subtle imperfections.  Low benches and labeled trays hold smaller samples for closer inspection of texture, color, and workmanship.

title: [Sutana's Designs, Wall Decor]
description: Soft textiles and framed pieces line the walls, hung from slender rails and wooden pegs arranged at varying heights.  Embroidered hoops, stitched charts, and woven tapestries share space with sketches, maps, and sculptural accents, each displayed with care.  Gentle lantern light warms linen, cotton, and flax, deepening dyes and drawing out fine threadwork, while small placards beneath each piece note materials, techniques, and origin.

title: [Sutana's Designs, Floor Decor]
description: Rugs and woven mats soften the floor beneath careful arrangements of sculpted figures and low furnishings.  Potted plants add subtle color among stone urns, wooden stools, and artful curios, their forms casting gentle shadows in the lantern light.  Glass and metal accents create a balanced display of comfort, craft, and whimsy viewable from every angle.

title: [Sutana's Designs, Flooring]
description: Broad sample platforms cover the floor in neat sections, each fitted with a different pattern of planks, boards, or inlaid wood.  Smooth paths guide visitors between displays, allowing grain, finish, and joinery to be seen up close and underfoot.  Lantern light reflects softly from polished surfaces while rougher samples show tool marks and natural flaws, offering a clear sense of texture, tone, and craftsmanship.

title: [Sutana's Designs, Office]
description: Polished timber floors, partially covered by an oversized red-on-black mandala rug, span the room, stretching between oak-paneled walls.  Arranged upon a carved mahogany desk are ledgers, stacks of parchment, and labeled material samples.  Along three walls, shelves hold miniature facade models, roof tiles, and wood panels, while a tall brass lamp in one corner casts light across the windowless room.

title: [Czeroth Tunnel, Threshold]
description: Deep, jagged claw marks scar the rock walls surrounding a steel-banded ironwood door, its surface equally marred.  Greenish black ichor mingles with faded maroon bloodstains along the pathway, both somewhat obscured by detritus, dust, and stones.  Rusted steel sconces, empty of torches, line the walls, several wrenched from their positions and left askew where the claw marks cross them.

title: [Czeroth Tunnel]
description: Water from Rainbow Falls cascades through a small, circular opening in the ceiling above the cavern, casting an array of prismatic hues against the tunnel walls as sunlight hits it.  The water gathers in recessed channels flanking the pathway and flows smoothly toward collection pools surrounded by honey fungus and orange lichen growing on logs of deadwood.

title: [Czeroth Tunnel]
description: The tunnel's pathway, strewn with scattered rubble, widens as it curves northwest.  Primitive drawings along the cavern's walls, framed in part by stalactites that have joined with stalagmites, depict battle scenes between humanoids and oversized insects.

title: [Czeroth Tunnel]
description: Clusters of thick stalagmites border the tunnel's pathway, creating a natural barrier from the severe drop on either side.  High overhead, rows of stalactites hang from the ceiling, their surfaces spiked with miniature crystals.

title: [Czeroth Tunnel]
description: An eerie clicking echoes throughout the area, its source unknown.  Grey-green stones litter the ground, and hollow, root-like indentations along the eastern wall frame a makeshift mithril-banded door.

title: [Czeroth Tunnel]
description: The tunnel narrows toward the center of the area, widening like a contorted hourglass at the northern and southeastern exits.  Coils of corroded steel wire, discarded along the ground, line the pathway, and gossamer webbing from silken threads creates a canopy overhead.

title: [Czeroth Tunnel, Cavern]
description: Shards of glass and corroded alchemical implements are scattered along the floor, concentrated in piles with the broken pieces of a mahogany table.  Against each wall is a moldy threadbare cot, the frames splintered and rotting, with tree roots dangling above creating makeshift partitions.  A stone surface, chiseled flat, rises from the center of the cavern, atop which rests a set of exoskeletal remains.  Though faded, ichor and blood stains can be seen along the ground, walls, and cots.

title: [Czeroth Tunnel]
description: Brownish grey sludge seeps through a crack in the stone overhead, slowly dripping down the craggy walls to settle in various puddles along the ground.  Patinated brass lanterns hang from rusted hooks on uneven stalagmites, formed in a tight row along the cavern's edge, serving as a natural barrier to the steep drop waiting beyond them.

title: [Czeroth Tunnel]
description: Ironwood rails mark the path through the tunnel as it descends southwest beneath an irregularly chiseled archway.  Several brackets have been pulled from the cavern walls, leaving sections of the railings to dangle uselessly.

title: [Czeroth Tunnel]
description: The tunnel curves downward in a steady, medium slope.  Poorly sanded and misshapen ironwood rails run parallel to the ground, secured to the walls with slipshod brass brackets.  Several broken rungs remain embedded in the walls, with jagged pieces scattered beneath them.

title: [Czeroth Tunnel]
description: Water drips from stalactites and trickles down the walls, turning the floor into a muddy slurry of small rocks.  A large crack in the stone, ringed with black fungus, swallows the runoff with slow gurgles.

title: [Czeroth Tunnel]
description: The stench of decay wafts from around a steel-banded ironwood door leading into Czeroth Labyrinth, mixing with the stale air within the tunnel.  Scattered along the ground are the remnants of ancient mining tools, most unrecognizable in their current state.
